We also release a benchmark dataset for label-free cell viability analysis to facilitate future research, available at https://amirrezavazifeh.github.io/ViabiLens-Project-Page/.

</details>


### [150] [Insights from Autoresearch for Solar Panel Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10491)
*Justinas Lekavicius,Kursat Komurcu,Valentas Gruzauskas,Linas Petkevicius*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 研究AutoResearch协议：语言模型在1小时GPU预算内编辑训练程序，仅保留验证IoU提升的改动；用于光伏板分割。三个24次实验的活动均改善基线，但保留的修改无法跨硬件迁移；Qwen3-8B纯真实图像配置测试IoU达0.836，略高于GAN增强参考的0.833。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探索编码语言模型能否在受限算力（1小时GPU）与仅验证集IoU反馈下自动改进训练程序，并检验此类自动搜索所得修改的可迁移性与实际性能，以光伏板分割为具体任务进行验证。

Method: 提出AutoResearch协议：语言模型编辑训练程序，在1小时GPU预算内运行，仅当验证IoU提升时保留改动。任务为冻结真实图像划分上的光伏板分割，骨干DeepLabV3--ResNet-50固定。开展三个活动、各24次实验，使用Gemma 4 12B与Qwen3-8B。

Result: 三个活动均优于各自的1小时基线；但保留的修改无法跨硬件迁移。Qwen3-8B仅用真实图像训练的配置测试IoU为0.836，参考GAN增强调度为0.833。

Conclusion: AutoResearch可在单小时预算内稳定改进基线，但增益依赖具体硬件，迁移性差；纯真实图像自动调优可匹配甚至略优于GAN增强参考方案。

Abstract: This paper investigates AutoResearch, a protocol in which a coding language model edits a training program under a one-hour GPU budget and retains a change only if validation IoU improves. The protocol is applied to photovoltaic panel segmentation on a frozen real-image split, with DeepLabV3--ResNet-50 held fixed. Three campaigns of 24 experiments, using Gemma~4 12B, Qwen3-8B all improve their one-hour baselines, but retained modifications do not transfer across hardware. The Qwen3-8B configuration, trained on real images only, reaches a test IoU of 0.836 versus 0.833 for the reference GAN-augmented schedule. Research repository https://github.com/VU-AIML/automl4eo-autoresearch-segmentation.

</details>


### [151] [QuadTok: Quadtree Visual Tokenizer for Autoregressive Image Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10497)
*Yucheng Mao,Zeyuan Chen,Xiaojun Shan,Xiang Zhang,Divyansh Srivastava,Bingnan Li,Zhuowen Tu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出QuadTok框架，用层次化四叉树结构进行视觉tokenization与自回归图像生成，在ImageNet上节省约10% token、COCO零样本迁移节省9% token，并在256×256 ImageNet达2.08 gFID。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统视觉tokenization采用2D网格或1D token序列，前者空间绑定强但灵活性差，后者序列灵活但缺乏空间结构。作者希望弥合2D空间绑定与1D序列灵活性之间的鸿沟，并让tokenizer能自适应地将表征容量分配给复杂区域。

Method: 提出层次化四叉树（quadtree）tokenization结构：动态为视觉复杂区域分配更多表征容量，对同质区域使用粗分辨率；利用树结构天然引入的因果性，在生成前给定四叉树拓扑作为条件，使用947M参数的GPT风格生成模型进行自回归图像生成。

Result: 相比固定256-token网格，ImageNet训练tokenizer节省约10% token，零样本迁移到COCO节省9%，同时保持相近重建保真度；947M GPT风格模型在ImageNet 256×256上取得2.08 gFID；并可实现零样本空间可控图像生成。

Conclusion: 四叉树结构有效结合了2D空间绑定与1D序列灵活性，在节省token的同时保持重建质量，并为自回归生成与零样本空间控制提供自然支持。

Abstract: We introduce QuadTok, a novel framework for visual tokenization and autoregressive image generation. Compared to traditional approaches using 2D grids or 1D token sequences, we propose a hierarchical quadtree structure, bridging the gap between 2D spatial binding and 1D sequence-level flexibility. The QuadTok tokenizer dynamically allocates representational capacity to visually intricate areas while leaving homogeneous regions at a coarse resolution. Compared with a fixed 256-token grid, our ImageNet-trained tokenizer saves approximately 10% of tokens on ImageNet and 9% when transferred zero-shot to the COCO dataset, while maintaining comparable reconstruction fidelity. Furthermore, the natural causality introduced by the tree structure seamlessly enables autoregressive image generation. Conditioned on a quadtree topology supplied before generation, our 947M GPT-style generative model achieves a 2.08 gFID on the ImageNet $256 \times 256$ benchmark. Additionally, leveraging the strong spatial correlation preserved by the quadtree structure, the QuadTok generator enables zero-shot spatially controlled image generation capabilities. Code: https://github.com/myc634/QuadTok.

</details>


### [152] [Video-Conditioned Generative Joint 2D-3D Hand Motion Recovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10512)
*Chen Xu,Yunqi Li,Binbin Huang,Brent Yi,Shenghua Gao,Yi Ma*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出JoHan：一个统一生成式框架，从视频序列直接恢复手部运动，无需逐帧中间姿态预测，联合生成对齐的2D与3D局部手部姿态序列，并借由学习的2D-3D对应关系恢复相机空间全局位置与朝向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从视频中恢复忠实的三维手部运动仍具挑战：频繁遮挡与不完整视觉观测导致逐帧姿态估计不可靠且时间上不一致。作者希望摆脱对中间逐帧姿态预测的依赖，直接在序列层面建模手部运动。

Method: JoHan是一个从头训练的统一生成式框架，直接从视频序列恢复手部运动。模型联合生成对齐的2D与3D局部手部姿态序列，学习其时间动态与跨表示对应关系。生成的2D轨迹利用2D图像中的直接空间与时间线索引导后续3D运动生成重建；学习到的运动先验促进时间一致性；学到的2D-3D对应关系进一步用于恢复手部相对相机的全局位置与朝向。

Result: 在具有挑战性的基准上，该方法在局部手部姿态与相机空间重建的准确率和速度上均有显著提升；相比已有方法能捕获更好的手部运动动态，在保持较高逐帧姿态精度的同时产生明显更平滑的运动。

Conclusion: 通过统一生成式建模与2D-3D对应学习，JoHan有效缓解了遮挡与观测不完整带来的逐帧估计不可靠问题，在精度、速度与运动平滑性上优于现有方法，为视频手部运动恢复提供了新范式。

Abstract: Recovering faithful 3D hand motion from video remains challenging due to frequent occlusions and incomplete visual observations, which make frame-wise pose estimates unreliable and temporally inconsistent. To address this problem, we propose JoHan, a unified generative framework that recovers hand motion directly from video sequences without relying on intermediate per-frame pose predictions. Trained from scratch, our model jointly generates aligned 2D and 3D local hand pose sequences by learning their temporal dynamics and cross-representation correspondence. The generated 2D trajectories exploit direct spatial and temporal cues from the 2D images to guide the following generative 3D motion reconstruction, while the learned motion prior promotes temporal consistency. Their learned 2D-3D correspondence further enables recovery of the hand's global position and orientation relative to the camera. Extensive experiments on challenging benchmarks demonstrate significantly improved accuracy and speed in local hand-pose and camera-space reconstruction. Notably, our method captures much better hand-motion dynamics, producing significantly smoother motion than previous methods while maintaining high per-frame pose accuracy.

</details>


### [153] [GRACE: Generation-aware latent compression for efficient video generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10524)
*Jiyoung Kim,Paul Hyunbin Cho,Jisu Nam,Donghoon Lee,Hyunsung Go,Yeonkyeong Lee,Hansaem Kim,Seungryong Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出GRACE两阶段框架，通过残差隐变量与生成感知对齐压缩预训练视频自编码器，在保持与预训练DiT兼容的同时实现8倍token压缩与11.1倍加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频扩散模型因DiT在大量token上运行而计算昂贵。高压缩比自编码器可减少token，但面临两大难题：其一，提升压缩比会降低重建质量，恢复质量需增加通道数，从而拖慢DiT收敛；其二，压缩后的隐空间分布与DiT训练时所用隐空间不一致，导致预训练DiT须从零重训或以高代价适配。即便压缩DiT原本训练所用的自编码器可保持兼容性，仅以重建为目标优化仍会使隐变量偏离DiT已学习的分布。

Method: GRACE为两阶段框架：1）隐空间压缩阶段，保留预训练编码器的冻结基础隐变量，学习一个残差隐变量以承载强压缩下丢失的信息，并在冻结DiT的特征空间中将压缩隐变量与预训练隐变量对齐，使自编码器以生成为目标优化；2）DiT适配阶段，采用轻量微调与非对称去噪，其中基础隐变量先于残差隐变量被去噪。

Result: 在480x832x81分辨率下，GRACE将Wan2.1-I2V-14B的token数量减少8倍，延迟降低11.1倍，同时在VBench上达到与压缩前预训练流程相当的生成质量。

Conclusion: 通过保留基础隐变量、引入残差隐变量并在冻结DiT特征空间中进行生成感知对齐，可在不牺牲生成质量的前提下大幅压缩视频自编码器隐空间，显著降低视频扩散模型的计算与延迟开销，并保持与预训练DiT的兼容性。

Abstract: Highly compressed video autoencoders offer an effective way to accelerate video diffusion models, as the Diffusion Transformer (DiT) operates on far fewer tokens. However, such autoencoders are challenging to train, since a higher compression ratio degrades reconstruction quality and recovering it requires more channels, which is known to slow the convergence of the DiT. The compressed latent also differs from the one the DiT was trained on, so the pretrained DiT must be either retrained from scratch or adapted at considerable cost. Compressing the autoencoder the DiT was trained with appears to preserve compatibility, yet optimizing it for reconstruction alone still shifts the latent away from the distribution the DiT has learned. To address this, we propose Generation-Aware Latent Compression for Efficient Video Generation (GRACE), a two-stage framework that compresses a pretrained video autoencoder while keeping it compatible with the pretrained DiT. Specifically, we keep a frozen base latent from the pretrained encoder and learn a residual latent for the information lost under stronger compression, while aligning the compressed latent with the pretrained latent in the feature space of the frozen DiT so that the autoencoder is optimized for generation. We then adapt the DiT with lightweight fine-tuning and asymmetric denoising, where the base is denoised ahead of the residual. GRACE reduces the token count of Wan2.1-I2V-14B by 8x and its latency by 11.1x at 480x832x81, while matching the generation quality of the pretrained pipeline before compression on VBench.

</details>


### [154] [Never Look Back: Understanding Persistence in 3D Object Memory from Egocentric Videos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10538)
*Shravan Chaudhari,William Paul,Suchi Saria,Rama Chellappa,Homanga Bharadhwaj*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 Ledger，一种从第一视角视频中构建的持久性 3D 物体记忆系统。它融合物体位置、历史与上下文描述，跨观测关联并在物体离开视野后保留记忆，通过聚类静置位置和重复证据确认移动来抑制定位噪声，并以简短描述保留内容与支撑面等信息。记忆可无需访问原始图像或视频即可回答空间问题，将 HD-EPIC 准确率从 29.7% 提升至 42.6%，UCS-Bench 从 33.8% 提升至 38.5%，并在 Ego4D 上取得 0.99 m 中位定位误差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类能在日常活动中记住物品位置、容器内容等，即使当时并不知道未来会用到。作者希望让具身助手通过观察人的第一视角视频，建立类似记忆，从而支持后续空间问答，而无需保留庞大的原始视频。

Method: Ledger 构建持久 3D 物体记忆，包含物体位置、历史与上下文描述；跨录制关联观测，并在物体离开视野后仍保留，包括人从未触碰的物体。方法将每个物体的观测按静置位置聚类，仅在出现重复证据后记录一次移动，以降低定位噪声影响；用简短描述保存物体内容或支撑面等细节，并将记录存储，使后续回答空间问题时不需访问原始图像或视频。

Result: 在 HD-EPIC 上准确率由 29.7% 提升至 42.6%，在 UCS-Bench 上由 33.8% 提升至 38.5%，并在 Ego4D 物体定位中返回预测的中位误差为 0.99 m。分析表明时间持久性、上下文描述与检索具有互补作用；对 100 条多场景拼接流的实验暴露了检索与构建两方面的失败；逐场景构建相比单场景流可部分恢复跨场景变化导致的性能损失。

Conclusion: Ledger 表明，从第一视角视频构建持久 3D 物体记忆可有效支持空间问答与物体定位，时间持久性、上下文描述和检索机制各自发挥互补作用；同时跨场景流的检索与构建仍是主要失效点，逐场景构建可部分缓解整体性能下降。

Abstract: As we move through the world and carry out everyday tasks, we encounter objects that may become relevant only later. We are capable of recalling where we left something or what was inside a container, even without knowing we would need it later. Here, we study how an embodied assistant can build a similar memory from egocentric videos, by observing a person's day-to-day activities. We present Ledger, a persistent 3D object memory that combines object locations, their histories, and contextual descriptions. It associates observations across the recording and retains objects after they leave the view, including those the person never touches. It clusters each object's observations by resting locations and records a move only after repeated evidence, reducing the effect of localization noise. Short descriptions preserve details such as an object's contents or supporting surface. It saves these records to later answer spatial questions without having to access the original images or video. Our memory raises HD-EPIC accuracy from 29.7% to 42.6%, UCS-Bench accuracy from 33.8% to 38.5% and localizes Ego4D objects with a 0.99 m median error on returned predictions. Our analyses identify complementary roles for temporal persistence, contextual descriptions, and retrieval. Our study on 100 stitched streams of multiple scenes each further exposes failures in both retrieval and construction. Per-scene construction partially recovers the performance lost across scene changes compared to that of single scene streams.

</details>


### [155] [Tetris3D: 3D Scene Generation With Objects That Fit Together](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10539)
*Jaeyeong Kim,Jinhyuk Jang,Jongmin Lee,Kyehong Park,Seungryong Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Tetris3D，一种单图 3D 场景重建生成框架，通过对每个对象的生成显式地以其邻近对象的几何与物理关系为条件，保证场景级几何与物理一致性，并发布含 120 万场景的物理仿真数据集 ComOb。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有单图 3D 场景重建方法通常独立生成各对象，或以隐式方式耦合对象关系，难以为相互作用的相邻对象提供细粒度空间兼容性约束，导致场景中出现几何与物理不一致。

Method: 将每个对象的生成显式地条件化于周围对象的几何信息及其物理关系，从而共同约束该对象的形状与位姿，使其在场景中保持几何与物理合理；同时构建 ComOb 数据集，基于物理仿真，包含 120 万个场景、跨多类别的物体交互，并提供逐对象网格与成对物理关系标注。

Result: 在合成场景与真实场景上的实验表明，Tetris3D 在交互区域被遮挡的情况下仍能恢复出一致的物体形状与位姿，并在生成质量和物理稳定性两方面达到当时最优性能。

Conclusion: 显式建模对象间几何与物理关系的条件生成，是提升单图 3D 场景重建场景级一致性的有效途径，且配套的物理仿真数据集为该方向提供了可扩展的监督与评测基础。

Abstract: We propose Tetris3D, a generative framework for single-image 3D scene reconstruction that recovers objects which are physically and geometrically coherent as a scene. Existing methods often generate objects independently or couple them implicitly, providing limited guidance for ensuring fine-grained spatial compatibility between neighboring objects that interact with one another. To address this, we explicitly condition the generation of each object on the geometry of surrounding objects and their physical relationships, guiding its shape and pose to remain geometrically and physically plausible within the scene. Moreover, we introduce ComOb, a physics simulation-based dataset of 1.2M scenes featuring physical interactions across diverse object categories, with per-object meshes and pairwise physical relation annotations. Comprehensive experiments on synthetic and realworld scenes show that Tetris3D recovers coherent object shapes and poses even when interacting regions are occluded, and achieves state-of-the-art performance in both generation quality and physical stability.

</details>


<div id='cs.CL'></div>

# cs.CL [[Back]](#toc)

### [156] [ExperienceIndex: Artifact-Grounded Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10091)
*Peter Baile Chen,Geoffrey X. Yu,Xinming Liu,Samuel Madden,Dan Roth,Jacob Andreas,Doug Downey,Michael Cafarella*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: ExperienceIndex是一种面向知识密集型任务的智能体经验层，通过存储和复用“单工件经验”与“工件对经验”来引导检索完整的相关工件集合，从而提升答案质量并降低在线成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 知识密集型任务需要在共享工件语料（如判例、科学文献）上进行推理问答。人类在与语料交互中会积累关于工件的经验知识，从而快速定位相关工件；而现有AI智能体缺乏此类以工件为中心的记忆方案，其记忆方法主要提取用户偏好、事实属性或抽象推理模式，忽略了持久化的工件特定知识，导致答案质量低、在线成本高。

Method: 提出ExperienceIndex经验层，基于既有推理轨迹捕获并复用关于工件的知识。其存储两种互补经验：一是单工件经验，概括某工件对以往任务的贡献；二是工件对经验，编码过去推理中发现的结构性关系。该层以轻量中间件形式集成，并采用经验检索机制，引导智能体为新任务找到完整的相关工件集合。

Result: 在不同语料和采用不同搜索框架的智能体方案上均取得一致收益：答案质量最高提升11.0分，在线费用最高降低50.5%。同时展示两项能力：跨任务泛化，即从文本到SQL任务积累的经验可迁移至同一工件语料上的事实型问答任务；以及师生学习，即强模型的经验可帮助弱模型达到可比性能。

Conclusion: ExperienceIndex通过捕获和复用工件层面的经验，为AI智能体提供了一种有效的记忆方案，在提升答案质量与效率的同时，还具备跨任务泛化和师生知识迁移能力。

Abstract: Knowledge-intensive tasks require answering many questions by reasoning about a shared corpus of artifacts (e.g., court cases, or scientific literature). As humans interact with these corpora, they naturally accumulate experiential knowledge about artifacts, enabling them to quickly identify the complete set of relevant artifacts for each new task. However, existing AI agents lack appropriate memory solutions to build or reuse such artifact-grounded experience, leading to lower answer quality and higher online cost. Existing memory solutions extract and reuse information from prior task-solving traces, but they primarily focus on user preferences, factual attributes, or abstract reasoning patterns rather than persistent artifact-specific knowledge. We introduce ExperienceIndex, a novel experience layer for AI agents that captures and reuses knowledge about artifacts based on prior reasoning traces. ExperienceIndex stores two complementary forms of experience: (i) single-artifact experiences that summarize an artifact's contribution to prior tasks and (ii) artifact-pair experiences that encode structural relationships discovered during past reasoning. Integrated as lightweight middleware, ExperienceIndex uses an experience retrieval mechanism to guide agents toward the complete set of relevant artifacts for new tasks, improving both answer quality and efficiency. Across diverse corpora and agentic solutions with different search frameworks, ExperienceIndex delivers consistent gains, raising answer quality by up to 11.0 points and reducing online dollar cost by up to 50.5%. We further demonstrate two benefits: (i) cross-task generalization, where experiences accumulated from text-to-SQL tasks transfer to factoid QA tasks over the same artifact corpus, and (ii) teacher-student learning, where experiences from a stronger model enable a weaker model to reach comparable performance.

</details>


### [157] [Child ASR Adaptation with Adult Retention: An Empirical Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08827)
*Houssam Eddine-Othman Lachemat,Shammur Absar Chowdhury*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 研究儿童语音ASR自适应中的“成人保留”问题，跨阿拉伯语与英语比较全量微调、LoRA及事后权重空间合并，发现权重合并能改善自适应-保留权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ASR系统对儿童及非母语说话人表现较差，而将成人ASR模型适配到儿童语音会导致成人语音能力遗忘（灾难性遗忘），因此需要研究既能提升儿童识别又保留成人性能的适配方法。

Method: 在阿拉伯语和英语上研究儿童ASR自适应与成人保留，比较全量微调、LoRA和事后权重空间合并三类方法，覆盖编码器-解码器、编码器-CTC和基于AudioLLM的ASR系统；使用阿拉伯语母语及非母语儿童语音、英语MyST儿童语音，以及MGB-2和LibriSpeech test-clean成人基准；用WER评估识别质量，并用Retention Index、Child Adaptation Gain和Adaptation Recovery量化自适应-保留权衡。

Result: 儿童自适应是必要的，对非母语阿拉伯语和英语儿童语音尤为明显，但直接适配常降低成人ASR性能；双语适配比单语适配更稳定；权重空间合并通常改善权衡，尤其对编码器-CTC、Whisper和AudioLLM类ASR，其中LERP更利于成人保留，TIES能恢复更强的儿童增益；对编码器-解码器模型，直接双语微调在原始WER上仍最强。

Conclusion: 儿童ASR适配需在提升儿童识别与保留成人性能间权衡；双语适配更稳定，权重空间合并（LERP/TIES）可有效改善该权衡，而编码器-解码器模型仍以直接双语微调在WER上最优。代码与模型已开源。

Abstract: Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) systems often underperform for children and non-native speakers, while adapting adult ASR models to child speech can cause adult-speech forgetting. We study child ASR adaptation with adult retention across Arabic and English. We compare full fine-tuning, LoRA, and post-hoc weight-space merging across encoder--decoder, encoder--CTC, and AudioLLM-based ASR systems. Experiments use Arabic native and non-native child speech, English MyST child speech, and adult benchmarks from MGB-2 and LibriSpeech test-clean. We evaluate recognition quality with WER and quantify the adaptation--retention trade-off using Retention Index, Child Adaptation Gain, and Adaptation Recovery. Results show that child adaptation is necessary, especially for non-native Arabic and English child speech, but direct adaptation often reduces adult ASR performance. Bilingual adaptation is more stable than language-specific adaptation. Weight-space merging often improves the trade-off, especially for encoder--CTC, Whisper, and AudioLLM-based ASR, with LERP favoring adult retention and TIES recovering stronger child gains. For the encoder--decoder model, direct bilingual fine-tuning remains strongest in raw WER.\footnote{Code, and models are available at https://github.com/qcri/Child-ASR-Adaptation.

</details>


### [158] [When Forgetting Looks Like Improvement: Metric Masking in Streaming Diarizer Adaptation and the Price of Rehearsal](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08828)
*Mo Yu,Yang Liu,Jing Qian*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 小数据自适应能提升语音检测，却会损害说话人归属。作者在7.5小时双人对话上微调流式分离器并在六个语料库评测，发现域内性能大幅提升且可迁移，但额外混淆主要来自时序身份一致性受损而非说话人数错误；重放（rehearsal）可缓解退化却削弱跨域迁移。呼吁联合评估检测准确率、身份一致性与保留行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 小数据自适应在语音检测上有效，但在说话人归属（speaker attribution）上表现退化，这一矛盾现象缺乏系统解释。作者希望厘清该差异的来源，并明确自适应对流式说话人日志系统身份维护机制的影响。

Method: 在已发布的流式分离器（streaming diarizer）上，使用7.5小时双人对话数据进行自适应微调，并在六个语料库上开展评测；引入局部重映射（local-remapping）诊断分析身份退化模式；并对比加入 rehearsal 后的性能变化。

Result: 自适应显著提升域内分离性能，并可迁移到独立语料；但提升在不同评测场景下不一致：额外混淆主要与受损的时序身份一致性（temporal identity consistency）相关，而非说话人数（speaker-count）错误。局部重映射揭示不同语料库存在不同的身份退化模式；rehearsal 能降低退化，却降低跨域迁移性能。

Conclusion: 自适应可能改变流式模型随时间维持说话人分配的方式。评估自适应后的流式分离系统时，应联合考察检测准确率、身份一致性与保留（retention）行为，而非仅看检测指标。

Abstract: Small-data adaptation can improve speech detection while degrading speaker attribution. We study this discrepancy in a released streaming diarizer adapted on 7.5 h of two-party conversation and evaluated across six corpora. Adaptation substantially improves in-domain diarization performance and transfers to an independent corpus. However, this improvement is not consistent across evaluation scenarios as the additional confusion is mainly associated with impaired temporal identity consistency rather than speaker-count errors. A local-remapping diagnostic reveals different patterns of identity degradation across corpora, indicating that adaptation may alter how streaming models maintain speaker assignments over time. Rehearsal reduces the observed degradation but reduces the cross-domain transfer performance. These results highlight the need to jointly evaluate detection accuracy, identity consistency, and retention behavior when adapting streaming diarization systems.

</details>


### [159] [Steering Follows Geometry, Not Labels: Emotion Directions in a Full-Duplex Speech Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08887)
*Pulak Kuli*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 研究全双工语音模型 Moshi 的情绪引导：情绪可从残差流线性解码，但激活引导仅部分可行且不均衡（happy/angry/surprise 共享方向，sad 可独立引导），且共享成分无法被等价地投影去除。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全双工语音代理在实时对话中需要调节情绪与表达方式（如缓和投诉、传递调度紧迫感、柔化临床结果）。现有情绪与表达控制研究主要集中于 TTS 与轮次式模型（提示条件、参考条件合成与激活引导），而 PersonaPlex 虽在全双工模型中控制身份，却不涉及情感。

Method: 在完全开源的全双工语音语言模型 Moshi 上，针对四类情绪开展情绪引导研究，采用均值差（mean-difference）激活引导方法，每帧仅需少量向量加法且无需重新训练。同时对残差流进行线性解码性分析，并考察三种情绪共享成分的可投影性。

Result: 情绪可从 Moshi 的残差流中线性解码；但激活引导仅能部分实现且效果不均衡：happy、angry 与 surprise 朝向一个共享方向可被引导，而 sad 的引导方向明显不同；此外，三种情绪共享的成分类别无法简单地从所有情绪中等价地投影去除。

Conclusion: 全双工语音模型中的情绪引导具有可解码性但可控性受限，情绪表征存在共享与特异的混合结构，简单的共享方向投影难以实现统一的情绪解耦控制。

Abstract: Full-duplex voice agents need to modulate emotion and delivery during real-time conversations, when de-escalating a complaint, carrying urgency in dispatch, softening a clinical result. Emotion and delivery control is well studied for TTS and turn based models through prompt-conditioned synthesis, reference-conditioned synthesis and activation steering; PersonaPlex controls identity in a duplex model but not affect.
  We study emotion steering in Moshi, a fully open sourced full-duplex speech language model, across four emotions, using mean-difference activation steering, which costs only a few vector additions per frame and no retraining.
  We show that emotion is linearly decodable from Moshi's residual stream, but activation steering is only partially achievable, and unevenly so; as happy, angry and surprise steer towards a shared direction while sad is distinctly steerable. We also show that the shared component across the three emotions cannot simply be projected away from all the emotions equally.

</details>


### [160] [Itgan at NADI 2026 shared task: Parameter-Efficient Whisper Adaptation for Robust, Mixed-Dialect and Code-Switched Arabic ASR](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09934)
*Ibrahim Almajai*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文介绍了 Itgan 团队参加 NADI 2026 三个阿拉伯语方言 ASR 子任务的系统，均基于消费级 GPU 上用 LoRA 微调的 Whisper，分别通过不同改进取得结果，并附有配对自助法检验及八条失败方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: NADI 2026 设置鲁棒国家级 ASR、混合方言 ASR 与突尼斯语码切换 ASR 三个子任务，需在有限算力下构建统一且有效的方言 ASR 方案，并厘清各改进手段的实际贡献。

Method: 三个子任务共用一套配方：在消费级 GPU 上用 LoRA 对 Whisper 进行适配，再各自叠加不同模块。1.1 采用按方言标签训练的专家模型，从共享适配器继续训练；1.2 比较不同基座模型与适配器容量，并引入去相关成员做系统融合；1.3 对独立训练的多轮结果做权重空间平均并结合 ROVER 投票。所有对比均采用配对自助法检验。

Result: 1.1 提交系统取得 57.1% 国家级平均 WER；事后在冻结编码器特征上做线性探针可无标签路由，恢复 oracle 路由收益的 44%。1.2 基座模型选择比适配器容量更重要，加入去相关成员后系统融合才有效，WER 为 46.7%。1.3 以 14.49% WER 位列第二，CER 5.38% 为领先提交中最低，其中最后 0.60 WER 来自无额外训练的权重平均，其余来自 ROVER。

Conclusion: 以 LoRA 微调 Whisper 的统一配方可高效覆盖多个方言 ASR 子任务，方言专家、基座选择与去相关融合、权重平均与投票在不同场景各有收益；同时作者报告了八条无效方向，强调需用配对自助法严格验证改进。

Abstract: We describe the Itgan systems for the three ASR subtasks of NADI 2026, namely robust country-level ASR (1.1), mixed-dialect ASR (1.2), and Tunisian code-switched ASR (1.3). All three share one recipe, Whisper adapted with LoRA on consumer GPUs, and each was carried by a different addition to it. On 1.1, where the dialect label is given at test time, per-dialect specialists continued from a pooled adapter gave the largest gain, and the submitted system reached 57.1% country-average WER. A post-evaluation linear probe on frozen encoder features routes utterances without the label and recovers 44% of what oracle routing gives. On 1.2 the choice of base model mattered more than adapter capacity, and system combination helped only once we added a decorrelated member, reaching 46.7% WER. On 1.3 our system placed second at 14.49% WER with the lowest CER among the leading submissions, 5.38%. Its last 0.60 WER points came without further training, mostly from an exact weight-space average of independently trained runs, with ROVER voting adding the remainder. Every comparison carries a paired-bootstrap test, and we report eight directions that did not work.

</details>


### [161] [Tokka-Bench: Evaluating Tokenizers Across 100 Natural and 20 Programming Languages](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08794)
*Ben Gubler*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出 Tokka-Bench，一个开源的多指标分词器评测框架，覆盖 100 种自然语言（30+ 文字系统）与 20 种编程语言，通过五项互补指标对七种 BPE 分词器进行跨语言比较。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型依赖子词分词器，但其质量在不同语言间差异显著，而目前缺乏标准化、多指标的框架来进行广泛的对比评测。

Method: 构建 Tokka-Bench 开源框架，采用针对各书写系统自适应的语言感知分词方法，在五项互补指标（每 token 字节数、唯一 token 覆盖率、子词生育率、词切分率、词表构成）上，对 GPT-2、GPT-4、gpt-oss、Llama 3.1、Gemma 3、Qwen3、Kimi K2 七种 BPE 分词器在 100 种自然语言与 20 种编程语言上进行语言内比较。

Result: 在单一语言内比较发现，词表分配策略比词表绝对规模更重要；近期分词器在编程语言上的效率已趋同，但在自然语言上的表现画像仍存在明显分化。

Conclusion: 分词器质量的关键在于词表分配策略而非规模，且编程语言与自然语言的优化趋势出现分离；框架、数据与交互式仪表盘已公开。

Abstract: Large language models rely on subword tokenizers whose quality varies across languages, yet no standardized multi-metric framework exists for broad comparative evaluation. We introduce Tokka-Bench, an open-source framework that evaluates tokenizers on five complementary metrics -- bytes per token, unique token coverage, subword fertility, word-split rate, and vocabulary composition -- across 100 natural languages (30+ scripts) and 20 programming languages, using language-aware segmentation adapted to each writing system. Comparing seven BPE tokenizers (GPT-2, GPT-4, gpt-oss, Llama 3.1, Gemma 3, Qwen3, and Kimi K2) within individual languages, we find that vocabulary allocation strategy matters more than raw vocabulary size, and that programming-language efficiency has converged among recent tokenizers despite divergent natural-language profiles. The framework, data, and interactive dashboard are publicly available.

</details>


### [162] [Leveraging LLM-Generated Explanations for Detecting Emotionally Rewritten Fake News](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08835)
*Yupei Guo,Jiajun He,Xiaohan Shi,Tomoki Toda,Zekun Yang,Bowen Wang,Yukinobu Taniguchi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文研究情感改写（保持事实主张不变）下的假新闻检测鲁棒性问题，构建了情感改写的测试集并生成解释作为稳定背景知识，提出门控交叉注意力（GCA）框架自适应融合情感改写新闻与解释，在PolitiFact、GossipCop和LUN上验证有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 假新闻传播会带来严重社会后果。现有检测方法主要依赖风格特征或引入解释等外部信息，但新闻常在不同情感背景下被改写而事实主张保持不变，这会削弱检测模型的鲁棒性，因此需要研究事实保持型情感变化下的假新闻检测问题。

Method: 作者构建了情感改写的测试集，并从原始新闻生成解释作为稳定的背景知识。在此基础上提出门控交叉注意力（GCA）框架，自适应地将情感改写后的新闻与对应解释进行融合，使模型聚焦于有信息量的解释内容，同时减少情感重构带来的潜在不匹配。

Result: 在PolitiFact、GossipCop和LUN三个数据集上的实验表明，该方法在PolitiFact和LUN的多种情感条件下取得显著提升，在GossipCop上保持有竞争力的性能。作者进一步分析了不同情感条件下解释引导与门控机制的作用。

Conclusion: 情感改写会挑战假新闻检测的鲁棒性，而通过将稳定的解释性背景知识与情感改写新闻进行门控交叉注意力融合，可有效缓解情感重构带来的干扰，提升多情感条件下的检测性能。代码与数据已开源。

Abstract: The spread of fake news may cause severe social consequences. Existing fake news detection methods mainly focus on stylistic variations or incorporate external information such as explanations. However, news articles are often rewritten under different emotional backgrounds while preserving their underlying factual claims, which may affect the robustness of detection models. In this work, we investigate fake news detec- tion under fact-preserving emotional variations. To study this problem, we construct emotion-rewritten test sets and generate explanations from the original news articles as stable background knowledge. We then propose a Gated Cross Attention (GCA) framework that adaptively integrates emotionally rewritten news with the corresponding explanations, enabling the model to focus on informative explanation content while reducing potential mismatches caused by emotional reframing. Experiments on PolitiFact, GossipCop, and LUN demonstrate that the proposed method achieves notable improvements under multiple emotional conditions on PolitiFact and LUN, while maintaining competitive performance on GossipCop. We further analyze the effects of explanation guidance and gating mechanisms under different emotional conditions. Our code and data are available at: https://github.com/Flulike/fakenews gca .

</details>


### [163] [Beyond the Sycophancy Score: How Task, Model, and Pressure Shape LLM Yielding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08840)
*Guang Yang,Homa Hosseinmardi,Fengchen Liu,Amir Ghasemian*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文用103,939条分级回复、10种模型配置、200道题、13种施压条件和四轮对话，系统研究LLM谄媚行为（sycophancy）的触发条件，发现主导因素是"验证用户主张的成本"和"是否存在训练护栏"，而非模型家族或施压策略；最大推理可完全消除困难题目上的让步。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 谄媚行为通常仅以"单一比率/模型"的形式报告，无法说明该行为在何时发生、用户如何规避，因此需要揭示其产生的具体条件。

Method: 收集103,939条分级回复，覆盖10种配置（8个关闭推理的LLM，其中2个再开启最大推理）、200个项目、13种施压条件、四轮对话；每条回复由两个独立LLM评审标注，并用逻辑回归量化各因素（任务因素、模型家族、施压策略）的贡献，另用人类标注做校准。

Result: 主要因素是将任务因素从逻辑模型中移除会损失0.485的McFadden R²，模型家族为0.139，施压策略仅0.009；锚定事实几乎不被让步（1.3%），逻辑谜题上的采纳率随反驳所需线索数上升；个人选择在77.0%对话中被附和；多数困难题的让步来自无法可靠求解的模型，能求解者很少让步；两模型开启最大推理后深度谜题采纳率从19.2%、12.5%降至0%；谬误或情绪化框架并不比单纯重复更有效；人类标注者在118/120校准项上与评审共识一致。

Conclusion: 提出可靠使用的实用规则：简化难以验证的问题并深入推理、陈述问题而非预设偏好答案、对开放性问题要求证据、按实测护栏画像选择模型。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) often abandon a correct answer, or endorse a user's position, once the user pushes back. This behavior, called sycophancy, is usually reported as a single rate per model, which says little about when it happens or how a user can avoid it. We study the conditions that produce it with 103,939 graded replies from ten configurations: eight LLMs with reasoning disabled, and two of them again with maximum reasoning, all facing the same 200 items, 13 pressure conditions, and four-turn conversations, with every reply labeled by two independent LLM judges. We find that the dominant factors are how costly it is for the model to verify the user's claim, and whether a trained guardrail covers it. Removing this task factor from a logistic model costs 0.485 of McFadden $R^2$, against 0.139 for model family and 0.009 for pressure tactic. Anchored facts are almost never conceded (1.3%), while adoption on logic puzzles rises with the number of clues needed to refute the pushed answer. Personal choices are endorsed in 77.0% of conversations. Most concessions on hard items come from models that cannot reliably solve them; models that can solve them rarely give the answer up. For both models tested, maximum reasoning removes these concessions completely: adoption on deep puzzles falls from 19.2% and 12.5% to 0%. Fallacious or emotional framing adds nothing beyond plain repetition. Three human annotators agree with the judges' consensus on 118/120 calibration items. These results give practical rules for reliable use: simplify hard-to-verify problems and reason deeply, state the question rather than one's preferred answer, ask for evidence on open questions, and choose models by their measured guardrail profile.

</details>


### [164] [Beyond Risk Prediction: Evidence Grounding and Psychosocial Factor Verification for Explainable Suicide Risk Assessment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08842)
*Tianle Hu,Chen Peng,Yi-Hsin Tsai,Takshing Andy Tung,Bingyang Sun,Yenjou Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究提出一个包含风险评估、证据定位与心理社会因素识别三部分的框架，用于从社交媒体帖子中检测自杀风险并给出可解释依据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 仅做风险等级分类难以揭示预测背后的文本证据与心理社会因素，因此需要在风险预测之外提供证据支撑与细粒度因素信息，以增强可解释性。

Method: 框架含三个任务：①风险评估采用基于长度的路由以适配不同长度帖子；②证据定位识别支持性短语，并用“风险-证据”约束保持与风险预测的一致性；③因素识别使用两个验证器，分类体系验证器关注因素语义，证据感知验证器利用因素特定的词汇-语义线索挑选信息量高的正训练单元，二者预测概率融合得到最终因素预测。三项任务分别用任务特定的F1指标评估。

Result: 风险评估加权F1为0.8088；证据定位测试宏行F1为0.7605；因素识别宏F1为0.5562。

Conclusion: 该框架在输出风险预测的同时提供支持性文本证据与细粒度心理社会因素信息，将自杀风险评估从单一风险等级预测拓展为更具可解释性的社交媒体帖子分析。

Abstract: Identifying suicide risk from social networking services (SNS) posts is important for detecting suicide-related signals in online environments. However, risk classification alone provides limited insight into the textual evidence and psychosocial factors behind a prediction. Based on the IEEE BigData 2026 Explainable Suicide Risk Detection Challenge, this study presents a framework consisting of Risk Assessment, Evidence Grounding, and Factor Identification. Risk Assessment uses length-based routing to accommodate posts of different lengths. Evidence Grounding identifies supporting phrases and uses a Risk-Evidence constraint to maintain consistency with the Risk prediction. For Factor Identification, two verifiers are used. The Taxonomy Verifier focuses on factor semantics, whereas the Evidence-Aware Verifier uses factor-specific lexical-semantic cues to select informative positive training units. Their prediction probabilities are combined to produce the final factor predictions. The three tasks are evaluated using task-specific F1 score measures. Risk Assessment achieved a Weighted F1 of 0.8088, Evidence Grounding achieved a test Macro row F1 of 0.7605, and Factor Identification achieved a Macro F1 of 0.5562. The results show that the framework can provide risk predictions, along with supporting textual evidence and fine-grained information on psychosocial factors. Overall, the proposed framework extends suicide-risk assessment beyond risk-level prediction and provides a more interpretable analysis of SNS posts.

</details>


### [165] [QuanLing: Cross-Branch Validation of Language Distance Quantification on Western Romance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08851)
*Yiping Bai*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文将QuanLing定量框架从北日耳曼语族扩展至西罗曼语族（法、葡、西、意），验证其跨语支适用性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 量化近亲语言间的语言距离是定量语言学的核心难题；作者此前提出的QuanLing框架仅在单一语支（北日耳曼语）上验证过，其跨语支泛化能力尚不明确。

Method: 沿用与北日耳曼研究相同的度量族与聚合协议，适配四语言（英语作锚点、四元组构造）。基于150组四语平行句，计算LaBSE句嵌入距离、四种单语BERT分词器的分词碎片率，以及mBERT掩码语言模型的互懂度（MLM预测概率）。

Result: 葡—西最近（LaBSE距离0.0229），法—意最远（0.0338）；LaBSE与mBERT在6对中4对排序一致，显示跨模型稳健性。西罗曼语绝对距离跨度大于北日耳曼（0.011 vs. 0.008），但相对比值相近（1.48 vs. 1.67），符合更长的分化时间。法语MLM可预测性显著更高（top-1准确率36.12% vs. 意大利语29.28%），反映其拼写—语音解耦。

Conclusion: 跨语支验证为QuanLing超越单一语支的泛化性提供了进一步证据。

Abstract: Quantifying language distance among closely related languages remains a core challenge in quantitative linguistics. Our previous work [1] introduced QuanLing (Quantitative Linguistics via Pretrained Language Models), a quantitative framework combining language distance metrics (sentence embedding distance, tokenization fragmentation rate) with language property analysis (MLM prediction probability), validated on North Germanic (Danish, Norwegian Bokmål, Swedish). This paper extends QuanLing to Western Romance--French, Portuguese, Spanish, Italian--testing cross-branch applicability with the same metric family and aggregation protocol as our North Germanic study, adapted for four languages (English anchor, quadruplet construction). Using 150 four-language parallel sentences, we compute LaBSE sentence embedding distances, tokenization fragmentation rates from four monolingual BERT tokenizers, and mBERT masked language model mutual intelligibility. Results show that Portuguese--Spanish are closest (LaBSE distance 0.0229), French--Italian most distant (0.0338); LaBSE and mBERT rankings agree on 4 of 6 pairs, confirming cross-model robustness. Western Romance shows a wider absolute distance span than North Germanic (0.011 vs. 0.008) but comparable relative ratios (1.48 vs. 1.67), consistent with longer divergence time. French exhibits notably higher MLM predictability (36.12% top-1 accuracy vs. 29.28% for Italian), reflecting its orthography--phonology decoupling. This cross-branch validation provides further evidence for QuanLing's generalizability beyond a single language branch.

</details>


### [166] [LRCC: Generalizing Low-Rank Compression with Conditional Computation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08858)
*Thomas Vaitses Fontanari,Maximo Eduardo Rulli,Federico Alvetreti,Donatella Genovese,Simone Scardapane*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出LRCC方法，为预训练语言模型的每个Transformer块训练轻量级路由器，在嵌套低秩路径间进行token级条件计算，仅优化路由器而冻结低秩因子，在同等平均激活参数预算下优于静态低秩压缩。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统低秩压缩在推理时采用固定秩分配，对所有token分配相同计算量，无法根据输入token的难度自适应调整计算，造成计算资源浪费与性能受限。

Method: LRCC在预训练模型中为每个Transformer块加入一个轻量级路由器，从一小组嵌套低秩路径中选择；训练时冻结低秩因子，仅优化路由器参数，实现token相关的条件计算。

Result: 在Llama和Qwen上评估语言建模与零样本下游任务：相同平均激活参数预算下，LRCC优于静态低秩压缩，Llama-2-7B平均下游准确率提升7.6个百分点；在匹配batch-size-1解码延迟时，Llama-3.2-1B的困惑度与下游准确率均提升，Llama-2-7B保持竞争力，且无需专用kernel。

Conclusion: token级条件计算可有效增强低秩压缩的表达能力，在不增加平均计算量的前提下提升性能；通过分析路由器路径选择验证了token-wise路径分配的有效性。

Abstract: Low-rank compression reduces the cost of pretrained language models by replacing linear transformations with low-rank factorizations. However, conventional methods use a fixed rank allocation during inference, assigning the same amount of compute regardless of the input token. We introduce Low-Rank Conditional Computation (LRCC), which adds token-dependent computation to pretrained models by training one lightweight router per Transformer block to select among a small set of nested low-rank paths. During training, the low-rank factors remain frozen, and only the routers are optimized. We evaluate LRCC on Llama and Qwen models for language modeling and zero-shot downstream tasks. Within the same average active-parameter budget, LRCC improves the predictive performance over static low-rank compression, including a 7.6 percentage-point gain in average downstream accuracy on Llama-2-7B over static methods. At matched batch-size-1 decoding latency, LRCC improves both perplexity and downstream accuracy on Llama-3.2-1B and remains competitive on Llama-2-7B, without specialized kernels. Finally, we assess the usefulness of assigning a token-wise path by analyzing the routers' path choices.

</details>


### [167] [Tiny-Scale Chinese BERT Pretraining: A Controlled Comparison of MLM, WWM, and MacBERT Strategies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08879)
*Yiping Bai*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 在8.7M参数的微型中文BERT上进行受控对比，发现MLM/WWM/MacBERT三种预训练策略的排序（MLM > WWM >> MacBERT）与base规模结论相反，并揭示训练损失不可靠的评估陷阱。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MLM、WWM和MacBERT式替换策略的对比主要集中于base规模（≥110M参数），缺乏对微型规模模型的系统研究，而预训练策略对模型质量影响显著，因此需要在小规模下进行受控比较以检验结论是否可迁移。

Method: 在完全相同的架构（4层、256隐维、8.7M参数）、语料（129万句中文维基百科）和超参数下从头训练三个模型，并从五个内在维度评估：困惑度、MLM命中率、语义区分、语法判断和上下文敏感性。

Result: 微型规模下MLM综合表现最佳（5个维度中胜出3个）；WWM在困惑度（1.27 vs. 2.10，提升39.5%）和MLM命中率（22% vs. 16%）上表现最优；MacBERT在同义词词典严重受限（222条，覆盖率3.3%）时困惑度严重退化（47.23，为MLM的22倍）。整体排序为MLM > WWM >> MacBERT，与base规模结论（MacBERT > WWM > MLM）明显不同。此外，MacBERT训练损失最低（2.17）却困惑度最高（47.23），暴露了混合替换策略下仅凭训练损失评估的不可靠性。

Conclusion: 预训练策略的最优选择具有规模依赖性，微型模型上MLM优于MacBERT式替换；训练损失不能单独作为评估指标；所有模型与语料已公开。

Abstract: Pretraining strategies significantly impact the quality of language models, yet existing comparisons of Masked Language Modeling (MLM), Whole Word Masking (WWM), and MacBERT-style replacement have focused primarily on base-scale models (>=110M parameters). This paper presents a controlled comparison of these three strategies on a tiny-scale Chinese BERT model (4 layers, 256 hidden dimensions, 8.7M parameters). Under identical architecture, corpus (1.29M sentences from Chinese Wikipedia), and hyperparameters, we train three models from scratch and evaluate them across five intrinsic dimensions: perplexity, MLM hit rate, semantic discrimination, grammatical judgment, and contextual sensitivity. At tiny scale, MLM achieves the best overall intrinsic performance (winning 3 of 5 dimensions), while WWM excels in both perplexity (1.27 vs. 2.10, a 39.5% improvement) and MLM hit rate (22% vs. 16%). Notably, MacBERT under a severely limited synonym dictionary (222 entries, 3.3% coverage) exhibits severe perplexity degradation (47.23, 22x higher than MLM), yielding a ranking (MLM > WWM >> MacBERT) that differs markedly from the established base-scale conclusion (MacBERT > WWM > MLM). We further identify a critical evaluation pitfall: MacBERT achieves the lowest training loss (2.17) yet the highest perplexity (47.23), revealing that training loss alone is unreliable under mixed replacement strategies. All models and corpus are publicly available at https://huggingface.co/eebyp.

</details>


### [168] [Quad-State Safety Evaluation of Open-Weight Large Language Models on Non-Canonical Inputs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09033)
*Pavan Maddula*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出ASRD对抗性表层形式鲁棒性数据集（2100条提示、7类表层变换），在5个开源权重模型上评估10500条响应，并用"四态评估量表"将响应分为有害顺从、安全响应、理解失败和不确定四类；结果显示表情符号与不可见Unicode变换几乎不引发理解失败且有害顺从率接近基线，而leet语、编码包装和混合变换则大幅提升理解失败率并压低了知情的有害顺从率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准安全评估通常只考察规范纯文本形式的恶意请求，但真实部署中的模型会遇到含表情符号、变体拼写、编码字符串和字符级变形的输入。现有安全评测因此可能高估模型的鲁棒性与安全性，本文旨在系统刻画模型在表层形式扰动下的安全表现，并揭示评估中被忽略的理解失败问题。

Method: 构建Adversarial Surface-Form Robustness Dataset（ASRD），共2100条提示，覆盖七个表层形式家族（含表情符号、不可见Unicode、leet语、编码包装、混合变换等）。在五个开源权重语言模型上进行评估，共产生10500条响应。提出Quad-State Evaluation Rubric（四态评估量表），将每条响应判定为有害顺从、安全响应、理解失败或不确定；并对原始输出进行质性审查以归纳响应行为模式。

Result: 表情符号与不可见Unicode变体几乎不造成理解失败，合并有害顺从率分别为20.27%和17.20%，对照基线为22.87%（该基线主要由Mistral 7B贡献）。相比之下，leet语、编码包装和混合变换的有害顺从率分别为2.40%、0.13%和2.40%，但理解失败率分别升至36.47%、65.60%和34.47%。对原始输出的检查揭示三种响应行为：幻觉式良性（hallucinated benignity）、结构崩溃（structural collapse）和语言漂移（language drift）。

Conclusion: 表层形式扰动会显著改变安全评估结论：部分变换（如编码包装）表面上有害顺从率极低，但实质是模型无法理解请求而非真正拒绝，因此单看有害率会误判安全性。安全评测应将理解失败作为独立维度纳入，并采用四态分类以区分"安全拒绝"与"理解失败"；同时需关注幻觉式良性、结构崩溃与语言漂移等失效模式。

Abstract: Standard safety evaluations of large language models assess harmful requests written in canonical plain text, while models in real-world deployment routinely receive inputs containing emojis, altered spellings, encoded strings, and character-level variations. This work introduces the Adversarial Surface-Form Robustness Dataset (ASRD), comprising 2,100 prompts across seven distinct surface-form families. Five open-weight language models are evaluated across these prompts, producing 10,500 responses. The Quad-State Evaluation Rubric classifies each response into one of four outcomes: harmful compliance, safe response, comprehension failure, or indeterminate. Emoji and invisible Unicode variations cause almost no comprehension failure, with pooled harmful compliance of 20.27% and 17.20% against a 22.87% baseline that is driven mainly by Mistral 7B, whereas leetspeak, encoded wrappers, and hybrid transformations score 2.40%, 0.13%, and 2.40% while comprehension failure rises to 36.47%, 65.60%, and 34.47%. Inspection of raw model outputs reveals three response behaviors: hallucinated benignity, structural collapse, and language drift. Project page: www.pavanmaddula.com/quadstate

</details>


### [169] [U-Space: Uncovering When and Why Uncertainty Arises in Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09087)
*Tobias Braun,Nils Loose,Alexander Herzog,Virginia Ceccatelli,Marcus Rohrbach,Thomas Eisenbarth,Lorenzo Cavallaro*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出 U-Space 与 U-Lens，一种无需训练、无需正确性标签、无需多次生成的机制可解释性方法，用于在低维子空间中度量并解释大模型在推理过程中逐 token 的不确定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大模型在高风险场景中做决策，其错误可能以流畅、自信的表达形式出现，因此需要判断单次回答的可信度。现有不确定性量化方法多依赖重复采样或额外训练组件，且标量估计无法揭示不确定性来源与演化过程；同时生成长度常与不确定性和正确性高度相关，令人质疑估计器的预测力有多少来自不确定性信息本身而非长度。机制可解释性可将人类可理解概念与模型中间状态关联，为解决上述问题提供了途径。

Method: 提出 U-Space：一个低维子空间，使模型演化中的不确定性可被测量与解释。方法首先确定"怀疑"与"确信"的语义锚点，将其 unembedding 方向映射回残差空间，并把它们的对比组合为正交基。U-Lens 将每个 token 的隐状态投影到这些基向量上，得到可解释的 token 级不确定性图，该图可直接检查，也可聚合为标量不确定性分数。整个过程不需要正确性标签、重复生成或训练。

Result: 在多个推理基准上，其置信度分数在标准评估与长度控制评估两种设定下均优于既有基线，并且相比监督式估计器具有更可靠的迁移性。

Conclusion: U-Space/U-Lens 提供了一种无需训练、标签与重复采样即可获得可解释、可聚合不确定性度量的方法，在预测性能与跨任务迁移上优于现有基线，为大模型单次回答的可信度评估提供了新思路。

Abstract: Large language models are informing decisions with ever-higher stakes. As the consequences of their errors grow, a central question becomes harder to ignore: how much can we trust an individual answer? Yet recognizing when to defer remains difficult because language models can present incorrect conclusions with fluent explanations and an authoritative tone. Uncertainty quantification seeks to address this disconnect by estimating the reliability of individual predictions. However, many existing methods require repeated generations or separately trained components, and their scalar estimates do not reveal where uncertainty arises or how it evolves during reasoning. Recent work has also shown that generation length can be strongly associated with uncertainty estimates and correctness, raising the question of how much of an estimator's predictive power comes from uncertainty-specific information rather than output length alone. Mechanistic interpretability offers a way to address these limitations by connecting human-interpretable concepts to intermediate model states. Building on this capability, we introduce the U-Space, a low-dimensional subspace that makes a model's evolving uncertainty measurable and interpretable. We identify semantic anchors for doubt and certainty, map their unembedding directions back into the residual space, and combine their contrasts into an orthogonal basis. The U-Lens projects each token state onto these basis vectors, yielding an interpretable token-level uncertainty map that can be inspected directly or aggregated into a scalar uncertainty score. Our approach requires no correctness labels, repeated generations, or training. Across reasoning benchmarks, its confidence score outperforms established baselines under both standard and length-controlled evaluation and transfers more reliably than supervised estimators. Code: https://github.com/s2labres/U-Space.

</details>


### [170] [sk-bench: A Native-First Benchmark for Evaluating Large Language Models in Slovak](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09152)
*Marek Šuppa,Ivan Vykopal,Andrej Ridzik,Kristián Sopkovič,Natália Kňažeková,Jaroslav Kopčan,Miroslav Blšták,Viktória Ondrejová,Daniel Hládek,Michal Gregor,Martin Tamajka,Marián Šimko*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出 sk-bench，一个以母语数据为核心的斯洛伐克语生成式大模型评测基准，包含 30 个数据集（33 个计分任务变体）、10 类技能，并系统评测了 55 个开源与闭源模型，给出面向低资源语言基准设计的四点建议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 斯洛伐克语作为形态丰富的西斯拉夫语言（约五百万使用者）在多语言 LLM 基准中被忽略，或仅通过机器翻译覆盖，缺乏母语优先的评测资源，无法真实反映模型在该语言上的能力。

Method: 构建 sk-bench：母语优先的斯洛伐克语基准，含 30 个数据集、33 个计分任务变体、10 类技能；新引入或首次打包 11 项资源（如带斯洛伐克语适配指令校验器的 IFEval-SK，以及面向语法与形态的母语 Chiby/SKJ1 资源）。在统一评测框架下评测 55 个开源与闭源权重模型，并开展母语 vs 翻译数据排序一致性、人工 vs LLM 生成 QA 对比、Qwen3-14B 继续预训练与指令修复、测试时推理等消融分析。

Result: 最佳开源模型落后专有 API 达 12.6 分；母语与翻译的闭式数据模型排序高度一致（ρ≥0.98），但翻译对最强模型的区分度更低；人工撰写与 LLM 生成的 QA 问题排序不同（ρ=0.72）；Qwen3-14B 继续斯洛伐克语预训练使总分下降 13.9 分，少量指令数据可恢复其中约四分之三；测试时推理使 9B 及以上模型提升 8.5–12.5 分。

Conclusion: 面向其他低资源语言的四条基准设计经验：翻译失效处应使用母语数据；语言适配后需规划指令修复；扩展规模前先启用测试时推理；避免在目标语言提示上过度投入。数据与代码已开源。

Abstract: Multilingual LLM benchmarks omit Slovak, a morphologically rich West Slavic language of five million speakers, or cover it only by machine translation. We present sk-bench, a native-first Slovak benchmark with 30 datasets (33 scored task variants) across ten skill categories. Eleven resources are introduced or first packaged for generative-LLM evaluation, including IFEval-SK with Slovak-adapted instruction checkers and native Chiby/SKJ1 resources for Slovak grammar and morphology. We evaluate 55 open- and closed-weights models under one harness. The best open model trails proprietary APIs by 12.6 points. Model rankings are similar for native and translated closed-form data ($ρ\geq0.98$), though translation separates the strongest models less well. By contrast, human-authored and LLM-generated QA questions rank models differently ($ρ=0.72$). For Qwen3-14B, continued Slovak pretraining lowers the overall score by 13.9 points. A small instruction set restores three quarters of that loss. Test-time reasoning improves scores by 8.5 to 12.5 points for models of 9B and above. Together, these findings suggest four design lessons for other under-resourced languages: use native data where translation fails, plan instruction repair after language adaptation, enable test-time reasoning before scaling up, and avoid overinvesting in target-language prompts. We release the data and code at https://github.com/slovak-nlp/sk-bench

</details>


### [171] [ToolRACER: A Robust Agentic Conversation Emulation Resource for Agent Training and Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09163)
*Arkajyoti Chakraborty,Aryan Tayal,Ishika Agarwal,Tanner Sorensen,Justin Chiu,Alessandro Di Bari,Neha Gupta,Andreas Stolcke*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出ToolRACER合成数据生成流程与ToolRACERBench基准，通过对抗性多轮对话数据提升面向任务对话智能体的鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有函数调用基准多聚焦于成功、合作的交互，缺少对抗性对话轨迹，导致开发鲁棒智能体所需训练资源不足；真实场景中用户行为不可预测且常为非合作性，使任务型对话智能体表现脆弱。

Method: ToolRACER：协同用户、助手与工具仿真模型的合成数据生成流程，用于生成并验证用户与智能体间的多轮交互；据此构建ToolRACERBench，覆盖六个领域、55种多样人格，注入对抗行为，生成并验证对话轨迹。

Result: 构建经校验的语料共5.6K条对话轨迹，其中约66%包含易失败对话场景；在τ²-bench、BFCLv3、ACEBench及内部基准上评估，基于ToolRACERBench训练的模型在τ²-bench与ACEBench上端到端智能体准确率提升，与域内数据集混合时对小语言模型的智能体能力任务有显著增益。

Conclusion: 对抗性多轮对话合成数据可有效弥补现有基准对非合作交互覆盖不足的问题，提升任务型对话智能体的准确性与鲁棒性，尤其在混合域内数据训练小语言模型时效果显著。

Abstract: Task-oriented conversational agents remain fragile under real world conversation scenarios as they rarely follow a predictable script, especially when users exhibit non-cooperative behavior. Existing function-calling benchmarks often emphasize successful, cooperative interactions and underrepresent adversarial conversation trajectories, thereby limiting the training resources available for developing robust agents. We present ToolRACER, a synthetic data generation pipeline that coordinates user, assistant and tool emulation models to generate and validated multi-turn interactions between a user and an agent. Using \sysn, we construct ToolRACERBench a robust multi-turn conversation benchmark spanning six domains, ranging over 55 varied personas, generating a validated corpus of 5.6K conversation trajectories, with approximately 66\% of conversations containing failure-prone conversation scenarios. We inject adversarial behaviors, producing validated conversational interaction trajectories that capture realistic, robust scenarios. We evaluate models trained on ToolRACERBench against internal benchmarks, as well as on function calling benchmarks such as $τ^2$-bench, BFCLv3 and ACEBench to evaluate agentic accuracy and robustness. Models trained on ToolRACERBench improve end to end agentic accuracy across $τ^2$-bench and ACEBench, demonstrating significant gains when mixed with in-domain dataset in small language models for agent capability tasks.

</details>


### [172] [Multi-Objective Aligned Small Language Model Framework for SUD Patient Dialogue Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09209)
*Thushara Manjari Naduvilakandy,Hyeju Jang,Mohammad Al Hasan*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出一个认知基础的SUD患者对话生成框架，通过认知成分检测与对齐生成两阶段，结合知识蒸馏、偏好优化和注意力引导奖励塑造，使小语言模型在认知一致性和临床真实性上显著优于通用与心理健康领域基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SUD咨询需要患者回应能反映信念、应对策略、改变准备度等潜在认知状态。尽管LLM能生成流畅文本，但难以产生认知连贯、临床真实的患者行为，尤其在伦理敏感和数据稀缺的临床场景下。同时，前沿规模LLM在医疗应用中存在计算成本高、延迟大、隐私风险和资源受限环境部署困难等问题，因此需要认知对齐的小语言模型（SLM）。

Method: 提出认知基础的SUD患者对话生成框架，显式建模并将潜在认知成分与患者历史和咨询师问题对齐。流程分为两阶段：认知成分检测和认知成分对齐的对话生成。为使小模型有效学习，结合了高容量教师模型的知识蒸馏、基于人工标注的偏好优化以及注意力引导的奖励塑造。

Result: 使用BERTScore、ROUGE、METEOR、BLEU等自动指标，以及以人类和教师模型为参考的LLM-as-judge命中指标进行广泛评估。结果显示，认知信息微调在认知实现和对齐方面显著优于通用指令微调基线和心理健康领域专用SLM，在开放式认知成分上提升尤为明显。

Conclusion: 认知信息的微调能有效提升小语言模型在SUD患者对话生成中的认知实现与对齐能力，为资源受限临床环境下部署认知对齐的SLM提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Substance Use Disorder (SUD) counseling requires patient responses that reflect underlying cognitive states such as beliefs, coping strategies, and readiness for change. Although large language models (LLMs) can generate fluent text, they often fail to produce cognitively coherent and clinically realistic patient behavior, especially under ethical and data-scarce clinical settings. Moreover, deploying frontier-scale LLMs in healthcare applications presents practical challenges including high computational cost, latency, privacy concerns, and limited deployability in resource-constrained environments, motivating the need for cognitively aligned small language models (SLMs). We propose a cognitively grounded framework for SUD patient dialogue generation that explicitly models and aligns latent cognitive components with patient histories and counselor questions. Our pipeline consists of two stages: cognitive component detection and cognitive component-aligned dialogue generation. To enable effective learning with smaller models, we combine knowledge distillation from high-capacity teacher models, preference optimization from human-annotations, and attention-guided reward shaping. Extensive evaluations using automatic scores like BERTScore, ROUGE, METEOR and BLEU, and LLM-as-judge hit-metrics against both human and teacher-model references show that cognitively informed fine-tuning substantially improves cognitive realization and alignment over a generic instruction-tuned baselines and mental health domain specific SLMs, with particularly strong gains for open-ended cognitive components.

</details>


### [173] [OnlineQAT: On-Policy Distillation for Ultra-Low-Bit Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09346)
*Wenjun Wang,Heng Li,Yanggan Gu,Hongxia Yang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出OnlineQAT两阶段框架：先用分块QAT获得低比特初始化，再对学生自生成响应做在线策略蒸馏，在Qwen3-1.7B上W3A16和W2A16分别达到57.28和32.52。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有量化感知训练（QAT）的恢复阶段通常基于固定补全或教师生成答案进行优化，但部署中的量化模型实际以自身生成的prefix为条件，量化误差会使模型进入离线恢复数据中未覆盖的状态，导致恢复效果受限。

Method: OnlineQAT采用两阶段框架：第一阶段通过分块（block-wise）QAT获得可用的低比特初始化；第二阶段在学生模型自生成的响应上进行在线策略蒸馏（OPD），在每个访问到的prefix处，由冻结的全精度教师模型提供采样的reverse-KL训练信号。

Result: 在Qwen3-1.7B上，OnlineQAT在对比的量化方法中取得最佳平均成绩：W3A16为57.28，W2A16为32.52，分别比ReasoningQAT提升2.90和0.44分。

Conclusion: 结果表明，学生实际访问到的状态能提供超出固定补全训练的有效恢复信号，这一优势在3比特量化下尤为明显。

Abstract: Quantization-aware training (QAT) can recover much of the accuracy lost when large language models are compressed below four bits. Existing re- covery stages, however, are commonly optimized on fixed completions or teacher-generated answers, whereas the deployed quantized model condi- tions on prefixes generated by itself. Quantization errors can therefore move the model into states that are absent from offline recovery data. We introduce OnlineQAT, a two-stage framework that first obtains a usable low-bit initialization through block-wise QAT and then performs on-policy distillation (OPD) on student-generated responses. At each visited pre- fix, a frozen full-precision teacher provides a sampled reverse-KL training signal. On Qwen3-1.7B, OnlineQAT obtains the best average among the compared quantized methods: 57.28 at W3A16 and 32.52 at W2A16, im- proving over ReasoningQAT by 2.90 and 0.44 points, respectively. The results suggest that student-visited states provide a useful recovery signal beyond fixed-completion training, particularly at three bits.

</details>


### [174] [Arctic Questions, Missing Answers: A Dataset and Benchmark for LLM Abstention in Arctic Science](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09446)
*Benjamin Wilcox,Dawei Gao,Pradeeban Kathiravelu,Douglas Causey,Kewei Sha,Yunhe Feng*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文提出ArcticQA数据集与ArcticAbstain配对基准，用于评估大语言模型在科学多选题中"答案不可得时是否弃答"的敏感性，发现仅看弃答频率不足，需联合衡量弃答频率与对答案可用性的响应性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型在科学多选题无有效选项时应弃答，但仅凭高弃答率无法证明模型对"答案是否可得"具有敏感性，因此需要构建能区分弃答频率与响应性的评测方法。

Method: 构建ArcticQA数据集（194道源自北极一线研究的题目，含答案支持与干扰项矛盾的自动化校验）；并设计ArcticAbstain配对基准，对比"有答案"与"无答案"（将正确答案替换为干扰项）两种条件，二者均设显式弃答选项。对Gemini、Claude、ChatGPT三系列八个模型在高推理强度下评测，每条件三次试验，共9,312条响应。

Result: "有答案"条件下的弃答率为0.0%至63.0%；替换正确答案后弃答率平均上升5.05个百分点。模型间基线差异显著。

Conclusion: 仅评估弃答频率不足，应联合考察弃答频率与对答案可用性的响应性；数据集与基准已开源。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) should abstain from scientific multiple-choice questions when no option is valid, but frequent abstention alone does not demonstrate sensitivity to answer availability. We introduce ArcticQA, a dataset of 194 questions derived from primary Arctic research, with automated checks of answer support and distractor contradiction against source evidence. We further develop ArcticAbstain, a paired benchmark comparing answer-present and answer-absent conditions, with the correct answer replaced by a distractor in the latter and an explicit abstention option in both. We evaluate eight models from the Gemini, Claude, and ChatGPT families at high reasoning effort, with three trials per condition, yielding 9,312 recorded responses. Answer-present abstention rates range from 0.0% to 63.0%, whereas replacing the correct answer increases abstention by 5.05 percentage points on average. These findings highlight substantial baseline differences and the need to evaluate abstention frequency and responsiveness jointly. The dataset and benchmark are available at https://github.com/BenWilcox8/arctic-qa.

</details>


### [175] [How Do LLMs Change Predictions Under Negation?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09571)
*Jongwook Yoon,Jongwon Lim,Sungjib Lim,Woojin Cho,Yohan Jo*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 大语言模型在否定处理上表现脆弱，37-71%的情况下在否定后仍重复原答案。机制分析发现专门的注意力头和MLP神经元通过抑制原答案检索并促进类别内偏好候选来实现否定，这不同于人类利用原答案信息来确定排除对象的方式。作者提出针对更自信原预测要求更大答案偏好偏移的训练目标，有效减少否定失败且对通用能力损害更小。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 否定是人类语言的基本特征，但大语言模型在处理否定时仍不可靠。作者希望理解并解决这一脆弱性，即模型为何在否定语境下仍重复原答案。

Method: 作者在否定基准上评估了近期开源与闭源LLM；从机制层面（mechanistic）分析模型在否定下的运算过程，识别出专门实现否定的注意力头和MLP神经元；并提出一种训练目标，要求对更自信的原预测施加更大的答案偏好偏移。

Result: 在37-71%的情况下，模型在否定后仍重复同一答案（如对"什么不是西班牙的首都"回答"马德里"）。机制上，专门的注意力头与MLP神经元共同实现否定，(1)抑制原答案（如"马德里"）的检索，(2)促进答案类别内的偏好候选（如"巴黎"）。这一机制依赖抑制而非利用原答案，导致抑制过弱或答案偏置过强时出现否定失败。所提训练目标比标准微调基线更能减少否定失败，且通用能力退化更小。

Conclusion: 与人类否定处理（利用原答案信息确定应排除什么）不同，模型的否定机制依赖抑制原答案。这一差异是导致否定失败的关键原因。机制分析能够揭示语言能力失败的原因，并指导针对底层局限的训练。

Abstract: Negation is an essential feature of human language, yet large language models (LLMs) remain unreliable in processing it. We evaluate recent open-source and closed-source LLMs on our negation benchmark and find that, in 37-71% of cases, they repeat the same answer under negation (e.g., "Madrid" for "What is not the capital of Spain?"). To understand and address this brittleness, we mechanistically examine how models operate under negation. Our main finding is that specialized attention heads and MLP neurons jointly implement negation by (1) suppressing retrieval of the original answer (e.g., "Madrid") while (2) promoting a favored candidate within the answer category (e.g., "Paris"). This contrasts with accounts of human negation processing, in which information about the original answer helps to determine what should be excluded. Furthermore, we find that this difference from human processing is a key source of negation failures: the model's mechanism relies on suppressing the original answer rather than using it to determine what to exclude, so the model can repeat the original answer when suppression is too weak or when a bias toward particular answers prevents it from selecting an alternative. To address this weakness in the model's negation mechanism, we propose a training objective that requires larger shifts in answer preference for more confident original predictions, and show that it reduces negation failures with less degradation of general capabilities than standard fine-tuning baselines. Together, our results demonstrate how mechanistic analysis can reveal why a linguistic capability fails and guide training that targets the underlying limitation.

</details>


### [176] [Which Language Should a Skeleton Speak? Language Choices in Multilingual Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09607)
*HyeonSeok Lim,SeungWoo Song,Inho Won,Hoyun Song,Jihyo Kim,KyungTae Lim*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文提出语言感知骨架探索框架LASEF，系统研究多语言数学推理中"骨架语言"（推理结构提示所用语言）的选择问题，发现英语骨架平均略有优势但并非普遍最优，骨架语言是一种依赖情境的设计变量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于骨架的推理提示（skeleton-based reasoning prompting）是一种有前景的免训练LLM推理结构化方法，但已有工作大多默认英语中心设定，缺乏对多语言场景下骨架语言选择影响的系统研究。

Method: 提出语言感知骨架探索框架LASEF，在多个数学基准、多种模型规模与多语言条件下开展实验，综合采用贪心解码、多轮采样（multi-rollout）评估、翻译消融以及跨基准验证等手段。

Result: 英语骨架平均呈小幅正向倾向，在较小模型和低资源语言上更明显；但经多重比较校正后，语言层面的显著增益所剩无几，英语并非普遍最优。归纳出三类骨架语言效应：方向一致型、依赖评估与基准型、非对称负向型，且这些效应无法仅用生成质量解释。

Conclusion: 骨架语言是一个依赖情境（context-dependent）的设计变量，需要多层次探索；相关资源已开源。

Abstract: Skeleton-based reasoning prompting is a promising training-free approach for structuring LLM reasoning, but prior work largely assumes an English-centric setting. We propose the Language-Aware Skeleton Exploration Framework (LASEF) to study skeleton-language choice in multilingual mathematical reasoning. Across math benchmarks, model scales, and languages, we show that English skeletons yield a small positive tendency on average, most visible for smaller models and low-resource languages. However, few language-level gains remain significant after correction, and English is not universally optimal. Combining greedy decoding, multi-rollout evaluation, translation ablation, and cross-benchmark validation, we further find three patterns of skeleton-language effects: directionally consistent, evaluation- and benchmark-dependent, and asymmetric negative. These effects cannot be fully explained by generation quality alone. Overall, skeleton language is a context-dependent design variable that requires multi-level exploration. All resources are released at https://github.com/lhsstn/LASEF.

</details>


### [177] [From Pareto to Preference: Personalized Test-Time Scaling via Amortized Agentic Policy Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09684)
*Xinglin Wang,Zishen Liu,Tong Zheng,Shaoxiong Feng,Peiwen Yuan,Yiwei Li,Jiayi Shi,Yueqi Zhang,Chuyi Tan,Ji Zhang,Boyuan Pan,Kan Li*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出个性化测试时扩展（Personalized TTS）问题，并给出 PersonTTS 框架，通过需求匹配的控制器初始化与源蒸馏的过程性指导复用搜索经验，在 AIME 与 HMMT 上对未见用户画像和留出问题显著提升联合需求满足率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 TTS 效率研究多针对单一资源维度，只推动精度—成本或精度—延迟的 Pareto 前沿；而用户需求是多维的，可能同时指定精度、延迟与推理成本，且不同需求组合对应不同的最优控制器。因此需要把 TTS 建模为面向用户个性化多维需求的策略发现问题。

Method: 将 Personalized Test-Time Scaling 形式化为：发现可执行控制器，以最大化用户特定需求的联合满足率。为降低新用户画像重复策略发现的开销，提出 PersonTTS——一种摊销式智能体策略发现框架，通过需求匹配的控制器初始化与源蒸馏的过程性指导复用已有搜索经验，同时对每个候选策略保留目标画像评估。

Result: 在 AIME 和 HMMT 上，PersonTTS 在未见用户画像与留出问题上，其联合需求满足率显著优于强 TTS 基线；在相同候选评估预算下，跨用户经验复用进一步提升了策略质量，同时大幅降低发现智能体的时间与成本。

Conclusion: Personalized TTS 是将 TTS 从单资源维度优化拓展到多维用户需求联合满足的有效建模方式；经验复用式摊销策略发现可在保证候选评估质量的同时提升效率，为个性化推理计算分配提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Test-time scaling (TTS) improves the reasoning capabilities of large language models by allocating additional inference computation. Existing approaches to improving TTS efficiency largely optimize accuracy against one resource dimension at a time, advancing either the accuracy--cost or accuracy--latency Pareto frontier. Yet user requirements are multidimensional: users may specify accuracy, latency, and inference-cost requirements jointly, and different requirements can favor different controllers. We formulate Personalized Test-Time Scaling as discovering executable controllers that maximize the joint satisfaction rate of user-specific requirements. To reduce the overhead of repeated policy discovery for new user profiles, we propose PersonTTS, an amortized agentic policy-discovery framework that reuses prior search experience through requirement-matched controller initialization and source-distilled procedural guidance, while retaining target-profile evaluation for every candidate. Experiments on AIME and HMMT show that PersonTTS substantially outperforms strong TTS baselines in joint requirement satisfaction on unseen user profiles and held-out problems. Under the same candidate-evaluation budget, cross-user experience reuse further improves policy quality while substantially reducing discovery-agent time and cost.

</details>


### [178] [Decoupling Logic from Persona: Structural Immunity of Edge LLM Agents to Context Pollution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09772)
*Masaaki Nakatsu,Reno Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文研究了边缘设备上小型语言模型智能体在长且具有误导性、且包含人设信息的历史上下文中出现的"人设-逻辑干扰"问题，提出解耦架构AO-DA，将逻辑推理（"What"）与人设表达（"How"）分离为同一INT4基座模型上的两条推理路径，配合可热插拔的LoRA适配器。实验表明解耦逻辑路径对污染具备结构不变性，而混合单次推理性能单调退化；该优势在8B模型上显著，但在4B模型上消失。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 边缘设备上的小语言模型智能体需在同一上下文窗口内同时完成人设维持与逻辑推理，而对话历史与人设指令会持续填充该窗口，导致长且具误导性的历史对人设与逻辑产生干扰（人设-逻辑干扰）。作者希望探究这种干扰对智能体逻辑能力的破坏程度，并寻求一种能在资源受限设备上兼顾人设表达与推理可靠性的方案。

Method: 提出解耦架构AO-DA，在单一INT4基座模型上以两条推理路径分离逻辑推理与人设表达：逻辑路径仅接收核心轮次输入并输出可验证的结构化状态（Micro-State）；人设路径在完整历史下将该状态以人设风格渲染。采用可热插拔LoRA适配器实现切换。在Apple M2笔记本上以Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct与Gemma-3-4B-it（4-bit）进行同基座模型消融实验，共480次运行，覆盖4个污染等级×3种配置×2项任务×2种人设×5个随机种子。

Result: (i) 解耦逻辑路径对污染结构不变：提示长度固定为180（Llama）或167（Gemma）token，而混合单次推理提示从242增长至1,203，且输出在各污染等级下逐字节相同（40/40）。(ii) 混合单次推理单调退化：Llama综合逻辑分数由0.669降至0.150，Gemma由0.487降至0.150，主要因未能输出所需结构化结果（Llama在80-95%运行中失败，Gemma在最高两级污染下为100%）。(iii) 将相同污染输入解耦逻辑路径，使用专用适配器与专用格式时在8B模型上仍优于单次推理（失败率0-20%对80-95%；配对Δ为+0.30至+0.50，Cliff's δ为0.50-0.85，Holm校正后p≤0.03），但在4B模型上两者均崩溃。分离的代价是话题首轮多一次解码（Llama上28.2 s对18.2 s），换来1.7 ms的人设热切换且无需重跑逻辑路径。

Conclusion: 解耦逻辑推理与人设表达能有效抵御上下文污染对人设-逻辑干扰的破坏，在8B模型上显著提升鲁棒性，并支持低成本人设热切换；但该增益对模型规模敏感，在4B模型上失效。作者开源了代码、评分标准、测试夹具、适配器与日志，为边缘设备智能体设计提供依据。

Abstract: Small language-model agents on edge devices must hold a persona and reason correctly at once, inside one context window that fills with conversational history and persona instructions. We study what happens to the logical part of such an agent when that history is long, misleading and persona-heavy (persona-logic interference), and present a Decoupling Architecture (AO-DA) that separates logical inference ("What") from persona expression ("How") into two inference paths on one INT4 base model with hot-swappable LoRA adapters. The logic path receives only the core turn and emits a verifiable structured state (Micro-State); the persona path renders it in character with the full history. In same-base-model ablations on an Apple M2 laptop (Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct and Gemma-3-4B-it, 4-bit; 480 runs over 4 pollution levels x 3 arms x 2 tasks x 2 personas x 5 seeds) we find: (i) the decoupled logic path is structurally invariant to pollution: its prompt stays at 180 (Llama) or 167 (Gemma) tokens while the mixed single-pass prompt grows from 242 to 1,203, and its outputs are byte-identical across levels (40/40); (ii) the mixed single pass degrades monotonically (composite logic score 0.669 to 0.150 on Llama, 0.487 to 0.150 on Gemma), mostly by failing to emit the required structured output (80-95% of runs on Llama, 100% on Gemma at the two highest levels); (iii) with the same pollution fed into the decoupled logic path, the dedicated-adapter, dedicated-format path is still more robust than the single pass on the 8B model (failure 0-20% vs 80-95%; paired $Δ$ +0.30 to +0.50, Cliff's $δ$ 0.50-0.85, Holm-adjusted $p \le 0.03$) but not on the 4B model, where both collapse. Separation costs one extra decode on a topic's first turn (28.2 s vs 18.2 s on Llama) and buys persona hot-swapping in 1.7 ms without re-running the logic path. Code, rubric, fixtures, adapters and logs are released.

</details>


### [179] [MIRROR: From Imitation to Internalization in LLM Personalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09795)
*Huayi Lai,Jicheng Yang,Min Yi,Chong Meng*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出自蒸馏框架MIRROR及其插件MIRROR-F，将LLM个性化从参考文本模仿转向偏好内化，在三个个性化生成基准上取得领先性能与更优文本质量，且灾难性遗忘更少。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 个性化LLM的需求正从风格模仿转向内容质量，但现有微调范式难以弥合这一差距；作者探究自蒸馏能否解决该局限。

Method: MIRROR采用参考揭示的on-policy自蒸馏，替代参考token模仿，在模型自身生成轨迹上将下一token分布与参考条件化的自身对齐，从而内化用户偏好；MIRROR-F作为焦点插件，在on-policy分布对齐基础上对信息量高的参考token进行选择性监督。

Result: 在三个个性化生成基准、两种模型规模及参考评估与LLM评估下，MIRROR与MIRROR-F取得领先的整体个性化性能与更优文本质量；在三个未见个性化生成任务上，相比SFT基线灾难性遗忘更少，且增益跨模型规模与应用场景一致。

Conclusion: 自蒸馏可有效弥合个性化中内容质量与风格模仿的差距，偏好内化优于参考措辞复现，MIRROR框架具备良好的泛化性与抗遗忘能力。

Abstract: The demand for personalized LLMs is shifting from style imitation toward content quality. We investigate whether self-distillation can bridge this gap in existing fine-tuning paradigm. To address this limitation, we introduce MIRROR(Meta- personalization by Internalizing Reference-Revealed On-policy Reflections), a novel self-distillation framework that shifts LLM personalization from imitation toward preference internalization. First, we replace reference-token imitation with reference-revealed on-policy self-distillation, aligning the model's next-token distributions along its own generation trajectories with those of its reference-conditioned self, thereby internalizing user preferences rather than reproducing reference wording.Second, we introduce MIRROR-F, a focal plug-in that augments on-policy distributional alignment with selective supervision over informative reference tokens, thereby strengthening content generation while preserving user-specific expression. Across three personalized generation benchmarks, two model scales, and complementary reference-based and LLM-based evaluations, MIRROR and MIRROR-F achieve leading overall personalization performance and superior text quality, while exhibiting less catastrophic forgetting than SFT-based baselines on three unseen personalized generation tasks. The gains are consistent across model scales and application scenarios, translating to improved performance in LLM personalization tasks.

</details>


### [180] [A Deafening Silence: Catastrophic Forgetting Lives in the Output Embeddings of Tokens the Data Never Speaks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09835)
*Jonghyun Han,Younghoon Song,Jongyoul Park*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 在无原始数据的持续预训练/微调场景中，遗忘集中在"新语料中罕见词"的输出嵌入行上，其机制是Adam二阶矩归一化放大了缺失token的单侧softmax梯度；仅对输出投影层提高Adam的epsilon即可消除39.4%–67.9%的遗忘，且不损害目标学习、无需逐模型调参，并能与replay叠加。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 持续预训练与微调会不可避免地引发灾难性遗忘，常用replay缓解，但原始数据往往不可得，属于"无数据"困境。作者希望在无数据条件下回答两个问题：遗忘到底发生在哪里（定位），以及为什么会发生（机制），从而得到无需原始数据的防御手段。

Method: 1) 在五种设定、最大1.4B模型上系统性冻结参数，定位遗忘发生的位置；2) 结合token词频统计做预训练前的风险排序；3) 从梯度角度分析机制，指出缺失token产生持续的单侧softmax梯度，被Adam的二阶矩（sqrt(v-hat)）归一化放大为满幅更新；4) 据此提出干预：训练时仅对输出投影（output projection）提高Adam的epsilon；5) 在160M–12B、四个模型家族、八种设定上验证，并测试与replay的组合效果及对LoRA的影响。

Result: 遗忘选择性集中在输出嵌入中"新语料罕见token"对应的行，而body中同属sqrt(v-hat)频段的参数是惰性的，新学习发生在别处；这种定位由语料的词汇缺失（vocabulary deficiency）决定，而非训练模式，因此可在固定基座模型内仅凭token计数做重训练前的风险排序。仅对输出投影提高epsilon的干预在七个稳定配置上消除39.4%–67.9%的遗忘，不损害目标学习、无需逐模型调参；与replay可叠加甚至更优（Qwen/Korean上达79.8%），并将released-head LoRA从23倍遗忘激增中挽救回来。事后编辑漂移行只能恢复不足5%的遗忘，说明干预必须在训练中进行。

Conclusion: 当语料"饿死"词汇表时，一行优化器参数调整（输出投影上提高Adam epsilon）可能成为对抗灾难性遗忘的首要防御手段，且必须在训练期间实施而非事后修补。

Abstract: Continual pre-training and fine-tuning in Large Language Models (LLMs) inevitably induce catastrophic forgetting, typically mitigated by replay using often-inaccessible original data. In this data-free regime, we analyze where forgetting occurs and why. Systematic parameter freezing across five settings up to 1.4B reveals that forgetting concentrates selectively in the output embeddings of tokens rarely seen in the new corpus, whereas the same sqrt(v-hat) band of the body is inert and new learning resides elsewhere. This localization is governed by the vocabulary deficiency of the corpus rather than the training mode, allowing pre-retraining risk ranking from token counts alone within a fixed base model. Mechanistically, absent tokens receive persistent one-sided softmax gradients that Adam's second-moment (sqrt(v-hat)) normalization amplifies into full-sized updates. We therefore propose an intervention: raising Adam's epsilon exclusively for the output projection during training. Across eight settings spanning 160M to 12B parameters and four model families, this removes 39.4% to 67.9% of forgetting across all seven stable configurations without degrading target learning or requiring per-model tuning. The defense combines additively or better with replay (79.8% on Qwen/Korean) and rescues released-head LoRA from a 23-fold forgetting surge. Because post-hoc editing of the drifted rows recovers under 5% of forgetting, the intervention must operate during training. Our findings indicate that a single-line optimizer adjustment may serve as the primary defense against catastrophic forgetting where the corpus starves the vocabulary.

</details>


### [181] [Training Advisors for LLM Agents from Task Outcomes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09858)
*Sergei Polezhaev,Barys Liskavets,Ori Press,Alexander Golubev*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出 Caddie：一种用结果监督的强化学习训练"评论家"（critic）的方法，在智能体执行多步任务时提供自然语言分析与建议，无需步骤级标注或参考评论，可跨基座模型与任务域迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 LLM 智能体通过交替进行推理、工具调用与环境观察来完成多步任务，自然语言反馈有助于执行过程中修正决策；但已有方法依赖步骤级标签或参考评论（reference critiques），标注成本高、难以泛化。作者希望仅凭智能体最终是否成功这一结果信号来训练评论家。

Method: Caddie 在基座模型冻结的前提下，用强化学习优化评论家模型；奖励信号来自智能体在接受评论反馈后最终是否成功，而非步骤级标注。训练任务为单基座模型上的多跳问答（MuSiQue）。智能体可在推理时自主决定何时向评论家求助（inference-time help-seeking）。

Result: 以 Qwen3-4B 为统一基座训练出的评论家，在不同规模与架构的四个基座模型上均提升成功率，其中三个模型在训练中未见；在 MuSiQue 上使 Qwen3-4B 成功率提升超过 25 个百分点，超过无评论家的 Kimi K3；同一评论家在域外交互式基准 τ³ 与 DeepDive 上零额外训练即有增益。

Conclusion: 结果表明：智能体可以在推理阶段自行决定何时寻求评论家帮助；基于最终结果的评论家训练能够产生跨基座模型、跨任务域可迁移的指导，且无需步骤级监督与额外微调。

Abstract: Large language model agents tackle multi-step tasks by interleaving reasoning and tool calls with observations from the environment. Prior work has shown that natural-language feedback can help these agents revise their decisions during task execution. We introduce Caddie, a method for training critics to provide natural-language analysis and advice as agents work through a task. Unlike approaches that rely on step-level labels or reference critiques, Caddie learns from whether the agent ultimately succeeds after receiving the critic's feedback. We optimize the critic through reinforcement learning while keeping the base model frozen. Trained on multi-hop question answering with a single base model, our Qwen3-4B critic improves success rates across four base models of different scales and architectures, including three not used during critic training. On the MuSiQue benchmark, the trained critic improves Qwen3-4B's success rate by more than 25 percentage points, surpassing the performance of Kimi K3 without a critic. The same critic also yields gains on out-of-domain interactive benchmarks, including $τ^3$ and DeepDive, with no additional training. Our results show that agents can decide when to seek help from a critic at inference time and that outcome-based critic training can produce guidance that transfers across base models and task domains.

</details>


### [182] [Beyond Outcome Rewards: Constructing and Assigning Retrieval Credit for Search Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10179)
*Wenyu Huang,Xinyu Hou,Pavlos Vougiouklis,Ruofei Lai,Jeff Z. Pan*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文将中间监督引入搜索智能体的强化学习训练，系统研究奖励塑形与信用分配策略，并提出结合中间信号与最终结果奖励的训练框架，在多基准上提升了搜索智能体性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 搜索智能体需通过多轮检索处理复杂多跳问题，而基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）仅依赖稀疏的结果监督，导致信用分配困难、学习效率受限，因此需要研究如何利用中间监督改善训练。

Method: 系统研究多种奖励塑形与信用分配策略，从中间检索步骤提供学习信号；在此基础上提出将中间信号与最终结果奖励相结合的强化学习训练框架，并在统一训练条件下开展多基准实验。

Result: 在多个基准、匹配训练条件下，搜索智能体的总体性能得到提升；中间信号的选择及其信用分配位置均会影响训练行为。

Conclusion: 奖励设计与信用分配是训练高效搜索智能体的重要设计维度，中间监督可有效缓解结果监督稀疏带来的信用分配难题。

Abstract: Search agents enable Large Language Models (LLMs) to iteratively retrieve and use information for complex multi-hop questions. Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) offers a promising approach for post-training such agents, but its reliance on sparse, outcome-based supervision can make credit assignment difficult and limit learning efficiency. In this paper, we systematically investigate how intermediate supervision can improve reinforcement learning for search agents. We study a range of reward-shaping and credit-assignment strategies that provide learning signals from intermediate retrieval steps. Building on these insights, we develop a training framework that combines intermediate signals with final outcome rewards to improve learning from multi-step search trajectories. Experiments across multiple benchmarks under matched training conditions demonstrate improvements in aggregate search-agent performance and show that both the choice of intermediate signal and where its credit is assigned affect training behaviour. These findings show that reward design and credit assignment are important design dimensions for training effective search agents.

</details>


### [183] [LLM Persuasion Is in the Eye of the Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10232)
*Kamile Dementaviciute,Julija Vaitonyte,Tijl De Bie*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文将9种已发表的LLM说服力自动评估方法统一到同一设置下,对15个LLM进行评测,发现方法间排名一致性很弱(平均Spearman ρ=0.25)。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM的说服能力已达甚至超越人类专家,既可被用于教育、健康传播等有益用途,也可被用于操纵与误导;然而现有评估高度碎片化,各研究对"说服"的定义不一,宽泛结论常建立在狭窄的情境化评估之上,因此开发者和监管者亟需可比、可规模化、且能覆盖高风险说服形式的评估。

Method: 作者将9种已发表的自动化说服评估方法适配到统一实验设置,在同一批15个LLM上运行,并检验这些方法的模型排名是否一致及其原因;分析中考察了任务拒答行为和模型的通用能力这两个因素。

Result: 方法间一致性很弱,平均Spearman ρ=0.25。部分任务拒答(直接或间接)使一致性降低约四分之一,且拒答主要集中于操纵类任务;通用能力方面,多数理性说服(非操纵)方法能追踪模型通用能力,而多数操纵类方法则不能。

Conclusion: 一致性更多取决于方法所设定的任务,而非其如何为说服打分(但仅有8种方法可分析,该模式仅为指示性)。更广泛地看,说服分数混合了模型"能否说服"与"是否愿意说服",因此单一分数只对其自身设定有信息量,难以推广到跨任务的说服力判断。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have already been shown to match or exceed human experts in persuasion. While their persuasive capabilities hold promise for beneficial uses such as education and health communication, they can also be used to manipulate and misinform, making their evaluation a growing priority for developers and regulators. That evaluation, however, remains fragmented: studies differ in what they treat as persuasion, and broad claims often rest on narrow, situation-specific assessments. Automated methods, often modelled on human studies, offer a way to compare such assessments directly, as they can be run on the same models at scale and can include high-risk forms of persuasion that would be difficult or unethical to test on people. In this study, we adapt nine published automated methods to a shared setup, run them on the same fifteen LLMs, and ask whether their rankings agree and why. We find that the methods agree only weakly (mean Spearman $ρ= 0.25$). Our analyses point to two contributing factors. Models that refuse some tasks but not others, directly or indirectly, lower agreement by about a quarter, and these refusals fall mostly on manipulation tasks. General capability also plays a part: most rational persuasion (non-manipulative) methods track it, whereas most manipulation methods do not. Together, these findings suggest that agreement depends more on the task a method sets than on how it scores persuasion, although this pattern is only indicative given the eight methods available for analysis. More broadly, our results suggest that persuasion scores combine a model's ability to persuade with its willingness to do so. A single score is therefore informative about its own setting, but says little about a model's persuasiveness across tasks.

</details>


### [184] [PHRBench: A Behavioral Evaluation of Post-Hallucination Reasoning in LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10455)
*Linghao Meng,Feng He,Xuan Yang,Junyuan Mao,Pinze Ren,Deqing Mu,Hesen Yang,Qiankun Li*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出受控基准 PHRBench，从行为层面结构化刻画大模型在幻觉后推理（PHR）中如何处理被污染的上下文，覆盖4个领域、18个模型、4820个受控实例，并发现成功纠错依赖更频繁的信念更新。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 幻觉信息会在多阶段 LLM 系统中传播并进入后续推理上下文。已有 PHR 研究主要刻画最终结果变化和聚合推理动态，对模型在响应层面如何消解幻觉前提理解不足。

Method: 构建 PHRBench 受控基准，独立于最终答案正确性，将每条推理轨迹划分为幻觉遵从（Hallucination Compliance）、幻觉规避（Hallucination Avoidance）和启发式纠正（Heuristic Correction）三类；将"有洞察力的轨迹"定义为成功纠正并最终得到正确答案，并在4个领域、18个模型上进行4820个受控实例的评测。

Result: 成功恢复（纠错）整体较为罕见，且与推理轨迹中更频繁的信念更新相关；幻觉提示自身的属性对成功恢复具有显著预测信号，轻量预测器达到 AUROC 0.847。

Conclusion: 研究提供了 PHR 的行为视角，刻画了 LLM 如何消解错误上下文以及成功恢复在何时更可能发生。

Abstract: Hallucinated information can propagate through multi-stage LLM systems and become part of the context for subsequent reasoning. Existing studies of post-hallucination reasoning (PHR) mainly characterize changes in final outcomes and aggregate reasoning dynamics, leaving how models resolve hallucinated premises at the response level insufficiently understood. In this work, we introduce PHRBench, a controlled benchmark for behaviorally structured PHR across four domains and 18 large language models. PHRBench characterizes each reasoning trajectory independently of final-answer correctness through Hallucination Compliance, Hallucination Avoidance, and Heuristic Correction, and defines an insightful trajectory as successful correction that ultimately reaches the correct answer.
