Several new datasets and studies have examined this setting, showing that the current embedding models often struggle to follow such instructions reliably. In this paper, we study the mechanism of how instructions actually affect the representations of retrieval queries in asymmetric retrieval tasks. We show that models can fail to follow even simple task instructions when query-side distractors are included in the evaluation. We hypothesize that this behavior is driven by the training setup of current embedding models and their evaluation, and show that fine-tuning with added query-side distractors leads to substantial improvements, with minimal effect on other tasks.

</details>


### [220] [EngramEdit: Decoupled Knowledge Updates in LLMs through Conditional Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10533)
*Hongru Cai,Ran Wei,Wenjie Wang,Chengfa Wu,Ning Song,Yongqi Li,Wenjie Li*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出 EngramEdit，通过对条件记忆架构（以 DeepSeek Engram 为代表）中的共享 n-gram 嵌入进行联合更新，实现与 Transformer 主干解耦的事实知识编辑。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 条件记忆架构（如 DeepSeek Engram）用输入 n-gram 查询学习到的嵌入，能在有限额外计算下扩展 LLM 容量，并展现出将事实知识存储与通用计算解耦的潜力，从而有望在冻结 Transformer 主干的前提下更新事实知识。然而实现该潜力存在困难：同一事实的不同表达会激活不同的 n-gram 嵌入，而更新共享嵌入又可能意外改变模型对其他事实的预测。

Method: EngramEdit 分两步：首先计算目标记忆表示，使模型在多种表达下都能预测更新后的事实；然后联合更新共享 n-gram 嵌入，使其在多种表达和多次编辑中匹配这些目标，并对被频繁复用的嵌入施加更强的更新惩罚，以保护无关知识。

Result: 实验表明，EngramEdit 能通过条件记忆实现独立的事实知识更新，编辑成功率接近完美；修订后的知识可迁移到未见表达并支持多跳推理，在思维链（CoT）提示下准确率约为最强基线的三倍；即使事实更新不断累积，无关知识与通用能力也基本得以保留。

Conclusion: EngramEdit 将条件记忆转变为可编辑的知识接口，使其作用超越模型规模扩展，支持解耦式知识更新。

Abstract: Conditional memory architectures such as DeepSeek Engram use input n-grams to look up learned embeddings, expanding the capacity of large language models (LLMs) with limited additional computation. Beyond model scaling, this architecture has demonstrated the potential to decouple factual knowledge storage from general-purpose computation, offering a promising route to updating factual knowledge while keeping the Transformer backbone fixed. Realizing this potential is challenging because different expressions of a fact may activate different n-gram embeddings, while updating shared embeddings can unintentionally change the model's predictions about other facts. We propose EngramEdit for decoupled knowledge updates through conditional memory. EngramEdit first computes target memory representations that make the model predict the updated fact across multiple expressions. It then jointly updates the shared n-gram embeddings to match these targets across expressions and edits, penalizing updates to frequently reused embeddings more strongly to preserve unrelated knowledge. Experiments show that EngramEdit enables independent factual knowledge updates through conditional memory, achieving near-perfect editing success. Revised knowledge is usable across unseen expressions and in multi-hop reasoning, with nearly three times the strongest baseline's accuracy under chain-of-thought (CoT) prompting. Unrelated knowledge and general capabilities are largely preserved even as factual updates accumulate. These findings show that EngramEdit turns conditional memory into an editable knowledge interface, extending its role beyond model scaling to support decoupled knowledge updates.

</details>


<div id='cs.IR'></div>

# cs.IR [[Back]](#toc)

### [221] [Trustworthy Domain-Specific AI for Structured Knowledge Retrieval and Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08894)
*Ryan C. Barron*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 该博士论文提出一套可扩展架构，将非结构化领域文本转化为结构化知识，集成语料策展、语义结构化、检索与推理，核心贡献包括Binary Bleed、HNMFk、类型化知识图谱与向量库同步、T-SRAG及张量链接预测，并在多个领域验证效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决非结构化、领域特定文本难以用于检索与推理的问题，并提升检索精度、语义保真度与可解释性，减少幻觉，构建可信的领域AI系统。

Method: 1) 半自动语料策展与语义结构化流程；2) Binary Bleed——适配的二分搜索方法，降低NMF低秩搜索复杂度；3) HNMFk——带自动潜在特征选择的层次NMF主题建模，生成可解释分类体系并由领域专家引导；4) 将表示填充至类型化知识图谱与语义对齐向量库，经事件驱动底座同步；5) T-SRAG动态路由检索路径，对比对齐映射文档与查询嵌入到层次主题结构；6) 基于张量的链接预测补全知识图谱缺失链接，支持引用结构推理。

Result: 在网络安全、法律、材料科学与医疗健康等应用中，检索精度、早期趋势检测、假设生成及幻觉缓解均有提升。

Conclusion: 该论文提供了可部署、模块化的基础框架，用于构建可信的、领域特定的AI系统，实现对结构化知识的检索与推理。

Abstract: This dissertation presents a scalable architecture for transforming unstructured, domain-specific text into structured knowledge for retrieval and reasoning. It integrates semi-automatic corpus curation, semantic structuring, retrieval, and inference into an interpretable pipeline.
  The research introduces Binary Bleed, an adapted binary search method that reduces low-rank search complexity for Non-negative Matrix Factorization (NMF), and Hierarchical NMF with automatic latent feature selection (HNMFk), a depth-adaptive topic modeling method that produces interpretable taxonomies guided by subject matter experts. These representations populate a typed Knowledge Graph and a semantically aligned Vector Store containing extracted latent features, synchronized through an event-driven substrate.
  Tensor-Structured Retrieval-Augmented Generation (T-SRAG) dynamically routes queries across retrieval paths. Contrastive alignment maps document and query embeddings to hierarchical topic structures to improve semantic fidelity and reduce hallucinations. Beyond retrieval, tensor-based link prediction identifies and completes missing links in the Knowledge Graph, supporting inference grounded in citation structure.
  Applications across cybersecurity, law, materials science, and healthcare demonstrate improvements in retrieval precision, early trend detection, hypothesis generation, and hallucination mitigation. The dissertation provides a deployable, modular foundation for trustworthy, domain-specific AI systems that retrieve and reason over structured knowledge.

</details>


### [222] [What Transfers from a VLM Teacher? Comparing Supervision Signals for Visual Document Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09177)
*Saba Sturua,Han Xiao*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 该论文质疑视觉文档检索器对比学习中将VLM教师信号用于"正样本增强"的做法，转而将教师用于评判被挖出的负样本候选，在相同学生、数据、优化器和评测下显著提升ViDoRe v2/v3检索性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 对比训练中每条查询仅有一个标注正样本页，负样本被预设为不相关，但标签本身并不完整：标注者实际判定查询前四个被挖出候选中的约两个为相关，却未被打标，导致训练把相关页当作负样本推开。作者据此提出，教师的价值应体现在判断这些"标签沉默"的负样本候选上，而非仅用于丰富正样本。

Method: 在固定学生模型、数据、优化器与评测的前提下，将VLM教师用于对检索器挖出的负样本候选进行评判，采用教师判定的困难负样本与分数蒸馏；并与正样本描述对齐、注意力 grounding 等既有教师用法比较。同时设置无教师规则基线，从同一挖出候选池中按相同训练计算量选取四个候选，其中最强规则即现有系统使用的正样本感知阈值法。

Result: 教师判定的困难负样本与分数蒸馏将ViDoRe v2的nDCG@5从55.2分别提升至62.6和63.0；描述对齐仅增益2.6分，注意力grounding无可测增益。相较最佳无教师规则基线，教师判断在v2上额外提升4.1分、v3上提升1.7分。教师信号较粗糙：0-100评分提示下82%的评分落在量表两端，但仅用相关/不相关二分仍能保留大部分蒸馏增益。十人标注审计显示教师处于人类标注者变异范围内，并在查询存在单一确定答案时表现可靠。

Conclusion: 将VLM教师用于评判负样本候选比用于正样本增强更有效，性能提升与标签不完整性一致；教师判断虽粗糙但在人类标注变异范围内可靠，尤其在单一确定答案场景。作者公开代码、330万条教师判断与页面描述、挖出候选池、人工审计及训练适配器。

Abstract: Visual document retrievers are trained contrastively: each query is matched to one page labelled relevant - the positive - and pushed away from negatives, pages presumed irrelevant. Recent methods distil a vision-language model (VLM) teacher into the retriever by enriching that positive, transferring the teacher's attention over it or a description of it. We ask whether the teacher is better spent on the other side, judging the candidates the retriever mines as negatives, which the label says nothing about. With student, data, optimizer and evaluation fixed, teacher-judged hard negatives and score distillation raise ViDoRe v2 nDCG@5 from 55.2 to 62.6 and 63.0; description alignment, as adapted here, gains 2.6 points and attention grounding nothing measurable. Against teacher-free rules that select four candidates from the same mined pool at identical training compute, the best of which is the positive-aware threshold current systems use, the teacher's judgement adds 4.1 points on v2 and 1.7 on v3. This is consistent with how incomplete the labels are. Annotators judge about two of a query's four top-ranked mined candidates relevant, none of them labelled, so training pushes the retriever away from relevant pages treated as negatives. What reaches the student is coarse: under a greedily decoded 0-100 rating prompt, 82% of the teacher's ratings come back at one end of the scale or the other, and a relevant/irrelevant partition keeps most of the distillation gain. A ten-annotator audit places the teacher within the range of variation among human annotators, and finds it reliable where a query has a single determinate answer. We release the code, the teacher's 3.3M judgements and page descriptions, the mined pools, the human audit and the trained adapters at https://github.com/elastic/vdr-teacher-signals.

</details>


### [223] [Quantize by Drift: Label-Free Mixed-Precision Post-Training Quantization for Text Embedders](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09227)
*Hyojung Han,Jongmin Kim,Seung-Hun Jeon*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出用"量化导致的表示漂移"作为文本嵌入器混合精度量化的无标签敏感度信号，在5个嵌入器上其配置级漂移与检索质量排序高度一致（Spearman 0.911），并可作为硬字节预算下的加法分配目标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 混合精度训练后量化需要逐模块的敏感度信号，而文本嵌入器最直观的敏感度指标——某模块被量化后造成的检索质量损失——依赖部署中通常不具备的相关性标注。因此亟需一种无需标签的替代敏感度信号。

Method: 以"量化诱导的表示漂移"作为替代信号：量化单个模块后重新编码语料，记录输出嵌入相对全精度位置的偏移量；观测对象是稠密检索器用于排序的部署输出表示。在硬性打包字节预算下，将其用于一种加性分配（无标签、无搜索）。在三款方法/基线/假设冻结封存前未触碰的嵌入器上做预注册的方向性检验。

Result: 在5个开发嵌入器上，配置级漂移对留出检索质量的排序达到宏平均Spearman 0.911；敏感度可跨校准语料与检索域迁移；模块漂移可排序一致地组合但数值不可加；相关性推导的敏感度无一致增益。预注册的方向性假设对先前的LieQ准则成立（主预算3/3无崩溃），漂移在2/3情况下优于双侧LieQ steelman；但主预算下漂移数值低于同预算均匀精度（-0.99、-0.85、-1.01分），尽管已按设计降低了模块与整体模型漂移。

Conclusion: 输出漂移是一种稳健的粗粒度敏感度信号，而非普适最优的分配目标：它避免了迁移自符号几何适配的灾难性失败，在均匀精度崩溃的压力预算下仍可用，但在强均匀工作点附近的细粒度重分配仍未解决。

Abstract: Mixed-precision post-training quantization needs a per-module sensitivity signal; for a text embedder the obvious one -- the retrieval quality a module costs when quantized -- needs relevance labels that deployments rarely have. We measure a label-free substitute: quantization-induced representation drift, obtained by quantizing one module, re-encoding the corpus, and recording how far the output embeddings moved from their full-precision positions. What is specific is the observable: the deployed output representation a dense retriever ranks with. Across five development embedders, configuration-level drift orders sampled mixed-precision plans against held-out retrieval quality at a macro Spearman of 0.911, the sensitivity transports across calibration corpora and retrieval domains in the usable regime, module drifts compose rank-consistently but not numerically, and relevance-derived sensitivity adds no consistent value. The method is one additive allocation under a hard packed-byte budget, with no labels and no search. On three embedders held untouched until method, baselines and hypotheses were frozen and sealed, the pre-registered directional hypothesis against the prior LieQ criterion holds (3/3 at the main budget, no collapse) and drift scores above a two-sided LieQ steelman in 2/3; but at the main budget drift is numerically lower than same-budget uniform precision on all three (-0.99, -0.85, -1.01 points), having reduced module and whole-model drift as designed. Output drift is thus a robust coarse sensitivity signal, not a universally optimal allocation objective: it avoids the catastrophic failures of the transferred signed-geometry adaptation and can remain usable at stressed budgets where uniform collapses, but fine-grained redistribution around a strong uniform operating point remains unresolved.

</details>


### [224] [Reading Position Is the Baseline to Beat: A Time-Ordered Evaluation of Personalised Highlight Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09262)
*Kazuki Nakayashiki,Keisuke Watanabe*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 在按时间顺序的评测中，"读者首个高亮下方的后续句子"（阅读位置基线）比流行度和两种相似度方法更能预测下一个高亮，但该基线依赖预测目标，且相似度方法相对流行度无显著增益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 阅读产品通常用"相似读者标注内容"来推荐高亮，并以流行度作为基准评价效果。作者认为真正的基线应是阅读位置，因为读者首次高亮后的连续阅读位置本身就是最廉价、最直接的个人信号，而此前工作忽视了这一基线，且常用非时间顺序评测和合成数据，可能高估相似度方法的效果。

Method: 在一个社交高亮平台上进行时间顺序评测（筛选后为1,511个页面的7,343个读者-页面配对，每个仅保留一个高亮）。比较三类方法：阅读位置基线（对首个高亮下方句子排序）、流行度、以及两种相似度方法。预测目标区分两种：紧接首个高亮后的下一个高亮，以及所有后续高亮。还测试了按距最新高亮距离折减的流行度（三种尺度中平均精度最佳者）。此外设置预先指定的比较，检验相似度是否优于流行度，并用合成读者与乱序评测作为对照，检验"偏好发现"与"预测位置"的区别。

Result: 对下一个高亮，位置基线在47%情况下将下一个高亮排进前五，而流行度为26%，较优相似度方法为29%。但对所有后续高亮，位置基线反而不及流行度；按距离折减的流行度在两个目标上均胜过流行度和两种相似度方法。预先指定的比较显示，在1至5个高亮范围内，两种相似度方法在所有后续高亮上的平均精度均未超过流行度，且+0.01的增益被排除。合成读者（共享同一偏好集）会产生增益，乱序评测则显示方法只是预测了读者去过的位置。

Conclusion: 位置基线结果属探索性、尚未确证。文档内的个性化推荐应在时间顺序下评测，并必须与阅读位置基线对比；相似度方法的表面增益可能源于评测设置（如合成数据或乱序），而非真正捕捉到读者偏好。

Abstract: A reader's first highlights on a page are the cheapest personal signal a reading product has. The natural plan is to suggest what similar earlier readers marked, and to judge the result against popularity. We argue that the baseline to beat is reading position. In a time-ordered evaluation on one social highlighting platform (7,343 reader-page pairs on 1,511 pages after one highlight), ranking the sentences just below a reader's first highlight, with no other reader's data, puts the next highlight in the top five 47% of the time, against 26% for popularity and 29% for the better of two similarity methods. The baseline depends on the target: over all later highlights that ranking loses to popularity, while popularity discounted by distance from the latest highlight, at the scale with the best average precision of three tried, beats popularity and both similarity methods on both targets. In a comparison specified in advance, neither similarity method shows a gain over popularity in average precision over all later highlights, from one to five highlights, and a gain of +0.01 is excluded. Nor would a gain by itself show that a method has found a reader's preferences: synthetic readers who share one set of preferences produce one, and an evaluation out of time order shows a method where the reader went. The position results are exploratory and unconfirmed. Personalisation inside a document should be evaluated in time order and against reading position.

</details>


### [225] [From Chunks to Functional Evidence: Function-Aware Retrieval for EDA Documentation QA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09361)
*Xiaotian Qiu,Kairui Liu,Shi Chenyi,Jinyuan Deng,Qi Sun,Cheng Zhuo*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 该论文指出EDA文档问答的瓶颈在于查询与知识组织方式不匹配，提出将RAG检索单元改为"功能单元"超边，并通过编码器对齐与单元-块混合检索、统一重排序提升效果，在EDADocEval-QA上ROUGE-L较Chunk RAG提升37.1%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在复杂技术文档（尤其EDA文档）中，答案所需信息分散于异构但紧耦合的工件之间，RAG的主要瓶颈并非模型推理能力，而是查询与检索知识组织方式之间的错配。传统基于孤立文本块或二元关系的检索单元无法有效捕获这种跨工件、功能层面的耦合结构。

Method: 重新设计RAG的基本检索单元：将带类型的工件聚合为"EDA功能单元"，每个单元以超边（hyperedge）形式记录并链接到其源文本块；训练编码器将查询与功能单元对齐；结合功能单元检索与直接文本块检索；将选中的功能单元映射回源块后，由统一重排序器（reranker）选择交给生成器的证据。

Result: 在新构建的EDADocEval-QA数据集上，ROUGE-L较Chunk RAG提升37.1%，较最强图基线提升55.6%；在公开基准ORD-MMBench上，ROUGE-L较最强基线提升30.0%。

Conclusion: 结果表明，在所评估的EDA文档场景中，功能感知（function-aware）的证据组织方式能够有效缓解查询与知识组织之间的错配，验证了以功能单元为检索单元的设计有效性。

Abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) is widely used to ground answers in documents. For complex technical documentation, however, the primary bottleneck is often not model reasoning but a mismatch between a query and the way knowledge is organized for retrieval. This mismatch is pronounced in Electronic Design Automation (EDA) documentation, where the information needed for an answer is scattered across heterogeneous yet tightly coupled artifacts. We therefore redesign the basic retrieval unit of RAG. Instead of operating on isolated chunks or binary relations, we collect typed artifacts into EDA functional units. Each unit is recorded as a hyperedge with links to its source chunks. We then train an encoder to align queries with functional units and combine unit retrieval with direct chunk retrieval. After mapping the selected units back to their sources, a unified reranker chooses the evidence given to the generator. On the newly constructed EDADocEval-QA dataset, our method improves ROUGE-L by 37.1% over Chunk RAG and 55.6% over the strongest graph baseline. On the public ORD-MMBench benchmark, it improves ROUGE-L by 30.0% over the strongest baseline. These results support function-aware evidence organization in the evaluated EDA documentation settings.

</details>


### [226] [Finding the Right Balance: Relevance and Diversity in LLM Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09412)
*Guillaume Brouillette,Faustin Kagabo,Usef Faghihi,Nadia Ghazzali*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 检索多样化在RAG中的效果取决于候选池冗余度与查询所需证据数量的匹配关系，据此提出查询自适应多样化规则与RNG-Score重排器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究对检索多样化能否提升检索与答案质量存在分歧，作者试图揭示效果差异背后的条件性因素，即候选池冗余度与查询证据需求的交互作用。

Method: 采用受控的近重复注入与生产式重叠分块构建不同冗余度的候选池；提出查询自适应规则，当最近邻top-k中有效不同文档数低于查询证据需求时才进行多样化，该规则直接由现有嵌入计算；同时提出几何重排器RNG-Score，配备精确最近邻回退机制，其间隔可指示重复结构。

Result: 在干净候选池上，多样化损害相关性、证据覆盖与答案质量；在多证据任务中，当冗余导致最近邻检索选中重复段落时，多样化转为有益。查询自适应规则可获取大部分可达收益，跨数据集与编码器迁移良好，并对单证据查询自动退化为最近邻检索。

Conclusion: 检索多样化应基于可观测的冗余度与证据需求量进行选择性使用，而非普遍启用。

Abstract: Retrieval diversification is widely available in retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) frameworks, yet prior studies disagree on whether it improves retrieval and answer quality. We show that its effectiveness varies primarily with candidate-pool redundancy, in a pattern consistent with the number of distinct evidence pieces a query requires. Using controlled near-duplicate injection and production-style overlapping chunking, we find that diversification harms relevance, evidence coverage and answer quality on clean pools, but becomes beneficial on multi-evidence tasks when redundancy causes nearest-neighbor retrieval to select repeated passages. We therefore introduce a query-adaptive rule that diversifies only when the effective number of distinct documents in the nearest-neighbor top-$k$ selection falls below the query's evidence requirement. Computed from existing embeddings, the rule captures most of the achievable gain, transfers across datasets and encoders and automatically reduces to nearest-neighbor retrieval for single-evidence queries. We also introduce RNG-Score, a geometric reranker with an exact nearest-neighbor fallback whose margin indicates duplicate structure. Overall, we conclude that diversification should be used selectively, based on observable redundancy and evidence requirements.

</details>


### [227] [Towards Explaining Query Expansion Performance in Information Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09724)
*Sourav Saha,Aditya Dutta,Soumajit Pramanik,Mandar Mitra*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文从“理想扩展查询(IEQ)”与“可分离性(separability)”两个互补视角解释查询扩展(QE)效果的差异，并在TREC多个集合上验证：越接近IEQ的扩展查询检索效果越好，相关/非相关文档的可分离性提供了补充性解释。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: QE广泛用于缓解信息检索中的词汇不匹配问题，在基于大语言模型的现代检索系统中仍有价值，但没有任何单一QE方法能在所有查询上稳定占优。本文旨在解释这种QE性能差异的来源。

Method: 提出两个互补视角：一是理想扩展查询(IEQ)，即在与下游BM25检索模型配合时能最大化检索效果的假设性查询；二是可分离性视角，用Cohen's d量化给定扩展查询下相关文档与非相关文档得分的区分程度。作者设计可分离性度量，并提出实用公式近似IEQ，进而分析这些因素与检索效果的关系。

Result: 在TREC Robust、TREC DL 2019–2022 passage集合以及TREC DL 2019–2020 document集合上的大量实验显示出一致规律：越接近理想扩展查询的扩展查询往往获得更高的检索效果；相关与非相关文档的可分离性为理解QE性能提供了互补视角。

Conclusion: QE性能差异可由“与IEQ的距离”和“文档得分的可分离性”共同解释，为QE方法分析与改进提供了新的理论视角和度量工具。

Abstract: Query Expansion (QE) techniques have long been widely used in Information Retrieval (IR) to address the vocabulary mismatch problem. They remain relevant in modern retrieval systems, including those based on large language models (LLMs). However, no single QE method consistently outperforms others across all queries. This work seeks to explain the variation in QE performance through two complementary perspectives. The first is the concept of an Ideal Expanded Query (IEQ)--a hypothetical query that maximizes retrieval effectiveness with a downstream BM25 retrieval model. The second is a separability perspective, which quantifies how distinctly relevant and non-relevant documents are scored for a given expanded query using Cohen's (d). We develop a separability measure and practical formulations to approximate the IEQ and investigate how these factors relate to retrieval effectiveness. Extensive experiments on the TREC Robust collection, TREC DL 2019-2022 passage collections, and TREC DL 2019-2020 document collections reveal several interesting patterns. In particular, we find that expanded queries that are closer to the ideal expanded query tend to achieve higher retrieval effectiveness. We further show that the separability of relevant and non-relevant documents provides a complementary perspective for understanding QE performance.

</details>


### [228] [The Impact of Backbone Evolution on LLM-Based Relevance Assessments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09820)
*Chuting Yu,Guido Zuccon,Teerapong Leelanupab*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文挑战"LLM能力越强，相关性判断与人类一致性越高"的假设：在固定提示词下，评估商业模型（Gemini、GPT）与开源模型（Qwen、Llama）的连续版本，发现没有一致证据表明新版本带来更好的相关性判断者，且聚合性能稳定并不代表判断稳定，早期版本正确判断未必被后续版本保留。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM快速迭代，新模型能力更强，通常被默认会在同一提示词下与人类判断更一致。作者质疑这一常识性假设，希望考察在backbone演进过程中LLM相关性判断器的行为是否真的随之改善。

Method: 保持提示词固定，选取代表性的单提示方法（UMBRELA）和基于评分标准（rubric-based）的提示方法（EXAM），在商业模型（Gemini、GPT）与开源权重模型（Qwen、Llama）的连续模型版本上进行相关性判断评估。

Result: 整体上没有一致证据表明新版本模型能产生更好的相关性判断者。更关键的是，相似甚至提升的聚合性能并不意味着判断稳定：早期backbone版本做出的正确判断不一定被后续版本保留。作者进一步分析了这些性能回退的潜在驱动因素。

Conclusion: 不应假设为某一backbone版本设计并验证过的判断提示词，在模型更新后（即使同一家族内）仍会表现相当或更好；提示词与backbone版本之间存在耦合，需要重新验证。

Abstract: LLMs are evolving rapidly, with newer models offering stronger capabilities. This suggests that in LLM-based relevance judging, more capable models will achieve higher agreement with human judgements under the same prompt. We challenge this understanding by investigating the behavior of LLM-based relevance judges under backbone evolution. Keeping the prompts fixed, we evaluate a representative single-prompt (UMBRELA) and a rubric-based prompt (EXAM) across sequential model versions of commercial (Gemini, GPT) and open-weight (Qwen, Llama) models. Overall, we find no consistent evidence that newer versions lead to better relevance judges. Crucially, similar or improved aggregate performance does not imply judgment stability: correct judgements made by an earlier version of an LLM backbone are not necessarily preserved by later versions. We investigate the potential drivers of these regressions. Our findings caution against the assumption that judging prompts designed and validated for one backbone version will perform equivalently or better when the model is updated, even within the same family.

</details>


### [229] [Inverting Multi-Vector Visual Document Indices](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09920)
*Zhuchenyang Liu,Yao Zhang,Yu Xiao*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 多向量视觉文档检索器的索引本身并不安全：仅凭存储的补丁向量即可重建页面图像，从原始索引反演可恢复约47%的单词和45%的敏感词，反演页作为查询有98.4%的概率将源页面排在第一。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多向量检索器把每页存为约千个补丁向量，常托管于第三方向量数据库。由于向量"不可读"，该索引常被当作比原文档更不敏感的数据。但索引按栅格顺序保留每个补丁的向量，且向量由预训练用于阅读文档的视觉语言模型计算，因此作者假设：运行或攻破该存储者仅凭索引即可还原页面。

Method: 将索引反演建模为条件文档图像生成，并推断攻击所需信息：编码器、页面形状，以及乱序向量的排列顺序。在 ViDoRe v3 上评估攻击效果，并测试两种低成本防护（token pooling 与 shuffle），同时训练一个模型恢复被 shuffle 索引的顺序。最后将同一攻击不加改动地迁移到另一多向量检索器以检验泛化性。

Result: ViDoRe v3 上，从原始索引反演的页面恢复47%的单词和45%的敏感 token；作为查询时98.4%的情况下将源页面排第一。token pooling 与 shuffle 均把单词召回降至约8%。顺序恢复模型把源页面排第一的比例从3.8%提升到93.5%，而反演 pooled 索引仍未被攻破。迁移到另一检索器时，反演页面仍有70.2%的概率把源页面排第一，但单词召回低于最近邻基线。

Conclusion: 多向量视觉文档检索器因存储的索引而面临反演风险，该索引应像其所编码的文档一样受到保护；token pooling 与 shuffle 能显著削弱攻击，但 shuffle 可通过顺序恢复模型破解，pooled 索引的反演仍是开放问题。

Abstract: Prevailing multi-vector visual document retrievers store each page as about a thousand patch vectors, often in vector databases run by a third party. Since no one can read a page from its vectors, this index is easily treated as less sensitive than the page. However, because the index keeps one vector per patch in raster order, and each vector is computed by a vision-language model pre-trained to read documents, we hypothesize that whoever runs or breaches the store can reproduce a page from its index alone. We frame inversion as conditional document image generation and infer from the vectors what the attack needs: the encoder, the page shape and, for shuffled vectors, their order. On the ViDoRe v3 benchmark, pages inverted from raw indices recover 47% of the words and 45% of the sensitive tokens. Used as queries against the stored indices, they rank their source page first 98.4% of the time. We test two cheap protections, token pooling and shuffling, which both cut word recall to about 8%. A model that restores the order of a shuffled index raises the share of source pages ranked first from 3.8% to 93.5%, while inverting a pooled index remains open. To test generalisation, we apply the same attack unchanged to another multi-vector retriever: its inverted pages still rank their source page first 70.2% of the time, though its word recall stays below a nearest-neighbour baseline. Multi-vector visual document retrievers are therefore vulnerable to inversion through their stored index, which should be protected like the documents it encodes.

</details>


### [230] [Training with Missed Targets in Generative Recommendation: Separating Supervision from Probability Competition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10124)
*Xuesi Wang,Yangbin Shi,Xiaolin Zheng*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 将生成式推荐器漏掉的观测目标追加到重排训练列表会同时改变三件事——已检索目标权重、新增监督信号、两组竞争概率，因此"追加/不追加"对比无法解释返回项排序的变化；作者构造三个匹配损失解耦这些效应，发现组间竞争会损害返回项排序，建议按生成器逐个评估候选补全策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式推荐器只返回有限候选集，可能在重排前漏掉观测目标。常见训练策略是把这些漏掉的目标追加到重排器训练列表中，但推理阶段仍只对原始候选排序。这一操作同时引入三种耦合变化：(1) 改变已检索目标的样本权重；(2) 对追加目标增加监督；(3) 使两组目标在概率上相互竞争。由于效应混杂，简单的有/无追加对比无法归因返回项排序的变化。

Method: 设计三个相互匹配的损失函数，在固定已检索目标权重的前提下，分别单独引入追加目标监督与组间竞争：(1) 基线损失；(2) 中间损失——在两组内部训练但分别归一化，使仅在训练中出现的追加目标不与推理候选竞争概率；(3) 完整追加损失——允许组间竞争。用公开的 OneRec 模型与本地训练的 Amazon 生成器进行实验，并在四个预先设定的 Amazon Video Games 对比中评估。

Result: 组间竞争会损害返回项排序。在四个预设的 Amazon Video Games 对比中，去除组间竞争使全目标归一化折损累计增益（FT-NDCG）提升 7.8%–22.2%；基于用户的 95% 置信区间以及四个区间中的三个（基于训练运行）均排除零。在开发集上采用保守规则时，一个留出类别中三个生成器有两个选择追加目标训练，另一个类别中三个全部拒绝，从而避免了 1.7% 的损失。

Conclusion: 候选补全（追加漏检目标）的收益并非普适，其负面影响主要来自训练目标与推理候选之间的概率竞争。应针对每个生成器单独评估是否采用该策略，而非默认自动启用。

Abstract: Generative recommenders return a limited candidate set and may omit observed targets before reranking. A training strategy appends these missed targets to reranker training lists, although inference still ranks only original candidates. This operation simultaneously changes retrieved-target weight, adds supervision over appended targets, and makes the two groups compete for probability. An append/no-append comparison therefore cannot explain changes in returned-item rankings. We construct three matched losses that hold retrieved-target weight fixed while introducing appended-target supervision and group competition separately. The intermediate loss trains within both groups but normalizes them separately, preventing training-only targets from competing with inference candidates. Experiments with a released OneRec model and locally trained Amazon generators show that this competition can harm returned-item ranking. In four prespecified Amazon Video Games comparisons, removing it improved full-target normalized discounted cumulative gain (FT-NDCG) by 7.8--22.2\%; 95\% intervals over users and three of four intervals over training runs excluded zero. A conservative development-set rule selected appended-target training for two of three generators in one held-out category and rejected it for all three in another, avoiding a 1.7\% loss. Candidate completion should therefore be evaluated for each generator rather than applied automatically.

</details>


### [231] [Does Document Structure Help Dense Retrieval? A Placebo-Controlled Ablation of Four Mechanisms Across Two Corpora](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10170)
*Andrey Kuehlkamp,Priscila Correa Saboia Moreira,Samuel Rund*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 该论文通过机制隔离式消融实验，在统一协议下检验四种文档结构处理（结构对齐分块、LLM生成块上下文、标题路径元数据、两阶段分层检索），并引入语义虚无安慰剂对照，发现"组织性"的增益源于内容而非token，朴素两阶段检索反而有害。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有检索增强生成研究分别在不同语料、嵌入器和指标下支持各类文档结构处理，且均未控制一个共同混淆因素：任何前置到块的文本都会扰动其嵌入。因此无法判断增益究竟来自结构信息的内容还是单纯增加token。

Method: 提出机制隔离式消融，在同一协议下测试四种处理，跨条件匹配块大小，并加入语义虚无安慰剂（结构有效但跨文档打乱的标题路径）。采用覆盖率感知nDCG评分，通过文档聚类自助法加Holm校正检验四个预注册对比，在两类差异较大的语料上验证：200篇维基百科特色条目（951查询）与1,585篇QASPER论文（4,303问题）。

Result: 组织性有益且原因在于内容而非token：带真实标题路径的结构对齐分块优于上下文化固定窗口（+0.022/+0.012 cov-nDCG@10）及安慰剂（+0.010/+0.016）。朴素两阶段分层检索有害（-0.033/-0.015），可追溯至第一阶段章节召回。金标准结构在Wikipedia上优于LLM诱导结构，但在QASPER上无此优势。效应量小（dz 0.06-0.11）但经Holm校正显著且跨语料一致。

Conclusion: 文档结构处理的增益由结构内容本身驱动，而非前置token的嵌入扰动；标题路径的真实语义是有效成分。两阶段分层检索的失败源于章节召回瓶颈，提示需改进第一阶段结构检索。金标准与LLM诱导结构的差异具有语料依赖性，且整体效应量虽小但稳健显著。

Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation systems increasingly rely on document-structure treatments: structure-aligned chunking, LLM-generated chunk contexts, heading-path metadata, and hierarchical two-stage retrieval. Separate studies support each on different corpora, embedders, and metrics, and none control for a shared confound: any text prepended to a chunk perturbs its embedding. We present a mechanism-isolating ablation testing all four treatments under one protocol, matching chunk sizes across conditions and adding a semantically null placebo---heading paths that are structurally valid but shuffled across documents. We score retrieval with a coverage-aware nDCG and test four pre-registered contrasts via document-clustered bootstrap with Holm correction, on two distant corpora: 200 Wikipedia Featured Articles (951 queries) and 1,585 QASPER papers (4,303 questions). Organization helps, and the cause is content, not tokens: structure-aligned chunks with real heading paths beat contextualized fixed windows (+0.022 / +0.012 cov-nDCG@10) and the placebo (+0.010 / +0.016). Naive two-stage hierarchical retrieval hurts (-0.033 / -0.015), traceable to first-stage section recall. Gold structure beats LLM-induced structure on Wikipedia but not on QASPER. Effects are small ($dz$ 0.06-0.11) but Holm-significant and consistent across corpora.

</details>


<div id='cs.LG'></div>

# cs.LG [[Back]](#toc)

### [232] [Two-Level Softmax Sampling Done Right: Correcting Bias from Size Imbalance and Dispersion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10483)
*Walid Bendada,Guillaume Salha-Galvan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文指出两级softmax（2LS）采样存在系统性偏差，源于忽略簇规模不平衡与簇内相似度离散，提出S-2LS与SD-2LS两种校正方法，以极低开销获得更优的softmax近似。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从softmax分布采样是机器学习的基础操作，但其复杂度随物品数量线性增长，难以在大规模场景下精确采样。两级softmax（2LS）作为一种流行的次线性替代方案，先采样簇再采样簇内物品。本文旨在揭示2LS虽具效率优势，却因忽略簇规模不平衡与簇内相似度离散而导致簇权重错配，引入系统性、非期望的采样偏差。

Method: 作者首先分析2LS采样偏差的来源，即簇权重仅依赖簇内相似度的某种聚合而忽略了簇规模不平衡与簇内相似度离散。据此提出两种校正采样方法：Size-Corrected 2LS（S-2LS）仅校正簇规模偏差；Size- and Dispersion-Corrected 2LS（SD-2LS）同时校正簇规模与簇内离散度，二者均提供可证明更优的softmax近似且计算开销可忽略甚至为零。

Result: 在五个大规模数据集上的深入实验验证了所提方法在采样性质上的改进，表明S-2LS与SD-2LS相较标准2LS具有更好的采样准确性与近似质量。

Conclusion: 标准2LS存在由簇规模不平衡与簇内相似度离散引起的系统性采样偏差；S-2LS与SD-2LS能以可忽略至不存在的额外开销予以校正，并提供可证明更优的softmax近似。建议未来工作在需要2LS时一致采用这两种方法以替代标准2LS。

Abstract: Sampling from a softmax distribution is a fundamental operation in machine learning, but its linear complexity in the number of items makes exact sampling impractical at scale. Two-level softmax (2LS) sampling is a popular alternative enabling sublinear-time sampling. Assuming items are partitioned into clusters, 2LS first samples a cluster and then an item within it. In this paper, we show that, despite its advantages, 2LS introduces systematic and undesirable sampling biases, which arise from misweighting clusters by ignoring both cluster size imbalance and intra-cluster similarity dispersion. We propose two sampling methods, Size-Corrected 2LS (S-2LS) and Size- and Dispersion-Corrected 2LS (SD-2LS), which correct these biases and provide provably better softmax approximations with negligible to non-existent computational overhead. In-depth experiments on five large-scale datasets validate the improved sampling properties of our methods. We recommend their consistent use in place of standard 2LS in future work.

</details>


### [233] [HCPN-GCN: Scaling Hierarchical Prototype Networks with Cone Geometry for Continual Graph Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08823)
*Sammuel R. Silva,Vander L. S. Freitas,Gladston Moreira,Eduardo J. S. Luz,Rodrigo Silva*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出HCPN-GCN，通过将HPN的线性特征提取器替换为GCN并引入锥形原型与多样性正则，实现更紧凑且图感知的持续图学习，在六个基准上提升平均准确率并保持近零遗忘。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 持续图学习(CGL)的核心难题是灾难性遗忘。层次原型网络(HPN)虽通过原型记忆机制避免存储历史数据，但其线性特征提取器无法利用图拓扑结构，且点式原型在结构多样图上会导致原型数量低效增长。

Method: 提出HCPN-GCN：用图卷积网络(GCN)替换HPN原有的线性特征提取器，并引入锥形原型(cone-based prototypes)以及多样性正则化目标，从而生成更丰富的图感知表示并紧凑建模嵌入空间。

Result: 在六个持续图学习基准上，HCPN-GCN相较原始HPN及代表性持续学习基线持续提升平均分类准确率，同时保持近零遗忘；分析显示其用约少30倍的原子原型学习到更丰富的类级原型层次，实现更紧凑有效的记忆表示。

Conclusion: 将GCN与锥形原型、多样性正则结合可有效缓解持续图学习中的灾难性遗忘，兼顾表征能力与记忆紧凑性，为CGL提供更高效的记忆机制。

Abstract: Continual Graph Learning (CGL) aims to incrementally learn from graph-structured data while preserving knowledge acquired from previous tasks. A major challenge in this setting is catastrophic forgetting, where learning new tasks degrades performance on previously learned ones. Hierarchical Prototype Networks (HPNs) address this problem through a prototype-based memory mechanism that avoids storing historical data, but their reliance on linear feature extractors limits their ability to exploit graph topology, while point-based prototypes often lead to inefficient prototype growth on structurally diverse graphs. In this work, we propose HCPN-GCN, a graph-aware extension of HPN that replaces the original linear feature extractors with Graph Convolutional Networks (GCNs) and introduces cone-based prototypes with a diversity regularization objective. The proposed design produces richer graph-aware representations while compactly modeling the embedding space, reducing prototype proliferation without sacrificing discriminability. Experimental results on six continual graph learning benchmarks demonstrate that HCPN-GCN consistently improves average classification accuracy over the original HPN and representative continual learning baselines while maintaining near-zero forgetting. Furthermore, our analysis shows that the proposed model learns substantially richer class-level prototype hierarchies using approximately $30\times$ fewer atomic prototypes than the original HPN, providing a more compact and effective memory representation for continual graph learning.

</details>


### [234] [Consistent Distribution Matching for Data-Free Diffusion Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09221)
*Yuxiang Fu,Qi Yan,Zike Wu,Yongxing Zhang,Purang Abolmaesumi,Lele Wang,Renjie Liao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种无模拟、无数据的蒸馏方法（Consistent Distribution Matching），用单一学生网络同时完成样本生成与分数估计，实现扩散/流模型的少步快速生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散与流模型因数值积分计算量大而推理缓慢；现有蒸馏方法依赖精选数据集、昂贵的教师 rollout 或辅助代理网络，训练与扩展复杂。

Method: 统一样本生成与分数估计于同一个学生网络，仅使用一个冻结教师和一个可训练学生、优化单一目标，且无需模拟与数据。

Result: ImageNet 256×256 上，训练 40 个 epoch 内达到 1-NFE FID 2.04、4-NFE FID 1.37，在无数据设定下超越当前最先进蒸馏基线。

Conclusion: 该方法在无数据、无辅助网络的条件下实现了高效且高质量的少步生成，并理论上保证学生流映射前推向教师边缘分布的 Wasserstein 收敛。

Abstract: Flow and diffusion models suffer from slow inference due to computationally expensive numerical integration. Distillation provides a promising way for a student model to learn from a teacher's dynamics, enabling one-step or few-step generation. However, existing methods often depend on curated distillation datasets, costly teacher rollouts, or auxiliary proxy networks, which complicate model training and scaling. In this work, we propose Consistent Distribution Matching, a simulation-free and data-free distillation method for accelerating diffusion and flow models while preserving strong generative capacity. Our key insight is to unify sample generation and score estimation with one student network. Thus, our framework uses only two models, a frozen teacher and a trainable student, and optimizes one objective. We prove that minimizing our objective indicates Wasserstein convergence of the student flow-map pushforwards to the teacher marginals. On ImageNet 256$\times$256, our method attains an FID of 2.04 with a single function evaluation (1-NFE) and a 4-NFE FID of 1.37 within 40 epochs of training, surpassing the state-of-the-art distillation baselines without data. Our code code and model are available at https://consistentdmd.github.io/.

</details>


### [235] [LeCuration: A Tiny World Model as a Data Curation Multi-Tool](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09285)
*Mayank Sengupta,Nirmit Desai,Eric Song,Kunal Sawarkar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出以"物理世界/物理法则"为核心的物理AI数据策展新思路，训练小世界模型LeCuration（LeWM潜编码器+预测器+DiT解码器）作为大型下游模型的数据策展工具，并在CS:GO数据上做定性概念验证，展示异常检测、内容聚类和动作-状态一致性检查三种用途，尚未报告定量指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 物理AI应用多运行于有限或封闭的物理世界（如仓库机器人、视频游戏智能体），其对象行为受有限物理法则支配。为更好地组织、过滤和策展这类数据，需要一种围绕单个数据集独特设定与物理法则展开的方法，而非通用的大一统数据处理流程。

Method: 提出LeCuration——一个面向特定数据集的小型世界模型，作为独立的大型下游模型的数据策展工具。架构上选用LeWorldModel（LeWM）作为潜空间编码器与预测器，并添加扩散Transformer（DiT）解码器，用于自回归游戏过程推演的可视化生成。

Result: 在CS:GO游戏数据上开展定性、概念验证式案例研究：模型嵌入可作为异常检测信号与基于内容的聚类启发式；利用该模型自回归预测游戏状态，可对动作-状态一致性进行定性检查。尚未报告定量的策展指标或下游训练结果。

Conclusion: 该工作验证了以小世界模型进行世界特异数据策展的可行性，属于早期概念验证。定量策展指标与下游训练效果评估被明确列为下一步关键工作。

Abstract: Many applications of physical AI run within finite or closed physical worlds with a limited set of physical laws governing object behavior. Examples include robots working in a warehouse and agents moving around in a video game. In order to better organize, filter, and curate data for physical AI applications, we propose a new approach centered on the unique settings and physical laws of individual datasets. We train LeCuration, a small world model intended to serve as a data curation tool for a separate, larger downstream model. To build this model, we choose LeWorldModel (LeWM)as our latent encoder and predictor, adding a diffusion transformer (DiT) decoder to add visuals to autoregressive gameplay rollout. We find that the embeddings of this model can be used as an anomaly detection signal and as a content-based clustering heuristic, and that auto-regressively predicting the game state with this model allows us to qualitatively check for action-state consistency. This paper presents a qualitative, proof-of-concept case study on CS:GO gameplay data; we do not yet report quantitative curation metrics or downstream training results, which we identify as the key next step.

</details>


### [236] [Kuration SDK: Addressing the Virtual2Real Gap via Data Curation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09305)
*Nirmit Desai,Eric Song,Mayank Sengupta,Tejal Bedmutha,Siri Reddy,Sahiti Dharmavaram,Kunal Sawarkar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文指出动作条件世界模型的现有基准（FVD、LPIPS、JEDi等）无法反映实际可玩性，提出"Virtual2Real gap"概念；主张在训练前通过精编原始游戏数据和诊断属性度量来弥合该差距，并开源了数据精编工具包Kuration SDK。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动作条件世界模型的评测基准正从视觉相似度指标转向动作语义与物理接地指标，但对于领域与任务无关的训练，现有基准提供的信号有限。作者观察到视觉指标（FVD、LPIPS、JEDi）与实际可玩性不对应，即Virtual2Real gap，因此需要更可靠的数据侧信号。

Method: 在CounterStrike游戏数据上训练并评估扩散世界模型，验证定性可玩性与FVD、LPIPS、JEDi等指标不相关；进而提出若干数据精编策略，并开发通用物理AI数据精编工具包Kuration SDK，用于在训练前诊断数据属性。

Result: 实验确认定性可玩性与FVD、LPIPS、JEDi等指标不一致，即存在Virtual2Real gap。Kuration SDK成功定位了一个具体案例的根因：两个在相同地图、动作与状态分布上训练、LPIPS与FVD分数相近的世界模型，实际游玩时表现差异显著。

Conclusion: 在可靠基准缺位的情况下，精编原始游戏数据并度量多种诊断属性，比现有视觉指标提供更稳健的信号。Kuration SDK有望揭示特定数据集中Virtual2Real gap的根因，并加速高样本效率训练数据集的开发。

Abstract: Benchmarks for measuring the quality of action-conditioned world models are still evolving and shifting away from visual similarity-based metrics to action-semantic and physically-grounded metrics. However, for domain and task-agnostic action-conditioned world model training, existing benchmarks provide a limited signal. By training and evaluating diffusion world models on CounterStrike gameplay data, we confirm that qualitative playability does not correspond with metrics such as FVD, LPIPS, and JEDi. We term this the Virtual2Real gap. We posit that, in lieu of reliable benchmarks, curating raw gameplay data and measuring a variety of diagnostic properties provides a more robust signal to bridge the gap, before the training even begins. We present several curation strategies and a general-purpose kit for physical AI data curation called Kuration SDK, which is being open-sourced with this paper. The SDK was instrumental in uncovering the root cause of the virtual2real gap in a specific case: why two world models trained on identical gameplay map, action and state distribution, behaved very differently when played in spite of having very similar LPIPS and FVD scores. Thus, Kuration SDK has the potential to uncover the root causes of Virtual2Real gap in specific datasets and accelerate development of sample-efficient training datasets.

</details>


### [237] [Multimodal LLMs Can Learn to Read Brain Signals: A Vision--Language Model for Unified Multi-Task EEG Decoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09355)
*Parastoo Azizeddin,Omid Sharafi,Maryam M. Shanechi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 BraVista，一种将多通道EEG编码为结构化图像、通过指令条件化的视觉-语言模型实现多任务EEG解码的框架，无需大规模EEG专用预训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: EEG表征跨认知任务、被试和记录条件的泛化仍是难题；基础模型虽提升了EEG解码性能，但如何有效地将神经信号与这些模型对接以实现跨数据集多任务学习尚属开放问题。

Method: 将多通道EEG信号编码为结构化图像，借助指令条件化的视觉-语言模型（VLM）完成多任务学习；对通用领域VLM进行持续后训练，利用其视觉与语言先验适配神经信号，无需单独的EEG专用大规模预训练阶段。

Result: 在睡眠分期、情绪识别、认知负荷分类和异常EEG检测四个数据集上均取得较强性能；分析表明EEG到图像的表示方式对性能至关重要；在受控噪声扰动下性能随噪声增加而渐进下降，说明模型依赖EEG相关信息而非表层视觉模式。

Conclusion: 结构化视觉表示可作为神经信号与通用领域基础模型之间有效且可扩展的接口，用于统一的多任务EEG解码。

Abstract: Learning EEG representations that generalize across cognitive tasks, subjects, and recording conditions remains a key challenge in electroencephalography (EEG) decoding. Recent advances in foundation models have improved EEG decoding performance, yet a fundamental open question remains: how to effectively interface neural signals with these models to enable multi-task learning across datasets. To investigate this question, we introduce BraVista, a visual-language framework that encodes multichannel EEG signals as structured images and enables multi-task learning through instruction-conditioned vision-language models (VLMs). Our approach relies on continued post-training of a general-domain VLM, leveraging its visual and linguistic priors to adapt to neural signals without a separate large-scale EEG-specific pretraining stage. We evaluate BraVista on four datasets spanning sleep staging, emotion recognition, cognitive workload classification, and abnormal EEG detection, showing strong performance across these tasks. Further analyses show that the choice of EEG-to-image representation is critical to performance. Moreover, through controlled perturbations of the EEG signal, we observe a gradual performance degradation under increasing noise, suggesting that the model relies on EEG-relevant information rather than superficial visual patterns. Together, these findings establish structured visual representations as an effective and scalable interface between neural signals and general-domain foundation models for unified multi-task EEG decoding.

</details>


### [238] [Shared Geometry As A Rosetta Stone: Cross-Modal Alignment Without Paired Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09411)
*Dominik Schnaus,Thomas Dagès,Daniel Cremers,Xi Wang,Phillip Isola*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究证明，不同模态独立训练的模型无需配对数据即可实现粗粒度跨模态对齐；提出的 Wasserstein Procrustes 方法与几何初始化可在无配对条件下估计单一正交映射，并在极少配对数据时显著优于现有方法，还能支持无配对文本到图像生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态表示虽支持零样本分类与检索，但传统跨模态对齐通常依赖大量配对数据。受 Platonic Representation Hypothesis 启发，作者追问：不同模态独立训练的模型是否本就收敛到共享表示几何，因此无需配对样本也能完成跨模态对齐。

Method: 提出 Wasserstein Procrustes 方法，结合粗粒度几何初始化，在不使用任何配对样本的情况下对齐两组互不相交的嵌入集合，通过估计单一正交映射实现跨模态对应。方法还自然扩展到极少配对样本场景。

Result: 在跨数据集、跨模态和单模态模型上，无需配对即可一致地对齐独立训练的表示；标准几何对齐指标能准确预测何时可行。在极少配对数据场景下显著优于现有方法，随配对增加仍具竞争力。所得对齐可支持无配对文本到图像生成。

Conclusion: 独立训练的模型往往共享足够相似的几何结构，使得仅需极少甚至无需配对数据即可建立跨模态对应；配对数据并非粗粒度跨模态对齐的必要条件。

Abstract: Multimodal representations enable zero-shot classification and retrieval, but aligning independently trained models usually requires large amounts of paired data. Yet, the Platonic Representation Hypothesis suggests that models trained on different modalities may converge spontaneously toward a shared representation geometry. But then, do we even need paired examples for cross-modal alignment? Remarkably, we show that paired examples are unnecessary for coarse cross-modal alignment. Our simple Wasserstein Procrustes method with a coarse geometric initialization aligns two disjoint embedding sets by estimating a single orthogonal map without seeing any pairs. Across datasets, modalities, and unimodal models, we show that we can consistently align independently trained representations without pairs, and standard geometric alignment metrics accurately predict when this is possible. Nevertheless, we can naturally benefit from paired examples. In the very few-pair regime, our method substantially outperforms existing ones, while staying competitive with pair-based methods with more added examples. Finally, we demonstrate that the resulting alignments can enable text-to-image generation without paired examples. These results show that independently trained models often share enough geometry to establish cross-modal correspondence with little or no paired data.

</details>


### [239] [For Those Who Believe in Faithfulness: Optimizing the Area Under Insertion and Deletion Curves for Ranking Relative Feature Importance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09844)
*Bjørn Leth Møller,Bulat Ibragimov,Christian Igel*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文从插入/删除曲线所度量的忠实性出发推导目标函数及其梯度近似，建立插入曲线与top-k特征选择的联系，提出随机化损失并结合神经解释掩码框架，形成Ra-NEM方法，可获得忠实、鲁棒且高效的归因。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 面向社会相关任务的机器学习应用需要有效的可解释AI方法以理解模型行为。归因方法通过热图刻画输入-输出关系，其质量通常以插入/删除曲线下面积衡量的忠实性来评估，但如何直接优化这种忠实性并高效计算梯度仍是待解决的问题。

Method: 作者从忠实性概念推导出一个目标函数及其梯度近似方法；建立插入曲线与top-k特征选择之间的联系，从而得到衡量归因质量的损失函数；通过对损失进行随机化，实现梯度的高效近似；将该损失函数与神经解释掩码（NEM）框架结合，得到Ra-NEM方法，适用于任意可微模型且不影响模型性能。

Result: 实验表明，Ra-NEM能够稳定且高效地提供准确归因；与其他算法相比，其归因不仅具有更高的忠实性，在其他XAI指标上也表现良好；Ra-NEM推理速度快，适合在线应用。

Conclusion: 该研究将忠实性度量与top-k特征选择相联系，给出可微、可随机近似的归因损失，并在NEM框架下实现Ra-NEM，验证了其在忠实性、鲁棒性、效率及在线适用性方面的优势，代码已开源。

Abstract: The adoption of machine learning for socially relevant tasks requires effective explainable artificial intelligence (XAI) methods to better understand the behavior of machine learning models. Attribution methods are a popular XAI approach in which input-output relationships are characterized by heat maps that reflect the relative importance of input features for a particular prediction. The quality of such maps is often assessed by measuring faithfulness based on the area under insertion and deletion curves, which measures changes in the model output as features are added and removed. In this study, we derive an objective function from this notion of faithfulness and a way to approximate its gradient. We establish the connection between insertion curves and top-$k$ feature selection, which leads to a loss function measuring the quality of attributions. Randomization of the loss allows us to efficiently approximate its gradient. To show the effectiveness of the general approach, we combine the loss function with the neural explanation mask framework. The resulting method, termed Ra-NEM, can be used with any differentiable model without affecting the model's performance. Experiments demonstrate that Ra-NEM provides accurate attributions robustly and efficiently. Compared to other algorithms, the attributions have not only higher faithfulness but also perform well in terms of other XAI metrics. The high inference speed of Ra-NEM makes the method suitable for online applications. The code is available online: https://github.com/baerminator/Ra_Nem

</details>


### [240] [LASER: Latent Space Adjoint Matching for Support-Constrained Entropy-Regularized Offline RL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08989)
*Songyuan Zhang,Oswin So,Eric Yang Yu,Matthew Cleaveland,Peter Crowley-Dolen,Chuchu Fan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: LASER是一种在流匹配潜空间中进行熵正则化离线强化学习的算法，通过潜空间伴随匹配实现，在40个OGBench任务上取得SOTA性能且无需任务特定调参。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离线RL受限于分布外（OOD）动作的风险。近期方法通过流匹配学习行为克隆策略并在其约束潜空间内做RL，但朴素优化潜策略易导致策略坍缩为脆弱模式或利用critic的尖锐伪影。本文发现熵正则化对解决这些问题至关重要。

Method: 提出LASER算法：在潜空间中应用adjoint matching（伴随匹配），实现熵正则化的潜空间RL，同时支持表达力强的流策略，并避免通过时间的反向传播（BPTT）。

Result: 在40个具有不同数据质量的挑战性OGBench任务上进行了全面实验，LASER达到SOTA性能。

Conclusion: LASER在所有任务上使用固定的方法特定超参数，却优于包括经任务和数据特定调参的基线，凸显其稳健的适用性。

Abstract: While offline reinforcement learning (RL) enables policy optimization from static datasets without costly online interaction, it remains bottlenecked by the risk of executing out-of-distribution (OOD) actions. Recent approaches mitigate this by learning a behavior-cloning policy through flow matching and then performing RL within its constrained latent space. However, naively optimizing the latent policy can easily cause the policy to collapse into a brittle mode or exploit sharp artifacts of the learned critic. In this work, we find that entropy regularization is essential in latent-space RL for addressing these challenges. We introduce LASER, a novel offline RL algorithm that applies latent-space adjoint matching to achieve entropy-regularized latent-space RL with expressive flow policies while avoiding backpropagation through time. Through comprehensive experiments on 40 challenging OGBench tasks with varying dataset qualities, we show that LASER achieves state-of-the-art performance. Notably, LASER uses fixed method-specific hyperparameters across all tasks and outperforms the evaluated baselines, including those with task- and dataset-specific tuning, which highlights the robust applicability of LASER. Project website: https://mit-realm.github.io/laser/.

</details>


### [241] [An Informational Curse of Horizon in Goal-Conditioned Policy Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09247)
*John L. Zhou,Yuxuan Dong,Jonathan C. Kao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文识别出目标条件策略学习中的"信息视野诅咒"：增大目标重标定视野会显著降低策略的泛化性与性能，其机制是动作与事后重标定目标之间的条件互信息随视野增加而下降；通过将短视野策略的输入雅可比蒸馏到长视野策略可显著提升性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 以往认为目标到达策略的学习困难源于"视野诅咒"，表现为时序差分备份中的偏差累积与优势估计的噪声。作者提出除此之外还存在一种更本质的"信息视野诅咒"：用于目标重标定的视野越长，策略的泛化能力与性能反而越差，这一问题此前未被明确阐述。

Method: 采用一系列带有oracle规划器的受控实验，将训练时采样的目标视野与测试时要求达到的目标视野解耦；对比目标条件行为克隆（BC）与强化学习（RL）目标下的策略表现；用动作与事后重标定目标之间的条件互信息解释现象；通过策略输入雅可比衡量策略对目标信息与状态信息的敏感性；将短视野策略的输入雅可比蒸馏进长视野策略。

Result: 即使仅在邻近子目标序列上评估，目标条件BC策略也会随训练视野增长出现严重的性能退化，而RL目标可缓解该问题；长短视野策略的条件互信息随视野增加而下降；BC与RL策略在长视野目标训练后，敏感性均由目标信息转向状态信息（雅可比可测）；将短视野策略的输入雅可比蒸馏给长视野策略带来显著性能提升，在组合式操作任务中尤为突出。

Conclusion: 目标重标定视野是从离线数据学习通用策略时的重要考量因素；长视野训练会导致策略对目标信息的利用减少，通过蒸馏短视野策略的输入雅可比可有效缓解该问题。

Abstract: The difficulty of learning goal-reaching policies is often attributed to a "curse of horizon" that manifests as bias accumulation in temporal-difference backups and noisy advantage estimates. In this work, we identify an additional informational curse of horizon in goal-conditioned policy learning, where increasing the goal relabeling horizon can significantly reduce policy generalization and performance. Through a series of controlled experiments with oracle planners, we decouple the goal horizons sampled during training from those that the policy is asked to reach at test time. Even when evaluated only on a sequence of nearby subgoals, goal-conditioned behavioral cloning (BC) policies suffer from severe, training horizon-dependent performance degradation that is mitigated by reinforcement learning (RL) objectives. We explain this phenomenon as a horizon-dependent decrease in the conditional mutual information between actions and hindsight-relabeled goals, and find empirically that both BC and RL policies trained on longer-horizon goals exhibit a shift in sensitivity from goal to state information, as measured by the policy's input Jacobians. Motivated by this observation, we find that distilling the input Jacobians of short-horizon policies into long-horizon policies yields significant performance gains, especially in combinatorial manipulation tasks. Taken together, our results highlight goal relabeling horizon as an important consideration when learning generalist policies from offline data.

</details>


### [242] [DSReg: Provably Recovering Individual World Latents without Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09457)
*Yujia Zheng,David Klindt,Randall Balestriero,Bernhard Schölkopf*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出DSReg（依赖稀疏正则化），在无重建、无解码器、无标签条件下，仅凭"结构多样性"假设即可从线性可辨识的JEPA表示中恢复出各个世界潜变量（至符号置换）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 非线性ICA、字典学习、因果表示学习等方法通过重建、辅助监督或非高斯性等分布不对称来锚定潜变量，从而恢复单个潜变量；而无锚定的方法（如JEPA）只能把潜状态辨识到线性变换，各潜变量仍然混叠。论文旨在消除这一差距。

Method: 提出结构多样性（Structural Diversity）条件：不同潜变量在观测上留下不同的依赖"足迹"。在此条件下，基于LeJEPA已有的线性可辨识性，证明DSReg（Dependency-Sparsity Regularization，依赖稀疏正则化）可将表示恢复至符号置换。DSReg作为后处理模块，可作用于任意线性可辨识表示，复用已训练检查点，训练开销与联合训练相当。

Result: 证明结构多样性严格弱于以往可辨识潜变量模型的各类结构条件；构建了首个可恢复全部世界潜变量的完全可辨识JEPA。在合成数据、世界模型探针、学习到的视觉编码器及外部渲染器上，DSReg在保持稠密预测性能的同时，随规模提升个体潜变量恢复与下游任务表现。

Conclusion: 无需重建、解码器或标签，仅依赖观测依赖足迹的结构多样性即可实现单个世界潜变量的可证明恢复，DSReg为JEPA类表示提供了通用、低成本的后处理可辨识化方案。

Abstract: Methods that recover individual latent variables of the world, from nonlinear ICA to dictionary learning and causal representation learning, anchor the latents to observations through reconstruction, auxiliary supervision, or distributional asymmetries such as non-Gaussianity. Methods without these anchors, including joint-embedding predictive architectures (JEPAs), identify the latent state only up to a linear transformation, so individual latents remain mixed. We close this gap: individual world latents can be provably recovered with no reconstruction, no decoder, and no labels. The key condition is Structural Diversity: different latents leave distinct dependency footprints on observations, just as no two snowflakes are alike. Building on the linear identifiability that LeJEPA provides, we prove that under Structural Diversity, DSReg (Dependency-Sparsity Regularization) recovers individual world latents up to signed permutation, without reconstruction or a decoder. It applies post hoc to any linearly identified representation, reusing trained checkpoints at no loss over joint training, and establishes the first fully identifiable JEPA that recovers every world latent. Moreover, as a condition on dependency footprints, Structural Diversity is strictly weaker than all structural conditions of prior identifiable latent variable models. Across synthetic regimes, world model probes, learned visual encoders, and external renderers, DSReg preserves dense prediction while improving individual-latent recovery and downstream use with scales.

</details>


### [243] [Beyond Policy Support: Interaction Constrained Offline Reinforcement Learning for Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09763)
*Mahmoud Selim,Cristina Cipriani,Karl Henrik Johansson*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出交互分布偏移（IDS）概念及ICDP框架，通过对比密度比估计分离出交互支持分量，从而在离线强化学习中显式约束智能体与周边智能体之间的交互级分布偏移，无需联合密度建模或反应式仿真器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离线强化学习面临分布偏移问题，策略优化易偏向离线数据支持不足的动作，导致价值估计不可靠。现有方法主要在策略自身动作空间内控制偏移，但在自动驾驶等交互环境中不够充分：自车候选轨迹在边缘行为分布下可能支持良好，但与日志交互中周边智能体行为联合支持却很差。作者将这种交互支持的退化称为交互分布偏移（IDS）。

Method: 从自车与周边智能体未来的联合数据分布出发，证明联合支持退化可精确分解为自车支持分量和残余的交互支持分量；后者通过对比密度比估计（contrastive density-ratio estimation）恢复，从而隔离交互兼容性，避免显式联合密度建模、周边智能体预测，以及策略优化期间在反应式仿真器或学习世界模型中的rollout。

Result: 在nuPlan、InterPlan及真实卡车实验的闭环评估中，ICDP抑制了高价值但交互支持不足的轨迹选择，并在交互关键型驾驶场景中提升了性能。

Conclusion: ICDP通过显式控制交互级分布偏移，为交互环境下离线强化学习提供了一种无需联合建模或反应式仿真的有效方案，在自动驾驶等安全关键领域具有良好的应用前景。

Abstract: Offline reinforcement learning enables reward-driven policy improvement from fixed datasets without requiring online exploration, making it particularly attractive in safety-critical domains. A central challenge, however, is distribution shift: policy optimization may favor actions that are weakly supported by the offline data, rendering value estimates unreliable. Existing approaches primarily control this shift in the policy's own action space. In interactive environments such as autonomous driving, this can be insufficient: a candidate ego trajectory may remain well supported under the marginal behavior distribution while being poorly supported jointly with the surrounding-agent behavior observed in the logged interaction. We refer to this degradation in interaction support as \emph{interaction distribution shift} (IDS), and introduce \emph{Interaction-Constrained Drive Policy} (ICDP), an offline reinforcement learning framework that explicitly controls interaction-level distribution shift. Starting from the joint data distribution over ego and surrounding-agent futures, we show that joint-support degradation decomposes exactly into an ego-support component and a residual interaction-support component. We recover the latter through contrastive density-ratio estimation, isolating interaction compatibility without explicit joint-density modeling, surrounding-agent prediction, or rollouts in reactive simulators or learned world models during policy optimization. Closed-loop evaluations on nuPlan, Interplan and real-world truck experiments show that ICDP suppresses high-value yet interaction-unsupported trajectory selections and improves performance in interaction-critical driving scenarios. Project webpage: https://mahmoud-selim.github.io/ICDP/

</details>


### [244] [Multi-Agent Coordination via Support-Preserving Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10087)
*Sangmin Lee,Youngju Na,Chanmi Lee,Sung-eui Yoon*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文识别了离线MARL中基于流的教师模型存在的“教师端失败模式”，并提出MoSDOT方法，通过半离散最优传输将噪声样本分配到单一模式，消除模式间伪影，提升端点质量与路由一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离线MARL常采用生成式策略建模多模态联合行为，通过CTDE将集中式教师蒸馏为去中心化单步执行器。作者发现教师训练阶段存在失败模式：标准流式教师将噪声与回放目标独立配对，导致邻近噪声样本被路由到冲突的协调模式，教师在有效模式之间生成样本，而蒸馏损失将局部执行器回归到教师输出的条件均值，这一误差不被吸收而被传播给学生，因此需要从教师端消除该伪影。

Method: 提出Mode-Support Semi-Discrete Optimal Transport (MoSDOT)：将多模态回放数据总结为具有预设容量的有限模式支撑集，并利用条件半离散最优传输在教师训练前将每个噪声样本分配给单一模式；此外研究了一种共享随机性变体，在执行阶段使用共享噪声分量，以暴露严格乘积式执行内在的残余差距。

Result: 在受控诊断实验和离线MARL基准上，MoSDOT改善了端点质量与路由一致性，尤其在呈现多模态联合行为的数据集上表现突出。

Conclusion: 通过半离散最优传输在教师训练前对噪声样本进行模式分配，可消除教师端模式间伪影，避免误差向学生传播，从而提升离线MARL生成式策略的多模态建模质量。

Abstract: Offline MARL increasingly relies on generative policies to model multimodal joint behavior, typically by distilling a centralized teacher into decentralized one-step actors under the CTDE. We identify a failure mode at the teacher training stage: standard flow-based teachers pair noise with replay targets independently, so nearby noise samples can be routed toward conflicting coordination modes. The teacher then produces samples between valid modes, and because the distillation loss regresses each local actor onto the conditional mean of the teacher's output given local input, this error is not absorbed but propagated to the student. To remove this teacher-side artifact, we propose Mode-Support Semi-Discrete Optimal Transport (MoSDOT), which summarizes multimodal replay into a finite mode support with prescribed capacities and uses conditional semi-discrete optimal transport to assign each noise sample to a single mode before teacher training. We additionally study a shared-randomness variant that uses a shared noise component at execution to expose the residual gap intrinsic to strict-product execution. On controlled diagnostics and offline MARL benchmarks, MoSDOT improves endpoint quality and routing consistency, particularly on datasets exhibiting multimodal joint behavior.

</details>


### [245] [Temporally Interpretable Differentiable Decision Trees](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10367)
*Eisuke Hirota,Aarav Sane,Rohan Paleja*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"时间可解释性"这一新维度，通过动作分块（action chunking）使可微分决策树（DDTs）具备时序抽象能力，并结合信息论树重构算法实现参数高效训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可微分决策树虽能提供离散可视化的可解释策略，但其单时间步决策特性与人类多时间步规划存在固有错配，现有实现难以适配顺序决策任务。

Method: 引入时间作为可解释性的新维度（时序可解释性），提出两种融合动作分块策略梯度算法；同时开发基于信息论的树重构算法，在训练过程中动态修改树结构以保持参数高效。

Result: 在四个仿真环境中，从蒸馏的动作分块策略热启动动作分块DDT效果最佳：在四个域中的三个达到与神经网络策略相当的性能，同时参数最多减少80%。

Conclusion: 动作分块与时序可解释性可有效弥合DDT单步决策与多步规划的鸿沟，热启动结合树重构能实现性能与参数效率的平衡。

Abstract: Interpretability offers a solution to safe autonomy by providing transparency into an agent's underlying decision-making model. Within sequential-decision making tasks, differentiable decision trees (DDTs) are one approach to such interpretability, maintaining automatic-differentiable policies while providing humans with a discrete tree-based visualization. Nonetheless, current implementations of DDTs are not well-suited for sequential-decision making domains, as there exists an inherent mismatch between a tree's single-timestep behavior and a human's multi-timestep planning. Our work thus introduces time as a new dimension of interpretability, coined as temporal interpretability, and demonstrates how temporal abstractions via action chunking improve it. We achieve this by first introducing two novel policy gradient algorithms that incorporate action chunking. Additionally, to maintain parameter-efficient trees, we develop an information-theoretic tree restructuring algorithm that modifies the tree during training. Across four simulation environments, we find that warm-starting action chunked DDTs from a distilled action chunked policy is the most effective way to obtain temporally interpretable trees: they match neural network policies in three of the four domains while using up to 80$\%$ fewer parameters. Our code is available at https://github.com/ei5uke/temp-interp.

</details>


### [246] [Q-Learning with Scalar Adjoint Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10437)
*Yonghoon Dong,Minsung Yoon,Jaehyuk Kim,Jungwoo Park,Changyeon Kim,Jinwoo Shin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 SQAM：基于预训练流策略雅可比矩阵对角集中现象的标量伴随匹配 Q 学习，消除逐步的向量-雅可比积，并在策略动作处加入值惩罚，在 OGBench 最难四个域上成功率超出最强基线 18–35 个百分点，并在真实双臂机器人视觉-语言-动作策略上优于监督微调。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 流策略能刻画丰富多样的动作分布，用离策略强化学习对其进行微调以超越示范数据日益受到关注；但流策略的多步生成特性使基于价值函数的微调困难。伴随匹配虽能将最终动作的价值信息回传到各流步，却需要在每一步对策略求向量-雅可比积，开销随流步数与策略规模增长，限制了实用性。

Method: 观察到预训练流策略的批平均速度雅可比集中于对角线，据此推导出闭式标量伴随：仅用流时间对最终动作的价值梯度进行缩放，从而免去逐步的向量-雅可比积。进一步发现标量伴随下控制策略生成动作处的评论家价值尤为关键，因此提出 Q-learning with Scalar Adjoint Matching（SQAM），将标量伴随与这些动作上的值惩罚相结合。

Result: SQAM 的收益集中在 OGBench 四个最难域，成功率达每域最强基线的 18–35 个百分点以上；为验证其可扩展至大规模预训练策略，在真实双臂机器人上微调视觉-语言-动作策略，三个任务均优于监督微调。

Conclusion: SQAM 通过标量伴随近似显著降低了流策略离策略微调的计算成本，并以值惩罚稳定评论家，在仿真困难任务与真实机器人大规模策略上均取得一致提升，为流策略的高效强化学习微调提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Flow policies capture rich and diverse action distributions, and fine-tuning them with off-policy RL to improve beyond the demonstrations has drawn growing interest. However, fine-tuning a flow policy against a learned value function is not trivial, because the policy generates its action over many flow steps. Adjoint matching offers a principled way to update the flow model itself by propagating value information from the final action back to each flow step, but it requires a vector--Jacobian product through the policy at every step, a cost that grows with the number of flow steps and the policy size. We observe that the batch-averaged velocity Jacobian of pretrained flow policies concentrates on its diagonal. Motivated by this finding, we derive a closed-form scalar adjoint that scales the value gradient at the final action by the flow time, eliminating the per-step vector--Jacobian products. We further find that controlling the critic's value at policy-generated actions is particularly important under the scalar adjoint. Based on these findings, we propose Q-learning with Scalar Adjoint Matching (SQAM), which combines the scalar adjoint with a value penalty at those actions. SQAM's gains concentrate on the four hardest OGBench domains, where its success rate exceeds that of the strongest baseline in each domain by 18 to 35 percentage points. To test whether SQAM extends to large pretrained policies, we also fine-tune a vision-language-action policy on a real bimanual robot. SQAM improves over supervised fine-tuning on all three tasks.

</details>


### [247] [Just for FUNS: LLM-Guided Spatio-Temporal Graph Node Generation for Forecasting Unobserved Node States](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08818)
*Shuhao Li,Weidong Yang,Changan Liu,Wei Zhuo,Yingbo Zhou,Fan Zhang,Siqiang Luo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出GenST框架，将"未观测节点状态预测"(FUNS)重新定义为时空图上的条件生成任务，借助预训练LLM从节点描述中提取语义特征，并结合时空VAE与生成式Transformer(GenT)从噪声重建未观测节点的未来状态。在6个交通和2个非交通数据集上，GenST在零样本预测任务中显著优于现有基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时空预测对物流、城市规划和智能交通系统至关重要，但受部署成本与维护资源限制，传感器网络往往缺乏完整的空间覆盖，导致"未观测节点状态预测"(FUNS)成为关键却艰巨的挑战。传统模型依赖历史观测，面对无历史记录的节点时表现不佳，因此需要新范式来弥补缺失的时空信号。

Method: 作者将问题重新定义为时空图上的条件生成任务，并提出GenST框架：引入LLM作为语义桥梁，利用微调的预训练LLM从节点描述（如功能区、路网结构）中提取丰富的语义特征以补偿缺失的时空信号；设计两阶段生成架构——先用时空VAE将时空动态压缩到隐空间，再由生成式Transformer(GenT)在语义、地理坐标和邻域上下文等多模态条件引导下，从噪声重建未观测节点的未来状态。

Result: 在6个交通数据集和2个非交通数据集上的实验表明，GenST在零样本预测任务中显著优于现有基线，验证了语义引导生成在缓解时空数据稀疏性方面的实际潜力。

Conclusion: GenST通过LLM语义桥梁与两阶段生成架构，有效解决了无历史记录节点的预测难题，证明了语义引导生成对缓解时空数据稀疏问题具有实用价值与应用前景。

Abstract: Spatio-temporal forecasting is a cornerstone of logistics, urban planning, and intelligent transportation systems. However, constrained by deployment costs and maintenance resources, sensor networks often lack comprehensive spatial coverage, rendering Forecast Unobserved Node States (FUNS) a critical yet formidable challenge. Conventional models rely on historical observations and typically falter when encountering nodes without prior records. To address this, we redefine the problem as a conditional generation task on spatio-temporal graphs and propose GenST, a framework that introduces Large Language Models (LLMs) as a semantic bridge, leveraging a pre-trained LLM fine-tuned to extract rich semantic features from node descriptions, such as functional zones and road network structures, to compensate for missing spatio-temporal signals. Specifically, we design a two-stage generative architecture: a Spatio-Temporal VAE first compresses spatio-temporal dynamics into a latent space, followed by a Generative Transformer (GenT) that reconstructs the future states of unobserved nodes from noise, guided by multi-modal conditions including semantics, geographic coordinates, and neighborhood contexts. Experiments on six traffic and two non-traffic datasets show GenST significantly outperforms existing baselines in zero-shot prediction tasks, demonstrating the practical potential of semantic-guided generation for mitigating spatio-temporal data sparsity.

</details>


### [248] [Work While They Sleep: Exploiting Evaluation Latency for Fully Bayesian Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08969)
*Gustavo Sutter,Alejandro Comas-Leon,David Holzmüller,Hao Wang,Luis Ricardez-Sandoval,Pascal Poupart,Agustinus Kristiadi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ELF-BO利用目标函数评估的延迟时间提前计算下一次建议，实现全贝叶斯优化而几乎不增加决策时间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 黑盒优化中目标函数评估耗时长，导致评估主导执行时间且需样本高效算法。标准贝叶斯优化（BO）用点估计拟合代理模型超参数，而全贝叶斯方法通过模型平均考虑超参数不确定性，能在低数据条件下提供更优的不确定性估计，但计算代价过高，实践中很少使用。作者希望使全贝叶斯优化变得实用。

Method: 提出ELF-BO算法。核心思想是利用目标函数评估的延迟时间，在评估进行的同时从超参数后验中采样，从而"抢先"计算下一次建议；待目标值观测到后，仅需对样本进行重新加权（reweighting）即可。

Result: 在合成函数和真实应用中，ELF-BO的性能与全贝叶斯方法相当，而决策延迟仅与标准BO相当或更优。

Conclusion: ELF-BO使全贝叶斯优化在真实使用场景中变得实用。

Abstract: Black-box optimization problems are ubiquitous across science and engineering, often dealing with expensive objective functions. This objective latency has two consequences during optimization: (i) the objective evaluation dominates execution time, and (ii) sample-efficient algorithms are crucial to accelerate development and avoid wasting resources. Bayesian optimization (BO) methods are the \textit{de facto} choice of planners for suggesting the next point to try. Standard BO fits the surrogate model's hyperparameters with a point estimate. Alternatively, a fully Bayesian approach uses model averaging to account for uncertainty over the hyperparameters, leading to better uncertainty estimates---useful in the low-data regime that is pervasive in BO. However, it is often prohibitively expensive and thus rarely used. In this work, we propose ELF-BO, an algorithm that uses the objective evaluation latency to headstart the computation of the next suggestion, allowing for fully Bayesian optimization without incurring substantial decision-time costs. This is done by sampling from the hyperparameter posterior \emph{while} the objective is being evaluated, only requiring reweighting of the samples once the objective value is observed. Across synthetic functions and real-world applications, we show that ELF-BO matches the performance of fully Bayesian methods while only incurring decision latency on par with or better than standard BO. Thus, ELF-BO makes fully Bayesian optimization practical in real-world use cases.

</details>


### [249] [The Best Optimizer Depends on Batch Size](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08975)
*Xingyu Dang,Kaiyue Wen,Sadhika Malladi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文挑战了"最优优化器在某一批大小下的优势可跨批大小保持"这一假设，指出Muon缺乏一致的缩放规则，且语言模型预训练的最佳优化器会随批大小变化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有大量自适应优化器旨在高效估计并利用小批量梯度统计量来塑造参数更新，但通常仅在单一批大小下进行基准测试。超参数缩放规则被认为能在批大小和梯度噪声变化时保持性能，从而暗示某一批大小下的最优优化器应在其他批大小下依然最优。作者试图检验这一假设。

Method: 作者通过研究Muon是否存在可跨训练设置一致适用的原则性缩放规则，以及对语言模型预训练进行大量超参数调优后比较不同批大小下最优优化器的表现，来开展分析。

Result: 研究发现：(1) 对Muon而言，没有任何原则性缩放规则能在不同训练设置中一致奏效；(2) 即便经过广泛的超参数调优，语言模型预训练的最优优化器仍会随批大小改变。

Conclusion: 开发与评估优化器时不应预设单一批大小下的结论可外推；需要重新审视优化器评估范式，考虑批大小依赖性。

Abstract: A plethora of new adaptive optimizers are designed to efficiently estimate and use minibatch gradient statistics to shape parameter updates, but they are typically benchmarked at a single batch size. Hyperparameter scaling rules promise to preserve performance as batch size and gradient noise change, suggesting that the best optimizer at one batch size should remain the best at another. We challenge this approach to developing and evaluating optimizers by showing: (1) no principled scaling rule for Muon works consistently across training settings, and (2) the best optimizer for language model pretraining changes with batch size even after extensive hyperparameter tuning.

</details>


### [250] [FedRSPO+: A Heterogeneity-aware Algorithm for Decision-focused Federated Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09091)
*Konstantinos Ziliaskopoulos,Alexander Vinel,Jiaqi Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出FedRSPO+，一个面向决策聚焦学习（DFL）的异质性感知联邦框架，基于平滑决策映射的RSPO+代理，并给出决策误差、遗憾上界及跨客户端异质性界，在背包、最短路与能源定价任务上验证了稳定协同决策学习的效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有DFL方法大多假设数据集中式；联邦学习场景下，标准联邦方法以预测精度为目标而忽视决策质量，且未处理下游目标与可行域的异质性。多面体问题中微小扰动会导致最优决策不连续变化，从而破坏客户端更新与聚合的稳定性，这使联邦DFL中的异质性尤为困难。

Method: 提出FedRSPO+，构建在RSPO+之上——一种通过投影平滑决策映射的正则化"预测-再优化"代理。理论上证明RSPO+对正则化决策的决策误差与遗憾提供上界，并在精确正则化与一致的LP解选择条件下对原LP决策也成立；推导依赖目标异质性与可行集异质性的跨客户端异质性界，该界在同质性时消失且无需强凸性。FedRSPO+采用退火式模块化训练流程，兼容标准联邦个性化与聚合方法。

Result: 在合成背包、最短路任务以及真实世界能源定价任务上，与仅预测的联邦学习和DFL基线在不同异质性程度与通信预算下进行比较。结果表明平滑是稳定协同决策学习的有效要素，并为联邦DFL提供了异质性感知的基础。

Conclusion: 平滑机制有助于稳定的联邦决策聚焦学习，FedRSPO+为异质性下的联邦DFL提供了理论保证与实用框架。

Abstract: Decision-focused learning (DFL) trains predictive models for downstream optimization, but existing methods largely assume centralized data. In cross-silo settings, federated learning offers a natural alternative, yet standard federated methods optimize prediction over decision quality and do not address heterogeneity in downstream objectives or feasible sets. This heterogeneity is especially challenging for DFL because small perturbations in polyhedral problems can cause discontinuous changes in optimal decisions, destabilizing client updates and aggregation. We propose FedRSPO+, a heterogeneity-aware framework for decision-focused federated learning, built on RSPO+, a regularized predict-then-optimize surrogate that smooths the decision map through projection. We show that RSPO+ upper bounds decision error and regret for the regularized decision and, under exact regularization and consistent LP solution selection, for the original LP decision. We further derive cross-client heterogeneity bounds that depend on both objective and feasible-set heterogeneity, vanish at homogeneity, and require no strong convexity. FedRSPO+ uses an annealed, modular training procedure compatible with standard federated personalization and aggregation methods. Experiments on synthetic knapsack, shortest-path, and real-world energy pricing tasks compare against prediction-only federated learning and DFL baselines under varying heterogeneity and communication budgets. Results suggest that smoothing is a useful ingredient for stable collaborative decision learning and provide a heterogeneity-aware foundation for federated DFL.

</details>


### [251] [Exact Dynamics and Finite-Sample Trajectory Recovery of Linear Recursive Feature Machines](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09196)
*Andrew Cheng,Bobak T. Kiani,Yue M. Lu,Adityanarayanan Radhakrishnan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究线性递归特征机（RFM）在带噪多输出回归中的动力学与统计性质，证明其可等价为带岭正则的迭代重加权最小二乘，且学到的特征矩阵以高概率以 O(√(d/n)) 逼近无限数据理想值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AGOP 与神经网络特征学习之间的联系，使线性 RFM 成为分析表示如何随训练演化的简洁模型。然而此前关于线性 RFM 与迭代重加权最小二乘的等价性仅限于插值设定，缺少对带噪、多输出、岭正则场景的理论刻画，特别是特征矩阵在有限样本下逼近理想特征的程度尚不清楚。

Method: 在等方向子高斯输入、由维度 d 的低秩教师矩阵生成目标的带噪多输出回归设定下，将线性 RFM 与迭代重加权最小二乘（IRLS）的已知等价性从插值情形推广到带岭正则的带噪多输出回归，并分析特征矩阵随迭代的演化，推导其与无限数据理想特征之间误差的高概率界。

Result: 证明了线性 RFM 学到的特征矩阵在每一轮迭代都接近其无限数据理想对应物；对 n 个样本，特征矩阵误差以高概率按 O(√(d/n)) 衰减。在真实文本数据与单细胞基因表达数据上的实验展示了该简单线性模型学到的特征。

Conclusion: 线性 RFM 在带噪多输出回归中具有可分析的训练动力学，其特征学习过程可由 IRLS 精确刻画，并在有限样本下以 O(√(d/n)) 速率逼近理想特征，为理解表示演化提供了简洁而有理论保证的框架，并在真实数据上得到验证。

Abstract: Recursive feature machines (RFMs) learn representations of data by alternating between fitting a predictor to a dataset and updating features of that predictor using the average gradient outer product (AGOP). Connections between AGOPs and feature learning in neural networks motivate linear RFMs as a simple setting for analyzing how representations evolve during training. Here, we study the dynamics and statistics of linear RFM in noisy multi-output regression with isotropic sub-Gaussian input data and targets generated by a low-rank teacher matrix of dimension $d$. We extend the known connection between linear RFM and iteratively reweighted least squares from the interpolating setting to ridge-regularized multi-output regression with noise. We show that the learned feature matrix remains close to its infinite-data ideal counterpart at every iteration. Namely, for $n$ samples, we show the error in the feature matrix decays as $O(\sqrt{d/n})$ with high probability. Experiments on real-world text and single-cell gene-expression data illustrate the features learned by this simple linear model.

</details>


### [252] [An Accuracy--Information Tradeoff for Loss-Difference Conditional Mutual Information](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09206)
*Hazar Yueksel*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文证明了在适当条件下，精度（低超额风险）会强制损失差条件互信息（ld-CMI）达到 Ω(n) 比特量级，即使泛化间隙仅为 O(n^{-1/2})，因此范围缩放的 ld-CMI 界在这些分布上无法消失。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准泛化界中的信息度量（如模型级互信息）在精度压力下是否必然增大，以及数据处理的上下界能否传递到损失层面，尚不清楚。作者希望研究精度是否能强制 ld-CMI 这一更细粒度的信息量，并检验相关界的紧性。

Method: 通过界定损失差的前三阶矩，证明精度强制 ld-CMI。研究对象为：在缩放符号立方体上的乘积分布（维度至少与 n 线性相关），线性预测器加光滑凸损失（零点斜率非零，如 logistic 损失）并配以曲率和增长均为幂 r≥2 的正则项。分析满足最优样本量 n≍ε^{-2+2/r} 且期望超额风险≤ε 的任意 proper learner 的最坏情况 ld-CMI；另在损失差上加标准差为 τ 的高斯噪声，并考察无正则项时 n≍ε^{-2} 的情形。

Result: 在上述设定下，每个 proper learner 的最坏情况 ld-CMI 为 Θ(n) 比特；加入标准差 τ 的高斯噪声后为 Θ(n/(1+(τ/ε)^2)) 比特。无正则项时在 n≍ε^{-2} 下同样成立。因此，范围缩放的 ld-CMI 界在这些分布上不能趋于零，尽管每个 proper learner 的泛化间隙仅为 O(n^{-1/2})。此外，模型级信息不能决定带噪损失差信息；增长、斜率与维度条件均为必要，维度条件可放宽至对数因子。

Conclusion: 精度会强制 ld-CMI 达到线性于样本量的量级，这一下界与泛化间隙的 O(n^{-1/2}) 上界形成对比，说明范围缩放的 ld-CMI 泛化界本质上是非消失的；同时明确了模型级信息与损失差信息之间的不可推导性，并界定了各项假设条件的必要性。

Abstract: Loss-difference conditional mutual information (ld-CMI) uses the smallest of the standard observations in the supersample hierarchy of generalization bounds: it measures what a learner's loss differences reveal about which candidate of each pair it was trained on. Accuracy is known to force information into the model; data processing does not carry such lower bounds to losses. We show, by bounding three moments of the loss differences, that accuracy also forces ld-CMI. For linear predictors with a smooth convex loss of nonzero slope at zero, such as the logistic loss, plus a regularizer whose curvature and growth are both of power $r\ge2$, on product distributions over a scaled sign cube in dimension at least linear in $n$, every proper learner with expected excess risk at most $\varepsilon$ on these distributions at the optimal sample size $n\asymp\varepsilon^{-2+2/r}$ has worst-case ld-CMI of order $n$ bits, and $Θ(n/(1+(τ/\varepsilon)^2))$ bits under Gaussian noise of standard deviation $τ$ on the loss differences. The same holds without a regularizer, at $n\asymp\varepsilon^{-2}$. Consequently, range-scaled ld-CMI bounds cannot vanish on these distributions, although every proper learner's generalization gap is $O(n^{-1/2})$. We also show that model-level information does not determine noisy loss-difference information, and that the growth, slope and dimension conditions are needed, the last up to a logarithm.

</details>


### [253] [Efficient Best-of-N policy evaluation for inference-time alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09250)
*Jonas Schweisthal,Yuxin Wang,Athiya Deviyani,Stefan Feuerriegel,Dennis Frauen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种仅依赖样本（无需响应似然）的Best-of-N策略评估与选择框架，利用顺序统计量结构将密度比转化为可由样本估计的分数-排名概率，并构建双重稳健估计量BoN-DR用于推理与预算选择。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Best-of-N是常见的推理时对齐方法，从日志数据评估其策略在"仅可访问样本"条件下很困难，因为标准off-policy估计量需要依赖不可得的响应似然来计算密度比；同时较大采样预算会放大分数函数误差，导致奖励过度优化。

Method: 1) 证明BoN的顺序统计量结构可将所需密度比表示为score-rank概率，仅从样本即可估计；2) 提出BoN策略价值的双重稳健估计量BoN-DR，跨候选预算有效复用共享辅助样本池；3) 在奖励估计量误设定下建立有效的渐近推断并证明BoN-DR的效率；4) 导出两种选择规则：最大化估计策略价值，以及最大化相对参考策略改进的下置信界（考虑估计不确定性，提供no-harm保证）。

Result: 在合成实验及GSM8K上（多种参考模型与奖励模型）验证：该框架能准确估计BoN策略价值，并选出有效的采样预算。

Conclusion: 该工作给出了无须响应似然的BoN策略评估与选择方案，兼具统计有效性、效率与安全（no-harm）保证，在理论与实验中均表现良好。

Abstract: Best-of-N (BoN) is a common inference-time alignment method that selects the highest-scoring response among N samples from a reference model. Evaluating BoN policies from logged data is challenging under sample-only access because standard off-policy estimators require density ratios that depend on unavailable response likelihoods. In this paper, we propose a sample-only framework for evaluating and selecting BoN policies without access to these likelihoods. We show that the order-statistic structure of BoN allows the required density ratios to be expressed through score-rank probabilities that are estimable from samples alone. We then develop a doubly robust estimator of the BoN policy value (BoN-DR) that efficiently reuses a shared auxiliary sample pool across candidate budgets. We establish valid asymptotic inference even under reward estimator misspecification and prove the efficiency of our BoN-DR estimator. Since larger budgets can amplify errors in the score function and lead to reward overoptimization, we derive two selection rules: (i) maximizing the estimated policy value and (ii) maximizing a lower confidence bound on the improvement over the reference policy, which accounts for estimation uncertainty and provides a no-harm guarantee. Across synthetic experiments and GSM8K with multiple reference and reward models, our framework accurately estimates BoN policy values and selects effective sampling budgets.

</details>


### [254] [The Symbol of the Surrogate: Measuring Numerical Provenance in Neural PDE Solvers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09255)
*Ridham Patel*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出傅里叶符号诊断方法，证明神经PDE代理模型会模仿训练格式的离散误差而非逼近精确演化，对标准基准的有效性提出质疑。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数值求解器产生的训练数据同时包含物理演化与求解器特有的离散化误差；由于代理模型通常也在同一求解器的留出轨迹上评测，标准基准无法区分模型是忠实于精确演化还是单纯模仿了数值格式。

Method: 设计了一种经验傅里叶符号诊断：用单个傅里叶模态探测训练后代理模型的线性化单步算子，并将其与精确演化参考、训练格式参考进行对比。为排除架构自身的谱偏置，用具有正交耗散与色散特征的两种格式训练相同网络并比较其学习到的算子；实验涵盖线性平流、非局部傅里叶神经算子（FNO）以及非线性Burgers动力学的算子层面。

Result: 在线性平流中，学习到的代理模型复现了训练格式的振幅与相位误差，双格式差异达到解析预测的完全模仿上限的99.8%以上；非局部FNO上表现相同，Burgers动力学在算子层面亦如此。

Conclusion: 与求解器生成测试数据的一致性本身并不能证明模型忠实于精确演化；傅里叶符号测量为数值来源提供了一种直接诊断手段，揭示了神经PDE代理模型中普遍存在的格式模仿现象。
