Abstract: Neural PDE surrogates are trained on numerical solver outputs that contain both physical evolution and solver-specific discretization errors. Because surrogates are also evaluated against held-out trajectories from the same solver, standard benchmarks cannot distinguish fidelity to the exact evolution from imitation of the numerical scheme. We introduce an empirical Fourier-symbol diagnostic that probes a trained surrogate's linearized one-step operator with individual Fourier modes and compares it with both exact-evolution and training-scheme references. To address architectural spectral bias, we train identical networks on schemes with orthogonal dissipative and dispersive signatures and compare their learned operators. In linear advection, the learned surrogates reproduce the training schemes' amplitude and phase errors, with the twin-scheme difference reaching more than 99.8\% of the analytically predicted full-imitation ceiling. The same behavior occurs for a non-local Fourier neural operator and at the operator level for nonlinear Burgers dynamics. These results show that agreement with solver-generated test data does not by itself establish fidelity to the exact evolution. Fourier-symbol measurements provide a direct diagnostic of numerical provenance.

</details>


### [255] [Benign Overfitting under Heterogeneous Input Fusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09340)
*Houzhen Liu,Xiaobo Xia*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文研究异质高斯设计下最小范数线性插值的良性过拟合问题，比较两个统计相关输入块的融合效应，揭示融合的良性性由联合信号与谱几何决定，而非单块(边缘)良性性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 良性过拟合已在单一高维输入下被广泛研究，但在异质输入融合下其行为尚不清楚。作者希望在保持总体任务不变的前提下，考察两个统计相关输入块的融合如何影响线性插值的良性过拟合。

Method: 在异质高斯设计下分析最小范数线性插值，固定总体任务，比较两个统计相关的输入块及其融合。对回归给出全谱协方差证书，并证明所有与两个边缘一致的正半定联合协方差均保持该性质；对一稀疏高斯分类，用存活的预测信号与干扰污染之间的平衡刻画常规区良性性，并构造所有边缘-联合良性/非良性组合。

Result: 回归中，存在全谱协方差证书，其渐近状态与截断阈值无关，且被所有与两边缘一致的正半定联合协方差保持；该保护是紧的，且不适用于所有良性回归问题，在认证区之外两个良性边缘可产生有害融合。分类中，良性性由存活预测信号与干扰污染的平衡决定，融合可使两者朝相反方向变化，且在该模型类中每种边缘到联合的良性/非良性模式均可达。同一融合输入对回归与分类的影响可定性不同。

Conclusion: 异质融合下的良性过拟合由输入交互产生的联合信号与谱几何决定，而非仅由边缘良性性决定。这为理解多源/多块输入融合下的泛化提供新视角。

Abstract: Benign overfitting is extensively studied when learning from a single high-dimensional input, but its behavior under heterogeneous input fusion remains largely unexplored. We study this question for minimum-norm linear interpolation under a heterogeneous Gaussian design, comparing two statistically dependent input blocks with their fusion while holding the underlying population task fixed. For regression, we identify a full-spectrum covariance certificate whose asymptotic status is independent of the cutoff threshold and prove that it is preserved by every positive-semidefinite joint covariance consistent with the two marginals. This protection is sharp, yet it does not extend to all benign regression problems: outside the certified regime, two benign marginals can have a harmful fusion. For one-sparse Gaussian classification, benignity in the regular regime is characterized by the balance between surviving predictive signal and nuisance contamination. Fusion can move these two quantities in opposite directions, and within this model class every marginal-to-joint benign/non-benign pattern is attainable. We further show that the same fused input can have qualitatively different effects on regression and classification. These results establish that benign overfitting under heterogeneous fusion is determined by the joint signal and spectral geometry created by input interaction, rather than by marginal benignity alone.

</details>


### [256] [Global Exponential Convergence of Two-Layer Linear Network Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09356)
*Stephen Y Zhang,Gabriel Peyré*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文证明了宽两层线性网络在光滑 Polyak-Lojasiewicz 预测损失下，以显式速率实现全局指数（线性）收敛；梯度流在因子上精确闭合为神经元律协方差的有限维 Bures 流，并给出谱下界、稳定性和动量情形的收敛条件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究宽两层线性网络训练的全局收敛速率，特别是要给出显式收敛率、允许奇异初始化，并将分析推广到深线性 ResNet 与 heavy-ball 动量情形。

Method: 利用因子梯度流的闭合性，将训练动力学约化为神经元律协方差的有限维 Bures 流，预测器动态由隐协方差块预条件；通过平均场守恒律在初始协方差满足谱支撑间隙条件时给出隐预条件块的一致谱下界；并分析有限宽度采样、因子梯度下降以及 heavy-ball 动量下的提升相协方差动力学。

Result: 对初始协方差 Σ0 = σ^2 Id，损失以至少 4σ^2 κ 的线性速率收敛到全局最小值（κ 为 PL 常数）；建立了该速率在有限宽度采样下的稳定性，以及因子梯度下降在显式步长区间内的全局收敛；动量情形下，在线性收敛的能量与阻尼条件下给出可行动阻尼窗口，两尺度白初始化在大位置尺度下该区间非空；数值实验验证协方差几何并比较预测与实际速率。

Conclusion: 该工作为宽线性网络的全局线性收敛提供了显式速率与几何解释，可扩展到深线性 ResNet，并刻画了动量训练的稳定阻尼范围。

Abstract: We prove global exponential (linear) convergence with an explicit rate in the rich scaling for wide two-layer linear networks trained with smooth Polyak-Lojasiewicz predictor losses. Gradient flow in the factors closes exactly in terms of a finite-dimensional Bures flow of the neuron law covariance, in which the predictor dynamics are preconditioned by hidden covariance blocks. Mean-field conservation laws provide uniform spectral lower bounds on the hidden preconditioning blocks when the initial covariance satisfies a spectral support gap condition. This condition encompasses positive definiteness while still allowing for singular initializations. For an initial covariance $Σ_0 = σ^2 \mathrm{Id}$, the loss converges to the global minimum with linear rate at least $4σ^2κ$, where $κ$ is the PL constant. We establish stability of this rate under finite-width sampling, as well as global convergence of factor gradient descent for an explicit stepsize interval depending on smoothness, the initial loss, and conserved spectral margins. Our argument extends layerwise to deep linear ResNets, subject to a residual-path bound. In the case of heavy-ball momentum, training dynamics close instead over positions and velocities in terms of a lifted phase covariance. Linear convergence holds under an explicit condition on the energy and damping, specifying a window of admissible dampings. For two-scale white initializations, this interval is nonempty for sufficiently large position scales, with a fixed initial loss gap and velocity covariance. Numerical experiments illustrate the covariance geometry and compare the predicted and observed rates.

</details>


### [257] [Gauss-Newton Accuracy and Indefinite Hessians: Uniform Coexistence in Low-Cost Sets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09675)
*Kihun Rhee,Hanjoon Byun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究岭正则化非线性最小二乘中Gauss-Newton曲率的精度，证明低代价集内存在两种曲率机制共存，全局极小点Hessian相对误差小于(1+√2)/8，但同一集合内存在负曲率点且相对误差至少15/8，并给出沿预测水平集的逐点误差证书与尖锐界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Gauss-Newton方法广泛用于非线性最小二乘，但其曲率近似（忽略Hessian修正项）的精度缺乏刻画。本文旨在量化岭正则化下Gauss-Newton曲率与真实Hessian的偏差，特别是在低代价集和输出对齐、曲率方向变化等几何条件下的表现，从而解释优化中遇到的负曲率与收敛异常现象。

Method: 在局部正则性与精确拟合截面上水平集曲率幅值的持续性假设下，证明两类曲率机制的一致共存。构造基于当前预测水平集的逐点证书，分别控制Hessian修正的法向、混合与切向分量；并结合输出对齐、曲率方向与持续性进行解析示例分析。另给出低代价集内Jacobian行满秩及在秩亏参考附近精确插值的结构结果。

Result: 全局极小点存在，且每个全局极小点的相对Hessian误差低于(1+√2)/8；同一低代价集内存在一个点具有不定Hessian，相对误差至少15/8。对于固定邻域内的任意独立中心与标签扰动以及不超过上界的任意正岭权重，一个正岭上界即可保证结论，且邻域不随岭权重趋于零而收缩。在预测映射与岭权变化时，对所声明的逐点类给出尖锐相对误差界。

Conclusion: Gauss-Newton曲率在岭正则化非线性最小二乘中并非全局一致准确：低代价集内可同时存在Gauss-Newton型正定与真实不定曲率机制。逐点水平集证书可有效界定Hessian修正的各分量并给出尖锐误差界，为理解优化中Gauss-Newton近似失效及负曲率出现提供理论依据。

Abstract: We study the accuracy of Gauss-Newton curvature in ridge-regularized nonlinear least squares. Under local regularity and persistence of level-set curvature magnitude along an exact-fit section, we prove uniform coexistence of two curvature regimes. Global minimizers exist, and every global minimizer has relative Hessian error below $(1+\sqrt2)/8$, while the same low-cost set contains a point with an indefinite Hessian and relative error at least $15/8$. One positive ridge cap works for all independent center and label perturbations in fixed neighborhoods and every positive ridge weight up to the cap. These neighborhoods do not shrink as the ridge weight tends to zero. A pointwise certificate based on the current prediction level set controls the normal, mixed, and tangent parts of the Hessian correction. We prove a sharp relative-error bound over the stated pointwise class when the prediction map and ridge vary. Analytic examples describe the roles of output alignment, curvature orientation, and persistence. A separate structural result gives full Jacobian row rank throughout low-cost sets and exact interpolation near a rank-deficient reference.

</details>


### [258] [EntroPrefill: Renyi-Guided Context Pruning with Conditional Stability Guarantees for Retrieval-Augmented Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09757)
*Inbasekaran S*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文将 EntroPrefill 形式化为一种基于 Renyi 引导的提议机制，并辅以对被丢弃注意力权重的显式约束；从理论上推导了删除上限、观察者保证、扰动界与盈亏平衡条件，但本文为纯理论工作，未报告实测加速或任务精度保持结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 中期预填充剪枝可减少深层 Transformer 处理的序列长度，但仅凭注意力集中并不能证明被丢弃上下文可舍弃，因此需要为剪枝过程建立形式化约束与理论边界。

Method: 提出 EntroPrefill：Renyi 引导的提议机制结合对被丢弃注意力质量的显式约束；采用 sink 隔离、正则化的头池化以兼容分组查询注意力；推导 mixture-to-head 删除包络、可行 token 删除的可计算上界、剪枝层自适应选择下仍有效的有限样本观察者保证、带显式 Lipschitz 常数的条件式 Transformer 扰动界及首 token 决策边际推论；用反例说明浅层观察无法推出无条件的未来输出保证；系统分析区分 query-head 并集、物理页分配与 KV 传输负载。

Result: 给出如下理论结果：mixture-to-head 删除包络、可行 token 删除上界、自适应剪枝层下的有限样本观察者保证、条件式 Transformer 扰动界与首 token 决策边际推论、浅层观察不能保证未来输出的反例，以及剪枝的算术盈亏平衡条件；未报告实测加速或任务精度保持。

Conclusion: 本文为理论性研究，界定过程、假设与形式化局限；实验留待后续验证假设、近似紧致性与端到端资源权衡。

Abstract: Mid-prefill pruning can reduce the sequence processed by deeper transformer layers, but attention concentration alone does not certify that discarded context is dispensable. We formulate EntroPrefill as a Renyi-guided proposal mechanism coupled to explicit constraints on discarded attention mass. Sink-isolated, regularized head pooling respects grouped-query attention while exposing a quantitative trade-off between specialization and worst-head coverage. We derive a mixture-to-head deletion envelope, a computable upper bound on feasible token removal, and a finite-sample observer guarantee that remains valid when the pruning layer is selected adaptively. We then establish a conditional transformer perturbation bound with explicit sufficient Lipschitz constants and a first-token decision-margin corollary. A counterexample shows why shallow observations alone cannot imply an unconditional future-output guarantee. The systems analysis distinguishes query-head unions, physical page allocation, and KV-transfer payload, and gives an arithmetic break-even condition for pruning. This manuscript is theoretical in scope: it defines the procedure, its assumptions, and its formal limits, but does not report measured acceleration or task-accuracy preservation. Experiments are reserved for subsequent validation of the assumptions, approximation tightness, and end-to-end resource trade-offs.

</details>


### [259] [Leaner Transformers Can Easily Learn to Cluster](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09760)
*Charlotte Park,Kenneth L. Clarkson,Lior Horesh,Takuya Ito,Parikshit Ram*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文在Transformer可执行Lloyd k-means算法的基础上，提出了嵌入规模更小的等价Transformer（嵌入维数为 d+⌈log₂k⌉），并研究了其学习聚类算法的收敛性、分布内泛化及泛化失败情况。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有工作证明Transformer能以嵌入维数 d+k 精确执行Lloyd算法，但注意力投影矩阵规模为 (d+k)²，计算开销较大；同时，将Transformer作为学习算法（通过随机梯度训练）的收敛性与泛化性质尚缺乏理论刻画与实证验证。

Method: 1）设计表达能力等价但更紧凑的Transformer结构，将嵌入维数从 d+k 降至 d+⌈log₂k⌉；2）在给定聚类任务分布下，用随机梯度训练这些Transformer学习聚类算法；3）从理论上刻画并实证验证影响收敛性和分布内泛化的因素；4）探测所学Transformer算法的通用聚类能力，分析其成功与失败的场景。

Result: 提出了嵌入维数更小的等价Transformer，显著降低了对注意力投影矩阵规模的要求；理论刻画并实验验证了影响随机梯度学习算法收敛与分布内泛化的关键因素；揭示了所学Transformer在通用聚类任务中的表现边界，明确了其成功与失败的条件。

Conclusion: 该工作以更紧凑的Transformer实现了与原有方法等价的Lloyd算法执行能力，并系统性地从理论与实验两方面分析了基于随机梯度学习聚类算法的收敛、泛化与通用聚类能力，为理解Transformer的上下文学习算法执行机制提供了更深入的视角。

Abstract: Transformers have in-context learning capabilities, where some known learning algorithms can be executed in the forward pass through the model. Recent work shows that transformers can exactly perform Lloyd's algorithm for $k$-means clustering with $n$ points in $d$ dimensions with an embedding size $d_{\textsf{emb}} = d+k$ (thus, requiring attention projection matrices of size $(d+k)^2$). In this work, we build upon this result in the following ways: First, we present an equally expressive but smaller transformer that executes Lloyd's algorithm with embedding size $d_{\textsf{emb}} = (d + \lceil \log_2 k \rceil)$. Next, we train these transformers to learn the clustering algorithms given a distribution of clustering tasks, and theoretically characterize and empirically validate the factors affecting the convergence and in-distribution generalization of learning algorithms based on stochastic gradients. Finally, we probe the general clustering abilities of these learned algorithms (in the form of transformers), and try to understand situations where they succeed and fail.

</details>


### [260] [Fluctuations of Nonlinear Observables in Mean Field Neural Network Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09768)
*Arnaud Descours,Geoffrey Lacour*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究浅层神经网络在随机梯度下降训练下，平均场涨落如何传播到参数分布的非线性有限维可观测量，利用泛函Delta方法（普通Fréchet可微、无需Lions导数）建立了可观测量的中心极限定理与显式协方差公式，并给出可观测量能否由选定观测恢复的精确非线性局部因子分解判据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 平均场极限虽刻画了宽网络训练中参数经验分布的演化，且已有泛函中心极限定理描述其渐近涨落，但实际关心的量往往是参数分布的非线性泛函（可观测量），而非分布本身；因此需要理解平均场涨落如何传播到这些有限维非线性量，并判断所选观测是否包含足以识别目标量的信息。

Method: 在构造极限涨落过程的加权Sobolev空间中工作，采用普通Fréchet可微意义下的泛函Delta方法，避免对测度变量使用Lions导数；对可观测量的微分在适当表示下推导协方差公式；并在常数秩假设下，通过比较观测泛函微分与目标量微分的核，研究目标量能否局部因子化通过观测泛函。

Result: 建立了可观测量的中心极限定理，并在微分具有合适表示时得到继承自底层平均场涨落理论的显式协方差公式；证明在常数秩假设下，目标量在一个邻域内可局部因子化通过观测泛函，当且仅当观测微分的核包含于目标量微分的核中，从而给出环境Sobolev空间中直接的微分条件与精确非线性局部因子分解的等价性。

Conclusion: 该工作为量化有限宽度下具有统计或物理意义的可观测量的不确定性提供了框架，同时为判断所选观测是否含有识别目标量所需信息提供了判据。

Abstract: Mean field limits describe the training dynamics of wide neural networks through the evolution of the empirical distribution of their parameters. Although functional central limit theorems characterize the asymptotic fluctuations of this distribution, quantities of practical interest are typically nonlinear observables of the parameter distribution rather than the distribution itself. In this work, we show how these mean field fluctuations propagate to finite dimensional nonlinear observables for shallow neural networks trained by stochastic gradient descent. Working in the weighted Sobolev space in which the limiting fluctuation process is constructed, we apply a functional Delta method under ordinary Fr{é}chet differentiability, without requiring Lions derivatives with respect to the measure variable. We obtain a central limit theorem for the observables and, under a suitable representation of their differentials, an explicit covariance formula inherited from the underlying mean field fluctuation theory. We also study whether prescribed quantities of interest can be recovered from the selected observations. Under a constant rank assumption, we prove that a quantity of interest factors locally through the observation functional if and only if, throughout a neighborhood, the kernel of the differential of the observation is contained in that of the quantity of interest. Thus, a differential condition expressed directly in the ambient Sobolev space yields an exact nonlinear local factorization. These results provide a framework both for quantifying finite-width uncertainty on observable, statistically or physically meaningful quantities and for assessing whether the chosen observations contain the information required to identify them.

</details>


### [261] [AdaPS-LiNGAM: Adaptive Predecessor Selection for Linear Non-Gaussian Acyclic Models under Small-Sample Settings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09782)
*Shun Yanashima,Kentaro Kanamori,Hirofumi Suzuki*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文揭示了DirectLiNGAM在小样本高维下的结构性退化问题，并提出AdaPS-LiNGAM方法进行改进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 因果发现中样本量相对于变量数偏少时尤为困难，LiNGAM框架也面临此挑战。DirectLiNGAM通过依次识别外生变量并移除其线性效应来估计因果顺序，但作者关注其在小样本场景下的固有局限。

Method: 作者首先理论分析DirectLiNGAM的结构性局限：当变量数超过样本量时，重复残差化在确定完整因果顺序前必然退化。进一步证明每个残差可仅由已排在因果顺序前面的、由图结构决定的变量子集（称为活跃边界）重构。基于此提出AdaPS-LiNGAM，利用自适应选择的稀疏前驱变量子集直接从原始观测重构残差，并将同样的子集选择原则应用于边缘估计的最终剪枝步骤。

Result: 在合成数据上的实验表明，AdaPS-LiNGAM能在样本受限情形下准确恢复因果结构，且随样本量减少性能退化更为平缓。

Conclusion: 该工作从理论上刻画了DirectLiNGAM的退化机制，并借助活跃边界与自适应前驱选择有效缓解了小样本高维下的因果发现问题。

Abstract: Causal discovery becomes particularly challenging when the available sample size is small relative to the number of variables. This challenge also arises in the linear non-Gaussian acyclic model (LiNGAM), an identifiable framework for causal discovery from observational data. DirectLiNGAM estimates a causal order, which arranges variables so that causes precede their effects, by sequentially identifying an exogenous variable and removing its linear effect from the remaining variables. We establish a structural limitation of this procedure: when the number of variables exceeds the sample size, repeated residualization necessarily becomes degenerate before the full causal order can be determined. Our analysis further reveals that each residual can be reconstructed using only a graph-determined subset of variables already placed earlier in the causal order, termed the active boundary. This result motivates AdaPS-LiNGAM (Adaptive Predecessor Selection LiNGAM), which reconstructs each residual directly from the original observations using an adaptively chosen sparse subset of those earlier variables. The same subset-selection principle is also applied to the final pruning step for edge estimation. Experiments on synthetic data demonstrate that AdaPS-LiNGAM provides accurate causal-structure recovery in sample-limited settings and degrades more gradually as the sample size decreases.

</details>


### [262] [Identifiability of a dissipative knowledge-dynamics model: exact recovery under designed excitation, degeneration on observational data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09889)
*Arman Kostanian,Armen Beklaryan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文将人类学习建模为非线性耗散常微分方程系统，证明了逆问题的结构可辨识性定理，并揭示观测数据中"强恢复"实为模型平稳结构导致的退化而非真实可辨识。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类学习是耗散动力学过程：掌握随练习累积、随遗忘衰减、并在相互依赖的概念间传播。作者希望明确模型参数（概念迁移矩阵、遗忘率、饱和练习响应增益）在何种条件下能从数据中真正被恢复，以界定可辨识与不可辨识的边界。

Method: 构建非线性耗散ODE系统，参数具有机制意义（概念迁移矩阵编码先修耦合、逐概念遗忘率、饱和练习响应增益）。在显式激励条件下证明逆问题的结构可辨识性定理，给出双概念情形的构造性闭式恢复，并证明单调性、鲁棒性与L-稳定性。推导耗散子系统的半隐式L-稳定格式与批处理求解器。实证采用双侧设计：合成数据恢复 + 大规模观测基准，并设置四项独立对照（破坏时间顺序、经典贝叶斯基线、移除真实时间戳等）。

Result: 批处理求解器与逐轨迹公式数值等价（预测位精确、梯度达10^-10），速度快两个数量级，可支持10^5学习者的队列估计。在定理激励条件下，合成恢复精确：参数达机器精度，先修结构F1=1.0。在大规模观测基准上则不成立：表面强恢复（遗忘率与主题难度Spearman ρ=0.83）被四项对照推翻——破坏时间顺序后仍存在、被经典贝叶斯基线匹敌、移除真实时间戳无影响。

Conclusion: 表面上的强恢复源于模型的平稳结构，正是定理所预测的、在缺乏设计激励时的退化现象。结果划定了可辨识与不可辨识区域之间的清晰边界，并为可解释性主张提供了验证协议：必须依赖设计激励而非仅凭观测拟合优度。

Abstract: Human learning is a dissipative dynamical process: mastery accumulates through practice, decays through forgetting, and propagates across interdependent concepts. We model it as a nonlinear dissipative system of ordinary differential equations whose parameters are mechanistically meaningful (a concept-transfer matrix encoding prerequisite coupling, per-concept forgetting rates, and a saturating practice-response gain), and we study when those parameters can actually be recovered from data. We prove a structural identifiability theorem for the associated inverse problem under explicit excitation conditions, with constructive closed-form recovery for the two-concept case, together with monotonicity, robustness and L-stability results. We derive a semi-implicit L-stable scheme for the dissipative subsystem and a batched solver numerically equivalent to the per-trajectory formulation (bit-exact predictions, gradients to $10^{-10}$) yet two orders of magnitude faster, making estimation feasible on cohorts of $10^5$ learners. The empirical study is two-sided. Under the theorem's excitation conditions, synthetic recovery is exact: parameters to machine precision, prerequisite structure at $F_1 = 1.0$. On large observational benchmarks it is not. An apparently strong recovery, with forgetting rates correlating with topic difficulty at Spearman $ρ= 0.83$, is refuted by four independent controls: it survives destroying the temporal order of the data, is matched by a classical Bayesian baseline, and is unaffected by removing real timestamps. We trace this to the stationary structure of the model and show that it is the degeneration the theorem predicts in the absence of designed excitation. The result delineates a sharp boundary between identifiable and unidentifiable regimes and yields a validation protocol for interpretability claims.

</details>


### [263] [Eigenvalues of the Hessian in Deep Learning: The Origin of Symmetry and Its Breaking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09919)
*Yossi Arjevani*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出一个统一框架解释深度模型Hessian谱的"体+离群点"结构：将原始非对称配置视为对某个高度对称参考配置的偏离，对称参考处的Hessian具丰富不变性，导致高维核与大重数特征值；打破对称后即产生观测到的簇谱层级。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 训练后深度网络的Hessian谱反复呈现稳定模式：大量特征值聚集于零附近形成"体"，少数孤立"离群点"分离在外。这一现象虽被广泛观测，但缺乏对其成因的统一理论解释，尤其缺乏从对称性角度刻画谱层级来源的机制。

Method: 作者将原始设置重述为对某个"隐藏的、高度对称参考配置"的偏离。通过对结构、数据分布或参数度量施加修改，暴露出该邻近参考配置，其Hessian具有超出权重对称性的丰富不变性；利用这些不变性可精确刻画谱，导出高维核与大重数特征值。再回到原始配置即破坏Hessian对称性，从而产生簇与离群点的层级结构。框架具一般性，并在三层ReLU网络上做详细分析，同时应用于卷积、图与Transformer模型以及NTK。

Result: 在三层ReLU网络中给出详细谱分析；在卷积、图、Transformer模型及NTK上验证该机制；并表明同一机制在逐层Hessian和Gauss-Newton矩阵中也产生类似的谱结构。

Conclusion: 深度模型Hessian的簇状谱可由"偏离对称参考"这一统一机制解释，对称性为谱提供精确描述，对称破缺生成体的层级与离群点，该结论对多种架构及相关矩阵（逐层Hessian、Gauss-Newton、NTK）普遍成立。

Abstract: Hessian spectra at trained models in deep learning exhibit a persistent pattern: eigenvalues organize into distinct clusters, including a large bulk near zero and a few isolated outliers. This paper shows that a natural account of these spectral phenomena emerges when the original setting is understood as a departure from a nearby, otherwise hidden, highly symmetric reference.
  Modifications, including changes to the architecture, data distribution, or parameter metric, expose a nearby reference configuration whose Hessian exhibits rich invariances-ones not accounted for by weight symmetries. There, symmetry enables a precise description of the spectra, forcing high-dimensional kernels and eigenvalues of large multiplicity. Returning to the original configuration breaks the Hessian symmetry and thereby produces the observed hierarchy of clusters and outliers.
  The framework is developed in some generality, with a detailed analysis of three-layer ReLU networks and applications to convolutional, graph, and transformer models, as well as to the NTK. The same mechanism is further shown to yield analogous spectral structures in layerwise Hessians and the Gauss-Newton matrix.

</details>


### [264] [Expected Sample Complexity in Multi-Armed Bandits](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09929)
*Nadav Sukenik,Nadav Merlis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究随机多臂老虎机中的样本复杂度，提出"期望样本复杂度"指标与"期望近似正确(ACE)"框架，证明ACE保证蕴含几乎必然收敛，并给出将ACE保证转化为显式期望遗憾界的方法。针对ε已知与未知两种情形，分别设计explore-then-ε-greedy算法并分析Thompson采样，建立近乎匹配的下界，证明两类情形存在性能分离。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 样本复杂度（次优决策次数）是序贯决策的常用度量，但既有框架多基于高概率保证，缺乏对期望意义下样本复杂度的系统性刻画。作者希望引入期望样本复杂度这一性能度量，并在新框架下统一分析其性质、算法可达性与最优性，同时揭示确定性算法的局限及ε已知与否带来的本质差异。

Method: 提出ACE（approximately correct in expectation）框架；证明ACE保证可推出对最优期望奖励的几乎必然收敛，并给出ACE到显式期望遗憾界的转换；论证确定性算法无法获得良好ACE界；在ε已知情形设计explore-then-ε-greedy算法，在ε未知情形分析Thompson采样的期望样本复杂度；对两种情形分别建立近乎匹配的下界。

Result: ACE保证蕴含几乎必然收敛于最优期望奖励，并可转化为显式的期望遗憾上界；确定性算法不能取得有利的ACE界；explore-then-ε-greedy与Thompson采样分别在ε已知和未知情形下具有紧致（在ε意义下）的期望样本复杂度，且下界与上界近乎匹配，证明两种情形间存在性能分离。

Conclusion: 期望样本复杂度与ACE框架为老虎机样本复杂度提供了新的分析视角，统一了收敛性与遗憾界的结果，并明确了随机化算法的必要性及ε已知性对算法性能的根本影响。

Abstract: Sample complexity is a widely used metric in sequential decision-making problems, defined as the number of suboptimal decisions during the interaction between the agent and an environment. We study the sample complexity of stochastic multi-armed bandit problems and introduce the expected sample complexity performance measure, analyzing it in a novel framework called approximately correct in expectation (ACE). We show that ACE guarantees imply almost sure convergence to the optimal expected reward, in contrast to high-probability guarantees found in other frameworks, and also show how to convert ACE guarantees into explicit expected regret bounds. We further show that, in contrast to existing measures, deterministic algorithms cannot obtain favorable ACE bounds, and analyze stochastic algorithms in two settings: when the allowed suboptimality level $ε$ is known to the algorithm and when it is unknown. In the former, we devise an explore-then-$ε$-greedy algorithm, and in the latter, we analyze the expected sample complexity of Thompson sampling. Finally, we establish nearly matching lower bounds for both settings, showing that the algorithms are tight in $ε$ and proving a performance separation between the two regimes.

</details>


### [265] [m-Set Adversarial Bandits with Winner Feedback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10128)
*Nicolò Cesa-Bianchi,Matteo Papini*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究 m-set 对抗性赌博机，在不同效用（赢家奖励或奖励之和）与反馈模型（赢家索引、赢家奖励、奖励之和及其组合）下给出遗憾的上界与下界，通过对比组合赌博机和 MNL 赌博机的标准界，揭示设定中的细微变化如何对学习率产生显著影响。核心技术贡献是信息论遗憾下界，合成数据实验验证了理论分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 既有组合赌博机与 MNL 赌博机已有标准遗憾界，但 m-set 设定中效用定义与反馈模型的组合方式不同，这可能改变问题的可学习性；作者希望厘清这些细微设定差异对学习率的影响程度。

Method: 针对 m-set 对抗性赌博机，按效用（赢家奖励、奖励之和）与反馈（赢家索引、赢家奖励、奖励之和及组合）划分设定，分别推导遗憾上界，并构造信息论下界；同时与组合赌博机、MNL 赌博机的标准界进行对比，最后用合成数据实验验证理论。

Result: 给出了各设定下遗憾的上界与下界；对比表明设定中的细微变化会导致学习率出现显著差异。主要技术成果为信息论遗憾下界，合成数据实验与理论分析一致。

Conclusion: m-set 对抗性赌博机的学习率对效用与反馈模型的细节高度敏感，信息论下界是刻画这种敏感性的关键工具。

Abstract: We show upper and lower bounds on the regret of $m$-set adversarial bandits for different utilities (winner reward or sum of rewards) and feedback models (winner index, winner reward, sum of rewards, and their combinations). By comparing to standard bounds for combinatorial and MNL bandits, our results reveal how subtle changes in the setting can have a dramatic impact on the learning rates. Our main technical contributions are the information-theoretic lower bounds on the regret. Experiments on synthetic data confirm our theoretical analyses.

</details>


### [266] [Pre-training of Bayesian Optimization Algorithm through Bayesian Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10186)
*Satoshi Katayama,Shoyo Hunt,Shintaro Masuda,Masayuki Karasuyama*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种利用高斯过程样本路径优化贝叶斯优化算法自身参数的框架，以累积遗憾为性能指标，通过外层BO求解参数选择这一黑箱优化问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 贝叶斯优化（BO）算法通常包含需预先设定的参数，其性能对这些参数选择高度敏感；缺乏一种在BO开始前就能基于已有信息自动选择合适参数配置的方法。

Method: 以BO启动时可得信息推断的高斯过程（GP）为基准，从中抽取样本路径；在这些样本路径上运行待调参的BO算法，得到给定参数配置下期望累积遗憾的经验估计；将该估计的优化视为一个黑箱优化问题，并采用另一层BO（称为outer BO）来求解，从而选出期望累积遗憾较低的参数配置。

Result: 实验表明，该框架能在一系列候选参数配置中有效选出性能表现良好的参数配置。

Conclusion: 通过GP样本路径模拟与outer BO嵌套优化，可在BO开始前基于现有信息自适应地确定其参数，从而提升BO算法的实际表现。

Abstract: Bayesian optimization (BO) is widely used as a standard approach for expensive black-box optimization. However, BO algorithms often involve parameters that must be specified in advance, and their performance can strongly depend on these choices. We propose a framework for optimizing such parameters using sample paths drawn from a Gaussian process (GP) inferred from the information available at the start of BO. We use cumulative regret as the performance metric for a BO algorithm. By running the BO algorithm on the generated sample paths, we obtain an empirical estimate of its expected cumulative regret for a given parameter configuration. Optimizing this estimate allows us to identify parameter configurations that, given the currently available information, are expected to achieve low cumulative regret. Since this parameter optimization is itself a black-box optimization problem, we employ another BO procedure to solve it, which we refer to as outer BO. Through experiments, we demonstrate that the proposed framework can effectively select parameter configurations that achieve strong performance among a range of candidate configurations.

</details>


### [267] [Finite-Sample Approximation of Hessian-Guided Perturbed Wasserstein Gradient Flows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10218)
*Ryotaro Kawata,Atsushi Nitanda,Taiji Suzuki*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究PWGF用有限粒子逼近在时间尺度增长时的精度，给出粒子与目标值跟踪界，并在方差+余弦模型与正则化矩阵分解模型中验证曲率条件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Wasserstein梯度流把梯度下降推广到概率测度，其Hessian引导的扰动变体（PWGF）通过高斯扰动逃离非凸问题的鞍点。但用有限多相互作用粒子逼近该流时，误差会随时间累积，现有工作缺乏对增长时间尺度下逼近精度的刻画，尤其是负曲率放大误差与后续正曲率阻尼误差的相互作用尚未被系统分析。

Method: 保留沿种群驱动参考路径累积的曲率：负曲率放大逼近误差，正曲率随后阻尼其影响。在正则性假设与给定共同扰动日程下，对满足累积曲率显式条件的参考路径，证明高概率事件上的粒子跟踪界与目标值跟踪界。针对状态依赖的高斯跳变，构造"种群优先"耦合（population-first coupling），保持参考粒子的条件独立性，并将跳变误差归约为协方差比较。在方差+余弦模型中验证条件；在正则化矩阵分解模型中建立局部吸引、横向下降与正二阶变分。

Result: 在正则性假设和共同扰动日程下，获得高概率的粒子与目标值跟踪界；误差由累积曲率控制——负曲率放大、正曲率阻尼。在方差+余弦模型中验证所提条件，曲率恢复给出增长时间尺度的跟踪保证。在正则化矩阵分解模型的两个区域中证明局部吸引、横向下降和正二阶变分，支撑正-负-正曲率模式。

Conclusion: 有限粒子逼近PWGF的精度可由沿参考路径的累积曲率刻画，暂时的不稳定性（负曲率）与增长时间尺度上的精确跟踪可以兼容；种群优先耦合有效处理状态依赖跳变，为增长时间尺度跟踪与正-负-正曲率模式提供了理论与模型实例支持。

Abstract: Wasserstein gradient flow extends gradient descent to probability measures. Its Hessian-guided perturbed variant (PWGF) adds Gaussian perturbations to escape saddle points in nonconvex problems. We investigate when its approximation by finitely many interacting particles remains accurate over growing time horizons. Our analysis retains the curvature accumulated along the population-driven reference path: negative curvature can amplify approximation errors, while subsequent positive curvature can damp their influence. This captures favorable scenarios in which temporary instability is compatible with accurate tracking over growing horizons. Under regularity assumptions and a prescribed common perturbation schedule, we prove particle and objective-value tracking bounds on a high-probability event for reference paths satisfying explicit conditions on accumulated curvature. To handle state-dependent Gaussian jumps, we construct a population-first coupling that preserves the reference particles' conditional independence and reduces jump errors to covariance comparison. We verify the conditions in a variance-plus-cosine model, where curvature recovery yields a growing-horizon tracking guarantee. We also establish local attraction, transverse descent, and positive second variation in two regions of a regularized matrix-factorization model, motivating a positive-negative-positive curvature pattern.

</details>


### [268] [Shared Gaussianization: What Gaussian Regularizers Certify About Contrastive Learning, and What They Miss](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10299)
*Ruoyu Zhao,Yuting Chen,Jinheng Zhang,Zhehao Zou,Tong Che*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出共享高斯化(SG)正则项，用特征函数检验两视图平均的联合高斯性，可同时检测对比学习中的错位与非均匀性，并给出与InfoNCE的紧界及与LeJEPA/SIGReg的联系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究分布匹配正则项(如LeJEPA中的SIGReg)究竟能为对比学习提供何种理论保证；单视图均匀性无法捕捉视图间一致性，需要能同时约束对齐性与均匀性的检验。

Method: 在归一化两视图平均上做特征函数高斯性检验并按独立χ_d半径缩放；推导SG与总体InfoNCE极小值及超额误差的界；分析对齐项与旋转不变均匀性检验的线性界条件；研究各向同性干扰通道下的优化行为与有限批量偏差。

Result: SG在总体InfoNCE的对齐均匀极小点处恰为零，等边缘下InfoNCE超额被4·3^{3/4}β乘SG损失平方根加线性项所界，该平方根速率与无量纲常数是紧的，且视图对上任何平方均值嵌入距离都无法更快。均匀性检验的线性界当且仅当其谱支配核e^{βu^Tv}；SG满足，高斯核在γ≥β/2时恰好满足，矩匹配永不满足。干扰通道下纯SG会通过加入逐视图干扰降损，对齐权重高于通道增益时无干扰解成为严格局部极小；LeJEPA存在随批量递减的临界SIGReg权重。

Conclusion: SG型分布匹配正则项可从单一检验同时约束对齐与均匀，提供对InfoNCE的紧致、无维度常数保证；但偏离最优时目标不同，需合适对齐权重与无偏U统计量，且InfoNCE训练比纯SG更易优化。

Abstract: What can a distribution-matching regularizer such as SIGReg in LeJEPA certify about contrastive learning? We study shared Gaussianization (SG), a characteristic-function Gaussianity test on the average of two normalized views, scaled by an independent $χ_d$ radius. Because disagreeing views shorten the average, one test detects both misalignment and non-uniformity. SG vanishes exactly at the aligned, uniform minimizers of population InfoNCE, and under equal marginals it bounds the InfoNCE excess by $4\cdot 3^{3/4}β$ times the square root of the SG loss, plus a term linear in the loss. The square-root rate and this dimension-free constant are sharp, and no squared mean-embedding distance on view pairs achieves a faster rate. With an explicit alignment term, a rotation-invariant uniformity test gives a linear bound if and only if its spectrum dominates that of InfoNCE's kernel $e^{βu^\top v}$; SG's own test does, Gaussian kernels $e^{-γ\|u-v\|^2}$ qualify exactly when $γ\ge β/2$, and moment matching never does. Away from the optimum, the objectives differ. Along an isotropic nuisance channel, pure SG lowers its loss by adding per-view nuisance whenever the shared code is non-uniform. An alignment weight above the channel's gain makes the nuisance-free solution a strict local minimizer; for LeJEPA, the same rule gives a critical SIGReg weight that decreases with the batch size. At finite batch size, an off-diagonal U-statistic removes a plug-in bias toward misalignment. In controlled latent-variable models, pure SG retains per-view style, an alignment weight above the measured gain removes it, and for LeJEPA at three batch sizes the measured gain separates the encoders that retain style from those that do not. InfoNCE training also reaches a lower SG$_{0.2}$ loss than SG$_{0.2}$ training from scratch, which points to an optimization gap.

</details>


### [269] [Revisiting Explainable AI through Model-Independent Concept Dictionaries](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10301)
*Thomas Schnake,Doreen Schöppenthau,Alexander Meyer,Jacques Corbeil,Klaus-Robert Müller,Grégoire Montavon*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: DictXAI 通过在输入域用字典元素定义概念，先对输入求稀疏编码，再将预测归因到字典元素，从而提供可解释、可操作且与架构无关的模型解释。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 XAI 方法通常假设输入特征本身可解释，或依赖难以刻画、高度依赖具体架构的内部中间抽象，导致跨模型使用不一致。作者希望突破这些限制，直接在输入域定义概念。

Method: DictXAI 使用一个大型、可能过完备的预定义字典，每个元素携带可解释含义；方法先计算输入的稀疏编码，再将模型预测归因到相关字典元素上。

Result: DictXAI 能将 AI 故障（如 Clever Hans 效应）直接归因到数据中可识别的伪影模式，并促进人类与 AI 在复杂生物医学信号上的一致性；同时可跨多种字典工作，包括学习到的图像基、心电图解析波形以及实验获取的字典元素。

Conclusion: 相比经典 XAI 或现有基于概念的方法，DictXAI 提供了更可解释、更可操作且与架构无关的洞见。

Abstract: Modern applications of AI rely on increasingly complex models. Explainable AI (XAI) has emerged as a set of techniques aimed at improving model transparency. However, existing XAI methods typically assume input features to be inherently interpretable, or they rely on intermediate internal abstractions that are difficult to characterize and highly architecture-specific, hindering consistent use across models. To address these limitations, we propose DictXAI, a method that defines concepts directly in the input domain via a dictionary---a large, potentially overcomplete set of predefined elements, each carrying an interpretable meaning. Technically, DictXAI first computes a sparse code of the input and then attributes the model's prediction to the associated dictionary elements. We demonstrate the actionable nature of DictXAI explanations, showing that they can attribute AI malfunctions (e.g., Clever Hans effects) directly to identifiable artifact patterns in the data, while fostering human-AI alignment on intricate biomedical signals. We further demonstrate our method's ability to operate across a wide variety of dictionaries, including learned image bases, analytically defined waveforms for electrocardiography, and experimentally acquired dictionary elements. Overall, our results show that DictXAI provides more interpretable, actionable, and architecture-agnostic insights than classical XAI or existing concept-based approaches.

</details>


### [270] [Koopman Observers for Diffusion Acceleration: Correcting Feature Forecasts with Shallow Measurements](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10366)
*Hanru Bai,Yuanchao Xu,Fengyi Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出观测校正的Koopman框架，用浅层新鲜特征校正深层特征预测，加速冻结扩散模型采样。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有扩散采样加速的特征缓存方法仅依赖历史特征预测，无法直接纳入当前去噪状态的变化，限制了预测保真度。作者探究能否用廉价的新鲜计算特征作为观测来校正预测。

Method: 引入观测校正的Koopman框架：利用标定轨迹辨识有限维、时变的Koopman近似，联合描述浅层与深层网络特征的增量。加速采样时用算子预测昂贵的深层特征演化，同时用观测到的浅层特征新息校正预测状态；周期性全量评估刷新观测器，生成模型参数保持不变。该表述支持对时间预测与观测校正进行受控对比。

Result: 每数据集三次1万张图像运行：在相同四步部分步调度下，相比通道仿射预测，配对Inception特征MSE在CIFAR-10降低19.9%，在十类ImageNet子集降低11.9%；匹配消融显示观测校正额外贡献4.54%与4.67%的降低。观测器相对DDIM-50实现1.89×与1.85×实测加速。

Conclusion: 浅层新鲜特征作为观测可有效校正深层特征预测，提升参考采样器保真度，且无需重训练去噪器，为扩散采样加速提供可控的时间预测与观测校正框架。

Abstract: Feature caching accelerates diffusion sampling by replacing expensive network evaluations with predictions from previously computed activations. However, forecasts based only on past features cannot directly incorporate changes in the current denoising state. We investigate whether inexpensive, freshly computed features can serve as observations for correcting these predictions. We introduce an observation-corrected Koopman framework for accelerating frozen diffusion models. Using calibration trajectories, we identify finite-dimensional, time-dependent Koopman approximations that jointly describe the increments of shallow and deep network features. During accelerated sampling, these operators predict the evolution of expensive deep features, while innovations in the observed shallow features correct the predicted state. Periodic full evaluations refresh the observer, and all generative-model parameters remain unchanged. This formulation enables controlled comparisons of temporal prediction and observation correction. Across three 10,000-image runs per dataset, our method reduces paired Inception-feature MSE by $19.9\%$ on CIFAR-10 and $11.9\%$ on a ten-class ImageNet subset relative to channelwise affine prediction under the same four-partial-step schedule. Matched ablations attribute additional reductions of $4.54\%$ and $4.67\%$ to observation correction. The observer achieves $1.89\times$ and $1.85\times$ measured speedups over DDIM-50, supporting improved reference-sampler fidelity without retraining the denoiser.

</details>


### [271] [Training Parallel Speculative Draft Models by Directly Minimizing Expected Decoding Rounds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10411)
*Yunxiao Zhao,Changxiao Cai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将投机解码建模为马尔可夫奖励过程，提出EDR目标及精确时序差分梯度，并给出离线评测器，在九个基准上验证了其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 并行与半自回归草稿模型虽能一次前向生成整块token以提升起草效率，但其训练存在困难：某位置的草稿分布依赖于解码轮次的起点，而起点又取决于前几轮接受的token数量。现有目标多用块局部代理，忽略这种跨轮耦合，无法直接优化全局解码效率。

Method: 将投机解码形式化为马尔可夫奖励过程，导出"期望解码轮数（EDR）"目标：以状态占用度对局部拒绝代价加权，精确等于期望解码轮数，且不引入额外超参；进而推导精确的时序差分梯度，支持基于目标模型rollout的无偏随机优化；同一框架还给出精确的离线轮数评测器，可在共享rollout上做配对比较而无需实际运行投机解码。

Result: 用EDR微调两种先进草稿模型DSpark与DFly，在数学推理、代码生成和对话共九个基准上，平均接受长度一致提升，并优于现有训练目标。

Conclusion: 以马尔可夫奖励过程视角统一训练与评估并行/半自回归草稿模型，EDR提供了无超参、可无偏优化的全局效率目标，并附带来精确离线评测能力，实验证明其能稳定提升接受长度与解码效率。

Abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates large language model inference by using a low-cost draft model to propose tokens that the full-size target model verifies in parallel. Parallel and semi-autoregressive (semi- AR) drafters improve drafting efficiency by proposing an entire block in a single forward pass, but training them raises a new difficulty: the draft distribution for a given position depends on where the decoding round starts, and where rounds start depends on how many tokens earlier rounds accepted. Existing training objectives typically rely on block-local surrogates that ignore this cross-round coupling, and therefore do not directly optimize the global decoding efficiency. In this work, we develop a theoretical framework for training and evaluating these drafters by representing speculative decoding as a Markov reward process. This formulation yields the Expected Decoding Rounds (EDR) objective, which weights local rejection costs by state occupancies and exactly equals the expected number of decoding rounds. Unlike prior surrogate objectives, EDR introduces no auxiliary hyperparameters. We then derive an exact temporal-difference gradient that supports unbiased stochastic optimization from target-model rollouts. The same framework also yields an exact offline evaluator for round counts, enabling paired drafter comparisons on shared target rollouts without running speculative decoding. Finetuning two state-of-the- art drafters, DSpark and DFly, with EDR consistently improves mean accepted length and outperforms existing training objectives across nine benchmarks spanning math reasoning, code generation, and chat.

</details>


### [272] [Oracle-Efficient and Parameter-Free Agnostic Smoothed Online Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10499)
*Sasha Voitovych,Adam Block,Alexander Rakhlin,Abhishek Shetty*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文在smoothed online learning框架下，首次提出无需知晓基础测度μ、且适用于agnostic设置的无参数oracle高效算法（基于Gaussian Follow-The-Perturbed-Leader），仅需每轮一次ERM调用即可达到$\widetilde O(d\sqrt{T/\sigma})$的regret，最优至多差一个$\sqrt{d}$因子。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线学习的通用性带来显著统计与计算障碍；smoothed online learning虽能兼顾经典学习的统计/计算保证与在线学习的灵活性，但既有oracle高效算法依赖两个强假设：(i)对基础测度μ的采样访问，或(ii)标签能被固定假设完美预测。二者限制了适用性，而统计学习中ERM在agnostic设置下无需知道数据分布即可高效学习，因此需要消除这些假设。

Method: 提出基于Gaussian Follow-The-Perturbed-Leader的算法，为parameter-free设计，不依赖μ、平滑参数σ或时域T的先验知识；在agnostic设置下仅需每轮一次ERM oracle调用；证明regret界过程中引入多项新技术。

Result: 首次给出在agnostic设置、无需知晓μ的情况下实现sublinear regret的oracle高效算法；对VC维为d的二分类类达到$\widetilde O(d\sqrt{T/\sigma})$的regret，且相对最优仅差$\sqrt{d}$因子。

Conclusion: 证明既有算法的两个假设均非必要，从而显著拓宽了smoothed online learning的适用性，使其更接近经典统计学习的实用性；算法参数自由且计算高效，并对regret最优性给出近乎匹配的保证。

Abstract: Online learning is an attractive framework in many domains because it permits well-defined learning even when data are dependent or chosen adversarially. This generality, however, comes at a steep price, introducing significant statistical and computational barriers. Recently, smoothed online learning has emerged as a promising framework that interpolates between the fully adversarial and fully stochastic settings by assuming that the conditional law of each covariate has density at most $1/σ$ with respect to some fixed base measure $μ$, and it is known to match the statistical and computational guarantees of classical learning while still allowing for much of the flexibility of online learning. However, existing oracle-efficient algorithms require either (i) sampling access to the base measure $μ$ or (ii) labels that are perfectly predicted by a fixed hypothesis. Both assumptions limit the applicability of these algorithms, in contrast to statistical learning, where empirical risk minimization (ERM) learns efficiently in the agnostic setting without any knowledge of the data distribution. We show that neither assumption is necessary, giving the first oracle-efficient algorithm that achieves sublinear regret in the agnostic setting without knowledge of $μ$. Our algorithm, based on Gaussian Follow-The-Perturbed-Leader, is parameter-free: it requires no knowledge of $μ$, the smoothing parameter $σ$, or the horizon $T$, and it achieves regret $\widetilde O(d\sqrt{T/σ})$ for binary classes of VC dimension $d$ with a single call to an ERM oracle per round, which is optimal up to a $\sqrt{d}$ factor. En route to establishing the regret bound, we introduce several new techniques that may be of independent interest.

</details>


### [273] [Why Forget-Only Unlearning Needs Memorization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10519)
*Luka Radić,Vikrant Singhal,Amartya Sanyal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究"仅遗忘"（forget-only）机器遗忘的可行性：仅给训练好的模型和待遗忘样本，不给保留数据或额外训练信息。作者证明其可行性取决于学习算法，给出匹配重训练精度的下界，并推导算法必须记忆的训练信息量下界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有机器遗忘通常假设可访问保留数据或训练过程信息，而实际中删除请求往往只提供模型和遗忘样本。因此需要回答：在没有保留数据和额外训练信息时，遗忘是否总是可能？其信息论极限在哪里？

Method: 首先构造不同数据集产生同一训练模型、但在删除同样样本后需输出不同结果的现象，据此推导遗忘输出与重训练匹配精度的下界，并在若干标准学习算法上具体化；随后推导算法处理任意删除请求所需记忆训练数据的信息量下界，并以简单阈值学习器为例分析。

Result: 仅遗忘遗忘并非总可行，其可行性依赖具体学习算法；不同数据集可对应同一模型但删除后所需输出差异很大；对简单阈值学习器，处理任意删除请求所需记忆信息可能多达整个数据集，尽管普通训练只保留一个边界点。

Conclusion: 普通学习过程中被丢弃的信息在后续删除时可能重新变得必要。因此，为仅遗忘场景设计的模型可能需要比标准训练保留更多信息，以实现接近从零重训练的效果。

Abstract: Machine unlearning asks for a deletion algorithm whose output is close to retraining from scratch without the selected forget examples. In this work, we study forget-only unlearning, where the deletion algorithm receives only the trained model and the examples to forget, with no retained data or extra training information. We ask whether forget-only unlearning is always possible. We first show that this depends on the learning method: different datasets can produce the same trained model but require very different outputs after the same examples are removed. Using this observation, we derive lower bounds on how accurately unlearning can match retraining and instantiate them for several standard learning algorithms. We then ask what must be true when forget-only unlearning succeeds. To this end, we derive lower bounds on what an algorithm must memorize about the training data to handle arbitrary deletion requests. For simple threshold learners, the required information can be as large as the entire dataset, even though ordinary training keeps only one boundary point. Overall, our results show that information discarded during ordinary learning may be needed later for deletion, so models designed for forget-only unlearning may need to retain more information than standard training does.

</details>


### [274] [Beyond Baseline Severity: Temporal and Disease-Specific Predictors of Depression Outcomes Following Mindfulness Interventions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08809)
*Muhammad Jawad Chowdhury,Sultanus Salehin,Akib Jayed Islam*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文对多中心纵向临床队列开展可解释机器学习分析，预测正念干预后12周与24周的BDI-II抑郁评分，并揭示不同时间尺度上预测因子的差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 慢性或急性疾病患者的抑郁严重程度受基线心理状态、人口学特征、临床情境及行为干预参与度等多因素复杂交互影响，需构建可解释、情境敏感的模型以支持个性化心理健康服务。

Method: 使用人口学变量、临床疾病信息、医院中心标识、基线BDI-II评分及治疗参与度指标；对缺失随访结局采用基于模型的随机插补以保留样本量与结局变异性；评估五类回归模型，涵盖正则化线性回归与树集成方法。

Result: 12周预测中Ridge Regression表现最佳（RMSE=5.186，R²=0.474）；24周预测中LightGBM表现最佳（RMSE=5.038，R²=0.525）。基线严重度为最强总体预测因子；短期结局更依赖临床与医院情境，长期结局更依赖行为依从性与人口学因素；疾病特异与分层亚组分析显示预测因子在临床类别间及类别内差异显著。

Conclusion: 可解释、情境感知的建模方法可有效预测正念干预后的抑郁结局，并为个性化心理健康支持提供依据。

Abstract: Depression severity among patients with chronic or acute medical conditions is influenced by a complex interaction of baseline psychological state, demographic characteristics, clinical context, and engagement with behavioral interventions. This paper presents an interpretable machine-learning analysis of a multi-center longitudinal clinical cohort to predict Beck Depression Inventory-II (BDI-II) scores at 12 and 24 weeks following mindfulness-based intervention participation. The study uses demographic variables, clinical condition information, hospital-center identifiers, baseline BDI-II scores, and therapy engagement measures to model short-term and long-term depression outcomes. Missing follow-up outcomes were addressed using a model-based stochastic imputation procedure to preserve the modest sample size while maintaining outcome variability. Five regression models were evaluated, spanning regularized linear regression and tree-based ensemble methods. Ridge Regression achieved the best 12-week performance with an RMSE of 5.186 and R^2 of 0.474, while LightGBM achieved the best 24-week performance with an RMSE of 5.038 and R^2 of 0.525. Beyond prediction accuracy, the analysis reveals three clinically relevant patterns: baseline severity remains the strongest overall predictor, short-term outcomes are more strongly associated with clinical and hospital context, and long-term outcomes show greater dependence on behavioral adherence and demographic factors. Disease-specific and hierarchical subgroup analyses further indicate that predictors differ substantially across and within clinical categories. These findings support the use of interpretable, context-aware modeling to inform personalized mental-health support following mindfulness-based interventions.

</details>


### [275] [Transferability and operational reliability of a Prithvi crop classification foundation model under phenological and geographic shift across three continents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08810)
*Venkatesh Kolluru,Rajat Shinde,Abdelhak Marouane,Caden Helbling,Deepak Shah,Othneil Drew,Srinivas Kolluru,Iksha Gurung,Manil Maskey,Rahul Ramachandran*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 微调的地理空间基础模型（GeoFM，如 Prithvi-EO-2.0）在跨 12 国 37 个事件的分布外评估中，平均总体精度从美国 0.65 降至欧洲 0.40；精度崩塌主因是观测窗口与当地作物物候错位而非空间迁移，且模型置信度保持高企、出现大量高置信误标。合并类别（13→10 类）可提升 8.4 个百分点，窗口压缩至约 75 天可保持精度。GeoFM 仅在观测窗口匹配当地生长季时才具有可用迁移性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管基于大规模卫星档案预训练并微调的 GeoFM 已被证明能提升作物分类精度与地理可迁移性，但其在训练分布之外的业务化表现仍缺乏刻画；论文旨在系统评估该模型的分布外性能，并给出可靠部署的操作性指导。

Method: 在 3 大洲 12 个国家 37 个事件上评估广泛采用的 GeoFM（Prithvi-EO-2.0）的分布外性能，并以区域参考产品作验证。除精度指标外，考察五个方面：模型置信度是否能指示失效、对观测窗口的敏感性、类别方案粗化的影响、对波段缺失及云–阴影污染的鲁棒性；并使用期望校准误差与蒙特卡洛 dropout 熵分析置信校准与分布偏移。

Result: 平均总体精度（OA）由美国 0.65 降至欧洲 0.40。观测窗口与当地作物物候错位时精度崩塌而确定性置信度仍很高；八个配对事件中七个期望校准误差上升，每个受影响场景有 12–51% 像元以近零精度被高置信误标；蒙特卡洛 dropout 熵在全部八个事件中均检出偏移，表明跨洲精度下降在很大程度上源于物候错位而非空间迁移。两项无需重训的调整可恢复精度：依据模型主要混淆将 13 类合并为 10 类，使平均 OA 提升 8.4 个百分点；将窗口压缩至近实时使用，在 45–90 天区间保持精度（约 75 天达峰），但短于 30 天时较该平台期低约 0.11。

Conclusion: 微调的作物 GeoFM 仅在观测窗口与当地生长季匹配时才具有实用迁移性；研究据此转化为该已发布模型可靠部署的操作性指导。

Abstract: Fine-tuned geospatial foundation models (GeoFMs) pretrained on large satellite archives have been shown to improve crop classification accuracy and geographic transferability. However, their operational performance beyond the training distribution remains poorly characterized. We evaluated the out-of-distribution performance of a widely adopted GeoFM [Prithvi-EO-2.0] across 37 events in 12 countries on three continents and validated against regional reference products. Results indicated that the mean overall accuracy (OA) declined from 0.65 in the United States to 0.40 in Europe. Beyond accuracy metrics, we assessed five key aspects of model performance: whether model confidence indicates signal failure, sensitivity to observation windows, the effect of coarsening class schemes, and robustness to both band loss and cloud- and shadow-contamination. Accuracy collapsed when the observation window misaligned with local crop phenology, while deterministic confidence remained high. Expected calibration error increased for seven of eight paired events, and 12-51% of each affected scene was confidently mislabeled at near-zero precision. Monte Carlo dropout entropy registered the shift in all eight, indicating that much of the apparent cross-continent decline reflected phenological misalignment rather than spatial transfer. Two adjustments recovered accuracy without retraining. Consolidating 13 classes into 10, based on the model's dominant confusions, raised the mean OA by 8.4 percentage points. Compressing the window toward near-real-time use preserved accuracy across a 45- to 90-day plateau, peaking near 75 days, though arms tighter than 30 days fell about 0.11 below that plateau. Fine-tuned crop GeoFMs therefore transfer usefully only where observation windows match local growing seasons. We translate these findings into operational guidance for the reliable deployment of the released model.

</details>


### [276] [KVFetch: Temporal Prefetching for the Missing Half of KV Cache Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08811)
*Linfeng Dong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文指出KV缓存压缩方法普遍只支持基于内容的相关性检索，缺失按位置顺序遍历的访问模式，导致逐字复制任务出现"顺序遗忘"。作者提出免训练、即插即用的KVFetch框架，通过冷层降级、单调读指针检测复制行为并预取位置后继，在不增加注意力开销的情况下恢复顺序访问能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着上下文窗口扩展到数万乃至数十万token，KV缓存压缩对高效LLM推理变得至关重要。现有三类方法（基于分数的驱逐、摘要补偿、卸载与召回）都依据"当前查询的内容相关性"来决定保留或召回什么，忽略了缓存本应支持的另一种访问模式——按位置的顺序遍历。在检索增强生成、代码补全、结构化数据抽取等需要逐字复现标识符、字段值或代码token的任务中，内容驱动驱逐会保留序列头部却丢弃后续部分，导致逐字复制在中途不可逆地中断，这一问题被称为"顺序遗忘"，且无法通过更好的打分、更大预算、摘要补偿或动态重打分来解决。

Method: 提出KVFetch，一个免训练、即插即用的框架，可为任意基于分数的压缩器打开一条时间召回通道：将被驱逐的候选降级到量化的冷层；通过单调读指针检测模型正在进行复制行为；将位置后继预取到固定大小的热层槽位中，且不增加注意力成本。

Result: 在等预算控制下，于RULER-16K上，KVFetch将逐字复制得分从0.8恢复到78.4，并使13项任务的平均成绩提升+8.4，增益集中在需要顺序访问的任务上。在LongBench上，由于没有任务需要顺序访问，该通道保持休眠，不产生任何开销。

Conclusion: 现有KV缓存压缩的共同设计缺陷在于仅实现内容关联查找而缺失位置顺序遍历，顺序遗忘是压缩下残留质量损失的主要来源。KVFetch以时间召回通道补全该缺失维度，在不增加注意力成本、无需训练的前提下显著恢复顺序访问类任务性能，并在无需顺序访问的场景下自适应休眠，实现零额外代价。

Abstract: As context windows scale to tens or hundreds of thousands of tokens, KV cache compression has become essential for efficient LLM inference. Existing methods fall into three families: score-based eviction, summary compensation, and offload-and-recall. Yet all three decide what to keep or recall by content relevance to the current query. We show this shared design is structurally incomplete. A cache supports two access modes: associative lookup by content and sequential traversal by position; current compressors implement only the first. The gap matters in practice: retrieval-augmented generation, code completion, and structured-data extraction all require the model to reproduce identifiers, field values, or code tokens verbatim from the context. Under compression, content-based eviction retains the head of such a sequence but discards its continuation, causing verbatim copying to break irreversibly midway, a failure we call sequential forgetting. This failure resists better scoring, larger budgets, summary compensation, and dynamic re-scoring; it is the dominant source of remaining quality loss under compression. We propose KVFetch, a training-free, drop-in framework that opens a temporal recall channel for any score-based compressor. It demotes evicted candidates to a quantized cold tier, detects active copying through a monotone read pointer, and prefetches positional successors into fixed-size hot-tier slots without increasing attention cost. On RULER-16K under an iso-budget control, KVFetch recovers verbatim copying from 0.8 to 78.4 and raises the 13-task average by +8.4, with gains concentrating on tasks that require sequential access. On LongBench, where no task requires sequential access, the channel remains dormant and imposes no cost.

</details>


### [277] [HydroSphere: A Framework for Governed, Self-Healing Wastewater Infrastructure](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08819)
*Prabu,Fancy C,Suresh A,Srini Ramaswamy*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 HydroSphere——一个受治理约束、数据驱动的实时水质监测、预测、处理优化与故障恢复框架，基于 282 万条水质测量数据（1940–2023）进行评估，集成 TCN-LSTM 混合预测、PPO 自适应加药优化与 SHADE 深度自编码器异常检测三大模块，并配套分层治理、确定性安全边界与人工监督。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 快速工业化与城市扩张持续加剧水质与污水处理系统压力，而传统处理厂多依赖静态监测与控制策略，难以适应不断变化的污染物状况，因此需要具备实时性、自适应性与安全保障能力的智能水务管理方案。

Method: 框架包含三部分：(1) 混合 TCN-LSTM 模型对 7 个水质参数进行多步预测；(2) 自适应加药优化模块（Adaptive Dosage Optimization Module）采用 PPO 强化学习调节化学加药量；(3) SHADE 异常检测模块基于深度自编码器识别传感器与工艺异常。整体通过分层治理、确定性安全边界与人工监督实现受控运行，并在受控故障注入条件下评估异常检测性能。

Result: TCN-LSTM 预测取得 RMSE 0.1417、MAE 0.1047、R² 0.3596；PPO 加药优化平均单步奖励 1.059，高于固定加药基线的 1.017；结果显示无约束的奖励优化会导致过量加药，表明需引入显式运行安全约束；SHADE 在受控故障注入下异常检测 F1 为 0.651。

Conclusion: HydroSphere 将实时监测、预测、优化与故障恢复能力同分层治理、确定性安全边界和人工监督相结合，为更安全、更具适应性的水务基础设施提供支撑，可作为智能污水管理的可扩展基础，并服务于联合国可持续发展目标 6 与 13。

Abstract: Rapid industrialization and urban growth are increasing pressure on water quality and wastewater treatment systems, while conventional treatment plants often rely on static monitoring and control strategies that cannot easily adapt to changing pollutant conditions. This paper presents HydroSphere, a governed, data-driven framework for real-time water quality monitoring, forecasting, treatment optimization, and fault recovery. HydroSphere is evaluated using 2.82 million water-quality measurements collected between 1940 and 2023. The framework integrates three main components. First, a hybrid TCN-LSTM model performs multi-step forecasting across seven water-quality parameters, achieving an RMSE of 0.1417, MAE of 0.1047, and R2 of 0.3596. Second, the Adaptive Dosage Optimization Module uses PPO reinforcement learning to adjust chemical dosing, achieving a mean step reward of 1.059 compared with 1.017 for a fixed-dose baseline. The results also show that unconstrained reward optimization can lead to excessive dosing, demonstrating the need for explicit operational safeguards. Third, the SHADE anomaly detection module uses a deep autoencoder to identify sensor and process anomalies, achieving an F1 score of 0.651 under controlled fault injection. HydroSphere combines these capabilities with tiered governance, deterministic safety bounds, and human oversight to support safer and more adaptive water infrastructure. The framework provides a scalable foundation for intelligent wastewater management and supports the objectives of UN Sustainable Development Goals 6 and 13.

</details>


### [278] [FinVector-Market-4B: A Controlled Study of LoRA Adaptation for Structured Financial Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08882)
*Alina Khaybullina*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究用rank-16 LoRA将Qwen3.5-4B适配到结构化金融任务，在匹配显式提示下各项任务指标大幅提升，且证明部分"性能下降"实为标签集变化所致。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究轻量级领域适配能否在结构化金融任务上带来超出"输出格式学习"的真实任务能力增益，并厘清基准评测中格式契约与标签集变化对结论的干扰。

Method: 以Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B为基座，在22,000条样本语料上用rank-16 LoRA微调（FinVector-Market-4B）。在600条基准上对比基座与适配模型，设置隐式与显式JSON-schema两种提示契约，并进行事后策略评分审计（统一三类目标标签）及数据重叠/计算器目标一致性检查。

Result: 仅提供schema即使基座JSON合法率由0%升至91.3%。匹配显式提示下，FinQA答案精确匹配由14.7%升至40.0%，计算器表达式正确率48.0%→82.7%，情景分支标签一致率20.1%→89.5%，蕴含方向一致率52.4%→87.2%。事后审计显示原macro-F1下降源于标签集变化，统一三类目标后基座77.4%、适配器83.1%。

Conclusion: 紧凑的金融领域适配能在匹配提示下产生显著的任务特定增益，超越单纯输出格式学习；但增益受评测任务分布与提示契约约束，且文件重叠与计算器目标不一致削弱了基准的泛化结论。

Abstract: FinVector-Market-4B adapts Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B with rank-16 LoRA on a 22,000-example corpus for structured financial tasks. We evaluate the base and adapted models on the same 600-example benchmark under implicit and explicit JSON-schema contracts. Supplying the schema alone raises base-model JSON validity from 0% to 91.3%. Under matched explicit prompting, the frozen scores improve from 14.7% to 40.0% for FinQA answer exact match, from 48.0% to 82.7% for calculator-expression correctness, from 20.1% to 89.5% for scenario branch-label agreement, and from 52.4% to 87.2% for implication-direction agreement. A post-hoc policy-scoring audit shows that the reported macro-F1 decline reflects a changing label set; using the same three target classes gives 77.4% for the base and 83.1% for the adapter. Filing overlap and calculator-target inconsistencies qualify the benchmark's generalization claims. The results show that compact financial domain adaptation can produce substantial task-specific gains beyond output-format learning under matched prompting, with gains bounded by the evaluated task distribution and prompt contract.

</details>


### [279] [GraphOPD: Graph-Augmented On-Policy Distillation for LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08959)
*Bohan Lin,Liyi Chen,Zhuoning Guo,Muyang Li,Qimeng Wang,Yan Gao,Yao Hu,Yudong Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出GraphOPD，用环境状态变化构建步骤依赖图，以随机游走平稳分布打分并与散度信号融合，实现更优的on-policy蒸馏。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有on-policy蒸馏按教师-学生散度大小分配指导，基于单轮直觉；在多轮决策链中该规则失效：早期漂移会进入后续所有上下文，使教师与漂移轨迹保持一致而无法定位责任步，同时可互换步骤产生大但与结果无关的散度。实验显示蒸馏最高散度步骤相比随机选择并无稳定收益。

Method: GraphOPD从环境自身状态变化记录中读取哪些步骤促成了哪些后续步骤，构建依赖图，用图上随机游走的平稳分布为每步打分，再将该结构信用与散度信号融合为轨迹相对掩码，把监督集中在每条轨迹中能力匹配度最高的步骤上。

Result: 在ALFWorld、WebShop、SearchQA上，覆盖三种模型规模与十一个基线，GraphOPD整体表现具竞争力，较最强基线最高提升+5.8个百分点。执行回放审计表明结构信用分对真实因果影响远超随机水平，两种融合信号各自必要，且该信号可迁移到域外工具集成推理。

Conclusion: GraphOPD首次将图结构增强引入面向智能体能力的on-policy蒸馏，用环境可观测的因果依赖替代不可靠的散度启发式，实现更精准的步骤级监督并具备跨域泛化性。

Abstract: On-policy distillation post-trains large language model agents by supplying dense, step-level guidance from a teacher policy when the reinforcement-learning reward is sparse and arrives only once per trajectory. Existing instantiations allocate this guidance by the size of the teacher-student divergence at each step, on the single-turn intuition that a large disagreement marks a mistake worth correcting. Once decisions chain over many turns, that rule misfires, since an early drift enters every later context both policies condition on, leaving the teacher consistent with the drifted trajectory instead of flagging its cause, while interchangeable steps register large but outcome-irrelevant divergences. We demonstrate this on an agentic benchmark, where distilling the highest-divergence steps brings no consistent benefit over random selection. To this end, we introduce GraphOPD, the first method to bring graph-based structural augmentation into on-policy distillation for agent capabilities. It reads which steps enabled which later ones from the environment's own record of state changes, immune to the drift that corrupts the teacher-student gap, organizes them into a dependency graph, scores each step by a random-walk stationary distribution over it, and fuses that structural credit with the divergence signal into a trajectory-relative mask concentrating supervision on each rollout's highest-aptitude steps. Across three model scales and eleven baselines on ALFWorld, WebShop, and SearchQA, GraphOPD shows competitive performance throughout, improving over the strongest baseline by up to +5.8 pp. An executed-replay audit further shows that this structural credit score tracks true causal impact far above chance, that both fused signals are independently necessary, and that the same signal transfers to out-of-domain tool-integrated reasoning.

</details>


### [280] [On KL-Regularized Policy Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08963)
*Yifan Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出KLPO框架，将KL正则锚定在采样器处，通过闭式Gibbs解与对数比最小二乘拟合实现无critic、无需重要性权重的异步RL更新，每提示仅需一条rollout。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 异步强化学习训练LLM智能体时，rollout来自过期checkpoint，且推理引擎与训练器概率在相同参数下亦不一致。传统做法（如裁剪重要性比率）会引入偏差，或如GRPO每提示采样一组响应，在长回合场景代价高昂。

Method: 提出KL-Regularized Policy Optimization (KLPO)：将KL正则项锚定于采样器，使正则化改进步具有闭式Gibbs解；在采样器自身轨迹上以最小二乘拟合对数比最优性条件，采样器概率仅通过对数比进入，无需重要性权重。通过消去回归截距，用信号采样器均值加采样器到训练器的KL散度替代不可解的log-partition函数。对token级策略镜像下降目标，证明梯度可由终端回报计算而无需critic（采样器中心score或单条轨迹残差），并适用于随机工具输出。进一步证明KL项的独立蒙特卡洛估计保持梯度无偏，推导廉价top-K与二值近似的精确KL差距，并说明SPPO、GPO、REBEL、BPO均为KLPO特例。

Result: 得到一个无critic的更新方法：每提示仅使用一条rollout，无需学习归一化器，也无需一组响应；同时统一了SPPO、GPO、REBEL、BPO等既有方法。

Conclusion: KLPO为异步LLM智能体RL提供了一种理论统一且高效的策略优化框架，在保持更新无偏的同时显著降低采样与计算开销。

Abstract: Asynchronous reinforcement learning (RL) for large language model (LLM) agents trains one policy on trajectories generated by another: rollouts come from stale checkpoints, and the inference engine's probabilities differ from the trainer's even at identical parameters. Standard remedies either clip importance ratios, which biases the update, or, as in GRPO, sample a group of responses per prompt, which is costly when episodes are long. We propose KL-Regularized Policy Optimization (KLPO), a framework that anchors the KL regularizer at the sampler. The regularized improvement step then has a closed-form Gibbs solution, and KLPO fits its log-ratio optimality condition by least squares on the sampler's own trajectories, so the sampler probability enters through a log-ratio and no importance weights are needed. Profiling out the regression intercept replaces the intractable log-partition function with the signal's sampler mean plus a sampler-to-trainer KL divergence. For token-level policy mirror descent targets, we show that the resulting gradient can be computed from terminal returns without a critic, via sampler-centered scores or a single trajectory residual, even under stochastic tool outputs. We further prove that independent Monte Carlo estimates of the KL term keep these gradients unbiased, derive the exact KL gap of cheaper top-$K$ and binary approximations, and show that SPPO, GPO, REBEL, and BPO arise as special cases of KLPO. The result is a critic-free update that uses one rollout per prompt and requires neither a learned normalizer nor a group of responses.

</details>


### [281] [Algorithmic Scratchpads and Curriculum Staging for Arithmetic Reasoning in Tiny Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09003)
*Sourabh Kasliwal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文系统研究了小型Tiny Transformer在多步算术任务中的机制，发现数据加载、语言预训练、现代架构原语和算法式草稿本设计对性能有决定性影响，并揭示了模型的泛化与遗忘边界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自回归大语言模型在确定性多步算法任务（如多位数乘法和长除法）上表现不佳。作者希望在小规模可控的Tiny Transformer上揭示多步算术的机制，厘清影响成功的关键因素。

Method: 在约10.6M非嵌入参数（总计49.3M）的Tiny Transformer上，使用合成数据对加减乘除四种基本运算以逐步草稿本形式训练。方法包括：连续序列打包修复梯度饥饿；引入语言预训练；采用RoPE、RMSNorm、SwiGLU及稀疏MoE；设计确定性的逐位长除法草稿本并配合4阶段分层发展课程；对乘法采用FOIL草稿本并进行错误分析。

Result: 数据加载填充造成83%梯度饥饿伪影，使准确率从40%崩溃至1%，经连续序列打包修复；无语言预训练时准确率≤2.0%；现代架构原语与MoE显著提升加性推理。逐位长除法草稿本将单位数除法从4.0%提升至86.7%（4000题留出基准）；多位数乘法仍困难，FOIL草稿本因迫使单步同时求和多达九个多位数项而无成对中间累加而失败。未见4位数操作数时性能降至0.00%；无缓冲训练引发灾难性遗忘，除法准确率从86.7%降至0.00%。

Conclusion: 多步算术能力高度依赖训练基础设施（打包、预训练）、现代架构原语以及算法式草稿本与课程设计；同时模型存在明显的泛化边界和灾难性遗忘风险。

Abstract: Autoregressive Large Language Models (LLMs) frequently struggle with deterministic multi-step algorithmic tasks such as multi-digit multiplication and long division. In this paper, we investigate the mechanics of multi-step arithmetic in compact "Tiny" Transformers (~10.6M non-embedding parameters, 49.3M total) trained on synthetic data across four basic operations (+, -, *, /) unrolled as step-by-step scratchpads. First, we establish the necessary training foundations: (1) dataloader sequence padding creates an 83% gradient starvation artifact that collapses accuracy from 40% to 1%, remediated via continuous sequence packing; (2) linguistic pretraining is an essential prerequisite (<= 2.0% without it); and (3) modern architectural primitives (RoPE, RMSNorm, SwiGLU) and Sparse Mixture of Experts (MoE) substantially improve additive reasoning over baseline GPT-2. Second, we demonstrate that algorithmic scratchpad formulation directly dictates success. Introducing a deterministic Digit-by-Digit Long Division scratchpad within a 4-stage Hierarchical Developmental Curriculum dramatically elevates single-digit division from 4.0% to 86.7% accuracy on a 4,000-problem held-out benchmark. In contrast, multi-digit multiplication remained challenging: detailed error analysis revealed that while the model correctly computed single-digit sub-products and place-value zeros, our FOIL scratchpad failed because it forced a simultaneous summation of up to nine multi-digit terms in a single step without pairwise intermediate accumulation. Finally, we identify two key boundaries: performance collapses to 0.00% on unseen 4-digit operands, and unbuffered training induces catastrophic forgetting, collapsing division accuracy from 86.7% down to 0.00%.

</details>


### [282] [MaRK: Markov-adapted Recurrent Kernels for Dynamic Operator Conditioning in State Space Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09092)
*Syed Ibrahim Omer,Ginny Y. Wong. Xiangyu Zhao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: MaRK 将上下文向量直接映射为冻结 SSM 递归算子（A、B、C、D、Δ）的有界调制，使每个扩散时间步重塑记忆核，仅需少量可训练参数即可从双向目标迁移到迭代扩散生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有对预训练 SSM 的条件化多在递归算子外部进行（输入注入或激活调制），虽能注入条件信息，却未改变底层时间动力学，限制了迭代生成中的表达与适应能力。

Method: 提出 MaRK（Markov-adapted Recurrent Kernels）算子级条件化框架，将上下文映射为冻结 SSM 递归 A、读入 B、读出 C、跳连 D 与离散化 Δ 的有界调制；以 LPV-SSM 视角构造上下文索引的 Markov 参数序列族。在 111M 参数的冻结 Hydra SSM 上实例化三种适配器几何：Hypernet、Chebyshev 多项式与 DCT 核；通过低秩辅助映射修改 Markov 参数序列，参数高效微调成为结构副产品，可训练参数仅 6.3–11M。有界递归参数化给出解析的仿射二次稳定性（AQS）证书。

Result: 合成 LPV 恢复实验与 Markov 算子诊断表明：在匹配假设下 MaRK 可恢复坐标不变的时间算子，并产生各异且稳定的时间步条件记忆剖面。三种几何中 Chebyshev 变体最强，平均验证损失 2.55，其次为 DCT（2.59）与 Hypernet（3.77）。

Conclusion: 算子级条件化可在不改变 SSM 主体权重的前提下有效重塑递归记忆核，兼顾稳定性与参数效率，Chebyshev 多项式核是当前最优适配器几何。

Abstract: State Space Models (SSMs) offer an efficient alternative to Transformers for sequence modeling, yet conditioning pre-trained SSMs for iterative generation typically operates outside the recurrent operator, through input injection or activation modulation. While such mechanisms expose the model to conditioning information, they leave the underlying temporal dynamics fixed. We introduce MaRK (Markov-adapted Recurrent Kernels), a dynamic operator-conditioning framework that maps context vectors directly into bounded modulations of a frozen SSM's recurrence ($A$), read-in ($B$), read-out ($C$), skip ($D$), and discretization ($Δ$) parameters. Viewed through the lens of LPV-SSM systems, MaRK induces a context-indexed family of Markov parameter sequences, allowing each diffusion timestep to reshape the model's input-output memory kernel. We instantiate MaRK on a frozen 111M-parameter Hydra SSM backbone and study three adapter geometries: Hypernet, Chebyshev polynomial, and Discrete Cosine Transform kernels. Since these adapters modify the Markov parameter sequence through low-rank auxiliary maps on the frozen backbone, parameter-efficient fine-tuning arises as a structural consequence of the adaptation mechanism itself, requiring only 6.3--11M trainable auxiliary parameters to transition from a bidirectional objective to an iterative diffusion regime. The bounded recurrence parameterization further yields an analytic Affine Quadratic Stability certificate for the modulated recurrence. Through synthetic LPV recovery experiments and Markov-operator diagnostics, we show that MaRK recovers coordinate-invariant temporal operators under matched assumptions and produces distinct, stable timestep-conditioned memory profiles. Empirically, the Chebyshev variant yields the strongest performance, achieving an average validation loss of 2.55, followed by the DCT (2.59) and Hypernet (3.77) geometries.

</details>


### [283] [Convex-Concave Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09108)
*Shripad V. Deshmukh,Yaswanth Chittepu,Dhawal Gupta,Philip Thomas,Scott Niekum*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将策略优化在log密度比坐标下重写为DC约束DC规划，用SCP求解，统一了CPI、NPG、TRPO、AWR，并提出多步轴k的CCRL算法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 策略学习的核心优化问题（最大化期望回报）是非凸的，现有方法（NPG、TRPO、PPO、AWR）普遍回避直接求解，转而优化带信赖域约束的凸代理目标。作者希望揭示该问题潜在的可利用结构，从而超越代理近似。

Method: 在log密度比坐标y=log[π/π_n]下，将可由PDIS计算的精确每轮目标表示为DC约束DC（difference-of-convex）规划；用序列凸规划（SCP）求解该每轮子问题，并给出收敛性保证。该框架可沿可解释轴恢复CPI、NPG、TRPO、AWR为特例，并引入耦合相邻决策的多步轴k，形成多步Convex-Concave RL（CCRL）。

Result: CCRL在需要跨时间步传播信用的诊断型MDP上表现更好，优势随依赖长度增大；在经典控制任务上与调优的PPO相当；在真实、随机、中时长的医疗场景中收敛显著更快，达到相同近最优生存率时训练曲线AUC高出11.3%。

Conclusion: 策略优化的非凸问题在log密度比坐标下具有DC结构，可用SCP有效求解，从而统一多种现有算法并支持多步信用传播，在诊断任务与真实医疗场景中验证了其优势，桥接了DC优化与强化学习两个领域。

Abstract: Policy learning drives many of the most consequential and heavily-invested applications of reinforcement learning today. Yet the core optimization problem it rests on (maximizing expected return) is notoriously non-convex, even under a direct policy parameterization, and the field has largely responded by avoiding it: optimizing convex surrogate approximations of the return under trust-region constraints (NPG, TRPO, PPO, AWR). We show that this seemingly unstructured problem is not actually structureless. In log-density-ratio coordinates $y := \log[π/π_n]$, the exact per-iteration objective, computable via per-decision importance sampling (PDIS), is a difference-of-convex-constrained difference-of-convex (DC-constrained DC) program. This structure lets us move beyond surrogate approximations: it recovers CPI, NPG, TRPO, and AWR as special cases along interpretable axes, and it opens a multi-step axis $k$ that couples consecutive decisions. We solve the per-iteration program with sequential convex programming (SCP), the standard solver for difference-of-convex problems, and give convergence guarantees under mild conditions, bridging the difference-of-convex optimization and RL literatures. Empirically, multi-step Convex-Concave RL (CCRL) wins on diagnostic MDPs where credit must propagate across a horizon (its advantage growing with the dependency length), is competitive with a tuned PPO on classic control, and on a realistic, stochastic, mid-horizon healthcare domain converges markedly faster than tuned PPO to the same near-optimal survival, with an 11.3% higher area under the training curve.

</details>


### [284] [Spatial Induction Heads: In-Context Learning of Multidimensional Cellular Automata](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09124)
*Kimia Kazemian,Menghan Xu,John Thickstun,Sarah Dean*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"空间归纳头"（spatial induction heads）这一两层gather-and-match电路机制，解释Transformer如何在多维数据被展平为一维序列、空间邻居被打散的情况下克服路由难题，实现上下文学习。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有关于归纳头（induction heads）的理论大多假设与预测相关的上下文构成连续块。但在多维数据中，序列化会把空间邻居分散到token序列中相距很远的位置，破坏了该假设，从而带来"路由问题"（routing problem）。作者希望研究Transformer如何克服这一难题。

Method: 作者在多维随机与确定性元胞自动机（cellular automata）上研究该问题：每条轨迹由未知局部规则生成，并以展平序列形式呈现，且不包含显式的基于坐标的空间归纳偏置。为此提出空间归纳头——一种两层gather-and-match电路：第一层重构相关空间邻域，第二层将所得构型与更早出现的情况进行匹配。作者给出gather的两种显式实现，并构造出实现贝叶斯计数的matching层。

Result: 空间路由所需的位置维度仅取决于局部邻域和空间维度，而与网格体积或轨迹长度无关。端到端电路对随机规则可任意逼近贝叶斯后验，对确定性规则可精确预测。实验中，训练后的两层Transformer能在一维和二维设置下泛化到未见规则，确定性rollout近乎完美，随机规则下与贝叶斯最优预测器的KL散度小于0.005 nats。注意力模式与逐层探针与所预测的gather-and-match计算一致。

Conclusion: 本文为训练后Transformer中的"空间归纳"提供了机制性证据，将归纳头理论从一维连续上下文推广到多维展平序列场景，并揭示了空间路由所需位置维度与网格规模无关这一关键性质。

Abstract: Induction heads provide a mechanistic account of in-context learning in sequential data, but existing theory largely assumes that the context relevant to a prediction forms a contiguous block. In multidimensional data, serialization breaks this assumption by scattering spatial neighbors across distant positions in the token sequence. We study how transformers overcome this routing problem in multidimensional stochastic and deterministic cellular automata, where each trajectory is generated by an unknown local rule and presented as a flattened sequence without an explicit coordinate-based spatial inductive bias. We introduce spatial induction heads, two-layer gather-and-match circuits in which the first layer reconstructs the relevant spatial neighborhood and the second matches the resulting configuration against earlier occurrences. We give two explicit realizations of the gather and show that the positional dimension required for spatial routing depends only on the local neighborhood and spatial dimension, not on grid volume or trajectory horizon. We further construct a matching layer which implements Bayesian counting. The end-to-end circuit can approximate the Bayesian posterior arbitrarily closely for stochastic rules and can predict exactly for deterministic rules. Empirically, trained two-layer transformers generalize to unseen rules in one and two dimensional settings, achieving near-perfect deterministic rollouts and less than 0.005 nats KL from the Bayes-optimal predictor on stochastic rules. Attention patterns and layerwise probes align with the predicted gather-and-match computation, providing mechanistic evidence for spatial induction in trained transformers.

</details>


### [285] [LayerRoPE: Dynamic Depth-wise Magnitude & Angular Superposition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09179)
*Shikhar Srivastava,Christopher Kanan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文挑战"深度诅咒"主流观点，提出隐藏状态范数随深度增长实际上是一种涌现的深度位置编码，由归一化权重γ承载，并据此设计LayerRoPE，将逐层γ替换为共享向量与深度条件标量，在减少参数与近乎零额外FLOPs下显著提升深层Transformer的可扩展性与训练稳定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Transformer中隐藏状态范数随深度呈数量级增长，通常被视为"深度诅咒"这一病态现象而被抑制。作者持相反观点，认为这种增长可能是有意义的结构性信号，而非纯粹的病理，因此需要探究其本质来源与功能。

Method: 作者在来自9个家族、涵盖稠密、MoE与混合架构以及Pre-/Peri-/Post-Norm设计的16个预训练LLM中进行分析，发现该增长由残差流上唯一可学习的逐层增益——归一化权重γ承载：随深度增加，γ的幅度增大且方向旋转，共同编码层索引。基于此提出LayerRoPE，作为深度轴上RoPE的隐式类比，用单一共享向量加深度条件标量替换所有逐层γ向量，参数净减少且FLOPs变化小于0.02%。

Result: 在扩展至100B+ token的模型阶梯上，LayerRoPE一致优于Pre-Norm、Post-Norm、Peri-Norm与Layer-Norm Scaling，以少3.4倍算力达到Pre-Norm 1.3B模型的损失；是唯一在深度扩展至512层时展现强收敛且近乎单调改善的方法；将学习率敏感度改善3–10倍；可朴素迁移并无缝提升looped latent模型与视觉Transformer。

Conclusion: 对LayerRoPE学习到的调度进行检验，颠覆了主流前提：它并不收缩残差流，而是扩宽残差流，抑制每个模块的读取、放大其写入。作者由此提出，深度稳定性不应依靠抑制残差流，而应通过深度条件化调节其所馈入的计算模块来实现。

Abstract: As data propagates through a Transformer, the norm of its hidden states grows by orders of magnitude with depth, a phenomenon framed as 'curse of depth' and nearly universally treated as a pathology to be suppressed. We take the opposite view. Across 16 pre-trained LLMs from 9 families, spanning dense, mixture-of-experts and hybrid architectures and Pre-, Peri- and Post-Norm designs, we find that this growth reflects an emergent depth-positional encoding, carried by the only learned per-layer gain on the residual stream, the normalization weight $γ$: with depth, $γ$ grows in magnitude and rotates in direction, jointly encoding the layer index. We make this depth-conditioned encoding explicit with LayerRoPE, an implicit analog of RoPE along the depth axis, which replaces all layerwise $γ$ vectors with a single shared vector and depth-conditioned scalars, at a net reduction in parameters and $<0.02\%$ change in FLOPs. Across a model ladder scaled up to $100$B+ tokens, LayerRoPE consistently outperforms Pre-, Post- and Peri-Norm and Layer-Norm Scaling, reaching Pre-Norm's 1.3B loss with $3.4\times$ less compute; LayerRoPE is the only approach that shows strong convergence and improves near monotonically as depth scales to 512 layers. It improves learning-rate sensitivity by $3$-$10\times$, and transfers naively to and consistently improves looped latent models and Vision Transformers. Inspecting its learned schedule inverts the prevailing premise: LayerRoPE does not shrink the residual stream but widens it, damping what each block reads while amplifying what it writes. Depth stability, our results suggest, calls not for suppressing the residual stream, but for depth-conditioned regulation of the computational blocks it feeds.

</details>


### [286] [Patient, Place, Prior (P$^3$): What Counts as Personalization in Medical World Models?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09194)
*Xingrui Gu,Hanxue Gu,Yuxiang Zhang,Yang Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 P³ 审计框架与 Cancer JEPA 模型，用于区分纵向影像预测中"输入被使用"与"具备患者特异性预测价值"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 纵向模型能预测患者影像状态演变，但预测准确性本身无法说明该预测是否真正由患者的观测轨迹驱动。群体平均预测可能有实用价值，却不足以支撑"患者特异性世界模型"的主张，因此需要一个能区分输入使用与患者特异性预测价值的审计方法。

Method: 提出 Patient, Place, Prior (P³) 审计：检验预测是否受益于患者纵向影像历史（Patient）、是否受益于患者匹配的外部空间支持（Place）、以及在匹配支持与上下文下是否优于群体平均预测（Prior）。同时提出 Cancer JEPA，一步式预测新辅助治疗期间乳腺 DCE-MRI 冻结表征的模型；在患者条件化的低复杂度降秩回归基线上，增加受病灶约束的神经校正，并以基于遮挡的潜在目标训练。该分解方式支持对冻结模型进行事后 P³ 审计。

Result: 在先前用于开发的验证队列中，当神经校正接收患者自身历史而非其他患者历史、以及患者匹配的病灶占据图而非替代图时，预测误差更低。但比较患者历史计算的校正与群体平均神经校正的描述性 95% 区间包含零。

Conclusion: P³ 将输入使用与患者特异性预测价值（超越群体水平模式）的证据相分离。

Abstract: Longitudinal models forecast how a patient's imaging state evolves, but accuracy does not show whether the patient's observed trajectory drives the prediction. A population-average forecast may be useful but cannot establish a patient-specific world-model claim. We introduce Patient, Place, Prior (P$^3$), an audit asking whether a forecast benefits from the patient's longitudinal imaging history (Patient), benefits from patient-matched externally supplied spatial support (Place), and gains predictive value beyond a population-average prediction under matched support and context (Prior). We also propose Cancer JEPA, a one-step model that forecasts frozen representations of future breast dynamic contrast-enhanced MRI examinations during neoadjuvant therapy. It adds a lesion-constrained neural correction, trained with an occlusion-based latent objective, to a patient-conditioned low-complexity reduced-rank regression baseline. This factorization permits a post-hoc P$^3$ audit of the frozen model. In a validation cohort previously used in development, forecast error is lower when the neural correction receives the patient's history rather than another patient's and patient-matched lesion occupancy maps rather than substituted maps. However, the descriptive 95% interval comparing the correction computed from patient history with the population-average neural correction includes zero. P$^3$ thus separates input use from evidence of patient-specific predictive value beyond a population-level pattern.

</details>


### [287] [CurveTQ: Rotation-Free Trellis Quantization of LLM Weights via Curvature-Weighted Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09212)
*Guanhua Ding,Zi Wang,Ruichao Li,Jack Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出将Hessian的LDL分解对角权重引入Viterbi分支度量，构建无需旋转的trellis量化器CurveTQ，在2-bit下下游精度超过QTIP与Proteus。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM二值/两比特量化器（QTIP、Proteus）先对权重矩阵做随机正交旋转并在每步解码时撤销，再以格或网格码搜索编码，Hessian仅通过编码块间的误差反馈进入，导致部分Hessian信息未被利用；同时旋转带来解码开销。

Method: 分析表明误差反馈把损失变为各坐标舍入误差的加权和，权重正是Hessian的LDL分解对角（现有量化器算出但未使用）。将这些权重放入Viterbi分支度量使搜索在块内遵循曲率；指出在原始基上加权与旋转是替代关系。构建CurveTQ：无旋转的trellis编解码器，用因子化scale场处理幅度与边缘形状，用闭式分位表，并为每个编码块存储起始状态以适配误差反馈带来的残差。
