Result: 在三个模型上，加权原始基搜索与全维随机Hadamard旋转相差约1个下游精度点，旋转后再加权收益很小。2-bit下CurveTQ在三个4-8B Instruct模型上平均下游精度比QTIP和Proteus高1-3点，即使给二者加入该起始状态后仍如此；起始状态本身可提升基线1-3点。在35B混合专家模型上也领先，为首个trellis编码在该类模型上的结果。无需撤销旋转，解码器在全部测试batch size与位宽下最快。

Conclusion: 块内曲率加权与旋转可相互替代，把Hessian对角权重用于Viterbi搜索即可免去旋转；CurveTQ在精度与解码速度上均优于现有两比特量化器，并首次在35B MoE模型上实现trellis编码量化。

Abstract: The best two-bit weight quantizers for large language models, such as QTIP and Proteus, rotate each weight matrix by a random orthogonal transform, which must be undone at every decoding step, then encode it with a trellis or lattice code under a Euclidean search; the layer Hessian enters only through error feedback between coding blocks. We show that this leaves part of the Hessian unused. Error feedback turns the loss into a weighted sum of per-coordinate rounding errors whose weights, the diagonal of the Hessian's LDL factorization, existing quantizers compute but never read. We put these weights into the Viterbi branch metric, so the search follows the curvature within each coding block. This also explains the rotation: it removes this within-block variation, so weighting in the native basis and rotating are substitutes. On three models the weighted native search matches a full-dimension randomized Hadamard to within about one point of downstream accuracy, and weighting after the rotation gains little. Around this search we build CurveTQ, a trellis codec with no rotation, which handles the weights' amplitude and marginal shape with a factored scale field and a closed-form quantile table, and stores a start state per coding block so the trellis can adapt to the residual that error feedback carries into it. At two bits CurveTQ is 1-3 points higher in mean downstream accuracy than QTIP and Proteus on three 4-8B Instruct models, even after both are given our start state, which alone lifts either baseline by 1-3 points. It also leads on a 35B mixture of experts, to our knowledge the first trellis-coded result on such a model. With no rotation to undo, our decoder is the fastest of the three at all tested batch sizes and bit widths.

</details>


### [288] [Conditional Accuracy Profiles: Diagnosing LLM Judges across Deployment Conditions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09229)
*Wenqi Li,Bin Liu,Mindi Ruan,Chuanbo Hu,Minglei Yin,Xin Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出条件准确率剖析（CAP）诊断框架，将LLM评判者的成对准确率分解为八种条件，揭示聚合准确率所掩盖的性能差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前LLM-as-judge的评价常被单一准确率数字概括，这种聚合视角掩盖了评判者在不同部署条件下成功或失败的情形，无法支撑评判者的选择决策。

Method: CAP是一个事后诊断框架，将成对LLM评判准确率分解为八种条件，归入内容敏感性、鲁棒性、理由质量三类。框架与基准无关，可通过三种方式应用：基准自带标注时直接应用；通过任务子集代理近似应用；通过受控增强生成扰动对。作者在七个LLM评判者、六个成对评判基准上实例化CAP，并构建了支持全部八种条件的受控测试床judgerEva-Standard。

Result: 在judgerEva的评判者无关Hard-Constructed子集上，对遗漏限定条件最敏感的两个评判者在其七者中总体准确率排名处于后三位，说明遗漏敏感性无法由聚合准确率预测。跨基准来看，Position Robustness（位置鲁棒性）的排名稳定性最强（平均Spearman ρ̄=0.87），但其自身在JudgeBench-Pro对抗压力下表现脆弱，在共有条件中平均准确率下降幅度最大，且主导退化渠道因评判者而异。

Conclusion: 条件级剖析比聚合准确率为选择LLM评判者提供了更具可操作性的依据。

Abstract: LLM-as-judge is now a standard tool for scalable evaluation, but judge performance is still often summarized by a single accuracy number. This aggregate view hides the deployment conditions under which a judge succeeds or fails. We introduce \textbf{Conditional Accuracy Profiling} (CAP), a post-hoc diagnostic framework that decomposes pairwise LLM-judge accuracy into eight conditions organized into content sensitivity, robustness, and rationale quality. CAP is benchmark-agnostic: it can be applied directly when a benchmark provides the required annotations, approximately through task-subset proxies, or through controlled augmentation when perturbation pairs can be generated. We instantiate CAP on seven LLM judges across six pairwise judging benchmarks, including \textsc{judgerEva-Standard}, a controlled testbed we created to support all eight conditions. CAP exposes profile differences hidden by aggregate accuracy: on \textsc{judgerEva}'s judge-independent Hard-Constructed subset, the two judges most sensitive to omitted qualifications rank in the bottom three of seven by overall accuracy, so omission sensitivity is not predicted by aggregate accuracy. Across benchmarks, Position Robustness shows the strongest rank stability (mean Spearman $\barρ{=}0.87$) but is itself fragile under JudgeBench-Pro adversarial stress, showing the largest mean accuracy drop among the shared conditions, though the dominant degradation channel varies by judge. Condition-level profiles provide a more actionable basis than aggregate accuracy for selecting LLM judges.

</details>


### [289] [Evaluating Trajectory Features for Routing Final-Layer Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09272)
*Yupeng Yao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 在两种冻结基座模型上，六项预设的轨迹特征增益假设经多重校正后均未获支持；参数匹配的固定投影路由器反而优于轨迹路由器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 注意力路由需要一个能预测当前前缀上注意力价值的信号。作者希望检验：隐状态外推误差、曲率与误差变化这三类轨迹摘要，能否在不确定性、一步位移、位置与状态投影之外提供增量预测价值。

Method: 在冻结的 SmolLM3-3B-Base 与 Qwen3.5-4B-Base 上，对最终注意力层进行成对执行，得到带符号的下一 token 损失差作为监督信号；训练效用监督路由器，并在 100 本留出 PG-19 书籍上以相同的因果式 20% 调用配额评测；同时设置参数匹配的固定投影对照，并做六项预设比较与家族错误率校正，辅以消融、特征位置与评分视野的敏感性分析、长视野阈值漂移检验，以及实际选中查询执行与缓存续写延迟测量。

Result: 六项预设比较经家族错误率校正后均无正增益。在 Qwen3.5 中，参数匹配的固定投影对照相对轨迹路由器将 NLL 降低 0.00356 nats/token（95% 区间 0.00218–0.00487）。次要结果依赖被移除的操作、特征位置与评分视野；冻结阈值在更长视野下显著漂移。实际选中查询执行在长序列上带来小幅延迟下降，但 NLL 上升；学习到的路由器在缓存续写时反而更慢。

Conclusion: 该研究界定了轨迹类摘要在注意力路由中的增量价值上限，并强调了需将分配质量与实测推理收益区分开来：预测信号更准并不等于端到端更快。

Abstract: Attention routing requires a signal that predicts the value of attention on the current prefix. We evaluate whether hidden-state extrapolation error, curvature and error change improve this prediction beyond uncertainty, one-step displacement, position and state projections. Paired executions of the final attention layer supply signed next-token loss differences in frozen SmolLM3-3B-Base and Qwen3.5-4B-Base checkpoints. Utility-supervised routers are tested on 100 held-out PG-19 books at an identical causal 20 percent invocation quota. None of six prespecified comparisons shows a positive gain after familywise correction. In Qwen3.5, a parameter-matched fixed-projection control lowers NLL by 0.00356 nats/token relative to the trajectory router (95 percent interval 0.00218 to 0.00487). Secondary results depend on the operation removed, feature location and scoring horizon; frozen thresholds also drift substantially at longer horizons. Actual selected-query execution yields small long-sequence latency reductions with increased NLL, while learned routers remain slower during cached continuation. The study identifies limits on the incremental value of these trajectory summaries and separates allocation quality from measured inference benefit.

</details>


### [290] [Node-level Graph Neural Architecture Search Framework](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09297)
*Lintao Yanga,Sirui Lia,Yaqing Wang,Pietro Liò,Xu Shen,Baisong Liu,Chengbin Peng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出节点级图神经架构搜索算法 N-GNAS，可为不同节点子集自动选择合适网络架构，并引入对比学习损失，在八个数据集的节点与图分类任务上优于现有 GNAS 方法与人工设计 GNN。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统 GNN 与架构搜索方法对所有节点统一施加相同的卷积操作，忽视了节点在结构与特征上的差异性，导致模型性能下降，且随层数增加易出现过平滑问题。

Method: 提出节点级图神经架构搜索（N-GNAS）算法，在更新节点特征时为每个节点子集自动选择合适的网络架构；同时引入对比学习损失，用以拉开不同类别样本特征之间的距离、拉近同类样本特征。

Result: 在八个数据集的节点分类与图分类任务上，该方法优于当前领先的 GNAS 技术与传统人工设计的 GNN；例如在 CiteSeer 数据集上达到 78.26% 的准确率。

Conclusion: 节点级架构搜索能够有效缓解统一卷积带来的性能损失与过平滑问题，结合对比学习可进一步提升分类性能，证明细粒度架构搜索在非欧几里得数据处理中的有效性。

Abstract: In recent years, Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) and architecture search frameworks have gained extensive application in non-Euclidean data processing, attributable to their superior capacity in managing unstructured data. Nevertheless, traditional approaches typically apply uniform convolution operations to all nodes, regardless of their varying structural and feature characteristics, which can undermine model performance and result in over-smoothing issues as the number of layers increases. To overcome this limitation, in this work, we propose a \textbf{N}ode-Level \textbf{G}raph \textbf{N}eural \textbf{A}rchitecture \textbf{S}earch (N-GNAS) algorithm. It can automatically choose an appropriate network architecture for each subset of nodes when updating node features. N-GNAS also introduces a contrastive learning loss to separate sample features from different categories and vice versa. In experiments conducted on eight datasets for node and graph classification, our methodology outperforms current leading GNAS techniques and traditional human-designed GNNs. For example, it achieves an accuracy rate of 78.26\% on the CiteSeer dataset.

</details>


### [291] [Denoising Blocks, Not Tokens: Efficient Compressed Continuous Diffusion with Branching Token Realization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09311)
*Xinsong Feng,Peng Du,Zhizhuo Yang,Daniel M. Bikel,Jiayun Wang,Haipeng Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 Branching Latent Diffusion (BLD)，将扩散语言模型的生成从 token 级状态转移到压缩的连续隐序列上：把 1024-token 序列压缩为 64 个 block latent（16× 压缩），并用并行的局部自回归分支解码每个 latent。相比同规模 ELF-L 基线，生成 FLOPs 降低 80× 以上、吞吐提升 6× 以上；相比 AR 基线吞吐提升 6× 以上、延迟降低 4× 以上，同时保持有竞争力的局部流畅度与多样性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散语言模型（DLM）通过迭代并行精炼生成文本，有潜力获得高于自回归（AR）解码的吞吐量。但现有 DLM 大多为每个 token 维护一个生成状态，导致每一步去噪都要处理与输出等长的状态序列，限制了并行生成的吞吐收益。连续型 DLM 提供了额外自由度：单个连续状态可表示多个 token，使扩散能在更短的隐序列上进行，从而释放吞吐潜力。

Method: BLD 利用连续隐状态的表达能力，将 1024-token 序列压缩为仅 64 个 block latent（16× 缩减），在短隐序列上执行扩散。解码端采用 branching token realization：每个 latent 由一个局部 AR 分支解码，所有分支并行运行。由于强压缩使 latent 的联合生成困难，BLD 按组生成 latent，每组以先前已生成的 latent 为条件进行条件生成。

Result: 在同一 GPU 上的端到端评测中，相比同规模 ELF-L 基线，BLD 生成 FLOPs 降低 80× 以上，吞吐量提升 6× 以上；相比 AR 基线，吞吐量提升 6× 以上，延迟降低 4× 以上。尽管进行了强压缩，BLD 仍保持有竞争力的局部流畅度和多样性，但长程连贯性仍具挑战。

Conclusion: BLD 表明，将扩散从 token 级状态迁移到压缩的隐序列，可显著提升长序列生成的效率，在 FLOPs、吞吐和延迟上均大幅优于强基线，为高效扩散语言建模提供了可行方向，长程连贯性为核心待解问题。

Abstract: Diffusion language models (DLMs) generate text through iterative parallel refinement, offering the potential for higher throughput than autoregressive (AR) decoding. However, most DLMs still maintain one generative state per token, so every denoising step processes a state sequence as long as the output sequence, limiting the throughput gains from parallel generation. Continuous DLMs provide an additional degree of freedom: a single continuous state can represent multiple tokens, allowing diffusion to operate on a much shorter latent sequence. We introduce \emph{Branching Latent Diffusion (BLD)}, which exploits this flexibility by compressing a 1024-token sequence into only 64 block latents, a $16\times$ reduction. BLD combines latent compression with \emph{branching token realization}, where each latent is decoded by a local AR branch and all branches run in parallel. Because strong compression makes joint latent generation difficult, BLD generates the latents in groups, conditioning each group on previously generated latents. In end-to-end evaluation on the same GPU, BLD reduces generation FLOPs by more than $80\times$ and increases throughput by more than $6\times$ relative to the similarly sized ELF-L baseline. Compared with the AR baseline, BLD achieves more than $6\times$ higher throughput and more than $4\times$ lower latency. Despite the compression, BLD maintains competitive local fluency and diversity, although long-range coherence remains challenging. Overall, BLD shows that moving diffusion from token-level states to compressed latent sequences can substantially improve the efficiency of long-sequence generation.

</details>


### [292] [Shared Low-rank Basis Factorization for Data-free Mixture-of-Experts Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09342)
*Tianxiao Cao,Jiahe Shao,Yuning Qiu,Kyohei Atarashi,Hisashi Kashima,Qibin Zhao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文分析三种MoE压缩范式，证明剪枝与合并存在结构误差，提出免数据的权重重建方法SLBF，在16B至122B参数的五种MoE架构上均超越现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MoE大模型通过稀疏路由解耦容量与计算，但参数量庞大带来存储与推理服务挑战，需要有效的压缩方法；现有压缩范式缺乏系统的理论分析与对比。

Method: 系统分析专家剪枝、专家合并与权重重建三类压缩范式，并推导结构误差界；据此提出共享低秩基分解（SLBF）：使用专家间共享的秩-k基进行免数据权重重建，实现更充分的跨专家共享、更快收敛与更低重建误差；并通过事后规范固定（gauge fixing）在不损失表示能力的前提下去除冗余参数。

Result: 理论分析表明剪枝与合并会产生与路由及专家异质性相关的非消失误差，而权重重建因保留专家结构与路由可避免该结构代价；实验在涵盖16B至122B参数的五种MoE架构上，SLBF一致优于三类压缩范式中的现有方法。

Conclusion: 权重重建在结构上优于剪枝与合并，SLBF作为免数据的共享低秩基分解方法，兼具理论优势与跨架构的实证有效性，是MoE压缩的有效方案。

Abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) large language models decouple capacity from compute through sparse routing, but their large parameter count creates storage and serving challenges. We analyze three MoE compression families: expert pruning, expert merging, and weight reconstruction, and derive structural error bounds showing that pruning and merging can incur non-vanishing errors tied to routing and expert heterogeneity. In contrast, weight reconstruction avoids these structural costs by preserving expert structure and routing. Motivated by the analysis, we propose Shared Low-rank Basis Factorization (SLBF), a data-free weight reconstruction method that uses rank-$k$ bases shared among experts, enabling richer cross-expert sharing, faster convergence, and lower reconstruction error. A post-hoc gauge fixing removes redundant parameters at no representational cost. Across five MoE architectures spanning 16B to 122B parameters, SLBF consistently outperforms methods from all three compression families.

</details>


### [293] [GeoPrior-Mamba: Structured Process Priors with Mamba for Fine-Resolution XCO2 Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09456)
*Zhao Meng,Yinan Cai,Siru Zhong,Juepeng Zheng,Haohuan Fu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出GeoPrior-Mamba框架，借助语言模型离线构建结构化过程先验表，并通过知识适配器注入多方向Mamba骨干网络，实现稀疏卫星观测下高分辨率XCO2场重建。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 稀疏卫星观测难以约束XCO2空间结构，现有学习方法将环境协变量视为普通数值输入，需从稀疏监督中学习异质的源汇关系，先验知识利用不足。

Method: 用语言模型在训练前将生物圈吸收、生态系统呼吸和人为排放的相对过程知识组织为确定性先验表；结合地理、生态、排放和季节信息进行空间实例化；通过轻量级知识适配器自适应注入多方向Mamba重建骨干。语言模型不参与数值预测。

Result: 基于2018-2020年OCO-2观测，留出观测上RMSE为0.81 ppm、R2为0.93；相比CAMS背景插值RMSE降低48.2%，相比Trans-XCO2在同一评估协议下降低3.1%；消融显示知识先验分支有可测贡献且收敛显著快于无知识Mamba骨干；TCCON独立评估支持重建场与地基柱CO2观测的一致性。

Conclusion: 当全球一致的过程-响应表征难以直接获取时，语言模型可作为构建结构化过程先验的实用机制，且始终位于数值预测循环之外。

Abstract: Reconstructing fine-resolution column-averaged dry-air CO2 (XCO2) fields from sparse satellite observations requires models to infer spatial structure that is only weakly constrained by direct measurements. Existing learning-based methods typically treat environmental covariates as ordinary numerical inputs and must therefore learn heterogeneous source-sink relationships largely from sparse supervision. We introduce GeoPrior-Mamba, a multi-directional Mamba framework augmented with offline language-model-induced structured process priors. Rather than using a language model to predict XCO2, we use it before training to organize relative process knowledge for biospheric uptake, ecosystem respiration, and anthropogenic emissions into deterministic prior tables. These priors are spatially instantiated using geographic, ecological, emission-related, and seasonal information and are adaptively injected into the reconstruction backbone through a lightweight knowledge adapter. Using OCO-2 observations from 2018-2020, GeoPrior-Mamba achieves an RMSE of 0.81 ppm and an R2 of 0.93 on held-out observations, reducing RMSE by 48.2% relative to CAMS background interpolation and by 3.1% relative to Trans-XCO2 under the same evaluation protocol. Ablation experiments show a measurable contribution from the knowledge-prior branch and substantially faster convergence than the knowledge-free Mamba backbone. Independent TCCON evaluation further supports the consistency of the reconstructed fields with ground-based column CO2 measurements. These results suggest that language models can provide a practical mechanism for constructing structured process priors when globally consistent process-response representations are difficult to obtain directly, while remaining outside the numerical prediction loop.

</details>


### [294] [MORA: Modeling Observed Changes for Drift-Robust Time-Series Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09473)
*Xudong Mou,Tiejun Wang,Rui Wang,Hui Wang,Pin Liu,Tianyu Wo,Xudong Liu,Renyu Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出MORA，一个漂移鲁棒的时序异常检测框架，通过从短期与长期两个视图重建同一局部目标，并利用重建差距进行数据依赖的保守修正，从而区分分布漂移与真实异常。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 非平稳环境下，分布漂移与真实异常会产生相似的局部变化，难以判别偏差究竟是异常还是上下文演化。现有方法通过适应检测到的漂移或学习漂移不敏感表征来应对，但均未解决这一歧义。

Method: 作者将该问题定义为"时序变化消歧"，并提出MORA框架：从配对的短期与长期视图重建同一局部目标，用重建差距度量局部偏差的上下文支持度，并通过数据依赖的修正机制保守地调整主局部异常分数；上下文仅在改善同一目标重建时才能降低分数。该方法无需漂移标注，也不需在线自适应。

Result: 在四个时序异常检测基准上的实验表明，MORA对非平稳性具有强鲁棒性，同时保持对真实异常的敏感性。

Conclusion: MORA通过双视图重建与保守修正有效缓解了漂移与异常混淆问题，无需标注或在线适配即可在非平稳设置下实现鲁棒且灵敏的异常检测。

Abstract: Time-series anomaly detection (TSAD) identifies deviations from patterns learned from historical data. In non-stationary settings, distribution drift and true anomalies can cause similar local changes, making it difficult to tell whether a deviation reflects abnormality or evolving context. Existing methods typically adapt to detected shifts or learn drift-insensitive representations, but do not resolve this ambiguity. We define this problem as \emph{temporal change disambiguation}: determining whether a local deviation is explained by broader temporal evolution. We introduce MORA, a drift-robust TSAD framework that reconstructs the same local target from paired short- and long-term views. The reconstruction gap measures contextual support for a local deviation, and a data-dependent correction mechanism conservatively adjusts the primary local anomaly score. Context can only reduce the score when it improves reconstruction of the same target. MORA needs neither drift annotations nor online adaptation. Experiments on four TSAD benchmarks show strong robustness to non-stationarity while preserving sensitivity to genuine anomalies.

</details>


### [295] [Safe on Average, Unsafe in the Tail: When Is the Episodic-Cost Tail Controllable?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09508)
*Samuel Tetteh,Cody Fleming*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文指出主流安全强化学习仅约束期望回合成本、评估只报告平均回合成本，因而无法刻画最差回合的安全性；作者用CVaR₀.₁（最差10%回合的平均成本）度量回合成本尾部，定义"尾部安全"，并在Safety-Gymnasium导航任务上识别均值安全但尾部不安全的策略，进而研究在保持回报的前提下控制尾部违规的可行性与约束族设计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有安全强化学习大多对期望回合成本施加约束，标准评估也只报告平均回合成本，缺乏对成本在回合间分布（尤其是最差回合）的刻画。满足平均成本约束的策略仍可能在某些极端回合中不安全，而平均成本报告既无法识别这种尾部违规，也无法说明能否在不牺牲回报的前提下将其控制在预算内。因此需要引入尾部风险度量来重新审视安全策略评估与约束设计。

Method: 采用CVaR₀.₁（最差10%回合的平均成本）作为回合成本尾部度量，将CVaR₀.₁在安全预算内的策略定义为"尾部安全"。首先在Safety-Gymnasium的三个导航任务上评估五种标准算法，识别均值安全但尾部不安全的策略；随后在密集危险导航任务上考察四种约束族，并在四个导航与四个运动任务上评估尾部控制效果。

Result: 在Safety-Gymnasium三个导航任务上，五种标准算法中存在满足平均成本约束却在尾部（CVaR₀.₁）违反安全预算的策略；在密集危险导航中比较了四种约束族对尾部的控制表现，并在四个导航与四个运动任务上验证了尾部控制的可评估性。

Conclusion: 平均回合成本评估不足以保障安全强化学习的安全性，需以尾部风险指标（如CVaR₀.₁）补充评估并据此设计约束；尾部违规在标准算法中普遍存在，且可通过合适的约束族在一定程度上加以控制，从而在不显著损失回报的情况下提升最差回合的安全性。

Abstract: Safe reinforcement learning seeks policies that maximize return while satisfying constraints on cumulative cost. Most methods impose these constraints on expected episodic cost. Consequently, standard evaluations report mean episodic cost without characterizing how cost is distributed across episodes. A policy that satisfies the mean-cost criterion may therefore remain unsafe in its worst episodes. Mean-cost reporting neither identifies this tail violation nor shows whether it can be brought within budget while preserving return. In this work, we measure the episodic-cost tail using $\mathrm{CVaR}_{0.1}$, the average cost of the worst $10\%$ of episodes. We classify a policy as tail-safe when $\mathrm{CVaR}_{0.1}$ is within the safety budget. This allows us first to identify policies that are safe on average but unsafe in the tail and then to study whether their tail violations can be controlled while preserving return. To identify tail-unsafe policies, we evaluate five standard algorithms on three Safety-Gymnasium navigation tasks. We then examine four constraint families on dense-hazard navigation and assess tail control across four navigation and four locomotion tasks.

</details>


### [296] [Align Before You Combine: Reference Space Calibration for Supervision Without Ground Truth](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09525)
*Jackson Eshbaugh,Jorge Silveyra*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种"校准优先"框架，在无真实标签、无共享标注空间的条件下生成监督分数，性能总体优于未校准平均与最佳单一评分器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在缺乏真实标签（ground-truth labels）与共享标注空间（shared annotation space）的场景下，多个子集专属评分器（subset-specific scorers）的输出彼此不可比，无法直接融合，因此需要一个统一的尺度来对齐异构评分器输出。

Method: 采用校准优先（calibration-first）框架：先用有序的校准特征（ordered calibration features）构建一个合成的序数参考空间（synthetic ordinal reference space），该空间表征潜在概念（latent concept）；在融合前将各子集专属评分器对齐到该共同尺度。由于校准使用参考空间而非训练样本，该流程独立于训练集的经验分布。

Result: 在三个基准数据集上，该框架持续优于未校准平均（uncalibrated averaging），且主要指标点估计高于最佳单一评分器。与依赖样本的基线相比，性能差异随领域而变化：Ames Housing 绝对差异小于 0.02，Breast Cancer Wisconsin 与 Wine Quality 小于 0.01。经 Bonferroni 校正后，Ames Housing 的三个比较均保持显著，Breast Cancer Wisconsin 有一个比较显著。此外，每个特征使用更少校准层级即可逼近高分辨率结果，且计算成本显著降低。

Conclusion: 该框架是在既无真实标签又无共享标注空间时构建监督分数的可行方案；并具有通过降低校准分辨率来控制计算成本的实用灵活性。

Abstract: We introduce a calibration-first framework that produces supervision scores without access to ground-truth labels or a shared annotation space. Our framework aligns subset-specific scorers using a synthetic ordinal reference space before fusion. This reference space is constructed from ordered calibration features that represent the latent concept, providing a common scale on which otherwise incomparable scorer outputs can be aligned. Because our calibration procedure uses the reference space rather than training samples, it is independent of the training set's empirical distribution. Across three benchmark datasets, our framework consistently outperforms uncalibrated averaging and achieves higher primary-metric point estimates on the evaluation metrics than the best individual scorer. Performance relative to sample-dependent baselines varies by domain, with absolute differences below 0.02 on Ames Housing and below 0.01 on Breast Cancer Wisconsin and Wine Quality. After Bonferroni correction, differences remain significant for all three comparisons on Ames Housing and one on Breast Cancer Wisconsin. Additionally, we show that using fewer calibration levels per feature can closely approximate higher-resolution results at substantially lower computational cost. Together, these results support our framework as a viable approach to construct supervision scores when neither ground-truth labels nor a shared annotation space is available.

</details>


### [297] [Collaborative Reasoning Distillation via Cross-Feedback and Coherent Curation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09587)
*Taehoon Kim,Seunggeun Cho,Dongsu Han*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出协作推理蒸馏（CRD）框架，通过跨反馈、细粒度步骤评估和连贯性拼接，将推理能力蒸馏到小模型，CRD-4B 以极少数据达到领先性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前提升大语言模型推理能力的方法或需巨大算力，或难以有效将推理蒸馏到小模型；且标准蒸馏依赖结果奖励，无法区分合理推理与侥幸猜对。

Method: CRD 三项创新：(1) 交互式跨反馈，教师互相批判推理；(2) 细粒度逐步质量评估，独立于最终答案判断逻辑有效性；(3) 连贯性感知步骤拼接，综合互补优势。学生模型通过带预算约束的 Reasoning Quality Optimization (RQO) 训练。

Result: CRD-4B 在 MATH-500 上达 97.3%，AIME'25 达 70.3%，超越基线，仅用 50K 训练样本，比同类模型数据集小至多 12 倍。

Conclusion: CRD 框架在紧凑模型中有效提升推理能力，并以更高的数据效率超越现有方法。

Abstract: Reasoning capabilities are critical for advancing Large Language Models, yet current approaches either require massive computational budgets or struggle to effectively distill reasoning to smaller models. Standard distillation methods rely on outcome-based rewards, failing to distinguish between sound reasoning and lucky guesses. We propose Collaborative Reasoning Distillation (CRD), a framework that enhances reasoning in compact models through three innovations: (1) interactive cross-feedback where teachers iteratively critique each other's reasoning, (2) fine-grained step-wise quality assessment capturing logical validity independent of final answers, and (3) coherence-aware step stitching that synthesizes complementary strengths. Students are trained via Reasoning Quality Optimization (RQO) with budget constraints. Our model, CRD-4B, achieves 97.3% on MATH-500 and 70.3% on AIME'25, surpassing baselines while using only 50K training examples, up to 12 times smaller than the datasets of comparable models.

</details>


### [298] [Coding-Agent Benchmarks Should Match Their Users' Task Flows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09633)
*Igor Slinko,Yaroslav Golubev,Sergey Titov*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文基于4,782条真实IDE中软件工程师与编码agent的会话（Production Sessions），发现真实交互中的长会话与基于issue的基准任务在任务类型多样性和类型切换上显著不同，且不同公开交互语料的任务流分布差异明显，因此不存在通用的"真实"交互分布。作者提出SWE-TaskFlow方法，可将任意issue-derived基准改造成目标任务流，并给出TaskFlow Alignment Score（TFAS）。在700条SWE-Bench Pro任务上的试验表明，将任务拆分为多步顺序求解会使agent成本约翻倍，但解决率无稳定变化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有编码agent评测追求"真实"，但通常以issue-derived基准任务作为交互分布，未必反映真实工程实践。作者希望刻画真实生产环境中的交互特征，并指出交互协议本身是评测中重要但被忽视的维度，需要可校准到特定目标用例的评测方式。

Method: 收集4,782条JetBrains IDE中真实软件工程师的agent会话（Production Sessions），并以至少含3条用户消息的长会话（占33%）为研究对象；对比真实会话与issue-derived基准任务在任务类型构成和类型切换上的差异，并分析三个公开交互语料的长会话Task Flow（会话长度、任务类型及类型间转移的分布）。提出SWE-TaskFlow：在保留已验证任务与测试的前提下，通过prompt splitting与可验证的仓库QA将交互引导至目标Task Flow，并使用TaskFlow Alignment Score（TFAS）在生成的轨迹中进行选择。

Result: 真实长会话的请求涵盖项目代码问答、规划、评审、重构、执行等多种任务类型，且用户会在会话中切换任务类型；三个公开交互语料的长会话Task Flow彼此差异显著，说明不存在单一通用的真实交互分布。在700条SWE-Bench Pro任务的试点中，将任务拆分为多步顺序求解使agent成本约增加一倍，而resolve rate并无稳定变化。

Conclusion: 基准评测应明确其目标用例，并依据该用例的实测交互分布进行校准，而非假定某种交互分布具有普适真实性。交互协议本身是编码agent评测的重要维度；SWE-TaskFlow提供了一种在保留任务与测试有效性的同时，将基准交互对齐到目标Task Flow的可操作方案。

Abstract: The evaluation of coding agents generally strives to be as realistic as possible. In our study, we collect 4,782 agent sessions of real software engineers in JetBrains IDEs, which we call Production Sessions. Since our subject is interactive agents, we study the sessions with at least three user messages (33% of the sample). These long sessions differ from issue-derived benchmark tasks in two ways: (i) user requests span a far wider mix of task types - questions about the project's code, planning, review, refactoring, execution - and (ii) users switch between types throughout a session. Long-session samples from three public interaction corpora exhibit markedly different Task Flows (the distributions of session lengths, task types, and type-to-type transitions), so no single interaction distribution is universally realistic: benchmarks should name a target use case and calibrate to measurements from it. We present SWE-TaskFlow, an approach for transforming any issue-derived benchmark: it preserves the verified tasks and tests while steering the interaction toward a target Task Flow through prompt splitting and verifiable repository QA, with a TaskFlow Alignment Score (TFAS) for selecting among generated trajectories. In a pilot on 700 SWE-Bench Pro tasks, solving the task sequentially in several steps approximately doubles agent cost without a stable change in resolve rate: the interaction protocol itself is an important dimension of evaluation.

</details>


### [299] [CERO: Where and When to Allocate Rollouts for RL Post-Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09679)
*Yiming Zong,Yige Wang,Xing Hu,Jiashuo Jiang,Zuo-Jun Max Shen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究如何在整体训练周期内协调有限的 rollout 预算，提出基于凹代理效用的在线原始-对偶调度器 CERO，自适应决定提示选择、复访频率与每轮组数；在五个数学推理基准、三个骨干上取得最高 avg@16 宏平均。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 group-relative 强化学习中的自适应 rollout 方法通常将固定的每次更新预算分配到各个 prompt 上，缺乏对有限 rollout 预算在整个训练周期上的统筹协调，导致预算分配效率不足。

Method: 将问题建模为累积 prompt 曝光的凹代理效用，提出在线原始-对偶调度器 CERO，用于 prompt 准入与预算节流。每个被准入 prompt 获得固定规模响应组，CERO 自适应选择 prompt、控制跨轮复访频率及每轮生成组数。采用紧凑的 Fenchel 表示对累积曝光的依赖进行线性化，并用投影在线梯度下降，结合奖励变化反馈与预算偏差，更新 prompt 特定的支撑斜率与共享预算价格。

Result: 建立了代理分配目标相对于固定速率和同路径时变基准的路径级保证，并给出代理差异与速率变化的显式项。在匹配训练响应预算下，CERO 在三个骨干、五个数学推理基准上均取得最高 avg@16 宏平均。机制分析将 CERO 的 prompt 选择与组内奖励对比度关联，多种子消融显示自适应节流优于均匀和预设开销计划。

Conclusion: CERO 通过在线原始-对偶框架实现全局 rollout 预算协调，在理论与实验上均优于固定分配策略，验证了自适应 prompt 准入与预算节流的有效性。

Abstract: Adaptive rollout methods for group-relative reinforcement learning typically allocate a fixed per-update budget across prompts. We instead study how to coordinate a finite rollout budget over the entire training horizon. We formulate this problem using a concave surrogate utility of cumulative prompt exposure and introduce CERO, an online primal dual scheduler for prompt admission and budget pacing. In our experiments, each admitted prompt receives a fixed-size response group. CERO instead adapts which prompts are selected, how often they are revisited across rounds, and how many groups are generated in each round. A compact Fenchel representation linearizes the dependence on cumulative exposure, while projected online gradient descent updates prompt-specific supporting slopes and a shared budget price using reward-variation feedback and budget deviations. We establish pathwise guarantees for the surrogate allocation objective against fixed-rate and same-path time-varying benchmarks, with explicit terms for proxy discrepancy and rate variation. Under matched training-response budgets, CERO attains the highest avg@16 macro-average on each of three backbones across five mathematical reasoning benchmarks. Mechanistic analyses link CERO's prompt choices to within-group reward contrast, while multi-seed ablations show gains from adaptive pacing over both uniform and preset spending schedules.

</details>


### [300] [Few-Shot Learning for Personalised Automated Pain Assessment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09692)
*Heinke Hihn,Ibrahim Eisawy,Patrick Thiam,Hans A. Kestler,Friedhelm Schwenker*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将基于人群的自动疼痛评估中的个体差异问题，重新表述为任务域偏移，并采用少样本学习实现受试者个性化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 疼痛感知在个体间差异显著，导致基于人群的分类器难以对整个数据集中的所有受试者泛化。为应对受试者差异性，一种方法是训练个性化分类器。

Method: 作者将少样本学习（元学习的一个子领域）用于自动疼痛评估中的个性化。他们将从人群级评估到受试者级评估的转变重新解释为任务域偏移：可观察的类别保持不变，但目标受试者发生变化。方法在 BioVid 疼痛数据库、SenseEmotion 数据库和 PainMonit 实验数据集（PMED）上评估，采用留一受试者交叉验证（Leave-One-Subject-Out CV）协议，并使用样本进行 k-shot 条件化。

Result: 在 LOSO CV 协议下，二分类和多分类设置中分别达到：BioVid 85.75% 和 35.49%，SenseEmotion 82.37% 和 41.88%，PMED（仅有二分类基准）90.47%。使用样本进行 k-shot 条件化后，准确率可分别提升至 86.25%、40.06%、83.43%、44.08% 和 91.25%。此外还进行了消融实验并研究了个性化效果。

Conclusion: 结果表明，支持集条件化的少样本自适应可以在受试者间变异性下改善平均性能。

Abstract: Pain perception varies substantially across individuals, making it difficult for population-based classifiers to generalise across all subjects in a dataset. One way to account for subject variability is to train personalised classifiers. In this work, we evaluate Few-Shot Learning, a sub-area of Meta-Learning, as an approach to personalisation in automated pain assessment. We re-interpret the shift from population-level to subject-level evaluation as a task-domain shift, where the observed classes remain fixed but the target subject changes. We evaluate our method on the BioVid Pain Database, the SenseEmotion Database, and the PainMonit Experimental Dataset (PMED), reaching 85.75% and 35.49% accuracy on BioVid and 82.37% and 41.88% on SenseEmotion in the binary and multi-class settings under a Leave-One-Subject-Out CV protocol respectively, and 90.47% on PMED, for which only a binary benchmark exists. Using samples to implement k-shot conditioning, the accuracies can be improved to 86.25%, 40.06%, 83.43%, 44.08%, and 91.25%, respectively. To further evaluate the effects and robustness of our method, we provide additional ablation experiments and investigate the personalisation effects. Our results suggest that support-conditioned few-shot adaptation can improve average performance under inter-subject variability.

</details>


### [301] [Unrolled Flow Models for Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09759)
*Faissal Izermine,Hanru Bai,Oscar Davis,T. Konstantin Rusch*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文证明两层Transformer参数化的流模型可求解图可达性，且所需积分步数随目标距根距离增加而增加；提出在随机子区间上进行隐状态rollout训练、球面投影稳定长程动力学及无参选择评分，使流匹配模型在推理任务中随积分步数增多而提升性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 流匹配（flow matching）能以少步完成语言生成，但额外积分步是否能提升推理能力尚不明确，且标准流语言模型在推理任务上常无法从更多步中获益，其瓶颈被归因于逐时间点独立监督、未显式训练相邻步骤相互累积。

Method: 1）理论上构造由两层Transformer参数化的流，证明其能求解图可达性，且积分步数需求随目标到根的距离增长；2）训练时在[0,1]内随机采样子区间，沿模型自身隐状态rollout并在端点解码；3）对Sudoku、Maze等长rollout任务，将隐状态回缩到球面以稳定动力学；4）采样多条rollout并结合无参数选择评分进行筛选。

Result: 在ProsQA上准确率提升至97%，且性能随积分步数增加而改善；在Sudoku和Maze上经球面稳定后显著超越参数量三倍以上的基线；多条rollout采样配合无参选择评分可进一步提升性能，但对较长答案的可靠选择仍具挑战。

Conclusion: 研究为基于流的推理建立了理论基础，并表明rollout训练、稳定隐状态动力学与rollout选择三者结合可在实践中实现流模型的推理能力。

Abstract: Flow matching enables language generation in few steps, but whether additional integration steps improve reasoning remains unclear. We prove that a flow parameterized by a two-layer Transformer can solve graph reachability, with the required number of integration steps increasing with the target's distance from the root. Yet, standard flow language models can fail to benefit from additional steps on reasoning tasks. We attribute this limitation to objectives that supervise each time point independently, without explicitly training successive steps to build on one another. To address this, we instead train through the model's own latent rollout over a randomly sampled subinterval of [0, 1], decoding only at the endpoint. On ProsQA, this raises accuracy to 97% and enables performance to improve with additional integration steps. For the longer rollouts required by reasoning tasks such as Sudoku and Maze, retracting the latent state onto a sphere stabilizes the dynamics and yields substantial gains over baselines with more than three times as many parameters. Sampling multiple rollouts further improves performance when paired with a parameter-free selection score, although reliable selection remains challenging for longer answers. Together, these results establish a theoretical basis for reasoning with flows and show how rollout training, stable latent dynamics, and rollout selection help realize this capacity in practice.

</details>


### [302] [Fully Interpretable Minimal Transformers: From Geometry to Algorithm](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09838)
*Raneem Mahajne,Toviah Moldwin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一个构建与解读极简Transformer的框架，将嵌入维度和注意力头维度限制为2，使内部表征可完整地进行二维可视化，并以“输出最近出现的偶数”任务为例，逐步可视化Transformer的完整计算过程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Transformer内部机制不透明，现有可解释性研究多在高维空间中分析，难以直观观察信息几何。作者希望通过将维度压缩到二维，使嵌入、Q/K/V变换、注意力、残差流和决策边界都能被直接观察，从而把“学习到的几何结构”解读为显式算法，为教学和实验提供可视化试验台。

Method: 将Transformer的嵌入维度和头维度约束为2，在R^2中训练一个模型完成简单任务：当数字序列中出现“+”运算符时，输出最近观测到的偶数。训练后逐步可视化并解释其计算流程，包括token及位置嵌入、Q/K/V矩阵变换、Q与K点积形成注意力矩阵、利用注意力矩阵选择value以将每个输入token的表征移动到输出层定义域中能正确预测下一token的区域。同时提出一套可解释性可视化工具。

Result: 在二维约束下可完整观察模型内部表征与计算；能够清晰展示token与位置嵌入、Q/K/V变换、注意力矩阵形成、value选择及表征移动过程；模型在目标任务上完成下一token预测，且其学习到的点与决策边界布局可被解读为逐步算法流程。

Conclusion: 学习到的几何结构蕴含算法；R^2中的点与边界排列可读作分步过程。该框架为探究Transformer如何利用信息几何实现下一token预测提供了教学与实验试验台。

Abstract: We present a framework for building and interpreting minimal transformer models. By constraining a transformer's embedding dimension and head size to 2, we enable full two-dimensional visualization of its internal representations. Embeddings, query/key/value transforms, attention outputs, residual streams, and decision boundaries can all be seen directly. Our central claim is that the learned geometry implies an algorithm; the arrangement of points and boundaries in R^2 can be read as a step-by-step procedure. We train a transformer on a simple task where it must produce the most recently observed even number whenever the '+' operator appears in a sequence of digits. Once trained, we visually walk through every step of the transformer's computation. We show how the model embeds the tokens and their respective positions in the sequence, transforms them via the Q, K, and V matrices, uses the dot product between the Q and K representations to form the attention matrix, and uses the attention matrix to select values that move the representation of each input token to the region of the domain of the output layer that will correctly predict the next token. We introduce a suite of interpretability visualizations that make the algorithmic interpretation of this procedure explicit. Our framework offers a pedagogical and experimental testbed to explore how transformers use informational geometry to implement next-token prediction.

</details>


### [303] [Stream-Based Active Learning with Cooperative Neural Networks for Data-Efficient Partial Inverse Design: An Automotive Glass Run Channel Case Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09848)
*Agung Nugraha,Hyerin Kwon,Heungjun Im,Gian Antariksa,Jihwan Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出CoNN-AL框架，将流式主动学习与CoNN-DAE结合，实现数据高效的部分逆向设计，在汽车玻璃导槽数据集上以约2.3%标注量达到R² 0.967–0.982。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工程逆向设计中，每个带标签训练样本都需昂贵的仿真生成，构建大规模数据集耗时且成本高，尤其在仅有部分设计变量给定、需推断其余变量的部分逆向设计场景下数据效率问题突出。

Method: 在Cooperative Neural Network with Denoising Autoencoder（CoNN-DAE）基础上加入基于流的主动学习（stream-based active learning），构成CoNN-AL；通过Monte Carlo dropout估计预测不确定性，实时判断传入候选样本是否值得标注，从而将有限标注预算用于最具信息量的设计。

Result: 在超过900,000个唯一仿真设计的真实汽车玻璃导槽数据集上验证：仅用20,000个主动选择标签（约占训练池2.3%），各缺失变量水平下R²达0.967–0.982，接近用更多数据训练的上界模型；较难缺失变量水平下比随机采样少30–40%标注即可达R²≥0.95；在最难水平上是本研究中唯一达到R² 0.98的策略。同时公开数据集。

Conclusion: CoNN-AL能显著提升部分逆向设计的数据效率，在有限标注预算下逼近上界性能，并公开数据集以支持后续数据驱动设计研究。

Abstract: Inverse design in engineering often runs into a simple problem. Each labeled training sample must be produced through expensive simulation, so building a large dataset is slow and costly. This study addresses that problem for partial inverse design, where only some design variables are specified and the rest must be inferred to reach a target performance value. We propose CoNN-AL, a framework for data-efficient partial inverse design that adds stream-based active learning to the Cooperative Neural Network with Denoising Autoencoder (CoNN-DAE). The model estimates predictive uncertainty through Monte Carlo dropout and uses it to decide, in real time, which incoming candidate samples are worth labeling, so the limited labeling budget is spent on the most informative designs. We validate the framework on a real-world automotive glass run channel dataset of more than 900,000 unique simulated designs. With only 20,000 actively selected labels, about 2.3% of the training pool, CoNN-AL reaches R-squared values of 0.967 to 0.982 across all missing-variable levels, approaching the upper-bound models trained on far more data. It reaches R-squared of at least 0.95 with 30 to 40% fewer labels than random sampling at the more difficult missing-variable levels and, at the most challenging level, is the only strategy in this study to reach R-squared of 0.98. Together with this work, we publicly release the dataset to support future research on data-driven design.

</details>


### [304] [RollVerify: Bridging Efficiency and Accuracy in Long-Tail Rollout Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09914)
*Yongqiang Yao,Jinru Tan,Kaihuan Liang,Zixin Yin,Yazhe Niu,Ruihao Gong,Dahua Lin,Ningyi Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出RollVerify，一个基于部分回放的轻量级强化学习框架，通过主动验证和修复样本来缓解离策略偏差，在保持效率增益的同时达到与全在策略训练相当的准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着上下文窗口增大，回放序列长度呈现长尾分布，在在策略训练中会造成GPU气泡，降低系统利用率并限制RL的可扩展性。异步或部分回放方法虽能提升吞吐量，但会引入陈旧的离策略样本，可能损害最终准确率。现有方法主要在训练时对离策略样本重新加权，但仍存在与完全在策略训练之间的性能差距。

Method: 提出RollVerify框架，构建于部分回放之上。其核心是引入离策略偏移度量OPS（off-policy shift metric），用于量化部分生成轨迹的离策略偏差。在OPS约束的指导下，RollVerify在序列级和token级两个层面执行验证，识别并截断轨迹中无效的后缀，从而产出高质量样本。

Result: 在数学推理和工具辅助数学推理任务上的实验表明，RollVerify在降低训练成本的同时，准确率可与在策略训练相媲美。额外的代码生成结果进一步提供了数学领域之外的初步证据。

Conclusion: 与被动地对样本重新加权不同，RollVerify通过主动验证与修复，在样本进入训练前即加以处理，能够在保留部分回放效率优势的同时保护模型准确率，是一种兼顾效率与效果的有效RL框架。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning is crucial for improving large language models' reasoning and generalization. It relies on massive rollouts whose lengths become increasingly long-tailed as context windows grow. In on-policy training, these long-tail rollouts can result in GPU bubbles, reducing system utilization and limiting RL scalability. Asynchronous or partial-rollout methods improve throughput by relaxing synchronization, but inevitably introduce stale off-policy samples (trajectories) that may hurt final accuracy. Existing approaches mainly mitigate this off-policy issue by reweighting off-policy samples during training, yet they can still leave a performance gap compared to fully on-policy training. In this work, rather than passively reweighting samples during training, we propose RollVerify, a lightweight RL framework built on partial rollout that actively verifies and repairs samples before they enter training. Specifically, it introduces an off-policy shift metric OPS, to quantify the off-policy deviation of partially generated trajectories. Guided by the OPS constraint, RollVerify performs both sequence-level and token-level verification to identify and truncate invalid suffixes of trajectories. This yields high-quality samples that protect the models' accuracy while preserving the efficiency gains of partial rollout. Experiments on mathematical and tool-assisted mathematical reasoning show that RollVerify achieves accuracy comparable to on-policy training while reducing training cost. Additional code-generation results provide preliminary evidence beyond mathematics.

</details>


### [305] [KGATE : a Knowledge Graph Embedding Training Environment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09927)
*Benjamin Loire,Galadriel Brière,Célia Brahimi,Antoine Toffano,Anaïs Baudot*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: KGATE：基于PyTorch Geometric与TorchKGE的模块化知识图谱自编码器训练环境，支持模块自由组装、防数据泄漏预处理与可复现训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有KGE库多仅支持编码器或解码器之一，难以构建完整自编码器；且普遍缺乏维护、超参数默认值无文档说明、跨库结果不可比。

Method: 提出KGATE，模块化Python库，构建于PyTorch Geometric和TorchKGE之上，将初始化器、编码器、解码器、损失函数、负采样器和评价指标实现为可替换构建块，并内置防数据泄漏的预处理流程与训练管线。

Result: 与六个现有KGE库的基准测试表明，KGATE训练时间与最快库相当，同时提供更丰富功能。

Conclusion: KGATE兼顾完整自编码器支持、模块化扩展、可复现性与训练效率，为KGE研究提供统一且可比的实验平台。

Abstract: Knowledge graph embedding (KGE) models encode the entities and relations of a knowledge graph into a low-dimensional latent space, enabling tasks such as classification or link prediction. Most KGE models follow an autoencoder architecture, in which an encoder projects the knowledge graph into the latent space and a decoder reconstruct it. Combining both encoder and decoder components is increasingly needed, yet existing libraries rarely support complete autoencoders, are often unmaintained, rely on undocumented default hyperparameters, and produce results that cannot be compared across libraries. Here we present KGATE (Knowledge Graph Autoencoder Training Environment), a modular Python library built on PyTorch Geometric and TorchKGE. KGATE lets users assemble initializers, encoders, decoders, losses, negative samplers, and evaluation metrics as building blocks, or plug in their own block. KGATE includes a preprocessing procedure that controls data leakage, a builtin training pipeline, and reproducibility by design. Benchmarks against six existing KGE libraries show that KGATE training time is comparable with the fastest libraries while offering a broader set of features.

</details>


### [306] [Efficient Patch-Based Anomaly Detection Fused with Diffusion Driven Generative Modeling for Semiconductor Wafer Bin Map Open Set Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09993)
*Limon Bin Hossain,Md Sadib Rahman Ananta*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出EfficientAD+DDPM混合单类框架，以百分位校准和固定凸组合融合异常分数，在WM-38K上AUROC达0.9985、误分类降至618，并揭示固定权重融合的局限与评价指标失衡问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 晶圆图(WBM)空间缺陷可追溯至特定工艺故障，但监督分类器只能识别训练中见过的缺陷类型；单机制单类检测器又往往只能捕捉局部结构偏差或全局分布违反中的一种，难以兼顾。因此需要一种能同时利用局部与全局线索、且仅依赖正常样本训练的单类检测框架。

Method: 混合单类框架：将基于图像块的student-teacher检测器(EfficientAD)与去噪扩散概率模型(DDPM，用于部分扩散重建)耦合，对两者分数做百分位(percentile)校准后通过固定凸组合融合。仅用WM-38K混合类型数据集中700片正常晶圆训练，在18,658片留出晶圆上评测；并做像素级图分析、错误重叠分析及与oracle选择器的对比。

Result: 融合检测器AUROC达0.9985，误分类由DDPM的852、EfficientAD的1,412降至618，所有两两差异p<0.001。收益源于两模块错误的弱重叠；但固定权重融合仅能挽回oracle选择器可用纠正量的40-70%。在基准的反向类别分布下，平均精度与F1饱和，而MCC与阴性预测值暴露了正常预测不可靠。像素级图显示图像级强可分性不意味着空间定位能力，扩散模块实际起局部密度先验作用，而非全局几何推理。

Conclusion: 混合单类方案在图像级检测上精度极高，但固定权重融合次优、且常规指标在类别失衡下会掩盖缺陷。应发展样本自适应融合策略与面向类别失衡的评价体系，用于混合式晶圆异常检测器。

Abstract: Spatial defect signatures on wafer bin maps (WBMs) trace yield loss to specific process faults, yet supervised classifiers recognize only the defect types seen during training, and one-class detectors built on a single mechanism tend to capture either local structural deviations or global distributional violations, but rarely both. This work proposes a hybrid one-class framework that couples a patch-based student-teacher detector (EfficientAD) with a denoising diffusion probabilistic model (DDPM) used for partial-diffusion reconstruction, and fuses their percentile-calibrated scores through a fixed convex combination. Trained on only 700 normal wafers from the WM-38K mixed-type dataset and evaluated on 18,658 held-out wafers, the fused detector reached an AUROC of 0.9985 and reduced misclassifications from 852 (DDPM) and 1,412 (EfficientAD) to 618, with all pairwise differences significant at p < 0.001. Beyond aggregate accuracy, the analysis shows that the gain arises from weakly overlapping errors between the two modules, yet fixed-weight fusion recovers only 40-70% of the correction available to an oracle selector. Under the benchmark's inverted class balance, average precision and F1 saturate, while the Matthews correlation coefficient and negative predictive value expose unreliable normal predictions. Pixel-level maps further show that strong image-level separability does not imply spatial localization, and the diffusion module succeeds as a local density prior rather than through global geometric reasoning. These findings motivate sample-adaptive fusion and imbalance-aware evaluation of hybrid wafer anomaly detectors.

</details>


### [307] [Temporal Predictive Multiplicity: Equally Accurate Time Series Models Yield Different Forecast Trajectories](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09994)
*Emanuele Albini,Francesca Toni,Saumitra Mishra,Francesco Leofante*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文提出"时间预测多重性"框架，刻画性能相近模型在完整预测轨迹上的分歧，并证明仅约束性能或逐视野多重性均无法消除轨迹级分歧。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 性能近乎相同的模型可能产生差异显著的预测，即预测多重性。既有研究多聚焦于单个标量输出的层面，而时间序列预测中跨视野的预测共同构成一条轨迹，逐视野比较会掩盖预测行为的重要差异。

Method: 引入时间预测多重性框架，刻画性能近乎相同模型间在完整预测轨迹上的分歧；分析仅约束预测性能时的轨迹多样性；并检验在单个视野上约束多重性对轨迹级多重性的削减效果；在11个数据集与19种神经预测架构上进行实验验证。

Result: 实验确认近乎最优的模型在预测轨迹上可表现出显著变异，且轨迹级分歧与逐视野分歧在很大程度上不相关；仅约束预测性能仍允许广泛不同的轨迹，仅在单视野层面约束多重性只能部分削减而非消除轨迹级多重性。

Conclusion: 该框架揭示了现有多重性研究的空白：预测性能不可区分的模型隐含根本不同的时间轨迹，并带来重要的下游影响。

Abstract: Models with near-identical predictive performance can yield substantially different predictions, a phenomenon known as predictive multiplicity. Prior work has mostly studied this at the level of individual scalar outputs. In time-series forecasting, however, predictions across horizons jointly define a trajectory, and horizon-wise comparisons can hide important differences in predictive behavior. To address this problem, we introduce temporal predictive multiplicity, a framework that characterizes disagreement over complete forecast trajectories among models with near-identical predictive performance. We show that constraining predictive performance alone can still admit a broad range of different trajectories. We further show that constraining multiplicity at individual horizons partially reduces, but does not eliminate, trajectory-level multiplicity. Experiments with 19 neural forecasting architectures on 11 datasets confirm that near-optimal models can exhibit substantial variability in the forecast trajectories they produce, and trajectory-level disagreement is largely unrelated to horizon-wise disagreement. Our framework, therefore, exposes a gap in existing multiplicity studies: models with indistinguishable predictive performance imply fundamentally different temporal trajectories, with consequential downstream effects.

</details>


### [308] [Beyond Reward Suppression: Near-Optimal Offline Attacks on Warm-Start Bandits with Bounded Rewards](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10000)
*Qirun Zeng,Manhin Poon,Xiangxiang Dai,Qixin Zhang,Jinhang Zuo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究热启动赌博机上的有界离线攻击，指出"目标推广"（直接提升目标臂）并非启发性技巧，而是近最优攻击的必然组成部分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有对赌博机的对抗攻击通常通过压制非目标臂来误导学习器选择目标臂。但现实中（如虚假评论）更常见的方式是直接推广目标物品，这一差距尚未被系统研究。

Method: 在热启动赌博机上建模有界离线攻击：攻击者只能在部署前的热启动历史中注入合法的动作-奖励对。针对UCB证明：当目标臂位于奖励下界附近时，任何阶最优成本、使UCB在几乎所有在线轮选中目标臂的攻击，都必须将不可忽略比例的成本分配给目标臂。随后设计一种达到最优次线性成本的攻击，并刻画其在目标推广与非目标压制之间的成本分配。进一步将攻击扩展至Thompson Sampling、ε-greedy及更广泛的赌博机算法类。

Result: 理论上给出目标推广必要性的下界结论，并构造出达到最优次线性成本上界的攻击及成本分配刻画；在真实与合成数据上验证了攻击的有效性。

Conclusion: 目标推广是热启动赌博机离线攻击的内在机制而非启发式选择，为理解推广型攻击与设计更鲁棒的赌博机算法提供了理论依据。

Abstract: Adversarial attacks on bandits aim to mislead a learner toward a target arm while keeping the attack cost small. Existing attacks typically achieve this by suppressing non-target arms. In practice, however, manipulation such as fake reviews often directly promotes the target item. We study this gap through bounded offline attacks on warm-start bandits, where an attacker can inject only valid action-reward pairs into the warm-start history before deployment. We show that target promotion is not merely a heuristic: when the target arm lies near the lower reward boundary, any order-optimal-cost attack against UCB that makes it selected in nearly all online rounds must allocate a nonvanishing fraction of its cost to the target arm. We then design an attack that achieves the optimal sublinear cost and characterize its allocation between target promotion and non-target suppression. We further extend the attack to Thompson Sampling, $ε$-greedy, and a broader class of bandit algorithms. Experiments on real-world and synthetic data validate the effectiveness of our attacks.

</details>


### [309] [Activation-Aware Weight Tensorization: A Calibration-Time Preconditioner for Tensor-Network LLM Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10085)
*Alessandro Beatini,Marco Maronese,Emanuele Rodolà*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出无训练的激活感知权重张量化(AWT)，用激活导出的对角缩放对权重矩阵做预条件，在不变TT/TTN分解器与仅输入侧逐元素重缩放部署下，显著改善大模型张量网络压缩的功能保真度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 后训练张量网络压缩以TT/TTN替换Transformer线性层，但标准分解最小化权重空间Frobenius误差，而非该层激活分布下的功能误差，导致压缩后困惑度劣化明显。

Method: AWT作为一个无训练校准包装器：在保持TT/TTN求解器不变的前提下，先用由激活分布导出的对角缩放矩阵对每个权重矩阵做预条件，分解后在部署阶段仅施加输入侧的逐元素重缩放。

Result: 在Llama 3.1 8B、Ministral 8B与Qwen2.5 7B上，2-6倍压缩率下AWT稳定优于原始TT/TTN：单算子替换时缩小12-35%的WikiText困惑度差距；Llama后缀多算子替换时在注意力组与全部七个矩阵设置下缩小27-60%；收益可迁移到HellaSwag与ARC-Challenge。此外，稠密全协方差oracle在其加权目标上81例中胜80例，但对角AWT在53/81例中取得更优的留出功能保真度，说明对角预条件是一种鲁棒性-模块性权衡而非对角协方差假设。

Conclusion: AWT是一种原则化、模块化的预条件方法，可在不修改分解求解器的固定TT/TTN压缩流程中提升功能保真度。

Abstract: Post-training tensor-network compression replaces Transformer linear layers with Tensor Train (TT) or Tree Tensor Network (TTN) operators, but standard decompositions minimize weight-space Frobenius error rather than functional error under the layer's activation distribution. We propose Activation-aware Weight Tensorization (AWT), a training-free calibration wrapper that preconditions each weight matrix with a diagonal activation-derived scale before an unchanged TT/TTN solver and deploys the result with only an input-side elementwise rescaling. Across Llama 3.1 8B, Ministral 8B, and Qwen2.5 7B, AWT consistently improves vanilla TT/TTN tensorization at 2-6 times compression: under single-operator replacement, AWT closes 12-35% of the WikiText perplexity gap to the dense baseline across the three model families and 2-6 times compression settings; while under multi-operator Llama suffix replacement it closes 27-60% across attention-group and all-seven-matrix settings. The gains also transfer to downstream HellaSwag and ARC-Challenge evaluations. We further show that diagonal preconditioning is a robustness-modularity tradeoff rather than a diagonal-covariance assumption: a dense full-covariance oracle wins its own weighted objective in 80/81 cases, yet diagonal AWT gives better held-out functional fidelity in 53/81 cases. Together, these results position AWT as a principled, modular preconditioner for improving functional fidelity in fixed TT/TTN compression pipelines without modifying the decomposition solver.

</details>


### [310] [From Prompts to Trees: Effective LLM-Guided Tree Generation for Few-Shot Tabular Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10227)
*Yue Qiu,Zekang Du,Yiqun Diao,Bingsheng He,Qinbin Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种三阶段框架，在少样本场景下将大语言模型知识蒸馏为可解释决策树，通过提示LLM生成规则并组织为树，实现高准确率、高可解释性与低提示开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型具备丰富世界知识与强泛化能力，但直接用于表格数据分类存在推理成本高、可解释性差的问题；决策树快速透明，却在低数据场景下性能不足。因此作者希望结合两者优势。

Method: 提出一种新的蒸馏框架：不直接让LLM生成完整决策树，而是采用三阶段范式，先提示LLM生成规则，再将规则组织成决策树，从而在少样本学习设定下将LLM知识蒸馏到可解释决策树中。

Result: 在多个真实世界表格数据集上，与现有基线相比，该方法取得了更优的准确率和可解释性，并显著降低了提示开销。

Conclusion: 该工作说明将LLM知识通过规则—树的方式蒸馏为决策树，是提升少样本表格分类性能与可解释性、同时控制推理与提示成本的有效途径。

Abstract: While Large Language Models (LLMs) possess rich world knowledge and impressive generalization capabilities, their direct application to tabular data classification is hindered by high inference costs and limited interpretability. In contrast, decision trees are fast and transparent but often underperform in low-data regimes. In this work, we propose a novel framework that bridges these paradigms by distilling LLM knowledge into interpretable decision trees under a few-shot learning setting. Instead of directly prompting the LLM to generate full trees, which is often unstable and inefficient, we develop a three-stage paradigm that prompts the LLM to generate rules and organize the rules into a tree. Experiments on multiple real-world tabular datasets demonstrate that our method achieves superior accuracy and interpretability with significantly lower prompting overhead compared to existing baselines.

</details>


### [311] [Stationary Bias and Extrapolation in Nonlinear Two-Timescale Stochastic Approximation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10246)
*A. Ch. Madhusudanarao,Rahul Singh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究由外生有限状态马尔可夫链驱动的非线性双时间尺度随机逼近的平稳均值偏差，推导了慢步长远小于快步长时仍一致有效的偏差展开，揭示了 ε²/η 混合项，并据此讨论了偏差消除与外推权重的匹配问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 常步长随机逼近存在非零平稳均值误差，且时间平均不能消除它。现有分析多针对线性或单时间尺度情形，缺乏对非线性双时间尺度递推在慢步长远小于快步长极限下偏差结构的刻画，而这直接影响偏差消除与 Richardson–Romberg 外推的有效性。

Method: 在给定光滑性假设与平稳分布条件下，对由外生有限状态马尔可夫链驱动的非线性双时间尺度递推推导一阶偏差展开；利用快流形坐标保持协方差方程在慢步长趋于零时的正则性；对快步长 η、慢步长 ε 分析各项阶数；在附加耦合假设下界定有限次运行中两个时间尺度尾部平均的初始化误差；对加性独立噪声特例利用三阶矩符号相消得到更紧的余项。

Result: 偏差展开在 ε/η → 0 时误差界一致，除各步长的线性项外还出现混合项 ε²/η；沿幂律步长路径，偏差指数不必为整数，故 Richardson–Romberg 外推需匹配路径的权重。用可解析求解的非线性马尔可夫算例验证了系数，并在时间差分学习中验证了定位，在相同更新预算下比较了有限次运行外推效果。

Conclusion: 非线性双时间尺度随机逼近的平稳偏差具有以 ε²/η 为代表的混合阶结构，该结构决定了外推权重设计与偏差消除策略；快流形坐标、尾部平均初始化误差界及三阶矩相消分析为有限运行与加性噪声情形提供了更精细的工具。

Abstract: Constant-step stochastic approximation generally has a nonzero stationary mean error that persists under time averaging. This paper studies that error for nonlinear two-timescale recursions driven by an exogenous finite-state Markov chain. Under stated smoothness assumptions and conditions on the stationary distribution, we derive a first-order bias expansion whose error bound remains uniform as the slow step size becomes much smaller than the fast step size. Fast-manifold coordinates keep the associated covariance equation regular in this limit. For fast step $η$ and slow step $\varepsilon$, the expansion reveals a mixed contribution $\varepsilon^2/η$ alongside terms linear in each step size. This dependence matters for bias reduction: along power-law step-size paths, the bias exponents need not be integers, so Richardson--Romberg extrapolation requires weights matched to the path. An exactly solvable nonlinear Markov example verifies the coefficients. We verify localization for temporal-difference learning and compare finite-run extrapolation at equal update budgets. For finite runs, we bound the initialization error of tail averages on both timescales under an additional coupling assumption. In the special case of additive independent noise, signed third-moment cancellation yields a sharper remainder.

</details>


### [312] [Logarithmic Regret via Passive Change Detection in Piecewise-Stationary Self-Tuning Regulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10250)
*A. Ch. Madhusudanarao,Rahul Singh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究带外生输入、系数在未知时刻变化的未知自回归系统的最小方差控制，提出PIECE-CD算法，在扰动有界、变化间有充分间隔等条件下证明高概率对数遗憾界 O((C+1)log((T+1)/δ))。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典切换赌徒问题中未被选中的臂可在不被观测的情况下发生变化，而自适应控制中的容许被控对象变化在利用（exploitation）阶段会提供信息：若控制器仍可行，输出中仅剩扰动；若变化可检测，则旧控制器下输出能量会升高。作者希望利用这一信息结构，解决未知自回归系统在未知时刻系数变化下的最小方差控制遗憾界问题。

Method: 提出PIECE-CD算法：初始阶段与每次报警后进行探索，随后使用带门控的递归最小二乘（gated RLS）进行控制；采用能量检测，将窗口输出功率与高于噪声底的阈值比较，并监控参考控制器的输入建议以覆盖不稳定控制器失配的情形；输入被裁剪到规定边界内；跨整个时间域控制误报，并证明对数级检测延迟。

Result: 在有界独立扰动、固定检测间隔、稳定性与可行性条件、变化间充分时间间隔的前提下，以至少1−δ的概率获得 O((C+1)log((T+1)/δ)) 遗憾，其中T为时域、C为变化次数；证明了对数级检测延迟；在使裁剪在有限预热期后失效的显式条件下，对数遗憾同样成立；扩展检测器在给定可行性条件下可覆盖具有固定窗口上可检测超额能量的失稳变化。

Conclusion: 该工作表明，利用容许被控对象变化在利用阶段暴露的信息，可在未知变化点的自回归系统中实现高概率对数遗憾，且扩展检测器能够处理导致控制器失稳的变化，为变化环境下的最小方差控制提供了理论保证。

Abstract: We study minimum-variance control of an unknown autoregressive system with exogenous inputs and coefficients that change at unknown times. Under bounded independent disturbances, fixed detection gaps, stability and feasibility conditions, and sufficient time between changes, we prove \(O((C+1)\log((T+1)/δ))\) regret with probability at least \(1-δ\), where \(T\) is the horizon and \(C\) the number of changes. Unlike switching bandits, where unselected arms can change unobserved, admissible plant changes provide information during exploitation: the correct feasible controller leaves only the disturbance in the output, whereas a detectable change raises output energy under the old controller. PIECE-CD explores initially and after alarms, then uses gated recursive least squares for control. Its energy test compares windowed output power with a threshold above the noise floor; the extension to unstable controller mismatches also monitors the reference controller's input proposal. We control false alarms across the horizon and prove logarithmic detection delay. Inputs are clipped to prescribed bounds. Logarithmic regret also holds under an explicit condition ensuring that clipping becomes inactive after a finite burn-in. Under the stated feasibility conditions, the extended detector covers destabilizing changes with detectable excess energy over a fixed window.

</details>


### [313] [SemanticFold: Latent Sequence Compression SeparatesLanguage Modeling, Decodability, and Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10304)
*Mingyan Liu,Min Huang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 SemanticFold——一种在学习到的边界处折叠前缀隐状态的潜在序列压缩方案，并在 Qwen3-1.7B、Qwen3-8B、SmolLM2-1.7B、Pythia-1.4B、Pythia-6.9B 五个规模模型上，用固定目标协议考察压缩是否保持推理所需能力。结论：压缩对语言模型拟合、可解码性、推理行为等多个端点的作用是非单调的，不存在单一压缩阈值或单一的"保持性"标量证书。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究前缀提示的潜在序列压缩是否会破坏大模型推理时依赖的能力，并检验"压缩保持能力"能否用单一标量指标来衡量。既有做法常以单一指标判定压缩是否无损，本文质疑该假设，试图厘清不同端点（似然、推理、探针、生成、系统开销）在同一压缩操作下是否一致。

Method: 提出 SemanticFold：在学习到的边界处折叠前缀隐状态。采用固定目标协议——冻结前缀分别以原生或压缩方式执行，两条支路对相同的续写 token 做 teacher-forcing，从而排除目标选择对似然变化的解释。在五个模型（Qwen3-1.7B、Qwen3-8B、SmolLM2-1.7B、Pythia-1.4B、Pythia-6.9B）上考察五类端点：固定目标负对数似然、有限标签推理准确率、线性探针可及性、开放式生成、系统级显存与延迟。另做 NLL 分解，将序列缩短与学习到的残差变换分离，并设 MLP-only（只变换不缩短）对照。

Result: 压缩对各类端点的作用是<b>非单调</b>的，且不共享同一压缩阈值。Qwen3-1.7B 在 R=1.7 时，压缩减原生的平均 NLL 在配对 bootstrap（10000 次抽样）下降 0.135；SmolLM2 在 R=1.2 时平均变化比原生高 0.013；两个 Pythia 检查点上 NLL 基本不变。NLL 分解显示 Qwen 的有利似然主要来自<b>残差自适应</b>而非单纯序列缩短：MLP-only 比 Full SemanticFold 的 NLL 低 0.082。线性探针准确率与 macro AUC 在各条件下绝对变化均小于 0.03，置信区间跨越零。

Conclusion: 潜在压缩下的能力保持不存在单一标量证书：语言模型拟合、可解码性与推理行为回答的是不同问题，在同一压缩操作下可以朝不同方向移动。评估压缩时应采用多端点视角而非单一阈值判定。

Abstract: We study whether latent sequence compression of prompt prefixes preserves the capabilities that large language models rely on during inference. We introduce SemanticFold, a compression scheme that folds prefix hidden states at learned boundaries, and evaluate it across five model scales: Qwen3-1.7B, Qwen3-8B, SmolLM2-1.7B, Pythia-1.4B, and Pythia-6.9B. We use a fixed-target protocol: a frozen prefix is executed natively or compressed, and both arms teacher-force identical continuation tokens. This design rules out target-selection explanations for likelihood changes. We examine five endpoint families: fixed-target negative log-likelihood, finite-label reasoning accuracy, linear probe accessibility, open-ended generation, and systems-level memory and latency. We find that compression moves these endpoints non-monotonically and that they do not share a single compression threshold. On Qwen3-1.7B at compression ratio R=1.7, compressed-minus-native mean NLL decreases by 0.135 under paired bootstrap with 10000 draws. On SmolLM2 at R=1.2, the mean change is 0.013 higher than native. On both Pythia checkpoints, NLL is effectively unchanged. An NLL decomposition separating sequence shortening from the learned residual transform shows that the favorable Qwen likelihood is attributable primarily to residual adaptation rather than to shortening alone. MLP-only, which applies the transform without shortening, achieves 0.082 lower NLL than Full SemanticFold. Linear probe accuracy and macro AUC change by less than 0.03 in absolute value across conditions, with confidence intervals crossing zero. We conclude that preservation under latent compression has no single scalar certificate: language-model fit, decodability, and reasoning behavior answer different questions and can move in different directions under the same compression operation.

</details>


### [314] [Fault-tolerant foundation models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10311)
*Trevor McCourt,Ila R. Fiete,Isaac L. Chuang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究表明大语言模型可被训练以容忍不可靠硬件，且错误韧性随模型规模增大而提升；修改后的神经缩放定律暗示模型学会了在"好"纠错码内计算，其相对开销有限，作者据此猜想适宜的LLM可能具有形式化容错性，从而为在低能耗故障硬件上运行推理以大幅节能提供路径。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 新兴计算机硬件常以牺牲可靠性换取能效，因此需要探究大语言模型能否容忍这种不可靠性，以权衡可靠性与能效之间的关系。

Method: 在模拟的故障数字硬件上进行40,000 GPU小时的训练实验，并推导修改后的神经缩放定律来量化错误韧性随模型规模变化的趋势。

Result: LLM的错误韧性随模型增大而增加而非退化；模型学会在"好"纠错码内计算，其相对开销无论模型多大都保持有限。

Conclusion: 作者猜想经过适当训练的LLM可能具有形式化容错性；若成立，在低能耗故障硬件上运行AI推理可能带来远高于现状的显著节能。

Abstract: Emerging computer hardware often trades reliability for energy efficiency; here we show that large-language models (LLMs) can be trained to tolerate this unreliability, and that rather than degrading, their error resilience actually increases as they grow. Modified neural scaling laws inferred from 40,000 GPU-hours of training runs on simulated faulty digital hardware quantify this trend and suggest that models learn to compute within "good" error-correcting codes, whose relative overhead remains finite no matter how large the model gets. This finding leads us to conjecture that appropriately trained LLMs may be formally fault-tolerant; if true, running AI inference on low energy, faulty hardware may be a path to substantial energy savings over the status quo.

</details>


### [315] [A Good Self-Teacher Meets the Student Where They Are: Joint On-Policy Learning and Teaching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10447)
*Randy Ardywibowo,Arnav Dalal,Jiantao Jiao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出JOLT方法，通过联合训练单一策略担任特权教师和无特权学生两个角色，解决自蒸馏中特权信息导致的监督错配问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 强化学习依赖稀疏的结果奖励，在长时程困难任务上成功轨迹稀少且昂贵；在线策略蒸馏（OPD）虽提供密集令牌级监督，但自蒸馏中特权条件可能使教师走"捷径"，产生与学生当前能力不匹配的监督，甚至导致性能下降。因此需要分析特权教师选择对学生更新的影响。

Method: 推导教师局部蒸馏更新成为学生奖励梯度正倍数的充要条件，说明教师不仅需任务表现好，还需匹配学生当前能力；据此设计教师训练代理目标，将结果奖励与对学生令牌级KL正则结合，提出JOLT——联合训练单一策略，一为使用KL正则目标训练的特权教师，一为使用密集在线策略蒸馏的无特权学生。

Result: 在数学推理、编程、工具使用和终端使用等任务上，JOLT提升了训练效率和性能，并从学生奖励中获得额外增益。

Conclusion: 特权条件本身不能保证蒸馏更新有益；通过充要条件刻画可知教师应提供适配学生能力与有效梯度对齐的指导，JOLT据此实现高效自蒸馏训练。

Abstract: Reinforcement Learning (RL) from outcome rewards suffers from sparse supervision, particularly on difficult, long-horizon tasks where successful trajectories are rare and costly to generate. On-Policy Distillation (OPD) offers an attractive alternative by providing dense token-level supervision from a stronger teacher along the student's own generations. Self-distillation methods further remove the need for a separate teacher model by conditioning the same policy on privileged information to serve as its own teacher. However, privileged conditioning alone does not guarantee that the resulting distillation update improves the student. Indeed, privileged information can lead the teacher to solve tasks through shortcuts unavailable to the student, producing supervision poorly matched to the student's current behavior. Consequently, even a higher-performing teacher can provide guidance that degrades student performance. To address this, we analyze how the choice of privileged teacher affects the student's update. We derive a necessary and sufficient condition for the teacher's local distillation update to be a positive multiple of the student's reward gradient. Our analysis suggests that the teacher should not only perform well on the task, but also provide guidance suited to the student's current capabilities. This characterization motivates a practical teacher-training surrogate that combines outcome rewards with token-level Kullback-Leibler (KL) regularization toward the student. Based on this result, we propose Joint On-Policy Learning and Teaching (JOLT), which jointly trains a single policy in two roles: a privileged teacher using a KL-regularized objective, and an unprivileged student using dense on-policy distillation. Across mathematical reasoning, coding, tool use, and terminal use, JOLT improves training efficiency and performance, with further gains from student rewards.

</details>


### [316] [Composing What Each Teacher Learned: Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation through Teacher-Relative Shifts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10460)
*Hejian Sang,Zhengze Zhou,Shayan Mohajer Hamidi,Xiaomin Li,Rohit Jain,Alborz Geramifard*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 Δ-MOPD，将多教师在线策略蒸馏中的监督目标从教师端点策略改为"教师减基座"的 logit 位移，并在学生冻结初始化处重新锚定，从而避免继承自教师基座的偏好干扰。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多教师在线策略蒸馏（MOPD）通常迁移每个教师的端点策略，而端点策略混合了后训练带来的变化与教师基座继承的偏好。作者发现，继承的基座牵引可能超过后训练位移，这一机制会阻碍端点迁移，因此需要一种只迁移后训练变化的目标构造方式。

Method: 提出 Δ-MOPD：不再迁移教师端点策略，而是迁移"教师减其基座"的 logit 位移，并将该位移重新锚定在学生冻结的初始化上。在保持教师选择固定的前提下，与端点监督在共同域组合与路由域蒸馏两类设置中进行对比，并考察三教师组合、两教师组合、分阶段路由（两种阶段顺序）、交错路由（每次更新仅涉及一个教师）等场景。

Result: 机制上，去除继承基座牵引后，教师项范数比与目标—学生 KL 均下降。效果上，三教师组合时 Δ-MOPD 比端点组合高 4.11 分（Math）与 1.95 分（五基准）；两教师时与端点精度相当。分阶段路由下，两种阶段顺序的平均性能均更高，顺序差距从 10.50 分降至 6.42 分。交错路由下两种目标表现相当。

Conclusion: 目标构造是多教师在线策略蒸馏中一个独立的设计维度，与教师选择互补。当教师信号在同一状态被组合时，位移目标尤为有效；分阶段路由结果支持该收益可能扩展到跨训练阶段累积的信号。

Abstract: Multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) is used in two settings. In common-domain composition, several teachers score each student rollout from one prompt domain and their signals form a single target; in routed-domain distillation, prompts from different domains are assigned to the corresponding specialist. Both settings usually transfer each teacher's endpoint policy, which mixes what post-training changed with preferences inherited from the teacher's base. We introduce $Δ$-MOPD, which transfers each teacher's teacher-minus-base logit shift re-anchored at the student's frozen initialization, and compare it with endpoint supervision in both settings while holding teacher selection fixed. We first expose the mechanism that impedes endpoint transfer: inherited base pull can exceed the post-training shift. Removing it reduces the teacher-term norm ratio and target--student KL.
  Across our experiments, the results suggest that shift targets are particularly useful when teacher signals are combined at a state. With three composed teachers, $Δ$-MOPD exceeds endpoint composition by $4.11$ Math and $1.95$ five-benchmark points; with two, it matches endpoint accuracy. Under phased routing, it achieves higher mean performance in both phase orders and reduces the observed order gap from $10.50$ to $6.42$ points. Under interleaved routing, where each update involves one teacher, the two targets perform comparably. The phased results provide supporting evidence that the benefit may extend to signals accumulated across training phases. Target construction is thus an independent design axis in MOPD, complementary to teacher selection.

</details>


### [317] [Decoupling Exploration from Optimization in RLVR](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10536)
*Saif Punjwani,Micah Goldblum*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 Exploration-Distillation (ExpDis) 框架，将探索与优化解耦：用带新颖性奖励的 explorer 策略采样轨迹，经正确性与质量过滤后蒸馏到独立 student 策略，student 不带新颖性奖励训练，多轮交替探索与优化，在数学推理任务上以相同训练预算超越 DAPO。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RLVR 的核心承诺是发现新的推理策略，使模型能采样先验训练数据中不存在的新想法。但实践中直接给 RLVR 加入强新颖性激励效果有限，甚至会损害模型质量。原因在于可验证奖励只监督模型知识与行为的狭窄部分，一旦质量退化便难以恢复。因此需要一种既能激进扩展探索、又不牺牲学生策略质量的机制。

Method: 提出 ExpDis（Exploration-Distillation）框架，将探索与优化解耦。具体流程：1）训练一个或多个 explorer 策略，在奖励中引入新颖性 bonus 以鼓励探索；2）对其产生的轨迹进行正确性与质量过滤；3）将过滤后的轨迹蒸馏到独立的 student 策略；4）student 策略训练时不使用新颖性奖励；5）多轮重复上述过程，交替进行探索与优化。

Result: 在七个数学推理基准和两个模型家族上，ExpDis 在相同 wall-clock 预算下优于 DAPO；同时观察到 pass@k 扩展性提升，表明 ExpDis 训练出的模型能生成更多样化的正确解。

Conclusion: 将探索与优化解耦可有效规避新颖性激励导致的质量退化，使探索可以激进扩展而不损害学生策略，从而在推理任务上带来更优性能与更强的多样性 scaling。

Abstract: Modern language models undergo reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) on top of already-trained checkpoints. A key promise of RLVR is the discovery of new reasoning strategies. In principle, a model can sample novel ideas absent from its prior training data. In practice, however, augmenting RLVR with strong novelty incentives has seen limited success and can degrade model quality. Because verifiable rewards supervise only a narrow slice of the model's knowledge and behavior, such degradations are difficult to recover from. Instead, we decouple exploration from optimization in a framework we call Exploration-Distillation (ExpDis). We train one or more explorer policies with a novelty bonus in the reward, filter their trajectories for correctness and quality, and distill them into a separate student policy. The student policy is then trained without a novelty bonus. We repeat the above procedure for several rounds, alternating between exploration and optimization. This decoupling allows us to aggressively scale exploration without degrading the student policy. Across seven mathematical reasoning benchmarks and two model families, ExpDis outperforms DAPO at the same wall-clock budget. Moreover, we observe improved pass@$k$ scaling, indicating that ExpDis produces models that generate more diverse correct solutions.

</details>


### [318] [Multi-Label Topic Assignment via LLM Distillation: A Comparative Analysis of Generative vs. Discriminative Student Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09063)
*Sourabh Kasliwal,Shubhranshu Singh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文评估了在电商UGC多标签主题分类任务中，不同规模SLM（1B/4B/8B）与不同架构范式（生成式 vs 判别式）的权衡关系，并报告了生产部署结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模电商UGC（产品评论与买卖对话）的多标签主题标注面临语言非正式、标签极度稀疏、分类体系快速演化等可扩展性挑战。用LLM作为标注预言机蒸馏训练数据已成为业界标准做法，但学生模型应采用何种低延迟最优架构仍是未解问题。

Method: 在SLM参数规模（1B、4B、8B）与架构范式（因果生成式 vs 双向判别式）两个维度上开展系统评测。将生成式"文本到标签"分类器与判别式基线（DeBERTa-V3、ModernBERT）进行对比，并在标签集大幅扩展（最多112个主题）和严重长尾分布条件下考察性能。

Result: 发现数据依赖的关键权衡：在结构化产品评论上判别式模型优于超轻量生成式模型；但在复杂多轮对话数据上，即便最小的1B生成式模型也超过判别式基线。生成式模型在标签集大规模扩展和严重长尾分布下保持稳健，而判别式基线在规模扩展时Macro-F1下降35%。

Conclusion: 这些优化模型已在产品评论与对话两个领域成功投入生产部署，满足严格的延迟要求，并在全球市场级规模下产生可衡量的业务收益。

Abstract: Multi-label topic assignment for user-generated content (UGC) -- including product reviews and buyer-seller conversations -- poses unique scalability challenges in large-scale e-commerce due to informal language, extreme label sparsity, and rapidly evolving taxonomies. While utilizing Large Language Models (LLMs) as labeling oracles to distill ground-truth data has emerged as an industry standard to bypass prohibitive manual annotation costs, determining the optimal, low-latency architecture for the resulting student models remains an open challenge. To address this, we conduct a comprehensive evaluation across Small Language Model (SLM) parameter scales (1B, 4B, and 8B) and architectural paradigms (causal generative versus bidirectional discriminative). Comparing generative text-to-label classifiers against discriminative baselines (DeBERTa-V3 and ModernBERT), our analysis reveals a crucial data-dependent trade-off: while discriminative models outperform ultra-lightweight generative models on structured product reviews, even the smallest 1B generative model surpasses discriminative baselines on complex, multi-turn conversational data. Furthermore, generative models maintain robust performance under massive label-set expansion (up to 112 topics) and severe long-tail distributions, whereas discriminative baselines suffer a 35% drop in Macro-F1 at scale. Finally, we detail the successful production deployment of these optimized models across both product review and conversational domains, demonstrating strict latency compliance and tangible business impact at a global marketplace scale.

</details>


### [319] [Noise Your Prompt: Noising Conditioning Tokens in Continuous Diffusion Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09145)
*Justin Jung*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出对连续扩散语言模型的训练目标做一行修改：训练时也对条件提示词token加噪，从而在组合推理任务上取得更好泛化与更高多样性，但在部分自然语言任务上增益不通用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 连续扩散语言模型文献中通常固定（保持干净）条件提示词token进行训练，作者质疑这一默认做法，探索训练时对提示词token加噪是否能提升泛化与生成多样性。

Method: 在训练目标上做单行改动：不再固定条件提示词token为干净状态，而是在训练过程中同样对其加噪；默认不增加推理成本，并支持类似classifier-free guidance的引导采样。

Result: 在组合推理任务上提升显著：Sudoku Hard求解率由3.73%升至24.65%，10x10 N-Queens覆盖率由50.60%升至73.79%；在Gigaword摘要的中小数据集设定下有可测的提升；但增益未迁移到所有自然语言任务（如开放式对话生成）。

Conclusion: 对条件提示词token加噪是一种简单、低成本且有效的训练目标修改，能提升组合推理泛化与解多样性，并在部分自然语言生成任务上有效，但并非对所有自然语言任务通用；代码已公开。

Abstract: We revisit a standard accepted practice in the continuous diffusion language model
  literature of fixing conditioning prompt tokens clean during training.
  We make a very simple modification: also noise the conditioning prompt tokens during training.
  We demonstrate that under this modified training objective, we achieve better generalization
  in combinatorial reasoning tasks such as Sudoku and N-Queens, with the largest gains on harder variants
  ($3.73\% \to 24.65\%$ solve rate on Sudoku Hard), and increased diversity of generated solutions ($50.60\% \to 73.79\%$ coverage on
  10x10 N-Queens). We also show measurable improvements to natural language generation quality
  in modest dataset regimes with Gigaword summarization, but notably demonstrate that gains do not
  transfer to all natural language tasks (e.g open ended dialogue generation).
  Our method is a single line change to the training objective, requires no additional inference costs by default,
  and provides the flexibility of classifier-free guidance inspired guided sampling. Our
  \href{https://github.com/LateralIntelligence/noise-your-prompt} {code} is publicly available.

</details>


### [320] [CHASE: Channel-Aligned Structure Exploitation for Geometry-Aware Model Engineering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09476)
*Wei Wang,Wei Jiang,Ziran Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 CHASE，将 GSA（几何与谱对齐）刻画出的网络结构直接用于模型设计，涵盖微调、补偿、合并、KV 共享、KV 缓存压缩与结构化剪枝六类应用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GSA 已能从谱集中、物理通道对齐、支撑结构与奇异基变化等角度刻画训练后的网络，但这些结构尚未被用于实际的模型设计。作者希望验证这些结构能否被直接利用，形成一套可复用的方法论。

Method: 提出 CHASE（Channel-Aligned Structure Exploitation）框架，包含六个应用：CORA（参数高效微调）、COEC（结构化剪枝补偿）、CORAM（模型合并）沿用 GSA 结构；另提出三个新方法——CAGA 通过几何对齐与低秩子空间提取，识别可共享 KV 表示的多头注意力头并构造共享 K/V 头；SAKV 用 GSA 判断可共享低秩 KV-cache 表示的相邻层及每组保留秩；CAPS 依据谱结构对输出神经元分组，并为每组分别选择保留的输入通道。

Result: CORA、COEC、CORAM 的结果验证了 GSA 在适配、剪枝补偿与模型合并上的有效性。CAGA 的几何共享头构造显著改善 MHA 到 GQA 的转换；SAKV 与 CAPS 在 KV-cache 压缩和结构化剪枝上优于代表性基线。

Conclusion: GSA 所识别的结构可直接用于设计多种模型操作的方法，说明该结构刻画具有跨任务的可迁移性与实用性。

Abstract: Geometric and Spectral Alignment (GSA) characterizes trained networks through spectral concentration, physical-channel alignment, support structure, and changes in singular bases. In this paper, we propose CHASE (Channel-Aligned Structure Exploitation) to use these structures in practical model design. CHASE covers six applications across model modification, reconfiguration, and compression. CORA, COEC, and CORAM apply GSA to parameter-efficient finetuning, structured-pruning compensation, and model merging. We further develop three new methods. CAGA uses GSA to identify multi-head attention heads that can share a KV representation and constructs the shared key and value heads through geometric alignment and low-rank subspace extraction. SAKV uses GSA to determine which adjacent layers can share a low-rank KV-cache representation and the retained rank for each layer group. CAPS uses GSA spectral structure to group output neurons and selects retained input channels separately for each group. Results from CORA, COEC, and CORAM establish the effectiveness of GSA for adaptation, pruning compensation, and model merging. Experiments on CAGA show that geometric shared-head construction substantially improves MHA-to-GQA conversion, and SAKV and CAPS improve over representative baselines for KV-cache compression and structured pruning. These results show that the structures identified by GSA can be used directly to design methods for a range of model operations.

</details>


### [321] [When Rank Rises as LLMs Degrade](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09647)
*Zhaohui Geoffrey Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文质疑"表征退化必然导致秩下降"的假设，发现在LLM后训练中数据重复会同时恶化损失并抬升RankMe与协方差有效秩，即出现"谱弥散"而非坍缩，并指出监测方向依赖具体"机制–统计量"组合，双通道顺序监测可诊断失效类型但不能早于留出损失报警。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实践中常用RankMe等谱统计量监测表征健康度，并默认秩下降即表征退化（单向监测）。作者要检验该假设在LLM后训练的非平稳环境下是否安全。

Method: 以Qwen3-0.6B为对象，设置四种退化模式、三个随机种子进行受控研究；对比原始RankMe、中心化RankMe、k95与协方差有效秩等统计量；区分RankMe（归一化奇异值）与协方差有效秩（归一化特征值）的定义差异，并在预训练模型原始中间层状态上检验二者对massive activations的敏感性；设计双侧、多通道顺序监测器，采用独立校准与测试数据，并进行预注册的共享前缀、留一种子评估。

Result: 数据重复使留出损失相对健康状态恶化75%，同时原始与中心化RankMe均上升，后者变化达13.5个合并标准差，协方差有效秩升至健康值近两倍；单向监测会把最差检查点判为最健康。相反，学习率误配置会降低中心化RankMe与k95，而未中心化RankMe跨种子不一致。在预训练模型原始中间层状态上，massive activations使协方差有效秩被钉在约1/d，而RankMe仍保持可用动态范围。双侧多通道监测器在每一折中均能在分叉后10–60步内检出全部三种退化机制，并通过触发方向区分弥散型与秩下降型损伤。

Conclusion: 监测方向是"机制–统计量"配对的属性，无法仅靠重校准修正；谱监测可用于诊断失效机制，但不能早于留出损失提供预警，且有效性声明必须依赖留出的健康数据（两种子校准在留出健康种子上产生误报）。

Abstract: Post-training adapts language models in non-stationary environments. Practitioners monitor representation health with RankMe and related spectral statistics, often assuming that rank falls when representations degrade. We show that this assumption is unsafe for LLM post-training. In a controlled study of Qwen3-0.6B with four degradation modes and three seeds, data duplication worsens held-out loss by 75% relative to healthy while increasing both original and centred RankMe; the latter changes by 13.5 pooled standard deviations. Covariance effective rank rises to nearly twice its healthy value. This failure is spectral dispersion rather than collapse, so a one-sided monitor rates the worst checkpoint as the healthiest. By contrast, a learning-rate misconfiguration lowers centred RankMe and k95, while uncentred RankMe is inconsistent across seeds. Direction is therefore a property of the regime-statistic pair and cannot be fixed by recalibration alone. We also distinguish two often-conflated statistics: RankMe normalises singular values, whereas covariance effective rank normalises eigenvalues. On raw intermediate-layer states in the pretrained model, massive activations pin the latter near 1 out of dimension d while RankMe retains usable range. We then test a two-sided, multichannel sequential monitor with separate calibration and test data. In a pre-registered shared-prefix, leave-one-seed-out evaluation, it detects all three damage regimes in every fold 10 to 60 steps after the fork and separates dispersion from downward-rank damage by firing direction. However, it never precedes held-out probe loss, and calibration with two seeds produces false alarms on the held-out healthy seed.
