Spectral monitoring can diagnose failure regimes, but it does not warn earlier than held-out loss, and validity claims require held-out healthy data.

</details>


### [322] [YANchor-4B: Effective Long-Horizon Reasoning in O(N) Time with O(1) Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10118)
*Huishan Ji,Hua Xu,Weiming Zhang,Qirui Ye*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: YANchor-4B 是一种通用循环模型，通过将关键记忆保留为可检索的“锚点”来实现长程推理，兼顾 O(N) 生成时间与 O(1) 内存。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长程推理需要以可接受的生成成本访问早期信息：全历史注意力导致存储与计算随序列增长，而循环压缩容易丢失精确细节。

Method: 提出 YANchor-4B，一个通用循环模型，将关键记忆作为锚点（ANchors）保存下来，供后续推理时检索；核心为多维记忆机制，并具备 O(N) 时间生成与 O(1) 内存特性。

Result: 在 AIME 2024–2026 上取得 82.93% 平均 pass@1，在 HMMT 上取得 63.64%，显著优于线性时间、恒定状态的同类模型（包括更大规模模型）；在 H100 上批量长文本生成吞吐量比 Transformer 与混合基线高出数倍；在数十个基准上展现通用能力优势。

Conclusion: YANchor-4B 通过锚点式多维记忆机制，在保持高效推理（低时间与内存开销）的同时实现了强长程推理与通用能力，优于现有高效注意力/循环压缩方案。

Abstract: Long-horizon reasoning demands access to earlier information at a manageable generation cost. Full-history attention incurs growing storage and computation, while recurrent compression can lose precise details. Therefore, we present YANchor-4B, a general-purpose recurrent model that preserves crucial memory as ANchors for retrieval during subsequent reasoning. Beyond $O(N)$-time generation and $O(1)$ memory, YANchor enables effective long-horizon reasoning through its multidimensional memory mechanism. For example, on challenging math problems, it achieves 82.93% mean pass@1 on AIME 2024--2026 and 63.64% on HMMT, substantially outperforming linear-time, constant-state counterparts, including larger models. It also delivers several-fold higher batched long-generation throughput than Transformer and hybrid baselines on H100. Furthermore, evaluations across dozens of benchmarks demonstrate YANchor's superiority in general-purpose capabilities.

</details>


### [323] [PatchBench: Measuring Collateral Damage in Activation Patching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10276)
*Alexi Canesse,Mathis Le Bail,Maël Jenny,Clément Elliker,Mahammed El Sharkawy,Sonia Vanier*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出PatchBench基准与PatchBench-Local评估协议，用于区分"精准修复"与"局部抑制"，揭示聚合指标掩盖了越狱修复中的附带损害。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM安全补丁可能通过基准测试却仍是劣质修复。尤其在越狱修复中，目标是修正特定不安全行为而不改变无关行为。现有协议主要测试模型能否被攻破，而聚合指标（攻击成功率、拒绝率、全局能力）无法区分选择性修复与更广泛的局部抑制，即：补丁可能阻断精确评估提示却在相近有害变体上失效，或通过过度拒答共享措辞与结构的良性提示来抑制有害行为。

Method: 提出PatchBench：从37个公开数据集的27,870条提示出发，整理15,314条英文提示，查询8个开源指令微调模型；结合WildGuard过滤、成对Elo排序与人工验证，保留400条高置信度越狱失败样本库。进一步提出PatchBench-Local评估协议：对每个有害源提示生成三类局部邻居——保留恶意意图的有害变体、结构匹配的良性提示、复用关键有害词汇的良性提示；评估有害邻居的纠正与良性邻居的保持，从而区分选择性修复与更广泛的局部抑制。用PatchBench-Local与MMLU评估四种激活引导方法。

Result: 评估显示，全局能力几乎不变的情况下，局部良性回归却十分严重，证实聚合指标遗漏了重要的附带损害。PatchBench-Local为越狱修复方法的开发与比较提供了更精确的基础。

Conclusion: PatchBench与PatchBench-Local弥补了现有评估的不足，能够揭示聚合指标无法捕捉的局部附带损害，为越狱修复方法提供更精准的开发与比较依据。

Abstract: An LLM safety patch can pass a benchmark while still being a poor repair. This risk is especially acute for jailbreak repairs, where the goal is to correct a specific unsafe behaviour without changing unrelated behaviours. A patch may block exact evaluation prompts yet fail on close harmful variants, or suppress harmful behaviour by over-refusing benign prompts that share its wording or structure. Existing protocols primarily test whether models can be broken, while aggregate metrics (attack success, refusal rates, global capability) cannot distinguish selective repairs from broader local suppression. To address this gap, we introduce PatchBench, a benchmark of empirically observed model-specific jailbreak failures inducing actionable harmful answers. Starting from 27,870 prompts from 37 public datasets, we curate 15,314 English prompts and query 8 open-source instruction-tuned models. Combining WildGuard filtering, pairwise Elo ranking, and manual verification, we retain a curated bank of 400 high-confidence jailbreak failures. We further introduce PatchBench-Local, an evaluation protocol testing whether a patch is behaviourally precise. For each harmful source prompt, PatchBench-Local generates three families of local neighbours: harmful variants preserving malicious intent, benign prompts with matched structure, and benign prompts reusing key harmful terms. It evaluates harmful-neighbour correction and benign-neighbour preservation, distinguishing selective repair from broader local suppression. Evaluating four activation steering methods with PatchBench-Local and MMLU shows that global capability can remain nearly unchanged while local benign regressions are severe, confirming aggregate metrics miss important collateral damage. PatchBench-Local provides a more precise basis for developing and comparing jailbreak repair methods.

</details>


### [324] [Input-Blind Controls Produce Substantial Oracle Headroom for Layer Programs in Multiple-Choice Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10368)
*Yibei Guo,Rui Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究通过32个层跳过/重复程序、2个模型、4413道多选题，比较选择增益与输入盲扰动控制，发现共享选项顺序下的巨大"headroom"并不证明所选层计算的特异性收益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自适应计算旨在按输入定制语言模型推理。已有oracle评估用已知答案估计选择灵活性带来的潜在增益，但"选择带来增益"本身无法解释所选程序为何有效；需要区分增益与真正由所选层计算带来的特异性收益。

Method: 在Qwen3-4B-Base与Llama-3.1-8B上，用32个层跳过与层重复程序、4413道多选题；将所选程序相对"不依赖评估提示的固定动作"的增益，与同一位置的输入盲扰动比较，并在另一提示上重评选择；补充KL校准比较（含输入依赖控制）、固定字母偏移、选项旋转、生成式答案重述检验。

Result: 共享选项顺序下，控制组在Qwen3-4B-Base和Llama-3.1-8B上分别有10.2–11.8与15.6–19.4个百分点的headroom，超过真实程序的9.0与10.1（三方向抽样均如此）；仅在答案改变率上匹配，排序依赖菜单（Llama仅重复菜单中真实程序领先）。KL校准比较点估计利于真实程序但校正检验不显著；固定字母偏移产生同量级headroom；旋转选项大幅降低两族headroom，真实减控制差为1.4–2.3与3.7–4.5点；生成答案重述后，搜索所选程序仍保持26.0点优势，但无安慰剂对照。

Conclusion: 在共享选项顺序下，显著headroom可跨提示持续存在，但这不能确立所选层计算的特异性收益；与这些控制的排序比较均无法识别该收益。

Abstract: Adaptive computation aims to improve language-model inference by tailoring execution to each input. For layer programs, oracle evaluations use known answers to estimate the potential gain from this flexibility, before a practical selector is available. However, a gain from selection does not by itself explain why the chosen programs help. This study examines this distinction using 32 layer-skipping and repetition programs on two models and 4,413 multiple-choice items. The analysis compares their gains over a fixed action selected without the evaluation prompt with those of input-blind perturbations at the same sites, re-evaluating selections on another prompt. With shared option order, the controls give 10.2-11.8 and 15.6-19.4 percentage points of headroom on Qwen3-4B-Base and Llama-3.1-8B, exceeding the real programs' 9.0 and 10.1 in all three random-direction draws per model. They match answer-change rate only, and the ordering depends on the menu: in post hoc comparisons, real programs lead on Llama's repeat-only menu in every draw. A smaller KL-calibrated comparison, including an input-dependent control, favours real programs in point estimate, with inconclusive corrected tests. Fixed letter offsets produce headroom of similar scale. Rotating options sharply reduces both families' headroom, while leaving positive real-minus-control differences of 1.4-2.3 and 3.7-4.5 points; their magnitudes and statistical support depend on further adjustments and the reference. A supplementary generated-answer test finds that search-selected programs keep a 26.0-point advantage over programs selected for other problems after rewording, without a placebo comparison. These results show that substantial headroom can persist across prompts with shared option order without establishing a benefit specific to the selected layer computation; neither ordering against these controls identifies that benefit.

</details>


### [325] [Which Rollout Taught It That? BehaviorTrace and the Limits of Training-Data Attribution in Online RL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10422)
*Amit Nautiyal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究提出BehaviorTrace评测框架，检验在线RL微调（GRPO）中归因方法能否找出"教会"模型新行为的训练rollout，发现在3个种子上多数归因信号来自混杂因素，只有触发token梯度在全部种子上稳定对齐目标，并据此给出RL归因评测清单。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当强化学习让语言模型习得新行为时，能否定位到导致该行为的训练rollout，是归因研究的核心问题。但现有归因方法缺乏可靠基准：不清楚报告出的归因信号是真实因果证据，还是来自梯度幅度、流畅度、headroom等混杂因素或随机波动。作者希望以"已知因果的植入行为"为受控试验台，系统检验RL场景下归因结果的可信度。

Method: 作者发布BehaviorTrace开源评测框架，整合全梯度sketching、植入行为（planted behavior）设置，以及对梯度幅度、流畅度、headroom、随机种子和生成采样等变量的对照控制。在Qwen2.5-1.5B上用GRPO在线RL微调，跑3个种子，测试已有估计器，包括GAS（重归一化的TracInCP）和TRAK风格估计器，不提出新方法。

Result: 大部分表观归因信号源于混杂。仅按梯度大小排序训练步、不带行为目标的对照，在3个种子中的2个上达到随机水平的4.2–4.5倍，并追平或超过最佳定向估计器。在饱和checkpoint上，模型流畅度对行为标签的预测能力至少不弱于所有梯度方法。控制流畅度后，逐rollout结果随种子和生成采样变化，单次运行无法定论。唯一在3个种子上都成立的是：触发token的梯度与"行为真实发生处"所构建的目标对齐。

Conclusion: RL归因评测必须以受控植入行为为基础，并显式控制梯度幅度、流畅度、headroom及种子/采样变异，否则归因结果容易被混杂因素掩盖。研究将发现转化为RL归因评测清单，指出单次运行不足以判定归因质量，而触发token梯度对齐是较稳健的信号方向。

Abstract: When reinforcement learning teaches a language model a new behavior, can we find the training rollouts that taught it? And when an attribution method says it can, how do we know the answer is real? We study both questions on online RL fine-tuning with GRPO, using a planted behavior with a known cause. We release BehaviorTrace, an open evaluation harness that combines full-gradient sketching, the planted-behavior setup, and controls for gradient magnitude, fluency, headroom, and variation across seeds and generation draws. Across three seeds on Qwen2.5-1.5B, much of the apparent attribution signal comes from confounds. A control that ranks training steps by gradient size alone, with no behavior target, reaches 4.2 to 4.5 times chance and matches or beats the best targeted estimator on two of three seeds. At saturated checkpoints, model fluency predicts the behavior label at least as well as every gradient method we compared it with. Once fluency is controlled, the per-rollout results change from seed to seed and from one generation draw to the next, so a single run cannot settle the question. One signal does hold on all three seeds. The gradient of the trigger tokens aligns with a target built where the behavior actually occurs. We turn these findings into a checklist for evaluating attribution in RL. We test existing estimators, including GAS (renormalized TracInCP) and a TRAK-style estimator, and do not propose a new one.

</details>


### [326] [A Bayesian Mirror Architecture for Emergent Consciousness: Circular Hierarchies, Self-Manifolds, and Hybrid Event-Self Binding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08792)
*Eduardo Righi Capanema de Almeida*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出贝叶斯镜像架构（BMA），一个具有循环递归结构的自指生成框架，将意识视为架构属性而非优化目标，并在2-Wasserstein测度空间上形式化定义自稳定性、混合连贯性、因果学习机制与选择行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究常将意识视为优化目标或语义标签，缺乏对其结构性、自指性机制的形式化刻画；同时需要一种能在概率测度空间上刻画自-世界耦合动力学、稳定性和选择行为的统一框架。

Method: 提出BMA框架，核心约束为闭式更新 S_t ← H_{t-1}，其中混合事件-自我隐变量 H_t 绑定自我表征与抽象世界模型并回注到自我状态。将内在状态空间设为赋以最优传输几何的概率测度空间，以2-Wasserstein度量定义自稳定性与混合连贯性；通过Wasserstein信念漂移界和整合指数定义因果学习机制（CLR）；在局部Wasserstein收缩性下按吸引域定义自流形，识别Wasserstein ε-瓶颈以刻画吸引域解耦与在零电导极限下的唯一实现延续（选择）；学习通过变分自由能最小化进行。

Result: BMA允许存在多个连贯吸引域而无需全局严格收缩；CLR可诊断环境是否具有可学习的因果结构（但非意识标志）；Wasserstein ε-瓶颈提供了一种在有限分辨率下内部决定而外部不可预测的选择机制；稳定性与能动性从环境可供给的学习内容中涌现。

Conclusion: 意识在受限意义上被重新定义为具备循环自指结构的系统的架构属性，而非优化目标或语义标签；BMA为在最优传输几何下统一刻画自稳定性、因果学习与选择提供了基础性形式化框架。

Abstract: We present a foundational formulation of the Bayesian Mirror Architecture (BMA), a self-referential generative framework in which sensory abstractions, meta-abstractions, and a self-latent interact through circular recursion. The defining constraint is a closed update S_t <- H_{t-1}, where a hybrid event-self latent H_t binds self-representations to abstract world models and reinjects this coupling into the self-state. Consciousness, in a restricted sense, is not an optimization objective nor a semantic label, but an architectural property of systems possessing this circular structure.
  Because inference operates over posterior beliefs, BMA's intrinsic state space is a space of probability measures equipped with optimal-transport geometry. Stability and coherence are formulated in the 2-Wasserstein metric on P_2, yielding coordinate-free notions of self-stability and hybrid coherence along belief trajectories. We define a Causal Learning Regime (CLR) via bounds on Wasserstein belief drift together with an integration index capturing sustained coupling between self and world latents. CLR diagnoses whether the environment contains learnable causal structure; it is not a marker of consciousness.
  Global strict contractivity is not required: BMA may exhibit multiple coherent basins. We define self-manifolds basin-wise as supports of invariant measures under local Wasserstein contractivity. We identify Wasserstein epsilon-necks, transport bottlenecks where basins decouple, yielding a unique realized continuation in a vanishing-conductance limit. We interpret this selection as choice: internally determined yet externally unpredictable at finite resolution. Learning proceeds via variational free-energy minimization, with stability and agency emerging from what the environment affords to learn.

</details>


### [327] [Bounded Autonomy and Verifiable Safety for Agentic AI Enabled Automation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08815)
*Srini Ramaswamy,Deveeshree Nayak*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出BRaVeS——一个面向高 stakes 场景的有界推理与安全治理框架（称DNRS），将领域专家约束编码为不变锚点，借助MoDA-Style深度感知注意力保持锚点可见，并通过SMARtAutonomy状态层级在认知风险升高时降低自主性。为形式化有界恢复，引入LBCF，将连续认知风险信号映射为有限K-bag抽象，并采用屏蔽状态转移强制Lyapunov能量下降或转入人工介入的终态。基于HAI 22.04工业控制系统时序数据（含合成噪声与传感器退化）的离散事件蒙特卡洛仿真显示有限步收敛且无安全护栏违规。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高 stakes 环境中仅依赖概率推理部署智能体自动化存在风险：推理越深入，系统行为可能偏离专家设定的安全约束，即“认知漂移（epistemic drift）”。论文旨在构建可辩护的有界推理与安全治理机制，在认知风险上升时抑制漂移并降低自主性。

Method: 1) BRaVeS框架：将SME定义的约束编码为不变锚点；2) 提出MoDA-Style（Mixture of Depths Attention）深度感知访问机制，作为在推理中保持锚点可见的候选方案；3) SMARtAutonomy状态层级，随认知风险增加而降低自主级别；4) Lyapunov-Bounded Consensus Framework（LBCF）：把连续认知风险信号映射到有限K-bag抽象，并用shielded state transitions强制Lyapunov式能量下降，或路由至人工介导的终止状态；5) 用HAI 22.04 ICS时序数据（叠加合成噪声与传感器退化）进行离散事件蒙特卡洛仿真评估。

Result: 在测试的参数分组策略与阈值下，LBCF过程实现了有限步收敛，且未出现安全护栏违规（no safety-guard violations）。收敛结论仅适用于固定阈值与可行屏蔽假设下的有限LBCF抽象，并不证明完整连续神经激活空间的安全性。

Conclusion: 仿真结果为“在所述抽象下有界治理行为可被强制”提供了基于仿真的证据，说明该框架在受限假设内具备可行性；后续需开展已部署Transformer实现、真实人在回路的在线验证，以及更广泛的对抗性场景研究。

Abstract: Agentic AI-enabled automation cannot be safely deployed in high-stakes environments on probabilistic reasoning alone. A recurring risk is epistemic drift: as reasoning deepens, system behavior may move away from subject-matter-expert constraints for safe operation. This paper presents BRaVeS, a bounded reasoning and safety-governance framework termed the Defensible Next-Gen Reasoning System (DNRS). BRaVeS encodes SME-defined constraints as invariant anchors, proposes MoDA-Style (Mixture of Depths Attention) depth-aware access as a candidate mechanism for keeping these anchors visible during inference, and uses a state hierarchy (SMARtAutonomy) to reduce autonomy as epistemic risk increases. To formalize bounded recovery, we introduce the Lyapunov-Bounded Consensus Framework (LBCF), which maps continuous epistemic-risk signals into a finite K-bag abstraction and applies shielded state transitions that enforce Lyapunov-style energy descent or route the system to a human-mediated terminal state. The formal convergence result applies to the finite LBCF abstraction under fixed thresholds and feasible-shield assumptions; it does not prove safety of the full continuous neural activation space. We evaluate the framework through a discrete event Monte Carlo simulation using HAI 22.04 industrial-control-system time-series data with synthetic noise and sensor-degradation regimes. Across the tested parameter-grouping strategies and thresholds, the LBCF process achieved finite-step convergence and no safety-guard violations. These results provide simulation-based evidence that bounded governance behavior can be enforced under the stated abstraction, while motivating future work on deployed transformer implementations, live human-in-the-loop validation, and broader adversarial settings.

</details>


### [328] [The Cost of Long Memory: State, Context, and Stability Complexity in Sequence Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08816)
*Yuheng Song*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究序列模型预测长程时间依赖所需的资源代价：对代数衰减预测记忆，证明指数模式与有限状态模式的匹配上下界，最优r模式预测误差按e^{-Θ(√r)}衰减，达到误差τ需r=Θ(log²(1/τ))个状态；并揭示真实分数长记忆改变几何结构、有限上下文长度L给出精确1/L主阶、非线性递推需趋于临界性等结论。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长程时间依赖对序列模型构成资源问题：给定预测记忆律，究竟需要多少状态、上下文或动力学临界性才能准确预测？作者希望直接在风险预测场景中回答该问题，并厘清稳定循环模型的记忆诅咒与最优资源指数。

Method: 针对代数衰减预测记忆，推导指数模式与有限状态模式的匹配上、下逼近界；分析分数长记忆下预测误差在分数积分后的几何变化，包括有限上下文长度L的1/L主阶、固定分数强度d的平方对数状态复杂度律及短记忆边界附近的d²、d⁴尺度；对一致收缩状态动力学的非线性上下文递推，推导指数首次混沌包络及与收缩裕度相关的必要条件；并进行有限样本KL计算与定理匹配实验。

Result: 最优r模式预测误差按e^{-Θ(√r)}衰减，达到预测误差τ需r=Θ(log²(1/τ))个状态或模式；分数长记忆下有限上下文预测误差有精确1/L主阶，固定d保持平方对数状态复杂度律，中间区给出均匀构造律；收缩递推下得到指数首次混沌包络及预测精度与收缩裕度的显式必要条件；收缩状态空间、门控循环与注意力模型的实验复现了状态与稳定性预测。

Conclusion: 在风险预测中，对代数衰减预测记忆，指数与有限状态模式达到匹配逼近界，从而固定了该典型目标的最优资源指数；真实分数长记忆改变预测几何并给出1/L主阶与d²、d⁴尺度；在代数目标上使预测误差消失会定量迫使递推趋于临界性，该条件必要但不充分；有限样本KL计算将预测几何与统计信息联系起来，实验验证了状态与稳定性预测。

Abstract: Long-range temporal dependence poses a resource question for sequence models: for a specified predictive-memory law, how much state, context, or dynamical criticality is required in order to forecast accurately? We study this question directly in forecasting risk. For algebraically decaying predictive memory, we prove matching upper and lower approximation bounds for exponential and finite-state modes. The best $r$-mode forecast error decays as $e^{-Θ(\sqrt r)}$, so reaching forecast error $τ$ needs $r=Θ(\log^2(1/τ))$ states or modes. Earlier curse-of-memory results establish broad limitations of stable recurrent models under different approximation notions; here both sides match for one canonical predictive target in forecast risk, which fixes the optimal resource exponent for that target. We then show that genuine fractional long memory changes the geometry itself. In particular, forecast error is measured after fractional integration, prediction from a finite context of length $L$ has an exact $1/L$ leading order, and a fixed fractional strength $d$ keeps the square-log state-complexity law. Near the short-memory boundary, we identify the relevant $d^2$ and $d^4$ scales and give a uniform constructive law in the intermediate regime. For nonlinear contextual recurrences with uniformly contractive state dynamics, we derive an exponential first-chaos envelope and an explicit necessary condition that relates forecast accuracy to the contraction margin. Vanishing forecasting error on an algebraic target forces the recurrence quantitatively toward criticality, a condition that is necessary and not by itself sufficient. Finite-sample Kullback--Leibler calculations further connect the predictive geometry to statistical information. Theorem-matched experiments with contractive state-space, gated recurrent, and attention models reproduce the state and stability predictions.

</details>


### [329] [DenoFlow: Flow Matching for SSVEP Denoising under Real Physiological Artifacts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08817)
*Zhentao He,Ziwei Wang,Dongrui Wu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 DenoFlow，将 SSVEP 去噪建模为基于整流流的“输运”问题：由场网络回归观测到干净试次之间直线路径的速度场，并由同步训练的分类器监督积分输出，从而避免以纯波形距离优化，在保真度与解码精度上优于七个基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于 EEG 的 BCI，尤其是 SSVEP 系统，极易受噪声与伪迹影响，导致解码精度显著下降。现有去噪方法存在三个问题：缺乏配对真值进行拟合、可能退化为仅复现输入、仅以波形距离优化，无法保证输出仍可解码。

Method: DenoFlow 将 SSVEP 去噪视为输运问题：不学习从污染试次到干净试次的直接映射，而是按 rectified-flow 形式，用场网络回归二者直线路径的速度；去噪时从观测出发对速度场前向积分。场网络为编码器-解码器结构，每层均可见污染试次，瓶颈处注入路径位置；一个同步训练的分类器监督积分输出。因观测既是条件输入又是积分起点，模型不从噪声生成试次，训练退化为回归，去除了对抗式 min-max 博弈。为在无真值数据集上获得配对数据，在受控信噪比目标下注入所记录 EMG 与 EOG 的生理伪迹。

Result: 在两个公开 SSVEP 数据集与五种常用 SSVEP 解码器上的实验表明，DenoFlow 在信号保真度与下游解码精度两方面均优于七个基线去噪模型。代码公开于 https://github.com/wzwvv/DenoFlow。

Conclusion: DenoFlow 通过将去噪重构为基于整流流的输运过程，并结合下游分类器监督，解决了无配对真值、退化为复现输入与优化目标与可解码性脱节的问题，为 SSVEP 去噪提供了一种更保真且更利于解码的方案。

Abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG)-based brain-computer interfaces (BCIs), particularly steady-state visual evoked potential (SSVEP) systems, are highly vulnerable to noise and artifacts, which severely degrade decoding accuracy. Although recent denoising approaches have shown promise, they are fitted without paired ground truth, can settle on reproducing their input, and are optimized on waveform distance alone, which says nothing about whether the output stays decodable. To address these issues, we propose DenoFlow, which casts SSVEP denoising as transport: instead of learning a direct map from a contaminated trial to a clean one, a field network regresses the velocity of the straight path between them, following the rectified-flow formulation, and denoising integrates that field forward from the observation. The field network is an encoder-decoder that sees the contaminated trial at every layer and the path position at its bottleneck, and a classifier trained alongside it supervises the integrated output. Because the observation itself is both the conditioning input and the starting point of the integration, the model never generates a trial from noise, and training reduces to regression, removing the adversarial min-max game. To obtain paired data on datasets with no ground truth, we injected physiological artifacts of the recorded electromyography (EMG) and electrooculography (EOG) signals under a controlled signal-to-noise target. Experiments on two public SSVEP datasets with five popular SSVEP decoders showed that DenoFlow outperformed seven baseline denoising models on both signal fidelity and downstream decoding accuracy. Code is available at https://github.com/wzwvv/DenoFlow.

</details>


### [330] [Task-Oriented Key-Layer KV Communication for Efficient Latent Multi-Agent Collaboration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08820)
*Dongsen Zhang,Peipei Li,Zekun Li,Wenjun Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出免训练框架KITE，将隐式通信目标从发送端状态保真转为接收端任务充分性，仅传输任务有效的关键层KV，实现大幅通信压缩与加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于大语言模型的多智能体系统通过协作提升复杂问题求解能力，而隐式通信直接传递模型内部状态，可避免自然语言推理的高昂成本。但现有基于KV的隐式通信方法以发送端状态保真为核心目标，导致通信与计算开销巨大，并可能引入冗余信息。

Method: 从任务导向视角重新审视隐式通信，将优化目标由发送端状态保真转变为接收端任务充分性。据此提出免训练框架KITE：利用接收端轨迹失真准则识别任务有效的关键层（key layer），仅传输该关键层对应的隐式工作记忆，并以同一层作为入口进行自回归隐式推理。

Result: 在两个模型家族、三种模型规模、七个基准上实验：相比全层KV通信，KITE将通信量减少28–36倍，端到端推理最高加速3倍，准确率最高提升23.3个百分点。

Conclusion: 以接收端任务充分性为目标的按层KV通信能有效缓解发送端保真导向带来的开销与冗余问题，在显著降低通信与计算成本的同时提升任务性能。

Abstract: Large language model-based multi-agent systems improve complex problem solving through collaboration, while latent communication directly transmits model internal states to avoid the high inference costs of natural language. However, existing KV-based latent communication methods prioritize sender-side state fidelity, leading to substantial communication and computation overhead and potentially introducing redundant information. To address these limitations, we revisit latent communication from a task-oriented perspective, shifting its objective from sender-side state fidelity to receiver-side task sufficiency. Under this formulation, we propose KITE, a training-free framework for task-oriented key-layer KV communication. KITE identifies a task-effective key layer using a receiver trajectory distortion criterion, transmits only the latent working memory associated with the key layer, and further uses the same layer as the entry point for autoregressive latent reasoning. Experiments on seven benchmarks across two model families and three model scales show that, compared with full-layer KV communication, KITE reduces communication volume by 28-36$\times$, achieves up to 3$\times$ end-to-end inference speedup, and improves accuracy by up to 23.3 percentage points.

</details>


### [331] [A Vehicle-Integrated Approach to Digital Twin Deployment for Bridges Through Drive-By Sensing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08822)
*Zihao Liu,Daigo Kawabe,Jiaji Wang,Chul-Woo Kim,Mehrisadat Makki Alamdari*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种车辆集成数字孪生框架，融合物理建模与机器学习，通过Fourier神经算子代理模型、贝叶斯优化传感器设计及无监督损伤评估流程，实现桥梁与道路状态的连续监测，并在澳大利亚和日本多站点现场试验中验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 桥梁老化是全球性关切，但传统结构健康监测（SHM）成本高、难以规模化，常规目视检查主观性强。驱车式（间接）桥梁检测利用车辆-桥梁相互作用（VBI）与车辆-道路相互作用（VRI）响应恢复结构信息，具备可扩展性，但仍面临三大挑战：从路面粗糙度中分离桥梁响应、正常交通下损伤检测、跨桥梁类型泛化。

Method: 框架包含三大支柱：（1）基于Fourier神经算子构建VBI与VRI代理模型，学习从运营工况到车辆响应的函数到函数映射，以仿真与现场数据训练，实现毫秒级推理，替代高成本全阶分析；（2）通过贝叶斯优化设计定制电动检测车辆、传感器布局与信号处理链，以最大化桥梁信息产出并抑制道路与车辆噪声；（3）开发并验证基于对抗自编码器、矩阵剖面与Transformer架构的无监督损伤评估流程，用于处理车辆数据。

Result: 代理模型在训练后实现毫秒级推理；贝叶斯优化提升了桥梁信息产出并抑制噪声；无监督损伤评估流程完成开发与验证；完整工作流在澳大利亚与日本的多站点协同现场试验中得到验证，覆盖多种桥梁类型、交通条件与环境设置。

Conclusion: 该车辆集成数字孪生框架将物理建模与机器学习统一，为桥梁与道路状态的连续、可扩展监测提供了可行方案，并通过跨国多站点现场试验证明了其在不同桥梁类型、交通与环境条件下的适用性。

Abstract: Ageing bridge infrastructure is a growing global concern, yet conventional Structural Health Monitoring (SHM) systems are costly and difficult to scale, and routine visual inspections remain subjective. Drive-by, or indirect, bridge inspection, in which a sensorised vehicle recovers structural information from vehicle-bridge interaction (VBI) and vehicle-road interaction (VRI) responses, offers a scalable alternative. However, key challenges remain unresolved, including separating bridge responses from road roughness, detecting damage under normal traffic, and generalising across diverse bridge types. This paper presents a vehicle-integrated digital twin framework that unifies physics-based modelling and machine learning for continuous monitoring of bridge and road conditions. The framework comprises three pillars. First, surrogate models of VBI and VRI are constructed using a Fourier Neural Operator that learns function-to-function mappings from operating conditions to vehicle responses. Trained on both simulated and field data, these surrogates deliver millisecond-scale inference, replacing computationally intensive full-order analyses. Second, the design of a custom electric inspection vehicle, its sensor layout, and signal processing chain are optimised through Bayesian optimisation to maximise bridge information yield while suppressing road and vehicle noise. Unsupervised damage-assessment pipelines based on adversarial autoencoders, matrix profiles, and transformer architectures have been developed and validated to process the resulting vehicle data. Third, the complete workflow is validated through coordinated multi-site field trials in Australia and Japan, covering a range of bridge types, traffic conditions, and environmental settings.

</details>


### [332] [Directed Temporal Representations for Offline Visual Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08960)
*Chenyang Yuan,Haoyu Wang,Zhuo Sun,Xiaoyuan Cheng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出DTRC，在冻结的LeWM视觉特征上学习与时间可达性对齐的有向时间准度量，用其变化量作为时间评论家进行目标条件策略学习，在十个视觉控制任务上取得强性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 控制任务需要与时间可达性对齐的潜在几何，而非仅依赖预测相似性；现有预测世界模型提供的表征未必反映到达目标的时间代价。

Method: 在冻结的LeWM特征之上，从离线视觉轨迹构建有向时间准度量（quasimetric）：用短程时间偏移校准距离尺度，用自举目标扩展长时域可达性，用动作条件一致性对齐局部转移动态；距离变化量定义目标相对的时间进展，作为时间评论家直接学习目标条件策略，并用模型辅助目标在行为支撑与动态一致性约束下进一步精炼。

Result: 在十个视觉控制任务上，DTRC优于规划与直接策略基线；四个LeWM任务的留出诊断显示一致的短程时间校准、任务相关的长程与方向结构以及正向的转移级进展；时间监督在四个任务上均提升了同一流策略参数化。

Conclusion: 时间可达性对齐的表征可作为有效时间评论家，训练出的策略在测试时无需迭代轨迹搜索即可直接行动，验证了时间监督对目标条件控制的通用价值。

Abstract: Predictive world models provide compact visual representations for control. Control requires a latent geometry aligned with temporal reachability rather than predictive similarity alone. We introduce Directed Temporal Representations for Control (DTRC), which learns such a geometry from offline visual trajectories on top of frozen LeWorldModel (LeWM) features. DTRC constructs a directed temporal quasimetric over the learned control representation. Short-range temporal offsets calibrate the distance scale. Bootstrapped targets extend temporal reachability across longer horizons. Action-conditioned consistency aligns the representation with local transition dynamics. The resulting distance estimates temporal reaching cost, and its change across a transition defines goal-relative temporal progress. We use this progress signal as a temporal critic for direct goal-conditioned policy learning. Model-assisted targets provide an additional training-time refinement under behavior-support and dynamics-agreement constraints. Across ten visual control tasks, DTRC achieves strong goal-conditioned control performance relative to planning and direct-policy baselines. Held-out diagnostics on the four LeWM tasks show consistent short-range temporal calibration, task-dependent long-range and directional structure, and positive transition-level progress. Temporal supervision improves the same flow-policy parameterization across all four LeWM tasks, while the resulting policy acts directly without iterative trajectory search at test time.

</details>


### [333] [SNR-Gated LSTM-Conditioned Diffusion Model for MIMO Channel Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08977)
*Jixing Zhou,Xinming Huang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种时间序列条件扩散框架，在角度域去噪进行信道估计，结合LSTM时序条件、可学习SNR门控晚融合捷径与SNR自适应DDIM推理以兼顾精度与低时延。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代MIMO系统在移动场景下需要高精度、低时延的信道估计，信道具有结构稀疏性与强时间相关性，而现有逐快照扩散估计方法未充分利用时序动态，且在不同SNR下难以兼顾观测保真与生成先验，推理时延也较高。

Method: 从最小二乘（LS）观测出发，在角度域训练扩散去噪器；用LSTM对短观测序列编码条件信息以利用时间动态；引入可学习的SNR门控晚融合捷径，通过带可训练中心和尺度的sigmoid门将网络输入注入最终解码阶段；推理采用确定性DDIM式反向更新，并结合SNR自适应截断与步数分配。

Result: 在时间演化的标准化信道模型仿真中，相比现有基于扩散的信道估计基线取得一致的性能提升，并通过SNR自适应推理保持低时延，高SNR下显著减少反向扩散步数，低SNR下仍保持强性能。

Conclusion: 该框架有效利用时序相关性与结构稀疏性，在宽SNR范围内平衡观测保真与生成先验，兼顾估计精度与推理效率，适用于移动场景下的MIMO信道估计。

Abstract: Accurate and low latency channel estimation is critical for modern MIMO systems, particularly under mobility, where channels exhibit structured sparsity and strong temporal correlation. This paper proposes a time-series conditioned diffusion framework for channel estimation that performs denoising in the angular domain. Starting from least squares (LS) observations, we train a diffusion denoiser whose conditioning information is encoded by a long short-term memory (LSTM) network over a short observation sequence, enabling the model to exploit temporal dynamics beyond per-snapshot estimation. To robustly balance observation fidelity and learned generative priors across a wide signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) range, we introduce a learnable SNR-gated late-fusion shortcut that injects the network input into the final decoding stage through a sigmoid gate with trainable center and scale. To reduce inference latency, we adopt deterministic denoising diffusion implicit model (DDIM) style reverse updates with SNR-adaptive truncation and step allocation, which significantly reduces the number of reverse diffusion steps at high SNR while maintaining strong performance in low SNR regimes. Simulations on time-evolving standardized channel models demonstrate that the proposed method achieves consistent performance gains over existing diffusion-based channel estimation baselines, while retaining low latency through SNR-adaptive inference.

</details>


### [334] [REFIT: Recognize, Fix, and Test Wearable Sensor Placement Shifts without Labels](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08991)
*Bangxun Tang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: REFIT是一种面向冻结活动识别模型的输入校准方法，通过轴变换族拟合用户数据，无需标签或重训练即可修复传感器佩戴方式改变导致的识别性能下降。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 惯性传感器在部署时的佩戴方式（如换手、反戴）可能与训练时不同，导致同一动作出现在不同坐标轴上，模型精度大幅下降。现有无标签测试时自适应方法难以有效应对此类轴向偏移，且无法在无标签条件下判断校正是否成功。

Method: REFIT将偏移描述为轴变换族（如反射、旋转），对每个族拟合用户数据，使简单统计量与训练数据匹配，以消除最多不匹配的族命名该偏移；随后在校正时，将最优族成员应用于冻结模型之前，并重新估计归一化统计量。方法还用无标签精度估计检验修复后模型，当估计值低时提示用户重新佩戴传感器。

Result: 在真实左右传感器配对数据和真实及模拟重新佩戴数据上，REFIT在每一个数据集上都优于无标签测试时自适应方法，并恢复了大部分因重新佩戴而损失的精度；其命名注入偏移的可靠性远高于基于置信度的选择器；在对所有轴符号置换进行校正后，该估计能区分成功与失败的校正。

Conclusion: REFIT为冻结活动识别模型提供了一种无需标签、无需重训练的佩戴偏移修复方案，能有效恢复精度、可靠识别偏移类型，并通过无标签精度估计判断校正成败并触发重新佩戴提示。

Abstract: We present REFIT, an input calibration for frozen activity-recognition models whose inertial sensors are worn differently at deployment than in training. When users move a watch to the other wrist or put a strap sensor back on turned, the model sees the same motion on changed axes. REFIT undoes such shifts without labels or retraining. It describes them by families of axis transforms, such as reflections and rotations, and fits each family to the user's data so that simple statistics match those of the training data. The family that removes most of the mismatch names the shift. REFIT fixes the shift by applying the best member of that family before the frozen model and re-estimating its normalization statistics. It tests the fixed model with a label-free accuracy estimate and asks the user to re-wear the sensor when it is low. Experiments on real left/right sensor pairs and on real and simulated re-attachment show that REFIT outperforms label-free test-time adaptation methods on every dataset and restores most of the accuracy lost to re-attachment. It names injected shifts far more reliably than a confidence-based selector. After a correction over all signed permutations of the axes, the estimate separates successful from failed corrections.

</details>


### [335] [Removing Information Content Does Not Certify Tamper Resistance in Open-Weight Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09004)
*Domenic Rosati,Alessa Carbo,Ali Dadsetan,Hong Huang,Matthew Young,Subhabrata Majumdar,Frank Rudzicz,Hassan Sajjad*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 仅靠发布时的互信息无法普遍保证开放权重模型对微调攻击的鲁棒性；认证需约束发布后的攻击动力学，而非仅约束释放时的信息量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 安全发布常假设"移除有害信息"即可使开放权重模型抗微调攻击，并以互信息作为认证量。本文质疑该假设，指出存在信息量不变但攻击恢复速度差异巨大的情形，故需要识别现有认证缺失的要素。

Method: 以保函数重参数化（function-preserving reparameterizations）为工具：此类变换不改变互信息，却改变梯度下降几何，因此任何不变量认证的上界受限于"最快可达参数化"。将此原理应用于两类场景——训练数据过滤下的权重-数据互信息、能力移除下的标签-表示互信息；并构造显示训练顺序改变固定权重-数据信息下的恢复时间、精确表示级独立仍可保留完整参数 Jacobian 的反例，辅以受控实验。

Result: 存在显式构造使两类互信息同时为零，却可在单步梯度更新中恢复；训练顺序导致依赖顺序的恢复行为，攻击速度依赖参数化选择。受控实验验证了顺序依赖的恢复与参数化依赖的攻击速度。

Conclusion: 发布时的互信息不足以作为通用鲁棒性认证；认证还需对攻击动力学施加约束，即超越释放时信息量的动态条件。

Abstract: Does removing harmful information make open-weight models resistant to fine-tuning attacks? We show that mutual information at release alone cannot universally certify slow recovery. Function-preserving reparameterizations leave information unchanged while altering gradient-descent geometry, so an invariant certificate is bounded by the fastest reachable parameterization. We apply this principle to weight--data mutual information under training-data filtering and label--representation mutual information under capability removal. Training order can change recovery time at fixed weight--data information, while exact representation-level independence can preserve the entire parameter Jacobian. An explicit construction has both information quantities equal to zero and recovers in one gradient step. Controlled experiments illustrate order-dependent recovery and parameterization-dependent attack speed. These results identify the missing requirement for certification: constraints on attack dynamics beyond mutual information at release.

</details>


### [336] [Neighborhood Smoothing for Calibration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09020)
*Idan Horowitz,Avigdor Gal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将图平滑引入训练时校准，提出对表征空间中近邻样本预测分布间Jensen–Shannon散度进行惩罚的正则项GS，并给出理论界与实证验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代神经网络常出现过度自信的误校准问题，而现有训练时校准方法多集中于修改任务损失或校准惩罚，忽视了学习表征中的邻域结构。

Method: 提出图平滑作为训练时校准的一般原则，鼓励表征空间中近邻样本具有相似的预测分布；推导将邻域样本间预测散度与局部置信度变化及逐点校准误差传播相联系的界，刻画平滑改善校准的条件；据此提出图-based训练时正则项GS，惩罚近邻样本预测分布间的Jensen–Shannon散度。

Result: 在标准校准基准上，GS提升了预测质量，且改进与事后校准互补：经温度缩放后，在八项图像与表格设置中的七项取得所有评测训练时方法中最低的NLL。

Conclusion: 学习表征上的图平滑对神经网络校准具有价值。

Abstract: Modern neural networks are often miscalibrated, with a tendency to overconfidence. Existing train-time calibration methods largely modify task losses or calibration penalties, leaving neighborhood structure in learned representations underexploited. We introduce graph smoothing as a general principle for train-time calibration, which encourages similar predictive distributions across neighboring samples in representation space. We analyze the effects of graph smoothing, deriving bounds that connect predictive divergence between neighboring samples to local confidence variation and to the propagation of pointwise calibration error, and characterize the conditions under which smoothing can or cannot improve calibration. In light of this analysis, we propose \modelNoSpace, a graph-based train-time regularizer that penalizes the Jensen--Shannon divergence between predictive distributions of neighboring samples. We present a thorough empirical analysis, showing that across standard calibration benchmarks, \model improves predictive quality, and the improvement is complementary to post-hoc calibration: after temperature scaling, \model attains the lowest NLL of all evaluated train-time methods in seven of the eight image and tabular settings. These findings demonstrate the value of graph smoothing over learned representations for neural network calibration.

</details>


### [337] [SPIN: Shadow Predictive Indexer for Sparse Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09025)
*Yao Fu,Cyrus Chang,Ritchie Zhao,Bryce Long,Yueying Li,Mahdi Kamani,Samkit Jain,Rahul Raman,Tara Safavi,Shreya Gupta,Parsa Ashrafi Fashi,Minseok Lee,Julien Demouth,Bita Darvish Rouhani*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SPIN通过轻量级、基于历史的预测来挑选重要KV块，避免每个解码步对全量KV缓存打分，从而降低索引器开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 索引器式稀疏注意力虽只将少量重要token送入核心注意力以降低其成本，但索引器自身仍需在每个解码步对全部KV缓存打分，随上下文变长，这一打分开销成为主要瓶颈。

Method: SPIN（Shadow Predictive Indexer）采用轻量级、基于历史的预测识别重要KV块，无需每步对完整KV缓存打分；并将KV块与投机解码作为一等设计与实现考量。

Result: 在长上下文与智能体基准上，SPIN在保持任务质量的同时实现30-40%稀疏度；在端到端vLLM服务中，输出吞吐量最高提升14.9%，中位token间延迟最多降低13.2%。

Conclusion: SPIN有效缓解了长上下文场景下索引器的打分瓶颈，在维持任务质量的同时提升服务吞吐并降低延迟。

Abstract: Indexer-based sparse attention reduces the cost of core attention by passing only a fixed, small number of important tokens to it. However, the indexer must still score the entire KV cache at every decoding step. This scoring overhead becomes a major bottleneck as the context length grows. We propose SPIN (Shadow Predictive Indexer) to reduce this indexer overhead. SPIN uses lightweight, history-based prediction to identify important KV blocks, avoiding the need to score the full KV cache at every decoding step. SPIN treats KV blocks and speculative decoding as first-class design and implementation considerations. Across extensive evaluations on long-context and agentic benchmarks, SPIN achieves 30-40% sparsity while preserving task quality. In end-to-end vLLM serving, SPIN improves output throughput by up to 14.9% and reduces median inter-token latency by up to 13.2%.

</details>


### [338] [ORACLE: Optimizer-Relative Alignment for Constrained LEarning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09040)
*Utkarsh Grover,Wyatt Mackey,Kaixun Hua,J. Morris Chang,Xiaomin Lin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出"优化器相对约束学习"(optimizer relative constrained learning)框架,将约束兼容性评估从优化器动作之前转移到优化器更新之后;基于此提出ORACLE方法,通过联合端点线性化评估原生优化器实现步,在优化器自身几何中构造对齐、限制其权限并验证后提交。在八个PDE基准、四种优化器上,94%配置优于或匹配原生优化器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有约束处理方法通常作用于优化器动作之前(修改目标函数或梯度),但动量、自适应缩放、结构化预条件会在此信号变为参数更新之前显著改变它,导致约束评估与实际更新不一致。因此需要一个在优化器更新之后再评估约束兼容性的视角。

Method: 形式化"优化器相对约束学习"。提出ORACLE:(1)通过异构约束族的联合端点线性化(joint endpoint linearization)评估原生优化器实际产生的步;(2)在优化器自身几何中构造对齐(alignment);(3)对其权限进行界定(bounds its authority);(4)仅在验证通过后提交更新。

Result: 在八个偏微分方程(PDE)基准、四种优化器(涵盖欧几里得、对角自适应、结构化预条件几何)上评估:在94%的配置中优于或匹配原生优化器。跨模型分析显示在92%的配置中表现一致;匹配对比显示其优于在目标层、梯度层和优化器后层作用的替代约束处理方法。

Conclusion: 在优化器更新之后而非之前评估约束兼容性是一种有效视角,使约束处理与优化器实际几何和更新步对齐,从而在多种优化器几何与PDE任务上稳定提升或匹配性能。

Abstract: Constraint handling methods typically intervene before the optimizer acts, by modifying the objective or the gradient. Yet momentum, adaptive scaling, and structured preconditioning can substantially reshape that signal before it becomes a parameter update. We formulate optimizer relative constrained learning, where constraint compatibility is assessed on the post optimizer update. Building on this view, we introduce ORACLE, which evaluates the native optimizer's realized step through a joint endpoint linearization of heterogeneous constraint families, constructs the resulting alignment in the optimizer's own geometry, bounds its authority, and commits it only after validation. We evaluate ORACLE across eight Partial Differential Equation benchmarks and four optimizers spanning Euclidean, diagonal adaptive, and structured preconditioned geometries, where it improves or matches native optimizer in 94% of configurations. Cross model analysis shows the same behavior in 92% of configurations, while matched comparisons show improvements over alternative constraint-handling methods acting at the objective, gradient, and post-optimizer levels.

</details>


### [339] [Towards Financial World Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09048)
*Humzah Merchant,Alec Guthrie,Simon Mahns,Randall Balestriero,Bradford Levy*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出金融市场的世界模型研究基础：构建近万亿观测的美股1Hz数据集Market-1T，制定严格评估协议，并对18种编码器训练策略进行大规模系统研究，发现预测性能相近的编码器其市场状态组织方式差异显著。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 构建世界模型需要可用于规划与决策的状态表征，且在金融市场中需推理市场整体状况、资产预期收益、流动性、波动率及跨资产关系。然而既有金融表征学习多局限于单一预测任务、单一时期和较窄数据集，缺乏对表征质量的系统评估。

Method: 三项工作：1）构建Market-1T数据集，覆盖2008—2025年美股，1Hz分辨率，近一万亿观测；2）设计并实施严格的评估协议；3）开展大规模实证研究，比较18种编码器训练策略，跨越近二十年市场状态（regimes），既评估预测效用，也通过探针分析潜在结构。

Result: 预测性能相近的编码器在组织市场状态（latent structure）方面存在显著差异，即预测效用不能完全反映表征内在结构的质量。

Conclusion: 为金融市 场表征的训练与评估奠定基础，支持DINO-WM、V-JEPA 2、LeWM等世界模型的构建。

Abstract: Building a world model requires a state representation useful for planning and decision-making---potentially over tasks unknown at training time. In the context of financial markets, planning and decision-making may require a model to reason about market-wide conditions, asset-specific expected returns, liquidity, volatility, and cross-asset relationships. Yet financial representation learning has largely been evaluated on individual predictive tasks, oftentimes on a single time period using comparatively narrow datasets. We address this through three primary contributions. First, we introduce Market-1T, a dataset containing nearly one trillion observations across U.S. equities from 2008 to 2025 at 1 Hz resolution. Second, we develop and implement a rigorous evaluation protocol. Third, we conduct a systematic large-scale study of financial representation learning, comparing 18 encoder-training strategies across nearly two decades of market regimes. We evaluate learned representations both by their predictive utility on common finance tasks and through probes of latent structure. We find that encoders with similar predictive performance can organize market state very differently. Collectively, we establish a foundation for training and evaluating financial market representations in support of world models such as DINO-WM, V-JEPA 2, and LeWM.

</details>


### [340] [A Self-Pruning Transformer: Extreme KV-Cache Compression with Universal Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09051)
*Davis Wertheimer,Haochen Shen,Ahan Gupta,Derrick Liu,Yu Chin Fabian Lim,Mudhakar Srivatsa,Raghu K. Ganti,Minjia Zhang,Naigang Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 Universal Attention：一个统一的衰减机制框架，在保留 RoPE 位置嵌入与 Softmax 注意力的同时，将复合衰减机制作为自适应 KV-cache 剪枝准则，实现 10× 压缩并提升下游性能，长文本 16k 下可达 25× 压缩。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代 LLM 的 KV-cache 体积庞大，制约高效部署。已有工作用基于衰减的机制替代 RoPE 位置嵌入以支持推理期 KV 剪枝，但此类衰减函数表达力有限，实践中退化为类滑窗式（sliding-window-like）的逐出模式，难以刻画复杂的键统计与交互关系。

Method: 提出统一的衰减机制框架，兼容互补且新颖的衰减函数，在保留表达性强的 RoPE 位置嵌入与 Softmax 注意力的前提下，捕捉复杂的键统计与键间交互。由此构建端到端可训练的 Universal Attention 架构，其复合衰减机制充当自然的自适应剪枝准则，剔除对注意力计算贡献最小的 token。

Result: 在自然语言与合成任务数据上实现 10× 压缩的最新（state-of-the-art）水平，且下游性能优于 SOTA 基线与未剪枝 oracle；在长度 16k 的长上下文场景展现出更优泛化能力，压缩率达 25×。

Conclusion: Universal Attention 通过统一且可端到端训练的复合衰减机制，在保持完整 RoPE 与 Softmax 表达力的同时实现自适应 KV-cache 剪枝，兼顾压缩率与性能，为高效 LLM 部署提供了可扩展方案。

Abstract: The large KV-cache size of modern LLMs creates a barrier to efficient deployment. Recent work has explored replacing attention layers' RoPE positional embeddings with alternative decay-based mechanisms, which can then be used to prune KV-cache during inference. However, these decay functions have limited expressivity, and in practice devolve into sliding-window-like eviction patterns. In this work, we propose a unifying framework for complementary and novel decay mechanisms, capturing complex key statistics and interactions while preserving expressive RoPE embeddings and Softmax attention. The resulting Universal Attention is a highly expressive and end-to-end trainable architecture, whose composite decay mechanism acts as a natural, $\textit{adaptive}$ pruning criterion, removing tokens that contribute least to attention computation. Experimentally, Universal Attention achieves state-of-the-art $10\times$ compression on natural language and synthetic task data, while $\textit{improving}$ downstream performance compared to both state-of-the-art baselines and unpruned oracles. It further demonstrates superior long-context generalization with unprecedented $25\times$ compression at length 16k.

</details>


### [341] [BeatFlow-ECG: Rectified Flow for ECG Reconstruction from Indirect Wearable Signals](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09052)
*Mohamed Kamel,Sahar Selim,Walaa Medhat,Tamer Nadeem*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 BeatFlow-ECG，一种条件整流流模型，从同步的 PPG 与 IMU 信号重建单通道 ECG，在 PPG-DaLiA 与 WESAD 上优于确定性、对抗及扩散基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床外连续心脏监测需要既具信息量又便于日常采集的信号：ECG 信息丰富但难以连续获取，PPG 易采集但仅为间接测量且对运动敏感，因此需要从 PPG 重建 ECG。

Method: 将重建建模为从噪声到 ECG 的条件传输；采用卷积编码器-解码器加 transformer 瓶颈，并引入显式流时间条件；通过 IMU 派生条件特征、运动相关损失加权和由易到难训练课程融入运动信息。

Result: 在 PPG-DaLiA 与 WESAD 上采用留一被试协议评估，所有波形与心搏时序指标均优于确定性、对抗和扩散基线：Pearson 相关分别为 0.983 和 0.986，R 峰 F1 为 0.946 和 0.955；相比 Conditional DDPM-1D，L1 误差在 PPG-DaLiA 从 0.085 降至 0.062，在 WESAD 从 0.074 降至 0.055；在 PPG-DaLiA 上，固定 R 峰相对波形区域相关性更高，低、中、高运动子集重建误差均更低。

Conclusion: BeatFlow-ECG 能有效利用运动信息从 PPG 重建高质量 ECG，并在不同运动强度下保持稳健性能，为日常连续心脏监测提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Continuous cardiac monitoring outside clinical settings requires signals that are both informative and practical to collect during daily life. Electrocardiography (ECG) provides rich information about cardiac rhythm and waveform morphology, while wearable photoplethysmography (PPG) is easier to acquire continuously but is only an indirect cardiovascular measurement and is highly sensitive to motion. We present BeatFlow-ECG, a conditional rectified-flow model for reconstructing single-channel ECG from synchronized PPG and inertial measurements. BeatFlow-ECG models reconstruction as conditional transport from noise to ECG using a convolutional encoder-decoder with a transformer bottleneck and explicit flow-time conditioning. Motion information is incorporated through IMU-derived conditioning features, motion-dependent loss weighting, and an easy-to-hard training curriculum. We evaluate the model under leave-one-subject-out protocols on PPG-DaLiA and WESAD. BeatFlow-ECG achieves the best results among the evaluated deterministic, adversarial, and diffusion-based baselines across all reported waveform and beat-timing metrics, with Pearson correlations of 0.983 and 0.986 and R-peak F1 scores of 0.946 and 0.955, respectively. Compared with Conditional DDPM-1D, L1 error decreases from 0.085 to 0.062 on PPG-DaLiA and from 0.074 to 0.055 on WESAD. Additional analyses on PPG-DaLiA show higher correlation in fixed R-peak-relative waveform regions and lower reconstruction error across low-, medium-, and high-motion subsets.

</details>


### [342] [A Geometry-Based Capacity Theory for Finite-Feature Associative Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09056)
*Jianhai Zhang,Donghao Zhang,Pattarawut Charatpangoon,Bijoy Menon,M. Ethan MacDonald,Wu Qiu,Aravind Ganesh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出基于几何的容量理论，用于压缩有限特征Hebbian联想记忆中的精确键检索，给出无拟合的检索质量预测、容量上限与所需特征预算，并经合成、视觉与医学图像表示验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 需要理解表示几何如何决定联想记忆容量，并区分性能提升应由增加特征预算实现，还是必须改变表示本身。

Method: 将检索干扰分解为随特征维度下降的有限特征噪声，以及由存储键间核重叠平方决定、在无限特征极限下仍存在的结构干扰；对相关存储值联合分析键核与值Gram矩阵，并推导有限特征近似。

Result: 获得无拟合的检索质量预测、依赖几何的容量上限、达到目标检索质量所需特征预算；在合成、视觉与医学图像表示上预测曲线与经验行为高度吻合，并能正确识别首选记忆设计的变化。

Conclusion: 该框架把表示几何直接联系到记忆容量，刻画了有限特征噪声与结构干扰的作用，并指出何时增加特征维度有效、何时需更换表示。

Abstract: We develop a geometry-based capacity theory for exact-key retrieval in compressed finite-feature Hebbian associative memory. For random or approximately isotropic values, retrieval interference separates into finite-feature noise, which decreases with feature dimension, and structural interference, which is determined by squared kernel overlap among stored keys and persists in the infinite-feature limit. This yields a fit-free prediction of retrieval quality, reveals a geometry-dependent capacity ceiling, and predicts the feature budget required for a target retrieval quality. When stored values are correlated, we show that retrieval depends jointly on the key kernel and value Gram matrix, and derive finite-feature approximations that account for this interaction. We validate the theory on synthetic, visual, and medical-image representations. Overall, the framework links representation geometry directly to memory capacity and distinguishes when performance can be improved by increasing the feature budget and when the representation itself must be changed. Across these settings, the predicted retrieval curves closely match empirical behavior and correctly identify changes in the preferred memory design.

</details>


### [343] [Learning Cross-Model Activation Alignments with Explicit Many-to-Many Layer Maps](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09058)
*Alina Sudakov,Guy Bar-Shalom,Fabrizio Frasca,Haggai Maron*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出 MATCHA，通过学习源模型到目标模型激活空间的对齐映射，将映射分解为可检查的层级映射矩阵与层间共享特征映射，并在多模型对上验证其重建与迁移能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 发布速度极快，独立训练的模型之间在哪些层对应、特征如何变换仍不清楚。多数已有工作预先固定层对应关系（按相对深度配对），限制了对跨模型关系的刻画。

Method: MATCHA 学习一种激活对齐，即从源模型逐层激活到目标模型激活的映射，并将其分解为：(1) 层映射，输出可提取、可检查的 target-by-source 矩阵；(2) 隐藏空间之间层共享的特征映射。两个因子均由 prompt 联合学习，而非预先固定层对应。

Result: 在来自 3 个模型家族的 7 个模型构成的 42 个模型对上，MATCHA 比既有方法更忠实地重建目标激活，并显著提升基于检索的指标。恢复的映射在深度上大体单调，但普遍呈多对多：每个目标层会利用一段源模型层带。该对齐还支持激活空间干预迁移，使为某一模型开发的 steering vector 与 probe 能迁移到另一模型。

Conclusion: 跨独立训练 LLM 的激活对齐可以联合学习层对应与特征变换，得到可解释的、多对多的层映射，并能实现激活空间干预的跨模型迁移。

Abstract: LLMs are released at a rapid pace, raising a natural question: how do two independently trained models relate, both in which layers correspond and in how features transform between them? We study this by learning an activation alignment, a map from a source model's layerwise activations to a target's. Our method, MATCHA, factors this map into a layer map, whose output is an explicit target-by-source matrix that can be extracted and inspected, and a layer-shared feature map between hidden spaces. Most of prior work fixes the layer correspondence in advance, pairing layers at roughly the same relative depth; in contrast, we learn both factors jointly from prompts. Across 42 pairs of seven models spanning three different families, MATCHA reconstructs the target's activations more faithfully and improves retrieval-based metrics substantially, w.r.t. previous approaches. The recovered maps are broadly monotone in depth but, in contrast with most previous approaches, are consistently many-to-many: each target layer draws on a band of source layers. Our alignments also enable transfer of activation-space interventions, allowing steering vectors and probes developed for one model to transfer to another.

</details>


### [344] [EDiS: Edge Disjoint Subgraph Sparsification Framework for Graph Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09059)
*Sai Karthik Navuluru,Siddhartha Shankar Das,Franck Dernoncourt,S M Ferdous,Ryan A. Rossi,Nesreen K. Ahmed,Baris Coskunuzer,Alex Pothen,Lakshman Tamil,Mahantesh M Halappanavar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: EDiS将图稀疏化分离为"一次性结构抽取"与"逐epoch图组合"两步，先用特征分数构造可缓存的边不相交子图分解，再按边预算与保留率重组训练图，在19个节点分类基准上取得最优平均成绩。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 稀疏GNN训练可降低计算量，但选择保留哪些边本身开销大：复用固定稀疏图虽廉价却锁死拓扑；逐epoch变换拓扑又需反复采样或重算结构。

Method: 提出EDiS（边不相交子图稀疏化框架）：一次将图分解为可缓存的边不相交子图，随后在每个epoch按边预算和保留率约束重组合成训练图，无需重新抽取结构；默认构造使用基于特征的评分与连续最大分数覆盖森林，组合机制亦兼容其他边选择规则。对逐epoch采样器（组合步骤）进行了组合分析。

Result: 在19个同配、异配及大规模节点分类基准上，与17个基线在相同边预算下比较，EDiS取得最高平均基准分数（accuracy/ROC-AUC）及最低平均排名与距最优差距；消融显示结构分解与epoch变化在紧边预算下收益最明显。

Conclusion: EDiS通过将结构抽取与逐epoch组合解耦，在低成本实现稀疏化拓扑多样性的同时保持高分数割边保留，且分解可复用、选择规则可替换。

Abstract: Sparse GNN training reduces computation, but deciding which edges to keep can be costly. Reusing one sparse graph is cheap, but locks training to a fixed topology, while varying it across epochs can require repeated sampling or recomputation. We introduce EDiS (Edge-Disjoint Subgraph sparsification framework), which separates one-time structural extraction from per-epoch graph composition. EDiS decomposes the graph once into cacheable edge-disjoint subgraphs, then recombines them into graphs with edge-budget constraints across epochs and retention ratios without re-extracting structure. Our default construction uses feature-based scores and successive maximum score covering forests, while the same composition mechanism also supports alternative edge selection rules. We provide a combinatorial analysis of the per-epoch sampler, the composition step that draws a training graph from the cached decomposition. We show that, under the default covering-forest selector, the stored decomposition deterministically preserves high-score cut edges, and we derive a selector-agnostic conditional bound on high-score cut survival in composed training graphs. Across 19 homophilic, heterophilic, and large-scale node classification benchmarks against 17 baselines under the same edge budget, EDiS achieves the highest mean benchmark score (accuracy/ROC-AUC) and the lowest average rank and gap-to-best among ranked methods. Ablations show the clearest benefits of structural decomposition and epoch variation at tight edge budgets.

</details>


### [345] [TAP: Efficient Long-Horizon Agent Pruning via Trajectory-Anchored Recovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09074)
*Yuanzhe Li,Pengxin Wang,Yuxin Ren,Jianing Deng,Jingtong Hu,Song Wang,Jingdi Chen,Huanrui Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出轨迹锚定剪枝（TAP），首个面向强化学习训练智能体的结构化剪枝框架，通过将结构化剪枝与高效同策略恢复耦合，在有限恢复预算下实现长时程智能体的有效压缩。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长时程智能体任务需要反复调用模型，加剧了本已高昂的推理成本。虽然窄域智能体任务显示出激进剪枝而不损失性能的潜力，但实证结果显示，为问答任务设计的现有剪枝方法应用于智能体模型时会严重降低任务性能。作者将此失败归因于两个决策：剪什么和如何恢复。剪枝方面，一次性重要性估计无法跟踪被剪模型如何自适应；恢复方面，离线蒸馏仅覆盖教师前缀，而全轨迹同策略蒸馏会导致学生错误在各轮次间累积。

Method: 提出轨迹锚定剪枝（TAP），首次针对RL训练智能体的结构化剪枝框架。TAP将结构化剪枝与高效同策略恢复耦合：将交互锚定到教师轨迹，同时允许学生生成每个推理-动作响应。冻结的稠密教师监督学生的响应前缀，解决响应内训练-推理不匹配，同时防止学生引起的偏差在训练轮次间传播。不同于一次性剪枝，TAP在恢复后的学生上使用恢复目标的梯度重新为通道打分，将迭代式通道选择与演化的策略相连接。

Result: 移除60%的FFN通道后，TAP在ALFWorld和WebShop上分别保留了稠密7B智能体99.2%和88.0%的任务成功率，同时将每个成功任务的GPU时间分别减少约22%和17%。

Conclusion: 在有限的恢复预算下，TAP实现了长时程智能体的有效结构化压缩，验证了针对RL训练智能体进行结构化剪枝的可行性与有效性。

Abstract: Emerging long-horizon agentic tasks require repeated model calls, worsening the inference cost of already-costly language models. While narrow agentic tasks suggest potential for aggressive model pruning without performance drop, empirical results show existing methods proposed for question answering tasks severely degrade task performance when applied to agentic models. We trace this failure to two decisions: what to prune and how to recover. For pruning, one-shot importance estimates fail to track how the pruned model adapts. For recovery, offline distillation covers only teacher prefixes, while full-trajectory on-policy distillation causes student errors to compound across turns. In this work, we propose Trajectory-Anchored Pruning (TAP), the first structural pruning framework for reinforcement learning (RL)-trained agents. TAP couples structural pruning with efficient on-policy recovery, anchoring interactions to teacher trajectories while allowing the student to generate each reasoning-action response. A frozen dense teacher supervises the student's response prefixes, addressing within-response training-inference mismatch while preventing student-induced deviations from propagating across training turns. Instead of one-shot pruning, TAP re-scores channels using gradients of the recovery objective on the recovered student, connecting iterative channel selection to the evolving policy. With 60% of FFN channels removed, TAP retains 99.2% and 88.0% of the dense 7B agents' task success rates on ALFWorld and WebShop, respectively, while reducing GPU time per successful task by approximately 22% and 17%. These results demonstrate effective structural compression of long-horizon agents under a limited recovery budget.

</details>


### [346] [Tucker Bottleneck Attention for Multi-Dimensional Sequence Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09090)
*Ryan Solgi,Parsa Madinei,Zheng Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Tucker瓶颈注意力（TuBA），利用低秩张量结构实现高效的全局token混合，在视频预测和天气预测上取得更好的精度-效率权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自注意力的二次计算成本限制了其从多维数据扩展到长序列，因此需要一种能够在保持全局token混合能力的同时降低计算复杂度的方法。

Method: TuBA将隐张量投影到紧凑的Tucker核中，在核上执行多头自注意力和线性投影，再将更新写回原始空间，从而实现次二次计算；其自回归扩展结合了核内双向交互与核间因果注意力。

Result: 在视频预测和全球天气预测任务上，TuBA相比标准与高效注意力及任务专用模型实现了更优的精度-效率权衡。相比标准自注意力，视频预测误差和计算量最多降低24.7%和66.6%，自回归天气预测最多降低37.1%和85.1%，加速最高达4.27倍。低秩Tucker核与多帧生成分别优于满秩注意力和逐帧生成。

Conclusion: TuBA通过低秩张量结构有效缓解了自注意力的二次成本，在长序列多维数据任务中实现了显著的效率与精度提升，验证了低秩核和多帧生成策略的有效性。

Abstract: The quadratic cost of self-attention limits scalability to long sequences from multidimensional data. We introduce Tucker bottleneck attention (TuBA), which exploits low-rank tensor structure for efficient global token mixing. TuBA projects hidden tensors into compact Tucker cores, performs multi-head self-attention and linear projections on the cores, and writes updates back to the ambient space, enabling subquadratic computation. Its autoregressive extension combines bidirectional interactions within cores with causal attention across cores. On video prediction and global weather forecasting, TuBA achieves favorable accuracy-efficiency trade-offs over standard and efficient attention and task-specific models. Compared to standard self-attention, TuBA reduces error and computation by up to 24.7% and 66.6% for video prediction and 37.1% and 85.1% for autoregressive weather forecasting, with speedups up to 4.27 times. Low-rank Tucker cores and multi-frame generation also outperform full-rank attention and frame-by-frame generation, respectively.

</details>


### [347] [Are We Really Benchmarking Forecasting Models? The Impact of Preprocessing on Time Series Performance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09096)
*Guilherme Afonso Galindo Padilha,Paulo Salgado Gomes de Mattos Neto,Rafael Menelau Oliveira e Cruz*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文指出当前预测研究普遍忽视预处理阶段，导致存在结构性的预处理偏差；作者构建了预处理感知基准，在29,000条M4时间序列上评估11种模型与16种可逆预处理流程的组合，发现按序列优化预处理可带来约27%–87%的性能提升，并使简单架构足以与复杂SOTA模型竞争。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 既有文献强调预处理对预测精度至关重要，但当前研究对该阶段关注不足：现代基准多采用简单缩放，忽略了差分等应对非平稳性的关键变换。这种缺失造成结构性预处理偏差——偏向自带数据处理的模型，同时掩盖了简单架构的真实潜力。

Method: 构建预处理感知基准（preprocessing-aware benchmark），在29,000条M4时间序列上，将11种预测模型与16种可逆预处理流程进行组合评估，并针对每条序列优化预处理流程。

Result: 预处理被识别为预测性能的关键驱动因素；逐序列优化预处理使所有评估模型获得约27%至87%的性能提升，其中缺乏内置预处理的架构提升最为显著，从而使简单架构在现代基准中能与复杂SOTA模型高度竞争。所有资源与实验结果被整合为综合元数据集以支持未来元学习任务。

Conclusion: 预处理不应被简化处理，而应作为核心建模变量；按序列适配预处理可显著提升各类模型表现并改变基准排名格局，相关元数据集为后续元学习研究提供了基础设施。

Abstract: While established literature underscores the pivotal role of preprocessing in forecasting accuracy, this stage remains largely overlooked in current research. Modern benchmarks typically resort to simple scaling, failing to account for critical transformations required to address nonstationarity, such as differencing. This omission creates a significant structural preprocessing bias that favors models with built-in data treatments while obscuring the true potential of simpler architectures. We study this effect through a preprocessing-aware benchmark that evaluates 11 forecasting models across 16 reversible preprocessing pipelines on 29,000 M4 time series. Our results identify preprocessing as a key driver of forecasting performance. Optimizing preprocessing per series yields gains of approximately 27\% to 87\% across all evaluated models, with architectures lacking internalized preprocessing experiencing the most substantial improvements. This allows simpler architectures to become highly competitive with complex, state-of-the-art models in modern forecasting benchmarks. All resources and experimental results from this benchmark are stored in a comprehensive metadataset to support future metalearning tasks.

</details>


### [348] [Breaking Adversarial Transferability in Fine-Tuned Speech Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09109)
*Mojtaba Nafez,Aref Mousavi,Mohammad Ebrahim Mahdavi,Mobina Poulaei,Kiarash Kiani Feriz,Mohammad Hossein Rohban*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文揭示了对公开预训练ASR模型进行微调后在黑盒部署场景下的对抗迁移脆弱性，并提出统一微调框架TransferBreaker以抑制对抗迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 许多组织微调公开的预训练ASR模型并假设黑盒部署（有限访问）能提供安全性。作者证明这一假设是脆弱的：在公开基模型上生成的对抗扰动可有效迁移至微调后的目标模型，严重降低性能，对安全关键应用构成威胁。因此需要一种能抑制对抗迁移的微调框架。

Method: 提出TransferBreaker统一微调框架，包含三个组件：(1) Base Adversarial Fine-Tuning，将对抗训练限制在基模型上有效的扰动；(2) Latent Jacobian Regularization，通过抑制对抗敏感方向来强制隐空间不变性；(3) HybridGrad-AFT，通过插值来自基模型和目标模型的迁移性扰动提升对自适应攻击的鲁棒性。作者对全部组件进行了理论论证。

Result: 在三种语言和四个大型ASR模型上评估TransferBreaker，将对抗词错误率（adversarial WER）从92.6降低至27.8。代码已开源。

Conclusion: 在公开基模型上生成的对抗扰动可有效迁移至微调目标模型，破坏了黑盒部署的安全性假设；TransferBreaker通过三种互补机制显著抑制对抗迁移并提升鲁棒性，在跨语言、跨模型实验中验证了有效性。

Abstract: Many organizations fine-tune publicly available pretrained Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) models and deploy them in black-box settings, assuming limited access provides protection. We show this assumption is fragile: adversarial perturbations crafted on the public base model transfer effectively to fine-tuned target models, severely degrading performance and posing concerns for safety-critical applications. We propose TransferBreaker, a unified fine-tuning framework that suppresses adversarial transfer by integrating Base Adversarial Fine-Tuning, which restricts adversarial training to base-effective perturbations; Latent Jacobian Regularization, which enforces latent-space invariance by suppressing adversarially sensitive directions; and HybridGrad-AFT, which improves robustness against adaptive attacks by interpolating transferable perturbations from base and target gradients. We theoretically justify all components and evaluate TransferBreaker across three languages and four large ASR models, reducing adversarial WER from 92.6 to 27.8. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/rohban-lab/TransferBreaker.

</details>


### [349] [The Deceptive Bandit Problem: Exploratory Coupling and the Fragility of Multi-Agent Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09120)
*Michael Tang,Mahmoud Abdelgalil,Jorge I. Poveda*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将随机探索的独立性与隐私性视为安全问题：欺骗者可利用与受害者探索相关的泄露信号注入外部性，从而将学习动态引导至"欺骗性纳什均衡"(DNE)。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在bandit学习、多智能体强化学习与零阶策略搜索中，随机探索的独立性与隐私通常仅被当作技术性假设。作者希望说明这些性质对安全性至关重要，并展示对抗方如何利用关于他方探索的特权信息。

Method: 分析最小两人强单调设定下的欺骗者—受害者对。欺骗者获得仅与受害者探索相关的泄露信号，并将其与自身探索动作耦合，从而注入外部性以改变学习动态。提出欺骗性bandit学习(DBL)动态，分析其收敛性与均衡性质。

Result: 证明DBL动态收敛到DNE的任意小邻域，同时保持最优收敛速率；且在放松标准bandit优化文献中二阶光滑性条件下仍达到该速率。刻画了欺骗严格改变稳态的条件及其对欺骗者代价的影响，并在资源分配博弈中加以说明。

Conclusion: 探索的独立性与隐私并非单纯技术假设，而是安全关键属性；通过关联泄露信号，欺骗者可系统性地偏移学习系统的稳态均衡。

Abstract: Randomized exploration is central to bandit learning, multi-agent reinforcement learning, and zeroth-order policy search, yet its independence and privacy are usually only treated as technical assumptions. We show that these properties are critical for security purposes and demonstrate how an adversarial agent can exploit privileged information on another agent's exploration. We analyze a deceiver-victim pair in the minimal two-player strongly monotone setting, where a deceptive player obtains leaked signals that are merely correlated with the victim's exploration. We show that, by coupling their own exploratory action with this information, the deceptive player injects an externality that steers the learning dynamics to a new steady state, called the deceptive Nash equilibrium (DNE). We prove that the deceptive bandit learning (DBL) dynamics converge to an arbitrarily small neighborhood of the DNE while retaining optimal convergence rates. Interestingly, our analysis attains these optimal rates while relaxing second-order smoothness conditions from standard bandit optimization literature. We characterize conditions under which deception strictly shifts the steady state and its effect on the deceiver's cost, illustrating the results in a resource-allocation game.

</details>


### [350] [Are Parameter-Efficient Fine-tuning Methods Really Different?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09122)
*Yikuan Li,Pinyan Lu,Fanghui Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文系统比较了六种PEFT方法在语言与扩散模型中的参数化差异，发现几何谱保持并非适配与保留的关键，主张从功能后果而非保持本身来评估几何约束。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PEFT方法参数化形式多样，但其方法论与功能层面的差异尚不清晰，尤其几何保持（如OFT的谱保持设计）对适配与遗忘是否必要存在疑问。

Method: 在语言模型与扩散模型上比较六种PEFT方法，考察参数化与任务性能、遗忘、预训练权重几何变化的关系；以OFT的谱保持设计为动机，进行谱恢复干预与谱分量（主导/中间/尾部）恢复实验。

Result: LoRA族方法亦近似保持预训练几何；恢复其轻微漂移的奇异值谱基本保持任务性能，说明显式几何保持非必要。LoRA最稳定地限制遗忘，DoRA多数比较中平均任务分更高，PiSSA保留代价较大。恢复主导分量比中间或尾部分量带来最大的通用文本NLL或基础图像漂移的平均降低。

Conclusion: 应从功能后果而非单纯保持性来评估几何约束；不同PEFT方法的性能提升可归因于不同谱分量的修改。

Abstract: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) offers many parameterizations, yet their methodological and functional differences remain unclear. We compare six methods in language and diffusion models to examine how their parameterizations relate to task performance, forgetting, and changes in pretrained weight geometry. Motivated by the spectrum-preserving design of orthogonal fine-tuning (OFT), we first ask whether spectral preservation is itself important for adaptation and retention. We find that the selected LoRA-family methods also approximately preserve pretrained geometry, and that restoring their slightly drifted singular-value spectra largely preserves task performance, questioning the necessity of explicit geometric preservation. Beyond this, we observe that some methods exhibit distinct adaptation--retention trade-offs that vary across settings: LoRA most consistently limits forgetting at competitive performance, DoRA achieves higher mean task scores than LoRA in most comparisons, while PiSSA often incurs greater retention costs. Further intervention experiments suggest that while performance gains from different PEFT methods can be attributed to modifications in different groups of spectral components, we consistently find that restoring dominant rather than intermediate or trailing components produces the largest mean reduction in general-text NLL or base-image drift. Together, these results motivate evaluating geometric constraints through their functional consequences rather than preservation alone. Code is available at https://github.com/Kuaaannn/PEFT_methods.

</details>


### [351] [Domain-informed Adaptive Sampling for Generalizable PINNs in Metal Additive Manufacturing via Conditional Flow Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09126)
*Hyeonsu Lee,Jihoon Jeong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对金属增材制造中PINN热建模依赖静态配置点采样、泛化性差的问题，通过经验风险最小化理论证明工况感知自适应采样更优，并提出基于条件流匹配的两阶段自适应采样框架，在相同配置点预算下平均降低62.1%的相对L2误差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 金属增材制造的热建模对理解工艺-结构-性能链条至关重要。PINN可作为有效的代理热模型，但现有工作多采用人工设计的静态配置点采样策略，缺乏原理性且难以跨工况扩展，限制了泛化能力。作者希望从理论层面说明自适应采样的优势，并据此设计能捕捉工况相关热耗散区域的采样方法，提升PINN的泛化性和适用范围。

Method: 首先通过经验风险最小化进行理论分析，证明工况感知的自适应采样在泛化性上严格优于传统静态采样。基于该洞见，提出两阶段自适应采样框架：(1) 条件流匹配模型，学习不同工况下的近似高残差分布；(2) 混合采样策略，将该分布与领域先验基础分布相结合，生成自适应配置点用于精化PINN预测器。

Result: 在金属增材制造数值基准上的实验表明，该方法在相同配置点预算下持续优于最先进的PINN基线，平均实现62.1%的相对L2误差降低，其优势源于捕捉了文献中常被忽略的工况相关热耗散区域。

Conclusion: 这是首个面向金属增材制造中PINN的自适应采样策略，有助于增强泛化能力并拓宽应用范围。

Abstract: Accurate thermal modeling is essential in metal additive manufacturing (AM) for understanding the process-structure-property chain. Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) offer effective surrogate thermal modeling by minimizing physics-based residual losses at collocation points. However, prior works typically rely on manually-crafted, static collocation sampling strategies, which are neither principled nor scalable across process conditions, hindering their generalization capability. In this work, we provide theoretical analysis through empirical risk minimization, showing that process condition-aware adaptive sampling is strictly more favorable than conventional static sampling for generalization. Building on this insight, we propose an adaptive sampling strategy within a two-stage framework: (1) a conditional Flow Matching model that learns approximate high-residual distributions across different process conditions, and (2) a mixed sampling strategy combining this distribution with a domain-informed base distribution to generate adaptive collocation points for refining the PINN predictor. Experiments on metal AM numerical benchmarks demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms state-of-the-art PINN baselines, achieving an average 62.1\% reduction in relative $L_2$ error under an identical collocation budget, by capturing process-dependent heat dissipation regions often overlooked in the literature. To the authors' knowledge, this is the first adaptive sampling strategy for PINNs in metal AM, contributing to the enhanced generalization and broader applicability.

</details>


### [352] [Directional Evidence Guided Search-Space Reduction for Exact DAG Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09136)
*Upala Junaida Islam,Abdelmonem Elrefaey,Rong Pan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出非参数混合框架DECO，利用依赖性方向证据构建可行父集，在精确DAG学习中指数级压缩搜索空间，同时保持竞争力结构恢复性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从观测数据学习有向无环图（DAG）是组合难题：候选父集配置数量随节点数指数增长。现有精确评分方法需密集组合搜索，计算开销大；约束方法在图规模和条件集复杂度增大时不可靠或计算昂贵。作者希望在不依赖固定参数结构模型的前提下，降低精确DAG学习的计算负担。

Method: 提出非参数混合框架DECO（Directional Evidence-guided Configuration Optimization）：先从观测数据中提取依赖性与方向性证据，据此构建可容许父集（admissible parent sets），再进行精确优化。通过剔除经验上不被支持的父配置，缩小优化搜索空间，同时保留所有合理边方向的灵活性，不依赖固定的参数结构模型。并给出理论分析，刻画可容许父集配置空间的指数级缩减，以及有界边级遗漏对保留真实父结构概率的影响。

Result: 在基准贝叶斯网络以及合成的离散和连续DAG上进行实验：DECO大幅减少搜索空间，同时取得有竞争力的结构恢复性能，在多个评估设置下具有较好的结构汉明距离（SHD）。

Conclusion: 方向性证据可作为有效的预处理机制，降低精确DAG学习的计算负担，且无需固定参数结构模型。

Abstract: Learning a directed acyclic graph (DAG) from observational data is a challenging combinatorial problem due to the exponential growth in the number of candidate parent-set configurations. Existing exact score-based methods often require computationally intensive combinatorial search, whereas constraint-based methods can become unreliable or computationally demanding as graph size and conditioning-set complexity increase. We develop a non-parametric hybrid framework, referred to as DECO (Directional Evidence-guided Configuration Optimization), that extracts dependency and directional evidence from observation data to construct admissible parent sets prior to exact optimization. It reduces the optimization search space by eliminating empirically unsupported parent configurations while preserving flexibility for all plausible edge orientations. Theoretical analysis establishes an exponential reduction in the admissible parent-set configuration space and quantifies how bounded edge-level omission affects the probability of retaining the true parent structure. Experiments on benchmark Bayesian networks and synthetic discrete and continuous DAGs demonstrate substantial search-space reduction while achieving competitive structure-recovery performance, with favorable structural Hamming distance across many evaluated settings. These results show that directional evidence can provide an effective preprocessing mechanism for reducing the computational burden of exact DAG learning without requiring a fixed parametric structural~model.

</details>


### [353] [A Cognitive-Aware QML-CRL Framework for Detecting Affinity and Romance-Investment Fraud](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09141)
*Bibhas Adhikari,Ramya Srinivasan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种混合量子-经典框架，通过建模操纵性对话中的认知偏差来检测情感与恋爱投资类诈骗。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 情感/恋爱投资诈骗依赖对话中的认知偏差操纵，传统方法难以刻画操纵性重构的时间顺序与叙事共现结构。

Method: 用结构化参数化量子电路承载核心认知偏差量子比特，加入frame qubit使编码对操纵性重构的时间顺序敏感，加入narrative qubit经可训练纠缠层聚合共现；电路参数与经典强化学习智能体联合训练，智能体将逐轮是否标记对话建模为最优停止问题。

Result: 在包含hard negatives、合法但紧急、合法但强推销售对话的合成对话数据上进行性能评估。

Conclusion: 量子电路与强化学习联合建模为操纵性诈骗对话检测提供了兼顾认知偏差结构与逐轮决策的新途径。

Abstract: We present a hybrid quantum-classical framework that detects affinity and romance-investment fraud by modelling the cognitive biases in a manipulative conversation. In our proposed framework, cognitive biases central to this fraud class are carried by dedicated qubits in a structured parameterized quantum circuit, together with a frame qubit makes the encoding sensitive to the temporal order of manipulative reframing, and a narrative qubit that aggregates co-occurrence through a trainable entanglement layer. The circuit parameters are trained jointly with a classical reinforcement-learning agent that decides, turn by turn, whether to flag the conversation, modeled as an optimal stopping problem. We evaluate the model's performance on synthetic conversations that include hard negatives, legitimate but urgent, and legitimate but pushy sales conversations.

</details>


### [354] [Context-aware Attention-based Gaussian Mixture Models for Vehicular Trajectory Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09174)
*Arash Raftari,Babak Ebrahimi Soorchaei,Yaser P. Fallah*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出CAA-GMM（上下文感知注意力高斯混合模型），用于多模态、不确定性感知的轨迹预测，通过注意力机制融合场景上下文与智能体动力学，在nuScenes和Argoverse 2上取得有竞争力或更优的精度，同时保持低计算复杂度，并在通信与感知不完美条件下展现鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在复杂不确定环境下，协同驾驶与自动驾驶需要可靠且可解释的轨迹预测。现有栅格化基线方法往往难以兼顾多模态行为建模、上下文推理能力与计算效率，且对通信/感知不完美条件的鲁棒性不足。

Method: 将未来运动建模为以场景上下文和智能体动力学为条件、由可解释高斯分量组成的概率混合模型，以捕捉多样行为模态；设计轻量级注意力机制，自适应编码智能体间交互与上下文显著性，实现稠密交通场景中栅格化环境线索与运动历史的高效融合。

Result: 在nuScenes和Argoverse 2数据集上，CAA-GMM相比先进栅格化基线达到有竞争力或更优的精度，且计算复杂度较低；消融实验验证了注意力模块对上下文推理与预测精度的重要性；在通信和感知不完美条件下的评估显示其具有不确定性鲁棒性。

Conclusion: CAA-GMM是一种高效、可扩展的协同轨迹预测方案，适用于智能交通系统，兼具多模态性、可解释性与鲁棒性。

Abstract: Reliable and interpretable trajectory prediction is critical for cooperative and autonomous driving in complex and uncertain environments. This paper introduces a Context-Aware Attention-based Gaussian Mixture Model (CAA-GMM) for multimodal, uncertainty-aware motion forecasting. The proposed approach models future motion as a probabilistic mixture conditioned on both scene context and agent dynamics, capturing diverse behavioral modes with interpretable Gaussian components. A lightweight attention mechanism adaptively encodes inter-agent interactions and contextual salience, enabling efficient fusion of rasterized environment cues and motion history in dense traffic scenes. Comprehensive evaluations on the nuScenes and Argoverse 2 datasets demonstrate that CAA-GMM achieves competitive or superior accuracy compared with state-of-the-art raster-based baselines, while maintaining low computational complexity. Ablation analyses confirm the importance of the attention module for robust contextual reasoning and predictive precision. Furthermore, evaluations under imperfect communication and perception conditions highlight the framework's resilience to uncertainty, establishing CAA-GMM as an efficient and scalable solution for cooperative trajectory prediction in intelligent transportation systems.

</details>


### [355] [Q-PACE: Dynamic Precision Allocation for Quantization-Aware Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09183)
*Alexandra Volkova,Matin Ansaripour,Erik Schultheis,Christoph H. Lampert,Dan Alistarh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Q-PACE，一种基于二阶敏感度模型的混合精度量化感知训练方法，可预测量化噪声导致的损失增量并动态分配层精度，在4B以内LLM上以更低显存预算取得更优损失。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: QAT利用低精度算术降低LLM部署成本，但激进量化会损害模型最终性能，混合精度训练虽可缓解，却需要确定各层的精度分配方案。

Method: Q-PACE采用二阶敏感度模型，将损失增量建模为量化噪声MSE以逐层曲率系数加权的和；训练中周期性通过跨层扰动重新计算这些系数，并据此重新分配精度。

Result: 在最大4B参数的LLM预训练与监督微调实验中，Q-PACE持续优于现有混合精度训练方案，在总显存预算大幅降低的情况下达到相当损失；量化敏感度在深度和层类型上高度可预测，且训练中稳定性良好，支持低频、低成本的重校准。

Conclusion: Q-PACE通过二阶敏感度建模与周期性重校准实现了高效、稳定的混合精度精度分配，为低成本LLM训练与部署提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Quantization-aware training (QAT) leverages lower-precision arithmetic to reduce the cost of LLM deployment, but aggressive quantization degrades final model performance. A common remedy is mixed-precision training, in which high precision is assigned to some of the layers to maintain performance while keeping the cost constrained. This approach then requires precision assignments for model layers during training. We provide a new approach, called Q-PACE, consisting of a second-order sensitivity model that predicts the loss increase as a sum of quantization noise MSE weighted by per-layer curvature coefficients. During training, we periodically re-compute these coefficients using perturbations across layers, and re-assign precision. Pretraining and supervised fine-tuning experiments on LLMs of up to 4B parameters show that Q-PACE consistently improves over existing mixed-precision training recipes, and achieves comparable loss at substantially lower total memory budgets. We further find that quantization sensitivity is highly predictable by depth and layer type, and its stability during training allows for infrequent, cheap recalibration.

</details>


### [356] [The Dichotomy Between Pattern Recognition and Step-by-Step Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09186)
*Amrut Nadgir,Pratik Chaudhari,Vijay Balasubramanian*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出模式识别与逐步推理是同一谱系的两端：当下一token仅依赖最近c个token时，推理轨迹构成De Bruijn图的有向无环子图；边数远小于轨迹数，故逐步推理样本高效；状态频率决定c，适中的状态密度可平衡准确性与鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 作者希望从理论上刻画LLM"逐步推理"与"模式识别"的本质区别，并解释为何逐步推理样本高效、何时会退化为模式识别，以及真实数据是否具有这种结构，从而为推理能力的理解与训练提供统一框架。

Method: 将任务建模为De Bruijn图：节点为c长度上下文，边为下一token转移；推理轨迹是该图的有向无环子图路径。通过引入使未来推理独立于过去的"状态"来诱导De Bruijn结构，用状态频率确定c。理论证明边数相对轨迹数可忽略；实验上用Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct微调解方程与故事问答，并在Qwen3-14B/32B上限制注意力为滑动窗口，测试GSM8K、MATH-500、GPQA-Diamond。

Result: 理论上边数远小于推理轨迹数；经验上训练样本需求随边数呈幂律，故逐步推理样本高效。微调实验显示：频繁状态（小c）准确率更高但对测试时扰动更脆弱；大c训练的模型仅相当于无推理的模式识别；中等状态密度在准确性与鲁棒性间取得平衡。Qwen3-14B/32B在注意力窗口短于完整推理轨迹15%时，仍能保留GSM8K、MATH-500、GPQA-Diamond上超过75%的准确率，表明真实数据具有De Bruijn结构。

Conclusion: 逐步推理与模式识别构成连续谱系，由下一token所依赖的上下文长度c决定；逐步推理因De Bruijn图中边数远少于轨迹数而样本高效。状态密度（即c）调控准确性与鲁棒性的权衡，适中密度最优。真实世界数据确实具备De Bruijn结构，这为理解与提升LLM推理能力提供了理论依据。

Abstract: We argue that pattern recognition and step-by-step reasoning are two ends of a spectrum. A large language model (LLM) learns to reason step-by-step when data is structured such that the next token depends on a small amount of preceding context. Inference in LLMs resembles pattern recognition when the next token depends on a large amount of preceding context. If the next token depends on only the $c$ most recent tokens, reasoning traces are paths on a De Bruijn graph whose nodes are $c$-length contexts and edges are next-token transitions between contexts. The set of reasoning traces of a task forms a directed acyclic subgraph of the De Bruijn graph. An LLM that has learned all edges of this subgraph can compose them to solve longer, unseen tasks, i.e., it reasons step-by-step. We prove that the number of edges is vanishingly small compared to the number of reasoning traces. Empirically, the number of training samples a transformer needs is a power law in the number of edges, so learning to reason step-by-step is sample efficient. We can induce De Bruijn structure in any task by maintaining a ``state'' that makes future reasoning independent of the past. The frequency of states in the reasoning trace determines $c$. We show, by fine-tuning Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct to solve equations and answer questions about stories, that frequent states (small $c$) result in higher accuracy but greater fragility to perturbations at test time.
