LLMs trained with a large $c$ are only as good as models that perform pattern recognition without reasoning. A moderate density of states balances accuracy and robustness. We show that real-world data has De Bruijn structure: Qwen3-14B and Qwen3-32B retain over 75% of their accuracy on GSM8K, MATH-500 and GPQA-Diamond when attention is restricted to a sliding window less than 15% as long as the full reasoning trace.

</details>


### [357] [Symmetry-Informed Causal Partial Identification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09230)
*Uzair Akbar,Zulfiqar Zaidi,Niki Kilbertus,Krikamol Muandet,Bo Dai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出将"已知数据对称性"（因果效应在特定数据变换下的不变性）作为一种新的约束来源引入部分识别（PI），通过将其操作化为因果函数的形状约束，并借助简单的数据预处理进行测度变换，从而收紧因果效应的识别边界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 部分识别（PI）通过将关于数据生成的假设编码为约束优化问题来估计因果效应的边界，这些边界在因果效应本身不可识别时仍可指导政策决策。然而，PI边界在实践中往往过于宽松（近乎无信息）。因此，研究者希望尽可能充分地编码领域知识作为额外约束，使边界更具信息量。论文由此提出一个新的约束来源——数据对称性。

Method: 作者将已知的数据对称性（即因果效应在某些数据变换下保持不变）作为PI的新约束来源。具体操作化为两种方式：（1）将对称性转化为对因果函数的形状约束；（2）通过一个测度变换（change of measure）重新表述PI问题，并配合简单的数据预处理实现。在两种典型的PI模型下对该方法进行理论分析（总体情形）与实验验证（有限样本情形）。

Result: 在两种典型的PI模型下，所提的两种方法（形状约束与测度变换）均被证明能够收紧识别边界。这一结论在总体（population）情形下得到理论证明，并在有限样本情形下通过实验得到验证。

Conclusion: 该框架确立了数据对称性作为一种自然但尚未被充分利用的背景知识来源，可用于稳健的因果推断。它为在PI中进一步编码领域知识、获得更具信息量的因果效应边界提供了新的思路。

Abstract: Partial identification (PI) entails estimating bounds on causal effects by encoding different assumptions on data generation as a constrained optimization problem. Such bounds can suffice to inform policy decisions even if the causal effect itself is not identifiable. Often vacuous in practice, practitioners seek to exhaustively encode domain knowledge as additional constraints to make the PI bounds more informative. We introduce known data symmetries -- invariance of the causal effect under certain data transformations -- as a new source of constraints to inform PI. We operationalize this as a shape constraint on the causal function, and via a change of measure against which PI is posed using simple data pre-processing. Both approaches are shown to sharpen bounds under two canonical PI models. This is shown both theoretically for the population case, and via experiments in the finite-sample case. More broadly, our framework establishes data symmetries as a natural, underutilized source of background knowledge for robust causal inference.

</details>


### [358] [Twist Flow for Inverse Problems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09281)
*Shiqin Zeng,Zijun Deng,Felix J. Herrmann*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出joint twist-flow，一种增广流匹配框架，将(z_x, y)输运到(x, z_y)，在保持观测一致性的同时提升贝叶斯反问题的后验采样多样性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 贝叶斯反问题中，后验采样需同时满足观测一致性并反映合理解的范围。直接条件生成模型虽引入隐噪声刻画歧义，但成对训练易退化为近似确定性映射，导致生成样本虽与观测一致却低估后验变异性，尤其在后验多峰时出现覆盖不足、模态失真或不同可行解间的虚假过渡。

Method: 提出joint twist-flow：一种增广流匹配公式，学习从增广源状态(z_x, y)到增广终态(x, z_y)的连续输运。其中x为目标变量，y为观测，z_x为后验采样的高斯参考坐标，z_y为与观测分支关联的高斯似然侧坐标。在高斯观测模型下，z_y由归一化观测残差导出，用于刻画观测相容性；其作用不是替代x中的不确定性，而是将生成的x样本与观测一致性耦合，在保持弱约束方向可变性的同时减少似然不一致的变异。

Result: 在具有参考后验样本的低维反问题上，joint twist-flow比直接条件流基线更好地保留多峰后验支撑。在图像恢复与地震地下速度模型反演任务上，方法在维持观测一致性的同时提升了后验变异性。

Conclusion: joint twist-flow通过似然侧坐标z_y耦合观测一致性，缓解了条件生成模型后验变异性不足的问题，在多峰低维反问题及图像恢复、地震反演等任务中验证了其保持后验多样性与观测一致性的有效性。

Abstract: In Bayesian inverse problems, posterior sampling requires generating samples that are consistent with given observations while capturing the range of plausible solutions. Direct conditional generative models introduce latent noise to model this ambiguity, but paired inverse-problem training can still encourage an almost deterministic map from the observation to the target. As a result, generated samples may be observation-consistent while under-representing posterior variability, especially when the posterior is multimodal, leading to undercoverage, mode distortion, or artificial transitions between distinct feasible solutions. We propose joint twist-flow, an augmented flow-matching formulation that learns a continuous transport from the augmented source state $(z_x, y)$ to the augmented terminal state $(x, z_y)$. Here x is the target variable, $y$ is the observation, $z_x$ is the Gaussian reference coordinate for posterior sampling, and $z_y$ is a Gaussian likelihood-side coordinate associated with the observation branch. Under a Gaussian observation model, $z_y$ is motivated by the normalized observation residual associated with observation compatibility. Its role is not to replace uncertainty in $x$, but to couple generated samples of x to observation consistency, helping reduce likelihood-inconsistent variation while preserving variability in weakly constrained directions. We validate the method on low-dimensional inverse problems with reference posterior samples, where joint twist-flow better preserves multimodal posterior support than a direct conditional-flow baseline. We further evaluate the method on image restoration and seismic subsurface velocity-model inversion, showing increased posterior variability while maintaining observation consistency.

</details>


### [359] [Self-attention summary networks for subsurface velocity-model building from common-image gathers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09282)
*Shiqin Zeng,Yunlin Zeng,Abhinav Prakash Gahlot,Zijun Deng,Felix J. Herrmann*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出多尺度自注意力摘要网络，将3D CIG体映射为紧凑条件嵌入，配合流匹配模型实现概率速度反演。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CIG包含反映速度模型误差的聚焦与剩余时差信息，但在常规成像流程中仅作为诊断工具，未被有效用于反演。

Method: 多尺度自注意力摘要网络将高维3D CIG体积压缩为条件嵌入，保留随偏移距变化的运动学结构与空间相干性，同时抑制背景速度失配带来的变化；以该嵌入为条件，用流匹配模型学习从高斯源分布到速度场后验分布的输运映射。

Result: 数值实验表明，相比直接以原始CIG为条件，所提摘要网络提升后验速度推断；多尺度注意力设计对背景模型失配更稳健，后验重建更准确且预测不确定性更低。

Conclusion: 将CIG经多尺度自注意力摘要后作为条件，可有效提升概率速度反演的精度与稳健性，使CIG从诊断工具转为反演的有用输入。

Abstract: Common-image gathers (CIGs) contain physically meaningful information about velocity-model errors through reflector focusing and residual moveout, but in conventional imaging workflows they are typically used only as diagnostic tools. In this work, we propose a multiscale self-attention summary network that maps high-dimensional 3D CIG volumes into compact conditioning embeddings for probabilistic subsurface velocity inversion. These learned embeddings preserve offset-dependent kinematic structure and spatial coherence while reducing variability caused by background-velocity mismatch. Conditioned on these summary embeddings, a flow-matching model learns a transport from a Gaussian source distribution to the posterior distribution of plausible velocity fields. Numerical experiments show that, compared with direct conditioning on raw CIGs, the proposed summary network improves posterior velocity inference. In particular, the multiscale attention design provides greater robustness to background-model mismatch, yielding more accurate posterior reconstructions and lower predictive uncertainty.

</details>


### [360] [MovieSTAGE: Scene, Transition, and Global Encoding for Movie-fMRI ADHD Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09306)
*Boseong Kim,Haejun Chung,Ikbeom Jang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 MovieSTAGE 多尺度框架，将影片内场景的超图功能连接、相邻场景间连接差异与全片功能连接结合，用于自然观影 fMRI 的分类预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自然观影 fMRI 能提供共享且具时间结构的脑动态探测，但现有预测模型多依赖整段功能连接（FC）或时间上泛化的表征，未与叙事事件对齐，可能损失事件相关的动态信息。

Method: MovieSTAGE（Scene, Transition, Global Encoding）包含三部分：场景内基于超图结构组织的 FC 剖面、相邻场景间无符号 FC 剖面差异、以及全片 FC。在 CMI-HBN Despicable Me 队列 260 名被试上，开展病例-对照、ADHD 亚型及三分类任务；采用 10 次重复分层五折交叉验证、完整折外（OOF）预测、配对被试聚类 bootstrap 与置换检验。比较不同分支组合，并将超图神经网络（HGNN）场景编码器与 MLP、GAT、BNT 对比；以人工标注场景划分对比时长匹配随机划分与固定数量 GSBS 对照。

Result: 三类任务 AUROC 分别为 0.69、0.73、0.75，平衡准确率为 67.6%、69.8%、58.3%，均为所评估方法中最高平均点估计。三分类中完整模型优于所有双分支变体；匹配设置下 HGNN 场景编码器优于 MLP、GAT、BNT；人工标注划分优于随机与 GSBS 对照。事后模型分析生成涉及额顶与默认模式网络的网络级假设。

Conclusion: 在该队列中，事件对齐的场景与转换表征与全片 FC 结合具有增量预测价值，受控结果支持多尺度、事件对齐建模的有效性。

Abstract: Naturalistic movie-fMRI provides a shared, temporally structured probe of brain dynamics, yet predictive models commonly rely on whole-run functional connectivity (FC) or temporally generic representations that are not aligned with narrative events. We introduce MovieSTAGE (Scene, Transition, and Global Encoding), a multiscale framework that combines hypergraph-structured FC-profile organization within scenes, unsigned FC-profile differences across adjacent scenes, and whole-movie FC. We evaluated 260 participants from the CMI-HBN Despicable Me cohort on case-control, ADHD-subtype, and three-class classification using 10 repetitions of stratified five-fold cross-validation, complete out-of-fold (OOF) predictions, and paired subject-cluster bootstrap and permutation tests. MovieSTAGE achieved AUROCs of 0.69, 0.73, and 0.75 and balanced accuracies of 67.6%, 69.8%, and 58.3%, respectively, yielding the highest mean point estimates among the evaluated methods. On the three-class task, the full model outperformed all two-branch variants, the HGNN scene encoder outperformed MLP, GAT, and BNT alternatives under matched settings, and the human-annotated partition outperformed duration-matched random and fixed-count GSBS controls. These controlled results support incremental predictive value from event-aligned scene and transition representations when combined with whole-movie FC in this cohort. Post-hoc model-derived analyses generated network-level hypotheses involving frontoparietal and default-mode systems.

</details>


### [361] [From Retrieval to Customer Context: Evaluating Frontier-Model Systems for Voice-of-Customer Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09375)
*Raviraja G,Viraj Bagal,Prabhath Chellingi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出“客户上下文图”(Customer Context Graph)，将客户、运营与分析/行动对象通过类型化关系统一建模，并以此为支撑构建智能体，在9,432条公开反馈与30个问题上对比Agentic RAG、深度研究智能体与图支撑智能体。图支撑智能体综合得分0.961，显著优于深度研究智能体（0.710）与Agentic RAG（0.651），优势主要体现在分析深度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 组织日益依赖前沿语言模型分析客户反馈，但回答质量不仅取决于模型本身，还取决于反馈的组织与可用方式；仅凭文本检索难以回答“为什么、谁受影响、后续采取何行动、由谁负责、是否解决”等深层问题。

Method: 定义客户上下文图：以类型化关系连接客户对象（反馈、对话、用户、账户）、运营对象（工单、支持人员、商机、竞品）与分析/行动对象（分类概念、证据、洞察、工作项、结果）。实验以公开Cursor反馈填充该图，在相同9,432条记录与30个产品、事件、对比及元数据问题上，对比Agentic RAG、深度研究智能体与图支撑智能体。因缺乏穷尽真值，采用比较性评分标准，从答案质量（覆盖与组织）、分析深度（具体性与分解）与证据质量（引用支撑与可追溯性）三维度等权联合评分，评分标准在30题中的28题上校准，并对引用记录与主张进行抽样核验。

Result: 在该对齐评分标准下，客户上下文图支撑智能体综合得分0.961，深度研究智能体为0.710，Agentic RAG为0.651；图支撑智能体在30个配对问题中的27个上优于深度研究智能体（符号检验p<10^-5，其中26题严格最优）。最大优势体现在分析深度（0.967对0.642），反映其发现更具体、层级化展开，具有量化主题与可追溯证据。

Conclusion: 以客户上下文图统一组织客户与业务上下文，可显著提升智能体回答客户反馈问题的质量、分析深度与证据可追溯性；该架构不限于特定反馈来源，可推广至任意反馈渠道。但由于缺乏穷尽真值，评估依赖比较性评分标准，结论的普适性仍需进一步验证。

Abstract: Organizations increasingly use frontier language models to analyze customer feedback, but answer quality also depends on how that feedback is organized and made available. We define a \emph{customer context graph} as a unified model of customer and business context. Typed relationships connect customer objects (feedback, conversations, users, and accounts), operational objects (tickets, support agents, opportunities, and competitors), and analytical or action objects (taxonomy concepts, evidence, insights, work items, and outcomes). This lets an agent investigate not only what customers say, but why, who is affected, what action followed, who owns it, and whether it was resolved. For this experiment, the graph is populated from public Cursor feedback; the same architecture can support any type of feedback source. We compare Agentic RAG, a Deep Research Agent, and a Customer Context Graph-backed Agent on the same 9,432 public Cursor feedback records using 30 realistic product, incident, comparison, and metadata questions. Without exhaustive ground truth, we jointly score responses on answer quality (coverage and organization), analytical depth (specificity and decomposition), and evidence quality (citation support and traceability), using a comparative rubric calibrated on 28 of the 30 questions. We sample cited records against their claims and weight the three dimensions equally. Under this aligned rubric, the Customer Context Graph-backed Agent scores 0.961 overall, versus 0.710 for the Deep Research Agent and 0.651 for Agentic RAG, and leads the Deep Research Agent on 27 of 30 paired questions (sign-test p < 10^(-5); strictly best on 26 of 30). Its largest advantage is analytical depth (0.967 versus 0.642), reflecting more specific, hierarchically developed findings with quantified themes and traceable evidence...

</details>


### [362] [Noise, Denoise, Correct: MCMC Posterior Sampling with Diffusion Priors in Three Steps](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09407)
*So Takao,Gregory David Bellchambers,Luke Ye,Sanmitra Ghosh,Michalis Michaelides*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出"扩散华尔兹"（diffusion waltz）：以SDEdit式加噪-去噪为提案的MCMC方法，经Metropolis-Hastings校正实现精确后验采样，并引入无梯度的集合Kalman更新将观测注入提案。在不可微的Navier-Stokes初始条件恢复任务上优于现有基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预训练扩散模型是求解逆问题的强先验，但在非线性、不可微前向模型下的后验采样仍然困难。现有方法或依赖可微前向算子，或缺乏精确性保证。

Method: 将SDEdit式的加噪-去噪过程用作MCMC提案分布，通过Metropolis-Hastings校正，从而在无需评估先验密度的情况下实现精确后验采样；进一步采用无梯度的集合Kalman更新，在保持采样精确性的前提下把观测信息注入提案，提升提案接受率与混合效率。

Result: 在不可微的Navier-Stokes初始条件恢复任务上，在不同噪声水平与非线性强度条件下，diffusion waltz均优于现有基线方法。

Conclusion: 扩散模型结合MCMC校正可稳健处理非线性、不可微逆问题，观测注入式提案在保证精确性的同时显著提升性能，为非可微逆问题后验采样提供了有效方案。

Abstract: Pretrained diffusion models are powerful priors for inverse problems, but posterior sampling under nonlinear, non-differentiable forward models remain hard. We introduce diffusion waltz, an MCMC method using SDEdit-style noising-denoising as a proposal, corrected via Metropolis-Hastings for exact posterior sampling without prior evaluation. We further propose injecting observations into the proposal while preserving exactness, using a gradient-free ensemble Kalman update. On a non-differentiable Navier-Stokes initial condition recovery task, diffusion waltz outperforms existing baselines across different noise and nonlinearity regimes.

</details>


### [363] [Stability and Diversity of Networked Self-Consuming Generative Ecosystems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09409)
*Xiukun Wei,Yang Zhang,Xueru Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究"网络化自消耗生成模型"：将多个生成模型建模为有向加权图的节点，边权控制合成数据流动，分析重训练动态下的长期行为，给出收敛条件与不动点性质，并揭示真实数据获取、跨模型数据消费与图结构对系统稳定性与多样性的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式AI广泛部署使合成内容难以与真实数据区分，合成数据不可避免地进入后续模型的训练流程，形成自消耗训练循环。已有研究多局限于单模型自消耗或两模型简化交互，缺乏对多模型通过复杂路径相互消费合成数据的网络化场景的理解。

Method: 提出理论框架，将各模型表示为有向加权图中的节点，边权刻画模型间合成数据流动，在重训练动态下分析网络化模型的长期演化行为。

Result: 建立了网络化模型重训练动态的收敛条件，刻画了系统的不动点；分析了各模型对真实数据的可及性、跨模型数据消费以及交互图结构如何影响系统的长期稳定性与多样性。

Conclusion: 该工作首次将自消耗生成模型的分析从孤立模型与双模型交互推广到网络化多模型情境，为理解递归自消耗训练在模型生态系统中的长期后果提供了理论基础。

Abstract: The widespread deployment of generative AI has made it increasingly difficult to distinguish synthetic content from real data. Consequently, synthetic data is inevitably incorporated into the training pipelines of future model generations, forming a self-consuming training loop. Prior work has studied the effects of such recursive self-consuming training, but analyses have largely been limited to isolated models, where a model consumes only its own synthetic data, or to simplified interactions between two models. This paper takes a first step toward understanding networked self-consuming generative models, in which multiple models consume synthetic data generated by one another through complex interaction pathways. We introduce a theoretical framework representing models as nodes in a directed, weighted graph, with edge weights governing the flow of synthetic data among models. Using this framework, we analyze the long-term behavior of networked models under retraining dynamics, establishing conditions for convergence and characterizing the resulting fixed points. We further investigate how the system's long-term stability and diversity are shaped by each model's access to real data, cross-model data consumption, and the structure of the interaction graph.

</details>


### [364] [Self-Consuming Generative Models with Co-Evolving Human Preferences](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09415)
*Xiukun Wei,Tian Xie,Ding Zhu,Xueru Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究生成模型自消耗迭代训练中模型分布与用户偏好协同演化的长期动态，发现纯用户筛选合成数据会放大初始偏差导致单点均衡，而注入参考数据可获得唯一全局吸引均衡，并提出联合选择参考分布与混合权重的算法以低成本导向期望均衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有关于自消耗迭代训练（用户从模型生成候选中筛选偏好样本、用于训练下一代模型）的研究大多假设用户偏好固定。但现实中，接触模型输出会逐渐重塑用户对"理想样本"的认知，从而使模型分布与用户偏好形成协同演化的反馈回路。理解这种耦合动态的长期行为尚未被研究，本文试图填补这一空白。

Method: 作者对模型分布与用户偏好耦合演化的动态系统进行理论分析。首先考察训练完全依赖用户筛选的合成数据的情形，分析迭代筛选对偏差的放大效应与均衡结构；随后引入参考数据注入机制，分析注入率对系统动态的影响，并证明足够大的注入率下系统存在唯一全局吸引均衡。在此基础上，将参考数据注入视为控制手段，提出一种联合优化参考分布及其混合权重的算法，在保持目标属性的同时最小化数据采集成本。

Result: （1）当训练完全依赖用户筛选的合成数据时，迭代筛选会放大初始偏差，系统趋向多个单点均衡之一，即初始占优的实例最终主导整个分布。（2）在训练中以足够大的比率注入参考数据，会根本改变系统动态，产生唯一的全局吸引均衡。（3）所提出的算法能够联合选择参考分布与混合权重，将耦合系统导向既保留期望属性又降低数据采集成本的均衡。

Conclusion: 本文将自消耗迭代训练的长期行为研究从固定偏好扩展到模型分布与用户偏好协同演化的耦合动态，揭示了纯合成数据导致的偏差放大与单点均衡，以及参考数据注入带来的唯一全局吸引均衡，并将参考数据注入用作控制长期结果的手段，为可持续的生成模型训练提供了理论与算法启示。

Abstract: Generative models are increasingly trained in self-consuming iterative loops, where users curate preferred samples from model-generated candidates and the curated samples are used to train future generations of the model. Prior work has largely assumed fixed user preferences, but in practice exposure to model outputs gradually reshapes what users perceive as desirable, creating a feedback loop in which model distributions and user preferences co-evolve. We take a first step toward understanding the long-term behavior of such coupled dynamics. We show that when training relies entirely on user-curated synthetic data, iterative curation amplifies initial biases and drives the system toward one of multiple singleton equilibria in which the instance holding an initial advantage eventually dominates. In contrast, injecting reference data into training at a sufficiently large rate fundamentally changes the dynamics and yields a unique globally attracting equilibrium. Building on this insight, we study how reference-data injection can be used to control long-term outcomes, and propose an efficient algorithm that jointly selects a reference distribution and its mixing weight to steer the coupled system toward equilibria that preserve desired attributes while minimizing data collection costs.

</details>


### [365] [What a Reporting Convention Hides: A Matched-Budget Audit of Quantum Natural Gradient with an Exactly Computed Metric](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09425)
*Lu Wei,Yufeng Wang,Haibin Ling*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究比较了Adam、SPSA与QNG三种变分量子优化器在严格与宽松目标下的性能，发现评估惯例（是否计入未达标运行、目标阈值选择）会改变结论，建议对每次失败计入全额预算并跨目标报告结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已发表的变分量子优化器比较通常只计时达到目标损失的运行，或在单一目标处读取结论，这两种惯例可能决定优化器更昂贵的步骤是否有价值。作者希望量化这些惯例对优化器优劣判断的影响。

Method: 在从设定选择中留出的初始化上，比较Adam、SPSA和QNG；精确计算QNG预处理所需的度量；以电路评估次数为每一步计价，并给所有方法相同预算；对电路宽度、成本族及含共同失败的设定扫描做中位数汇总。

Result: 在汇总中位数下，SPSA达到宽松目标所需评估次数是Adam的两倍多，而剔除未达标的删失运行会掩盖这一差距；在全局成本族上，QNG通常晚于Adam达到宽松目标但先达到严格目标；当QNG度量的模拟器价格（与参数数线性）被假设的硬件计数（与参数数二次）替代后，其严格目标领先消失。

Conclusion: 评估惯例显著影响优化器优劣结论，应把每次失败计入全额预算，并在多个目标下报告结果，以避免因删失或单一目标读取而产生误导。

Abstract: Several published comparisons of variational quantum optimizers time only runs that reach a target loss, or read the verdict at a single target. Either convention could decide whether an optimizer's costlier steps pay off. We measure how much each convention changes verdicts among Adam, simultaneous perturbation stochastic approximation (SPSA) and quantum natural gradient (QNG), on initializations held out from the selection of settings. We compute the exact metric that preconditions QNG, price every step in circuit evaluations and give every method the same budget. In a median pooled over circuit widths, cost families and a sweep of settings with common misses, SPSA needs more than twice Adam's evaluations to reach a loose target. Dropping the censored runs that miss the target hides this gap. On the global-cost family we hold fixed the settings selected for a strict target. QNG then usually reaches the loose target after Adam but the strict target first. QNG's strict-target lead disappears when the metric's simulator price, linear in the number of parameters, is replaced by an assumed hardware count quadratic in that number. We recommend charging every miss the budget and reporting verdicts across targets.

</details>


### [366] [An extended deep energy method for thermo-mechanical crack propagation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09433)
*Han Zhang,Mehrisadat Makki Alamdari,Babak Shahbodagh,Mohammad Vahab,Cosmin Anitescu,Timon Rabczuk,Elena Atroshchenko*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出扩展深度能量方法，用双网络分别表示温度与位移场，通过非连续标量嵌入函数表示尖锐裂纹，实现热-力耦合裂纹扩展模拟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有神经能量求解器虽已处理相场断裂及尖锐裂纹表示，但尚未将裂纹域上的热传导与热应力驱动的裂纹扩展统一处理，缺乏热-力耦合裂纹扩展的求解框架。

Method: 采用两个神经网络分别表示温度场与位移场，输入含跨裂纹非连续、其他区域光滑的标量嵌入函数；位移场在裂尖用Williams展开加可训练幅值进行富集。以交错序列分别最小化增量传导泛函与热弹性势能，采用蒙特卡洛积分，采样点在背景单元上分层、裂尖附近加密并在训练中重采样。用含Wilson-Yu面积项的相互作用积分提取应力强度因子，并通过轮廓半径扫描校验；当拐折能量释放率在裂尖温度下达到临界值时，裂纹沿最大环向应力角扩展。

Result: 静止热边缘裂纹的应力强度因子与文献值误差0.11%；功能梯度剪切试验中裂纹起裂与独立尖锐裂纹有限元解误差在一个载荷步以内；缺口十字形试件在机械、热及联合载荷下的裂纹路径与已发表解一致。

Conclusion: 该扩展深度能量方法能够在无正则化长度下模拟尖锐裂纹的热-力耦合扩展，且与解析解、有限元解及文献结果吻合良好，验证了方法的准确性。

Abstract: Thermo-mechanical fracture couples transient heat conduction on a cracked domain with a crack that grows as the temperature and the displacement evolve. Neural energy solvers have been proposed for phase-field fracture and later extended to represent a sharp crack through the network input, but heat conduction on the cracked domain and crack propagation under the resulting thermal stresses have not yet been treated together in these solvers. We present an extended deep energy method for thermo-mechanical crack propagation in which the crack remains a sharp polyline. Two networks represent the temperature and the displacement and receive the crack through a scalar embedding function, discontinuous across the crack and smooth elsewhere, so that both fields can jump across it without a regularization length, and the displacement is enriched near the tip by the Williams expansion with trainable amplitudes. The two fields are obtained by minimizing an incremental conduction functional and the thermoelastic potential energy in a staggered sequence, with Monte Carlo integration on points stratified over background elements, densified near the tip and redrawn during training. The stress intensity factors are extracted by the interaction integral with the area term of Wilson and Yu and checked by a sweep of the contour radius, and the crack advances at the maximum hoop stress angle when the energy release rate of the kink reaches the critical value at the crack-tip temperature. On a stationary thermal edge crack the extracted stress intensity factor agrees with the published value to 0.11%, in a functionally graded shear test initiation agrees with an independent sharp-crack finite element solution to within one load step, and on a notched cruciform specimen the crack paths follow the published solutions under mechanical, thermal and combined loading.

</details>


### [367] [When Should an In-Context Learner Expand Its Hypothesis Space?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09471)
*Weihan Li,Xinlei Chen,Junhao Wu,Tianshi Zheng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出"结构修正环境"(SRE),将模型族扩展决策建模为代价敏感的序贯决策问题,存在精确贝叶斯解;实验表明Transformer能从效用中复现价值边界,但语言模型难以将证据转化为扩展价值的估计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 学习系统在熟悉的模型族内可快速适应,但更难的步骤在于:当观察到可能是噪声、例外、族内变化或族外结构的现象时,判断是否值得付出代价开启一个更丰富的模型族。核心问题是将预测失败转化为结构证据、证据转化为扩展价值、价值转化为行动。

Method: 构建"结构修正环境"(Structural Revision Environment):为每个来源生成匹配的失败样本,独立于证据地变化扩展价格与剩余时间跨度,支持精确贝叶斯计算及一次性决策的精确规范解。训练Transformer及三类后训练谱系的语言模型,并进行元训练的受控后训练实验。

Result: 规范解显示修正是价值边界而非证据阈值:同一历史在不同价格、时间跨度和给定查询下最优行动不同;局部修复与扩展之间的边界由规则预测无法覆盖的输入决定;对更丰富族的信念远早于决策跨越。Transformer仅从效用即可复现该边界。三类语言模型携带对失败敏感的信号但未反映在修正决策中,给定扩展收益时只读取收益而不权衡价格与时间跨度;三个被允许推理的模型按参考比例权衡收益,但仍未将历史转化为对扩展价值的估计。受控后训练改变先验与预测锐度,但均未改变判据。

Conclusion: 模型扩展决策本质上是价值边界问题,取决于收益、价格与时间跨度,而非单纯证据阈值。Transformer可从效用中学习该边界,但当前语言模型及其后训练与推理机制尚不能在决策中有效权衡价格与时间跨度。

Abstract: Learning systems adapt quickly inside a familiar family of models. The harder step comes earlier: deciding, from observations that could be noise, an exception, a change within the family or structure outside it, whether opening a richer family is worth its cost. We treat this as a costly sequential decision: prediction failure must be turned into structural evidence, evidence into a value of expansion, and value into action. The Structural Revision Environment produces matched failures from each source, varies the price of expansion and the remaining horizon independently of the evidence, and admits exact Bayesian calculations and an exact normative solution of the one-shot decision. Its solution shows that revision is a value boundary and not an evidence threshold: one history has different optimal actions under different prices, horizons and announced queries, the boundary between local repair and expansion is set by the inputs a rule predicts and a repair cannot cover, and belief in the richer family crosses long before the decision does. Transformers trained in the environment reproduce this boundary from utility alone. Language models of three post-training lineages carry a failure-sensitive signal in their predictions that is not reflected in their revision decisions, and given the gain of expanding they read it without weighing it against price and horizon. Three models allowed to reason weigh the stated gain in the reference's proportions and still do not turn the history into an estimate of what expansion would buy. Controlled post-training of the meta-trained learners moves the prior and the sharpness of predictions, and neither moves the criterion.

</details>


### [368] [Physics-Informed Neural Plasticity: PDE Solvers That Reshape Themselves](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09510)
*Chun-Wun Cheng,Bingcheng Hu,Angelica I. Aviles-Rivero*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"物理信息神经可塑性"范式及ReCAP方法，让PDE求解器的表示能力在训练中动态重塑，通过在五个3D/4D基准上取得最低相对L2误差（较最强基线降低10.7%–27.5%）验证了其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有物理信息神经PDE求解器仅调整参数而保持表示结构固定，这与空间及时空上复杂度强烈非均匀的PDE解不匹配：在物理困难区域容量不足，在简单区域容量冗余。

Method: 提出物理信息神经可塑性范式，并实例化为ReCAP——一种基于高斯基局部化的求解器，通过局部增强、残差导向分裂、门控剪枝和函数感知合并动态重分配容量；使用责任加权误差指标与残差能量几何决定细化位置与方式；引入"安静子代细化"（quiet-child refinement），通过迁移父代表示并控制瞬时函数扰动来初始化新分量；并建立条件性后验可靠性与结构稳定性保证，将局部物理残差与解误差及稳定细化联系起来。

Result: 在五个具有挑战性的3D和4D PDE基准上，与11种物理信息求解器对比，ReCAP在每个问题上都取得最低的相对L2误差，较最强竞争结果降低10.7%–27.5%。

Conclusion: 结果表明物理信息求解器不仅能够学习参数，还能学习其表示容量应如何组织，即表示结构本身可作为优化对象自适应演化。

Abstract: Physics-informed neural PDE solvers adapt their parameters to satisfy governing equations, yet their representational structure typically remains fixed throughout training. This rigidity is poorly matched to PDE solutions with strongly heterogeneous complexity across space and space--time, leaving capacity insufficient where the physics is difficult and redundant where it is simple. We introduce physics-informed neural plasticity, a paradigm in which the representation itself reshapes during optimization in response to unresolved physics. We instantiate this principle with Representation Capacity Adaptation for PDEs (ReCAP), a Gaussian-localized solver that dynamically redistributes capacity through local enrichment, residual-directed splitting, gate-based pruning, and function-aware merging. ReCAP uses responsibility-weighted error indicators and the geometry of residual energy to determine where and how to refine. To limit the disturbance introduced by splitting, we introduce quiet-child refinement, which initializes new components by transporting the parent representation while controlling instantaneous functional perturbation. We further establish conditional a posteriori reliability and structural-stability guarantees linking localized physics residuals to solution error and stable refinement. Across five challenging 3D and 4D PDE benchmarks against 11 physics-informed solvers, ReCAP achieves the lowest relative $L^2$ error on every problem, reducing error by $10.7\%$--$27.5\%$ relative to the strongest competing result. These results suggest that physics-informed solvers need not merely learn their parameters---they can learn how their representational capacity should be organized.

</details>


### [369] [Differential Refresh Policies for Models Trained on Lagging Data Snapshots: From a Single-Age Equivalence Limit to an Optimal Per-Segment Allocation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09519)
*Amit Rajula*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文指出，对全局训练数据年龄做加权陈旧度打分再触发重训是错误杠杆；任何单一全局年龄的单调触发都等价于统一年龄定时器。正确做法是按段差异化刷新，并求解预算分配问题：频繁刷新下最优刷新率正比于该段风险 w_jλ_j 的平方根，收益由柯西-施瓦茨形式的"统一代价"给出，异构性越大收益越高。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生产中的机器学习模型是时间受限训练快照的派生产物，一旦构建即开始老化。业界常用自适应触发（加权陈旧度分数）替代固定重训周期，作者认为选错了杠杆，需要找到真正有效的调度维度。

Method: 先证明等价性极限：对单一共享全局训练数据年龄的静态严格单调触发函数，在操作上等价于标定过的统一年龄定时器。据此提出按段差异化刷新，使每段拥有独立年龄与刷新间隔，适用于刷新成本可分段（增量训练或分模型）。随后在刷新预算约束下求解分段预算分配优化问题，并用真实泊松变化事件的离散事件仿真进行验证。

Result: 频繁刷新机制下，每段最优刷新率正比于其风险 w_jλ_j 的平方根；最优策略成本不高于统一定时器，收益有闭式柯西-施瓦茨"统一代价"，同质负载下为零、随异构性增长。仿真显示，在相同刷新预算下最优策略将实际加权陈旧暴露降低 8–29%，在 86–100% 的随机种子上胜出；朴素暴露阈值策略无此效果，说明起作用的是分配而非分数；该优势在 50% 速率估计噪声下仍保持。

Conclusion: 模型刷新的杠杆不在更好的陈旧度评分，而在更好的动作——按段差异化分配刷新预算。全局陈旧度预算不携带时钟以外的调度信息；异构负载下，平方根风险比例分配是更优且稳健的策略。

Abstract: Production machine-learning models are derived artifacts of time-bounded training snapshots: a deployed model is a materialized view over a training cut that ages the instant it is built. A common response is to replace the fixed retraining cadence with an adaptive trigger -- a weighted staleness score that retrains when accumulated source risk crosses a threshold. We show this is the wrong lever, and identify the right one. First, an equivalence limit: any refresh trigger that is a static, strictly monotone function of a single shared global training-data age is operationally equivalent to a calibrated uniform age timer, so a global staleness budget, however elaborately it weights segments, sources, and sensitivities, carries no scheduling information a clock does not. The limit also shows how to escape it: refresh segments differentially, giving each its own age and refresh interval, which is meaningful when refresh cost is separable across segments (incremental training or per-segment models). We solve the resulting budget-allocation problem. In the frequent-refresh regime each segment's optimal refresh rate is proportional to the square root of its risk $w_j λ_j$ (weight times change rate), and the optimal policy never costs more than the uniform timer, beating it by a closed-form Cauchy-Schwarz "price of uniformity" that is zero for homogeneous workloads and grows with heterogeneity. In a discrete-event simulation with real Poisson change events, the optimal policy lowers realized weighted stale exposure by 8-29% relative to the uniform timer at matched refresh budget, winning on 86-100% of seeds; a naive exposure-threshold policy does not, showing the allocation is what helps; and the advantage survives 50% rate-estimation noise. The leverage in model refresh is not a better score but a better action.

</details>


### [370] [CircuitGate: Logic-Consistent Circuit-Level Functional Modeling for And-Inverter Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09549)
*Qifan Zhang,Ruijie Li,Fangzhou Zhang,Qian Ma,Hui Li,Furui Zhan,Yongpeng Wang,Liying Hao,Shikai Guo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出CircuitGate，一种功能感知的AIG表示学习框架，通过编码全局原始输入支持与支持重叠感知的重汇聚关系，并结合逻辑启发的布尔约束，实现从门级语义到电路级功能建模的跨越，在多项任务上优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AIG是EDA中逻辑综合与验证的基本表示。现有基于学习的AIG表示方法主要依赖GNN和门级局部消息传递，难以捕捉电路级功能上下文，且表示对拓扑特定模式敏感、对功能保持变换的鲁棒性不足。

Method: 提出CircuitGate框架：显式编码全局原始输入（PI）支持；建模扇入之间支持重叠感知的重汇聚（reconvergence）关系；引入逻辑启发的布尔约束，以促使表示在功能上保持一致，从而实现电路级功能建模。

Result: 在ForgeEDA大规模基准上评估，并在EPFL与ITC'99上验证。在等价门识别与信号概率预测任务上持续优于现有方法，MAE分别最多降低21.7%和14.2%；在ForgeEDA到OpenABC的直接迁移（无微调）下，等价门识别取得最佳性能，展现强跨数据集泛化能力。

Conclusion: 结果表明，超越局部拓扑、建模电路级功能依赖关系是有效的，CircuitGate验证了功能感知表示学习的优势。

Abstract: And-Inverter Graphs (AIGs) are fundamental representations for logic synthesis and verification in Electronic Design Automation (EDA). As structured representations of complex digital systems, AIGs require models to capture functional dependencies beyond local structure and remain robust to functionality-preserving transformations. In learning-based AIG representation, existing approaches are predominantly based on GNNs and rely on local gate-level message passing, limiting their ability to capture circuit-level functional context and making the learned representations sensitive to topology-specific patterns. Therefore, we propose CircuitGate, a function-aware AIG representation learning framework that advances from gate-level semantics to circuit-level functional modeling. CircuitGate explicitly encodes global primary-input (PI) support and models support-overlap-aware reconvergence between fanins, while incorporating logic-inspired Boolean constraints to encourage functionally consistent representations. We evaluate CircuitGate on the large-scale ForgeEDA benchmark and further validate it on the EPFL and ITC'99 benchmarks. Across equivalent-gate identification and signal-probability prediction tasks, CircuitGate consistently outperforms existing methods, achieving up to 21.7% and 14.2% reductions in MAE, respectively. Under direct ForgeEDA-to-OpenABC transfer without fine-tuning, CircuitGate also achieves the best equivalent-gate identification performance, demonstrating strong cross-dataset generalization. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of modeling circuit-level functional dependencies beyond local topology.

</details>


### [371] [A Framework for the Systematic Review of ML Assets in AI Registries](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09551)
*Alexandra González,Quim Motger,Xavier Franch,Silverio Martínez-Fernández*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将传统系统综述方法（规划、执行、文档化三阶段）适配到AI资源注册中心，把ML资产（预训练模型、数据集、基准）作为一等分析单元，提出一个整合注册中心感知检索、跨注册中心模式对齐与依赖驱动探索的框架，使ML资产的检索与选择从非正式的临时活动转变为可追溯、可复现的系统化过程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代软件系统日益依赖ML资产（预训练模型、数据集、基准）来构建、评估和集成ML系统，但当前ML资产的探索、选择与复用缺乏类似传统证据综合的系统化检索方法，导致选择常被视为既定设计决策，仅凭非正式理由支撑，缺乏可追溯、基于证据且可更新的选择过程。

Method: 分析科学文献中成熟的系统综述实践，将其阶段（规划、执行、文档化）适配到AI注册中心，把ML资产视为一等分析单元，构建的框架整合了注册中心感知的检索策略、跨注册中心的模式对齐以及依赖驱动的ML资产探索。

Result: 将ML资产检索概念化为系统化、可复现的流程而非临时活动，并提出了结构化ML资产发现的框架。该工作展示了系统综述原则如何从科学文献扩展到对不断演化的AI注册中心进行证据综合。

Conclusion: 系统综述原则可超越科学文献范畴，用于支持对不断演化的AI注册中心进行证据综合，从而使ML资产的选择透明、可复现、基于明确证据，并更契合其预期用途。

Abstract: Background: Modern software systems increasingly rely on Machine Learning (ML) assets (i.e., pre-trained models, datasets, benchmarks) for building, evaluating, and integrating ML-based systems. However, current exploration, selection and reuse practices of ML assets are not supported by systematic retrieval methodologies comparable to those used in traditional evidence synthesis. Consequently, in practice, ML asset selection is often presented as a settled design decision, supported by informal justification rather than a traceable, evidence-based, and updatable selection process. Aims: This paper explores how systematic review methods can support ML asset retrieval. In doing so, we aim to make their selection transparent and reproducible, grounded in explicit evidence, and ultimately better suited to its intended use. Method: We analyze established systematic review practices from scientific literature and adapt their phases (i.e., planning, conducting, and documenting) to Artificial Intelligence (AI) registries, treating ML assets as first-class units of analysis. The resulting framework integrates registry-aware search strategies, cross-registry schema alignment, and dependency-driven ML asset exploration. Results: We conceptualize ML asset retrieval as a systematic and reproducible process rather than an ad hoc activity, and propose a framework for structured ML asset discovery. \textbf{Conclusions:} This work illustrates how systematic review principles can be extended beyond scientific literature to support evidence synthesis over evolving AI registries.

</details>


### [372] [UniCSI Towards a Universal Wi-Fi CSI Encoder for Ubiquitous Human Sensing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09559)
*Daniel Eckhoff,Hua Kang,Zhitang Chen,Jie Chuai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出UniCSI统一基础架构，直接处理异构CSI，通过物理感知RF分词器与频谱聚合器实现跨配置、跨频段、跨子载波数的通用Wi-Fi感知建模。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Wi-Fi感知可利用环境中现有无线信号实现普适人体感知，但CSI采集受设备配置差异影响（子载波数、带宽、载波频段不同），导致CSI张量在频谱分辨率和形状上不一致，异构建模困难。标准架构难以应对这种异构性，只能采用有损预处理，破坏了原始信号完整性。

Method: UniCSI包含两项核心创新：(1) 物理感知RF分词器，根据每个频率信道在物理频谱中的分数位置而非固定数组索引进行编码，保持内在频谱相干性，实现与频率分辨率无关的跨任意感知配置处理；(2) 频谱聚合器，将变长信道序列提炼为固定尺寸的频谱特征，使特征维度与物理子载波间隔解耦。

Result: 在25个异构公开数据集（涵盖14至2048个子载波、20至160 MHz带宽、2.4和5 GHz频段）上进行大规模评估，结果表明原生异构输入在监督和自监督训练方案下均显著提升跨域迁移性能，尤其在固定网格架构无法泛化的场景中优势明显。

Conclusion: UniCSI通过直接处理异构CSI并保留原生波形完整性，有效解决了设备配置差异带来的建模难题，为统一Wi-Fi感知基础模型提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Wi-Fi sensing promises to turn the everyday wireless signals that already surround us into ubiquitous sensors for human sensing. However, a fundamental obstacle is that CSI is acquired under diverse device-specific configurations, including different subcarrier counts, bandwidths, and carrier bands. Consequently, the resulting CSI tensors vary in both spectral resolution and tensor shape, making heterogeneous modeling challenging. Standard architectures struggle with such heterogeneity, forcing lossy pre-processing which compromises the underlying signal. To bridge this gap, we present UniCSI, a unified foundation architecture that directly operates on heterogeneous CSI while preserving the integrity of the native waveform. UniCSI hinges on two core innovations: (1) a physics-informed RF tokenizer that encodes each frequency channel based on its fractional position within the physical spectrum rather than rigid array indices. It preserves intrinsic spectral coherence and enables seamless, frequency resolution-agnostic processing across arbitrary sensing configurations. (2) a spectral aggregator that distills variable-length channel sequences into a fixed-size spectral signature, effectively decoupling the feature dimensionality from the physical subcarrier spacing. Extensive evaluations on a large-scale corpus of 25 heterogeneous public datasets, spanning 14 to 2048 subcarriers, 20 to 160 MHz bandwidth, and the 2.4 and 5 GHz bands, demonstrate that native heterogeneous ingestion substantially improves cross-domain transfer under both supervised and self-supervised training schemes, particularly in regimes where fixed-grid architectures fail to generalize.

</details>


### [373] [EvoSignal: LLM-Guided Evolutionary Design of Modular Traffic Signal Control Programs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09563)
*Leizhen Wang,Peibo Duan,Zhenlin Qin,Yancheng Ling,Jian Xu,Yue Wang,Hao Wang,Zhenliang Ma*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 EvoSignal：将交通信号控制（TSC）建模为模块化程序设计问题，用 LLM 引导的进化框架结合交通知识与性能反馈自动搜索可解释的控制程序，程序离线运行、无需在线 LLM 推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 TSC 策略难以适应变化的交通需求与路网条件，且常需反复人工设计与调参，难以系统性地探索更优控制规则；直接用 LLM 选择信号相位会导致决策规则黑箱化，并带来持续的推理成本与延迟。

Method: 将 TSC 形式化为模块化程序设计问题，模块划分为交通特征提取、局部相位优先排序、可选的网络级优先级调整三部分；以若干成熟策略为起点，利用 LLM 结合交通知识与拥堵、信号运行表现的反馈进行进化式改进，并保留具有不同性能权衡的策略；所得程序不含在线 LLM 推理。

Result: 在两个真实路网、五个场景的仿真中，默认 EvoSignal 程序相比每场景下 20 个基线（传统方法、强化学习、LLM 方法）中的最低等待时间再降低 16.8%–49.2%；一个以旅行时间与排队长度为优先的程序在搜索场景的全部三项指标上超过全部 20 个基线，原样迁移到其余四个场景后每项指标仍居前三。

Conclusion: 结果表明可自动设计出可审查（inspectable）的控制程序，且能在所评估的路网与交通需求间迁移，避免在线 LLM 推理的开销。代码已开源。

Abstract: Effective traffic signal control (TSC) requires policies that respond to changing traffic demand and network conditions while meeting different control objectives. However, adapting existing strategies often involves repeated manual design and adjustment, making it difficult to systematically explore better control rules for a target network. Large language models (LLMs) can automate this process, but directly using them to select signal phases leaves decision rules embedded in black-box models and incurs recurring inference costs and latency. This paper formulates TSC as a modular program design problem and proposes EvoSignal, an LLM-guided evolutionary framework using traffic knowledge and performance feedback. The modular representation separates traffic feature extraction, local phase prioritization, and optional network-based priority adjustment. Starting from several established strategies, EvoSignal improves programs through feedback on congestion and signal operation, retaining strategies with different performance trade-offs. The resulting programs operate without online LLM inference. Simulation experiments across five scenarios on two real-world road networks show that the selected default EvoSignal program reduces waiting time by 16.8--49.2\% relative to the lowest waiting time achieved by the 20 conventional, reinforcement learning-based, and LLM-based baselines in each scenario. A program prioritizing travel time and queue length outperforms all 20 baselines on all three metrics in the search scenario and remains among the top three on each metric when transferred unchanged to the other four scenarios. These findings support automated design of inspectable control programs that transfer across the evaluated road networks and traffic demands.Code is available at https://github.com/georgewanglz2019/EvoSignal.

</details>


### [374] [Online Resource Allocation with an Endogenous Markov State: Fewer LP Solves Earn More](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09577)
*Zhaohua Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究具有内生马尔可夫状态的有限时域在线资源分配：稳态LP提供状态依赖随机控制。已知先验下，非退化+不可约时频繁与不频繁重求解均达O(1)遗憾；退化时频繁重求解反而可能Ω(T)、不频繁为Θ(√T)。未知先验下提出三阶段U形不频繁重求解策略，仅需O(log log T)次LP求解，在非退化下达O(1)、退化下达O(√T)；缺乏目标状态类信息则线性极小极大遗憾不可避免。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线资源分配中，动作会影响支配未来奖励与资源消耗的马尔可夫状态，导致经典的流体LP基准与稳态LP控制之间存在状态内生性缺口；同时请求先验通常未知。作者希望厘清：重求解频率如何影响遗憾界，以及在学习未知先验时能否保持低遗憾与低计算成本。

Method: 以瞬态流体LP为上界基准，用稳态LP给出状态依赖的随机控制；引入原始非退化性与最优诱导核不可约性作为正则条件。已知先验下分析频繁/不频繁重求解的遗憾率；未知先验下设计三阶段U形不频繁重求解策略，将学习与库存校正协同，并控制LP求解次数。

Result: 已知先验：非退化+不可约时，频繁与不频繁重求解均达O(1)遗憾。退化最优时，不可约使不频繁重求解达到最坏情形尖锐Θ(√T)，而频繁重求解可为Ω(T)——更频繁优化反而渐近更差。未知先验：三阶段U形策略用O(log log T)次LP求解，在不可约且给定最优目标状态类与常数代价进入策略时，非退化O(1)、退化O(√T)；无目标类信息时线性极小极大遗憾不可避免。数值实验显示逐轮重求解相对按纪元不频繁重求解更不稳定，阈值化显著缓解其损失，且不频繁方案在已知与估计先验下均占优。

Conclusion: 重求解频率并非越高越好：在内生状态与退化最优下，频繁重求解可能渐近更差。最优实践是按纪元不频繁重求解并辅以阈值化和目标状态类信息，从而在未知先验下以极少LP求解实现接近最优遗憾。

Abstract: We study finite-horizon online resource allocation with i.i.d. requests and an endogenous Markov state on a finite state space: each action affects the transition of the state that governs future rewards and resource consumption. In this problem, a transient fluid LP benchmark upper bounds the expected reward of every nonanticipating policy, while a stationary LP supplies randomized state-dependent controls. We assume that the stationary LP has a unique optimum and identify primal nondegeneracy and irreducibility of the optimal induced kernel as important regularity conditions in this framework. With a known request prior, we show that, under nondegeneracy and irreducibility, both frequent and infrequent re-solving attain $O(1)$ regret. However, under a degenerate optimum, irreducibility yields the sharp worst-case $Θ(\sqrt{T})$ rate for infrequent re-solving, while frequent re-solving can incur $Ω(T)$ regret. Thus, more frequent optimization can perform asymptotically worse. With an unknown request prior, we develop a three-phase U-shaped infrequent re-solving policy that coordinates learning and inventory correction with $O(\log\log T)$ LP solves. When the optimal induced kernel is irreducible and the algorithm is given the optimal target state class and a constant-cost entrance policy, it attains $O(1)$ regret under nondegeneracy and $O(\sqrt{T})$ regret under degeneracy. Without the target-class information, linear minimax regret is unavoidable. Numerical experiments further illustrate the instability of round-by-round re-solving relative to epoch-wise infrequent re-solving, show that thresholding greatly mitigates its loss, and find that infrequent schemes remain dominant under both known and estimated priors.

</details>


### [375] [COPC: Coupled Off-Policy Correction for Asynchronous LLM Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09597)
*Zicheng Hu,Zhijian Zhou,Xuan Zhang,Yuchen Liu,Cheng Chen,Yuan Li,Qi Gu,Yan Feng,Hongyan Hao,Chao Qu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出耦合离策略校正（COPC），指出异步RL中仅做策略侧校正不足，需同时校正优势侧失配，在工具集成数学推理和搜索上取得最优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 异步RL通过解耦rollout生成与优化加速LLM后训练，但训练使用过时的轨迹。现有方法仅在actor目标中通过重要性比控制校正token级策略失配。作者指出这种仅策略侧校正不足以解决问题：优势估计也继承了行为策略续接带来的失配（即优势陈旧性），因此需要协调地校正策略侧与优势侧。

Method: 推导了通用双通道actor更新的精确偏差与方差分解，揭示策略权重误差与优势估计误差之间存在不可分离的耦合：其交互产生乘性偏差项，而策略权重的平方会放大梯度方差中的优势不确定性。基于此提出COPC（Coupled Off-Policy Correction），一种actor-critic方法，将token级比率掩码与对TD残差的双侧裁剪比率加权相结合，用于回报和优势估计。

Result: 跨不同陈旧度水平的联合参数扫描支持该假设：一个校正参数的效果依赖于另一个参数，且可能随其反转。COPC在工具集成数学推理和搜索上取得最高报告性能，各设置下均优于最强的异步基线；具备宽广的高性能参数区域和更好的训练稳定性。在搜索中COPC全程稳定，而多数异步基线在训练后期崩溃。这些增益在64步策略陈旧度下依然保持。COPC相较异步PPO仅增加极小的单步时间开销，并较同步PPO保持1.7倍单步速度提升。

Conclusion: 策略侧与优势侧的校正应当协调进行；COPC通过耦合校正实现了更高的性能、更稳定的训练和更广的参数适应范围，同时保持异步RL的效率优势。

Abstract: Asynchronous RL accelerates large language model post-training by decoupling rollout generation from optimization, but trains on stale trajectories. Existing methods primarily correct token-level policy mismatch through importance-ratio control in the actor objective. We show that this \emph{policy-side correction} alone is insufficient: advantage estimates also inherit mismatch from behavior-policy continuations, which we term \emph{advantage staleness}. We derive exact bias and variance decompositions for a general two-channel actor update, revealing nonseparable coupling between policy-weight and advantage-estimation errors: their interaction induces multiplicative bias terms, while squared policy weights amplify advantage uncertainty in gradient variance. This motivates the hypothesis that policy- and advantage-side correction should be coordinated. We introduce Coupled Off-Policy Correction (COPC), an actor--critic method combining token-level ratio masking with two-sided clipped-ratio weighting of TD residuals for return and advantage estimation. Joint parameter sweeps across staleness levels support this hypothesis: the effect of one correction parameter depends on, and can reverse with, the other. COPC achieves the highest reported performance on tool-integrated mathematical reasoning and search, outperforming the strongest reported asynchronous baseline in each setting. It also offers a broad high-performing parameter region and improved training stability. In search, COPC remains stable throughout training, while most evaluated asynchronous baselines collapse late in training. These gains persist at 64-step policy staleness. COPC adds minimal step-time overhead over asynchronous PPO and retains a $1.7\times$ step-time speedup over synchronous PPO.

</details>


### [376] [Lightweight and Versatile Learned Optimization by Recombination of Gradient History](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09604)
*Minyoung Choi,Dalta Imam Maulana,Wanyeong Jung*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种轻量级通用学习型优化器，将梯度历史表示为不相交时间跨度上的平均并按标量系数动态重组，可零样本泛化到未见任务，性能优于Adam且计算开销极低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有学习型优化器（learned optimizer）在泛化性、内存成本与计算开销之间难以平衡：长梯度历史虽有助于优化，但存储成本高；同时多参数共享与动态组合机制不足，导致难以零样本迁移到未见任务。本文旨在设计一个既能有效利用长梯度历史、又计算与内存开销极低的通用优化器。

Method: 将梯度历史表示为若干不相交时间跨度上的梯度平均值；通过动态重组这些平均值进行优化。将预测空间缩减为每个梯度平均对应一个标量系数，并在多个参数间共享。采用渐进式平均（progressively averaging）策略处理更旧的梯度以降低长历史的内存开销，同时保持各时间跨度贡献的独立可访问性。

Result: 37k参数的网络仅训练0.87 GPU小时即可零样本泛化到未见任务；在BERT-Tiny和GPT-Tiny上验证损失分别降低9.1%与0.4%；在Vision Transformer上测试准确率相较Adam提升3.5个百分点，在九个图模型上平均提升2.7个百分点；FLOPs开销低至0.3%。

Conclusion: 该优化器以极小的参数量、训练成本与计算开销，实现了对多种架构与任务的零样本泛化，并在语言、视觉与图模型上稳定超越Adam，展示了轻量级学习型优化器在实际应用中的潜力。

Abstract: This paper presents a lightweight and versatile learned optimizer that dynamically recombines gradient history, represented as averages over disjoint time spans. The optimizer reduces the prediction space to one scalar coefficient per gradient average, shared by multiple parameters. Progressively averaging older gradients minimizes memory cost of long history, while keeping their contributions independently accessible. A 37k-parameter network trained in 0.87 GPU-hours generalizes zero-shot to unseen tasks, lowering validation loss by 9.1% and 0.4% on BERT-Tiny and GPT-Tiny, and improving test accuracy over Adam by 3.5 %p on a Vision Transformer and by 2.7 %p on average across nine graph models, with FLOPs overhead as low as 0.3%.

</details>


### [377] [Decoupled Optimization for Teacher-Student Semi-Supervised Learning via a Pioneer Student](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09609)
*Haorong Han,Jidong Yuan,Chixuan Wei,Yongqi Sun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文指出半监督学习（SSL）中师生框架的自训练与标注/无标注联合优化存在两类优化病理，并提出独立参数空间的辅助分支Pioneer Student（PiS）以周期性知识回传，通用提升主流SSL方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有SSL依赖两大核心机制：Teacher-Student框架下的自训练，以及标注与无标注损失的联合优化。作者发现二者分别带来优化病理：其一，师生间的参数耦合强制严格同步，对学生施加强正则化会削弱教师的拟合能力，从而限制可用的泛化强度；其二，标注与无标注损失在梯度更新一致性上的不平衡，使共享参数过早收敛到标注主导的局部极小值，形成全局优化的瓶颈。因此需要一种解耦且能缓解梯度失衡的机制。

Method: 提出Pioneer Student（PiS），一个在独立参数空间中运行的辅助分支，避免与Teacher-Student模型直接参数耦合；PiS周期性将其累积的知识回传至T-S模型，以缓解教师拟合能力退化与梯度更新不一致问题。PiS设计为即插即用模块，可集成到主流SSL方法中。

Result: 大量实验表明，PiS作为通用即插即用模块，能够持续提升主流SSL方法的性能。

Conclusion: 通过解耦参数空间并周期性回传知识，PiS同时缓解了师生同步导致的泛化受限与标注主导的过早收敛问题，验证了其作为通用SSL增强模块的有效性与普适性。

Abstract: Semi-supervised learning (SSL) relies on two core mechanisms: self-training under the Teacher-Student (T-S) framework and joint optimization of labeled and unlabeled losses. Despite their effectiveness, we find both mechanisms introduce distinct optimization pathologies. First, parameter coupling enforces strict synchronization between teacher and student, where strong regularization on the student degrades the teacher's fitting ability, thereby limiting the permissible generalization intensity. Second, the imbalance in gradient update consistency between labeled and unlabeled losses drives the shared parameters to prematurely converge to labeled-dominated local minima, creating a bottleneck for global optimization. To address both issues, we propose the Pioneer Student (PiS), an auxiliary branch that operates in an independent parameter space and periodically transfers accumulated knowledge back to the T-S model. Extensive experiments show that PiS is a universal plug-and-play module that consistently improves mainstream SSL methods.

</details>


### [378] [Sequential Pretraining Favors Large Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09611)
*Mohnish Harwani,Yujia Zheng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文定义并量化了"首因偏差"（primacy bias）——早期数据分布对后续学习的损害，揭示小模型会将学习容量低效分配给早期分布，而大模型对此更鲁棒；并提出"暴露疗法"（Exposure Therapy, ET）正则化方法，提升顺序预训练中模型对后期数据分布及整体能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型神经网络常具备小模型无法习得的能力。作者想厘清这种差异究竟源于大模型学到了更具代表性的特征，还是源于其对训练中未计入的不良效应更鲁棒。为此需要定义并量化此类不良效应之一。

Method: 定义并量化"首因偏差"（primacy bias），即早期数据分布对后续学习的损害程度；通过小模型与充分过参数化模型的对比实验加以分析，尤其在顺序接触异质数据分布的基础模型预训练场景中研究。基于此提出 Exposure Therapy（ET），一种在顺序预训练中促进学习容量更高效分配的简单正则化方法。

Result: 小模型会把学习容量低效地分配给早期数据分布，而充分过参数化的模型对该效应具有鲁棒性。这一低效在预训练中尤为严重，使小型基础模型难以学习训练后期遇到的数据分布，尤其当后期数据强调代码、数学、推理等能力时损害更大。ET 在高达十亿参数规模的模型上，提升了模型对后期数据分布的表现及整体能力。

Conclusion: 大型基础模型的部分优势可能来自对不良训练效应更强的鲁棒性，而非学习到更具代表性的特征；改进的训练算法可在较小模型中恢复部分此类优势。

Abstract: Large neural networks often acquire capabilities that small models fail to learn. Does this stem from large models learning more representative features, or from being more robust to unaccounted-for adverse effects introduced during training? We define and quantify one such adverse effect, primacy bias, as the extent to which exposure to early data distributions impairs later learning. We show that small models can allocate learning capacity inefficiently toward early distributions, whereas sufficiently overparameterized models are robust to this effect. This inefficiency is particularly consequential in pretraining, where foundation models often encounter heterogeneous data distributions sequentially rather than jointly. As a result, small foundation models can struggle to learn distributions encountered late in training, which is particularly harmful when later data emphasizes desirable capabilities such as code, mathematics, and reasoning. Motivated by these findings, we introduce Exposure Therapy (ET), a simple regularization that promotes more efficient allocation of learning capacity during sequential pretraining. We demonstrate that ET improves foundation models' performance on late data distributions as well as overall capability in models up to the billion-parameter scale. Overall, our results suggest that some benefits of large foundation models may arise from greater robustness to adverse training effects, rather than from learning more representative features, and that improved training algorithms can recover some of these advantages in smaller models.

</details>


### [379] [The Identifiability and Observability of Deep Normalized Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09620)
*Pranav Venkata Konda*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究深度、无掩码、单头注意力中输入-输出函数所确定的参数，证明Henry–Marchetti–Kohn猜想在实解析情形（含softmax）成立，并刻画例外纤维与局部可辨识性的精确Taylor阶，给出同步query/key坍缩时完整Jacobian衰减谱。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究注意力模块的哪些参数由其输入-输出函数决定（可辨识性），此前仅有猜想，缺少实解析情形的证明与例外/退化结构的系统分类。

Method: 针对已知正非恒定实解析归一化函数，分析函数对有效分数与组合值映射的确定程度；在显式归一化条件下分类例外纤维；用Taylor展开确定局部辨识阶；计算同步query/key坍缩附近在分离有限输入库上的native Jacobian衰减谱。

Result: 函数一般地决定有效分数与组合值映射，至多相差偶归一化诱导的符号；证明Henry–Marchetti–Kohn猜想的实解析情形（含softmax）；识别坍缩导致后续分数不可观测的情形；得到第i层接触阶为2k3^{i-1}-1及精确重数与核维数；高精度与自动微分实验展示数值敏感性损失。

Conclusion: 给出了注意力参数可辨识性的实解析一般性结论、退化例外分类与精确局部辨识阶，并说明坍缩导致数值可辨识性显著下降。

Abstract: We study which parameters of deep, unmasked, single-head attention are determined by its input--output function. For known positive nonconstant real-analytic normalizers, the function generically determines the effective scores and combined value map up to the signs induced by even normalizers. This proves the real-analytic case of a conjecture of Henry--Marchetti--Kohn, including softmax. We then classify exceptional fibers under explicit normalizer conditions, identifying when collapse makes later scores unobservable, and establish sharp Taylor orders for local identification. Near simultaneous query/key collapse, we compute the complete native Jacobian decay spectrum on separating finite input banks. For common first nonconstant normalizer degree $k$, layer $i$ has contact order $2k3^{i-1}-1$, with exact multiplicities and kernel dimension. High-precision and automatic differentiation calculations illustrate the resulting loss of numerical sensitivity.

</details>


### [380] [When does a network's training history predict its future learning better than its current state? Evidence from a response probe and a forecasting screen](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09621)
*Martin Hofmann,Patrick Mäder*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究检验“网络训练历史”是否比“当前状态”更能预测未来学习能力。主研究（42种历史、4个检查点、探针验证充分）发现历史状态未优于当前状态的校准模型（增益-21.4%，未达预设10%）；在1,560次合成回归的伴随筛选中，历史模型仅在当前验证误差尚不具信息量的早期（前12/240轮）预测更好，48轮后无差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 关于可塑性丧失与关键期的研究表明训练路径会影响后续能力，但未回答路径是否携带当前状态测量所缺失的信息。作者由此提出问题：何时网络训练历史对未来学习的预测优于其当前状态。

Method: 主研究训练小型多层感知机，覆盖三类历史机制共42种历史，在4个检查点用“短探针”（在新任务上继续训练100次更新的网络副本）测量未来学习；读取预测结果前先对探针做验证：对隐单元的函数保持缩放呈单调响应、重复测量一致性高（最不可靠类组内相关0.940，[0.903, 0.997]，三次重复均值）、单元重初始化在紧接其后可见但在100–200次更新后不可见。采用维度至多4的历史状态与当前状态的校准模型比较。伴随筛选在1,560次合成回归上以更远目标（运行最终误差）重复同一问题。

Result: 主研究中，历史状态未优于校准的当前状态模型：增益-21.4%，90%区间[-91.9, 8.1]，未达事先设定的10%门槛。伴随筛选中，历史模型仅在最多240轮中的前12轮优于当前验证误差（紧凑状态30.3%，[15.8, 39.4]），48轮后与后者不可区分。

Conclusion: 两项研究中，历史仅在当前状态对目标尚不具信息量时才有信息价值（此解读为事后形成）。即训练路径的额外信息主要体现在当前状态尚未能预测目标的早期阶段，一旦状态变得有信息量，历史不再提供增量。

Abstract: Networks that behave alike now can still learn differently when training continues. Work on loss of plasticity and critical periods shows that the path to a state shapes what follows; it does not show whether the path carries information that a measurement of the state itself misses. We ask when the training history of a network predicts its future learning better than its current state. In a main study, small multilayer perceptrons were trained under three history regimes (42 histories), and future learning was measured at four checkpoints by a short probe: a copy of the network trained for 100 updates on a new task. Before the prediction result was read, the protocol checked the probe. It responded monotonically to a function-preserving rescaling of hidden units, repeated measurements agreed (intraclass correlation 0.940, [0.903, 0.997], in the least reliable class, mean of three repeats), and a re-initialisation of units was visible directly after it but not 100 to 200 updates later. A history state of at most four dimensions did not improve on a calibrated model of the current state (gain -21.4%, 90% interval [-91.9, 8.1]; required in advance: 10%). A companion screen on 1,560 synthetic regression runs asked the same question for a target further away, the final error of the run. There, history models forecast better than the current validation error after 12 of up to 240 epochs (compact state 30.3%, [15.8, 39.4], a contextual comparison) and were not distinguishable from it after 48. In both studies the history was informative only while the current state was not yet informative about the target; this reading was formed after the results.

</details>


### [381] [Closed-Form Noise Calibration Against Membership Inference for Random-Allocation DP-SGD](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09651)
*Murat Bilgehan Ertan,Marten van Dijk*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了采用随机分配（random allocation）的DP-SGD机制，给出了一个简洁的闭式公式来界定成员推断攻击（MIA）精度，并推导了精确攻击精度表达式用于噪声校准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DP-SGD通过向裁剪梯度添加高斯噪声来保护训练数据，噪声量通常依赖隐私会计器在搜索中数值求解，过程缓慢且噪声偏大。作者希望为随机分配设置下的DP-SGD提供一个可解释、高效且更紧的隐私边界，以降低所需噪声并加速校准。

Method: 针对随机分配（每个epoch每条记录仅在随机选定的步骤被使用一次）的DP-SGD，作者利用高斯分布与支配随机分配的高斯混合分布之间的卡方散度，推导出一行闭式公式来界定任意MIA的攻击精度。同时推导了这两种分布的精确攻击精度表达式并数值评估，用于与公式对比校准噪声。

Result: 公式为：当M为每epoch步数、E为epoch数、σ为噪声乘子、成员与非成员先验等可能时，攻击精度不超过 1/2 + 1/4·√((1+(e^{1/σ²}-1)/M)^E − 1)。该公式计算σ约需一微秒，在适用情形下所需噪声约为最先进闭式界的一半。精确表达式校准比公式少需13.0%~20.2%的噪声，且因精确，任何仅知M、E、σ的会计器都无法证明更小的σ。训练中所得σ优于公式并与已发表会计器测试精度相当，求值仅需秒级、认证分钟级，而该会计器每次搜索更慢或返回至少多0.62%的噪声。实验显示MIA精度均低于该界。

Conclusion: 该工作为随机分配DP-SGD提供了可解释、高效且更紧的MIA精度上界，精确表达式可作为最优噪声校准的基准，在训练中兼顾精度与效率，实证验证攻击精度始终低于所给界。

Abstract: DP-SGD protects training data by adding Gaussian noise to clipped gradients. The amount of noise is usually chosen by running a numerical privacy accountant inside a search. We study DP-SGD with random allocation, where each epoch uses every record once, at a randomly chosen step. For this setting we give a one-line formula that bounds the accuracy of every membership inference attack (MIA) on the trained model. With $M$ steps per epoch, $E$ epochs and noise multiplier $σ$, and with membership and non-membership equally likely a priori, the attack accuracy is at most $\frac12+\frac14\sqrt{(1+(e^{1/σ^2}-1)/M)^E-1}$. The formula comes from the chi-square divergence between a Gaussian distribution and a Gaussian mixture that dominates random allocation. It is interpretable and gives $σ$ in about a microsecond. Where applicable, our formula needs at most about half the noise of the state-of-the-art closed-form bound. To measure how close the bound is, we also derive an exact expression for the attack accuracy of these two distributions and evaluate it numerically. Calibrating to this exact expression requires $13.0\%$ to $20.2\%$ less noise than the formula in our main experiments, and since it is exact, no accountant that knows only $M$, $E$ and $σ$ can certify a smaller $σ$. In training, the resulting $σ$ outperforms the formula and matches a published accountant in test accuracy. It is found in seconds and certified in minutes, whereas every search we ran with that accountant took longer or returned at least $0.62\%$ more noise. We show that MIAs on the trained models stay below the bound.

</details>


### [382] [DSTNet: Dynamic Spectral Trajectory Network for Causal Multi-Horizon Financial Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09654)
*Aashish Bohra,Lokendra Vishwakarm*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出DSTNet，将小波滤波组幅值的近期演化作为因果动态谱轨迹，结合尺度-时间谱Transformer与CNN-BiLSTM，多步期预测股票指数与黄金。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有小波金融预测方法仅用小波去噪，或将变换压缩为预测原点处的单一谱快照；且产生系数的卷积多为双边卷积，会读到预测原点之后的未来信息，存在信息泄漏（look-ahead bias），且未充分利用谱随时间演化的动态信息。

Method: DSTNet保留滤波器组幅值的近期演化，构建因果的"动态谱轨迹"：基于七类滞后技术指标、二十日回看窗口、单边Morlet派生滤波器组，并对左边界瞬态做显式burn-in。采用因子化的尺度-时间谱Transformer分别沿时间轴与滤波组轴做注意力；用学习门融合谱分支与CNN-BiLSTM；由各预测期专属门在一次前向中输出1、3、5、10天预测。

Result: 在七个股指与黄金上，采用统一扩展窗口协议与未触碰的一年留出集，对比九种学习式基线和随机游走持续性基准。在MAE与MAPE下，持续性在32个"序列-期"单元中的29个里为十个固定竞争者中最强；DSTNet是唯一在每个单元都优于持续性的模型，1天领先0.7%–0.9%，10天领先3.4%–4.5%。1天期配对检验中DSTNet优于较弱学习基线，但与持续性和最强学习预测器比较无定论。下游配置诊断在七个指数上均不支持择时收益。

Conclusion: DSTNet在点预测精度上稳定优于持续性基准，是唯一在所有单元占优的模型，但优势幅度随预测期增长而增大、在短期并不显著；且精度提升未转化为股指择时收益。表明因果动态谱建模对预测误差有改进，但经济价值尚不成立。

Abstract: Wavelet-based financial forecasters typically use the transform only to denoise, or reduce it to a single spectral snapshot at the forecast origin, and the convolution that produces the coefficients is usually bilateral, so it can read past the forecast origin. DSTNet instead retains the recent evolution of filter-bank magnitudes as a causal Dynamic Spectral Trajectory, built from seven trailing technical indicators over a twenty-day lookback with a one-sided Morlet-derived filter bank and an explicit burn-in for the left-boundary transient. A factorized Scale-Temporal Spectral Transformer attends along the time and filter-bank axes separately, a learned gate fuses the spectral branch with a CNN-BiLSTM, and horizon-specific gates emit one, three, five, and ten day forecasts in a single pass. We evaluate seven equity indices and gold under a common expanding-window protocol and an untouched one-year hold-out, against nine learned baselines and a random-walk persistence benchmark. Under MAE and MAPE, persistence is the strongest of the ten fixed competitors in 29 of the 32 series-horizon cells and DSTNet is the only model below it in every cell, by 0.7 to 0.9 percent at one day and 3.4 to 4.5 percent at ten days. At one day, paired testing favours DSTNet against the weaker learned baselines but is inconclusive against persistence and the strongest learned forecasters. A downstream allocation diagnostic does not support an equity-timing advantage on any of the seven indices.

</details>


### [383] [Pretraining Shapes Spectral Structure: Architecture- and Strategy-Conditional Prediction of OOD Robustness in Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09709)
*Sangyoon Bae,Sk Miraj Ahmed,Shinjae Yoo,Jiook Cha*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 预训练权重的谱结构编码了模型的OOD泛化能力，按（架构×预训练策略）分cell后，单一谱统计量可在无目标数据时预测OOD鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有OOD诊断需要源域或目标域数据，无法在目标域存在之前使用；仅用权重的诊断对所有架构套用同一统计量，无法区分鲁棒与脆弱模型，因此需要一种仅依赖预训练权重、且能跨架构区分的OOD预测方法。

Method: 理论证明OOD精度差受源表征集中度上界约束，并用仅从预训练权重计算的谱统计量作为该集中度的代理；发现该代理方向在架构族间会反转，因此在“cell”（架构×预训练策略的最细分组）内使用对应方向的统计量排序。

Result: 在116个模型、7种模态上，全局单一统计量排序OOD鲁棒性较弱（不同方向的cell相互抵消）；cell内选定的统计量在样本内对92%的模型对正确排序OOD鲁棒性；在EEG、基因组和蛋白等未见模型族上，事先记录的cell、指标与符号方向均成立；按谱集中度行动可将OOD差距缩小24%，同时保持87.5%的ID性能。

Conclusion: OOD鲁棒性可在仅有发布权重、尚无目标数据或算力投入时于模型选择阶段进行检查，使OOD诊断成为数据不可得前的可行筛选手段。

Abstract: Can we determine whether a foundation model will generalize out-of-distribution (OOD) before any target data is available? Existing diagnostics require source or target data, which rules them out before a target domain exists. Those that use the weights alone apply one statistic to every architecture, and do not separate robust models from fragile ones. We show the answer is encoded in the spectral structure of pretrained weights. Two forces shape that structure. Architecture determines how information is stored in weight matrices. Pretraining strategy determines what is rewarded. Together they set a spectral geometry that governs OOD robustness. We prove that the OOD accuracy gap is bounded by how tightly the source representations concentrate. A statistic computed from the pretrained weights alone serves as a proxy for that concentration. The direction of that proxy reverses between architecture families. We operationalize it: the direction is stable within one (architecture X strategy) combination, the finest grouping we test, which we call a cell. Pooled over 116 models spanning 7 modalities, a single statistic ranks OOD robustness weakly, because cells of opposite direction cancel. Within a cell, the statistic selected for it orders 92% of model pairs by OOD robustness in-sample. The selection does not leak the target: for each model family outside the matrix we logged the cell, metric and sign before running its OOD evaluation, and the predicted direction held in every case: EEG, genomic and protein. Acting on spectral concentration narrows the OOD gap by 24% at 87.5% ID retention. The diagnostic operates on released weights alone, so OOD robustness becomes checkable at model-selection time, before data or compute is committed to a target domain.

</details>


### [384] [EC-EarthFlow: Probabilistic emulation of daily transient global climate model simulations with flow matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09715)
*Kirien Whan,Nikolaj T. Mücke,Karin van der Wiel*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出EC-EarthFlow生成式流匹配模型，模拟EC-Earth3气候模型，自回归预测日温度场，低成本复现气候特征。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 物理气候模型计算成本高昂，需要一种低成本的模拟替代方案。

Method: 基于流匹配的生成模型EC-EarthFlow，用EC-Earth3瞬态模拟数据（1950-2166，SSP2-4.5）训练，以前几日温度场及年平均温度预测次日温度场，并采用自回归方式展开一个月至季节尺度。

Result: 仅用温度变量即可复现EC-Earth3的日变化、空间格局、年循环和长期趋势，计算成本显著降低；长期推理稳定，并能学习EC-Earth3中的物理关系。

Conclusion: EC-EarthFlow可作为EC-Earth3的高效代理模型，兼具稳定性与物理一致性。

Abstract: We introduce EC-EarthFlow, a generative flow matching model that emulates simulations from the physical climate model EC-Earth3. The model is trained on transient simulations from EC-Earth3 (1950-2166, SSP2-4.5) to predict the day ahead temperature field from the previous days temperature as well as annual mean temperature. Predictions are made auto-regressively with rollout periods of between a month and an extended season. Using only this variable of interest, we are able to reproduce the daily variability, spatial patterns, annual cycle and long-term trend from EC-Earth3 at a substantially lower computational cost than the physical model. We demonstrate that EC-EarthFlow is stable for long inference periods, and that it can learn the physical relationships as simulated in EC-Earth3.

</details>


### [385] [SoftSEEPS improves ML-based precipitation forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09752)
*Jost Arndt,Utku Isil,Noelia Otero,Rodrigo Almeida,Wojciech Samek,Jackie Ma*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出可微的SoftSEEPS评分，用于直接训练降水预报的机器学习模型；在IMERG数据上通过预训练低分辨率预报模型潜空间训练降水解码器，SoftSEEPS与RMSE联合目标可兼顾两者。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统SEEPS评分不可微，无法直接作为机器学习模型的损失函数用于训练降水预报模型，因此需要构造其可微近似以实现端到端训练。

Method: 开发SEEPS评分的可微近似SoftSEEPS；在IMERG数据集（0.1度分辨率）上，基于预训练低分辨率预报模型的潜空间训练降水解码器，并将SoftSEEPS与RMSE组合成联合目标函数。

Result: 在IMERG数据上验证了SoftSEEPS的可行性；使用SoftSEEPS与RMSE联合目标训练时，两项指标仅有轻微折衷。

Conclusion: SoftSEEPS可实现降水预报模型的直接训练，且与RMSE联合优化具备可行性，折衷代价有限。

Abstract: In this paper we have developed a differentiable approximation of the well-known SEEPS score, which we name SoftSEEPS. This allows the training of a Machine Learning model to forecast precipitation directly. We test SoftSEEPS on the IMERG dataset (0.1 degree resolution) by training a decoder for precipitation on the latent space of a pre-trained low-resolution forecasting model. Combining SoftSEEPS and RMSE in a joint objective is possible with marginal trade-offs in either metric.

</details>


### [386] [A Proof-of-Concept Study of Weakly Supervised Labeling of Fine-Grained EEG Components for Artifact Attenuation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09792)
*Lu Wang-Nöth,Hai Huang,Philipp Heiler,Shuqiong Wu,Liyun Zhang,Helmut Mayer*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一个结合频率感知高维表征与多示例学习(MIL)的框架，用于脑电(EEG)中肌电(EMG)伪迹的细粒度检测与抑制，无需组件级真值标注。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: EEG极易受EMG伪迹干扰，其时间异质性及与神经活动的空间-频谱重叠，导致盲源分离后仍存在混合源。同时，现有去伪迹方法受限于缺乏可靠的组件级真值：专家标注昂贵且主观，且尚无方法能为多通道头皮EEG的EMG污染提供逼真的仿真真值。

Method: 提出将频率感知高维表征与多示例学习相结合的框架：将分离出的成分展开为频率分辨的"成分内"(intra-component)单元，构建更可分的空间；采用弱监督学习，从epoch级标签学习各intra-component的伪迹似然分数，无需细粒度真值；据此构建intra-component分类器，实现细粒度EMG检测与分数引导的衰减。

Result: 在留出受试者上的实验表明，该框架能学到有信息量的intra-component分数，并降低伪迹相关的频谱偏差；效果在紧咬牙(jaw tension)上最明显，抬眉(raising eyebrows)效果中等，皱眉(frowning)效果有限。

Conclusion: 该框架通过弱监督的intra-component建模，实现了无需组件级真值的细粒度EMG伪迹检测与抑制，但去伪迹效果因伪迹类型而异，对频谱重叠更强的类型效果受限。

Abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) is highly susceptible to electromyographic (EMG) artifacts, whose temporal heterogeneity and spatial-spectral overlap with neural activity can leave mixed sources after blind source separation. Existing artifact-removal methods are further limited by scarce reliable component-level ground truth: expert annotations are costly and subjective, while no established method provides realistic simulation-based ground truth for EMG contamination in multichannel scalp EEG. To address these limitations, we propose a framework combining a frequency-aware high-dimensional representation with Multi-Instance Learning. The representation unfolds separated components into frequency-resolved intra-components, creating a space in which mixed neural and muscular activity becomes more separable, while the weakly supervised learning formulation enables artifact-likelihood scores for individual intra-components to be learned from epoch-level labels without finer-grained ground truth. The resulting intra-component classifier supports fine-grained EMG artifact detection and score-guided attenuation. Experiments on held-out subjects show that the framework learns informative intra-component scores and reduces artifact-related spectral deviations most clearly for jaw tension, with moderate effects for raising eyebrows and limited effects for frowning.

</details>


### [387] [BoT-GRPO: Efficient Process-Reward RL for Reasoning via Bag-of-Token Aggregation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09804)
*Yingxiang Yang,Weihang Xiao,Zhunxuan Wang,Joshua Flashner,Niresh Agarwal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 BoT-GRPO，将 GRPO 扩展到 token 级奖励模型，通过长度不变的"词袋"聚合实现无 critic 的过程监督，加速收敛并提升最终质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GRPO 在 rollout 中每个 token 共享同一优势值，缺乏细粒度过程监督；而引入 value network 成本高昂。作者希望在不增加值网络代价的前提下，实现高效的 token 级过程监督，加速收敛并改善最终质量。

Method: 提出 Bag-of-Tokens GRPO（BoT-GRPO）：收集所有 rollout 的 token 级奖励，按所属序列长度的倒数加权，并基于加权组统计量计算每 token 优势。该方法为长度不变的"词袋"聚合，无 critic，可作为 GRPO 的即插即用替代（当有 token 级奖励时）。

Result: React 前端代码生成：编译率达 80%，比 GRPO 快至 1.9 倍，收敛快于 GSPO、DAPO、PURE，且最终编译率与 VLM 评判胜率更高。AIME 数学推理：Pass@k 绝对提升最高 8.1%，步数仅为 GRPO 一半。两任务均在推理与非推理基座（Qwen2.5-3B、SmolLM3-3B、Phi-4-mini-reasoning）上对比。附加发现：奖励稳定性比丰富性更重要，干净、有界、稳定的细粒度信号能持续加速学习，噪声化替代方案则停滞。

Conclusion: BoT-GRPO 以无 critic 的 token 级过程监督有效扩展 GRPO，在代码生成与数学推理任务上实现更快收敛与更优结果，并给出奖励模型设计的实用准则：稳定性优先于丰富性。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning is now central to eliciting reasoning in large language models, while in the popular algorithm Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) every token in a rollout receives the same advantage. We ask how to make process supervision efficient: accelerating convergence and improving final quality without the cost of value networks. We propose Bag-of-Tokens Group Relative Policy Optimization (BoT-GRPO), which extends GRPO to token-level reward models through a length-invariant "bag of tokens" aggregation: it collects all token-level rewards across rollouts, weights each by the inverse of its source sequence length, and computes per-token advantages relative to weighted group statistics. BoT-GRPO is critic-free, and is a drop-in replacement wherever GRPO is used when token-level reward is available. On React front-end code generation, BoT-GRPO reaches $80\%$ compile rate up to $1.9\times$ faster than GRPO and converges faster than modern GRPO variants (GSPO, DAPO, PURE) while reaching higher final compile and VLM-judged win rates. On a second task, AIME mathematical reasoning, BoT-GRPO delivers absolute Pass@$k$ gains up to $8.1\%$ over GRPO in half the steps. For both tasks we compare the algorithm's performance on reasoning vs. non-reasoning base-model families (Qwen2.5-3B, SmolLM3-3B, Phi-4-mini-reasoning). Our experiments also yield a practical recipe for the reward model itself: reward stability matters more than richness: clean, bounded, stable fine-grained signals consistently accelerate learning where noisier alternatives stall.

</details>


### [388] [Homogenization in Multi-Agent Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09824)
*Prakhar Ganesh,Kyra Wilson,Luca Zappella,Barry-John Theobald,Nicholas Apostoloff,Lucas Monteiro Paes,Nivedha Sivakumar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文揭示多智能体系统(MAS)中的"同质化"失效模式：智能体在交互中趋同，降低多样性并强化共同失败；作者用三项指标量化同质化，并在代码生成、招聘、同行评审任务中验证其下游风险，且发现简单增加多样性的方法无效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MAS依靠智能体间交互完成复杂任务，虽已取得成功，但交互本身可能带来负面效应——智能体行为趋同（同质化），从而削弱智能体多样性、放大共享的失败。现有MAS评估多关注聚合性能，忽视了交互动态带来的这一潜在失效模式，因此需要将同质化操作化并系统评估其风险。

Method: 作者将同质化操作化为三个度量指标：(1)对多数意见的从众性(conformity to the majority)；(2)向极端意见的极化(polarization towards extremes)；(3)随交互次数增加而对变化愈发抗拒的惯性(growing inertia)。在代码生成、招聘、科学同行评审三类任务中对MAS的同质化进行评测，并检验通过采样随机性和混合模型MAS来增加多样性的简单方法是否有效。

Result: 同质化在三类任务中均转化为具体的下游风险：代码生成中，同质化会隐藏并放大相关错误，形成系统性漏洞；招聘中，有偏智能体的影响在其被移除后仍长期持续；同行评审中，导致不同研究领域间评价标准不均衡。此外，利用采样随机性和混合模型MAS等简单增加多样性的方法，均无法降低同质化风险。

Conclusion: 同质化是MAS的一种失效模式。MAS评估不能仅停留在聚合性能层面，而必须细致分析智能体间的交互动态。同时，简单增加多样性的策略不足以缓解同质化风险，亟需能有效利用智能体多样性的新策略。

Abstract: Multi-agent systems (MAS) leverage interactions between agents to perform complex tasks. Despite their success, we show that these interactions can also lead to homogenization, i.e., agents converging to similar behaviors. Homogenization in MAS can reduce agent diversity and reinforce shared failures. In this paper, we operationalize homogenization using three metrics: conformity to the majority, polarization towards extremes, and growing inertia against changes over subsequent interactions. We evaluate homogenization in MAS for code generation, hiring, and scientific peer review. Across these tasks, we show that homogenization translates to concrete downstream risks: in code generation, it hides and amplifies correlated errors which can create systemic vulnerabilities; in hiring, it allows the influence of biased agents to persist long after their removal; and in peer review, it creates uneven evaluation standards across research areas. Our results establish homogenization as a failure mode of MAS, demonstrating that MAS evaluations must move beyond aggregate performance to carefully analyze interaction dynamics. Finally, we show that simple approaches to increase diversity---leveraging sampling stochasticity and mixed-models MAS---fail to reduce homogenization risks, highlighting the need for strategies to effectively leverage agent diversity.

</details>


### [389] [Dual-QK: Sharp Queries and Flat Keys for Prunable 2-bit KV Caches](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09827)
*Sunjoo Whang,Jungjun Oh,Minsung Kim,Dongho Seo,Jisu Shin,Gregory Kielian,Hoi-Jun Yoo,Sangjin Kim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Dual-QK 通过成对非正交的 query/key 变换与校准统计，兼顾 key 的低比特量化与 query 通道剪枝，实现长上下文下 KV 缓存高压缩与高吞吐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长输入与长生成使 KV cache 的存储和访问开销显著增加。低比特量化可降低存储与内存流量，query 通道剪枝可减少 key cache 读取。但基于旋转的量化要求对 query 施加同一正交变换以保持 query-key 点积不变，这会分散 query 能量，削弱"少数大分量保留、大量小分量剪枝"的可分离性，形成量化与剪枝之间的冲突。

Method: 提出 Dual-QK，采用成对的非正交 query 与 key 变换解决上述冲突：利用校准的 query/key 统计量，将部分 key 白化与 query 对齐基结合，一方面平衡 key 尺度以适配 INT2 量化，另一方面集中 query 能量以支持动态通道剪枝。此外引入 channel-0 保护与 bucket-relative RoPE，以在长上下文中维持低比特精度。

Result: 在 4 个模型、5 类生成基准及长上下文检索任务上，40% query 通道稀疏度下多数任务精度优于 OSCAR。128K 上下文时，相对未剪枝 BF16 实现 6.8× KV cache 压缩和约 8.3× KV 读取量降低；所评估配置下，SGLang 实现解码吞吐最高达未剪枝 BF16 的 3.75×。

Conclusion: Dual-QK 表明，解除变换正交性约束、让 query 与 key 变换协同设计，可在低比特量化与通道剪枝间取得更优折衷，为长上下文推理的效率与精度提供有效方案。

Abstract: Long inputs and extended generation increase the storage and access costs of the key-value (KV) cache. Low-bit quantization reduces storage and memory traffic, while query-channel pruning can further reduce key-cache reads. Rotation-based quantization redistributes the energy of key outliers across channels. To maintain computational invariance, the same orthogonal transform must be applied to queries, preserving query-key dot products. However, this rotation can disperse query energy, weakening the separation between a few large components to retain and many small ones to prune. We introduce Dual-QK, which uses paired non-orthogonal query and key transforms to address this conflict. Using calibrated query and key statistics, Dual-QK combines partial key whitening with a query-aligned basis to balance key scales for INT2 quantization and concentrate query energy for dynamic channel pruning. Channel-0 protection and bucket-relative RoPE support low-bit accuracy over long contexts. Experiments on four models across five generative benchmarks and long-context retrieval tasks show improved accuracy over OSCAR on most tasks at 40% query-channel sparsity. At a 128K context, Dual-QK provides $6.8\times$ KV-cache compression and an estimated $8.3\times$ reduction in KV read volume relative to unpruned BF16. Under the evaluated configurations, our SGLang implementation achieves up to $3.75\times$ the decoding throughput of unpruned BF16.

</details>


### [390] [MUNITE: Unified Multimodal Latent Inference for Any-to-Any Multimodal Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09866)
*Kyeongmin Yeo,Minhyuk Sung*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: MUNITE 提出一个隐变量框架，将多模态生成中的编码与隐变量生成统一为同一推断问题，用条件流模型和自蒸馏实现任意到任意的多模态生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态生成通常将编码（从观测到隐变量）与生成（从隐变量到观测）分开处理，难以灵活应对任意子集模态作为输入或输出的场景。作者希望用统一的隐变量推断视角，在观测证据多少不同的情况下统一建模。

Method: MUNITE 将完整观测对应的隐变量条件分布作为建模目标：全观测即确定性编码，无观测即隐变量边缘分布，中间子集即条件隐变量推断，全部纳入同一个条件流模型。共享隐变量样本捕获跨生成目标需保持一致的变化，模态特定生成解码器独立建模剩余不确定性。为从不完整训练样本中学习这些条件分布，作者通过自蒸馏扩展条件流匹配：以更多观测为条件的预测，在同一中间隐变量状态下监督以更少子集为条件的同一模型；当更丰富证据的轨迹遵循精确条件流时，可获得与全目标去噪相同的期望学习信号。

Result: 在 PolyMNIST-D-Q、FFHQ64 以及图像-文本-音频任务上，MUNITE 取得有竞争力或更好的生成质量和源-目标对齐，并具有更高的联合生成一致性。在一对多及无条件图像-文本-音频对比中，其一致性均为最高，验证了统一隐变量推断在多样多模态设置下的有效性。

Conclusion: MUNITE 通过将编码与隐变量生成统一为不同观测证据下的同一推断问题，并借助自蒸馏条件流匹配从不完整数据中学习，为灵活、任意到任意且跨目标一致的多模态生成提供了有效方案。

Abstract: We introduce MUNITE, a latent-variable framework for flexible any-to-any multimodal generation that treats encoding and latent generation as the same inference problem under different amounts of observed evidence. Given any subset of modalities, MUNITE models the conditional distribution over the latent representation associated with the complete observation. Full observation recovers deterministic encoding, no observation recovers the latent marginal, and intermediate subsets define conditional latent inference, all within a single conditional flow model. A shared latent sample captures variation that must remain consistent across generated targets, while modality-specific generative decoders model the remaining uncertainty independently. To learn these conditional distributions from incomplete training examples, we extend conditional flow matching through self-distillation: predictions conditioned on richer available observations supervise the same model conditioned on smaller subsets at the same intermediate latent state. When the richer-evidence trajectory follows the exact conditional flow, this provides the same expected learning signal as full-target denoising. Across PolyMNIST-D-Q, FFHQ64, and image-text-audio, MUNITE achieves competitive or better generation quality and source-target alignment, with higher joint-generation coherence. In particular, it attains the highest coherence in all one-to-many and unconditional image-text-audio comparisons, showing the effectiveness of unified latent inference across diverse multimodal settings.

</details>
