### [391] [Layerwise Error Attribution for Fast and Robust Mixed-Precision Post-Training Quantization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09877)
*Samy Houache,Yann Traonmilin,Jean-François Aujol*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种基于层级概率误差分析的混合精度训练后量化比特分配方法，无需外部求解器，在干净校准下匹配或超越SOTA，在校准数据受损时鲁棒性更强。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 混合精度训练后量化需在全局内存预算下逐层分配比特，核心难点是分配问题的组合爆炸性以及校准集小且可能被污染所导致的敏感性。因此需要一种计算快、且在校准数据受损时仍能保持模型质量的分配方法。

Method: 对量化误差进行层级概率分析，将传播误差与给定层引入的局部扰动分离；利用该局部项构建可分离评分，进而设计一个无需外部求解器的简单分配算法。其概率性质带来对污染数据的鲁棒性。

Result: 在DRUNet去噪任务上，平均每权重4比特预算下，干净校准时匹配或优于SOTA混合精度基线；受损校准下更鲁棒，PSNR最高提升7.5 dB；比特分配相对基线加速28倍至2570倍。在量化扩散模型上直接应用该框架也提升了SOTA。

Conclusion: 层级概率误差分析可导出可分离的比特分配评分，实现高效、免求解器且对校准数据污染鲁棒的混合精度训练后量化，并在去噪与扩散模型上验证了有效性与加速效果。

Abstract: Mixed-precision post-training quantization is a network compression method that assigns bits layer by layer, under a global memory budget using a small calibration set. The main difficulties are to overcome the combinatorial nature of the allocation problem and to manage the sensitivity to small, potentially corrupted databases. Hence, an efficient allocation method should be fast to compute and preserve model quality when calibration data are corrupted. To design such a method, we derive a layerwise probabilistic analysis of the quantization error that separates propagated error from the local perturbation introduced at a given layer. We use this local term to build a separable score for a simple allocation algorithm, that requires no external solver. The probabilistic nature of our approach brings robustness to corrupted data. On denoising tasks with DRUNet, with an average budget of 4 bits per weight, our method matches or improves state-of-the-art mixed-precision baselines under clean calibration, and is more robust to corrupted calibration, with PSNR gains of up to 7.5 dB under the tested corruptions. Experiments show bit-allocation speed-ups from 28x to 2,570x over the studied baselines. For quantized diffusion models, our experiments show that a direct application of our framework also improves the state-of-the-art.

</details>


### [392] [NeuralZip: Reusable Setup for Fast Lossless Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09916)
*Martín Bravo,Samuel Horváth,Gonzalo Navarro,Andrés Abeliuk*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: NeuralZip通过一次性统计指数分布并复用Huffman码与打包指数表示，实现无损压缩的加速与跨架构迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 无损压缩可减少模型权重的存储与传输而不改变浮点值，但重复的统计分析和码本构建带来计算开销，因此需要研究统计结构能否一次性准备并复用。

Method: 将指数分布相似的chunk分组，共享Huffman码，并对重复出现的指数元组选择性地用打包指数表示；在后续编码前通过setup选定这些表示，每次编码仍处理当前张量值。

Result: 在浮点模型checkpoint上，setup后的压缩比基线快1.81–21.33倍且实现逐比特精确重建；setup可预计算并从其他兼容架构迁移，保持相近压缩率并免去摊销成本；训练checkpoint中权重演化时可继续复用；GPU实验最多降低27.5%活跃显存并精确复现logits。

Conclusion: 压缩适应过程具有可迁移性与可复用性，setup成本可被转移和复用，从而在无损前提下同时获得加速、显存节省与精确性。

Abstract: Lossless compression can reduce the storage and movement of model weights without changing their floating-point values, but repeated statistical analysis and code construction add computational overhead. We study whether the statistical structure of exponents can be prepared once and reused. For this, we introduce NeuralZip, which groups chunks with similar exponent distributions, shares Huffman codes, and selectively represents recurring exponent tuples using packed exponents, thereby achieving additional moderate compression ratios. A setup chooses these representations before subsequent encodings, while every encoding still processes the current tensor values. In floating-point model checkpoints, post-setup compression is 1.81-21.33$\times$ faster than the baselines and achieves exact bit-to-bit reconstruction. We show that this setup can be precomputed and transferred from another compatible architecture, preserving similar compression ratios and avoiding the need to amortize setup costs. Therefore, compression adaptation is transferable and reusable. Training checkpoints demonstrate continued reuse as the weights evolve. Finally, GPU experiments reduce active memory usage by up to 27.5$\%$ while reproducing the logits exactly.

</details>


### [393] [Learning Traffic Flow Dynamics with Stochastic Physics-Informed Neural Cellular Automata](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09946)
*Federica Bragone,Matthieu Barreau*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出物理信息神经元胞自动机（PI-NCA）用于数据驱动交通流建模，保证车辆数守恒与物理一致性，并扩展至随机动力学。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 交通流建模对理解与预测路网车辆集体动力学至关重要。元胞自动机以局部交互规则刻画动力学，简单可解释且能再现复杂宏观现象。但从数据中学习局部转移规则并同时保持具物理意义的约束仍具挑战性，对随机模型尤为困难。

Method: 在标准神经元胞自动机（NCA）基础上，设计与道路拓扑物理一致的神经架构，保证车辆总数守恒，从而将学习到的转移规则约束为物理可行动力学；并通过参数化概率转移规则将该框架扩展至随机动力学，同时保持相同的物理信息约束。

Result: 在由Nagel-Schreckenberg与Kerner-Klenov-Wolf元胞自动机生成的多种交通场景上评估。PI-NCA成功学习两种交通模型的动力学，且持续优于标准NCA；随机扩展能捕捉概率转移规则而不损害所施加的物理约束。

Conclusion: PI-NCA为数据驱动的交通流建模提供了一种兼具物理一致性与守恒性质的框架，适用于确定性及随机动力学，优于标准NCA。

Abstract: Traffic flow modeling is essential for understanding and predicting the collective dynamics of vehicles on road networks. Cellular automata provide a simple, interpretable yet powerful framework for representing these dynamics via local interaction rules, while retaining the ability to reproduce complex macroscopic traffic phenomena. However, learning local transition rules from data while preserving physically meaningful constraints remains challenging, particularly for stochastic models. In this work, we propose a physics-informed neural cellular automaton (PI-NCA) for data-driven traffic flow modeling. Building on the standard neural cellular automaton (NCA), we design a neural architecture that is physically consistent with the road topology and guarantees conservation of the total number of vehicles, thereby constraining the learned transition rules to physically admissible dynamics. We further extend this framework to stochastic dynamics by parameterizing probabilistic transition rules while preserving the same physics-informed constraints. We evaluate the proposed models on multiple traffic scenarios generated by the well-established Nagel-Schreckenberg and Kerner-Klenov-Wolf cellular automata. The results demonstrate that the PI-NCA successfully learns the dynamics of both traffic models and consistently outperforms a standard NCA, while the stochastic extension captures probabilistic transition rules without compromising the imposed physical constraints.

</details>


### [394] [Force without transmission: a depth-induced rank collapse that no loss on the representation reopens](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09958)
*Martin Hofmann,Patrick Mäder*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究Transformer的秩崩塌能否被修复，结论是修复取决于梯度是否仍能到达需要改变的权重（路径问题），而非损失项推力强弱。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 训练可使Transformer发生秩崩塌（所有token表示指向同一方向、学习停止），已有研究用有界纠正力的损失项修复了注意力崩塌。作者由此提问：同类损失项能否修复秩崩塌？

Method: 通过削弱跳连接使小型Transformer崩塌，并对崩塌网络的多个副本进行实验；比较加入损失项、恢复跳连接、以及高学习率突发等干预手段的效果。

Result: 任何添加的损失项都未能修复崩塌，即使较强的推力约为任务梯度的十分之一。原因是梯度路径断裂：任务梯度不再到达决定注意力指向的query与key权重，且附加项的梯度在崩塌形成的模块之前就已衰减。恢复跳连接（不改变任何权重）立即重新打通该路径，秩随即恢复，但仅在远高于崩塌尺度处；高学习率突发后路径保持畅通，秩在无干预下恢复。来自路径的注册预测能对恢复时间排序，但不能迁移到该成因。所有情况下秩恢复后损失仍高于健康网络。

Conclusion: 崩塌网络能否被修复取决于梯度是否仍能到达必须改变的权重，而非损失项推力强弱；恢复跳连接等改变路径的手段比增强损失项更有效。

Abstract: Training can drive a transformer into a rank collapse: all token representations point in one direction, and learning stops. In a related collapse of attention, a loss term with a bounded corrective force repairs the network during the run. We ask whether such a term repairs rank collapse. We collapse small transformers by weakening their skip connection and treat copies of the collapsed network. No added loss term repaired the collapse, although the stronger kind pushed with about a tenth of the task gradient. The reason was the path, not the strength. The task gradient no longer reached the query and key weights, which decide where attention looks, and the added term's gradient faded before the blocks where the collapse forms. Restoring the skip connection, which changes no weight, reopened this path at once. The rank then recovered, but only far above the scale of collapse. After a burst of high learning rate the path stayed open and the rank recovered untreated. Registered predictions from the path ranked recovery times but did not transfer to this cause. In every case the loss stayed above that of a healthy network after the rank recovered. Whether a collapsed network can be repaired depends on whether the gradient still reaches the weights that must change, not on how strongly a loss term pushes.

</details>


### [395] [TR-PTQ: High-Accuracy Integer-Only Transformer Post Training Quantization via Taylor Region Reformulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09969)
*Eliyahu Levy,Adam Teman,Yoni Pugachov*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出TR-PTQ，一种全整数训练后量化框架，通过共享泰勒区域指数/对数原语移除非线性层的浮点回退，精度损失小于1.5%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Transformer非线性层量化困难，现有方法多将精度损失归因于数值精度不足并依赖浮点回退；本文将退化归因于具体结构误差来源，以消除浮点硬件需求。

Method: 诊断误差来源：Normalization层可学习缩放参数与GELU的复合近似为主要误差，SoftMax本身对激进量化鲁棒。据此提出统一整数TR-PTQ，使用共享Taylor Region指数与对数原语，使除法、开方等昂贵运算在log域用标准整数算术完成，并配合无校准、离群值感知的LayerNorm参数优化。

Result: 在视觉与语言基准上绝对精度退化小于1.5%，非线性运算无需浮点硬件单元。

Conclusion: 结构化误差分析与log域整数原语可在不依赖浮点回退的前提下实现高效Transformer量化。

Abstract: Post-training quantization (PTQ) enables efficient deployment, yet transformer architectures remain challenging to quantize due to nonlinear layers. While existing methods attribute accuracy loss to insufficient numerical precision, often necessitating floating-point fallbacks, we demonstrate that degradation is actually driven by specific structural error sources. We find that learned scale parameters in normalization layers and compounded approximations in GELU are the primary error contributors, whereas SoftMax remains inherently robust to aggressive quantization. To address these bottlenecks, we introduce TR-PTQ, a unified integer-only formulation using shared Taylor Region (TR) exponential and logarithm primitives. This approach allows computationally expensive operations, including division and square roots, to be performed entirely in the log-domain via standard integer arithmetic. Combined with a calibration-free, outlier-aware optimization for LayerNorm parameters, our method eliminates the need for floating-point hardware units for nonlinearities, achieving less than 1.5\% absolute accuracy degradation across vision and language benchmarks.

</details>


### [396] [A Drosophila Whole-Connectome Network Can Learn Human-Designed Cognitive Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10014)
*Joonghui Cho,Minchan Kang,Daeshik Kim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 雄性果蝇全脑连接组(MaleCNS v1.0)作为固定循环拓扑，可为有界加法与具身关系语言任务提供可复用的归纳偏置。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究生物接线图(连接组)能否超越其进化所针对的行为，充当通用的计算基底。

Method: 以单只成年雄性果蝇重建的MaleCNS v1.0连接组作为人工网络的固定循环拓扑；每条解剖边学习一个标量权重；分别训练有界加法模型与基于固定100词词表的受控具身关系语言任务模型；与保持有向度的重连(directed degree-preserving rewires)对照；在严格配对语言端点上跨四个固定接口评测；并进行固定21图比较与48组匹配干预(打乱任务定义的感官特征)。

Result: 有界加法留出集平均准确率92.77%，对照重连为67.93%；严格配对语言端点四接口平均61.59%，匹配重连为44.17%；在规范接口的固定21图比较中排名第一；匹配48组干预子集上打乱感官特征使得分由60.94%降至19.27%。

Conclusion: MaleCNS的高阶接线为有界加法与具身关系语言提供了可复用的归纳偏置，表明生物连接组可作为超越其进化行为的计算基底。

Abstract: Can a biological wiring diagram serve as a useful computational substrate beyond the behaviors for which it evolved? We use the publicly released MaleCNS v1.0 connectome, reconstructed from a single adult male Drosophila specimen, as the fixed recurrent topology of an artificial network. We train separate models for bounded addition and for a controlled grounded relational language task built from a fixed 100-word lexicon. In both models, one scalar is learned per anatomical edge. The anatomical graph reaches 92.77% mean accuracy on held-out addition, compared with 67.93% for directed degree-preserving rewires. On the strict paired language endpoint, which matches original and order-reversed scenes to their corresponding descriptions, it reaches 61.59% across four fixed interfaces, compared with 44.17% for matched rewires. At the canonical interface, it ranks first in a fixed 21-graph comparison. On the matched 48-group intervention subset, shuffling task-defined sensory features reduces its score from 60.94% to 19.27%. Together, these results show that higher-order MaleCNS wiring provides a reusable inductive bias for bounded addition and grounded relational language.

</details>


### [397] [Oscillatory Neural Dynamics over Sheaves](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10018)
*Jan-Willem Van Looy,Alessandro Trenta,Alessio Gravina,Alessio Borgi,Ferdinando Zanchetta,Pietro Liò,Davide Bacciu,Rita Fioresi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ONDA：基于算子值信息波的长程图学习框架，用二阶动力学与学习到的层（sheaf）传输算子驱动列（stalk）值表示演化，实现有效长程传播。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图神经网络中长程传播是核心难题：单纯增加传播深度并不保证远端节点能有效互相影响。层神经网络虽通过矩阵值传输增强传播表达力，但表达力本身不等于有效长程通信，因此需要新的机制来确保远距离影响不衰减。

Method: 提出ONDA框架，基于算子值信息波。列值表示在学习到的层传输算子支配下按二阶动力学演化，将波式传播与表达性局部几何结合。并通过逐列灵敏度分析刻画长程影响，证明跨列影响不会消失。

Result: 在长程传播、严重图瓶颈、图迁移与异质（heterophilic）基准上，ONDA一致优于标量波传播、扩散式层基线与当前最优模型，验证了波动力学与矩阵值传输耦合的优势。

Conclusion: 将波动力学与矩阵值传输耦合，可有效解决长程通信问题，且跨列影响理论上不消失，实验上获得一致提升。

Abstract: Effective long-range propagation remains a central challenge in graph neural networks, as increasing a model's propagation depth does not guarantee that distant nodes effectively influence each other. Sheaf neural networks enrich graph propagation through matrix-valued transport between stalks; still, this expressivity alone does not automatically imply effective long-range communication. We introduce ONDA, a long-range graph learning framework based on operator-valued information waves. Stalk-valued representations evolve through second-order dynamics governed by learned sheaf transport operators, combining wave-like propagation with expressive local geometry. We characterize long-range influence through a stalk-wise sensitivity analysis and show that the cross-influence never vanishes. Across long-range propagation, severe graph bottlenecks, graph transfer, and heterophilic benchmarks, ONDA consistently improves over scalar wave propagation, diffusive sheaf baselines, and state-of-the-art models, demonstrating the benefit of coupling wave dynamics with matrix-valued transport.

</details>


### [398] [Matching of signal, noise and hardware timescales for filtering and forecasting of correlated noise signals](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10037)
*Joshua Donald,Alex Gabbitas,Arthur G. T. Coveney,Sergey Savel'ev,Pavel Borisov*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文利用纳米多孔氧化铌储备池，揭示了噪声相关时间、储备池记忆与预测时域之间的关系决定相关噪声是被过滤还是被预测，并提出储备池记忆时域与预测机制指数来区分不同工作区间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 物理储备池计算虽能高效处理时间相关数据，但其固有响应时间尺度固定，而真实信号包含多时间尺度上的确定性与随机性成分，二者是否以及如何匹配尚不明确，亟需厘清噪声时间尺度与储备池记忆、预测时域之间的关系以指导输入编码与架构设计。

Method: 以纳米多孔氧化铌（nanoporous niobium oxide）作为物理储备池，输入合成含噪信号与加密货币价格波动数据，考察噪声相关时间（noise correlation time）、储备池记忆（reservoir memory）与预测时域（forecast horizon）三者的相互关系，并引入储备池记忆时域（reservoir memory horizon）与预测机制指数（forecasting regime index）刻画工作区间。

Result: 当噪声变化快于相关储备池记忆与预测时域时，储备池对其起平均（过滤）作用；而慢变噪声的时间结构足以支撑算法预测。由此可通过储备池记忆时域与预测机制指数区分“过滤”与“预测”两类工作区间。

Conclusion: 时间尺度匹配可指导输入时间序列的编码方式以及物理储备池架构的设计，使其能够在不同时间尺度上过滤、分析与预测随机信号成分。

Abstract: Physical reservoir computing exploits the nonlinear dynamics of physical systems to process time-dependent data with greater energy efficiency than conventional machine learning approaches. However, physical reservoirs have fixed intrinsic response timescales, whereas real-world signals combine deterministic and stochastic components across multiple timescales. Here we show, using a nanoporous niobium oxide reservoir, synthetic noisy signals and cryptocurrency-price volatility, that the relationship among noise correlation time, reservoir memory and forecast horizon determines whether correlated noise is filtered or predicted. Noise varying faster than the relevant reservoir memory and forecast horizon is averaged by the reservoir, whereas the temporal structure of slower-varying noise is sufficient for algorithmic forecasting. We introduce the reservoir memory horizon and forecasting regime index to distinguish these operating regimes. These contributions demonstrate that timescale matching can guide the encoding of input time series and development of physical reservoir architectures that filter, analyse and predict stochastic signal components across distinct temporal scales.

</details>


### [399] [WxFM-XL: Adapting Univariate Foundation Models to Multi-Station Weather Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10057)
*Xiao Wang,Changjian Chen,Zhuo Tang,Rongwen Li,Hongwu Liu,Kenli Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出WxFM-XL，通过引入跨站点误差相关先验图并设计动态融合机制，将单变量时间序列基础模型适配到多站点天气预报任务，实验表明其优于当前最优基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有单变量时间序列基础模型向多变量场景扩展时主要关注变量间相关性建模，应用于多站点天气预报时忽略了两点：(1)站点的空间信息；(2)不同站点相对于基础模型的误差先验差异。

Method: WxFM-XL首先构建跨站点误差相关先验图，用于刻画各站点相对基础模型的误差先验；在此基础上提出动态融合机制，自适应地将空间相关图与误差相关先验图进行整合。

Result: 在多个数据集上的实验表明，该模型性能优于现有的最先进基线方法。

Conclusion: 通过显式建模站点空间信息与站级误差先验，并动态融合两类图结构，可有效将单变量时间序列基础模型适配至多站点天气预报任务。

Abstract: With the rise of univariate time series foundation models (e.g., Sundial, Timer), initial efforts have been made to extend them to multivariate settings. However, these models mainly focus on modeling correlations among variables. When they are applied to multi-station weather forecasting, two important factors are often overlooked: (1) the spatial information of stations, and (2) different error priors of different stations relative to the foundation model. In this paper, we propose WxFM-XL, a model for adapting univariate time series foundation models to multi-station weather forecasting. WxFM-XL introduces a cross-station error correlation prior graph to capture stationwise error priors with respect to the foundation model. Building on this, we further propose a dynamic fusion mechanism that adaptively integrates a spatial correlation graph with the error correlation prior graph. Experiments on multiple datasets demonstrate that our model outperforms state of the art baselines.

</details>


### [400] [Efficient Provably Private Classification with a Tabular Foundation Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10068)
*Talal Alrawajfeh,Cristiana Diaconu,Ossi Räisä,Sebastian Rodriguez Beltran,Yuan He,John Bronskill,Richard E. Turner,Antti Honkela*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: PrivTab 是一种将差分隐私机制内嵌入架构的表格基础模型，通过上下文学习将敏感行转化为紧凑且可证明私密的摘要，在中等至强隐私下优于私有线性与神经网络基线，近乎无成员泄露，拟合时间缩短 1 万倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 表格数据广泛支撑医疗、金融、政府和科学领域的预测与决策，但常含敏感个体信息。传统隐私学习虽有形式化隐私保证，却需缓慢的逐数据集优化、在强隐私下效用损失大、且难以正确使用；现有表格基础模型虽适应快，但缺乏形式化隐私保证且易受成员推断攻击，限制了其在敏感数据上的应用。

Method: 提出 PrivTab：一种易用的、面向差分隐私分类的表格基础模型，将隐私机制嵌入模型架构内部。在模拟数据集上预训练，利用上下文学习（in-context learning）将敏感行转换为紧凑、可证明私密的摘要，即"在隐私约束下学会如何学习"。

Result: 在中等至强隐私预算下，PrivTab 优于私有线性与神经网络基线；成员泄露可忽略；在强隐私下仍保持良好校准的预测；将数据集拟合时间缩短 10,000 倍，仅需单次前向传播。

Conclusion: PrivTab 结合了形式化隐私、速度与易用性，将近期 AI 进展带给因敏感个体数据而受限的应用场景。

Abstract: Tabular data underpin prediction and decision-making in medicine, finance, government and science, but often contain sensitive individual-level information, creating a need for accurate prediction while preserving privacy. Traditional private learning provides formal privacy guarantees, but requires slow dataset-specific optimisation, suffers substantial utility loss under strong privacy, and is often difficult to apply correctly. Tabular foundation models adapt rapidly to new datasets, but existing models lack formal privacy guarantees, and are highly vulnerable to membership-inference attacks, limiting their use on sensitive data. Here we introduce PrivTab, an easy to use tabular foundation model for differentially private classification that embeds a privacy mechanism within its architecture. Pretrained on simulated datasets, PrivTab uses in-context learning to transform sensitive rows into compact, provably private summaries---effectively learning how to learn under privacy. PrivTab outperforms private linear and neural-network baselines under moderate-to-strong privacy, shows negligible membership leakage, maintains well-calibrated predictions under strong privacy, and reduces dataset fitting time by 10,000 times, requiring only a single forward pass. By combining formal privacy, speed, and easy of use, PrivTab brings recent advances in AI to applications where sensitive individual-level data have limited their adoption.

</details>


### [401] [CAFE+FNO: Fourier Kernel Generation via Multiplicative Feature Composition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10105)
*Hyungjoon Juen,Minwoo Shin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 CAFE+FNO，将 Content-Aware Frequency Encoding+ (CAFE+) 引入傅里叶核生成过程，通过傅里叶-切比雪夫特征的并行仿射分支与哈达玛积构建频率交互。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FNO 通过傅里叶空间核参数化学习 PDE 解算子，但频率截断限制了高频变化的学习。AM-FNO 和 SirenFNO 从谱坐标生成所有网格模态的核，使坐标编码与生成器设计变得重要；近期 INR 工作提出用显式特征组合构建频率交互，而非依赖后续 MLP 隐式形成。基于此思路，作者希望改进傅里叶核生成中的频率编码。

Method: 提出 CAFE+FNO，将 CAFE+ 融入傅里叶核生成：(1) CAFE+ 通过并行仿射分支与哈达玛积组合傅里叶-切比雪夫特征，在两个特征族内部及跨族之间形成交互；(2) 核 MLP 将每个归一化谱坐标的表示映射为复通道混合矩阵；(3) 每层在所有存储模态上共享生成器，使固定架构下可训练参数量与模态数无关。并在五个 PDE 基准上与现有 FNO 变体对比，针对基配置、乘法组合与带宽可学习性进行消融研究。

Result: 在五个 PDE 基准上与现有 FNO 变体进行了比较，并完成了关于基配置、乘法组合与带宽可学习性的消融实验（摘要未给出具体数值结果）。代码与实验配置见 https://github.com/fabsk101/CAFEPlusFNO.git。

Conclusion: CAFE+FNO 通过在傅里叶核生成中引入 CAFE+ 的显式频率特征交互，改进了高频变化的表达能力，并在参数效率上实现与模态数无关的特性，在多个 PDE 基准上验证了有效性。

Abstract: The Fourier Neural Operator (FNO) learns solution operators of partial differential equations (PDEs) through Fourier-space kernel parameterization, but frequency truncation can limit the learning of high-frequency variations. AM-FNO and SirenFNO generate kernels for all grid modes from spectral coordinates using shared networks, making coordinate encoding and generator design important. Recent work on implicit neural representations (INRs) has proposed constructing frequency interactions through explicit feature composition rather than relying on subsequent MLPs to form them implicitly. Building on this approach, we propose CAFE+FNO, which incorporates Content-Aware Frequency Encoding+ (CAFE+) into Fourier kernel generation. CAFE+ combines Fourier--Chebyshev features through parallel affine branches and a Hadamard product, forming interactions within and across the two feature families. A kernel MLP maps the resulting representation of each normalized spectral coordinate to a complex channel-mixing matrix. Each layer shares its generator across all stored modes, making the number of trainable parameters independent of the number of modes for a fixed architecture. We compare CAFE+FNO with existing FNO variants on five PDE benchmarks and conduct ablation studies on basis configuration, multiplicative composition, and bandwidth learnability. Code and experimental configurations are available at https://github.com/fabsk101/CAFEPlusFNO.git.

</details>


### [402] [What Can a Gaussian Process Design Test](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10122)
*Ivan De Boi,Marnix Van Soom*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出从"结构化矛盾"与"先验式矛盾"两个维度前瞻性地刻画高斯过程模型的检验能力，并据此在观测响应之前预测检验功效、指导序贯设计选点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GP 模型与数据一致可能源于假设正确，也可能因为所选输入根本无法暴露错误，而这一区别在未观测响应前难以辨识。作者希望在观测之前就区分二者，并量化设计本身对模型检验能力的决定作用。

Method: 将无噪声响应必须满足的代数关系刻画为核矩阵的零空间；对有限特征 GP，借助 Gale 对偶给出几何解释：每个观测对应一个向量，暴露错误的最小观测组即为 circuits。对其他核，这些关系软化——响应模式在先验下只是低概率而非代数上不可能。据此把标准检验的证据拆分为结构证据（源自被违反的关系，随噪声下降而无界增长）与先验证据（仅表示偏离在先验下概率低），并做模拟验证与基于预测功效的序贯选点。

Result: 模拟中预测功效与实际拒绝率相符；按预测功效选点将针对局部偏差的功效从 0.48 提升到 0.72，而按预测方差选点仅为 0.51；二维网格设计包含加性假设的精确检验，拉丁超立方则不具备。案例还显示：当所有输入位于区间两端时，GP 能拒绝直线而支持大曲率，但依据仅是被隐含截距在先验下概率低，而非观测到曲率。

Conclusion: 检验本身是经典方法，贡献在于对其的"前瞻性"解读：在观测响应之前，设计就已经决定了它能产生何种矛盾，因而可用于预测功效与优化选点。

Abstract: A Gaussian process (GP) model can agree with the data for two reasons: its assumptions are right, or the chosen inputs could never have shown that they are wrong. The distinction can be checked from the design before any responses are observed. Every model implies relations that its noiseless responses must satisfy at the chosen inputs, such as the middle value lies on the line through its two neighbours. For GPs built from finitely many features, these relations are exactly the null space of the kernel matrix. Gale duality gives them a geometric interpretation, in which each observation has a vector and the smallest groups of observations that can expose an error are the circuits. For other kernels the relations become soft: response patterns may be improbable under the prior rather than algebraically impossible. A standard test then combines two kinds of evidence. Structural evidence comes from a violated relation and grows without limit as the noise falls. Prior-based evidence only says that a departure is improbable under the prior. With all inputs at the two ends of an interval, for example, a GP can reject a straight line against a large curvature, but only because the implied intercept is improbable, never because curvature was seen. In simulations the predicted power matched the observed rejection rates. Choosing the next input by predicted power raised the power against a localised discrepancy from 0.48 to 0.72, against 0.51 when choosing by predictive variance, and a grid in two dimensions contained exact tests of additivity that a Latin hypercube lacked. The test itself is classical. The contribution is the prospective reading of that test: before observing the responses, the design already determines what kind of contradiction it can produce.

</details>


### [403] [A Unified Information-Theoretic Approach to Constrained Multi-Fidelity Multi-Objective Bayesian Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10174)
*Rikuto Matsumoto,Masanori Ishikura,Masayuki Karasuyama*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种统一的信息论方法，在存在多目标、约束和多保真度的贝叶斯优化中，联合选择评估点及其保真度，以识别最高保真度下的可行帕累托前沿。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多目标、约束、多保真度三者结合的贝叶斯优化中，如何联合决定在何处、以何种保真度进行评估，从而识别最高保真度的可行帕累托前沿，仍具挑战；且保真度选择与约束处理通常依赖分离的启发式策略。

Method: 从统一的信息论视角出发，以某次观测关于该帕累托前沿所带来的信息增益来度量查询效用。由于该互信息难以直接计算，采用欠截断与过截断混合的近似方法对帕累托一致区域建模，推导出变分下界；并利用多保真度代理模型将信息传播到任意保真度，得到无需独立保真度选择或约束处理启发式策略的成本感知采集函数。

Result: 在合成问题、基准问题及真实世界问题上进行了实验，结果表明该方法在多种目标、约束与保真度设置下均具有效性。

Conclusion: 所提方法为多目标、带约束、多保真度贝叶斯优化提供了一个统一的信息论框架，通过成本感知采集函数联合优化评估位置与保真度，避免了对保真度选择和约束处理的分离启发式设计。

Abstract: Bayesian optimization often involves multiple objectives, constraints, and fidelity levels. We address the challenge of jointly selecting where and at which fidelity to evaluate to identify the highest-fidelity feasible Pareto frontier in this combined setting. From a unified information-theoretic perspective, we measure query utility by the information gain about this frontier, provided by an observation. Since this mutual information is intractable, we derive a variational lower bound using a mixture of under- and over-truncated approximations to the Pareto-consistent region. Multi-fidelity surrogate models propagate the information to arbitrary fidelities, yielding a cost-aware acquisition function without separate heuristics for fidelity selection or constraint handling. Experiments on synthetic, benchmark, and real-world problems demonstrate effectiveness across diverse objective, constraint, and fidelity settings.

</details>


### [404] [Robust Decentralized Fairness Auditing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10199)
*Sayan Biswas,Jade Garcia Bourrée,Anne-Marie Kermarrec,Palak,Martijn de Vos*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Auditopus，一种无中心服务器的去中心化公平性审计方法，通过多轮查询、交换累积统计向量并本地降权统计不一致的审计者，抵御fairwashing攻击。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 新兴法律要求对LLM进行公平性合规审计，但黑盒审计通常假设单一批审计者拥有大规模代表性查询集。现实中审计者难以获得此类查询集，需多个审计者协作覆盖相关人口群体。然而多方审计引入信任问题：审计者可能代表LLM提供商伪造公平假象（fairwashing）。

Method: Auditopus采用无中心服务器的多轮审计：每轮每个审计者向LLM发出固定数量查询，仅将结果的累积统计向量（而非明文敏感查询）发送给其他审计者，聚合所有向量估计LLM公平性。针对单个恶意审计者可通过伪造向量操纵估计的问题，每个诚实审计者会本地对累积统计向量与历史统计不一致的审计者进行降权。

Result: 在两个数据集和两个预训练LLM上与鲁棒聚合基线对比：面对优化发送向量以使LLM显得公平的攻击者，Auditopus平均将审计误差相比无防御降低最多78%，相比鲁棒聚合基线至少降低62%。即使49%的审计者为恶意，Auditopus也从未让非常不公平或中度不公平的LLM被判定为公平。

Conclusion: Auditopus通过去中心化、仅共享累积统计向量并结合本地一致性降权机制，有效实现了对LLM公平性的鲁棒审计，能在高比例恶意审计者存在时抵御fairwashing，性能显著优于无防御与鲁棒聚合基线。

Abstract: Emerging legislation requires large language models (LLMs) to be audited for compliance with regulatory standards, particularly fairness. Such black-box audits typically assume a single auditor with access to a large, representative set of queries. In practice, it can be difficult for an auditor to obtain such a query set, but multiple auditors can together cover the relevant demographic groups by auditing the LLM collaboratively with their individual query sets. However, relying on multiple auditors raises a fundamental trust problem, as they may act on behalf of the LLM provider to portray a misleading appearance of fairness, i.e., fairwashing. We propose Auditopus, a novel approach for robust decentralized fairness auditing. In Auditopus, auditing proceeds in rounds without a central server. In each round, every auditor issues a fixed number of queries to the LLM, and sends only cumulative statistics vectors of its query results to other auditors instead of sensitive queries in clear. The fairness of the audited LLM is then estimated by aggregating all the vectors. We show theoretically and empirically that even a single adversarial auditor in the network can steer this estimate by fabricating the vectors it sends, making an unfair LLM appear fair. To address this threat, Auditopus has each honest auditor locally down-weight any auditor whose cumulative statistics vectors are statistically inconsistent with previous ones. We implement Auditopus and compare it to robust aggregation baselines on two datasets with two pre-trained LLMs. Against an attacker that optimizes the vectors it sends to make the LLM appear fair, Auditopus reduces audit error by up to 78% on average relative to no defense and at least 62% relative to the robust aggregation baselines. Even when 49% of the auditors are adversarial, Auditopus never lets a very unfair or moderately unfair LLM pass as fair.

</details>


### [405] [How to train your model organism](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10203)
*Xilin Wang,David Bau,Byron C. Wallace*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出模型生物（model organisms）不应只以"安装目标行为"单一目标训练，而应基于目标行为安装、通用能力保持、输出自然性三目标及其指标进行验证；并据此重审已有生物套件、提出基于模型合并的多目标训练方法，验证指标能预测可解释性方法的恢复效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模型生物（如后门、谄媚、伪相关）是评估白盒可解释性技术的关键工具，但当前主流做法仅以安装目标行为这一单一目标训练模型生物，这不足以保证其真实性，可能导致对可解释性方法的结论不可推广。

Method: 1）提出三目标验证框架及对应指标：目标行为安装、通用能力保持（参数化知识、对话质量）、输出自然性（CoT与激活）。2）用该框架重审两个公开的模型生物套件。3）提出基于模型合并（model merging）的多目标训练方法。4）在新构建的、针对临床推理中人口统计学偏见的模型生物套件上对比训练配方（DPO vs 监督微调），并用调查员代理（investigator agent）审计。

Result: （1）对话质量与CoT自然性在各类训练配方下普遍显著退化；（2）验证指标可预测可解释性方法恢复目标行为的程度，例如logit lens读出与模型生物的通用能力共变；（3）DPO训练比监督微调更接近基座模型；（4）所提模型优化方法更好地保持能力与自然性；（5）审计该套件时再次观察到验证指标与偏见恢复的相关性。

Conclusion: 训练方法会塑造模型生物所支撑的可解释性结论；应综合考虑多个目标，才能借助（更真实的）模型生物得出关于可解释性方法的可推广结论。

Abstract: Model organisms of alignment-relevant behaviors (e.g., backdoors, sycophancy, spurious correlations) have emerged as a key tool for evaluating whitebox interpretability techniques. We argue that the prevailing practice of training model organisms to a single objective of installing the target behavior is insufficient and propose validating model organisms with respect to three objectives with associated metrics: target-behavior installation, general-capability preservation (i.e., parametric knowledge, chat quality), and output naturalness (i.e., CoT and activations). We re-visit two publicly released organism suites using this validation framework and show that (1) chat quality and CoT naturalness degrade substantially across training recipes, and (2) validation metrics predict how well interpretability methods recover the installed behavior, e.g., a logit lens readout covaries with an organism's general capabilities. We introduce a multi-objective training approach based on model merging to train more realistic model organisms. Finally, on a new suite of model organisms targeting demographic biases in clinical reasoning, we compare training recipes and find that DPO training stays closer to the base model than supervised finetuning, and the proposed model optimization approach better preserves capabilities and naturalness. Auditing this suite with an investigator agent, we again observe validation metrics tracking bias recovery. In sum, training methods shape the interpretability conclusions an organism supports, and we argue that one should consider multiple objectives to draw generalizable conclusions about interpretability methods using (realistic) model organisms.

</details>


### [406] [OrthoGen: A Generative Orthogonal Learner for Time-Varying Treatments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10210)
*Tomàs Garriga,Valentyn Melnychuk,Konstantin Hess,Eduard Serrahima de Cambra,Axel Brando,Gerard Sanz,Stefan Feuerriegel*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究时变治疗下条件分布潜在结果（CDPO）的估计问题，提出生成式递归g-computation调整策略及Neyman正交、双稳健生成学习器OrthoGen。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在医学场景中（如估计不同治疗序列下患者特异性风险），估计随时间的条件分布潜在结果（CDPO）至关重要。然而该任务因存在时变混杂而具有挑战性，现有调整策略亦存在局限。

Method: (1) 提出针对该场景的调整策略——生成式递归g-computation，递归传播完整的条件结果分布而非条件均值，直接建模所关注变量而非完整轨迹；基于该策略构建简单的生成学习器。(2) 针对简单学习器对冗余估计误差敏感的问题，提出OrthoGen——一种Neyman正交且双稳健的生成学习器，可实例化于不同生成骨干（如归一化流与扩散模型）。

Result: 理论证明OrthoGen在适当条件下具有速率双稳健性与准神谕效率。在合成、半合成及真实世界数据集上的实验表明，OrthoGen具有高度有效性。

Conclusion: 本文首次提出用于时变治疗下CDPO估计的生成式正交学习器，兼具灵活性与统计保证。

Abstract: Estimating conditional distributional potential outcomes (CDPOs) over time is important in medicine (e.g., to estimate patient-specific risks under different treatment sequences). However, this task is challenging because of time-varying confounding, yet existing adjustment strategies for this task are limited. In this paper, we aim to learn CDPOs under time-varying treatments using flexible generative models. Our contributions are two-fold. (1) We introduce a tailored adjustment strategy for our setting, namely, generative recursive g-computation. Our adjustment strategy recursively propagates full conditional outcome distributions rather than conditional means, modeling the variables of interest directly rather than full trajectories. Building on our adjustment strategy, we formulate simple generative learners for CDPO estimation. However, these learners can be sensitive to nuisance estimation errors, which motivates an orthogonal learner. (2) We thus introduce OrthoGen, a Neyman-orthogonal and doubly robust generative learner. Importantly, we show that OrthoGen further achieves rate double robustness and quasi-oracle efficiency under suitable conditions. Our learners are flexible and can be instantiated with different generative backbones (e.g., normalizing flows and diffusion models). Across experiments with synthetic, semi-synthetic and real-world datasets, we find that OrthoGen is highly effective. To the best of our knowledge, we are the first to propose a generative orthogonal learner for estimating CDPOs under time-varying treatments.

</details>


### [407] [Edge Accuracy Is Not Enough: Why Dynamics-Learned Structure Fails to Transfer to Inverse Problems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10213)
*Nicholas Tan Jerome,Fangnian Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文证明：在标注稀缺的逆问题中，从大量正演仿真数据迁移关系结构这一策略会系统性失败，即便其满足标准的理论保证条件；作者提出以Jaccard相似度为核心的轻量可迁移性检验来区分成败。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 逆问题标注数据稀缺，直觉上应从大量正演仿真数据中迁移已学到的关系结构（relational structure）；且现有理论（边误差条件 Δ < n² − kn）预测这种结构迁移应降低样本复杂度，由 O(n²) 降至 O(kn+Δ)。然而该理论保证是否足以导致实际性能提升尚不明确，本文旨在检验这一策略的有效性并解释其失败原因。

Method: 1) 理论分析：证明当边误差满足 Δ < n² − kn 时，近似结构确能带来估计误差收益；2) 实验验证：用 Neural Relational Inference（NRI）从动力学预测中学习结构，在 180 个 CFD 仿真的氢泄漏场景与 180 个声学场景的源定位任务上评测；3) 对照基线：任务优化注意力模型、基于物理的先验（Green 函数）；4) 四条独立证据链：扩增数据、边阈值敏感性、图重叠度（Jaccard）、其他动力学导出结构估计器（相关性与互信息）；5) 提出轻量可迁移性检验。

Result: NRI 学到的结构满足理论条件，但在源定位任务上相对任务优化注意力基线性能下降 116%（氢泄漏）与 201%（声学），而物理先验（Green 函数）仅下降 69–72%。四类证据表明这非调参失败：训练数据增加 18 倍时 NRI 仅提升 0.5%（基线提升 16.6%，p<0.001）；性能对 NRI 边阈值在全范围内不敏感；动力学学到的图与任务最优图仅重叠 6% 的边；另两种动力学导出估计器（相关性/互信息）相对无结构基线无可测收益，相关性估计器显著更差。基于 Jaccard 相似度的可迁移性检验在全部四个领域/结构组合上均能区分成功与失败迁移，计算耗时不到 1 小时、使用 15–20% 目标域数据。

Conclusion: 从正演仿真迁移关系结构并非普遍有效：满足标准边精度理论条件不足以保证估计误差收益，其关键障碍在于边精度条件无法控制的近似误差（结构-任务不匹配）。作者将该差距形式化为关于近似误差的陈述，并提出一个基于 Jaccard 相似度（对照部分观测的目标任务图）的轻量启发式可迁移性检验，在少数案例上校准，尚非经充分验证的通用阈值。

Abstract: A natural strategy for inverse problems with scarce labelled data is to transfer relational structure learned from abundant forward-simulation data. We show this strategy fails systematically, even when it satisfies the standard theoretical justification for why structure should help. We prove that approximate structure provides estimation-error benefits whenever the edge error satisfies $Δ< n^2 - kn$, reducing sample complexity from $O(n^2)$ to $O(kn+Δ)$. Structure learned via Neural Relational Inference (NRI) from dynamics prediction satisfies this condition, yet on a source-localisation task across 180 CFD-simulated hydrogen-leak scenarios and 180 acoustic scenarios, it degrades performance by 116% and 201% relative to a flexible, task-optimised attention baseline, while a physics-based prior (Green's function) degrades by only 69-72%. Four independent lines of evidence show this is not a tuning failure: NRI improves only 0.5% when given 18x more training data (versus 16.6% for the task-optimised baseline, $p<0.001$); performance is insensitive to the NRI edge threshold across a wide range; the dynamics-learned graph overlaps the task-optimal graph on only 6% of edges; and two further dynamics-derived structure estimators (correlation- and mutual-information-based) show no measurable benefit over a structure-free baseline, with the correlation-based estimator performing markedly worse. We formalise this gap as a statement about approximation error that the edge-accuracy condition cannot control, and we provide a lightweight transferability test (Jaccard similarity against a partially-observed target-task graph) that separates successful from failed transfer in all four domain/structure pairs we evaluate, using under an hour of computation and 15-20% of target-domain data; we present this as a heuristic calibrated on few cases, not a validated general threshold.

</details>


### [408] [Evaluating Sequence Assembly Strategies for Differentially Private Synthetic Time-Series Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10222)
*Guoxiong Long,Huizhen Huang,Qikun Cai,Tao Huang,Chen Hou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究差分隐私时间序列生成器输出窗口的"生成后拼接"过程，系统改变重叠率与窗口加权方案，发现下游预测效用取决于预测器、重叠率和加权方案的联合作用，连续性等诊断指标不足以指导拼接配置选择。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 差分隐私时间序列生成器通常输出定长合成窗口，而下游预测模型需要长连续训练序列；因此窗口的拼接方式会改变预测器实际接收到的合成数据，但该"生成后拼接"环节此前缺乏系统研究。

Method: 在生成器固定不变的前提下，系统变化窗口重叠率与窗口加权方案，对拼接所得序列从三方面评估：边界连续性、统计与时间保真度、以及TSTR预测效用。实验覆盖四类公开数据集（ETTh1、ETTm1、Weather、Appliances）和五种预测模型，构建完整五预测器拼接网格，并配以TRTR参考对照。

Result: TSTR效用由预测器、重叠率与加权方案共同决定，不同预测模型呈现不同的拼接偏好；提高重叠率一般改善边界连续性，但连续性或单项保真度指标的改善并不稳定地降低预测误差；完整拼接网格与TRTR对照刻画了拼接相关效用的规律性，并通过鲁棒性与生成器变异分析得到验证。

Conclusion: 拼接配置的选择应依赖下游预测器与TSTR效用，而非仅凭连续性等单项诊断指标；研究给出了预测器相关的拼接原则，为差分隐私合成时间序列的生成后处理提供了实证依据。

Abstract: Differentially private time-series generators commonly produce fixed-length synthetic windows, whereas downstream forecasting models often require long continuous training sequences. How these windows are assembled after generation can therefore alter the effective synthetic data presented to a forecaster, even when the trained generator remains unchanged. We study this post-generation sequence assembly process by systematically varying overlap rates and window-weighting schemes and evaluating the resulting sequences in terms of boundary continuity, statistical and temporal fidelity, and Train-on-Synthetic-Test-on-Real (TSTR) forecasting utility. Across four types of public datasets (ETTh1, ETTm1, Weather, and Appliances) and five forecasting models, the results reveal a clear forecaster-dependent assembly principle: downstream TSTR utility is jointly shaped by the forecaster, overlap rate, and window-weighting scheme, leading to distinct assembly preferences across forecasting models. Increased overlap generally improves boundary continuity, but improvements in continuity or individual fidelity diagnostics do not consistently reduce forecasting error, indicating that these diagnostics alone are insufficient for selecting assembly configurations. Complete five-forecaster assembly grids, together with matched Train-on-Real-Test-on-Real (TRTR) references, further characterize these regularities and quantify assembly-dependent utility relative to real-data training. We then validate the identified principles through additional analyses of robustness and generator variability.

</details>


### [409] [ProtocolMatch: Protocol-Dependent Model Selection for Scientific Dynamics Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10239)
*Lu Wei,Yufeng Wang,Haibin Ling*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出ProtocolMatch——一个计算匹配、验证集选择、保留失效信息的评估框架，主张科学动力学预测的模型选择应依赖协议而非仅比较架构。实验表明模型排序随任务、训练集规模、历史长度和测试分布变化，因此应连同协议一起报告预测精度、物理有效性与分布偏移可靠性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 科学动力学预测常被简化为“架构选择”问题，但实际部署表现同时由观测历史、闭环反馈、算力预算、物理目标与测试分布决定，单一架构对比结论不可靠，缺少统一且可复现的评估协议。

Method: 提出协议依赖的模型选择思路与ProtocolMatch框架，在计算预算匹配、验证集选择、保留失效样本的条件下评估。于驱动量子自旋动力学上，使用三套独立生成的数据集，比较循环网络、分块注意力、因果注意力与低秩线性预测器；并操控观测历史长度、状态刷新与闭环滚动、物理惩罚项及驱动频率偏移。

Result: 在固定双自旋任务中，随训练集增大，因果注意力与循环模型的优劣排序发生反转；六自旋局域可观测量比较中线性预测器平均误差最低。缩短观测历史使所有刷新历史视图变差，却使所有闭环视图改善。最新状态MLP在五个单元、状态刷新设置下均优于持续性基线，但其闭环排名随系统变化并出现有限爆炸误差。物理惩罚提升目标一致性但不稳定改善预测误差；分布内区间在驱动频率偏移后大量丢失覆盖率。

Conclusion: 科学模型选择应返回“预测器+其评估协议”的组合，并分别报告预测精度、物理有效性和偏移分布下的可靠性，而非仅给出架构排名。

Abstract: Scientific dynamics forecasting is often framed as an architecture choice, although deployment is also determined by observed history, rollout feedback, compute budget, physical objective, and test distribution. We formulate protocol-dependent model selection and introduce ProtocolMatch, a compute-matched, validation-selected, and failure-preserving evaluation framework. On driven quantum-spin dynamics, we compare recurrent, patched-attention, causal-attention, and low-rank linear predictors across three independently generated datasets. The causal-attention--recurrence ordering reverses as the training set grows within a fixed two-spin task, while a linear predictor has the lowest mean error in the six-spin local-observable comparison. Restricting observed history worsens every refreshed-history view but improves every closed-loop view in the four-spin study. A latest-state MLP has lower error than persistence on every dataset under state refresh across all five cells, yet its closed-loop rank varies by system and includes finite explosive errors. Physical penalties improve targeted consistency without reliably improving prediction error, and in-distribution intervals lose most coverage after a driving-frequency shift. Thus scientific model selection should return a predictor with its protocol and report accuracy, physical validity, and shifted-distribution reliability separately.

</details>


### [410] [MorphCL: Morphological Contrastive Learning for Inertial-based Human Activity Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10245)
*Marius Bock,Yuwei Zhang,Juergen Gall,Michael Moeller,Kristof Van Laerhoven,Cecilia Mascolo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 MorphCL，一种基于"结构感知分组"的自监督预训练框架，将全局结构建模引入惯性运动数据的对比学习，在少 4600 倍数据的情况下达到或超过现有基础模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可穿戴与移动设备中的惯性传感器产生了海量人体运动数据，但将其转化为基础运动模型仍具挑战。现有自监督方法依赖随机采样批次与局部对比，未充分利用大规模运动数据的全局结构；而野外惯性数据以静止、低方差行为为主，局部对比效果尤其不佳。

Method: 提出 Morphological Contrastive Learning（MorphCL），利用结构感知分组（structure-aware grouping），将运动基元（motif）发现与领域特定的特征描述子两项运动分析基础结合，显式地将全局结构建模注入基于惯性的自监督学习框架。

Result: MorphCL 使学习到的编码器在线性探测与微调任务上 F1 分数最多提升 15 个百分点；与现有基础模型相比，其预训练编码器以少 4600 倍的数据达到或超过线性探测性能；嵌入空间的定性分析显示具有形态学意义的聚类结构，运动学相似的活动类别分离度更好。

Conclusion: 结构感知分组能有效弥补现有惯性自监督学习忽视全局结构的不足，MorphCL 在样本效率与表征质量上均具优势，为大规模人体运动基础模型提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Despite the ubiquity of sensors in wearable and mobile devices and the abundance of human movement data they generate, translating unlabeled recordings into foundational motion models remains an open challenge. Self-supervised learning (SSL) has alleviated the need for costly annotations, yet existing approaches leave the global structure of large-scale motion data largely untapped, relying on randomly sampled batches and local comparisons that become particularly problematic for in-the-wild inertial data dominated by stationary, low-variance behaviors. Here we introduce Morphological Contrastive Learning (MorphCL), a self-supervised pretraining framework that uses structure-aware grouping to inject explicit modeling of global structure into inertial-based SSL approaches. Building on two well-established pillars of motion analysis, the discovery of motion primitives, or motifs, and domain-specific feature descriptors, we show that MorphCL substantially improves linear probing and finetuning results of learned encoders by up to 15 percentage points in F1-score. In a comparison with existing foundation models, we demonstrate that MorphCL-pretrained encoders match or surpass them models in linear probing performance while trained on $4600\times$ less data. Qualitative analysis of the resulting embedding spaces further reveals morphologically meaningful cluster structure, with improved separation of kinematically similar activity classes.

</details>


### [411] [PairAudit: Guiding Human Review with Graph Tokens under Distribution Shift](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10260)
*Jiran Tao,Binyan Jiang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出PairAudit，用图token捕捉节点间预测模式，以异常关系模式发现被检出器自信误分类的样本，在固定审查预算下提升纠错效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 入侵检测器会对训练中未见的攻击产生高置信度误分类；人工审查仅能覆盖有限样本。基于不确定性的审查会遗漏自信错误，仅靠异常分数又无法判断调整审查计划能否纠正更多错误，因此需要新的审查定位方法。

Method: PairAudit不通过特征聚合训练新的预测器，而是构建图token以刻画相连节点间的预测模式，利用异常的关系模式在既有预测中挖掘潜在错误；再由人工反馈决定这些发现是否足以调整审查优先级。

Result: 在多项安全任务上，PairAudit平均比基于不确定性的审查纠正更多错误，且对未见攻击的纠错更多；收益已计入全部审查成本，且无需重训练检测器。

Conclusion: PairAudit以关系模式异常为线索，在固定审查预算下有效发现被忽略的高置信错误，提升审查纠错效果并保持检测器不变。

Abstract: Intrusion detectors can confidently misclassify attacks that were not seen during training. Human review can correct these errors, but only a limited number of cases can be checked. Uncertainty-based review may overlook confident errors, while anomaly scores alone do not show whether changing the review plan will correct more errors. We introduce PairAudit to find overlooked errors and improve review under a fixed budget. Its graph tokens capture prediction patterns across connected nodes. Rather than building another predictor through feature aggregation, PairAudit uses unusual relational patterns to uncover potential errors in existing predictions. Human feedback then helps decide whether these findings justify changing review priorities. Experiments across security tasks show that PairAudit corrects more errors on average than uncertainty-based review, including more errors on unseen attacks. These gains account for all review costs and do not require retraining the detector.

</details>


### [412] [A Closed-Loop Non-Asymptotic Convergence Analysis of PPO with Learned Critics and Clipping](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10273)
*Junwei Su,Mengfan Liu,Yanyong Zhang,Chuan Wu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文对带裁剪的近端策略优化（PPO-Clip）作为闭环actor-critic系统进行非渐近分析，刻画了actor-critic耦合、非光滑概率比裁剪、有限批次复用与可预测早停等机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PPO-Clip虽被广泛使用但难以调参，且critic学习、裁剪与rollout复用之间的相互作用尚未被充分理解，缺少同时刻画策略平稳性与critic跟踪精度的理论保证。

Method: 在显式覆盖与critic正则性假设下，采用原始GAE与蒙特卡洛critic目标，建立同步与异步两种非渐近保证；将优化、critic跟踪、裁剪与有限批次误差统一到共同放大界中；异步情形额外引入依赖延迟的critic步长限制；对有限分层MDP与表格critic，用裁剪梯度类的统一界替代完整轨迹计数。

Result: 给出策略平稳性与critic跟踪精度的显式参数依赖界；验证的增长时域族具有多项式样本复杂度；两时间尺度调度下达到O(T^{-2/5})的平稳性与critic跟踪界，并显式计入新鲜rollout的开销。

Conclusion: 该分析深化了对PPO的理解，并为实际调参提供了理论指导；同时指出违反所给充分条件并不证明发散。

Abstract: Despite its widespread use, Proximal Policy Optimization with clipping (PPO-Clip) remains difficult to tune, and the interactions among critic learning, clipping, and rollout reuse remain incompletely understood. We develop a \emph{non-asymptotic} analysis of PPO-Clip as a \emph{closed-loop actor--critic} system. It captures actor--critic coupling, nonsmooth probability-ratio clipping, finite-batch reuse, and predictable early stopping under explicit coverage and critic regularity assumptions, using raw GAE and Monte Carlo critic targets. Our synchronous and asynchronous guarantees jointly characterize policy stationarity and the tracking accuracy of the learned critic, with explicit dependence on algorithmic parameters. A sufficient coupling condition gives optimization, critic tracking, clipping, and finite-batch errors a common amplification bound. The asynchronous result also requires a delay-dependent critic stepsize restriction; violating these conditions does not establish divergence. For finite layered MDPs with tabular critics, a uniform bound on the actual clipped-gradient class replaces complete-trajectory counting. A verified growing-horizon family has polynomial sample complexity, and a two-time-scale schedule gives $O(T^{-2/5})$ stationarity and critic-tracking bounds with explicit fresh-rollout accounting. These results together advance our understanding about PPO and provide theoretical guidance in tuning.

</details>


### [413] [Sparse Planning in Visual World Models via Cost Gradients](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10274)
*Yingchen Xu,Edward Grefenstette*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出COSTGRAD：一种免训练、目标条件化的空间token选择器，按规划代价对输入token的梯度范数排序，实现稀疏token世界模型规划加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于token的世界模型支持细粒度潜空间规划，但反复处理大规模空间token网格使动作搜索（如CEM）计算代价高昂。现有token选择可能偏向预测重要性，而非规划/控制目标的重要性。

Method: COSTGRAD为免训练、goal-conditioned选择器，以规划代价对各输入token求梯度范数，据此对空间token排序并保留高重要性token；从下游控制目标导出重要性，并可与缩减的CEM搜索结合。

Result: 在AdaLN条件预测器、50%稀疏度下，COSTGRAD在四个连续控制基准中的三个上持平或超过全token规划，每环境规划步实现2.6倍实测墙钟加速；结合token稀疏与缩减CEM搜索可达约5倍总加速且仍超过全token基线。发现架构相关失效模式：匹配的AdaLN-vs-concat对比中，concat全token性能相当，但纯COSTGRAD相对随机选择丧失优势；该差异与动作通路漂移相关——AdaLN上梯度选择移除漂移小于随机移除，concat上则相反。

Conclusion: 选择器与架构的兼容性是稀疏世界模型规划的关键设计维度；COSTGRAD在AdaLN类架构上有效，但需针对concat类架构重新设计选择策略。

Abstract: Token-based world models enable fine-grained latent planning, but repeatedly processing large spatial token grids makes action search expensive. We introduce COSTGRAD, a training-free, goal-conditioned selector that ranks spatial tokens by the gradient norm of the planning cost with respect to each input token. By deriving importance from the downstream control objective, COSTGRAD targets tokens that matter for planning rather than merely for prediction. On AdaLN-conditioned predictors at $50\%$ sparsity, COSTGRAD matches or exceeds full-token planning on three of four continuous-control benchmarks, while giving a measured $2.6\times$ wall-clock speedup per environment planning step. Combining token sparsity with reduced CEM search increases this to a $\sim 5\times$ total speedup while still exceeding the full-token baseline. We also identify an architecture-dependent failure mode: in a matched AdaLN-vs-concat comparison, concat maintains comparable full-token performance but pure COSTGRAD loses its advantage over random selection. This difference tracks action-pathway drift: gradient-selected removal produces less drift than random removal on AdaLN, but more on concat. These results highlight selector-architecture compatibility as a design axis for sparse world-model planning. Project page and demos: https://ycxuyingchen.github.io/costgrad/

</details>


### [414] [Physics-Aligned Electronic Ground-State Learning Improves Generalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10298)
*Eike S. Eberhard,Xaver Kainz,Viktor Kotsev,Abdulrahman Aldossary,Stephan Günnemann*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出"电子基态描述符模型"(GSM),通过物理约束与架构对齐KS-DFT方程,在MLIP与KS-DFT之间构建成本-精度帕累托前沿,显著提升分布外泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器学习原子间势(MLIP)在分布内任务表现优异,但分布外泛化能力差;需要设计成本介于MLIP与KS-DFT之间、可泛化的模型。

Method: 提出观测无关的电子基态描述符模型(GSM),使学习目标与架构对齐KS-DFT控制方程,施加物理约束并移除对非物理/无关自由度的优化压力;具体方法包括OrthoNormal-Loss(ON-Loss)、Grassmann受限占据轨道训练(GROOT)和残差最优规范条件感知KS方程训练(ROCKET)。

Result: 在QM9到QM40尺寸外推实验中,ON-Loss+GROOT使能量和力MAE较此前最优密度GSM降低79.1%和83.4%;ON-Loss+ROCKET使最强基线的能量和力MAE分别降低99.8%和95.9%;自洽拒绝准则在QMugs上剔除不足0.4%预测即达0.07 mHa能量MAE;并实现无标签自洽微调,迁移至Transition1x反应化学使能量误差低于化学精度。

Conclusion: 通过将学习目标与物理约束对齐,GSM有效推进了成本-精度帕累托前沿,并展现出强泛化能力、高效微调与向反应化学的迁移潜力。

Abstract: Machine-learned interatomic potentials (MLIPs) excel at in-distribution tasks, accelerating drug and material development, yet they struggle to generalize out-of-distribution. We propose to push the cost-accuracy Pareto frontier by designing observable-agnostic electronic ground-state descriptor models (GSMs) with computational costs situated between MLIPs and Kohn-Sham density functional theory (KS-DFT). We align the learning objectives and architectures of GSMs with the governing equations of KS-DFT by enforcing physical constraints and removing optimization pressure on unphysical or irrelevant degrees of freedom. In our size-extrapolation experiments from QM9 to QM40, our combined contributions OrthoNormal-Loss (ON-Loss) and Grassmann Restricted Occupied-Orbital Training (GROOT) reach a 79.1% energy and 83.4% force mean absolute error (MAE) reduction over previous state-of-the-art density GSMs. For Hamiltonian GSMs, ON-Loss and Residual Optimal-gauge Conditioning-aware KS-Eq. Training (ROCKET) together reduce the energy and force MAEs of the strongest baseline by 99.8% and 95.9%, respectively. Using a self-consistency rejection criterion, we filter out extrapolation errors on QMugs, rejecting fewer than 0.4% of predictions while reaching an energy MAE of 0.07 mHa. Finally, we demonstrate the efficiency of label-free self-consistency fine-tuning, and transfer GSMs to reactive chemistry in Transition1x, reaching energy errors below chemical accuracy.

</details>


### [415] [Continual Graph Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10302)
*Tommaso Marzi,Ahmed Hendawy,Jan Peters,Carlo D'Eramo,Andrea Cini,Cesare Alippi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文针对持续多智能体强化学习（CMARL）中任务结构信息未被有效利用的问题，提出将任务序列建模为属性图的新框架CGMARL，并给出首个基准GRAFO与冻结图编码器方法FROG，实验证明FROG结合现有持续学习方法可显著提升多场景性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在CMARL中，智能体需在任务序列上学习协作策略，既要适应新任务又要保留旧任务能力。许多应用场景中任务差异体现为底层结构差异（如电网拓扑、编队构型），但现有CMARL方法缺乏专门机制来利用这类结构信息，导致迁移能力不足且遗忘严重。

Method: 提出CGMARL框架，将任务序列映射为一系列属性图，每张图建模任务专属结构，并决定环境动态（下一状态和/或奖励）及对应任务的智能体数量；构建首个CGMARL基准GRAFO，展示该设定下遗忘的产生；提出FROG方法，依托冻结的图骨干网络在基于图的CMARL策略中保留既往结构信息。

Result: 在GRAFO上的实验表明，将FROG与现有持续学习（CL）方法结合，在多个CGMARL场景中性能获得显著提升。

Conclusion: 结构信息是CMARL中促进迁移与缓解遗忘的关键要素；图建模为统一刻画任务结构差异提供了有效途径，冻结图编码器能有效保护既往结构知识，与通用持续学习方法互补。

Abstract: In Continual Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (CMARL), agents learn cooperative policies across sequences of tasks, aiming to adapt effectively to new tasks while preserving the ability to solve previously encountered ones. In many applications, tasks differ in their underlying structure, which can represent, for example, distinct operational conditions or target configurations (e.g., different network topologies in power grids or arrangements in formation control). Existing CMARL methods lack dedicated mechanisms to leverage this structural information when learning new tasks, failing to promote transfer and mitigate forgetting. To fill this gap, we propose Continual Graph Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (CGMARL), a novel framework for CMARL problems in which task sequences are mapped into a series of attributed graphs, each modeling a task-specific structure. In CGMARL, each graph determines the environment dynamics (next states and/or rewards) and the number of agents for the corresponding task. Then, we present Graph-based Formation (GRAFO), the first CGMARL benchmark, and show how forgetting arises in this setting. Finally, to address this limitation, we propose Frozen Graph Encoder (FROG), a method that relies on a frozen graph backbone to preserve past structural information in graph-based CMARL policies. Experiments on GRAFO show that pairing FROG with existing CL methods substantially improves performance on multiple CGMARL scenarios.

</details>


### [416] [How Do Transformers Learn to Represent Symmetries?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10305)
*Eduardo Santos-Escriche,Valerie Engelmayer,Ya-Wei Eileen Lin,Stefanie Jegelka*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统研究了普通Transformer通过有限数据增强学习点云数据中各种对称性的能力，揭示了不同对称群的递增可学习性顺序，并识别出诱导不变性的可解释机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于Transformer的架构结合有限数据增强在几何机器学习中日益流行，但其架构、对不同对称性的不变性与增强预算之间的相互作用尚未得到充分探索。本文旨在填补这一空白。

Method: 研究普通Transformer通过有限数据增强学习点云数据集各类对称性的能力。识别出对称群的递增可学习性顺序：（i）非保角对称性、（ii）保角对称性、（iii）基础保角子群（平移、旋转、缩放）。针对基础保角群，进一步研究外推行为并对训练模型进行结构分析，以识别诱导不变性的可解释机制。

Result: 发现了三类对称群的递增可学习性排序；对基础保角群揭示了Transformer的外推行为，并通过结构分析识别出诱导不变性的可解释机制；进一步将该机制扩展到等变函数，表明近似不变性的机制可作为学习等变性的关键构件。

Conclusion: 普通Transformer能够通过有限数据增强学习多种对称性，且不同对称群的可学习性存在层级顺序；所识别的可解释机制不仅解释近似不变性，还为学习等变性提供基础构件。

Abstract: Training Transformer-based architectures with finite data augmentation has become an increasingly popular approach in geometric machine learning. Despite its empirical success, the interplay between the Transformer architecture, invariance to different symmetries, and augmentation budgets remains underexplored. In this paper, we study the ability of a vanilla Transformer to learn various symmetries through finite data augmentation for point cloud datasets. We identify an ordering of increasing learnability across the following symmetry groups: (i) non-angle-preserving symmetries, (ii) angle-preserving symmetries, and (iii) base angle-preserving subgroups, such as translation, rotation, and scale. For the base angle-preserving groups, we further investigate the Transformer's extrapolation behavior and conduct a structural analysis of the trained models, allowing us to identify interpretable mechanisms that induce invariance. Finally, we extend our analysis to equivariant functions and show that the detected mechanisms for approximate invariance can also provide a key building block for learned equivariance. Our project page is available at https://transformers-learn-symmetries.github.io/

</details>


### [417] [RSIGym: A Flexible Environment for Recursive Self-Improvement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10310)
*Fanqing Meng,Lingxiao Du,Haocheng Lu,Qiguang Chen,Ziqi Zhao,Zijian Wu,Jiayuan Zhuo,Mengkang Hu,Michael Qizhe Shieh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出 RSIGym——一个基于"一切皆服务"(EaaS) 的智能体原生研究环境，将训练、推理、rollout、评测与沙箱执行封装为可复用服务，支持 Data、Harness 与 Joint 三条改进轨道；并定义 RSI-Index 指标，在六个前沿模型对比中 Opus 5 取得最高 0.4809。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 递归自我改进（RSI）需要把已接受的改动带入后续改进循环，而研究智能体提出的改动又依赖大量研究基础设施。现有设定常让智能体重复搭建常规基础设施，或只能针对单个组件进行探索，缺乏统一环境支撑联合优化与受控实验。

Method: 构建 RSIGym：以 Everything as a Service 为架构的智能体原生研究环境，将训练、推理、rollout、评测、沙箱执行暴露为可复用服务，并提供共享的预算与权限控制，支持 Data、Harness、Joint 三类改进轨道，使智能体可在同一环境内研究单项干预并联合优化数据、训练设置与执行 harness。同时定义 RSI-Index 为五个基准上已关闭剩余性能差距的平均比例。

Result: 在独立 Joint 运行中对比六个前沿研究模型，Opus 5 在每基准 500 美元平台服务预算下取得最高 RSI-Index 0.4809；其选定的系统在全部五个基准（软件工程、终端交互、数学、科学推理、技能类任务）上均有提升，SWE-bench Verified 从 17.67% 升至 50.33%，AIME 从 31.67% 升至 97.78%。附加实验考察了 DSH-harness 精化、预算变化与受限网络访问，轨迹记录揭示了智能体如何诊断失败并挑选候选方案。

Conclusion: RSIGym 为智能体驱动的递归自我改进研究提供了可复用、受控且可扩展的基础设施，验证了在统一环境中联合优化数据、训练与执行 harness 的可行性与收益；全部代码与结果已开源以支持可复现性与后续研究。

Abstract: Recursive self-improvement requires carrying accepted changes into later improvement cycles, while studying agent-proposed changes also requires substantial research infrastructure. Existing settings often leave agents to rebuild routine infrastructure or restrict exploration to individual components. We introduce RSIGym, an agent-native research environment based on Everything as a Service (EaaS). RSIGym exposes training, inference, rollout, evaluation, and sandbox execution through reusable services, with shared budget and permission controls supporting Data, Harness, and Joint improvement tracks. This design enables agents to investigate individual interventions and jointly optimize data, training settings, and execution harnesses within the same environment. We define RSI-Index as the mean fraction of the remaining performance gap closed across five benchmarks covering software engineering, terminal interaction, mathematics, scientific reasoning, and skill-based tasks. Comparing six frontier research models in independent Joint runs, Opus 5 achieves the highest RSI-Index of 0.4809 under a $500 platform-service budget per benchmark run. Its selected systems improve all five benchmarks, raising SWE-bench Verified from 17.67% to 50.33% and AIME from 31.67% to 97.78%. Additional experiments examine DSH-harness refinement, budget variation, and restricted network access, while recorded trajectories reveal how agents diagnose failures and select candidates. We open-source the full RSIGym codebase and results to support reproducibility and further research.

</details>


### [418] [PoreML: A Data-Driven Framework for Learning Multiphase Flow in Porous Media](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10314)
*Chunyang Wang,Mingrui Zhang,Yuyan Zhang,Linqi Zhu,Xin Ju,Edo Sicco Boek,Martin J. Blunt,Gege Wen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: PoreML：一个面向多孔介质多相流的开源框架，统一数据生成、模型训练与评估，含GPU原生LBM求解器、3.3 TB数据集（560次模拟、158,546个时间步、四类场景）及域专用评估协议，并对五种架构模型进行基准评测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多孔微结构中多相流在CO2封存、燃料电池与倒装芯片封装等应用中至关重要，但其界面演化受润湿性与复杂孔隙几何的非线性控制，难以预测。机器学习虽有潜力，却受制于稀缺的时序三维数据集以及缺乏统一的训练与评估工作流。

Method: 提出PoreML开源框架，包含三个核心组件：(a) 现代GPU原生格子玻尔兹曼求解器，经解析解与已发表实验验证，支持可复现数据生成；(b) 3.3 TB数据集，含560次模拟、158,546个存储时间步，覆盖四类应用驱动场景，轨迹涵盖合成结构及真实材料micro-CT扫描几何，涉及多种润湿条件与黏度比；(c) 统一学习框架，评估单步预测与自回归推理，采用域专用评估协议衡量预测精度与物理一致性。在该协议下评测五种不同架构模型，并设置两项互补挑战：向更大域的迁移与从合成结构到micro-CT结构的迁移。

Result: 构建并验证了GPU原生LBM求解器；发布了3.3 TB、560次模拟、158,546时间步的多场景数据集；建立了包含单步预测与自回归推演的评估协议，并对五种不同架构模型完成了基准测试与两项迁移挑战评估。

Conclusion: PoreML为多孔介质多相流的机器学习研究提供了共享基础，旨在帮助社区开发可靠的预测模型并推动该领域发展。

Abstract: Multiphase flow in porous microstructures is central to CO$_2$ storage, fuel-cell operation, and flip-chip packaging. Predicting these flows remains challenging because wettability and complex pore geometry govern the nonlinear evolution of fluid interfaces. Machine learning holds substantial promise for advancing the field, but progress is constrained by scarce time-resolved 3D datasets and a lack of a unified workflow for training and evaluating models. To fill this critical gap, we introduce PoreML, an open-source framework unifying data generation, model training, and evaluation grounded in pore-scale physics. The framework comprises three core components. (a) A modern GPU-native lattice Boltzmann solver, validated against analytical solutions and published experiments, enables reproducible data generation. (b) A 3.3 TB dataset contains 560 simulation runs and 158,546 stored time steps across four application-driven scenarios. These trajectories span synthetic structures and geometries derived from micro-CT scans of real materials, covering diverse wetting conditions and viscosity ratios. (c) A unified learning framework evaluates one-step prediction and autoregressive rollouts. Its domain-specific evaluation protocols assess predictive accuracy and physical consistency. We evaluate five models of diverse architecture under these protocols. Two complementary challenges assess transfer to larger domains and from synthetic to micro-CT-derived structures. PoreML provides a shared foundation for machine-learning research on multiphase flow in porous media, with the aim of empowering the community to develop reliable predictive models and advance the field.

</details>


### [419] [Thinking in Depth: Retrospective Inference for Tabular Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10317)
*Hao-Run Cai,Si-Yang Liu,Zi-Jian Cheng,Kun-Yang Yu,Jin-Hao Sheng,Guo Yu,Chonghan Liu,Zhi Zhou,Jun-Peng Jiang,Lan-Zhe Guo,Han-Jia Ye*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出Retro表格基础模型，通过回顾式推理显式复用网络中间层信息，克服现有TFM预测细化在深度上分布不均的问题，在多个基准上进入前三并处于Pareto前沿。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有表格基础模型（TFM）多用堆叠Transformer层做上下文预测，反复变换样例表示与比较方式；但作者追踪多个强TFM的单个查询发现，预测细化在深度上分布极不均匀，往往集中在靠后层，说明中间表示未被充分、有效利用，因此需要重新思考中间表示的构建与复用方式。

Method: 提出基于回顾式推理（retrospective inference）的TFM——Retro，使后期阶段能显式地重新访问并重组网络早期产生的中间信息。其围绕两个互补操作组织：(1)回顾哪些中间信息——由Attention Residuals通过自适应重加权不同深度的贡献实现；(2)如何为每个查询塑造所得的上下文更新——由query-conditioned Gated Attention沿表示维度对注意力输出做逐元素调制实现。

Result: 分析表明Retro使预测细化更早发生、在深度上分布更广，不同阶段修订不同查询子集，呈现出多视角细化的模式。在TabArena、TALENT和RelArena上，Retro均进入前三名并位于Pareto前沿。

Conclusion: 直接复用中间表示是更充分利用TFM深度的一种实用途径。

Abstract: Tabular foundation models (TFMs) are pretrained across diverse tabular tasks and make predictions on a new table at inference time using its labeled examples as context. Most recent TFMs perform such in-context prediction with stacked Transformer layers, repeatedly transforming how examples are represented and compared. By tracing individual queries through several strong TFMs, we find that predictive refinement is highly uneven across depth and is often concentrated in later layers. This uneven refinement motivates us to reconsider how intermediate representations are constructed and reused throughout the network. We introduce Retro, a tabular foundation model based on retrospective inference, where later stages can explicitly revisit and recombine intermediate information produced earlier in the network. Retro organizes this process around two complementary operations: which intermediate information to revisit, and how the resulting contextual update should be shaped for each query. Attention Residuals address the former by adaptively reweighting contributions from different depths, while query-conditioned Gated Attention addresses the latter by modulating the attention output element-wise across representation dimensions. Our analysis shows that Retro shifts predictive refinement earlier and more broadly across depth, with different stages revising different subsets of queries in a pattern suggestive of multi-view refinement. Across TabArena, TALENT, and RelArena, Retro ranks among the top three and lies on the Pareto frontier. These results indicate that directly reusing intermediate representations provides a practical way to better exploit depth in TFMs.

</details>


### [420] [HAN-Mamba: Hierarchical Selective State Space Networks for Multi-Scale Financial Volatility Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10323)
*Mihai Bogdan Deaconu,Ioan Daniel Pop*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出HAN-Mamba，将HAN-T中的二次注意力编码器替换为选择性状态空间（Mamba）编码器，仅在跨尺度融合器中保留注意力机制。在Optiver已实现波动率预测基准上，HAN-Mamba以更少参数取得更优RMSPE，并支持更长高频上下文与常数时间流式推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 短期已实现波动率预测需要融合从秒级订单簿动态到周级机制漂移等不同时间分辨率的市场信息。此前的会议工作HAN-T采用分层Transformer，但二次注意力编码器在参数量与计算复杂度上存在瓶颈，难以扩展高频上下文并支持高效流式更新。

Method: 提出HAN-Mamba混合架构：用选择性状态空间（Mamba）编码器替换短、中、长三个尺度流上的二次注意力编码器，仅在三token输入的跨尺度融合器中保留注意力。每个流通过循环状态进行汇总，其输入相关门控匹配波动率的两个结构特性——持续性但衰减的记忆与突变式机制转换。实验采用时间感知五折交叉验证，在Optiver已实现波动率预测基准上评估，并进行消融分析。

Result: HAN-Mamba平均RMSPE为0.1942，优于HAN-T的0.1965，且参数量减少33%。线性时间编码器使高频上下文从60个bucket扩展至240个bucket，误差降至0.1927，而注意力变体在该扩展下已饱和；同时支持推理阶段的常数时间流式更新。消融实验将增益归因于编码器替换，确认分层先验可跨序列模型族迁移，并表明置换不变的注意力融合器仍是跨尺度整合的正确机制。

Conclusion: 以选择性状态空间编码器替代二次注意力编码器，在保留注意力融合器进行跨尺度整合的前提下，可同时提升短期已实现波动率预测精度、降低参数量、扩展高频上下文并实现常数时间流式推理，验证了分层先验与融合机制的通用有效性。

Abstract: Short-horizon realized volatility forecasting requires the integration of market information that evolves at incompatible temporal resolutions, from second-level order book dynamics to weekly regime drift. Our conference work introduced HAN-T, a hierarchical architecture in which scale-specific Transformer encoders process short, mid, and long-horizon streams and a learned attention fuser weighs their contributions. This article replaces the quadratic attention encoders with selective state space (Mamba) encoders while retaining attention only in the fuser, where the input is a three-token set rather than a long sequence. The resulting hybrid, HAN-Mamba, summarizes each stream through a recurrent state whose input-dependent gating matches two structural properties of volatility: persistent but decaying memory and abrupt regime shifts. On the Optiver Realized Volatility Prediction benchmark under time-aware five-fold cross-validation, HAN-Mamba improves mean RMSPE over HAN-T (0.1942 vs. 0.1965) with 33% fewer parameters. Its linear-time encoders further allow the high-frequency context to be extended from 60 to 240 buckets, reducing error to 0.1927 where the attention variant saturates, and support constant-time streaming updates at inference. Ablations attribute the gains to the encoder swap, confirm that the hierarchical prior transfers across sequence-model families, and show that the permutation-invariant attention fuser remains the correct mechanism for cross-scale integration.

</details>


### [421] [Average-Reward Reinforcement Learning for Multichain MDPs: A Hierarchical Decomposition Approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10326)
*Huizhen Yu,Isaiah Heidt*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究平均回报多链MDP的最优策略学习问题，提出了基于异步值迭代的无模型强化学习算法，利用Bather分解将状态空间分层划分为互通子系统与瞬态、将全局问题重构为结构化子问题，并在此基础上发展出近似求解最优性方程的算法以及近似最优偏差函数的算法，三者均具有几乎必然收敛保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 平均回报多链MDP中，最优增益可能依赖初始状态，且不同策略下的常返结构各异，给强化学习带来困难；现有平均回报RL方法多依赖模型知识或需归约为折扣问题，缺乏针对一般多链MDP的通用无模型算法。

Method: 提出异步值迭代式RL算法，仅需MDP的转移图知识，借助Bather分解将状态空间分层划分为互通子系统与瞬态状态，把全局决策问题重构为若干结构化子问题加以求解；并派生出两个扩展算法：其一近似求解多链平均最优性方程以获得近增益最优策略，其二近似最优偏差函数并调用基础算法求解诱导的平均回报多链MDP。

Result: 基础算法可收敛至最优增益并在有限时间内产生增益最优策略；三个算法均具备几乎必然收敛保证；实验比较显示，两个扩展算法相对基础算法能持续改善瞬态性能。

Conclusion: 该工作给出了首批适用于一般多链MDP、且无需归约为折扣问题的本质无模型平均回报强化学习算法，为该类问题提供了完整的分层求解框架与收敛性理论。

Abstract: We study learning optimal policies in average-reward multichain Markov decision processes (MDPs), where the optimal gain may depend on the initial state and recurrence structures vary across policies, creating challenges for reinforcement learning (RL) methods. We propose an asynchronous value-iteration-based RL algorithm that requires no model knowledge beyond the MDP's transition graph and leverages Bather's decomposition to hierarchically partition the state space into communicating subsystems and transient states. This decomposition induces a recasting of the global decision problem into structured subproblems, which our algorithm exploits. We show that the algorithm converges to the optimal gain and produces gain-optimal policies after finite time. Building on this base algorithm, we develop two further algorithms: one approximately solves the multichain average optimality equations to obtain near gain-optimal policies, and another targets near bias-optimality by approximating the optimal bias function and solving an induced average-reward multichain MDP using the base algorithm. We provide almost-sure convergence guarantees for all three algorithms and empirically compare their tradeoffs, showing that the latter two also consistently improve transient performance relative to the base algorithm. To our knowledge, these are the first essentially model-free average-reward RL algorithms for general multichain MDPs without reductions to discounted problems.

</details>


### [422] [AutoAdapt: Automatic Domain Discovery Enables Low-Cost Extensibility](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10349)
*Josh McGiff,Salma Mekaoui,Robert Shanahan,Nikola S. Nikolov*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出AutoAdapt模块化框架，通过自动发现潜在领域并独立并行训练单领域LoRA适配器，在无需全模型重训的情况下达到与混合训练适配器相当的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 指令微调模型部署环境中的领域具有异构且持续演化的特性，但新增领域或数据通常需要昂贵的重训练。因此需要一种无需全模型重训、可模块化扩展新领域的方法。

Method: AutoAdapt包含三个核心组件：（1）自动发现潜在领域；（2）为每个领域独立并行训练Low-Rank Adaptation（LoRA）适配器；（3）进行无参数路由。通过针对性单适配器训练引入新领域与数据，且不修改其他适配器。

Result: 在14个领域特定基准与GPT-4o成对评判中，AutoAdapt达到了与在全部领域上训练的单一LoRA适配器相当的性能；并发现不同独立发现方法间存在专业化效应收敛的证据。

Conclusion: 为每个适配器在其自身领域上训练可从构造上避免领域干扰，从而实现模块化、免分类体系的领域专业化，且不损失聚合性能或需要全模型重训。

Abstract: Instruction-tuned models are deployed into environments where domains are heterogeneous and evolve, yet adding new domains or data typically requires costly retraining. We present AutoAdapt, a modular framework that incorporates new domains and data via targeted single-adapter training without modifying other adapters. The framework automatically discovers latent domains, uses them to train per-domain Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) adapters independently in parallel and performs parameter-free routing. Across 14 domain-specific benchmarks and GPT-4o pairwise judgements, AutoAdapt achieves parity with a LoRA adapter trained on all domains without requiring full-model retraining. We also find evidence of specialisation effect convergence across independent discovery methods. Overall, training each adapter on its own domain prevents domain interference by construction, thus enabling modular, taxonomy-free domain specialisation without aggregate performance loss or full model retraining.

</details>


### [423] [ORDERS: An Empirical Study of Norm-Rank Aggregation for Personalized Federated Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10361)
*Koffka Khan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文分析了ORDERS这一个性化联邦学习配置，指出在充分规范的评测下，服务器加权规则（按更新范数降序的几何权重）带来的收益相对有限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 个性化联邦学习常把共享表示与客户端专属预测器结合，但服务器加权规则的贡献容易被本地训练与评测方式掩盖，因此需要一个配置明确、评测规范的对照研究来分离其真实效果。

Method: 研究ORDERS配置：共享骨干网络+私有残差适配器与分类器、按更新范数降序赋权的几何权重、特征对齐、私有参数扰动。服务器对同一广播模型得到的更新做加权求和，不产生额外的序贯优化效应。评测为80次最终运行（8种配置×2数据集×5个训练种子，每个数据集固定一个划分），并设置统一权重对照、本地微调、训练多数类诊断等对照与消融。

Result: 在每客户端两类CIFAR-10上，ORDERS原生平均客户端准确率为80.51±0.79%，FedPer-R1为79.02±1.42%，匹配的统一权重对照为80.27±0.73%；经共同本地微调后，与FedPer-R1差距缩小至0.32个百分点。在Sent140上ORDERS为74.71±0.49%，仅比事后客户端训练多数类诊断高0.69个百分点。消融对范数排序与对齐仅提供有限且依赖端点的证据，扰动无明确收益。参数负载节省分别为5.47%与0.78%。

Conclusion: 服务器加权规则的实际贡献在被本地训练和评测选择遮蔽时容易被高估：ORDERS相对统一权重对照与简单诊断基线优势微弱，范数排序、对齐与扰动的证据有限。因此评估个性化联邦学习方法需明确配置、采用匹配对照并报告多种子结果。

Abstract: Personalized federated learning combines shared representations with client-specific predictors, but the contribution of a server weighting rule can be obscured by local training and evaluation choices. We study ORDERS, a configuration that combines a shared backbone, a private residual adapter and classifier, geometric weights assigned by descending update norm, feature alignment, and private-parameter perturbations. The server computes a weighted sum of updates obtained from the same broadcast model; it does not obtain an additional optimization effect from sequential addition. A fully specified evaluation comprises 80 final runs: eight configurations, two datasets, and five training seeds on one fixed partition per dataset. On two-class-per-client CIFAR-10, ORDERS achieves $80.51 \pm 0.79\%$ native mean client accuracy, compared with $79.02 \pm 1.42\%$ for FedPer-R1 and $80.27 \pm 0.73\%$ for the matched uniform-weight control. After common local fine-tuning, the difference from FedPer-R1 narrows to 0.32 percentage points. On Sent140, ORDERS reaches $74.71 \pm 0.49\%$, only 0.69 points above a post hoc client training-majority diagnostic. Ablations provide limited, endpoint-dependent evidence for norm ranking and alignment, and no clear benefit from perturbations. Parameter-payload savings are 5.47% and 0.78%, respectively.

</details>


### [424] [Continual Learning without Continual Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10379)
*Nikita Narayanan,Ritham Majumdarr,Sonali Parbhoo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出以“持续推理”替代“持续训练”的PFN框架Latent Concept PFN：元训练后冻结参数，仅通过扩展上下文证据集实现新类别/新域适应，在无任务标识的类增量与域增量学习中取得有竞争力的性能，并获得可解释的潜在概念。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有持续学习方法依赖持续优化，通过正则化、回放或参数扩展防止新更新覆盖旧知识，但参数更新本身是遗忘的根源，且通常需要任务标识、概念词表固定，难以处理噪声或含糊的标注。

Method: 元训练一个PFN（先验拟合网络）模型后将其冻结；在潜在概念空间上进行上下文贝叶斯推理，该空间捕捉跨域与跨类共享的语义结构。新域或新类到来时，将样例加入记忆（上下文证据集），适配体现为潜在概念后验信念的更新而非梯度更新，参数不变。概念标注仅在元训练阶段使用，作为潜在空间的软锚而非固定瓶颈；推理时结合概念标签与原始输入证据，以发现预定义概念集之外的区分性特征，从而应对噪声、歧义与不完整标注。

Result: 在类增量与域增量学习数据集上，方法的持续学习性能具有竞争力，同时学习到可解释的潜在概念；同一方法在无任务标识条件下统一处理两类增量学习场景。

Conclusion: 以持续推理取代持续优化可显著降低遗忘：冻结参数、仅扩展上下文证据使适配转为后验更新。软概念锚与原始证据结合突破了固定概念词表的限制，并统一了域增量与类增量学习。

Abstract: Continual learning requires models to adapt to new domains and new classes while retaining prior knowledge. Many existing methods rely on continued optimization, using regularization, replay, or parameter expansion to prevent new updates from overwriting previously learned knowledge. Instead, we propose replacing continual training with continual inference: a PFN-based model that is meta-trained, and then frozen, adapting to new classes only by extending an in-context evidence set. Our model, Latent Concept PFN, performs in-context Bayesian inference over a latent concept space that captures semantic structure shared across domains and classes. As each new domain or class arrives, exemplars are added to the memory; adaptation reflects updated posterior beliefs over latent concepts rather than gradient updates. No parameters are changed, reducing forgetting. The same method handles both domain and class incremental continual learning without task identity. Concept annotations are only used during meta-training, acting as a soft anchor on the latent space rather than a fixed bottleneck. Unlike fixed-vocabulary concept methods, the model also handles noisy, ambiguous, or incomplete annotations by combining concept labels with raw input evidence to discover distinctions beyond the predefined concept set. Experiments on class and domain incremental learning datasets demonstrate competitive continual learning performance while learning interpretable latent concepts.

</details>


### [425] [ResidualQuant: KV Cache Quantization for Looped Transformers with 2-Bit Residuals](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10381)
*Heejun Kim,Junyoung Lee,SangLyul Cho,Dongsu Han,Insu Han,Sehoon Kim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 ResidualQuant，一种针对循环 Transformer 的 KV cache 量化方法。利用跨循环 KV 状态高度相似的特点，以最后一轮 KV 为参考、对剩余循环以低精度残差表示，并结合最小二乘缩放、旋转与循环级混合精度，实现低至 INT2 的量化。在多个模型与推理/代码任务上，精度-显存权衡优于现有旋转式量化，KV 存储理论降低 80.7%，解码吞吐最高提升 4.15 倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 循环 Transformer 通过复用共享块多次循环来提升参数效率、增加计算深度，但 KV cache 显存随循环数线性增长，成为限制批大小与推理吞吐的关键瓶颈。现有 KV 量化方法在激进低精度下精度损失严重，需要一种针对循环结构的专用量化方案。

Method: 观察到跨循环的 KV 状态高度相似，故以最后一轮的 KV 状态作为参考，其余循环仅存储低精度残差（ResidualQuant）。进一步对残差施加最小二乘缩放与旋转以降低量化误差，并采用循环级混合精度，在保证高效重建的同时支持低至 INT2 的量化。

Result: 在多个循环 Transformer 模型及数学推理、代码生成基准上，ResidualQuant 的精度-显存权衡持续优于最先进的旋转式 KV 量化：混合精度下精度接近 BF16，KV 存储理论减少 80.7%，同显存预算下精度比旋转基线高最多 13.0%；RTX 5090 上固定批解码吞吐最高提升 2.73 倍，显存占用降低支持最多 2 倍更大批，峰值吞吐提升最多 4.15 倍。

Conclusion: 跨循环 KV 相似性为循环 Transformer 的低精度 KV 量化提供了有效切入点；ResidualQuant 在显著压缩 KV 存储的同时保持接近 BF16 的精度，并大幅提升解码吞吐，为循环结构模型的高效推理提供了实用方案。

Abstract: Looped Transformers improve parameter efficiency by repeatedly applying shared Transformer blocks over multiple recurrent loops, increasing computational depth without increasing the parameter count. However, KV cache memory still scales with the number of loops, becoming a key memory bottleneck that limits batch size and inference throughput. KV cache quantization can alleviate this bottleneck, but existing methods often suffer substantial accuracy degradation at aggressive low-precision regimes. We observe that looped Transformers offer a unique opportunity: KV states across loops are highly similar. Based on this observation, we propose ResidualQuant, which uses the final-loop KV states as a reference and represents the remaining loops with low-precision residuals. Our method further combines least-square scaling and rotations applied to the residuals, as well as loop-wise mixed precision, to enable accurate quantization down to INT2 while retaining efficient reconstruction. Across multiple looped Transformer models and mathematical reasoning and code generation benchmarks, ResidualQuant consistently improves the accuracy-memory tradeoff over state-of-the-art rotation-based KV quantization. In particular, our method retains accuracy close to BF16 under mixed-precision settings while reducing theoretical KV storage by 80.7%, achieving up to 13.0% higher accuracy than the rotation-based baseline at the same memory budget. On an RTX 5090, the reduced KV memory traffic improves fixed-batch decode throughput by up to 2.73x, while the smaller memory footprint enables up to 2x larger batches, improving peak throughput by up to 4.15x.
