</details>


### [426] [Boosting and the Expressive Power of Simple Weak Learners via the $γ$-VC Dimension](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10383)
*Arthur da Cunha,Kasper Green Larsen,Liang-Yu Zou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过 γ-VC 维研究 Boosting 弱到强学习的样本复杂度刻画，并给出若干概念类的 γ-VC 维上下界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Boosting 能将仅略优于随机的弱假设转化为高精度预测器，但其表达能力受基类结构影响很大，需要合适的复杂度度量来刻画这种依赖关系。

Method: 基于 Alon 等（STOC 2021）提出的 γ-VC 维：证明确该参数在 γ 的常数因子范围内刻画弱到强学习的样本复杂度；加强经典 VC 维与 γ-VC 维之间的一般关系；对决策树桩（decision stumps）和 R^d 中的轴平行矩形这两类基本概念类推导改进的 γ-VC 维上界与下界。

Result: γ-VC 维可在常数因子意义下刻画弱到强学习的样本复杂度；得到经典 VC 维与 γ-VC 维关系的更紧刻画；对决策树桩和轴平行矩形给出改进的 γ-VC 维上下界。

Conclusion: γ-VC 维是刻画 Boosting 表达能力与样本复杂度的有效参数，本文结果深化了其与经典 VC 维的联系，并为基本几何概念类提供了更精确的界限。

Abstract: Boosting converts weak hypotheses with a small edge over random guessing into highly accurate predictors, but the expressive power of the resulting classifier can depend strongly on the structure of the base class. We study this phenomenon through the $γ$-VC dimension introduced by Alon et al. (STOC 2021). Our first result shows that this parameter characterizes the sample complexity for weak-to-strong learning up to a constant factor scaling in $γ$. We then sharpen the general relationship between the classic VC dimension and the $γ$-VC dimension. Finally, we also give improved upper and lower bounds on the $γ$-VC dimension for the fundamental concept classes of decision stumps and axis-parallel rectangles in $\mathbb{R}^d$.

</details>


### [427] [OrBIT: Structure-Guided Embedding Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10385)
*Yunied Puig,Amit Kumar Jaiswal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出OrBIT嵌入表压缩框架，从轨道动力学中学习可复用局部几何以约束共享码字，实现高效压缩。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代语言模型的嵌入表体积极大，现有压缩方法（坐标块、低秩子空间、无约束码本）均固定编码几何，仅在给定几何下优化，未探索编码几何本身是否可被学习发现。

Method: OrBIT以结构引导方式从轨道动力学学习可复用局部几何，用以约束一小组共享码字；全局重建残差决定固定编码预算的分配，冗余重叠图卡使局部误差在拼接后相互补偿；最终轨道机制被编译消除，仅保留紧凑解码器。

Result: 在四个LLM嵌入表上，相对16位存储，GPT-2实现37.9倍压缩，每个7B表超过23倍，且在率失真性能上与主流量化及低秩基线具竞争力。

Conclusion: 编码几何可被学习发现，所学结构可决定存储内容、容量分配及局部信息的全局组装方式，验证了结构引导嵌入压缩的有效性。

Abstract: Embedding tables are among the largest components of modern language models. Most compression methods fix a coding geometry such as coordinate blocks, low-rank subspaces, or unrestricted codebooks, and optimize within it. We instead ask whether the coding geometry can itself be discovered. We introduce \emph{OrBIT}, a structure-guided embedding compression framework that learns reusable local geometry from orbit dynamics and uses it to constrain a small set of shared codewords. The global reconstruction residual then decides where the fixed coding budget is spent, while redundant overlapping charts let local errors compensate one another after gluing. Our theory shows how tight-chart geometry controls distortion, how the global residual directs sequential allocation, and how data-geometry-guided refinement improves the codec. The resulting orbit machinery is compiled away, leaving a compact decoder in which the learned structure governs what is stored, where capacity is allocated, and how local information is assembled globally. Across four LLM embedding tables, OrBIT achieves $37.9\times$ compression on GPT-2 and over $23\times$ on each 7B table relative to 16-bit storage, while delivering competitive rate-distortion performance against established quantization and low-rank baselines.

</details>


### [428] [Kernel Autoresearch for Open-Ended Model Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10394)
*Richard Cornelius Suwandi,Feng Yin,Kevin Murphy*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 Kernaut（Kernel Autoresearch），将核函数设计视为开放式模型发现：由编码智能体编写核程序，用构造契约保证有效性，配合质量-多样性存档与新颖性筛选进行搜索，发现的核具有可复用归纳偏置并能泛化到未见任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 核函数编码了众多机器学习模型的归纳偏置，但自动化核设计存在根本两难：固定基核与算子的语法能保证有效性，却将搜索限制在这些构件可表达的结构内；不受限制的程序虽突破表达限制，却无法保证有效性。作者的压力测试显示，通过随机输入数值检验的 LLM 生成核中，有 22%–58% 在不同尺度或维度下评估时失效。因此需要一种既能开放式探索又能保证核有效性的方法。

Method: 提出 Kernel Autoresearch（Kernaut），将核设计视为开放式模型发现：编码智能体以程序形式编写核，构造契约（construction contracts）确保每个被接受的核都有效；质量-多样性存档保留行为各异的高性能核；新颖性筛选引导智能体走向功能上全新的候选。

Result: 发现的核编码了可复用的归纳偏置并泛化到未见任务。在与训练同批次（episodes）的留出黑箱优化族上，发现的核优于元学习的深度核；由十条酶动力学速率定律发现的核在五个未见机制上误差低于调优的 ARD 与深度核基线。此外，发现的核是可解释程序，可被研究者改进：人工改进版本进一步将留出预测误差降低 5.7%、优化遗憾降低 7.8%。

Conclusion: Kernaut 通过契约约束与智能体开放式搜索的结合，兼顾核有效性与表达自由度，发现可泛化、可解释且可被人类进一步精炼的核，验证了以开放式模型发现方式进行自动核设计的可行性。

Abstract: Kernels encode the inductive bias of a wide range of machine learning models, yet automated kernel design faces a fundamental dilemma. A fixed grammar of base kernels and operators guarantees validity but limits the search to structures expressible by those building blocks. Conversely, unrestricted programs remove this limitation but no longer guarantee validity. In our stress tests, 22-58% of LLM-generated kernels that pass numerical checks on random inputs fail when evaluated at different scales or dimensions. We propose Kernel Autoresearch (Kernaut), which treats kernel design as open-ended model discovery. Coding agents write kernels as programs, while construction contracts ensure that every accepted kernel is valid. A quality-diversity archive retains high-performing kernels with distinct behaviors, and novelty screening steers agents toward functionally new candidates. Our experiments demonstrate that the discovered kernels encode reusable inductive biases that generalize to unseen tasks. On held-out black-box optimization families, a discovered kernel outperforms a meta-learned deep kernel trained on the same episodes. Furthermore, kernels discovered from ten enzyme-kinetic rate laws achieve lower error than tuned ARD and deep kernel baselines on five unseen mechanisms. The discovered kernels are also interpretable programs that human researchers can refine: a human-refined version of one further reduces the held-out predictive error by 5.7% and optimization regret by 7.8%.

</details>


### [429] [Executing Causal Structure Learning with Linear-Attention Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10395)
*Amartya Roy,Sayar Karmakar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了Transformer能否精确执行因果发现算法。作者针对一种带无环约束、迭代更新候选因果图的连续优化方法，显式构造固定权重Transformer，使单次前向传播精确复现一步更新，从而由堆叠模块复现完整优化轨迹。实验表明该构造块与参考更新在浮点精度上一致，并在合成数据和7个公开基准网络拓扑上延续参考求解器的成败，同时指出普通注意力模型难以可靠执行该更新。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 既有工作表明Transformer可对输入数据执行算法，但能否将其用于因果发现尚不明确。本文旨在探究Transformer是否可精确执行连续型因果发现优化过程，并区分“精确执行算法”与“准确恢复因果结构”这两类能力。

Method: 研究一种标准连续方法：反复更新候选因果图并施加无环性约束。作者显式构造固定权重的Transformer，使其单次前向传播精确对应该方法的一次更新，重复模块即可复现优化轨迹；Transformer在更新间携带当前图与算法的乘子。作者证明保留乘子对精确执行是必要的，因为不同乘子值会导致不同的下一次更新；并给出条件，使固定阶段内达到目标精度所需更新次数可预先计算，且随深度增长舍入误差保持有界。

Result: 构造块与参考更新在浮点精度上一致；在合成数据及7个已发表基准网络拓扑上的算术重放继承了参考求解器的成功与失败。普通注意力模型在给定训练预算下无法可靠执行该更新，也难以迁移到更大图。

Conclusion: 该工作将精确的算法执行与准确的因果恢复区分开来。梯度训练能否在该构造所属架构类中学习到执行器，仍为开放问题。

Abstract: Transformers can execute algorithms on data given in their input. We ask whether they can do the same for causal discovery. We study a standard continuous method that repeatedly updates a candidate causal graph while enforcing acyclicity. We explicitly construct a fixed-weight transformer whose forward pass exactly reproduces one update of this method, so repeated blocks reproduce its optimization trajectory. The transformer carries the current graph and the algorithm's multiplier between updates. We show that retaining the multiplier is essential for exact execution, since different multiplier values can lead to different next updates. We also give conditions under which, within a fixed stage, the number of updates needed to reach a target accuracy can be computed in advance and rounding errors stay bounded as depth grows. Experiments show that the constructed block agrees with a reference update to floating-point precision, while arithmetic replay on synthetic data and seven published benchmark network topologies inherits the reference solver's successes and failures. This separates accurate algorithm execution from accurate causal recovery. In contrast, the ordinary attention models tested under our training budgets do not reliably execute the update or transfer to larger graphs. Whether gradient training can learn an executor in the architecture class of the construction remains open.

</details>


### [430] [Cross-Domain Pretraining for Steady-State Neural CFD Surrogates](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10398)
*Anthony Zhou,Amir Barati Farimani,Shirley Ho,Rudy Morel*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究跨几何、边界条件和精度的跨域预训练对CFD神经代理模型的泛化能力影响，发现跨域预训练显著提升零样本/少样本性能，且效益随模型规模和预训练数据多样性增加。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CFD神经代理模型虽能加速仿真，但主要局限在于难以泛化到训练集之外的几何形状和应用场景；传统做法需为新场景重新生成数据集并运行昂贵的数值求解器，成本高昂。因此作者希望探索跨域预训练是否能缓解这一问题。

Method: 作者在跨不同几何、边界条件和精度（fidelity）的数据上训练神经代理模型，比较跨域预训练、从头训练（from scratch）以及从域内专家模型迁移三种策略的零样本和少样本性能，并分析跨域预训练有效的原因，包括简单池化稳态数据集的效果。

Result: 跨域预训练相比从头训练和域内专家迁移，均提升了在留出数据集上的零样本和少样本性能。微调预训练的跨域模型在相同样本量下误差降低2-3倍，达到相同误差所需样本量减少8倍。该收益与架构无关，并随模型规模和预训练数据多样性增加而提升。此外，简单池化稳态数据集即足够且有效。

Conclusion: 鉴于CFD数据生成成本高昂，通过跨域预训练利用现有数据集将是未来神经代理模型拓展到新问题和新用例时的重要策略。

Abstract: Neural surrogates for computational fluid dynamics (CFD) have the potential to greatly enhance engineering innovation through accelerating simulation. However, the primary limitation for neural surrogates is the lack of generalization to geometries and applications beyond the training set, which is significant given the diversity of engineering scenarios. Currently, this is addressed by generating a new dataset for a specific application; however, this requires running costly numerical solvers. In this work, we take a step toward addressing this by studying neural surrogates trained across different geometries, boundary conditions, and fidelities. We find that cross-domain pretraining improves zero- and few-shot performance on held-out datasets relative to both training from scratch and transferring from domain-specific experts. In particular, finetuning a pretrained, cross-domain model can achieve 2-3x lower errors at the same sample size and use 8x fewer samples to achieve the same error, compared to training from scratch. This benefit is architecture agnostic and improves with model size and pretraining dataset diversity. Furthermore, we study how and why cross-domain pretraining works in CFD surrogates, and find that simply pooling steady-state datasets is both sufficient and effective. Given the high cost of generating CFD data, leveraging existing datasets through cross-domain pretraining will likely be a valuable strategy as future surrogates expand to tackle new problems and use cases.

</details>


### [431] [Seq-Flow: Efficient Probabilistic Forecasting with Self-Rollout Error Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10440)
*Yinan Huang,Shitij Govil,Bo Dai,Pan Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Seq-Flow条件流模型，将上一次预测分布通过ODE传输到更新后的分布，实现少步采样下的高质量序列预测更新，并配合self-rollout训练缓解误差累积。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 科学预测任务需在获得新观测时不断更新未来轨迹分布。传统扩散/流模型每次从高斯噪声生成，采样步数多；warm-start方法虽复用旧预测降低开销，但模型未针对"预测更新"本身训练，少步采样下质量受损。

Method: Seq-Flow是由ODE驱动的条件流模型，将样本从上一时刻预测分布传输到更新后分布。由于相邻预测差异较小，传输起点具有信息量，故少量流评估即可生成准确更新。针对递归复用导致的误差累积，采用self-rollout训练：由模型的滑动平均副本生成预测作为后续训练的初始状态。与self-forcing（复用输出作条件上下文）不同，Seq-Flow将生成输出复用为下一次流的源分布。

Result: 在粒子加速器束流溢出预测中，少NFE采样预算下CRPS降低65%；在流体动力学预测任务上与强基线相当。仅用至多4次更新的self-rollout训练，Seq-Flow在超过400次连续更新中仍保持准确。

Conclusion: 以递归流传输为核心、配合self-rollout训练，Seq-Flow在少步采样下实现高效且长期稳定的预测更新，兼顾精度与计算效率。

Abstract: Many scientific forecasting tasks require updating a distribution over future trajectories as new observations arrive. Conventional diffusion and flow models generate each forecast from Gaussian noise, often at the cost of many sampling steps. Warm-start methods reuse earlier predictions to reduce this cost, but their models are not trained to perform the forecast update itself, which can compromise quality under few-step sampling. In this work, we introduce Seq-Flow, a conditional flow model whose ODE transports samples from the previous forecast distribution to the updated one. Because successive forecasts often differ only modestly, this transport starts from an informative distribution and can produce accurate updates with few flow evaluations. Recursive reuse also creates a challenge: errors in one forecast become errors in the initial states of subsequent flows. We address this with self-rollout training, in which a moving average copy of the model generates forecasts that initialize later training updates. Unlike self-forcing methods, which reuse generated outputs as conditioning context, Seq-Flow reuses them as the source of the next flow. Experiments On particle-accelerator beam spill forecasting show Seq-Flow reduces CRPS by 65% under a few-NFE sampling budget, while remaining competitive with strong baselines on fluid-dynamics forecasting tasks. Although trained on self-rollouts of at most four updates, Seq-Flow remains accurate over more than 400 consecutive updates. Our code is available at https://github.com/Graph-COM/Seq-Flow.

</details>


### [432] [NeuralBES: A Differentiable, Control-Aware Emulator for Scalable Building Energy Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10459)
*Ting-Yu Dai,Takuya Kurihana,Wing Yee Au,Hon Yung Wong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: NeuralBES 通过共享神经编码器将建筑元数据映射为物理有界的 RC 参数，结合对数空间并行扫描与预测-校正环路，构建可微分建筑能耗仿真器，在保持物理有效性的同时兼顾精度与效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 需求侧灵活性（预测、转移、削减住宅负荷）依赖可跨数百万异构建筑可信赖的热模型。现有工具存在硬性权衡：EnergyPlus 等高保真物理仿真器准确但串行且需逐建筑标定；纯数据驱动序列模型可扩展却抛弃了使预测可信的物理结构。论文旨在解决这一权衡。

Method: 提出 NeuralBES，一种可微分仿真器：用共享神经编码器参数化 RC 热模型，将静态建筑元数据（面积、建造年代、HVAC 类型等）映射为物理有界的电容、电导和设备系数；这些系数构成标量线性递推，通过对数空间并行扫描求解；预测-校正环路处理恒温器-温度非线性，同时保持全时域梯度流。

Result: 在 ResStock 数据集三个气候区上训练，NeuralBES 用单一编码器处理异构建筑原型、年代与气候区。年度全年 rollout 中，它是唯一既物理有效、又在最强原始误差基线 4 个 MAPE 点以内的数据条件模型，参数量比 transformer 和循环基线少约一个数量级；在参数对等的物理有效基线中，其 MAPE 比灰箱 RC 替代方案降低一半以上。黑箱基线产生统计上合理但物理不一致的轨迹。

Conclusion: NeuralBES 证明可微分的物理结构化学习可在单一模型中统一异构建筑仿真，在精度、物理有效性与参数效率上同时优于现有基线，为需求侧灵活性提供可扩展且可信赖的仿真工具。

Abstract: Demand-side flexibility i.e. forecasting, shifting, and curtailing residential energy loads, depends on thermal models trusted across millions of heterogeneous buildings. Existing tools force a hard tradeoff: high-fidelity physics simulators such as EnergyPlus are accurate but sequential and require per-building calibration, while purely data-driven sequence models scale but abandon the physical structure that makes their predictions trustworthy.
  We introduce NeuralBES (Building Energy Simulation), a differentiable emulator that resolves this tradeoff by parameterizing a resistance--capacitance (RC) based thermal model with a shared neural encoder: static building metadata such as floor area, vintage, and HVAC type is mapped to physically bounded capacitances, conductances, and equipment coefficients, which become the coefficients of a scalar linear recurrence solved via a log-space parallel scan, and a predictor--corrector loop closes the thermostat--temperature nonlinearity while preserving full-horizon gradient flow. Trained on the ResStock dataset across three climate zones, NeuralBES handles heterogeneous building archetypes, vintages, and climate zones within a single trained encoder, while black-box baselines produce statistically plausible but physically inconsistent trajectories. On the annual full-year rollout, NeuralBES is the only data-conditioned model that is simultaneously physics-valid and accurate to within 4 MAPE points of the strongest raw-error baseline, while operating at roughly an order of magnitude fewer parameters than the transformer and recurrent baselines; among physics-valid baselines at parameter parity it more than halves the MAPE of the grey-box RC alternative.

</details>


### [433] [Distilling Graph Geometry: Knowledge Gap from GNNs to MLPs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10520)
*Zhewei Chen,Hao Zhu,Jiaojiao Jiang,Ahad N. Zehmakan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 G^2MLP，一种基于 Ollivier-Ricci 曲率的图几何感知蒸馏框架，解决 GNN-to-MLP 蒸馏中学生表示空间的光谱欠拟合与过拟合两类失效模式，推理时无需图结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 GNN-to-MLP 蒸馏方法主要迁移节点级预测或使用基于置信度的重加权，但未明确学生应在何处保留教师由图结构诱导的几何信息。该缺失导致学生表示空间出现两类光谱失效：稀疏图上光谱欠拟合（遗漏边界区域附近的高能教师方向），稠密图上光谱过拟合（保留教师经聚合已坍缩的伪方向）。

Method: 以能量加权的师生对齐目标为动机，提出 Graph Geometry-aware MLP（G^2MLP）。该方法在训练阶段由 Ollivier-Ricci 曲率引导，利用曲率定位两类光谱误差的集中区域，从而在预测级对齐与表示级对齐之间分配监督强度。部署模型仍为标准 MLP，推理阶段不访问图结构。

Result: 在节点分类基准上，G^2MLP 持续优于无图蒸馏基线；在稀疏与稠密两种情形下均缩小了师生表示秩差距；并可无需架构修改迁移至 Graph Transformer 教师与链接预测任务。

Conclusion: 显式刻画并保留教师图诱导的几何结构是提升无图蒸馏的关键；曲率作为几何先验可有效指导监督分配，且方法具备良好的通用性与部署友好性。

Abstract: GNN-to-MLP distillation aims to retain the predictive accuracy of a message-passing teacher while deploying a graph-free MLP at inference. Existing methods mainly transfer node-wise predictions or use confidence-based reweighting, but they do not specify where the student should preserve the teacher's graph-induced geometry. We show that this omission leads to two spectral failure modes in the student's representation space. On sparse graphs, the student suffers from spectral underfit, missing high-energy teacher directions concentrated near boundary regions. On dense graphs, it suffers from spectral overfit, retaining spurious directions that the teacher has collapsed through aggregation. Motivated by an energy-weighted teacher-student alignment objective, we propose Graph Geometry-aware MLP (G^2MLP), a training-time distillation framework guided by Ollivier-Ricci curvature. Curvature identifies where the two spectral errors concentrate and is used to allocate supervision between prediction-level and representation-level alignment. The deployed model remains a standard MLP and requires no graph access at inference. Across node-classification benchmarks, G^2MLP consistently improves over graph-free distillation baselines, reduces the teacher-student rank gap in both regimes, and transfers without architectural changes to Graph Transformer teachers and link prediction.

</details>


<div id='cs.RO'></div>

# cs.RO [[Back]](#toc)

### [434] [A Review Of Robotic World Models For Dynamic Environments Based On Factor And Scene Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08800)
*Marco Giberna,Miguel Fernandez-Cortizas,Jose Luis Sanchez Lopez,Holger Voos*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该综述系统梳理了面向动态环境的图结构机器人世界模型（因子图、场景图及混合模型），从表示、构建更新管线、下游任务三方面总结方法、分类架构模式，并指出新兴趋势与开放挑战。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人世界模型中，因子图提供不确定性感知的几何估计，场景图提供结构化语义抽象，但早期模型多假设静态环境。真实机器人环境常具动态性，纯静态表示面临严峻挑战，因此需系统综述如何在图结构世界模型中处理动态性。

Method: 综述组织围绕三大维度：(I) 合适的表示；(II) 表示构建与更新的管线；(III) 面向下游任务的利用。回顾基于因子图或场景图的方法，特别强调将两者结合为混合模型的新方法，分析可建模的动态类型并归类常见架构模式。

Result: 给出了动态图结构世界模型的综合视图，整理了不同动态类型的建模方式，归纳了混合模型的常见架构模式，并明确了若干新兴趋势与开放问题。

Conclusion: 开放挑战包括：学习感知到表示层的不确定性传播、最小传感条件下动态实体运动与尺度的可观性、可扩展的终身维护，以及缺乏将世界模型质量与动态下游任务性能挂钩的数据集与评测协议。

Abstract: Models based on graphs have emerged in robotics as a powerful foundation for internal world representations, where factor and scene graphs are among the most prominent model types found in the related literature and in successful robotic solutions. Initially, many of these models were assuming static environments as a simplification. Herein, factor graphs mainly provide uncertainty-aware geometric estimations while scene graphs enable a structured semantic abstraction. However, real-world robotic environments are often dynamic, posing severe challenges for purely static world representations. Therefore, this review presents a comprehensive view on how dynamic aspects of real-world environments can be addressed in such graph-based world models. We organize our assessments around three main aspects: (I) suitable representations, (II) pipelines to construct and update the representations, and (III) their exploitation for downstream tasks. We review approaches that are either based on factor or scene graphs, but put special emphasis on novel approaches that combine both types to form hybrid models. We mainly analyze how different types of dynamics can be modeled herein, and categorize common architectural patterns. Finally, emerging trends and open challenges are identified, including uncertainty propagation from learned perception through the representation layers, the observability of dynamic-entity motion and scale under minimal sensing, scalable lifelong maintenance, and the lack of datasets and evaluation protocols that ground world-model quality in downstream task performance under dynamics.

</details>


### [435] [CIRRA: Dual-Level Continual Instruction Reconciliation with Ongoing Execution for Embodied Robot Agents in Interactive Household Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08862)
*Ci Zhang,Enfu Nan,Arman Akbari,Lin Zhao,Li Wang,Chen Wang,Weiwei Chen,Yanzhi Wang,Geng Yuan*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文提出持续指令协调（CIRRA）框架，通过LLM语义推理与规则约束的结构化整合，在不破坏正在执行任务序列的前提下融入新指令，并发布CHIRP基准验证其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 家庭机器人在执行任务时需接纳新指令。现有智能体常重生成或大幅修改剩余任务序列，导致计划歧义、逻辑不一致与冗余执行。

Method: CIRRA为双层框架：先将新指令落地为唯一可执行技能，并补全未明确动作与执行位置；再将正在进行的子任务序列保留为执行主干，把新子任务插入位置匹配的片段生成候选方案；语义推理器仅评估被修改片段以识别依赖与冲突，选出逻辑最连贯的局部整合方案。

Result: 在CHIRP基准（120个episode，8个家庭环境，6类日常活动）上，CIRRA决策一致率达74.2%，超过最强重规划基线30个百分点；每次正确的融合决策都产生位置正确、无冲突的调度。在Unitree G1人形机器人上，CIRRA每次试验都在正确时刻中断正在执行的技能，且在所有指标上显著优于基线。

Conclusion: 结构保持式整合可维持与正在执行任务的对齐，缓解歧义与不一致，并通过复用共享子任务减少冗余执行。

Abstract: Household robots must accommodate new user instructions while executing ongoing tasks. Existing agents often regenerate or extensively revise the remaining task sequence, introducing plan ambiguity, logical inconsistency, and redundant execution. We formulate continual instruction reconciliation and propose CIRRA (Continual Instruction Reconciliation for Robot Agents), a dual-level framework combining LLM-based semantic reasoning with rule-constrained structural integration. CIRRA first grounds incoming instructions to unique executable skills and resolves underspecified actions and execution locations. It then preserves the ongoing subtask sequence as an execution backbone and generates integration candidates by inserting incoming subtasks into location-matched segments. The semantic reasoner evaluates only modified segments to identify dependencies and conflicts and select the most logically coherent local integration. This structure-preserving process maintains alignment with ongoing execution, mitigates ambiguity and inconsistency, and reuses shared subtasks to reduce redundant execution. We also introduce CHIRP (Continual Household Instruction Reconciliation and Planning), a text-based benchmark of 120 episodes across eight household environments and six categories of everyday activities. On CHIRP, CIRRA achieves 74.2% decision agreement, exceeding the strongest replanning baseline by 30 percentage points; every correct fusion decision yields a correctly placed, conflict-free schedule. On a Unitree G1 humanoid, CIRRA interrupts ongoing skills at the correct moment in every trial and significantly outperforms all baselines on every metric.

</details>


### [436] [Do Better Visual Representations Always Lead to Better End-to-End Autonomous Driving?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09695)
*Zihao Zhang,Haochen Tian,Tianyu Li,Changhui Jing,Jingliang He,Naisheng Ye,Ziyuan Pu,Zhenjie Yang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出规划器无关的视觉表征对齐框架ViRA，系统研究VFM表征何时能提升端到端自动驾驶性能，并据此开发ViRA-Diffusion规划器，在NAVSIM v2上达到92.3 EPDMS。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉基础模型（VFM）凭借强大表征能力被越来越多地集成到端到端自动驾驶中，但其表征究竟在何种条件下能真正提升驾驶性能尚不明确，缺乏系统性研究。

Method: 提出ViRA（规划器无关的视觉表征对齐框架），在不改变规划器架构与推理成本的前提下进行对齐实验。基于三项发现（VFM引导表征一致提升性能；VFM目标选择影响性能且跨VFM对齐可带来额外收益；辅助感知监督降低对目标选择的敏感度），设计ViRA-Diffusion——一种无辅助感知监督训练的扩散式规划器。

Result: VFM引导表征在多种端到端规划器上均带来一致性能提升，并延伸至零样本闭环评测；辅助感知监督可将五个目标间的EPDMS差异从2.7分收窄至0.5分；ViRA-Diffusion在NAVSIM v2 navtest上取得92.3 EPDMS，比对比方法至少高出1.9分。

Conclusion: 将VFM集成到端到端自动驾驶时，需联合考虑VFM目标选择与规划器监督方式；相关结果与演示已开源。

Abstract: Visual foundation models (VFMs) are increasingly integrated into end-to-end autonomous driving for their powerful representations, yet it remains unclear when these representations improve driving performance. To investigate this question, we introduce ViRA, a planner-agnostic visual representation alignment framework that keeps the planner architecture and inference cost unchanged. Our study reveals three findings: (1) VFM-guided visual representations consistently improve driving performance across diverse end-to-end planners, with gains extending to zero-shot closed-loop evaluation. (2) The choice of VFM target matters for planning performance, and alignment to a different VFM can further benefit planners with pre-trained VFM encoders. (3) Auxiliary perception supervision reduces sensitivity to VFM target selection, narrowing the EPDMS spread across five targets from 2.7 to 0.5 points and potentially compensating for less effective VFM targets. Guided by these findings, we develop ViRA-Diffusion, a diffusion-based planner trained without auxiliary perception supervision, which achieves 92.3 EPDMS on NAVSIM v2 navtest, outperforming recent methods in our comparison by at least 1.9 points. The results motivate jointly considering target selection and planner supervision when integrating VFMs into end-to-end autonomous driving. The results and demo are available at https://github.com/OpenDriveLab/ViRA.

</details>


### [437] [YUBI-STAG: Contact and Semantic-Rich Alignment for VLAs via Automated Video-Language Grounding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09718)
*Masatoshi Tateno,Takehiko Ohkawa,Yueh-Hua Wu,Hanlong Li,Tatsuya Matsushima,Yoichi Sato,Kei Ota*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出 YUBI-STAG 框架，通过接触物体分割与视觉语言模型自动为操作演示补充细粒度交互语义标注（物体身份、属性、状态、单手动作、双臂协调、空间接地交互），并蒸馏为 YUBI-VLM 以从原始未分割视频中高效恢复动作结构与标注。在 YUBI-STAG-Bench 上验证后，用这些标注对 VLA 策略进行后训练，显著提升了细粒度语言对齐与指令跟随能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 VLA 模型虽经大规模预训练具备广泛操作能力，但通过语言调用这些能力需要指令与物理交互之间的细粒度对齐；然而现有机器人演示通常只提供粗粒度任务描述，缺失动作执行细节（哪只夹爪动作、接触哪个物体、如何抓取与移动），导致语言与操作语义对齐不足。

Method: 提出 YUBI-STAG（时空标注与接地方案），结合接触物体分割与视觉语言模型，自动标注物体身份、属性与状态、各夹爪动作、双臂协调及空间接地的交互；为降低其对局部序列与多阶段 VLM 推理的依赖，将其蒸馏为 YUBI-VLM，直接从原始未分割视频中、以少量推理调用恢复动作结构与标注，且仅依赖腕部视角。

Result: 在 YUBI-STAG-Bench 的时间、语义与空间接地任务上评估：YUBI-VLM 以更少推理调用与更短运行时间保留了 YUBI-STAG 大部分标注精度，并能泛化到未见过的操作；用这些标注后训练 VLA 策略后，模型与细粒度语言及接触感知结构对齐，双臂实验中性能与指令跟随均有提升，包括对物体身份、动作夹爪、目标位置及原始标签中缺失的空间关系的控制。

Conclusion: 自动化、交互丰富的时空语义标注可有效弥合预训练 VLA 与细粒度操作语言之间的差距；蒸馏得到的 YUBI-VLM 在效率与泛化上具优势，且基于该标注的后训练能赋予策略超越原始标签的细粒度控制能力。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models acquire broad manipulation capabilities via large-scale pretraining, yet eliciting them through language requires fine-grained alignment between instructions and physical interactions. Existing robot demonstrations typically provide only coarse task descriptions, omitting how actions are executed, including which gripper acts, which object is contacted, and how it is grasped and moved. We introduce YUBI-STAG, a framework for Spatio-Temporal Annotation and Grounding that automatically enriches manipulation demonstrations with interaction-rich semantics to align pretrained VLAs with fine-grained manipulation language. Combining contact-object segmentation with vision-language models, YUBI-STAG annotates object identities, attributes and states, per-gripper actions, bimanual coordination, and spatially grounded interactions. To address YUBI-STAG's reliance on localized sequences and multi-stage VLM inference, we distill it into YUBI-VLM. YUBI-VLM directly recovers action structure and annotations from raw, unsegmented video in few inference calls and operates from wrist views alone. We evaluate both frameworks on YUBI-STAG-Bench across temporal, semantic, and spatial grounding tasks. YUBI-VLM retains much of YUBI-STAG's annotation accuracy with fewer inference calls and shorter runtime while generalizing to unseen manipulations. Finally, post-training VLA policies on these annotations aligns them with fine-grained language and contact-aware structure. Bimanual experiments demonstrate improved performance and instruction following, including control over object identity, acting gripper, target location, and spatial relations absent from original labels.

</details>


### [438] [Juno: Taming Predictive Latents for Vision-Language-Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09940)
*Yuchen Zhu,Chenyi Xu,Yulin Zhang,Gang Xu,Wentao Zhu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出统一框架 Juno，以单一动作条件 JEPA 同时充当控制对齐表征骨干、预测教师与可适应动力学模型，覆盖预训练、策略学习与部署三阶段。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: JEPA 能在表征空间预测掩码或未来观测，为 VLA 模型提供预测性隐变量，但存在三个失败点：与具身特定控制不匹配、干扰动作学习、分布偏移下教师失准。

Method: 预训练阶段在具身匹配轨迹上训练动作条件 JEPA，用动态 CLS 损失将运动加权 patch 动力学迁移到紧凑全局状态；策略学习阶段将当前帧 JEPA patch 融入 VLA 感知，并用解耦推理分支（独立变换参数）蒸馏未来隐状态以生成动作；部署阶段在所有观测转移（含失败 rollout）上适应世界模型，冻结适应后的教师，用 LoRA 适配器与可训练动作头在验证通过的执行上重新对齐策略，无需专家纠正或任务奖励。

Result: 在 SimplerEnv 上平均成功率由最强基线 Qwen3GR00T 的 60.9% 提升至 68.5%，测试时适应进一步达 72.7%；真机在背景、高度与物体偏移下保持 70%–75% 成功率，而基线策略降至 0%。

Conclusion: 统一动作条件 JEPA 可同时解决控制对齐、动作学习干扰与教师失准问题，显著提升 VLA 在仿真与真实环境中的鲁棒性。

Abstract: Joint-embedding predictive architectures (JEPAs) predict masked or future observations in representation space, offering a natural source of predictive latents for vision-language-action (VLA) models. Yet making these latents useful across pretraining, policy learning, and deployment requires addressing three failures: mismatch with embodiment-specific control, interference with action learning, and teacher miscalibration under distribution shifts. We introduce Juno, a unified framework built around one action-conditioned JEPA that serves as a control-aligned representation backbone, a predictive teacher, and an adaptable dynamics model. During pretraining, we train it on embodiment-matched trajectories and use a dynamic CLS loss to transfer motion-weighted patch dynamics to a compact global state. During policy learning, we fuse current-frame JEPA patches into VLA perception and use a decoupled reasoning branch with separate transformation parameters to distill future latent states for action generation. During deployment, we adapt the world model on all observed transitions, including failed rollouts, freeze the adapted teacher, and re-align the policy on verified executions using LoRA adapters and a trainable action head, without expert corrections or task rewards. On SimplerEnv, Juno raises average success from $60.9\%$ to $68.5\%$ over Qwen3GR00T, the strongest baseline, and test-time adaptation further reaches $72.7\%$; on a real robot, it retains $70\%$--$75\%$ success under background, height, and object shifts where the base policy collapses to $0\%$.

</details>


### [439] [Lifelong small-object navigation in changing object layouts: a benchmark and method](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10125)
*Jiagan Huang,Zikun Zhou,Zijian Ni,Hongpeng Wang,Guangming Lu,Jun Yu,Wenjie Pei*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出"终身小物体导航于变化物体布局"任务（LiSoNav-COL）及基准LiSoNav-Eval，并给出基于多视角检查与视点锚定记忆的导航方法IVAM-Nav。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 家庭机器人需在同一环境中持续导航至不同小物体（如工具、玩具），这类物体视觉占位小、易被遮挡且可能被人在机器人未察觉时移动，导致可靠观测困难；同时现有方法依赖预先扫描建图，且缺乏针对该定义性假设的基准。

Method: 将任务形式化为LiSoNav-COL：智能体需寻找合适视角可靠观测、积累并复用场景知识以高效定位后续目标、并在物体移位后更新过时记忆，且从空场景记忆开始导航。提出IVAM-Nav：主动从互补视角观测承载表面以提升小物体感知可靠性，并将记忆锚定到对应观测视点，从而支持关系式记忆复用以及在相似视角条件下的再验证。

Result: 在LiSoNav-Eval上，IVAM-Nav相对代表性方法取得了更优性能；基准分析表明物体越小、环境越大、移位距离越长，任务挑战越大。

Conclusion: 该工作填补了小物体终身导航在变化布局下缺乏基准的空白，通过LiSoNav-Eval与IVAM-Nav验证了主动多视角观测与视点锚定记忆的有效性，并揭示了影响任务难度的关键因素。

Abstract: Household robots need to continually navigate to different objects in the same environment, many of which are small and portable, such as tools and toys. Their small visual footprint and frequent occlusion make reliable observation difficult, and they may be moved by people without the robot observing the changes. We formulate this challenging task as Lifelong Small-object Navigation in Changing Object Layouts (LiSoNav-COL). Agents must seek suitable viewpoints for reliable observation, accumulate and reuse scene knowledge to efficiently locate subsequent targets, and update outdated memory after object relocation. To eliminate the need for prior scene scanning, we also require agents to start navigation with empty scene memory. Although practical, this task still lacks benchmarks designed around its defining assumptions. To bridge this gap, we introduce LiSoNav-Eval, a dedicated benchmark spanning 28 indoor scenes with 45 small-object categories. Its lifelong navigation sequences include both unchanged and relocated targets to evaluate memory reuse and adaptation to object relocation. To address this challenging task, we propose a navigation method based on multi-view Inspection with Viewpoint-Anchored Memory, dubbed IVAM-Nav. IVAM-Nav actively observes supporting surfaces from complementary viewpoints for reliable small-object perception and anchors the resulting memory to their observation viewpoints, supporting relational memory reuse and revalidation under similar viewing conditions. Extensive experiments on LiSoNav-Eval demonstrate favorable performance of IVAM-Nav against representative methods. Benchmark analyses also show that smaller objects, larger environments, and longer relocation distances pose greater challenges. The dataset and code are available here.

</details>


### [440] [Temporal Visuo-Tactile Learning for Dexterous Grasp Stability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10283)
*Ken Nakahara,Aleksei Buvailik,Prokhor Kotov,Roberto Calandra*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该工作系统研究了高分辨率动态触觉感知对灵巧手抓取稳定性预测与模型引导抓取的作用，构建了1万次抓取试验的数据集并训练时序多模态模型，实验证明融合触觉（尤其是高分辨率动态触觉）能提升稳定性预测，在线部署后使实际抓取成功率提高10.5个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类借助指尖触觉反馈可实现近乎完美的抓取成功率，而现有机器人抓取研究多依赖视觉与平行夹爪进行抓取选择。作者希望探究高分辨率、动态触觉感知如何贡献于灵巧机器人手的抓取稳定性预测与模型引导抓取，弥补触觉在灵巧抓取中应用不足的现状。

Method: 使用配备四个Digit 360触觉传感器的多指灵巧手，在200个物体上采集10,000次抓取试验数据，同步记录外部视觉、本体感知与触觉信号流；基于该数据集训练端到端时序多模态模型，从抬升前的抓取观测预测抬升后稳定性，并对比不同感知模态与编码主干；最后将预测器部署到真实机器人上作为在线稳定性门控，结合视觉-触觉模型引导重新抓取。

Result: 实验与受控输入消融表明，引入触觉（尤其是高分辨率、动态触觉）能提升抓取稳定性预测性能；在真实机器人上部署后，视觉-触觉模型引导的重新抓取使实际执行的抬升成功率相比无触觉门控提升10.5个百分点。

Conclusion: 丰富的指尖感知与能捕捉触觉动态的表达性时序模型，无需显式接触或力建模即可支撑多指手的习得抓取，为从触觉经验到稳定灵巧操作提供了可扩展的数据驱动路径；数据集已公开。

Abstract: Humans can grasp everyday objects with almost perfect success rates using fingertip tactile feedback, yet much of the robotic grasping literature emphasizes vision-based grasp selection with parallel grippers. In this work, we systematically investigate how high-resolution, dynamic tactile sensing contributes to grasp stability prediction and model-guided grasping in dexterous robotic hands. To this end, we collected a dataset of 10,000 grasp trials across 200 objects using a multi-fingered robotic hand equipped with four Digit 360 tactile sensors, recording external vision, proprioception, and tactile streams throughout each grasp. With this dataset, we trained end-to-end temporal multimodal models to predict post-lift stability from pre-lift grasp observations and compared sensing modalities and encoding backbones. Experimental results and controlled input ablations show that incorporating touch, and particularly high-resolution, dynamic touch, improves grasp stability prediction. Finally, we deployed the learned predictor as an online stability gate on the real robot, where visuo-tactile model-guided regrasping improved the success rate among executed lifts by 10.5 percentage points over a non-tactile gate. These results show how rich fingertip sensing and expressive temporal models that capture the dynamics of touch can support learned grasping with multi-fingered hands without explicit contact or force modeling, providing a scalable data-driven path from tactile experience toward stable dexterous manipulation. The dataset is publicly available at https://lasr-lab.github.io/dexterous-grasp-stability/.

</details>


### [441] [MultiFly: A Real-World Multimodal Aerial Dataset with Annotation-Efficient Label Transfer and Cross-Modal Semantic Consistency](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10359)
*Markus Gross,Andreas Greiner,Taehyoung Kim,Sivasubiramaniam Subbiah,Tomaž Cotič,Sai Bharadwaj Matha,Conrad Christoph,Oussema Dhaouadi,Simon Zieher,Surya Vijaya Kumar,Gordon Elger,Henri Meeß,Olaf Wysocki,Paul Spannaus,Daniel Cremers*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: MultiFly是首个公开的真实低空无人机多模态语义感知数据集，覆盖RGB、热红外、LiDAR与雷达四种模态，提出基于几何表示传播的标签生成方法以降低标注成本，并建立四模态语义分割基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低空无人机多模态语义感知缺乏真实世界、帧级对齐且标注一致的公开数据集；逐模态人工标注成本高且一致性差，制约了该方向的数据驱动研究与跨模态算法评测。

Method: 构建含4个郊区场景、17,272个同步样本的数据集，提供15类逐帧标注、标定参数及GNSS-RTK/IMU数据；仅人工标注115张RGB图像，通过共享几何表示将标签传播至其他模态，得到17,157张额外RGB图像、17,272张热红外图像、8.4亿LiDAR点与340万雷达点的语义标签；并针对四模态建立语义分割基准。

Result: 传播标注与留出人工标注的平均一致率达89.93%，在全部6组模态对上的平均语义一致性为90.94%；四模态分割基准显示稠密LiDAR与稀疏雷达数据表现出不同的架构行为。

Conclusion: MultiFly为多模态空中感知提供了可扩展的数据基础，据作者所知是首个在RGB、热红外、LiDAR和雷达上同时提供一致逐帧语义标注的公开真实低空航空基准，数据已开源。

Abstract: We introduce MultiFly, a real-world, low-altitude UAV dataset for semantic perception across RGB, thermal, LiDAR, and radar modalities. MultiFly provides 17,272 synchronized samples from four suburban scenes with frame-wise annotations for 15 semantic classes, together with calibration and GNSS-RTK/IMU measurements. To avoid costly and inconsistent modality-specific annotation, we propagate labels from only 115 manually annotated RGB images through shared geometric representations to all four modalities. This approach generates semantic labels for 17,157 additional RGB images, 17,272 thermal images, 840M LiDAR points, and 3.4M radar points. Transferred annotations achieve 89.93% average agreement with held-out manual annotations, and 90.94% average semantic consistency across all six modality pairs. We further establish semantic segmentation benchmarks for all four modalities, revealing distinct architectural behavior for dense LiDAR and sparse radar data. Taken together, MultiFly provides a scalable foundation for multimodal aerial perception and, to the best of our knowledge, the first public real-world low-altitude aerial benchmark that combines consistent frame-wise semantic annotations for RGB, thermal, LiDAR, and radar. Data at https://github.com/markus-42/multifly.

</details>


### [442] [RoboQuest: Generalist Physical Agents that Search, Inspect and Test](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10388)
*Liu Renhang,Navonil Majumder,Tej Deep Pala,Soujanya Poria*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出 RoboQuest，一个面向目标导向具身探索的基准，包含十项移动操作任务，覆盖搜索、基于操作的检查与交互测试三类不确定性。五个前沿多模态智能体最佳仅 23% 成功率，微调策略几乎失败；失败分析表明主要瓶颈在于过早停止探索、无法预防/修复探索干扰，而非执行技能不足。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有通用多模态基础模型虽能完成多类操作任务，但在陌生环境中，任务相关信息（目标物体位置、未观测属性、陌生工具效果）往往不在观测中，需要智能体通过物理交互主动获取信息并据此调整动作。现有评测缺乏针对这种「目标导向具身探索」的标准化基准，因此作者构建 RoboQuest，以系统考察智能体主动信息获取、证据驱动适应与自主终止决策的能力。

Method: RoboQuest 包含十项移动操作任务，围绕三类不确定性组织：搜索（search）、基于操作的检查（manipulation-based inspection）与交互测试（interactive testing）。评测在统一的视觉运动（visiomotor）接口下进行，对象包括五个前沿多模态智能体，以及在作者发布的全回合演示（full-episode demonstrations）上微调的 π_{0.5} 策略。此外还进行隔离测试：将构建任务所需的执行技能单独取出，并直接提供隐藏信息，以区分「执行能力」与「探索/决策能力」。

Result: 最佳智能体仅成功 23% 的回合，微调后的 π_{0.5} 策略几乎从不成功。隔离测试显示，在提供隐藏信息时智能体能完成大部分所要求的动作，说明执行能力基本具备。失败分析将仅少数失败归因于执行问题；更主要的原因是智能体常在尚未观测到完成任务所需证据前就过早停止探索，并做出决策。此外，智能体很少预防或修复自身探索造成的干扰，且对大多数模型而言，试错学习仍然困难。

Conclusion: RoboQuest 揭示当前前沿多模态智能体在目标导向具身探索上仍存在显著能力缺口：瓶颈不在底层执行技能，而在信息获取的持续性、探索副作用的管理以及试错学习。该基准为评估与改进具备主动信息搜集与自适应决策能力的具身智能体提供了平台与全回合演示数据。

Abstract: Recent advances in multimodal foundation models have made them capable generalist physical agents for a range of manipulation tasks. However, successful operation in an unfamiliar environment may require an agent to seek task-relevant information through interaction when it is absent from the observations: it may need to determine where a relevant object is, inspect an unobserved property, or discover the effect of an unfamiliar tool. We thus introduce RoboQuest, a benchmark for goal-directed embodied exploration, where agents must actively acquire task-relevant information through physical interaction, use the resulting evidence to adapt subsequent actions, and autonomously decide when to commit to task completion. RoboQuest comprises ten mobile manipulation tasks centered on three forms of uncertainty: search, manipulation-based inspection, and interactive testing. We evaluate five frontier multimodal agents through a common visuomotor interface, as well as a $π_{0.5}$ policy fine-tuned on the full-episode demonstrations we release. The best agent succeeds in only 23\% of the episodes, and the fine-tuned policy almost never succeeds. Isolated tests of the execution skills the tasks are built from, with the hidden information supplied, show that the agents can carry out most of the required actions, and our failure analysis attributes only a minority of the failures to execution. Our failure analysis further finds that the agents often stop exploring too early as they make decisions before observing the required evidence for task completion. We also find that agents rarely prevent or repair the disturbances caused by their exploration. Moreover, learning by trial and error remains difficult for most models.

</details>


### [443] [Agentic RSR: Real-to-Sim-to-Real through Scene Reconstruction and Execution-Grounded Robot Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10479)
*Yihan Li,Yating Feng,Shengjiu Sun,Jianing Chen,Hao Ren,Bowen Yang,Weisheng Xu,Qiwei Wu,Hui Cheng,Renjing Xu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 Agentic RSR 框架，通过同一操作任务将场景重建、策略开发与真机执行串联，实现从真实视频到仿真再回到真实机器人的闭环，真机任务成功率达到仿真成功率的 80%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实机器人工作空间的仿真需保留任务相关交互，而在其中开发的策略又必须基于真机可获得的观测。但现有方法通常将场景重建与策略开发分离处理，导致仿真与真机之间存在断层，重建结果未必保留任务关键交互，策略也未必适配真机观测。

Method: 框架以同一操作任务为纽带连接三部分：输入工作空间视频、任务描述与已知机器人模型；智能体恢复度量尺度，借助视觉反馈迭代精化场景，并在 MuJoCo 中校验任务相关交互；随后由编码智能体开发可执行策略，从特权物体位姿逐步过渡到视觉观测与随机化仿真，策略可在单次调用中交错多个观测与动作，智能体依据执行反馈继续、重试或修正；共享的任务级接口将策略与累积经验传递到真机，由新观测与安全检查指导执行。

Result: 在 18 个重建场景（涉及两种机器人）上，四视角 Depth MAE 均值为 0.1057 m，Lab ΔE76 均值为 11.04，灰度 SSIM 均值为 0.6990；真机实验中总体任务成功率达到仿真任务成功率的 80%，表明仿真性能在硬件上得到显著保留。

Conclusion: Agentic RSR 证明了以任务为中心统一场景重建、策略开发与真机执行可有效缩小 sim-to-real 差距，在保持任务相关交互的同时使真机性能接近仿真水平；代码与重建场景数据将公开。

Abstract: A simulation of a real robot workspace must preserve task-relevant interactions, while policies developed in it must operate on observations available to the real robot. Yet scene reconstruction and policy development are often treated separately. We present Agentic Real-to-Sim-to-Real (Agentic RSR), a framework that links scene reconstruction, policy development, and real-robot execution through the same manipulation task. Given a workspace video, a task description, and a known robot model, an agent recovers metric scale, iteratively refines the scene using visual feedback, and checks task-relevant interactions in MuJoCo. A coding agent then develops an executable policy, progressing from privileged object poses to visual observations and randomized simulation. The policy can interleave multiple observations and actions within one invocation, while the agent uses execution feedback to continue, retry, or revise its approach. A shared task-level interface carries the policy and accumulated experience to the real robot, where fresh observations and safety checks guide execution. Across 18 reconstructed scenes involving two robots, the mean four-view Depth MAE against reference depth estimates is 0.1057 m, the mean Lab $ΔE_{76}$ is 11.04, and the mean grayscale SSIM is 0.6990. In real-robot experiments, the aggregate task success rate reaches 80% of the simulation task success rate, indicating substantial retention of simulated performance on hardware. Code and reconstructed scene data will be made publicly available.

</details>


### [444] [Long-WAM: Scaling the Context of World-Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10528)
*Wei Huang,Bohan Zhang,Chenzhi Liu,Isabella Liu,Shuai Yang,Weian Mao,Luozhou Wang,Yicheng Xiao,Weifeng Lin,Qixin Hu,Bryan Chu,Sifei Liu,Linxi Fan,Xiaojuan Qi,Song Han,Yukang Chen*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: Long-WAM 是一个面向实时机器人控制的因果世界-动作模型框架，通过自回归视频预训练实现长上下文历史利用，在多个基准与真实平台上取得显著增益并满足实时性约束。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实时机器人控制需要足够的视觉历史来推断运动与任务进展，但处理长历史会延迟动作输出。核心问题在于如何在实时控制约束下扩展因果世界-动作模型的上下文，并探究“能访问历史”与“真正利用历史”之间的差异。

Method: 先在无动作标签的机器人视频与自我中心视频上学习因果预测（自回归预训练），再在世界-动作适配过程中保留这种“历史到未来”的结构。系统层面采用流式观测编码、异步执行与硬件特定加速，支持在 RTX 5090、DGX Spark、Jetson AGX Thor 上部署。

Result: 在 RoboCasa GR-1 上，上下文从 0.0 秒增至 19.2 秒使成功率由 63.3% 提升至 78.7%，而双向预训练初始化无净增益；机器人域自回归预训练进一步提升 GR-1 与 LIBERO-Long 的峰值成功率。在 LIBERO-Long、RoboTwin 2.0、DOMINO 上均优于对比方法。RTX 5090 上每个动作块（含未来视频潜变量预测）耗时 107.4 ms。在 Unitree G1 与 YAM 上实现动态与长时程操作，动态叠杯成功率 95%，而 Pi0.5 与 Fast-WAM 在 20 次试验中均失败。

Conclusion: 历史的价值取决于预训练方式：自回归视频预训练是长上下文收益的前提。Long-WAM 作为“记忆驱动的执行器”，可在实时约束下兼顾长时程建模与未来预测，并能与高层规划互补，适用于复合任务。

Abstract: Real-time robot control demands enough visual history to infer motion and task progress, but processing that history can delay action. We present Long-WAM, a model-system framework for scaling the context of causal world-action models under real-time control constraints. Our central finding is that access to history is not the same as using it: longer histories pay off far more when the video foundation is pretrained autoregressively (AR). We first learn causal prediction from robot and egocentric videos without action labels, then preserve this history-to-future structure during world-action adaptation. On RoboCasa GR-1, increasing context from 0.0 to 19.2 seconds raises success from 63.3% to 78.7%, whereas a bidirectionally pretrained initialization shows no net gain; robot-domain AR pretraining further raises peak success on GR-1 and LIBERO-Long. Long-WAM also achieves the best results among compared methods on LIBERO-Long, RoboTwin 2.0, and DOMINO. Streaming observation encoding, asynchronous execution, and hardware-specific acceleration enable deployment on RTX 5090, DGX Spark, and Jetson AGX Thor without dropping future prediction; on RTX 5090, each action chunk, including future-video latent prediction, takes 107.4 ms. Real-time deployment on Unitree G1 and YAM supports dynamic and long-horizon manipulation, including 95% success on dynamic cup stacking, where Pi0.5 and Fast-WAM succeed in none of 20 trials. As a memory-informed executor, Long-WAM also complements higher-level planning in composite tasks.

</details>


### [445] [Evaluating the Transfer of Co-Evolved Communication from 2D to 3D Simulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09280)
*Fernando Montes-Gonzalez*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该研究将两个机器人智能体在离散2D仿真器中共同演化出的通信机制迁移到具有真实物理的3D仿真器，考察其功能是否保留，并分析回合时间预算、社会线索及角色不对称性的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 检验在简化2D环境中共同演化的通信机制能否在更真实的3D物理环境中保持其功能角色，这一问题对演化机器人学中"仿真到现实/仿真迁移"的有效性具有重要意义。

Method: 把2D离散仿真器中两智能体共同演化的通信机制迁移到3D物理仿真器；系统操控回合时间预算（2,000–6,000物理步）、社会线索以及两个共同演化角色之间的不对称性；通过控制智能体的处理顺序来排除物理引擎造成的伪影，共进行八次独立演化运行。

Result: 成功率随评估时间预算近似线性增长，在2,000至6,000物理步间未出现平台期，说明短回合评估可能低估控制器性能；社会线索在两种仿真器中主要发挥"拥堵辅助"而非"导航引导"作用，但2D中效果更明显；八次独立演化运行显示不对称方向一致，仅幅度存在波动；控制处理顺序排除了物理引擎伪影的可能。

Conclusion: 迁移后通信机制的核心功能得以保留，但存在残余性能差距；该差距可能由时间预算不足、社会线索作用减弱及演化不对称等因素导致，研究据此讨论了迁移性能差距的潜在成因。

Abstract: This work examines the transfer of a co-evolved communication mechanism between two robotic agents from a discrete two-dimensional (2D) simulator to a three-dimensional simulator with real physics (3D). The study focuses on whether a communication mechanism co-evolved in a 2D environment retains its functional role after transfer to a 3D physics-based simulator. To support this analysis, the effects of the episode time budget, the social cue, and the asymmetry between the two co-evolved roles were examined. The results indicate that the success rate increased approximately linearly with the evaluated time budgets, with no evidence of a plateau between 2,000 and 6,000 physics steps, suggesting that evaluations based on shorter episodes may underestimate the performance of the trained controllers. In both simulators, the social cue functioned primarily as a jam- assistance mechanism rather than as a navigation guide, although with a more pronounced effect in 2D. Analysis of eight independent evolutionary runs revealed a consistent direction of asymmetry, although its magnitude varied across runs. Controlling the processing order between agents allowed us to rule out an artifact of the physics engine. Finally, the results are discussed in terms of the factors that may contribute to the remaining performance gap observed after transfer.

</details>


### [446] [SAFE: Unified Slip and Fracture Detection with Low-Cost Acoustic Sensing in Robotic Grasping](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08802)
*Zerun Wang,Vivek Kamat,Shekhar Bhansali*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出SAFE：基于双PVDF声学传感器与电机本体感知的低成本通用滑移/破裂实时检测方法，配合自适应抓取控制器，实现无视觉、无先验材料知识的失效感知抓取。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人抓取易碎物体时需实时理解抓取状态（滑移、破裂）才能做出恰当响应，而现有方法多依赖视觉或已知材料属性，在材料未知、遮挡等条件下难以适用，且低成本、通用性方案缺乏。

Method: 在柔性Fin Ray夹爪上安装两个被动式聚偏氟乙烯（PVDF）声学传感器，结合电机本体感知信号；提取79维特征向量，采用统一的HistGradientBoosting分类器输出状态（正常/滑移/破裂）；在该检测层之上构建自适应抓取控制器，运行于Jetson Orin Nano（104 Hz）。

Result: 在留一抓取交叉验证下，Alert-F1达0.884，滑移与破裂几乎无混淆；消融实验证明声学感知不可或缺。46次闭环真机试验跨多类物体成功率达91.3%，而各固定力策略在不匹配条件下成功率降至0%；对训练未见新物体成功率达82.4%。

Conclusion: SAFE以低成本、无视觉、无材料先验的方式实现实时滑移与破裂检测，支持无需物体特定标定的失效感知抓取控制，在已知与新型物体上均具鲁棒性。

Abstract: Manipulating fragile objects remains challenging as robots must understand the state of what they grasp, such as slip or fracture, to respond appropriately, especially when material properties are unknown. In this paper, we present SAFE: a low-cost, general-purpose sensing approach that detects both slip and fracture in real time using two passive polyvinylidene fluoride (PVDF) acoustic sensors and motor proprioception, without relying on vision or prior material knowledge. The sensors are mounted on a compliant Fin Ray gripper, and a unified HistGradientBoosting classifier reports the state (normal, slip, or fracture) from a 79-dimensional feature vector. Under leave-one-grasp-out cross-validation, SAFE achieves an Alert-F1 of 0.884 with near-zero slip-fracture confusion, and ablations confirm that acoustic sensing is indispensable. An adaptive grasp controller built on this detection layer runs at 104 Hz on a Jetson Orin Nano, achieving 91.3% success across 46 closed-loop robot trials spanning diverse object categories, while each fixed-force strategy drops to 0% on object conditions that mismatch its preset. It further reaches 82.4% success on novel objects unseen during training, demonstrating robust, failure-aware grasp control without object-specific calibration.

</details>


### [447] [Context-Aware Adaptive Pesticide Spraying for Agricultural Robots under Changing Weather and Terrain Using Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08807)
*Cong-Thanh Vu,Yen-Chen Liu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种基于视觉-语言模型（VLM）的情境感知自适应喷洒框架，结合多源信息（作物类型、农药类型、气象数据）与MPPI轨迹跟踪控制，实现精准导航与自适应喷洒，作物行检测精度提升至少30%，并能灵活调节喷洒量与行驶速度、减少农药飘移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 精准农药喷洒对提升施用效率与保证化学品均匀分布至关重要，其性能受温度、风速等环境条件、农药类型及机器人感知能力等多因素影响。现有方法多侧重作物检测并依赖预设喷洒参数，而人类操作者会综合环境条件、区域作物特征和农药类型动态调整策略，二者存在差距。

Method: 提出基于视觉-语言模型（VLM）的情境感知自适应喷洒框架，使机器人具备空间推理能力并融合作物类型、农药类型与天气数据等多源信息，从而做出自适应且优化的喷洒决策；随后采用基于模型预测路径积分（MPPI）控制的轨迹跟踪控制器，保证精准导航与在作物位置的准确喷洒。

Result: 对比结果表明，所提方法在作物行检测方面精度提升至少30%；在两种环境下的实验评估进一步证明机器人能够灵活调整喷洒量与行驶速度，同时减少农药飘移。

Conclusion: 基于VLM的情境感知框架结合MPPI控制可有效提升喷洒决策的自适应性与作业精度，在作物行检测精度、喷洒量与速度的动态调节以及减少农药飘移方面均表现优越。

Abstract: Precision pesticide spraying is essential for optimizing application efficiency and ensuring uniform chemical distribution. Spraying performance is influenced by multiple factors, including environmental conditions such as temperature and wind speed, pesticide type, and the robot's capability to accurately perceive crops and target spray locations. Existing approaches predominantly emphasize crop detection and rely on predefined spraying parameters, whereas human operators dynamically adjust their spraying strategies by considering environmental conditions, region-specific crop characteristics, and the type of pesticide being applied. In this study, we propose a context-aware adaptive spraying framework based on Vision-Language Models (VLMs), which enables robots to leverage spatial reasoning and integrate information from multiple sources, including crop type, pesticide type, and weather data, to make adaptive and optimized spraying decisions. Subsequently, a trajectory-tracking controller based on Model Predictive Path Integral (MPPI) control is employed to ensure precise navigation and accurate spraying at crop locations. The comparative results demonstrate that the proposed method improves accuracy by at least 30% in detecting crop rows. In addition, the experimental evaluations conducted in two environments further demonstrate the robot's ability to flexibly adjust spraying volume and travel speed, while reducing pesticide drift.

</details>


### [448] [Taming an End-to-End Autonomous Driving Policy for Urban Navigation of Quadruped Robots](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08812)
*Joochan Kim,Chanuk Yang,Tackgeun You,Ziran Wang,Hwasup Lim*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 Go2-DrivoR，将端到端自动驾驶轨迹规划框架 DrivoR 适配为四足机器人城市导航的目标条件局部规划器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 将成熟的自动驾驶端到端规划框架迁移至四足机器人城市导航，避免重新设计核心解码器，同时弥补车辆中心设定与足式机器人人行道导航需求之间的差距。

Method: 通过目标 token 将轨迹生成条件化于局部坐标系子目标，并改造以车辆为中心的评分公式：重新定义面向人行道导航的可行驶区域合规项，将原有自车进度项重构为目标条件自车进度项。

Result: 仅在 TartanGround 仿真数据上训练，在未见仿真环境中提升了航点条件规划性能，并零样本迁移至真实世界开环轨迹预测。

Conclusion: 目标条件化改造可在不重构核心解码器的前提下，有效将车辆端到端规划框架扩展至四足机器人局部导航，并具备仿真到真实的零样本迁移能力。

Abstract: We present Go2-DrivoR, a goal-conditioned adaptation of the end-to-end autonomous driving trajectory planning framework DrivoR for urban navigation with quadrupedal robots. By conditioning trajectory generation on a local-frame subgoal through a goal token and adapting the vehicle-centric scoring formulation, the method extends DrivoR to short-horizon goal-conditioned local planning without redesigning its core decoders. Specifically, we redefine drivable-area compliance for sidewalk-oriented navigation and reformulate the original ego progress term as goal-conditioned ego progress. Trained exclusively on TartanGround simulation data, Go2-DrivoR improves waypoint-conditioned planning performance on unseen simulation environments and transfers zero-shot to open-loop real-world trajectory prediction.

</details>


### [449] [Autonomous Droplet Navigation via Model-Based Reinforcement Learning: Zero-Shot Transfer and Emergent Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08852)
*Rajneesh Anand,Mayuresh V. Kothare*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出首个在开放无约束表面上以基于模型的强化学习实现液滴闭环自主导航的机器人平台。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自驱动实验室（SDLs）虽已借助闭环自动化变革化学与材料发现，但针对柔软可变形物质的物理操控仍超出当前机器人平台能力。开放表面液滴自主运输是典型难题：接触角滞后、毛细钉扎与表面非均匀性导致部分可观测动力学，令传统基于模型的控制器难以应对。

Method: 构建两轴倾斜板平台，表面覆薄硅油膜以驱动液滴，顶置相机提供实时反馈；采用基于模型的强化学习训练策略，无需仿真或解析模型，依据几何复杂度仅用约50至150个物理回合完成训练。

Result: 策略可零样本迁移至未见几何构型；在液滴粘滞时自主学习出振荡脱钉策略将其释放；完整训练流程在90分钟内完成。

Conclusion: 该工作将强化学习操控从刚性微机器人拓展至可变形软物质体系，为下一代自驱动实验室提供新的自动化基础设施。

Abstract: Self-driving laboratories (SDLs) are transforming chemical and materials discovery through closed-loop automation, yet automated infrastructure for physical manipulation of soft, deformable matter remains beyond current robotic platforms. A critical instance is autonomous droplet transport on an open surface, where contact-angle hysteresis, capillary pinning, and surface heterogeneity produce partially observable dynamics that pose significant challenges for classical model-based controllers. We introduce the first robotic platform for closed-loop autonomous liquid droplet navigation on an open, unconfined surface using model-based reinforcement learning. A two-axis tilting board coated with a thin silicone oil film drives the droplet, while an overhead camera provides real-time feedback. A learned policy was trained on just 50 to 150 physical episodes depending on geometric complexity, without simulation or analytical models. Beyond performance alone, the platform demonstrates three capabilities of interest to the SDL community: it robustly transfers zero-shot to unseen geometries; it autonomously discovers an oscillatory depinning strategy to free the droplet when it sticks; and it completes its full training pipeline in under 90 minutes. These results extend reinforcement-learning manipulation from rigid microrobots to deformable soft-matter systems for next-generation SDLs.

</details>


### [450] [Trajectory Planning without Trajectory Data: A Manifold-Guided Approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08863)
*Silong Yong,Anji Liu,Cunxi Dai,Carl Busart,Guanya Shi,Yilun Du,Katia Sycara,Yaqi Xie*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 Ariadne，通过学习状态空间流形并利用其几何结构进行轨迹规划，仅需状态观测即可泛化到未见约束，在 Maze2D、机器人运动规划及高维双臂规划任务上取得竞争力表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于生成模型的轨迹规划方法依赖大规模专家轨迹监督，监督成本高、对序列长度扩展性差，且难以泛化到未见约束（如新的起点-终点组合）。

Method: 提出替代方案：学习状态空间底层流形，并利用该流形的几何结构进行轨迹规划。方法仅需状态观测，通过在学习到的状态空间流形上构造轨迹，实现对未见约束的泛化。

Result: 在 Maze2D 与机器人运动规划基准上，Ariadne 能从纯状态监督中构造可行路径，并泛化到未见起点-终点组合；在高维双臂规划中，无需轨迹数据训练即可与轨迹监督方法和经典规划器保持竞争力。

Conclusion: 通过学习状态空间流形的几何进行规划，可摆脱对轨迹监督的依赖，在泛化性与高维规划场景中具备与现有方法相当的性能，为轨迹规划提供了新范式。

Abstract: A common way for trajectory planning is to leverage generative models trained on large collections of expert trajectories. At inference time, the model generates executable trajectories by conditioning on task goal constraints. However, trajectory-based methods rely on costly supervision, scale poorly with sequence length, and often generalize poorly to unseen constraints such as novel start-goal pairs. We propose an alternative to learn the underlying state-space manifold and use the geometry of the manifold for trajectory planning. This approach requires only state observations and enables generalization to unseen constraints by con- structing trajectories on the learned manifold of the state space. Experiments on Maze2D and robotic motion-planning benchmarks show that Ariadne constructs feasible paths from state-only supervision and generalizes to unseen start-goal combinations. On high-dimensional dual-arm planning, it remains competitive with trajectory-supervised and classical planners, while requiring no trajectory data for training.

</details>


### [451] [From Wearable Interfaces to Dexterous Policies: Contact Shifts and Tactile Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08870)
*Ruitong Tian,Fang Xu,Noah B. Wilson,Xianyao Li,Eric Jing Du*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该研究考察可穿戴示教外骨骼的手部几何差异如何影响触觉数据质量与策略性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可穿戴界面让操作者以自身手部动作采集灵巧演示并直接接触任务物体，减少对目标机器人的依赖，但采集硬件本身成为生成演示的物理过程的一部分；界面几何会同时影响任务执行方式与可记录的触觉观测，因此需要评估其对数据与策略的影响。

Method: 比较DexUMI家族同机器人指令定义、映射流程与触觉模块类型的两个外骨骼版本，仅手侧几何不同；在开盖、开蛋盒等任务上记录接触变化，并用二值聚合输入与空间加力输入训练匹配策略，另加USB插入与焊接工具拾放两个任务。

Result: 改进版界面降低主观体力需求、提升设备评分，可在基线机械受阻的精确抓取中获取触觉，并产生任务相关接触变化：开盖主要改变接触位置，开蛋盒主要改变接触发生。改进版演示训练的策略成功率更高，界面效应合并显著；空间加力输入整体优于二值聚合。

Conclusion: 可穿戴采集硬件是机器人学习数据生成过程的一部分，评估此类界面不应只看操作者体验，还应看其可记录的触觉交互及演示所支撑的策略性能。

Abstract: Unlike conventional teleoperation, wearable interfaces allow operators to collect dexterous demonstrations through their own hand motions while directly interacting with task objects. This direct interaction reduces dependence on the target robot during collection, but it also makes the collection hardware part of the physical process that generates each demonstration. Interface geometry can influence both how a task is performed and what tactile observations are recorded for learning. We study two versions of a DexUMI-family exoskeleton that share the same robot command definition, mapping procedure, and tactile module type but differ in hand-side geometry. The revised interface reduces reported physical demand, improves selected device ratings, enables tactile access in a precision grasp that is mechanically blocked by the baseline, and produces task-dependent changes in recorded contact. Lid twisting primarily exhibits a change in contact location, whereas egg carton opening primarily exhibits a change in contact occurrence. We then train matched policies using either a binary aggregate input or a spatial-plus-force input. On lid twisting and egg carton opening, policies trained on revised-interface demonstrations achieve higher success than those trained on baseline demonstrations, with a significant pooled interface effect. Across these and two additional tasks, USB insertion and soldering tool pick and place, the spatial-plus-force input likewise outperforms binary aggregation. These results show that wearable collection hardware is part of the data-generation process for robot learning. Such interfaces should therefore be evaluated not only through operator experience, but also through the tactile interactions they make recordable and the policy performance their demonstrations support.

</details>


### [452] [Toward Evidence-Driven Human-Agent-Robot Teaming for Earth-Independent Anomaly Triage](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08933)
*Ignacio G Lopez-Francos,Alexis Gallagher,Samira Shalal*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向深空独立异常分诊的证据驱动人-智能体-机器人协同架构，将智能AI定位为受权限约束的有状态协调器，通过分诊状态管理、面向乘员的具身智能体和移动机器人构建闭环证据链，并在硬件在环原型中验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深空乘组无法依赖地面实时支持应对紧急异常事件。初始警报往往不足以确定故障原因，而关键判别证据可能存在于乘员观察中，或位于不安全、高成本或乘员无法检查的位置。因此需要一种地球独立的异常分诊机制来主动收集和整合证据。

Method: 提出证据驱动的人-智能体-机器人协同架构。智能AI被视为对有限、可审查服务进行协调的有状态协调器，而非完全自主的载具控制器。系统包含：分诊状态管理器（维护假设、证据溯源、不确定性、操作上下文与工具状态）；面向乘员的具身智能体（引导观察并解释评估变化）；移动机器人（采集针对性局部证据）。使用类型化接口将对话与编排同监控、机器人指令、上下文检索及安全关键控制分离。

Result: 通过两个场景说明架构：基于真实国际空间站氨气误报的载人深空任务（疑似污染限制乘员进入）与载人月球基地电源接口异常（机器人检查可区分局部连接器故障与其他在遥测中模糊的原因）。在采用Reachy Mini和Innate MARS移动机器人的硬件在环集成原型中进行了演练。

Conclusion: 主要贡献是一种权限受限的闭环证据架构，将智能AI作为受约束的协调器而非自主控制器，整合乘员观察与机器人局部证据以支持地球独立的异常分诊，并通过硬件在环原型验证了可行性。

Abstract: Deep-space crews cannot rely on real-time ground support for urgent off-nominal events. Initial alerts may underdetermine cause, while discriminating evidence may reside in crew observations or at locations that are unsafe, costly, or unavailable for crew inspection. We present an evidence-driven architecture for human-agent-robot teaming in Earth-independent anomaly triage. Agentic AI is treated as a stateful coordinator over bounded, inspectable services rather than as a fully autonomous vehicle controller. A triage state manager maintains hypotheses, evidence provenance, uncertainty, operational context, and tool status; a crew-facing embodied agent elicits observations and explains assessment changes; and a mobile robot acquires targeted, localized evidence. Typed interfaces separate dialogue and orchestration from monitoring, robot command, context retrieval, and safety-critical control. Two scenarios illustrate the architecture: a crewed deep-space mission based on an actual ISS ammonia false alarm, where suspected contamination restricts crew access, and a power-interface anomaly at a crewed lunar base, where robotic inspection distinguishes a local connector fault from other causes ambiguous in remote telemetry. Our main contribution is an authority-bounded closed evidence-loop architecture, exercised in a hardware-in-the-loop integration prototype using Reachy Mini and an Innate MARS mobile robot.

</details>


### [453] [HULK: Learning Whole-Body Forceful Loco-Manipulation for Humanoids](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08970)
*An Dang,Arturo Flores Alvarez,Yu-Ming Chen,Conor Mc Gartoll,Helen Sun,Aaron Ames,Nima Fazeli,Manikantan Nambi*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: HULK 是一个用于人形机器人全身用力搬运重物的整体控制框架：以 MPC 预测负载动力学引导强化学习，训练“腕力下手臂跟踪”与“贴身持大物体行走”两位教师策略，并加入基于捕获点的控制屏障函数增强负载平衡，最终蒸馏为单一策略，在仿真与 Unitree G1 上验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型重物的类人全身移动-操作需要全身肢体与物体之间的强相互作用力；但此类负载会改变人形机器人的质心位置，并对上肢持续施加负载，从而破坏平衡并降低指令跟踪精度。现有方法难以在负载条件下兼顾平衡与运动跟踪。

Method: 1) 采用模型预测控制（MPC）生成负载动力学预测，用于引导强化学习；2) 训练两个教师策略：其一在腕部受力条件下跟踪手臂运动，其二在将大型物体贴身持握的同时进行移动；3) 在训练腕力教师时引入捕获点（capture-point）控制屏障函数以提升负载下的平衡性；4) 将两个教师策略蒸馏为单一策略；5) 在仿真与 Unitree G1 实体平台上进行评估。

Result: 仿真中，在每臂 10 kg 负载条件下，带屏障函数的教师策略在参与比较的控制器中取得最低的前向与侧向速度跟踪误差，并将发散运动分量（DCM）偏移幅度的累计值相对仅使用 MPC 引导强化学习的方法降低 35.7%；腕力教师可承受最高 130 N 的躯干推力扰动。

Conclusion: 将 MPC 预测引导的强化学习与捕获点控制屏障函数、教师蒸馏相结合，可在重载条件下实现更强的平衡与速度指令跟踪能力，并在人形机器人实物上具备可行性。

Abstract: Humanoid loco-manipulation of large, heavy objects demands forceful interaction across the entire body. However, such payloads shift a humanoid's center of mass and impose sustained loads across the upper body, challenging balance and command tracking. We present HULK, a whole-body control framework for forceful loco-manipulation. Using model predictive control (MPC) to guide reinforcement learning with predictions of the loaded dynamics, we train two teachers: one tracks arm motions under wrist forces, and the other locomotes while holding large objects against the body. A capture-point control barrier function augments the wrist-force teacher during training to improve balance under load. We distill both teachers into a single policy. Evaluation spans simulation and the Unitree G1. In simulation, the teacher with the barrier function achieves the lowest forward and lateral velocity tracking errors at 10 kg per arm among evaluated controllers and reduces aggregate divergent component of motion (DCM) excursion magnitude by 35.7% relative to MPC-guided reinforcement learning alone. Our wrist-force teacher withstands torso push disturbances of up to 130 N.

</details>


### [454] [PhysEvo: Astra Can Act, Let It](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08995)
*Wenqing Tian,Zeyu Zhang,Zhaocheng Liu,Fengwei Liu,Qiang Liu,Liang Wang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: PhysEvo 提出面向冻结模型的物理递归自我改进（RSI）框架，通过任务智能体与元智能体协同，在不更新模型权重的情况下实现关节级控制、证据寻求观测与可复用操作技能，并在仿真与真实机器人任务上显著超越基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人操作依赖观测与控制系统的可靠性，而单一冻结模型缺乏对失败的诊断与自我修正能力。论文旨在让冻结模型通过物理任务反馈实现递归自我改进，避免权重更新与单独训练动作策略。

Method: PhysEvo 框架：任务智能体执行机器人任务并产生轨迹；元智能体利用轨迹诊断失败、修订工具与技能并测试修正；元智能体还可改进自身诊断工具，使保留的修订同时支持后续行动与后续自我改进。

Result: 在 42 个 RoboDojo 任务上，保留的任务特定部署版本在留出布局评估中取得五维平均分 68.14/100、成功率 62.00%，高于最强已发表参考 RoboDawn 一次性 Astra 智能体的 47.17%。在 8 个挑战直接 Astra 的操作任务上，PhysEvo 成功率达 55.00%，直接 Astra 参考仅 1.25%。将仿真演化出的 harness 部署到 AgileX PiPER 并继续技能修订，在 5 个真实任务 25 次试验中取得 90.60/100 平均分与 84.00% 成功率。

Conclusion: PhysEvo 将行动后果转化为对冻结模型行为与改进方式的持久、可测试的改变，验证了物理递归自我改进在机器人操作中的有效性。

Abstract: Astra can act, yet reliable manipulation depends on the system through which it observes and controls the world. We introduce PhysEvo, a framework for physical recursive self-improvement (RSI) around a single frozen model. A task agent executes robot tasks; a meta-agent uses the resulting trajectories to diagnose failures, revise tools and skills, and test corrections. The meta-agent can also improve its own diagnostic tools, so retained revisions support both later action and later self-improvement. This process develops joint-level control, evidence-seeking observation, and reusable manipulation skills without model-weight updates or a separately trained action policy. Across 42 RoboDojo tasks, held-out-layout evaluation of retained task-specific deployment versions yields a five-dimension average score of 68.14/100 and 62.00% success, compared with 47.17% for RoboDawn's one-shot Astra agent, the strongest published reference in our comparison. On eight manipulation tasks challenging direct Astra, PhysEvo achieves 55.00% success, compared with 1.25% for the direct-Astra reference. Deploying the simulation-evolved harness on AgileX PiPER and continuing skill revision yields 90.60/100 average score and 84.00% success across 25 trials on five real-world tasks. PhysEvo turns the consequences of action into persistent, testable changes to how a frozen model acts and improves.

</details>


### [455] [MimicX: Policy-in-the-Loop Supervision Refinement for Video-Driven Humanoid Motion Tracking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09055)
*Shuaijun Liu,Chenglong Zhang,Xuhao Liu,Feiyang You,Yifan Liao,Shuyang Hao,Chaozhe Zhang,Chengyu Wu,Zhen Sun,Ningxin Su*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: MimicX是一个策略在环（policy-in-the-loop）框架，利用执行反馈定位视频驱动人形运动跟踪中的困难过渡与受影响身体区域，联合自适应调整跟踪目标与重置课程，并通过反复 rollout 验证筛选执行优先的改进。相比固定参考基线，任务平均身体跟踪误差降低25.7%，执行视界提升255.6%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类视频为人形学习提供丰富的运动目标，但视觉上合理的参考在基于物理的执行中仍会产生持续性失败。这些失败揭示了训练监督应当改变的位置，即需要将执行反馈转化为可操作的监督信号来决定"细化什么"以及"保留哪种细化"。

Method: MimicX以重建并重定向后的运动为起点，定位困难过渡片段和受影响的身体区域，联合自适应调整跟踪目标（tracking objectives）与重置课程（reset curriculum）以支持策略续接；通过反复 rollout 验证，在跟踪守卫（tracking guards）约束下筛选执行优先的改进。同时引入 MimicX-HLoop 通过异构执行加速反馈。

Result: 在四个核心视频任务上，MimicX相对固定参考基线持续提升跟踪精度与鲁棒执行视界（Robust Execution Horizon）。任务平均结果显示身体跟踪误差降低25.7%，执行视界提升255.6%。额外的视频、运动参考与碰撞场景研究验证了方法在核心任务之外的泛化性。

Conclusion: MimicX将策略失败转化为可操作的监督信号，用于决定细化何处以及保留哪种细化，从而有效提升视频驱动人形运动在物理执行中的跟踪精度与执行视界。

Abstract: Human videos provide rich motion targets for humanoid learning, yet visually plausible references can still produce persistent failures under physics-based execution. These failures reveal where training supervision should change. We present MimicX, a policy-in-the-loop framework that uses execution feedback to refine video-driven humanoid motion tracking. Starting from reconstructed and retargeted motion, MimicX localizes difficult transitions and affected body regions, then jointly adapts tracking objectives and the reset curriculum for policy continuation. Repeated rollout verification selects execution-priority improvements subject to tracking guards. Across four core video tasks, MimicX consistently improves tracking accuracy and Robust Execution Horizon relative to the Fixed Reference baseline. Task-averaged results show a 25.7% reduction in body-tracking error and a 255.6% increase in execution horizon. Additional video, motion-reference, and collision-scene studies evaluate the method beyond the core tasks, while MimicX-HLoop accelerates feedback through heterogeneous execution. Overall, MimicX turns policy failure into actionable supervision for deciding what to refine and which refinement to retain.

</details>


### [456] [Workhorse: Learning Robust Whole-Body Humanoid Loco-Manipulation from Human Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09117)
*Songbo Hu,Qiayuan Liao,Yufeng Chi,Kevin Zakka,Yakun Sophia Shao,Pieter Abbeel,Koushil Sreenath*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: Workhorse：从无机器人的人类演示中学习类人机器人接触密集全身操作，视觉规划器预测躯干、双腕、双脚的目标位姿，强化学习全身跟踪器在真机执行，并互相模拟对方部署误差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 类人机器人从第一视角RGB与本体感觉出发，进行接触密集的全身操作仍很困难。现有方法通常依赖遥操作或运动重定向，成本高且难以获取多样化人类示范。

Method: 两阶段解耦策略：视觉规划器预测五连杆目标位姿（躯干、双腕、双脚），RL全身跟踪器在机器人上跟随。两者均在同一批记录的人类位姿上独立训练，无需重定向。并对每个策略的训练数据做增强，以模仿对方在部署时产生的误差。

Result: 真机Unitree G1上完成用双手与踢腿整理箱子、接住抛来的箱子、推倒并爬上行李箱；箱整理中被推挤或取走箱子后能恢复。仿真演示房间中箱整理成功率77%，40 N·s推挤下64%；用同一批演示重训练后，第二台仿真类人机器人无推挤时成功率达83%。

Conclusion: 无需机器人数据与重定向，通过人类演示独立训练规划与跟踪策略并互相注入误差，可实现鲁棒的接触密集全身操作并具备抗扰恢复能力。

Abstract: Humanoid robots still struggle to plan contact-rich whole-body manipulation from egocentric RGB and proprioception. Workhorse learns such manipulation from robot-free human demonstrations. A visual planner predicts five-link targets: the poses of the torso, both wrists, and both feet. A reinforcement-learning whole-body tracker follows them on the robot. Both policies train separately on the same recorded human poses, without retargeting. We augment the training data of each policy to imitate the errors that the other makes at deployment. On a real Unitree G1, Workhorse sorts boxes with its hands and a kick, catches a thrown box, and topples and climbs a suitcase. During box sorting, we show recoveries after a person pushes the robot or takes the box away. In a simulated copy of the demonstration room, the system completes box sorting in 77% of episodes, and in 64% under 40 N.s pushes. With both policies retrained from the same demonstrations, a simulated second humanoid completes box sorting in 83% of episodes without pushes.

</details>


### [457] [FlashNeRD: Performance-First Contact-Rich Neural Robot Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09130)
*Mohammadmehdi Ataei,Mohammad Amin Nabian,Jie Xu,Miles Macklin,Yashraj Narang,Eric Heiden,Octi Zhang,Yunrong Guo,Ruben D'Sa,Oliver Hennigh,Gavriel State,Sanjay Choudhry*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: FlashNeRD 通过并行流式架构、任意位置接触编码器和双向耦合，克服了 NeRD 在速度、接触点固定和对象耦动方面的三大局限，实现最高 $55\times$ 加速并提升精度与策略学习效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 学习型动力学模型相比解析物理仿真具有更快、可微、易适应真实数据的潜力。NeRD 通过保留解析碰撞检测、用学习模型替代机器人数值动力学来实现这一目标，但存在三个局限：相对所学仿真器加速有限、仅支持预定义接触点、与所操作对象无双向耦合。

Method: FlashNeRD 采用三项设计：并行流式架构使每次预测更快且更准确；编码器接受任意位置发生的接触；与解析求解器仿真的对象实现双向耦合。

Result: 在五种机器人上验证了更快更准的动力学、更快的策略学习和更快的推理时规划。在三种机器人上，其动力学模型比优化后的 NeRD 快最高 $55\times$，且长时程滚动更准确。PPO 在 34 秒内训练出 ANYmal 运动策略，比解析仿真器快 $3.8\times$、比优化 NeRD 快 $2.7\times$。使用 DIAL-MPC 时，机器人攀爬全部六个测试平台（固定接触的 NeRD 仅完成一个），规划时间约为解析仿真器的一半。用 FlashNeRD 训练的立方体重定向策略达到仿真器训练策略目标计数的 2% 以内。

Conclusion: FlashNeRD 通过并行流式架构、任意接触编码与双向耦合，同时提升了仿真速度、精度以及对策略学习与规划的下游支持，显著优于 NeRD 与解析仿真器。

Abstract: Compared with analytical physics, learned dynamics models promise robot simulation that is faster, inherently differentiable, and easily adaptable to real data. Neural Robot Dynamics (NeRD) pursues this by keeping collision detection analytical and replacing a simulator's numerical dynamics for the robot with a learned model. Three limitations remain. NeRD offers little speedup over the simulator it learned from, accepts contact only at predefined points, and has no two-way coupling with objects it manipulates. FlashNeRD removes all three with a parallel streaming architecture that makes each prediction faster and more accurate, an encoder that accepts contacts wherever they occur, and two-way coupling with objects simulated by analytical solvers. Experiments across five robots show faster and more accurate dynamics, faster policy learning, and faster inference-time planning. Across three robots, FlashNeRD's dynamics model is up to $55\times$ faster than an optimized NeRD and more accurate over long rollouts. This speedup extends to policy learning, where PPO trains an ANYmal locomotion policy in 34 seconds, $3.8\times$ faster than the analytical simulator and $2.7\times$ faster than an optimized NeRD. With DIAL-MPC, a sampling-based MPC method, the robot climbs all six test platforms where fixed-contact NeRD manages one, at approximately half the analytical simulator's planning time. Cube-reorientation policies trained with FlashNeRD complete within 2% of the simulator-trained policy's target count.

</details>


### [458] [World Models Dream of Success: Diagnosing and Repairing Failure Insensitivity in Robot World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09134)
*Jiuyi Xu,Xiao Hu,Meida Chen,Peng Gao,Yang Ye,Yangming Shi*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出CureWM，通过在执行中验证的"反事实失败"数据对已发布的机器人世界模型进行后处理微调，无需改动架构或训练目标，即可显著降低模型对失败动作的乐观预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人世界模型用于策略评估、规划与合成数据生成，前提是能区分成功与失败动作；但现有已发布模型对动作变化不敏感，且在真实验证为失败的情形下仍预测成功（乐观偏差）。已有工作把失败数据纳入训练，但"用何种数据修复已发布检查点且不改架构与目标"仍缺乏探索。

Method: CureWM：从成功示范出发，在严重度网格上构造替代动作，在仿真或真机上执行并验证其真实结果，再用由此得到的失败样本、幸存成功样本与标准示范数据共同微调已发布模型；该构造方式在共享初始情境下提供受控的动作对比。

Result: 在484个LIBERO失败反事实样本上，乐观率由官方数据微调后的80%降至四个独立微调CureWM模型的30–43%（均值38%）；真机机械臂两项评估中，被潜在距离诊断判为"类成功"的失败预测由仅用成功示范微调的90%降至33%；在失败样本数、成功回放数据与训练预算匹配时，反事实失败带来0.124的成功—失败价值差，而在线新采失败仅0.014。

Conclusion: 经执行验证的反事实回放是修复已发布世界模型的有效后处理手段；同时表明降低乐观率必须与成功—失败判别能力一同评估，代码已开源。

Abstract: Robot world models support policy evaluation, planning, and synthetic data generation, but these applications require predictions that distinguish successful actions from failures. Across four released checkpoints from two architecture families, we observe weak sensitivity to action changes and success-like predictions on verified failures. Although recent work incorporates failures into model training, which data can repair released checkpoints without changing their architecture or training objective still remains underexplored. To this end, we introduce CureWM, which constructs alternative actions from successful demonstrations across a severity grid, verifies their outcomes through execution in simulation or on hardware, and fine-tunes released models on the resulting failures and surviving successes alongside nominal demonstrations. This construction provides controlled action contrasts from shared starting contexts. On 484 held-out LIBERO failure counterfactuals, optimism falls from 80\% after fine-tuning on the official data to 30--43\% across four independently fine-tuned CureWM models (38\% mean). In two separate evaluations on a physical robot arm, failure predictions scored as success-like by a latent-distance diagnostic decrease from 90\% after fine-tuning on successful demonstrations alone to 33\% with CureWM. With failure counts per task, successful replay data, and training budget matched, counterfactual failures yield a success--failure value gap of 0.124, compared with 0.014 for freshly collected on-policy failures. These findings support execution-verified counterfactual replay for post-hoc repair and show why reduced optimism must be evaluated alongside success--failure discrimination. Code is available at https://github.com/jiuyixu25/CureWM.

</details>


### [459] [A Unified Kinematic Representation Enables Reusable Biological Joint Moment Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09150)
*Jinwoo Hwang,Ilseung Park,Changseob Song,Vu Phan,Eni Halilaj,Inseung Kang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出以关节运动学作为中间表征，解耦硬件传感器与生物关节力矩估计，使仅用开源数据训练的估计器能跨多种可穿戴平台使用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数据驱动的生物关节力矩估计广泛用于外骨骼控制，但估计器常与特定设备的传感器配置耦合，难以实现控制器迁移，也难以利用开源生物力学数据集。

Method: 以关节运动学（关节角度与角速度）作为中间表征；仅使用开源生物力学数据训练关节力矩估计器；再分别用髋外骨骼、膝外骨骼及IMU传感套件采集的运动学进行评测，覆盖平地行走、上坡与下坡行走。

Result: 髋外骨骼运动学：RMSE 0.17 Nm/kg，R² 0.79；膝外骨骼运动学：RMSE 0.19 Nm/kg，R² 0.62；IMU运动学（双侧髋、膝、踝）：RMSE 0.15 Nm/kg，R² 0.85。

Conclusion: 关节运动学使仅基于开源数据训练的估计器能够跨不同可穿戴平台运行；该框架有望减少目标设备的数据采集需求，支持面向外骨骼控制与可穿戴生物力学的可迁移关节力矩估计。

Abstract: Objective: Data-driven models that estimate physiological states, particularly biological joint moments, are widely used in exoskeleton control. However, these estimators are often coupled to device-specific sensor configurations, limiting controller transfer and the use of open-source biomechanics datasets. Methods: We proposed joint kinematics as an intermediate representation that decouples hardware-specific sensing from downstream biological joint moment estimation. A joint-moment estimator using joint angles and angular velocities was trained exclusively on open-source biomechanics data and evaluated using kinematics from a hip exoskeleton, knee exoskeleton, and inertial measurement unit (IMU) sensor suite during level-ground, ramp-ascent, and ramp-descent walking. Results: The estimator achieved an root mean square error (RMSE) of 0.17 Nm/kg and coefficient of determination (R2) of 0.79 using hip exoskeleton kinematics, 0.19 Nm/kg and 0.62 using knee exoskeleton kinematics, and 0.15 Nm/kg and 0.85 using kinematics derived from IMUs across bilateral hip, knee, and ankle joints. Conclusion: Joint kinematics enabled an estimator trained only on open-source data to operate across distinct wearable platforms. Significance: This framework may reduce target-device data collection and support transferable biological joint moment estimation for exoskeleton control and wearable biomechanics.

</details>


### [460] [geodex: A Library for Motion Planning on Riemannian Manifolds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09165)
*Phone Thiha Kyaw,Ben Wei,Sepehr Samavi,Miguel Angel Rogel Garcia,Jonathan Kelly*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: geodex 是一个开源 C++20 库（含 Python 绑定），将流形、黎曼度量、retraction 与采样器解耦为可互换组件，通过统一采样规划接口在多种空间上按配置相关黎曼度量规划路径。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有流形优化库几何原语丰富但不能绕障规划；通用运动规划库虽支持多状态空间与自定义距离函数，却不把配置相关黎曼度量作为驱动距离、插值与测地线的几何对象；而在配置空间内蕴几何下规划可获更短、更低能耗、更自然的轨迹。

Method: 提出 geodex：开源 C++20 库并提供 Python 绑定；将流形、黎曼度量、retraction、采样器设为独立可互换组件，统一到单一采样运动规划接口；同一规划器无需改动即可运行于 R^n、T^n、S^n、SO(2)、SE(2)、SO(3)、SE(3) 及其乘积、关节机器人配置空间，每类空间可配用户定义黎曼度量。

Result: 同一规划器在所列各流形与乘积空间、关节机器人配置空间上无需修改即可运行，并支持各空间搭配用户自定义黎曼度量；库公开提供，含文档、测试与可复现基准套件。

Conclusion: geodex 填补了流形优化与通用运动规划之间的空白，把配置相关黎曼度量作为规划几何，通过组件解耦和统一接口实现跨空间复用；公开文档、测试与基准便于复现与扩展。
