Abstract: Planning motions that respect the intrinsic geometry of a robot's configuration space, including its curvature and a configuration-dependent notion of cost, yields shorter, lower-energy, and more natural trajectories than planning under the ambient flat metric. Existing libraries for optimization on manifolds provide rich geometric primitives but do not plan around obstacles. While general-purpose motion planning libraries support many state spaces and custom distance functions, they do not yet treat a configuration-dependent Riemannian metric as the geometry that drives distance, interpolation, and geodesics. We present geodex, an open-source C++20 library with Python bindings. The library exposes the manifold, its Riemannian metric, the retraction, and the sampler as independent, interchangeable components through a single sampling-based motion planning interface. The same planner runs unchanged on canonical spaces $\mathbb{R}^n$, $\mathbb{T}^n$, $\mathbb{S}^n$, matrix Lie groups such as $SO(2)$, $SE(2)$, $SO(3)$, and $SE(3)$, products of these spaces, and articulated-robot configuration spaces, each equipped with a user-defined Riemannian metric. We make geodex publicly available with documentation, tests, and a reproducible benchmark suite.

</details>


### [461] [Beyond Reconstruction: What Matters in Action Tokenization for Robot Policies?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09170)
*Haoran Chen,Jingtian Ji,Samuel Wheeler,Kaylene Caswell Stocking,Matthew Walter*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: ProAct是一种策略无关的动作分词器训练方法，通过在重构目标中战略性引入增强，提升下游策略的可预测性与鲁棒性，在多个基准和真实机器人任务上显著提升成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自回归动作-令牌策略（如VLA模型）依赖动作分词器将离散令牌序列映射为连续空间中的精确控制动作。现有方法多通过重构目标学习令牌与动作之间的映射，但作者通过分析表明，准确的动作重构只是策略成功的一部分；策略还需能对新观测预测出正确令牌，且未见过的令牌预测仍能解码为合理动作。这些特性源于分词器训练，却未被单独的重构目标直接激励。

Method: 提出ProAct（Predictable and Robust Action Tokenization），一种分词器训练方法，通过在重构目标基础上进行战略性增强，以提升下游可预测性与鲁棒性。该方法与策略无关，仅使用动作数据集训练，可适配多种分词器架构。

Result: 在Robomimic、LIBERO与RoboTwin基准上，跨多种分词器架构，ProAct平均提升rollout成功率11.3个百分点；在视觉-语言-动作策略上平均提升21.8个百分点，在真实机器人操作上平均提升36.7个百分点。

Conclusion: 有效的动作分词应被设计为一种策略接口，在保真度、可预测性与鲁棒性之间取得平衡，而非单纯视为重构问题。

Abstract: Autoregressive action-token policies such as vision-language-action models require action tokenizers to translate discrete token sequences into precise control actions in continuous space. Many action tokenizers learn the mapping between tokens and actions via a reconstruction objective. However, as we show through extensive analysis, sufficiently accurate action reconstruction is only one part of what makes a downstream robot policy successful. It is also critical that the policy is able to predict the right tokens for new observations, and that unseen policy token predictions still decode into reasonable actions. These properties are downstream of tokenizer training and are not directly incentivized by a reconstruction objective alone. In this work, we introduce Predictable and Robust Action Tokenization (ProAct), a tokenizer training method that strategically augments reconstruction with the goal of improving downstream predictability and robustness. ProAct is policy-agnostic and uses only action datasets for training. Across the Robomimic, LIBERO, and RoboTwin benchmarks and a diverse set of tokenizer architectures, ProAct improves rollout success by an average of 11.3 percentage points. These improvements also translate to vision-language-action policies and real-world robotic manipulation, yielding average gains of 21.8 and 36.7 percentage points, respectively. These results suggest that effective action tokenization should be designed as a policy interface that balances fidelity, predictability, and robustness, rather than as a reconstruction problem alone.

</details>


### [462] [CAP: Codebook-Aligned Prediction for Tokenized Robot Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09178)
*Haoran Chen,Jingtian Ji,Samuel Wheeler,Kaylene Caswell Stocking,Matthew Walter*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出Codebook-Aligned Prediction (CAP)，将动作tokenizer的码本向量直接复用为策略分类头原型，在多种量化器、仿真基准和真机任务上一致提升成功率，且该增益并非源于token准确率提升，而是码本结构使token预测误差在动作空间更温和。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于tokenizer的策略将离散token视为互不相关的类别索引，丢弃了tokenizer学到的潜在码本结构，并从头训练新的分类器。作者认为这种被丢弃的结构具有价值。

Method: CAP直接复用tokenizer的码本向量作为策略的类别原型，tokenizer与策略主干网络保持其他部分不变，在四种量化器家族、三个仿真基准与两个真机任务上进行验证，并进行消融与分析。

Result: CAP在保持tokenizer及其重建质量不变的前提下，一致优于标准token分类头，任务成功率提升；分析表明增益并非来自更高的token准确率或仅策略头的变化。

Conclusion: 复用码本为策略提供了tokenizer跨token学习到的潜在结构信息，使token预测误差在动作空间中更温和，并改进了策略主干的表征；动作tokenizer学到的动作感知潜在结构在下游策略训练中应当被保留。

Abstract: Action tokenization converts continuous robot actions into discrete symbols that can be modeled autoregressively. However, existing tokenizer-based policies typically ignore the tokenizer's learned latent code structure: after tokenization, the policy treats tokens as unrelated class indices and learns a new classifier from scratch. We show that this discarded structure is valuable. We introduce Codebook-Aligned Prediction (CAP), a method that directly reuses the tokenizer's code vectors as policy class prototypes while leaving the tokenizer and policy backbone otherwise unchanged. Across four quantizer families, three simulation benchmarks, and two real-robot tasks, CAP consistently improves task success over standard token classification heads while holding the tokenizer (and therefore its reconstruction quality) fixed. Our analysis further shows that these gains are not explained by higher token accuracy or changes in the policy head alone. Instead, reusing the tokenizer codebook provides the policy with valuable information about the tokenizer's learned latent structure across tokens, making token prediction errors more benign in action space and improving the representations learned by the policy backbone. These results suggest that action tokenizers learn useful action-aware latent structure beyond discrete targets that should be preserved when training downstream policies.

</details>


### [463] [Embedded Evaluation of Task Admission Coalescing in Decentralized Multi-Robot Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09187)
*James Lott,Vahraz Honary*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该研究评估多机器人任务分配器中的"任务准入合并"机制，通过AGX Orin与RP2040两类平台的实验，比较即时应答与不同批处理阈值对分配器计算负载和目标服务时延的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动态任务场景下的多机器人任务分配器通常一有新任务到达就立即触发分配，导致处理器工作量大。作者希望考察任务准入合并能否在控制分配器计算开销与目标服务时延之间取得平衡。

Method: 以CBAA、ACBBA、PI、HIPC为代表性MRTA算法，开展3000任务AGX Orin实测延迟实验、3000组配对零计算实验，以及96任务Pololu 3pi+ RP2040硬件在环实验。比较即时应答（Eager）与阈值2、4、8任务及"4任务+10秒等待上限"策略，覆盖三种任务到达率。

Result: AGX实验中，合并策略在48个条件中的31个减少了分配器调用与处理器工作量，但节省幅度因算法而异。主要代价出现在稀疏到达场景，4任务批处理使在线目标平均时延增加20.08–23.57秒，主要源于准入等待。有界准入在12个分配器负载条件中的10个降低平均工作量，其中高到达率HIPC降低19.35%工作量、平均时延仅增1.40秒。RP2040实验中该权衡更有利：中等到达率HIPC场景下Count b=4使平均工作量降59.85%、服务时延降39.47%，而对应AGX场景时延反增27.69%。

Conclusion: 任务准入合并的有效性取决于任务到达强度、具体分配器行为以及执行平台上计算成本的相对高低；在处理器受限的平台上，合并策略可能同时改善计算负载与服务时延。

Abstract: Multi-robot task allocators in dynamic missions commonly admit newly released tasks immediately, potentially invoking allocation for each new arrival. We evaluate task-admission coalescing as a mechanism for controlling allocator processor work while accounting for target-service latency, using CBAA, ACBBA, PI, and HIPC as a representative MRTA suite. The study comprises a 3,000-mission AGX Orin campaign with measured computation delay, 3,000 paired zero-compute missions, and a 96-mission Pololu 3pi+ RP2040 allocator hardware-in-the-loop campaign. Immediate (Eager) admission is compared with thresholds of two, four, and eight tasks and a four-task policy with a 10-s waiting bound across three arrival rates. Across the AGX experiments, coalescing reduces both allocator calls and processor work in 31 of 48 evaluated conditions, although the magnitude of the saving varies by allocator. The principal cost appears under sparse arrivals, where four-task batching increases online-target mean latency by 20.08-23.57 s, predominantly through admission waiting. Bounded admission reduces mean work in ten of twelve allocator-load conditions, including a 19.35% reduction with a 1.40-s mean latency increase for high-arrival HIPC. RP2040 experiments show that this tradeoff can become more favorable as processor constraints tighten. Across four matched medium-arrival HIPC scenarios, Count b=4 reduces mean RP2040 work by 59.85% and service latency by 39.47%, while the corresponding AGX cases increase latency by 27.69%. These results show that the usefulness of task-admission coalescing depends on arrival intensity, allocator-specific behavior, and the relative cost of computation on the execution platform.

</details>


### [464] [Belief-Space Planning with Planner-Conditioned Estimator Error under Intermittent Observations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09207)
*Peter M. Donley,Joseph L. Moore*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出一种信念空间规划方法，通过预测、传播并惩罚规划器条件下的估计器误差，提升间歇随机修正场景下的规划性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 信念空间规划器与独立设计或现成的估计器分离，估计器可能无法观测到规划器所掌握的状态相关信息；因此即使估计器自身信息下均方误差最小，在规划器信息条件下其误差均值也可能非零。当未来修正是间歇且随机的，接受与拒绝修正的误差均值差异会引入零均值假设所忽略的额外不确定性。

Method: 用规划器条件下的估计器误差模型，将仿射误差动态与保留随机修正不确定性的矩递推相结合；提出在指定运行工况内预测估计器误差动态的方法，并将预测误差矩纳入任务加权二次风险目标。

Result: 在倾转旋翼VTOL舰船甲板着陆仿真中采用滚动时域规划评估：对命令盲EKF，条件化于规划器信息使误差预测损失较规划器无知模型降低13.4%，预测能力强烈依赖工况与时域；16组配对闭环试验中，规划器将终端任务指标中位数由1.60降至0.99，对2s以外的估计器误差预测误差在1.3倍以内，而仅用协方差的规划低估达5.7倍。

Conclusion: 将规划器条件下的估计器误差显式建模并纳入规划目标，可有效降低误差预测损失并改善闭环任务表现，优于仅考虑协方差的规划。

Abstract: Belief-space planners with separately designed or off-the-shelf estimators may have access to state-relevant information the estimator does not observe. Consequently, even an estimator that minimizes mean-squared error under its own information can have a nonzero error mean when conditioned on planner information. When future corrections are intermittent and stochastic, differences between accepted and rejected error means introduce additional uncertainty terms to correction events that zero-mean assumptions ignore. In this paper, we propose a belief-space planning approach that predicts, propagates, and penalizes planner-conditioned estimator error along evaluated trajectories. A planner-conditioned estimator-error model combines affine error dynamics with a moment recursion that preserves stochastically-induced correction uncertainty. We describe a method by which to predict estimator error dynamics within specified operating regimes and incorporate predicted error moments into a task-weighted quadratic risk objective. We evaluate the approach in simulation for a tilt-rotor VTOL landing on a ship deck using receding-horizon planning. We find that conditioning on planner information reduced error-prediction loss for a command-blind EKF by 13.4% relative to a planner-ignorant model, with strongly regime and horizon-dependent forecasting abilities. In a small set of 16 paired closed-loop trials, the planner lowered the median terminal task gauge from 1.60 to 0.99, and predicted estimator error beyond 2s within a factor of 1.3, versus a 5.7-fold underprediction by covariance-only planning.

</details>


### [465] [Fast Planning for Multi-object Multi-target Throwing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09224)
*Zhengming Zhu,Yang Liu,Xiao Gao,Aude Billard*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出首个面向多物体多目标抛掷(MOMT)的统一规划框架，利用仿人手高自由度，通过离线可行集建模与在线快速匹配滤波，在5 ms内生成多物体连续抛掷轨迹。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人抛掷可扩大工作空间并加速流程，但单物体抛掷吞吐量受限。为提高吞吐量，需要让机器人一次挥动抛掷多个物体（MOMT），其难点在于短轨迹时长与短规划时间之间的复杂权衡。

Method: 两阶段方法：离线阶段结合物体倒置飞行动力学与机器人运动学、动力学，构建可行集模型；在线阶段通过快速解匹配以及物体有效分离状态与机器人可行状态的滤波，生成可组成抛掷序列的可行抛掷，规划时间小于5 ms。在带多指手的7自由度机械臂上验证。

Result: 仿真中两物体协同抛掷相比独立单物体规划执行时间最多减少46%，扩展到三物体时改进仍保持；真实实验两物体减少29%，与理论50%的差距源于抛掷间过渡开销。目标位置执行中随机改变时，系统无需停机即在100 ms延迟内重新规划并命中新目标。

Conclusion: 该工作建立了首个MOMT抛掷的统一规划框架，仿真中验证了多物体可扩展性，真实场景验证了两物体可行性，推动了高通量机器人操作的发展。

Abstract: Robot throwing has emerged as a promising technique for improving efficiency in logistics and warehouse automation, by enlarging the workspace and speeding up the process. To significantly increase the throwing system's throughput, we develop strategies for throwing multiple objects in one swipe. Such multi-object multi-target throwing (MOMT) leverages the large degrees of freedom of anthropomorphic hands. The key is to quickly generate fast and feasible throwing motions, which involves a complex trade-off between short trajectory duration and short planning time. We solve this problem in two stages. Offline, we build a model of the feasible set by combining object's inverted flying dynamics and the robot's kinematics and dynamics. Online, we generate feasible throws through fast solution matching and filtering of object's valid detach state and robot's feasible state that can compose sequences of throws in less than 5 ms. We validate the framework on a 7-DoF manipulator equipped with a multi-fingered hand. In simulation, coordinated two-object throwing reduces execution time by up to 46% compared to independent single-object planning, and this improvement is maintained when scaling to three objects. Real-world experiments with two objects confirm a 29% reduction; the remaining gap to the theoretical 50% is attributed to inter-throw transition overhead. When target positions are randomly changed mid-execution, the system re-plans and successfully reaches the new targets within 100 ms latency without stopping the robot. These results establish the first unified planning framework for MOMT throwing -- demonstrating scalability to multiple objects in simulation and real-world feasibility on two-object tasks -- advancing the frontier of high-throughput robotic manipulation. A video summarizing the method and the hardware experiments is available at https://liuyangdh.github.io/momt-video

</details>


### [466] [Co-Evolving Robot Orchestrators and Policies through Deployment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09228)
*Xilun Zhang,Maggie Wang,Erik Bauer,Hong-Xing Yu,Huang Huang,Jiajun Wu,Marco Pavone*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出Robo-COP，让VLM编排器与VLA策略在部署中协同演化，通过从自身执行中筛选技能演示、按需微调策略并验证后采纳，解决冻结策略成为系统瓶颈的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于大规模数据训练的VLA策略在训练域内表现良好，但在真实部署中泛化能力不足。现有智能体机器人系统用VLM编排器来学习何时调用策略、如何指示策略以及何时使用脚本技能，但编排器围绕一个语言可控性有限的冻结策略构建，因此只能规避策略的失败却无法克服它们，策略成为整个系统的瓶颈。而单独微调策略又会使其与针对旧行为调优的编排器解耦。

Method: Robo-COP让编排器与策略在部署过程中协同演化：系统从自身执行中筛选技能演示数据；当这些数据能够解决反复出现的失败时对策略进行微调；仅当新策略在其所训练技能上确有提升时才予以采纳。

Result: 在十个仿真RoboLab任务上，Robo-COP将平均留出成功率从64.8%提升至73.8%，而相同框架下冻结策略以及按固定计划无验证微调的方法仅达到65.8%。在三个真实世界任务上，Robo-COP将留出成功率从38.3%提升至50.0%。

Conclusion: Robo-COP将部署过程转变为自改进的飞轮：机器人边做边学，每次执行能力的提升都会为下一轮学习产生更好的数据。

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies trained on large datasets are capable within their training domains, yet they still fail to generalize to the variety of situations a robot meets in real-world deployment. Agentic robot systems complement the policy with a vision-language model (VLM) orchestrator that learns when to call the policy, how to instruct it, and when to use scripted skills instead. However, because the harness is built around a frozen policy that has limited language steerability, the orchestrator can avoid the policy's failures but never overcome them. The policy becomes the bottleneck of the whole system. Fine-tuning the policy can remove this bottleneck, but updating it alone decouples it from an orchestrator tuned to its old behavior. We propose Robo-COP, in which the orchestrator and policy co-evolve during deployment. Robo-COP curates skill demonstrations from its own executions, fine-tunes the policy when this data can address recurring failures, and adopts each new policy only after it improves the skills it was trained for. Across ten simulated RoboLab tasks, Robo-COP raises mean held-out success from 64.8% to 73.8% over the same harness with a frozen policy, while fine-tuning on a fixed schedule without verification reaches only 65.8%. On three real-world tasks, Robo-COP raises held-out success from 38.3% to 50.0%. Robo-COP turns deployment into a self-improving flywheel in which robots learn by doing, with each improvement in execution producing better data for the next round of learning. Videos and code are available at https://robo-cop.pages.dev/.

</details>


### [467] [RoboRender: Robot-Oriented Video Generation for Visual Sim-to-Real Transfer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09254)
*Huang Huang,Wensi Ai,Ziyu Chen,Youhui Wang,Zijian Du,Yang Liu,Jiaolong Yang,Li Fei-Fei,Jiajun Wu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: RoboRender 将仿真轨迹转化为照片级真实的 RGB 视频用于策略学习，在真实世界任务中以 71% 平均成功率实现零样本迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 仿真可大规模、低成本生成机器人数据，但仿真中训练的策略因视觉 sim-to-real 差异难以迁移到真实世界。现有方法多依赖中间表示，会丢失丰富语义信息，或需在部署时增加额外感知模块。

Method: RoboRender 训练一个面向机器人的视频生成模型，以仿真深度视频、语言指令和机器人 RGB mask 视频为条件，保留仿真器几何、机器人运动与动作标签，同时合成真实纹理、背景与干扰物；生成的 RGB 视频与仿真器提供的状态和动作配对，用于训练可零样本部署的策略。

Result: 在机器人视频测试集上，该视频模型生成质量优于深度条件视频生成基线。真实世界实验中，在抓取放置、铰接物体操作和移动操作任务上，使用 RoboRender 生成数据训练的策略达到 71% 平均成功率，分别约为原始仿真渲染和常规视觉域随机化的 7.1 倍和 3.6 倍；每条仿真轨迹生成更多视频可提升策略性能，开盒任务成功率提高 65 个百分点。

Conclusion: 生成式视频渲染能够缓解视觉 sim-to-real 差距，实现零样本策略迁移。项目网站：https://robo-render.github.io/。

Abstract: Simulation enables large-scale, low-cost robot data generation, but policies trained in simulation often fail to transfer to the real world due to the sim-to-real visual discrepancies. Existing approaches often rely on intermediate representations, which can discard rich semantic information or require additional perception modules at deployment. We address this visual sim-to-real gap with RoboRender, a framework that converts simulated trajectories into photorealistic RGB videos for policy learning. RoboRender trains a robot-oriented video generation model conditioned on simulated depth videos, language instructions, and robot RGB mask videos, preserving simulator geometry, robot motion, and action labels while synthesizing realistic textures, backgrounds, and distractors. The generated RGB videos are paired with simulator-provided states and actions to train policies for zero-shot real-world deployment. On robot video test sets, our video model outperforms depth-conditioned video generation baselines in generation quality. In real-world experiments across pick-and-place, articulated-object manipulation, and mobile manipulation tasks, policies trained on RoboRender-generated data achieve a 71% average success rate, outperforming raw simulation renderings and conventional visual domain randomization by approximately 7.1x and 3.6x, respectively. We further show that policy performance improves with more generated videos per simulation trajectory, increasing opening-task success by 65 percentage points. These results demonstrate that generative video rendering mitigates the visual sim-to-real gap for zero-shot policy transfer. Project website: https://robo-render.github.io/.

</details>


### [468] [LACE-CRAFT: Robot Co-Design with Actor Inheritance and Blackboard Collaboration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09283)
*Yuhan Wen,Jiawei Wang,Qixuan Zhang,Yusen Qin,Lan Xu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文提出LACE-CRAFT框架，将机器人协同设计中的形态搜索与策略学习耦合，通过延续学习与策略适应对比，在五个运动基准上平均得分比D2C高6.4-91.9%，并完成实物原型验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人协同设计通常将形态搜索与策略学习结合，但从零训练每个新设计会丢弃已获得的控制经验，造成学习效率低、样本浪费。作者希望利用延续学习保留已有策略经验，并系统比较“继续训练当前机器人”与“适应到新形态-奖励对”两条路径。

Method: 提出LACE-CRAFT。LACE恢复当前最优设计的完整学习状态，并用其actor参数与观测统计初始化兼容的挑战者设计；固定任务指标在两条分支与冻结的当前最优之间选择。CRAFT通过共享实验记录和行为回放协调Feedback、Morphology、Reward、Integration四种角色，生成并交叉评审成对提案。生成式扩展将生成网格转换为可编辑的articulated模型，配置关节、执行器接口并持续更新仿真资产。

Result: 在五个locomotion基准上，三种评估种子的平均得分比D2C高6.4-91.9%。两种方法均在五轮中训练30个新的形态-奖励对；LACE额外使用四个延续训练单元。五任务消融实验考察了策略继承与回放反馈的作用。制作的原型展示了室内行走，并说明了从几何到硬件的流程。

Conclusion: 通过延续学习复用已有控制经验，并结合多角色协同的形态-奖励提案与评审机制，可显著提升机器人协同设计的性能；生成式建模到可编辑articulated模型及实物原型的流程具备可行性。

Abstract: Robot co-design couples morphology search with policy learning, yet training every new design from scratch discards acquired control experience. We present LACE-CRAFT, which compares continued learning on the current robot with policy adaptation to new morphology-reward pairs. LACE resumes the incumbent's full learning state and initializes compatible challengers with its actor parameters and observation statistics. A fixed task metric selects among both branches and the frozen incumbent. CRAFT coordinates Feedback, Morphology, Reward, and Integration roles through shared experimental records and behavioral replays to generate and cross-review paired proposals. A generative extension converts generated meshes into editable articulated models with configured joints, actuator interfaces, and consistently updated simulation assets. Across five locomotion benchmarks, mean scores over three evaluation seeds are 6.4-91.9% higher than D2C. Both methods train 30 new morphology-reward pairs over five rounds; LACE additionally uses four continuation training units. Five-task ablations examine policy inheritance and replay-derived feedback. A fabricated prototype demonstrates indoor walking and illustrates the geometry-to-hardware workflow.

</details>


### [469] [Co${}^{2}$Skill: Whole-Body Control via Skill Composition for Long-Horizon Human-Environment Interaction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09291)
*Jeonghwan Kim,Hyeonwoo Kim,Hanbyul Joo*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出统一策略框架Co²Skill，将全身场景交互与灵巧物体操作整合进单一策略，实现对坐、站、攀爬、上下楼梯及目标导向操作等任务，并支持顺序执行与技能组合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 复杂非结构化环境中达到人类级灵巧性，需要全身场景交互与灵巧物体操作的深度融合。然而现有基于物理的控制器虽能在各自领域生成物理上合理的行为，却基本将这两种能力独立处理，缺乏统一整合。

Method: 基于预训练运动先验构建统一策略，采用任务与阶段相关的观测掩码筛选与当前交互目标相关的信息；提出目标条件的移动-操作课程，结合部分参考引导以保证精度，并从多样初始状态探索，允许超出示范轨迹的目标导向执行；引入跨任务课程，联合训练单项技能与选定任务序列，跨任务边界保持物理状态并在后续场景交互中维持抓取。

Result: 在坐、站、攀爬、楼梯穿越和目标导向操作上进行了评估，并测试了顺序执行与随机不同条件下的表现；同时在室内环境中演示了技能组合，表明这些技能可在同一控制公式下实现集成。

Conclusion: Co²Skill通过统一策略公式成功将场景交互与灵巧操作整合，支持顺序任务执行以及场景交互与物体操作的同时进行，验证了技能组合在统一控制框架下的可行性。

Abstract: Achieving human-level dexterity in complex, unstructured environments requires the seamless integration of whole-body scene interaction and dexterous object manipulation skills. While existing physics-based controllers generate physically plausible behaviors in each domain, they largely address these two capabilities independently. In this paper, we present Co${}^{2}$Skill that integrates scene interaction and dexterous manipulation through a unified policy formulation. Built on a pretrained motion prior, the policy uses task and phase dependent observation masks to select information relevant to the current interaction goals. We introduce a goal-conditioned loco-manipulation curriculum that combines partial reference guidance for precision with exploration from varied initial states while allowing goal-directed execution beyond the demonstrated trajectories. We further introduce a cross-task curriculum that jointly trains individual skills and selected task sequences, preserving physical states across task boundaries and maintaining grasps during subsequent scene interactions. Together, these support sequential task execution and simultaneous scene interaction with object manipulation. We evaluate sitting, standing, climbing, stair traversal, and goal-directed manipulation, together with sequential execution and with random different conditions. Additionally, we demonstrate skill compositions in indoor environments, illustrating their integration within the same control formulation.

</details>


### [470] [Adaptive Risk-Certified Event-Triggered Replanning for Dynamic Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09302)
*Richie R. Suganda,Bin Hu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出CERT-Replan框架：用校准后的障碍风险作为重规划预警信号，结合一步安全滤波与视界级风险监控，在非平稳动态环境中提升安全性与计算可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动态环境中障碍预测误差不确定、非平稳，可能引发罕见但安全攸关的失效。现有控制障碍函数安全滤波器只能拒绝即时不安全控制，无法判断当前有限视界规划模式本身何时变得不安全。

Method: 在线校准按视界索引的障碍预测残差，得到不确定性半径以评估动态障碍安全裕度；一步安全滤波器保护下一个控制量；视界级风险监控沿当前MPC轨迹评估预测障碍违反损失的CVaR上尾；当风险超预算则拒绝当前规划模式并选择低风险替代方案（如不同速度剖面、走廊或同伦类），而非反复修正同一标称规划。

Result: 非平稳基准中，相比仅安全滤波基线碰撞减少83.3%，相比简单重规划触发减少77.8%，安全滤波平均干预降低32.4%；结合Trajectron++实现96%无碰撞运行；硬件实验与机载运行时分析验证计算可行性。

Conclusion: CERT-Replan通过校准风险作为早期预警实现了更早、更全局的重规划决策，在保证安全的同时降低干预频率，且具备实际部署的计算可行性。

Abstract: Safe navigation in dynamic environments requires robots to plan under obstacle predictions whose errors are uncertain, non-stationary, and can induce rare but safety-critical failures. Existing control-barrier-function safety filters can reject immediately unsafe controls, but they provide little guidance on when the current finite-horizon planning mode itself is becoming unsafe as prediction uncertainty evolves. We propose Conformal Event-Triggered Risk-Certified Replanning (\emph{CERT-Replan}), a framework that uses calibrated barrier risk as an early-warning signal for replanning. CERT-Replan calibrates horizon-indexed obstacle-prediction residuals online and uses the resulting uncertainty radii to evaluate dynamic-obstacle safety margins. A one-step safety filter protects the next applied control, while a horizon-level risk monitor evaluates the upper-tail CVaR of predicted barrier-violation losses along the current MPC rollout. When this risk exceeds an allocated budget, CERT-Replan rejects the current planning mode and selects a lower-risk alternative, such as a different speed profile, corridor, or homotopy class, rather than repeatedly correcting the same nominal plan. In a non-stationary benchmark, CERT-Replan achieves an \(83.3\%\) collision reduction relative to the safety-filter-only baseline \textcolor{black}{and a \(77.8\%\) reduction relative to simple replanning triggers}, while reducing average safety-filter intervention by \(32.4\%\). \textcolor{black}{With Trajectron++, CERT-Replan achieves \(96\%\) collision-free operation. Hardware experiments and onboard runtime profiling demonstrate computational feasibility.}

</details>


### [471] [Predicted Futures Are Not Enough: Learning Executable Goals for Robot Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09309)
*Tzu-Yu Chuang,Ching-Hsiang Chang,Yi-Hsiu Lee,Yi-Ting Chen,Min Sun,YuanFu Yang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出"实体级目标读出"(Entity-Level Goal Readout)接口，将3D轨迹世界模型的预测显式转换为可执行的SE(3)末端目标，并用共享的Pose-Native执行器实现闭环控制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式世界模型能预测操作场景的演化，但其未来预测并不直接暴露控制所需的紧凑任务变量；仅以未来预测为监督目标时，末端目标精度并非显式学习目标，导致预测与执行之间存在接口缺失。

Method: 将物体中心的位姿预测与基于观测深度的平移估计相结合，把世界模型输出读出一个紧凑的SE(3)目标；由共享的Pose-Native Executor以该固定目标加在线物体位姿反馈进行闭环控制，无需重跑世界模型。并设计目标诊断与受控平移扰动实验来量化目标误差对执行的影响。

Result: 在五项操作任务上平均成功率79.69%；Franka机械臂零样本部署：标称StackCube 73.33%，含干扰物66.67%，PickPlate（策略训练中未见目标）75.00%。

Conclusion: 应将预测到执行的接口视为世界模型规划中一个显式学习的组件，而非控制流程中附带的后期处理。

Abstract: Generative world models provide rich predictions of how manipulation scenes may evolve toward task objectives, yet those futures do not directly expose the compact task variables required by control. When training supervises future prediction alone, terminal goal accuracy is not an explicit learning objective, even when geometric recovery is available. We present Entity-Level Goal Readout, a learned prediction-to-execution interface that makes the executable terminal goal an explicit output of a 3D trace world model. It combines object-centric pose prediction with translation grounded in observed depth to produce a compact goal in SE(3). A shared Pose-Native Executor consumes this fixed goal with online object-pose feedback for closed-loop control without rerunning the world model. Across five manipulation tasks, the pipeline achieves a mean success rate of 79.69%. Goal diagnostics directly measure terminal goal accuracy, while controlled translation perturbations characterize how execution degrades under goal error. Zero-shot deployment on a Franka arm achieves 73.33% success on nominal StackCube, 66.67% with distractors, and 75.00% on PickPlate with a target unseen during policy training. These results support treating the prediction-to-execution interface as an explicit learned component of world-model planning rather than incidental post-processing in the control pipeline itself. Project page: https://claire0730.github.io/executable-goals/

</details>


### [472] [ClimbLab: MATLAB Simulation Platform for Legged Climbing Robotics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09315)
*Kentaro Uno,Warley F. R. Ribeiro,Yusuke Koizumi,Keigo Haji,Koki Kurihara,William Jones,Kazuya Yoshida*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文介绍了一个开源的MATLAB仿真与分析平台，用于腿式攀爬机器人，支持浮基多体建模、任意环境下的行走与攀爬仿真。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 面向腿式攀爬机器人研究，提供统一、开源且可定制的仿真与分析工具，便于设计任意肢体机器人系统并复现其行走与攀爬行为。

Method: 构建基于MATLAB的仿真平台：将机器人建模为带浮基的铰接多体系统；引入刚体动力学引擎；环境可变参数包括倾角、重力和地面刚度，并支持以任意点云作为地形地图；给出仿真器结构、计算流程。

Result: 展示了代表性仿真示例，四足机器人可贴附墙面抓握或在陡坡上攀爬。

Conclusion: 该开源平台能够为腿式攀爬机器人提供通用的建模、仿真与分析能力，支持在可控环境参数和自定义地形下验证行走与攀爬性能。

Abstract: This paper presents an open-sourced MATLAB simulation and analysis platform dedicated to legged climbing robots. This simulator enables the design of any limbed robotic system as an articulated multi-body with a floating base and simulates it walking and climbing in an arbitrary environment. The main variable environmental parameters are inclination, gravity, and ground stiffness, and any point cloud can be installed as the terrain map. Furthermore, the simulator employs a rigid body dynamics engine. This paper first describes the simulator structure, and the computational flow and next presents the representative simulation examples where quadrupedal robots assumed gripping on the wall or climbing on the steep slope.

</details>


### [473] [MCFR: A Mask-Guided Coarse-to-Fine Regression Framework for Robust Multi-Variant Board-to-Board Connector Assembly](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09327)
*Guanghui Shen,Song Wang,Dan Wu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出MCFR框架，用于多型号BTB连接器的自动化插装，通过掩码引导的粗到精回归与光度细化，在真实装配中实现99.25%的平均插入成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 3C制造中BTB连接器自动插装需兼具高视觉精度与部署鲁棒性。难点在于：多型号连接器形态与外观差异大，跨型号泛化困难；固定视角检测下训练与部署不匹配，引入背景伪相关，导致真实场景性能退化。

Method: 提出MCFR（Mask-Guided Coarse-to-Fine Regression）框架：引入目标感知的掩码先验，抑制背景干扰；采用由粗到精的回归策略提升对齐精度；结合显式光度细化增强实际部署中的鲁棒性。

Result: 在自建多型号数据集、BTB批量插装测试平台及真实智能手机装配任务上，MCFR持续优于代表性基线方法，真实场景平均插入成功率达99.25%。

Conclusion: MCFR对多型号BTB连接器自动装配具有有效性与实际应用潜力。

Abstract: Automated insertion of board-to-board (BTB) connectors in 3C manufacturing requires both high visual accuracy and strong deployment robustness. This problem remains challenging because multi-variant connectors exhibit significant morphological and appearance variations, making stable cross-variant generalization difficult, while the mismatch between training and deployment under fixed-view inspection settings induces background spurious correlation and degrades real-world performance. To address these issues, this paper proposes MCFR, a Mask-Guided Coarse-to-Fine Regression framework for multi-variant BTB connector assembly. By introducing an object-aware mask prior and explicit photometric refinement, the proposed method suppresses background interference and improves alignment accuracy and robustness in practical deployment. Experiments on a self-constructed multi-variant dataset, a BTB batch insertion testbed, and a real smartphone assembly task show that MCFR consistently outperforms representative baselines and achieves an average real-world insertion success rate of 99.25%. These results demonstrate the effectiveness and practical potential of MCFR for automated assembly of multi-variant BTB connectors.

</details>


### [474] [Learning Unknown Constraints without Unsafe Data via Optimality and Counterfactual Regularization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09350)
*Zhouyu Zhang,Chih-Yuan Chiu,Glen Chou*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出 CF-KKT，通过学习的可微动力学模型与反事实行为生成，将 KKT 最优性条件引入约束学习，在无需已知动力学和在线探索的情况下从局部最优示范中恢复未知约束，兼具 CIOC 的数据效率/安全性与 ICRL 的灵活性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从示范中学习约束（LfD）现有两条路线各有局限：CIOC 利用 KKT 等最优性条件但假设动力学已知且约束表示结构化；ICRL 可处理未知约束与未知转移动力学，却需要大量在线探索，期间可能发生不安全约束违背。作者希望融合两者优势，在未知动力学、无额外危险探索的前提下高效安全地学习约束。

Method: 提出 Counterfactual KKT（CF-KKT）框架：1）用局部学习的可微动力学模型，将 KKT 启发式最优性条件直接施加在示范上；2）用该动力学生成示范附近的"奖励改进"反事实行为，揭示在无未知约束时更优的行为，从而获得合成的不可行数据。当约束参数化已知时，同一框架可直接进行 CIOC 式参数恢复，并刻画其对动力学误设的敏感性。

Result: 在高维机器人控制任务上，相比最先进的离线 ICRL 基线，该方法学习到神经约束表示，并在安全性和数据效率上均有提升。

Conclusion: CF-KKT 表明，借助学习动力学与反事实合成不可行样本，可在不依赖已知动力学与在线危险探索的条件下有效恢复未知约束，为离线约束学习提供了兼顾安全性与数据效率的可行路径。

Abstract: Learning from demonstrations (LfD) provides a framework for inferring unknown constraints from locally optimal, constraint-satisfying expert behavior. Existing approaches largely fall into two paradigms, constrained inverse optimal control (CIOC) and inverse constrained reinforcement learning (ICRL). CIOC exploits optimality conditions such as the Karush--Kuhn--Tucker (KKT) conditions but typically assumes known dynamics and structured constraint representations. Meanwhile, ICRL accommodates complex unknown constraints and unknown transition dynamics but often requires extensive online exploration, during which unsafe constraint violations may occur. In this work, we introduce Counterfactual KKT (CF-KKT), a constraint learning framework that leverages learned dynamics and locally optimal demonstrations to recover unknown constraints without requiring known dynamics or additional risky exploration, thereby combining the data efficiency and safety advantages of CIOC with the flexibility of ICRL. First, we use a locally learned differentiable dynamics model to impose KKT-inspired optimality conditions directly on the demonstrations. Second, we use the learned dynamics to generate reward-improving counterfactual behaviors near the demonstrations, revealing behaviors that would be preferable in the absence of the unknown constraint and thus providing synthetic infeasible data. When the constraint parameterization is known, the same learned-dynamics framework enables direct CIOC-based parameter recovery, and we characterize its sensitivity to dynamics misspecification. Across high-dimensional robotic control tasks, our approach learns neural constraint representations with improved safety and data efficiency relative to state-of-the-art offline ICRL baselines.

</details>


### [475] [COOL: Curiosity-Driven Object Ownership Learning for Personalized Robotic Assistance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09358)
*Samira Huber,Ruben Hammele,Sören Pirk*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文提出COOL机器人框架，通过日常观察自主学习物体归属关系，并维护长期空间记忆，实现归属条件化的导航与任务执行。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人需在日常环境中提供个性化服务，须理解"我的背包在哪"这类自然语言指令，涉及对物体实例、人物、位置及归属的推理。难点在于归属关系很少被显式标注，必须从长期的人-物交互行为证据中推断。

Method: COOL是一个自主框架，从日常观察中学习物体归属，并维护环境的长期空间记忆；为保持记忆时效性，采用基于智能体的好奇心驱动数据采集策略，引导机器人前往最有价值的位置以获取信息并刷新过时观察。

Result: 离线实验、消融研究与真实世界评测表明，COOL能从真实交互中推断归属关系，并利用该知识完成归属条件化的导航与任务执行。

Conclusion: COOL验证了从无标注的长期行为观察中自主习得物体归属并用于机器人服务的可行性。

Abstract: Robots are increasingly expected to provide personalized services in everyday environments. To do so, they must ground natural-language commands such as "Where is my backpack?" or "Find my bottle" and execute them by reasoning about object instances, people, locations, and ownership. This is challenging because ownership is rarely labeled explicitly and must be inferred from long-term, behavioral evidence of human-object interactions. To address this, we present COOL, a novel robotic framework for autonomously learning object ownership from everyday observations and maintaining a long-term spatial memory of its environment. To keep its memory current, COOL uses an agent-based curiosity-driven data collection strategy that guides the robot toward the most promising locations to gain information and refresh stale observations. Offline experiments, ablation studies, and real-world evaluations show that COOL can infer ownership relations from real-world interactions and use this knowledge for ownership-conditioned navigation and task execution.

</details>


### [476] [Immiscible Diffusion Policy: Preserving Multimodal Robot Actions through Label-Free Noise Assignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09369)
*Xiao Zhang,Yuxin Chen,Zhixuan Liang,Guojian Zhan,Chenran Li,Chenfeng Xu,Masayoshi Tomizuka,Yiheng Li*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文发现扩散策略常发生模态坍缩，并提出无需标签的训练期插件"Immiscible Diffusion Policy"，通过动作-噪声分配保持噪声到动作路径的相对独立性，从而在多类机器人任务中显著保留动作多模态性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散策略最初被期望能恢复多模态动作分布，但作者发现该期望并不总能成立：即便保证数据集各模态平衡且批内完全对称，扩散策略仍会坍缩为单一模态。作者分析认为，独立采样的动作-噪声配对会增加扩散路径之间的混合与交叉，导致去噪响应被平均化，从而抑制模态特定行为。该问题在机器人规划中尤为严重，因为其动作空间稠密且低维，会进一步加剧这种混合与交叉。

Method: 提出 Immiscible Diffusion Policy（互不相溶扩散策略），一种无需标签、作用于训练阶段的插件式方法，通过动作-噪声分配（action-noise assignment）来保持各噪声到动作路径的相对独立性，且不修改策略网络架构，也不改变推理流程。

Result: 在五个仿真任务与两个真实世界人形机器人操作任务上（涵盖状态、RGB 与点云观测），该方法在保持较强任务性能的同时显著提升了策略对动作模态的保留能力：在三个双模态任务中，将非主导模态的比例提升 6.0 倍至 14.6 倍；在两个四模态任务中，恢复了在原始策略 rollout 中完全缺失的演示模态。

Conclusion: Immiscible Diffusion Policy 为通用机器人学习任务中保留动作多模态性提供了一种简单而稳健的解决方案。

Abstract: When diffusion policies were first introduced, they were expected to recover multi-modal action distributions. However, we find this expectation does not always hold, as diffusion policies often collapse to a single modality even when we guarantee the balance of dataset modalities and exact within-batch symmetry. Our analysis indicates that independent action-noise pairing contributes to this failure by increasing mixing and crossing among diffusion paths, which can produce averaged denoising responses and suppress modality-specific behavior. This issue is especially severe in robot planning, where action spaces are dense and low-dimensional, significantly increasing such mixing and crossing. To alleviate this problem, we propose Immiscible Diffusion Policy, a label-free training-time add-on to diffusion policy that uses action-noise assignment to preserve relatively distinct noise-to-action routes without modifying the policy architecture or inference procedure. Across five simulated and two real-world humanoid manipulation tasks spanning state, RGB, and point-cloud observations, our method significantly improves the policy's preservation of action modalities while maintaining strong task performance. It increases the proportion of the non-dominant modality by 6.0x-14.6x across three two-modality tasks and recovers demonstrated modalities that are entirely absent from vanilla policy rollouts on both four-modality tasks. These results demonstrate that Immiscible Diffusion Policy provides a simple yet robust approach to preserving action multi-modality in general robot learning tasks.

</details>


### [477] [IVG-UAV: An Intelligent Voice-Guided UAV System for Autonomous Ripe Fruit Harvesting with Vision-Based Classification and Adaptive Path Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09398)
*Dinh Trung Duong*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一套语音控制无人机（UAV）自动采摘系统，集成Whisper语音识别、LLM、计算机视觉成熟度分类与自适应路径规划，并在Gazebo仿真环境中建模验证，用于热带大型种植园水果采摘。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 热带地区农业采摘高度依赖人工，在大型农场中导致显著的人工成本与物流复杂性，亟需自动化方案。

Method: 以统一框架整合三部分：基于Whisper与LLM的语音识别、基于计算机视觉的果实成熟度分类、自适应路径规划；整体系统在Gazebo仿真环境下建模。

Result: 在受控农业场景下完成系统建模与验证，可用于性能评估（摘要未给出具体量化指标）。

Conclusion: 语音控制的无人机采摘系统在仿真层面具备可行性，为大型种植园采摘自动化提供了集成化技术路径。

Abstract: In tropical regions, their agricultural sectors remain highly dependent on manual labor for fruit harvesting. On large-scale farms, this dependency often results in significant labor cost and logistic complexities. This project presents the development and simulation of a voice-controlled Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) system designed to automate harvesting tasks in extensive plantations. The proposed system integrates speech recognition using Whisper [1] and LLM, computer vision-based ripeness classification, and adaptive path planning within a unified framework. The entire system is modeled and validated in a Gazebo simulation environment, allowing performance evaluation under controlled agricultural scenarios

</details>


### [478] [TempoBridge: Language-Guided Tempo Control for Vision-Language-Action Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09451)
*Yeonseo Lee,Hyosup Shin,Guebin Hwang,Sungho Jo*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出TempoBridge，一个轻量框架，利用冻结的VLA表示，根据指令中的节奏线索在任务各阶段调制动作，无需节奏条件演示或基策略微调。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLA模型擅长理解"做什么任务"，但对"如何执行"（如快慢）控制能力有限；训练节奏控制需要额外演示或微调，成本高。

Method: 从上下文VLM表示中提取节奏线索，通过因果阶段路由器将其与任务进度对齐，并在执行时调制标称运动指令；基策略与VLA表示保持冻结。

Result: LIBERO任务上节奏成功率从52.6%提升至89.7%，并保持高任务成功率；无节奏线索时接近基线表现；可零训练泛化到未见节奏表达；物理机器人实验验证了真实操作中的语言条件节奏调制。

Conclusion: TempoBridge以轻量方式为VLA模型补足执行节奏控制能力，兼顾任务成功与节奏遵循，并具零样本泛化与真实场景可行性。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are effective at understanding what task to perform, but provide limited control over how it should be executed, such as moving quickly or slowly. We introduce TempoBridge, a lightweight framework that uses frozen VLA representations to modulate actions according to tempo cues in the instruction at each task phase, without additional tempo-conditioned robot demonstrations or tempo-specific base-policy fine-tuning. TempoBridge extracts tempo cues from contextual VLM representations, aligns them with task progress through a causal phase router, and modulates nominal motion commands during execution. Across LIBERO tasks, TempoBridge improves Tempo Success Rate from 52.6% to 89.7% under canonical tempo instructions while retaining high task success. It also preserves near-baseline performance when no tempo cue is present and generalizes to unseen tempo expressions without additional training. Experiments on a physical robot further demonstrate language-conditioned tempo modulation in real-world manipulation.

</details>


### [479] [RobotAPO: Adversarial Physics Preference Optimization for Robotic Manipulation Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09454)
*Kerui Li,Zhe Jing,Chenyi Huang,Xiaofeng Wang,Zheng Zhu,Haoming Cui,Huaibo Huang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出物理偏好数据集 AgiBot-PhysPref 与对抗式物理偏好优化框架 RobotAPO，在流匹配去噪空间中对齐物理一致性，显著提升生成视频的下游机器人执行成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人操作视频常被用作具身智能体的视觉规划，但仅优化视觉合理性无法捕捉真实交互中脆弱的物理流形。交互边界处细微的物理违规（如穿模、物体提前运动）会导致推断的时序与位姿完全失效，而标准监督微调缺乏惩罚此类局部失败的直接压力。

Method: 构建 10,000 样本的物理偏好数据集 AgiBot-PhysPref，隔离条件匹配的物理违规样本，将生成器自身失败分布转化为物理一致性信号；提出 RobotAPO，在连续流匹配去噪空间进行对抗式物理偏好优化，并引入轻量级对抗反事实提议器，学习条件依赖、偏向物理失败方向的去噪扰动，促使模型探索并尊重物理交互边界，同时保持纯提示词与参考帧的推理接口，无需外部结构条件。

Result: 在留出的 AgiBot 条件下，RobotAPO 在物理一致性上较最强受控内部基线提升 6.8% 硬分数与 10.0% 软分数；在真实机器人回放中，将物理一致性增益转化为任务成功率 37.4% 的相对提升。

Conclusion: 显式纠正生成视频中的局部物理违规可有效提升下游机器人执行性能，验证了以物理偏好优化替代纯视觉合理性的必要性与有效性。

Abstract: Robotic manipulation videos are increasingly used as visual plans for embodied agents, but optimizing purely for visual plausibility often fails to capture the fragile physical manifold of real-world interactions. Even minor physics-violating errors at the interaction boundary, such as interpenetration or premature object motion, can completely invalidate the inferred timing and pose needed for downstream execution. Because standard supervised fine-tuning lacks the direct pressure to penalize these localized failures, we introduce AgiBot-PhysPref. This rigorously curated 10,000-sample preference dataset isolates condition-matched physics violations, turning the generator's own failure distribution into a foundational signal for physical consistency. Building upon this, we propose RobotAPO, an adversarial physics preference optimization framework operating in the continuous flow-matching denoising space. To prevent the policy from merely memorizing static curated failures, RobotAPO employs a lightweight adversarial counterfactual proposer that learns a condition-dependent, physical-failure-biased direction in denoising space. This encourages the model to explore and better respect the physical interaction boundary, all while maintaining a pure prompt-and-reference inference interface without requiring external structural conditioning. Comprehensive evaluations demonstrate that explicitly correcting these localized physics violations improves downstream robot execution from generated videos. On held-out AgiBot conditions, RobotAPO outperforms the strongest controlled internal baseline in physical consistency by 6.8% hard score and 10.0% soft score. Crucially, in real-robot replay, it translates these physical-consistency gains into a 37.4% relative improvement in task success over the strongest controlled internal baseline.

</details>


### [480] [TMT: Runtime Backdoor Detection for Vision-Language-Action Policies on Unseen Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09462)
*Zirun Zhou,Jingfeng Zhang,HaoChuan Xu,Xizhe Zhang,Elliott Wen,Jing Sun,Hong Jia*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文提出TMT，一种基于Token流形与隐层转移建模的VLA策略运行时后门检测器，并探索自蒸馏净化方法，在三类后门攻击与未见任务上取得最优检测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA策略被植入后门后，良性任务表现正常，仅在触发条件下产生恶意动作；恶意行为由单看合理的动作构成，且新任务本身会带来观测与行为的正常变化，导致后门激活难以与正常差异区分。

Method: TMT包含两个分支，仅在良性rollout上训练：一支建模输入Token的结构（Token Manifold），另一支建模相邻层隐空间动态的预测误差（latent Transition）。Token流形分支先标记可疑rollout，再经隐空间偏差确认，并用其引导后续监控的转移选择。净化方面采用自蒸馏：冻结的后门策略在良性输入上提供动作监督信号，指导学生在成对的良性/触发观测上学习，无需额外干净参考策略。评估中将传统后门检测器迁移至VLA场景，并将异常检测与故障检测方法改造为VLA后门检测器。

Result: 与十个基线进行事后比较，TMT在三种VLA后门攻击、未见任务设定下达到最先进的后门检测性能。

Conclusion: 通过结合输入Token流形建模与隐层动态转移建模，并配合自蒸馏净化，可在无干净参考策略条件下实现有效的VLA后门运行时检测与缓解。

Abstract: Backdoored vision-language-action (VLA) policies can preserve benign task performance while producing malicious actions when a trigger appears. Detecting such activation is difficult because malicious behavior can comprise individually plausible actions, while unfamiliar tasks introduce legitimate changes in observations and behavior. We introduce TMT, a runtime backdoor detector based on Token Manifold and latent Transition modeling. Trained on benign rollouts, its two branches assess input-token structure and prediction errors in adjacent-layer latent dynamics. A suspicious rollout identified by the token manifold branch, once confirmed through latent deviations, guides transition selection for subsequent monitoring. We further explore policy purification through self-distillation: a frozen copy of the backdoored policy provides benign-input actions to supervise a student on paired benign and triggered observations, without requiring a separate clean reference policy. For evaluation, we adapt traditional backdoor detectors and repurpose anomaly and failure detection methods as VLA backdoor detectors. In a post-hoc comparison with ten baselines, TMT achieves state-of-the-art backdoor detection performance on unseen tasks across three VLA backdoor attacks. Our project page is available at https://zzr42.github.io/tmt/.

</details>


### [481] [Precise SE(3) End-Effector Tracking in Whole-Body Humanoid Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09479)
*Joohwan Seo,Xiaofeng Guo,Jinkun Cao,Roberto Horowitz,Rocky Duan,Guanya Shi,Koushil Sreenath*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出ResGAC全身人形控制器，将几何导纳控制(GAC)与残差强化学习结合，实现人形机器人在移动过程中的精确末端执行器位姿跟踪，并在真实Unitree G1上验证有效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人形机器人全身运动中的末端执行器精确跟踪面临浮动基振荡、重力、动态耦合及行走扰动等挑战，现有方法难以同时兼顾运动与操作的精度。

Method: ResGAC结合几何导纳控制与残差RL：GAC提供结构化的SE(3)任务空间反馈并生成标称手臂关节位置目标；残差RL在共享关节位置动作空间中补偿未建模动态并协调运动与平衡。利用左不变几何表述，同一GAC律可跨操作参考系使用，并采用地面附着航向系，保留平面运动同时去除骨盆滚转、俯仰与垂荡。

Result: 在真实Unitree G1上验证：四项站立末端跟踪基准中持续优于SONIC等基线，平移与旋转误差更低；证实地面附着航向系可减少骨盆运动向末端位姿的传播；站立插孔任务成功率90%（SONIC为50%），并实现下肢运动时的世界坐标系SE(3)末端位姿精确跟踪。

Conclusion: ResGAC通过几何导纳控制与残差RL的融合，配合左不变几何表述与地面附着航向系，有效提升了人形机器人全身运动下的末端执行器跟踪精度与操作成功率。

Abstract: Precise end-effector tracking during humanoid whole-body motion is challenging due to floating-base oscillations, gravity, dynamic coupling, and locomotion-induced disturbances. We propose ResGAC, a whole-body humanoid controller for precise end-effector pose tracking that combines geometric admittance control (GAC) with residual reinforcement learning. GAC provides structured $\SE$ task-space feedback and generates nominal arm joint-position targets, while residual RL compensates for unmodeled dynamics and coordinates locomotion and balance in the shared joint-position action space. The left-invariant geometric formulation allows the same GAC law to be used across manipulation reference frames. This enables the use of a ground-attached heading frame that preserves planar locomotion while removing pelvis roll, pitch, and heave from the manipulation reference, thereby reducing reference-induced end-effector motion during locomotion. ResGAC is validated on a real Unitree G1 humanoid. Across four standing end-effector tracking benchmarks, ResGAC consistently outperforms representative baselines, including SONIC, achieving lower translational and rotational errors. Real-world experiments further demonstrate reduced propagation of pelvis motion to the desired end-effector pose using the proposed ground-attached heading frame. ResGAC achieves $90\%$ success in a standing peg-in-hole task compared with $50\%$ for SONIC, and accurate world-frame $\SE$ end-effector pose tracking during lower-body motion. Experimental videos are included in the supplementary material and are also available on the project website: https://resgac.github.io/ResGAC-website/.

</details>


### [482] [SiGNgapore - An Interactive Dataset for Sign-based Visual Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09488)
*Nicky Zimmerman,Joel Loo,Zishuo Wang,David Hsu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个用于以指示牌为中心的无地图导航的独特数据集，数据在新加坡多个公共空间用手持设备采集，包含RGB、稀疏深度、里程计与IMU测量，并附带56个长时程导航任务、450余个指示牌场景、ROS 2转换脚本以及场地地图与GPS对齐的场景图。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自主机器人在人类环境中应用的关键在于无需预建地图即可导航，而利用人类为人类设计的导航辅助（如指示牌）对实现自主性至关重要。现有数据缺乏针对指示牌决策的无地图导航场景，因此需要一个专门的数据集来支撑相关研究。

Method: 使用手持设备在新加坡多个公共空间采集数据，聚焦人类日常频繁出入的环境与以指示牌为中心的决策过程；记录RGB、稀疏深度、里程计和IMU测量，覆盖指示牌及其所处复杂环境；提供56个长时程导航任务与450余个指示牌场景，数据以人类可读格式存储，并提供转换为ROS 2的实用脚本，同时给出场地地图与GPS对齐的场景图。

Result: 构建了一个包含多模态传感器数据、长时程任务、大量指示牌场景、ROS 2转换脚本、场地地图及GPS对齐场景图的数据集，并讨论了其潜在应用场景。

Conclusion: 该数据集为以指示牌为中心的无地图导航研究提供了真实、多模态且可直接用于ROS 2的基准资源，有助于推动自主机器人在人类日常环境中的导航能力发展。

Abstract: The future of autonomous robots in human-oriented environments depends on their ability to navigate in the absence of prebuilt maps; exploiting navigational aids, such as navigational signs, designed by humans for humans is critical for enabling autonomy. This manuscript introduces a unique dataset collected using a handheld device, at various public spaces across Singapore, representing environments that humans frequent daily, and focusing on sign-centric decision making for mapless navigation. The dataset includes RGB, sparse depth, odometry and IMU measurements of scenarios centered around navigational signs and the complex environments where they are placed. Additionally, we provide 56 long-horizon navigation missions and over 450 sign-centric scenarios. All data is provided in a human- readable format, as well as utility scripts for conversion to ROS 2. Lastly, we provide venue maps and GPS aligned scene graphs of the test environments. We discuss the potential use cases for this dataset.

</details>


### [483] [Sparse Feature Policy Unlearning Mitigates State Hallucination in Vision-Language-Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09496)
*Jiho Lee,Jeongeun Park,Heayoun Choi,Taekyung Kim,Eunwoo Kim*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文研究VLA模型中的"状态幻觉"失败模式，通过稀疏自编码器定位相关稀疏特征，提出SOUL方法选择性遗忘幻觉相关策略知识，在仿真与真实环境中显著减少幻觉失败并提升任务成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型虽在机器人操作中泛化性强，但实际部署时常出现不可靠行为。作者聚焦"状态幻觉"这一反复出现的失败模式，即VLA在机器人-物体状态尚未真正达成时仍继续按已达成状态行动，旨在揭示其机制并加以缓解。

Method: 先进行注意力分析，发现状态幻觉伴随对任务相关视觉区域注意力的减弱；再用稀疏自编码器做机制解释，发现幻觉相关的稀疏特征在失败发生时被激活。据此提出SOUL（Sparse feature pOlicy UnLearning），将幻觉失败中识别的稀疏特征作为遗忘目标、成功行为中的稀疏特征作为保留目标，对策略知识进行选择性遗忘。

Result: 在多种VLA架构、仿真与真实环境中实验表明，该方法大幅减少幻觉性失败，提升任务成功率，且未明显损害已有操作能力。

Conclusion: 可解释的特征分析为选择性修改机器人策略中的不良知识提供了实用基础。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown strong generalization in robotic manipulation by leveraging rich representations from pretrained vision-language models. However, their deployment in real-world environments remains limited by recurring unreliable behaviors. In this work, we study state hallucination, a recurring failure pattern in which a VLA continues acting as if an unrealized robot-object state had been achieved. Our analyses find that state hallucination coincides with weakened attention to task-relevant visual regions, and a mechanistic interpretation via sparse autoencoders reveals that hallucination-associated sparse features are activated when these failures occur. Based on this analysis, we propose SOUL (Sparse feature pOlicy UnLearning), which selectively unlearns policy knowledge associated with state hallucination behaviors, where sparse features identified from hallucination failures and successful behaviors serve as explicit forgetting and retention targets, respectively. Experiments across VLA architectures in simulated and real-world environments show that our method substantially reduces hallucinated failures and improves task success without substantially compromising the existing manipulation capabilities. These results suggest that interpretable feature analysis provides a practical basis for selectively modifying undesirable knowledge in robot policies.

</details>


### [484] [Not All Uncertainty Matters: Simulation-in-the-Loop Fast-Slow Reasoning for Decision-Critical Autonomous Driving System](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09520)
*Jiayi Chen,Shuai Wang,Guangxu Zhu,Derrick Wing Kwan Ng,Chengzhong Xu,Kaibin Huang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: SIGMA：面向任务的快慢协同框架，通过仿真在环评估不确定性对规划代价的期望削减，以决定云端推理的调用时机。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型视觉语言模型虽为自动驾驶提供开放世界感知与推理，但算力与延迟高，难以持续云端调用；快慢协同中核心难题是判断云端推理何时应干预时敏驾驶决策。现有方法依赖感知不确定性、启发式触发或资源驱动策略，未评估"解决该不确定性是否能改善规划"。

Method: 提出SIGMA仿真在环框架，将规划器嵌入不确定性评估：在语义与几何不确定性下采样可行场景实现，评估其对可行轨迹与规划代价的影响，据此估计消除不确定性的期望规划代价削减；并提出期望规划增益（EPG）这一决策级指标，用于云端调用、云引导整合及截止时间与资源约束下的请求优先级排序。

Result: CARLA实验显示，SIGMA在静态与动态障碍场景中减少不必要的云端交互，同时改善规划、效率与导航成功率。相比固定周期协同，不必要云端交互减少50%，导航成功率提升6%以上，动态场景完成时间最多缩短26.2%。

Conclusion: 以规划增益为决策准则的仿真在环快慢协同，可有效平衡云资源开销与时敏决策质量，优于固定周期或不确定性/启发式触发策略。

Abstract: Large vision-language models (VLMs) provide powerful open-world perception and reasoning for autonomous driving, but their high computational cost and inference latency make continuous cloud-side use impractical. This motivates fast--slow collaboration, where efficient onboard modules handle real-time perception and control while cloud models provide high-level reasoning only when needed. The key challenge is deciding when cloud reasoning should influence time-critical driving decisions. Existing methods often rely on perception uncertainty, heuristic triggers, or resource-driven policies, without assessing whether resolving an uncertainty will improve planning. We propose \textbf{SIGMA}, a simulation-in-the-loop framework for task-oriented fast--slow collaboration. SIGMA embeds the planner into uncertainty assessment and evaluates how plausible scene realizations under semantic and geometric uncertainty affect feasible trajectories and planning cost. Based on these outcomes, it estimates the expected reduction in planning cost from resolving uncertainty. We further introduce expected planning gain (EPG), a decision-level metric for cloud invocation, cloud-guidance integration, and request prioritization under deadline and resource constraints. Experiments in CARLA show that SIGMA reduces unnecessary cloud interactions while improving planning, efficiency, and navigation success in static and dynamic obstacle scenarios. Compared with fixed-period collaboration, SIGMA reduces unnecessary cloud interactions by 50\%, improves navigation success by more than 6\%, and cuts finish time by up to 26.2\% in dynamic scenarios.

</details>


### [485] [Contact-Aware Imitation Learning Through Contact Factorization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09533)
*Jiho Hong,Daeun Song,Sanghyun Kim,Mingyo Seo*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出FACE——一种接触因子化的模仿学习框架，将意图任务行为与环境相关的接触因素解耦，通过归一化接触相对坐标、接触法向估计与在线摩擦估计，在不解算策略参数的情况下适应新的接触条件，实现真实机器人富接触操作的泛化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 富接触操作的可泛化要求机器人保持任务意图的同时，将物理实现适配到变化的接触条件。然而，表面几何、朝向和摩擦的微小变化都会导致交互力显著改变，使得直接在原始力测量上训练的策略难以迁移到示范条件之外。

Method: FACE将交互力表示为归一化的、接触相对坐标；使用学习的接触法向估计器与在线摩擦估计器推断局部接触法向和有效摩擦尺度；二者共同支持将力观测编码、并将策略输出解码为执行时的物理运动与力指令，从而在不更新策略参数的前提下适配当前接触条件。

Result: 在真实机器人富接触操作任务上，针对未见过的表面属性与几何变化进行评估，通过与将先前方法适配到该设定的变体进行受控对比，展示了跨接触条件的稳健泛化能力。

Conclusion: 将意图任务行为与环境相关的接触因素显式解耦，并借助接触法向与摩擦的在线估计，可在推理期实现接触自适应，而无需策略参数更新，从而提升富接触操作在未见接触条件下的泛化性。

Abstract: Generalizable contact-rich manipulation requires robots to preserve intended task behavior while adapting its physical realization to changing contact conditions. However, interaction forces can vary substantially with small changes in surface geometry, orientation, and friction, making policies trained directly on raw force measurements difficult to transfer beyond demonstrated conditions. We introduce FACE, a contact-factorized imitation learning framework that separates intended task behavior from environment-dependent contact factors. Our representation expresses interaction forces in normalized, contact-relative coordinates, while a learned contact-normal estimator and an online friction estimator infer the local contact normal and effective friction scale. Together, these estimators enable force observations to be encoded and policy outputs to be decoded into physical motion and force commands during execution. In this way, FACE adapts execution to current contact conditions while preserving the intended task behavior, without updating the policy parameters. We evaluate FACE on real-robot contact-rich manipulation under unseen variations in surface properties and geometry, demonstrating robust generalization across contact conditions through controlled comparisons with variants that adapt prior approaches to our setting. Videos and additional materials can be found on the project page: https://rcilab.khu.ac.kr/face.

</details>


### [486] [MagCilia: A Compact Magnetociliary Tactile Sensor with 3D Force Sensing for Robotic Contact Perception and Grasping Feedback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09536)
*Yu Feng,Hao Wu,Haotian Guo,Haoming Liu,William Su,Jingxiang Guo,Jiankun Li,Masayoshi Tomizuka,Wen Jung Li,Jianshu Zhou*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出紧凑型磁纤毛触觉传感器MagCilia，结合柔性磁纤毛与霍尔传感器实现3D力感知，并用因果历史融合回归(CHFR)从耦合磁通道重建力，完成抓取反馈与表面识别。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人抓取与表面探索需要同时测量法向与切向力，并获取接触表面信息，而单一紧凑触觉单元同时实现3D力重建与表面识别仍具挑战。

Method: 设计柔性磁纤毛结构与霍尔传感器集成的MagCilia；用准静态有限元分析研究多向加载下的结构变形与磁响应；提出因果历史融合回归CHFR，将当前磁场测量与其近期变化量结合，以从耦合磁通道重建力；采用按标定记录分组的五折交叉验证及频域特征分类。

Result: Fx、Fy、Fz的均方根误差分别为0.40、0.57、0.69 N，决定系数分别为0.93、0.90、0.92；机器人实验实现切向力引导的夹爪调整与外部扰动下的多轴载荷监测；重建力的频域特征在按采集会话分组的三折交叉验证中以99.39%准确率区分六类表面，在线演示识别全部六种表面。

Conclusion: 单个紧凑触觉单元即可实现3D力重建、抓取反馈与表面识别，验证了MagCilia与CHFR方法的有效性。

Abstract: Robotic grasping and surface exploration benefit from simultaneous measurement of normal and tangential forces and from surface information obtained through contact. Here, we present a compact magnetociliary tactile sensor (MagCilia) that combines a flexible magnetic-cilia structure with a Hall sensor for 3D force sensing. Quasi-static finite element analysis is used to investigate structural deformation and magnetic responses under multidirectional loading. To reconstruct forces from the coupled magnetic channels, we propose causal history fusion regression (CHFR), which combines current magnetic-field measurements with their recent changes. Five-fold cross-validation grouped by calibration record yields root-mean-square errors of 0.40, 0.57, and 0.69 N for Fx, Fy, and Fz, respectively, with corresponding coefficients of determination of 0.93, 0.90, and 0.92. Robotic experiments demonstrate tangential-force-guided gripper adjustment and multi-axis load monitoring under external perturbations. Frequency-domain features of the reconstructed forces distinguish six surface categories with 99.39% accuracy in three-fold cross-validation grouped by acquisition session. An online robotic demonstration additionally identifies all six tested surfaces. These results demonstrate 3D force reconstruction, grasping feedback, and surface recognition using a single compact tactile unit.

</details>


### [487] [Targeted Modality Dropout for Real-Robot Manipulation Robust to Intermittent Vision Loss](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09566)
*Genki Shikada,Kazuki Osamura,Masaru Ide,Tetsuya Ogata,Kanata Suzuki*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 Targeted Modality Dropout (TMD)，通过注意力估计各模态依赖度并选择性丢弃主导模态，配合依赖分布的熵正则化，提升模仿学习策略在视觉缺失下的鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态模仿学习策略在训练中易过度依赖某一主导模态（如视觉），当该模态在推理时缺失，策略执行会受到严重破坏。

Method: 利用注意力估计每个模态的依赖程度，选择性地丢弃最主导的模态；同时对依赖分布施加熵正则化，以避免依赖集中于单一模态。

Result: 在双臂机械臂真机实验中，视觉缺失时基线策略成功率大幅下降，而 TMD 仍能持续完成任务；相比之下，随机选择丢弃模态且无熵正则化的传统 dropout 在没有视觉缺失时也在许多任务上失败。

Conclusion: 按依赖度针对性地丢弃主导模态并结合熵正则化，可有效缓解多模态模仿学习中的模态过度依赖问题，提升推理阶段的鲁棒性。

Abstract: Imitation learning policies that integrate multiple sensory modalities are prone to overreliance on a dominant modality, such as vision, during training, which can disrupt policy execution when that modality is lost at inference time. In this paper, we introduce Targeted Modality Dropout (TMD), in which the dependence on each modality is estimated using attention and the most dominant modality is selectively dropped. This is combined with entropy regularization over the dependence distribution. Through real-robot evaluation using a bimanual manipulator, we show that under vision loss the success rate of the baseline policy drops substantially, whereas TMD sustains task execution. In contrast, a conventional dropout that selects the dropped modality at random, without the entropy regularization, fails on many tasks even without vision loss.

</details>


### [488] [Point It, Strike It: Direction-Conditioned Dynamic Manipulation of Deformable Linear Objects](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09573)
*Yi Yang,Xiang Fei,Lehong Wang,Zilin Dai,Ruogu Li,Jiting Cai,Liyao Chang,Xinyi Yang,Henry Kou,Ruijie Fu,Lu Li,Howie Choset*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 研究柔性线性物体的单次挥摆击打任务，目标同时指定末端3D位置与到达方向；提出加速仿真器DeformX2.0、数据生成方法TRACE与残差校准策略RECAP，仿真精度92.1%，真机成功率显著提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有柔性线性物体（如绳索）的目标条件动态操作多将目标仅设定为绳端到达位置，但许多任务依赖末端如何到达。因此需要研究同时指定末端3D位置与到达方向的单次挥摆击打，且面临绳索动力学难建模、无演示数据、不同挥摆达到同一目标的可靠性不同、仿真到现实差距超出绳索本身等挑战。

Method: 1) 扩展SOTA柔性线性物体仿真器DeformX为DeformX2.0，加入GPU加速、稳定的Cosserat杆求解器与横流空气动力学模型，速度提升超20000倍；2) 提出TRACE（Trace-rooted Adaptive Cross-Entropy），以存储的末端路径最接近新目标的挥摆进行热启动生成击打数据，代价函数惩罚绳索弯曲与末端突变运动以偏好可重复挥摆；3) 用该数据训练条件流匹配策略；4) 提出RECAP（Residual Calibration Policy），用少量校准挥摆拟合仿真器的绳索与装置参数，并用仿真中训练的校正策略自适应调整动作。

Result: 在仿真中，基于TRACE数据的条件流匹配策略达到92.1%准确率。在真实机器人上、三条绳索下，RECAP将位置目标5cm容差内的成功率从72%提升至87%；对同时指定到达方向的目标，在10cm与10°容差内成功率从50%提升至79%。

Conclusion: 通过高速仿真器、面向可重复性的数据生成与残差校准策略，可有效实现跨工作空间、跨绳索的单次挥摆击打，并显著缩小仿真到现实差距，支持同时满足末端位置与到达方向的目标条件操作。

Abstract: Goal-conditioned dynamic manipulation of deformable linear objects has mainly specified goals as positions for a rope tip to reach. Many tasks, however, depend on how the tip arrives. We therefore study single-swing rope striking with goals that specify the tip's 3D position and arrival direction, across the workspace and on different ropes. This is challenging because rope dynamics are hard to model, no demonstrations exist, distinct swings reach the same goal with different reliability, and the sim-to-real gap extends beyond the rope. To address these challenges, we extend the state-of-the-art DLO simulator DeformX with GPU acceleration, a stable Cosserat rod solver, and a cross-flow aerodynamic model, yielding DeformX2.0, which is more than $20{,}000\times$ faster. We then propose TRACE (Trace-rooted Adaptive Cross-Entropy), which generates striking data by warm-starting each new target from the stored swing whose tip path passes closest to it. Its cost penalizes rope bending and abrupt tip motion to favor repeatable swings. A conditional flow-matching policy trained on this data reaches 92.1% accuracy in simulation. Finally, we propose RECAP (Residual Calibration Policy), which fits the simulator's rope and rig parameters to a few calibration swings and adapts actions with a correction policy trained in simulation. On a real robot, across three ropes, RECAP raises success within 5cm from 72% to 87% for position goals, and within 10cm and 10° from 50% to 79% for goals that also specify the arrival direction.

</details>


### [489] [Adaptive Code Generation for Controlling Robots](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09588)
*Justus Flerlage,Thorsten Wittkopp,Alexander Acker,Odej Kao*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于生成式AI的机器人控制架构框架，采用LLM+VLM双AI设计，通过受限代码生成、语义接地、环境驱动的重规划与运行时监控，实现对复杂自然语言意图在动态未知环境中的稳健执行。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 将机器人作为复杂适应系统（CAS）部署于未知动态环境时，传统的刚性指令库难以奏效，需要转向基于意图的自主性；自然语言是表达超越有限指令集之复杂目标的唯一媒介。LLM虽提供了自然语言目标描述路径，但其集成面临形式化鸿沟（不精确意图与可执行动作之间）、分类学鸿沟（不可预测环境引起）以及时序状态与进度感知维护等重大挑战。

Method: 提出一种利用生成式AI实现机器人控制的架构框架，采用双AI设计：LLM将高层意图翻译为受限于形式化机器人库、并受可验证语法约束的可执行程序代码；VLM通过蒸馏过程提供语义接地。为增强鲁棒性，框架引入基于几何与语义阈值的环境驱动重规划触发器，并辅以持续运行时监控与自适应规划循环。在多个前沿模型上进行基准测试。

Result: 在多个前沿模型上的基准测试表明：将生成式AI接地于一个反应式、受限的闭环之中，能够在动态未知环境下稳健地完成复杂意图。

Conclusion: 该架构框架验证了“生成式AI+受限反应闭环”这一设计范式对机器人复杂意图执行的可行性与稳健性，为CAS场景下的意图驱动自主控制提供了有效路径。

Abstract: Deploying robots as Complex Adaptive Systems (CAS) in unknown and dynamic environments necessitates a transition from rigid command libraries toward intention-based autonomy, as natural language represents the only medium capable of articulating complex goals beyond the capacity of finite instruction sets. While Large Language Models (LLMs) offer a path toward natural language goal description, their integration introduces significant challenges: the formalization gap between imprecise intentions and executable actions, the taxonomy gap induced by unpredictable environments, and the challenge of maintaining temporal state and progress awareness. This work introduces an architectural framework that enables robotic control by leveraging generative AI. The system follows a dual-AI design: an LLM translates high-level intentions into executable program code restricted to a formal robotic library and constrained by verifiable syntax, while a Vision-Language Model (VLM) provides semantic grounding via a distillation process. To ensure robustness, the framework incorporates environment-driven replanning triggers based on geometric and semantic thresholds, complemented by continuous runtime monitoring and an adaptive planning loop. Benchmarked across frontier models, our framework architecture demonstrates that grounding generative AI in a reactive, constrained loop enables robust fulfillment of complex intentions in dynamic and unknown environments.

</details>


### [490] [Fast and Robust Teach-and-Repeat Navigation Using MixVPR Visual Place Recognition*](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09631)
*Václav Truhlařík,Tomáš Pivoňka,Libor Přeučil*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于MixVPR视觉位置识别方法的高效示教-重复导航系统，在室内外真实环境中实现了与现有最先进系统相当的鲁棒性和导航精度，同时显著降低了硬件需求。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 示教-重复导航系统结合先进视觉位置识别技术，具备在非结构化和动态环境中长期导航的能力。但现有基于深度学习的方法计算量大，限制了其实际应用范围。

Method: 构建了一个新颖且高效的示教-重复系统，核心采用现代视觉位置识别方法MixVPR作为定位模块，以降低计算开销和硬件需求。

Result: 在真实世界环境中进行了测试，系统能够在室内和室外场景下运行，鲁棒性和导航精度与其他最先进系统相当，同时硬件要求更低。

Conclusion: 该系统适合广泛的机器人平台和实际应用场景，为示教-重复导航提供了一种高效且易于部署的解决方案。

Abstract: Teach-and-repeat navigation systems employing advanced visual place recognition techniques for localization exhibit key attributes for long-term mobile robot navigation, such as the ability to operate in unstructured and dynamic environments. However, existing solutions based on deep-learning techniques are computationally demanding, limiting their applicability. This work introduces a novel and efficient teach-and-repeat system built on the modern visual place recognition method MixVPR. Real-world testing demonstrated its ability to operate both indoors and outdoors, achieving robustness and navigation precision comparable to other state-of-the-art systems. In addition, its lower hardware requirements make it suitable for a wide range of robotic platforms and practical applications.

</details>


### [491] [Design optimization of tendon-driven robots considering tendon wrapping and shortcut](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09645)
*Yuta Sahara,Kento Kawaharazuka,Kei Okada*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出腱驱机械臂多目标优化方法，用NSGA-II同时最大化关节力矩与最小化臂厚，优化腱路由、滑轮与固定点，得到Pareto最优解及设计指南。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 腱驱机械臂设计中关节力矩与臂厚存在固有权衡（腱缠绕与捷径效应），缺乏系统性优化与设计指导。

Method: 将问题建模为多目标优化（最大化力矩、最小化厚度），采用NSGA-II求解，优化变量为腱路由、滑轮配置和腱固定点。

Result: 获得Pareto最优设计集合，通过策略性捷径实现有效力臂扩展，配置呈现超越常规直觉的非平凡模式。

Conclusion: 该方法为紧凑高力矩机械臂提供实用设计指南，并为高效机器人系统设计提供新见解。

Abstract: This study proposes a multi-objective optimization method for tendon-driven arm design, addressing the inherent trade-off between joint torque and arm thickness through tendon wrapping and shortcut effects. We formulate the problem to simultaneously maximize torque and minimize thickness, solved using NSGA-II. The algorithm optimizes tendon routing, pulley configurations, and attachment points. Results reveal Pareto-optimal designs with effective moment arm expansion via strategic shortcuts, providing practical guidelines for compact high-torque arms. The optimized configurations demonstrate non-trivial patterns beyond conventional design intuition, offering new insights for engineering efficient robotic systems.

</details>


### [492] [NAViLoss: An Underwater Navigation-Aware Dual-Residual Objective for Physics-Consistent Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09690)
*Arup Kumar Sahoo,Itzik Klein*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出导航感知损失函数 NAViLoss，联合约束导航状态域速度残差与 DVL 波束一致性残差，并具界与自适应不确定性调节，结合 DeepONet 构建 NAVi-DeepONet，实现鲁棒的水下速度估计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AUV 依赖 INS 与 DVL 组合导航，DVL 速度估计精度至关重要。现有学习方法虽在退化量测下有所改进，但训练目标多为常规回归损失，对大残差与受污染观测高度敏感，且未显式考虑感知过程的物理一致性与量测不确定性。

Method: 提出 NAViLoss：在导航状态域惩罚速度估计残差，在 DVL 量测域惩罚波束一致性残差；采用有界形式抑制大残差影响；引入自适应机制调节波束几何不确定性。将 NAViLoss 与 DeepONet 结合形成 NAVi-DeepONet 模型。基于多次真实海试采集的约 10,000 m 半合成 AUV 实验数据进行评估。

Result: 相比常规方法与学习型基线，速度估计精度提升 44%。

Conclusion: 导航感知与不确定性自适应的损失设计可有效提升基于学习的水下速度估计的鲁棒性与精度。

Abstract: Autonomous underwater vehicles (AUVs) commonly rely on inertial navigation systems (INS) aided by Doppler velocity logs (DVLs) for reliable underwater navigation. Accurate DVL velocity estimation is therefore essential for successful operation. Recent learning-based methods have demonstrated improved DVL velocity estimation, particularly under degraded measurement conditions. However, their training objectives typically rely on conventional regression losses that are highly sensitive to large residuals and corrupted observations. Additionally, they do not explicitly account for the physical consistency and measurement uncertainty associated with the underlying sensing process. To address these limitations, this paper introduces navigation-aware loss (NAViLoss), a robust and uncertainty-aware objective function for learning-based AUV velocity estimation. NAViLoss jointly penalizes the velocity-estimation residual in the navigation-state domain and the beam-consistency residual in the DVL measurement domain. Its bounded formulation limits the influence of large residuals, while an adaptive mechanism regulates the uncertainty in beam geometry. Furthermore, NAViLoss is integrated with a DeepONet architecture to form a novel NAVi-DeepONet model for seamless estimation of an underwater vehicle's velocity. Lastly, our model is evaluated using approximately 10,000m of semi-synthetic AUV experimental data collected during multiple real-world sea trials. Experimental results demonstrate a 44% improvement in velocity-estimation accuracy compared with conventional and learning-based baselines. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of navigation-aware and uncertainty-adaptive loss design for robust learning-based underwater velocity estimation.

</details>


### [493] [RoboPace: Contact-Aware Time-Optimal Retiming for Action-Chunk Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09696)
*Mimo Shirasaka,Takehiko Ohkawa,Takuya Okubo,Nicola Scianca,Tatsuya Matsushima,Kei Ota*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: RoboPace：一种在线重定时层，在保持VLA策略几何路径的前提下调整执行时序，结合预测接触与机器人运动约束自适应速度，无需重训练即可实时运行，在接触密集型任务中兼顾成功率与效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人操作数据采集正从遥操作转向无机器人演示（如UMI或直接人手采集），但由此训练的VLA策略继承的是人类的执行节奏。人类节奏无法直接迁移到机器人：柔性手可容忍快速接触，而机器人因执行器和跟踪限制可能过冲；反之机器人在自由空间可更快。因此需要统一协调执行速度与接触安全的方法。

Method: 提出RoboPace在线重定时层。它保留策略的几何路径，仅改写其时间维度的执行节奏，并遵守目标机器人的运动学与动力学约束；基于预测的接触状态自适应调整执行速度，同时考虑接触相关的速度上限与机器人运动约束。该方法无需策略重训练，可实时运行。

Result: 在双臂机器人上的三个接触密集型任务中，较快匀速执行与仅考虑物理极限的重定时均大体失败。RoboPace则取得高于慢速匀速执行的总体成功率，并在约一半时间内完成五条指令中的四条，既保留慢速执行的可靠性，又避免其时间代价。

Conclusion: 通过在路径不变的前提下对VLA策略进行接触感知的在线速度重定时，RoboPace有效弥合了人类演示节奏与机器人执行能力之间的差距，在不重训练的前提下实现高成功率与时间效率的兼顾。

Abstract: Robot manipulation data collection has been shifting from teleoperation toward robot-free demonstrations, through interfaces such as the Universal Manipulation Interface (UMI) or directly from human hands. Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies trained on such data inherit the demonstrator's timing. Yet human timing does not directly transfer to robots: compliant hands tolerate fast contact, whereas robots may overshoot due to actuator and tracking limitations; conversely, robots can move faster in free space. This motivates a unified approach that reconciles execution speed with contact safety. We present RoboPace, an online retiming layer that preserves the policy's geometric path while adapting its timing, respecting the target robot's kinematic and dynamic constraints. It adapts execution speed based on predicted contact, jointly accounting for contact-dependent speed limits and the robot's motion constraints. The method requires no policy retraining and operates in real time. Across three contact-rich tasks on a dual-arm robot, faster uniform execution and physical-limit-only retiming largely fail. RoboPace instead achieves higher overall success than slow uniform execution while completing four of five commands in approximately half the time, retaining the reliability of slow execution without its time cost.

</details>


### [494] [ΔWAM: Distilling Action Tangent Fields into World Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09734)
*Ke Wu,Hanwen Huang,Bo Gu,Kaizhao Zhang,Xiangting Meng,Yupeng Zheng,Zijun Xu,Jieru Zhao,Wenchao Ding*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文提出 Action Tangent Fields，通过将世界监督重新表述为“动作如何引起未来动力学变化”的局部泰勒展开，集中预测与动作相关的变异，从而提升机器人策略的鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 World Action Models（WAM）用稠密未来预测增强稀疏动作监督，但可预测的未来大多由外观与场景持续性主导，而非动作依赖的动力学，导致世界监督效率不高。

Method: 在 Residual-VAE 空间中表示未来动力学，使未来潜变量可由当前潜变量及其残差恢复；利用强动作条件世界模型（ACWM）探测动作变化与残差世界变化之间的局部对应关系；将该局部一阶结构蒸馏进 WAM，引导去噪监督偏向与动作紧密耦合的动力学；并将多步 VideoDiT 去噪蒸馏为单步以高效推理。

Result: 在 LIBERO-Plus、RoboTwin 和 RoboTwin2.0-Plus 上，方法持续提升对光照、背景、相机、布局等环境扰动的鲁棒性；在无大规模具身预训练的情况下，在多种分布偏移下鲁棒性强于预训练策略。

Conclusion: 有效的 WAM 监督应保持信息丰富，同时将预测能力集中于动作改变未来的方向上。

Abstract: World Action Models (WAM) improve robot policies by augmenting sparse action supervision with dense future prediction. However, much of the predictable future is dominated by appearance and scene persistence rather than action-dependent dynamics. We observe that several recent WAM designs, including optical flow, motion-centric representations, and latent actions, can be understood from a common perspective in which world supervision becomes more efficient as it contains a higher proportion of action-relevant variation. Based on this insight, we introduce Action Tangent Fields, which reformulate world supervision through a local Taylor expansion of how actions induce changes in future dynamics. We represent future dynamics in Residual-VAE space, where the future latent remains recoverable from the current latent and its residual, and use a strong action-conditioned world model (ACWM) to probe the local correspondence between action variations and residual-world variations. This local first-order structure is distilled into the WAM to guide its denoising supervision toward dynamics that are more tightly coupled to action, rather than merely predictable from appearance. Across LIBERO-Plus, RoboTwin, and RoboTwin2.0-Plus, our method consistently improves robustness to lighting, background, camera, layout, and other environmental perturbations. Despite using no large-scale embodied pretraining, it achieves stronger robustness under several distribution shifts than pretrained policies. We further distill multi-step VideoDiT denoising into a single step for efficient inference. Our results suggest that effective WAM supervision should remain information-rich while concentrating its predictive capacity on the directions along which actions change the future.

</details>


### [495] [AeroEval: Staged Program and Execution Validation for AI-Generated Drone Missions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09764)
*Kautuk Astu,Naina Rabha,Yogesh Simmhan*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: AeroEval 提出一种"智能体辅助中间件"，对 AI 生成的无人机任务程序进行分阶段验证：先做确定性程序分析与意图校验，再基于执行轨迹、任务需求和环境上下文评估真实行为，并向重新生成阶段反馈结构化失败信息。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 生成的无人机程序虽语法合法，却可能违背用户意图、环境约束与任务级行为；这类赛博物理应用中，正确性依赖生成代码、移动感知、环境几何、事件驱动分析与物理执行的交互，而现有系统主要依赖提示词护栏或仿真结果，难以定位失败原因。

Method: AeroEval 将确定性程序分析与上下文锚定的 LLM 智能体相结合，分阶段验证：第一阶段验证程序语法、平台 API 用法与任务意图；第二阶段利用执行轨迹、任务需求与环境上下文评估实际实现的行为。每个阶段输出结构化失败信息，用于迭代式重新生成。

Result: 在 AirSim 与 Gazebo 仿真器上，使用 20 个导航任务和 5 类分析任务评估：导航成功率由 55% 提升至 95%。分阶段消融中，代码验证器与轨迹验证器单独的平均运行级成功率分别为 44% 和 56%，完整 AeroEval 流程达 88%；各阶段可检测程序结构、API 用法、任务意图、避障、高度、覆盖与事件驱动转换中的互补性失败。分析类任务中，聚合运行级成功率由一次性 AeroGen 的 34% 提升至重生成预算内的 88%。

Conclusion: 在所评估环境中，将程序级验证与执行锚定的智能体验证相结合，可有效提升 AI 生成无人机应用的正确性。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) can generate drone programs from natural-language mission descriptions, but syntactically valid programs may still violate user intent, environmental constraints, and mission-level behavior. This problem is pronounced in cyber-physical applications, where correctness depends on the interaction among generated code, mobile sensing, environmental geometry, event-driven analytics, and physical execution. Existing drone code-generation systems primarily use prompt guardrails or simulator outcomes and provide limited failure localization. We present AeroEval, an agent-assisted middleware for staged validation of AI-generated drone missions. AeroEval combines deterministic program analysis with context-grounded LLM agents. It first validates program syntax, platform API usage, and mission intent, and then evaluates the realized behavior using execution trajectories, mission requirements, and environmental context. Each stage returns structured failure information for iterative regeneration. In our evaluation using 20 navigation tasks and five analytical mission types over AirSim and Gazebo simulators, AeroEval improves navigation success from 55% to 95%. In a stagewise ablation study, our Code and Trajectory Validators by themselves achieve mean run-level success rates of 44% and 56%, respectively, while the full AeroEval pipeline achieves 88%; the stages detect complementary failures in program structure, API usage, mission intent, obstacle avoidance, altitude, coverage, and event-driven transitions and the guided regeneration corrects for them. Across the main analytics missions, AeroEval increases aggregate run-level success from 34% for one-shot AeroGen to 88% within the regeneration budget. These results demonstrate the benefit of combining program-level and execution-grounded agentic validation for AI-generated drone applications in the evaluated environment.

</details>


### [496] [On-Demand Robotic Assembly via Differentiable Geometric Part Repair](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09777)
*Millicent Schlafly,Fabio Schaub,Diogo Costa Pais,Luca Lelli,Janne Dvorak,Claire Colmont,Sven Marti,Mark D. Fuge*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出端到端自主流水线，实现从自然语言提示到木制装配体的设计与实体建造，无需专家手动调参。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从数字设计到机器人装配通常需数月经专家手动调参，以协调零件几何与机器人约束，制约了定制化、小批量商品的快速生产。

Method: 生成式AI智能体将用户提示转化为初始3D几何，兼顾视觉保真度与部分物理约束；再通过基于梯度的修复阶段，借助图注意力网络（GAT）代理模型反向传播，调整零件几何，实现硬件特定修正（如支持机器人拧螺丝）。
