TL;DR: 本文在Wasserstein空间上研究光滑势-相互作用能量的信赖域优化，利用沿pushforward曲线的二次模型、L²(ρ)步长半径和带显式自伴二阶变分算子的Steihaug-Toint子求解器，证明了目标非增、Wasserstein梯度范数收敛到零以及O(ε⁻²)的ε-稳定点复杂度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 交互粒子低能构型与概率分布近似问题可归结为Wasserstein空间中势-相互作用能量的极小化。这类能量非凸，因此既需要利用二阶信息加速，又必须控制局部近似（二次模型）的可靠性，而现有方法在步长可信度控制与收敛性保证方面尚不充分。

Method: 在有限二阶矩概率测度的Wasserstein空间上对光滑势-相互作用能量进行信赖域优化：沿pushforward曲线构造二次模型，采用L²(ρ)步长半径，并使用带显式自伴二阶变分算子的Steihaug-Toint子求解器求解子问题；通过比率检验决定步长接受与否并指导半径更新。对经验测度，该迭代等价于L²(ρ_N)内积下的有限维信赖域方法。

Result: 在能量有下界且势函数与相互作用核的Hessian全局有界的假设下，证明目标函数非增、Wasserstein梯度范数收敛到零，并在O(ε⁻²)次外层尝试（含被拒绝的尝试）内达到ε-稳定点；若势函数二次强制，则每个弱聚点都是稳定点。分析适用于任意有限二阶矩初始测度。对经验测度，当初始目标间隙一致有界时，复杂度常数与粒子数和维数无关。数值实验涵盖光滑软粒子能量、非高斯目标的MMD极小化、组件消融及粒子数与维数的扩展性研究。

Conclusion: 该工作为Wasserstein空间上的非凸势-相互作用能量极小化提供了具有全局收敛保证的信赖域框架，兼顾二阶信息利用与局部近似可靠性，并在粒子数和维数上具备良好的复杂度可扩展性，适用于低能构型求解与概率分布近似等任务。

Abstract: Finding low-energy configurations of interacting particles and approximating probability distributions lead to the minimization of potential-interaction energies in Wasserstein space. These energies can be nonconvex, making it important to exploit second-order information while controlling the reliability of local approximations. We study trust-region optimization of smooth potential-interaction energies on the Wasserstein space of probability measures with finite second moment. The method uses a quadratic model along pushforward curves, an $L^2(ρ)$ step radius, and a Steihaug-Toint subsolver with an explicit self-adjoint second-variation operator. A ratio test determines acceptance and guides the radius update. Under a lower energy bound and globally bounded Hessians of the potential and interaction kernel, we prove that the objective is nonincreasing, the Wasserstein-gradient norms converge to zero, and an $\varepsilon$-stationary iterate is reached within $O(\varepsilon^{-2})$ total outer trials, including rejected trials. If the potential is quadratically coercive, every weak accumulation point is stationary. The analysis applies to arbitrary initial measures with finite second moment. For empirical measures, the iteration is a finite-dimensional trust-region method in the $L^2(ρ_N)$ inner product, with complexity constants independent of particle number and dimension when the initial objective gaps are uniformly bounded. Numerical experiments include a smooth soft-particle energy, maximum-mean-discrepancy minimization for non-Gaussian targets, component ablations, and scaling studies in particle number and dimension.

</details>


### [532] [Careful Judge: Safe and Efficient Human-AI Collaborative Decision Making](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09043)
*Chenyu Zhang,Rachel Luo,Boyi Li,Anjali Parashar,Marco Pavone,Apoorva Sharma*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: CARE是一个端到端人机协作决策流水线，通过自适应校准与升级机制，在保证安全风险控制的同时，持续从选择性人类反馈中学习，提升自动化水平并减少人力查询。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类复核可阻止不安全AI决策，但每次人工判断成本高昂。将AI弃权后的人工介入视为一次性兜底，会错失利用反馈改进未来AI决策、实现更高自动化的机会；而AI若从选择性人类反馈中自适应学习，又会破坏针对旧模型校准的安全护栏。因此需在安全保证与持续学习之间取得平衡。

Method: 提出CARE（校准自适应纠正与升级）流水线，结合AI模型与人类复核者，保证安全且与人类对齐的决策，同时持续从人类反馈中学习以用更少查询实现更高自动化。方法具有原则性、通用性、模块化，适用于任意黑盒AI模型；核心是新颖的自适应校准模块，可为任意纠正模块在每个时间步保证风险控制；并分析了当AI训练良好且人机错配有清晰结构时，CARE可提升查询效率。

Result: 在涵盖驾驶、语言和机器人学的四个安全关键真实数据集上，CARE实现了与人类对齐的决策，相较基线将人类查询量减少25%-81%。

Conclusion: CARE能在提供实时风险控制保证的同时，持续从选择性人类反馈中学习，在保证安全与人类对齐的前提下显著降低人类查询成本，适用于多种黑盒AI模型与安全关键场景。

Abstract: In human-AI collaborative decision making, human review can prevent unsafe AI decisions, but each human judgment is costly. Treating human intervention after AI abstention as a one-off fallback misses the opportunity to improve future AI decisions for greater automation, yet AI adaptively learning from selectively queried human feedback breaks safety guardrails calibrated for old models. We approach this challenge with CARE---calibrated adaptive rectification and escalation---an end-to-end pipeline that combines AI models and human reviewers to guarantee safe, human-aligned decisions, while continuously learning from human feedback to achieve greater automation with fewer human queries. CARE is principled, general, modular, and works with any black-box AI model. Our novel adaptive calibration module guarantees risk control at every time step for any rectification module. We further show how CARE improves query efficiency when the AI model is well trained and the human-AI misalignment has a clear structure. Experiments on four safety-critical real-world datasets spanning driving, language, and robotics demonstrate that CARE achieves human-aligned decisions while reducing human queries by 25-81% relative to baselines.

</details>


### [533] [Quadratic Weak-to-Strong Generalization in Random Feature Networks via Random Matrix Theory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09044)
*Deborah Oliveira,Elliot Paquette*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文研究两层随机特征网络中的"弱到强泛化"现象，利用随机矩阵理论推导教师与学生模型的总体误差确定性等价，证明在特定设定下学生误差为教师误差的平方级改善。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 弱到强泛化指用弱教师模型生成的标签训练强学生模型时，学生泛化能力可超越教师。作者希望在可解析的两层随机特征网络中，从理论上刻画这一现象发生的条件与机制，并量化误差改善程度。

Method: 考虑模型强度由宽度决定的两层随机特征网络；借助随机矩阵理论推导最优训练教师模型与学生（使用梯度流训练）的总体误差的确定性等价；对ReLU激活和纯球谐目标，在高斯普适性假设下给出精确渐近结果；并推广到更一般的停止时间和支撑于多个谐波次数的目标。

Result: 在ReLU激活与纯球谐目标下，得到学生误差随教师误差呈平方标度的尖锐渐近，即学生误差 ~ 教师误差的平方，达到Medvedev等人(2025)的一般下界；对更一般的停止时间和多谐波次数目标，刻画了弱到强泛化发生的区域，并识别出二次改善、非二次改善与无改善之间的相变。

Conclusion: 该工作为弱到强泛化提供了精确的理论刻画，证明了在特定随机特征网络设定下至少可实现二次误差改善，达到了已知下界，并揭示了改善程度随训练停止时间与目标结构变化的相变图景。

Abstract: Weak-to-strong generalization is the phenomenon where a strong student model trained with labels produced by a weak teacher model is able to generalize better than the teacher. In this paper, we study this phenomenon in two-layer random feature networks where the model strength is determined by its width. Using tools from random matrix theory, we derive deterministic equivalents for the population errors of an optimally trained teacher and a student trained with gradient flow. For ReLU activation and a pure spherical harmonic target, we obtain sharp asymptotics under a Gaussian universality assumption, showing a quadratic improvement: the student error scales as the square of the teacher error. These results attain the general lower bound of Medvedev at al (2025). We also analyze how the student behaves under more general stopping times and targets supported on multiple harmonic degrees, characterizing the regimes in which weak-to-strong generalization occurs and identifying the transition between quadratic, non-quadratic, and no improvement.

</details>


### [534] [Learning Transition Kernels of Jump-Diffusion Processes with Conditional Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09045)
*Yuzhen Zhao,Yating Liu,Quentin Guibert*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文利用条件扩散模型学习时齐跳扩散过程的转移核，在理论上给出条件得分估计误差与真实/生成离散观测路径律之间KL散度的非渐近界，并在合成数据与真实数据的概率预测任务上验证方法并作对比。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 目标是从高频离散时间网格上观测到的N条独立轨迹中生成新的样本路径，即为时齐跳扩散过程学习转移核；已有方法（如Gao等2025）在非渐近理论刻画与真实数据概率预测方面仍有提升空间。

Method: 采用条件扩散模型建模转移核，从高频离散观测的N条独立轨迹训练，从而生成新路径；理论上推导条件得分估计误差的非渐近界，以及真实路径律与生成路径律之间KL散度的非渐近界。

Result: 在合成数据上验证了理论结论并与Gao等(2025)方法进行基准对比；随后在真实数据上开展概率预测任务并考察其性能。

Conclusion: 所提条件扩散模型能够为跳扩散过程的转移核学习与路径生成提供可证明的非渐近保证，并在合成与真实概率预测任务中展现有效性与竞争力。

Abstract: We study the problem of learning transition kernels for time-homogeneous jump-diffusion processes using conditional diffusion models, with the goal of generating new sample paths from training data consisting of N independent trajectories observed on a high-frequency discrete time grid. On the theoretical side, we establish non-asymptotic bounds for the conditional score estimation error and for the KL divergence between the laws of the true and generated discretely observed paths. On the numerical side, we first evaluate our method on synthetic data to assess the theoretical findings and benchmark its performance against the approach of Gao et al. (2025). We then apply our method to real-world data and investigate its performance on a probabilistic forecasting task.

</details>


### [535] [Covariate-dependent Joint Modeling of Multivariate Ordinal Preferences and Its Connections with Comparison Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09070)
*Yujie Chen,Antik Chakraborty,Anindya Bhadra*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 该论文针对多变量有序数据，提出一种联合的、依赖协变量的连续比值马尔可夫随机场模型，避免逐属性建模或转换为成对/列表比较所造成的信息粗化，并在归一化常数不可解的情况下给出最大似然推断方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多变量有序数据（如 MovieLens 中多部电影的1-5分评分及用户人口学信息、HelpSteer 中 LLM 回复在多个属性上的有序人类反馈及提示-回复协变量）广泛存在。现有方法存在两个缺陷：(a) 对各属性单独建模而非联合建模；(b) 常将数据转换为成对或列表式胜负比较以拟合 Bradley-Terry、Plackett-Luce 等模型。二者都会对实际观测到的信息造成粗化。

Method: 提出依赖协变量的联合连续比值马尔可夫随机场（consecutive ratio Markov random field）模型来直接建模多变量有序观测；证明成对或列表比较模型是该联合模型在特定约束下的特例；并针对归一化常数不可解（intractable normalizer）的情形，开发最大似然推断程序。

Result: 成对与列表式比较模型可视为所提联合模型在限制条件下的退化形式；联合建模能改善比较效果；所开发的最大似然推断方法可在归一化常数不可解时实施。

Conclusion: 联合建模多变量有序数据优于逐属性建模与成对/列表比较转换，所提模型兼具理论统一性（涵盖已有比较模型）与实用推断能力。

Abstract: Multivariate ordinal data along with covariates are commonly collected in problems ranging from alignment of language models with human preferences, as well as in recommender systems. For example, data sets such as MovieLens contain several movies rated on a scale 1--5 by human users, along with their demographic information such as age or gender. Similarly, data sets such as HelpSteer collect human feedback on several attributes such as "helpfulness" or "verbosity" of LLM response on an ordinal scale, with covariates depending on the LLM prompt--response pairs. Unfortunately, the standard approaches for modeling these data (a) look at the attributes individually rather than jointly, and (b) often convert the data into pairwise or list-wise win--loss comparisons for fitting models such as Bradley--Terry and Plackett--Luce. Both of these lead to a coarsening of what is actually observed, which we address via a joint covariate-dependent consecutive ratio Markov random field model. We also show pairwise or listwise comparison models are obtained under restrictions of our joint model, and that joint modeling improves comparisons. We also develop a maximum likelihood inference procedure even in the presence of an intractable normalizer.

</details>


### [536] [The Impact of Likelihood Tempering on the Limiting Predictive Moments of Variational Bayesian Linear Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09132)
*Ian Zhang,Thibault Randrianarisoa*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 该文研究宽贝叶斯神经网络中平均场变分推断的“先验主导”退化问题，通过温度化似然（KL项乘T）并令温度按 $T=\tau/M^c$ 随宽度衰减，推导了单隐层线性网络预测分布的极限，揭示预测均值与方差在不同尺度 $c$ 处的相变行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 宽贝叶斯神经网络中，高斯平均场变分推断存在“先验主导”问题：随宽度 $M$ 增大，ELBO中的KL正则项压过期望对数似然，导致变分预测分布退化为先验预测分布。温度化似然（将似然取 $1/T$ 次幂，等价于把KL项缩放 $T$ 倍）可缓解该问题，但温度应随宽度多快地下降才能平衡两项尚不清楚。

Method: 针对各向同性高斯先验的单隐层线性网络，采用形式为 $T=\tau/M^{c}$ （$\tau,c>0$）的温度调度，在 $M\to\infty$ 时推导变分预测分布的极限，并与未温度化的NNGP后验（即精确后验的无穷宽极限）进行对比。

Result: 预测均值与方差在不同尺度发生相变：极限期望在 $c=1/2$ 处离开其先验值（当 $\tau$ 低于某显式阈值时），并在 $c>1/2$ 时等于最小二乘预测；极限方差在 $c<1$ 时保持先验值，在 $c=1$ 时与NNGP方差一致，在 $c>1$ 时趋于消失。

Conclusion: 通过恰当选择 $\tau$ 与 $c$，可分别恢复NNGP后验的期望或方差，说明温度调度提供了在均值与方差间进行权衡、缓解先验主导的控制手段。

Abstract: In wide Bayesian neural networks, Gaussian mean-field variational inference is prone to "prior dominance": the Kullback-Leibler (KL) regularization term of the ELBO outweighs the expected log-likelihood, and the variational predictive distribution collapses to the prior predictive as the width $M$ grows. Tempering the likelihood, by raising it to the power $1/T$ for a temperature $T < 1$, is equivalent to scaling the KL term by $T$. We ask in this paper how fast $T$ must decrease with $M$ to counteract this degeneracy and strike a good balance between the two terms. For single-hidden-layer linear networks with isotropic Gaussian priors, we derive the limiting predictive distribution under schedules of the form $T = τ/M^{c}$, with constants $τ, c > 0$, as $M \to \infty$ and compare it with the untempered neural network Gaussian process (NNGP) posterior, the infinite-width limit of the exact posterior. Our main result is that the predictive expectation and variance undergo phase transitions at different scales: the limiting expectation leaves its prior value at $c = 1/2$, once $τ$ falls below an explicit threshold, and equals the least-squares prediction for $c > 1/2$, whereas the limiting variance keeps its prior value for $c < 1$, matches the NNGP's for $c=1$, and vanishes for $c > 1$. With suitable choices of $τ,c$, one can recover either the NNGP posterior expectation or its variance.

</details>


### [537] [Adjoint-Based Calibration and Optimal Control of Stochastic Multiscale Bioprocess Digital Twins](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09505)
*Keilung Choy,Wei Xie*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 针对多尺度生物过程模型，提出一种偏差感知的数字孪生校准与控制框架，融合SDE建模、准似然估计、伴随敏感性分析与偏差量化，并开发Actor-Simulator算法，同时更新参数、选择实验与优化控制策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多尺度生物过程处于生物系统之系统（Bio-SoS）范式中，观测稀疏离散、模型存在截断偏差，且校准不确定性会传播至价值函数与控制策略表现，现有方法难以同时兼顾校准精度、实验选择与控制优化。

Method: 以随机微分方程（SDE）表示数字孪生，利用准似然估计与伴随敏感性分析从稀疏离散观测中校准；用基于SDE生成元的矩展开刻画截断引起的参数偏差；通过前向-后向伴随量化校准不确定性向价值函数与策略性能的传播；由参数误差分布驱动策略导向的自适应实验设计与二阶高斯平均目标下的不确定性感知策略优化；实现Actor-Simulator算法联合更新模型参数、选择信息性实验并优化控制策略。

Result: 刻画了所导出探索准则的渐近行为，推导了优化策略下的物理系统性能；数值研究显示在校准精度、样本效率与控制性能上优于当前最先进基线。

Conclusion: 该偏差感知数字孪生框架将校准、实验设计与控制统一于Bio-SoS范式，理论与数值结果验证了其在不确定性量化和性能提升方面的有效性。

Abstract: We develop a bias-aware digital-twin calibration and control framework for multiscale bioprocess models within a biological systems-of-systems (Bio-SoS) paradigm. The digital twin is represented by a stochastic differential equation (SDE) model and calibrated from sparse, discrete observations using quasi-likelihood estimation and adjoint sensitivity analysis. SDE generator-based moment expansions characterize truncation-induced parameter bias, while forward-backward adjoints quantify how calibration uncertainty propagates to value functions and policy performance. The resulting parameter-error distribution supports both policy-directed adaptive experimental design and uncertainty-aware policy optimization through a second-order Gaussian-averaged objective. We characterize the asymptotic behavior of the resulting exploration criterion and derive a physical-system performance under the optimized policy. To implement these ideas, we develop an Actor-Simulator algorithm that jointly updates model parameters, selects informative experiments, and optimizes control policies. Numerical studies demonstrate improved calibration accuracy, sample efficiency, and control performance relative to state-of-the-art baselines.

</details>


### [538] [Reflected Anchored Langevin Algorithms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09522)
*Changwei Tu,Xiaoyu Wang,Yingli Wang,Xicheng Zhang,Lingjiong Zhu*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 该论文提出反射锚定朗之万动力学（RALD）及其离散算法RALMC，用于在有约束域上对不可微目标进行采样，并给出2-Wasserstein距离下的显式收敛界与迭代复杂度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有的约束采样一阶朗之万算法（如基于反射朗之万动力学离散化的投影朗之万蒙特卡洛）要求对数密度可微，限制了其在目标不可微情形下的适用性。

Method: 构造反射锚定朗之万动力学（RALD）：一种在有约束域上收敛到不可微目标的反射扩散。方法采用光滑的锚定参考势，并将反射朗之万动力学的漂移项与噪声协方差同时乘以同一个状态相关的缩放因子；对其做带投影的Euler-Maruyama离散化，得到反射锚定朗之万蒙特卡洛（RALMC）算法。

Result: 证明了RALMC在2-Wasserstein距离下收敛到目标分布的显式收敛界与迭代复杂度；数值实验验证了理论预测并展示了方法的实际性能。

Conclusion: 通过锚定参考势与状态相关缩放因子的设计，RALD/RALMC在无需目标可微的前提下实现了约束域上的采样，并具备理论收敛保证与良好经验表现。

Abstract: First order Langevin algorithms for constrained sampling in machine learning, such as projected Langevin Monte Carlo which are based on discretizations of reflected Langevin dynamics, require differentiable log densities that limits their applicability. This paper introduces reflected anchored Langevin dynamics (RALD), a reflected diffusion that converges to non-differentiable targets on constrained domains. The method uses a smooth anchored reference potential and multiplies the drift and noise covariance of its reflected Langevin dynamics by the same state dependent scaling factor. Its Euler-Maruyama discretization with projection gives reflected anchored Langevin Monte Carlo (RALMC) algorithm. We prove explicit convergence bounds and iteration complexity for RALMC in the 2-Wasserstein distance to the target distribution. Numerical experiments are provided to illustrate the theoretical predictions and the empirical performance of the method.

</details>


### [539] [Unpaired Canonical Correlation Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09530)
*Nir Ben-Ari,Ronen Talmon,Uri Shaham*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出UCCA，通过将二次分配问题与CCA建立理论联系，首次在严格无配对样本条件下学习最大化真实配对相关性的线性投影，并在多模态数据上显著优于现有无配对对齐基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统CCA要求严格配对的多视图数据，而实际中配对数据往往难以获取甚至完全缺失，这限制了CCA的应用。本文旨在填补传统统计多视图学习与无配对数据学习之间的空白。

Method: 提出Unpaired CCA (UCCA)：首先建立二次分配问题（QAP）与CCA的理论联系，基于该理论推导出仅利用无配对数据即可最大化相关性的实用方法，学习使真实潜在配对相关性最大的线性投影。

Result: 在真实世界多模态数据集上验证，UCCA在恢复潜在真实相关性方面显著优于近期无配对对齐基线方法。

Conclusion: UCCA是首个在严格无配对设置下学习最大相关投影的方法，填补了传统统计多视图学习与无配对数据学习之间的关键空白。

Abstract: Canonical Correlation Analysis (CCA) is a fundamental method for multiview shared space learning. However, its strict reliance on paired data poses a significant limitation, as such data is often difficult to obtain or entirely unavailable. In this paper, we present Unpaired CCA (UCCA), a novel method that learns linear projections to maximize the correlation of the true underlying pairing without access to any paired samples during training. We first establish theoretical results connecting the Quadratic Assignment Problem (QAP) to CCA. Leveraging these theoretical insights, we derive a practical method to maximize correlation exclusively from unpaired data. To the best of our knowledge, UCCA is the first approach to learn maximally correlated projections in a strictly unpaired setting. We validate UCCA on real-world multi-modal datasets, demonstrating that it significantly outperforms recent unpaired alignment baselines in recovering the underlying true correlation. This work fills a critical gap between traditional statistical multiview learning and the growing field of unpaired data learning.

</details>


### [540] [Certified by Abstention: Distribution-Free Guarantees for Chain-of-Thought Verifiers at Small Calibration Budgets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09541)
*Arjun Balaji*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文研究分布无关的选择性保序保证（conformal selective guarantee）在链式思维（CoT）验证器上的实际效果。基于7个开源模型、5种验证信号和37,000条已评分推理轨迹，在数十至数百标注问题的真实校准预算下，发现标准证书因"弃权吸收失败"而失效，并提出一种无需单调性假设的"地板启动固定序列证书"，将非空覆盖从0.05提升到0.16。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有工作多用AUC比较CoT验证信号，但AUC本身无法给出可部署的保证；部署需要一个带统计保证的阈值。作者希望回答：在真实的校准预算（数十到几百个标注问题）和分布无关假设下，选择性保证对CoT验证器究竟能提供什么。

Method: 在7个开源模型、5种验证信号、37,000条已评分轨迹上评估。核心是"弃权有效性"分析：一个(α,δ)-有效程序若以概率P_fire发放证书，其失败概率仅被δ/P_fire界定。通过已知风险的模拟、认证地板（certification floor）与Benjamini-Hochberg保形选择的格条件解释弃权现象，并提出"地板启动固定序列证书"，无需单调性假设。

Result: 已知风险模拟中，标准证书在≤0.3%的校准抽样中失效，但在其实际发放证书的抽样中失效比例最高达69%。标准证书要么不返回任何结果，要么返回很大的接受集，无法命中非空目标。不可读的残差流探针（residual-stream probe）覆盖率达可读信号的2–3倍，且交叉拟合重构无法从可读特征线性恢复这一优势。新证书在每个"模型-信号"组合上覆盖都超过Bonferroni证书，并把非空目标0.75π₀处的覆盖从0.05提高到0.16，但地板仍使绝对覆盖偏小。

Conclusion: 分布无关的选择性保证在真实校准预算下对CoT验证器作用有限：认证地板导致证书普遍弃权，绝对覆盖率很低。更关键的是，证书无法预测部署后的问题——在基准漂移下，被接受轨迹的错误率会跟随新任务的基础错误率；在best-of-n选择对抗验证器时，实际错误率会越过目标，而经验失败频率仍低于δ，因为弃权吸收了失败。因此证书的有效性不等于部署时的可靠性。

Abstract: Signals that predict whether a chain-of-thought (CoT) trace is correct are compared by AUC, but deploying one requires a threshold with a guarantee. We ask what distribution-free selective guarantees deliver for CoT verifiers at realistic calibration budgets of tens to a few hundred labelled problems, using seven open models, five verifier signals and 37,000 graded traces. The central observation is validity by abstention: an $(α,δ)$-valid procedure that issues a certificate with probability $P_{\rm fire}$ bounds the failure probability of an issued certificate only by $δ/P_{\rm fire}$, so a certificate that rarely fires can be valid and wrong every time it is used. In a simulation with known risk the standard certificate fails in at most 0.3% of calibration draws but in up to 69% of those in which it fires. A certification floor and a lattice condition for Benjamini-Hochberg conformal selection explain why certificates abstain at these budgets, and the data bear them out: the standard certificate returns nothing or a large accepted set, and an unreadable residual-stream probe buys two to three times the coverage of the readable signals, an edge a cross-fitted reconstruction cannot recover linearly from the readable features. We then give a floor-started fixed-sequence certificate, valid without monotonicity assumptions, that covers more than the Bonferroni certificate on every model-signal pair and raises coverage at the non-vacuous target $0.75π_0$ from 0.05 to 0.16, although the floor keeps absolute coverage small. Finally, a certificate cannot see what matters after deployment: under benchmark shift the error among accepted traces tracks the new task's base error, and under best-of-$n$ selection against the verifier it rises past the target while the empirical failure frequency stays below $δ$, because abstention absorbs the failures.

</details>


### [541] [Scalable Logistic Gaussian Process Density Regression with Kinetic Langevin Sampling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09591)
*Daniel Paulin,Ádám Jung,András A. Benczúr*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于logistic高斯过程的可扩展贝叶斯条件密度估计器，采用可分离协方差与Nyström特征，通过Kronecker白化坐标下的动能Langevin动力学直接采样非高斯隐后验，在390万样本的光度红移基准上单GPU训练即可媲美SOTA表格基础模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 条件密度估计需要刻画响应变量在给定协变量下的完整分布（如逐星系光度红移）。但现有高斯过程方法多依赖Laplace或变分近似，难以在超大规模数据上精确刻画非高斯隐后验并保持可扩展性，因此需要一种既精确又可扩展的贝叶斯估计器。

Method: 基于logistic高斯过程构建；对数条件密度采用可分离协方差：响应方向用Matérn核并以圆上截断Fourier基表示，协变量方向用Nyström特征表示，可支持带输入相关幅度与长度尺度的非平稳核。不对隐场做Laplace或变分近似，而是直接采样有限特征模型的隐场。给定超参数时其后验强对数凹且Hessian一致有界，通过Kronecker白化坐标下的对称小批量拆分动能Langevin动力学采样；边缘似然梯度由Fisher恒等式给出为后验期望，其偏差由采样步长与运行长度控制。

Result: 在最多390万条训练观测的光度红移基准上，仅用单块GPU训练，该估计器在密度与校准指标上可与当前最先进的表格基础模型相竞争；预测是对非高斯隐后验求平均，而非在其众数处的Gaussian近似。

Conclusion: 该工作将logistic高斯过程与高效MCMC采样结合，在理论上保证了强对数凹后验与可控的梯度偏差，在实践上实现了大尺度条件密度估计，为逐星系光度红移等任务提供了可扩展的贝叶斯解决方案。

Abstract: Conditional density estimation targets the full distribution of a response given covariates, as required, for example, for per-galaxy photometric redshifts. We develop a scalable Bayesian estimator based on the logistic Gaussian process. The log conditional density has a separable covariance: a Matérn kernel along the response, represented in a truncated Fourier basis on a circle, and a covariate kernel represented by Nyström features, which accommodate non-stationary kernels with input-dependent amplitudes and length scales. Instead of a Laplace or variational approximation, we sample the latent field of this finite-feature model. Given the hyperparameters, its posterior is strongly log-concave with a uniformly bounded Hessian, and we draw from it by simulating kinetic Langevin dynamics with symmetric minibatch splitting in Kronecker-whitened coordinates. Marginal-likelihood gradients follow from Fisher's identity as posterior expectations. Under the conditions of our analysis their bias is controlled by the sampler's step size and run length, and the predictive averages over the non-Gaussian latent posterior instead of a Gaussian around its mode. On photometric-redshift benchmarks with up to 3.9 million training observations, trained on a single GPU, the estimator is competitive with state-of-the-art tabular foundation models on density and calibration metrics.

</details>


### [542] [Sparsifying Stochasticity, Not Capacity: Partial Stochasticity via Deep Weight Factorization of Prior Scales](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09886)
*Marius P Linhard,Maurizio Filippone*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 论文研究贝叶斯神经网络中"哪些参数应当随机"这一问题，通过深度权重分解学习先验尺度并利用MMD拟合函数先验，实现"稀疏化随机性"而非稀疏化容量，并给出线性时间可验证的通用条件密度逼近证书。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 贝叶斯神经网络不必完全随机即可作为通用条件密度逼近器，但哪些参数应当保持随机、哪些应当确定，此前尚无定论。同时，常见的"部分采样、部分优化"混合方案的理论性质也不清楚。

Method: 对参数先验的标准差（即先验尺度）施加深度权重分解，并以最大均值差异（MMD）目标将函数先验拟合到高斯过程。当某参数的先验尺度低于阈值时，该参数变为确定性并在推断时被优化，从而使正则化项稀疏化随机性而非稀疏化容量。此外，给出可在<strong>线性时间</strong>内检验的通用条件密度逼近证书，以及在证书失败时的最小修复方案；并从理论上分析混合采样-优化方案与耦合步长的行为。

Result: 证明部分采样、部分优化的常见混合方案是第二类最大后验（type-II MAP）目标的随机逼近；耦合步长会留下随步长缩小而不消失的跟踪误差。在双峰目标上，学习到的随机/确定划分在所有预算下都接近无约束参考，且对阈值不敏感；而将相同先验尺度随机分配到各层的随机掩码最多差两个数量级。在UCI基准上，方法性能与完全随机网络相当，但约有一半参数为确定性。

Conclusion: 通过先验尺度的深度权重分解，可自动学习贝叶斯神经网络中应保持随机的参数子集，实现随机性稀疏化而非容量稀疏化。该方法具有线性时间可检验的通用条件密度逼近保证，并保持与全随机网络相当的性能，同时将约半数参数转为确定性。

Abstract: Bayesian neural networks need not be fully stochastic to be universal conditional density approximators, but it remains open which parameters should be stochastic. We learn this split by applying deep weight factorization to the prior scales, which are the standard deviations of the parameter priors, while fitting the functional prior to a Gaussian process with a maximum mean discrepancy objective. A parameter whose prior scale falls below a cutoff becomes deterministic and is optimized during inference, so the regularizer sparsifies stochasticity rather than capacity. We give a certificate for universal conditional density approximation that is checkable in linear time, together with a minimal repair when it fails. We further show that the common hybrid scheme of sampling some parameters and optimizing the others is stochastic approximation for a type-II maximum a posteriori objective, and that coupled step sizes can leave a tracking error that does not vanish as the step size shrinks. On a bimodal target, the learned split stays close to an unconstrained reference across all budgets and is insensitive to the cutoff, while random masks that distribute the same prior scales across layers are worse by up to two orders of magnitude. On UCI benchmarks, our method performs on par with a fully stochastic network while keeping about half of its parameters deterministic.

</details>


### [543] [Possibilistic Radial Transport for Approximate IM Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09956)
*Jungeum Kim,Percy Zhai*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种可能性径向传输方法，将参数的可能性轮廓值编码进源点半径，通过最大化壳内熵的传输，使采样覆盖置信切割只需截断半径；配合深度学习算法实现摊销推断，用于假设检验、覆盖/功效评估、预测检验以及Bel-Pl谱的假设比较与选择，并在仿真与卵巢衰老AMH数据上验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在看到数据后探测假设空间在可能性推断模型下仍有效（固定显著性水平），但计算代价高：每个似真性是可能性轮廓在假设上的上确界，且轮廓需在每个查询参数值处近似。因此需要一种高效的摊销式采样/近似方法来降低计算成本。

Method: 提出可能性径向传输：将参数的可能性轮廓值隐藏在源点半径中；选择最大化壳内熵的传输后，采样覆盖置信切割的参数等价于截断半径。提供一个深度学习算法，在满足轮廓深度条件的同时最大化每个壳内的熵，从而学习该传输（摊销近似）。

Result: 摊销使学习近似的覆盖与功效评估变得可行，并可对新数据集进行预测检验；采样器还能构造Bel-Pl谱，用于比较与选择满足给定Bel-Pl决策准则的可解释假设。仿真中学习到的轮廓匹配或优于对切割的椭球近似，覆盖与功效贴近精确参考。

Conclusion: 该可能性径向传输与深度学习摊销方法在保持有效性（固定显著性水平下）的同时显著提升计算可行性，能同时支持推断、预测检验与假设选择，并在卵巢衰老合成AMH记录上探测假设：对每位女性估计其中位AMH水平将保持在指定参考值之上的剩余年数。

Abstract: Probing the hypothesis space after seeing the data remains valid under possibilistic inferential models (IMs), provided the significance level stays fixed. The price is computation, as each plausibility is a supremum of the possibility contour over the hypothesis, and the contour itself is approximated at each queried parameter value. We propose a possibilistic radial transport, which hides the contour value of a parameter in the radius of its source point. When a transport that maximizes within-shell entropy is picked, sampling parameters covering a confidence cut becomes a matter of truncating the radius. We provide a deep learning algorithm that enforces the contour depth condition while maximizing the entropy within each shell. Our amortization makes coverage and power assessments of the learned approximation practical as well as predictive check of new datasets. We also use the sampler to construct a Bel-Pl spectrum for comparing and selecting interpretable hypotheses that satisfy a prescribed Bel-Pl decision criterion. In simulations the learned contours match or improve on ellipsoidal approximations to the cuts, while the coverage and power track the exact reference. Finally, we probe hypotheses about ovarian aging using synthetic AMH records, asking for each woman how many more years her median AMH level will remain above a specified reference value.

</details>


### [544] [Extreme Binary Classification: Extreme Value Theory for Extreme Constraint on False Negative](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09984)
*Samuel Gruffaz,Muhammad Fawad,Jaakko Nevalainen*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出"极端二分类"问题，要求分类器的假负率以 o(1/N₁) 趋于零（N₁ 为正样本数），并给出基于极值理论的阈值自适应方法与基于样本极大值置换检验的特征选择方法，在四个真实数据集上优于现有方法，并在癌症筛查数据上展示了可解释性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统二分类研究充分，但"要求假负率近乎为零"的场景鲜有系统研究。此类需求在癌症筛查等高风险应用中至关重要：漏检（假负）代价远高于误检，因此需要理论化的极端低假负率保证。

Method: 方法由两部分组成：(1) 阈值自适应方法，其理论保证来源于极值理论（Extreme Value Theory），用样本极大值的渐近分布刻画正类尾部，从而在统计上控制假负率 α；(2) 基于置换检验（permutation test）作用于样本极大值的特征选择流程，用以筛选对尾部极值判别有效的特征。

Result: 在四个规模各异的真实数据集上，该方法与当前最先进方法相比具有竞争力（favorable）；在癌症筛查数据集上的应用进一步展示了模型的可解释性。

Conclusion: 作者提出了极端二分类这一新问题设定，并给出具极值理论支撑的阈值自适应与特征选择框架，验证了其在极端低假负率目标下的有效性与可解释性，为该方向提供了理论与实证基础。

Abstract: While binary classification is one of the most extensively studied problems in machine learning,
  the regime in which the goal is to learn a classifier with an almost zero false negative rate remains largely unexplored.
  In this paper, we introduce the Extreme Binary Classification problem, where the objective is to learn a classifier whose false negative rate $α$ is constrained by $ε_{N_1}=o_{N_1\to\infty}(1/N_1)$, with $N_1$ denoting the number of positive examples in the training set.
  To address this problem, we propose a threshold adaptation method theoretically grounded in guarantees derived from Extreme Value Theory, together with a feature selection procedure based on a permutation test applied to sample maxima.
  Experimental results on four real-world datasets of varying sizes demonstrate that our approach compares favorably with state-of-the-art methods.
  In addition, we illustrate its interpretability through an application to a cancer screening dataset.

</details>


### [545] [Controlling Dependence in Implicit Generative Models via Spread Mutual Information](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10021)
*Jiahao Yu,Song Liu,José Miguel Hernández-Lobato,RuiKang OuYang*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 该论文提出Spread Mutual Information (SMI)，通过对生成变量施加公共扩散核并跨噪声水平对互信息加权积分，将基于分数差分的互信息梯度构造推广到可能奇异的分布，从而在多个实验中实现有效的依赖控制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 隐式生成模型中，互信息可用于抑制或鼓励统计依赖，但隐式模型密度通常不可解，难以直接评估互信息。一种补救方法是利用条件分数与边缘分数之差来估计生成器梯度，该分数差可通过对分类学得的对数密度比求导获得。然而该构造存在两个困难：(i) 奇异分布不一定存在所需的分数函数；(ii) 支撑重叠不佳会妨碍密度比估计。

Method: 提出Spread Mutual Information (SMI)：对生成变量施加公共扩散核，得到跨噪声水平的互信息加权积分。以高斯扩散为例，可获得光滑且严格正的条件密度与边缘密度，从而将原本基于分数差分的梯度构造推广到可能奇异的分布，缓解支撑重叠不足的问题。

Result: 在多种实验中，SMI在基于互信息的方法中持续实现有效的依赖控制，并与已有的任务专用方法相比具有竞争力。

Conclusion: SMI通过扩散核平滑与跨噪声水平加权积分，克服了分数差分互信息估计中奇异分布与支撑重叠不足的局限，为隐式生成模型提供了一种有效且具有竞争力的依赖控制目标。

Abstract: Mutual information (MI) provides an objective for suppressing or encouraging statistical dependence in implicit generative models. However, direct MI evaluation is challenging in implicit models due to typically intractable densities. A remedy is estimating the generator gradient from the difference between conditional and marginal scores. This score difference can, in turn, be estimated by differentiating a log density ratio learned through classification. This construction nevertheless faces two difficulties: (i) singular distributions need not admit the required score functions, and (ii) poor overlap can hinder density-ratio estimation. We therefore introduce Spread Mutual Information (SMI), a weighted integral of MI across noise levels obtained by applying a common spreading kernel to the generated variable. Gaussian spreading yields smooth, strictly positive conditional and marginal densities, extending the gradient construction to distributions that may originally be singular. Across a variaty of experiments, SMI consistently achieves effective dependence control among MI-based methods and remains competitive with established task-specific approaches.

</details>


### [546] [Gaussian Equivalence for Multi-Head Self-Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10033)
*Tomohiro Hayase,Ryo Karakida*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 利用随机矩阵理论证明多头自注意力的高斯等价性，保留中心化输出的极限谱分布。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多头自注意力是现代神经网络的核心机制，但其理论研究仍不充分，需要从理论上刻画其输出谱特性及不同结构因素的影响。

Method: 运用随机矩阵理论建立高斯等价：将 softmax 注意力替换为缩放分数加高斯噪声；该等价涵盖依赖于键的值投影与输出投影。

Result: 得到的极限谱定律能够分离头分配与投影宽度的影响，并区分跨头共享（谱保持）与头内键-值依赖两种结构。

Conclusion: 为多头自注意力提供了可分析的高斯近似框架，揭示头结构与投影维度对输出谱的独立作用。

Abstract: A theoretical understanding of multi-head self-attention is fundamental to the study of modern neural networks. Using random matrix theory, we establish Gaussian equivalence for multi-head self-attention: replacing softmax attention with rescaled scores plus Gaussian noise preserves the limiting spectral law of the centered output. This equivalence also covers value and output projections that depend on the keys. The resulting laws separate the effects of head allocation and projection widths, and distinguish spectrum-preserving across-head sharing from within-head key--value dependence.

</details>


### [547] [Towards Calibrated Probabilistic Forecasts for Events of Interest via Outcome-Conditional Recalibration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10076)
*Jakob Benjamin Wessel,Sam Allen*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出"结果条件校准"（outcome-conditional recalibration），一种事后重校准方法，可针对用户指定的结果空间区域校准概率预测，在回归基准与电价预测任务中改善了特定结果（如极端事件、负电价）的条件校准，同时保持整体校准与预测精度的竞争力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 概率预测要用于决策必须校准，但现有方法常产生误校准的预测分布。已有的事后重校准方案可能在结果空间的特定区域隐藏误校准，而对决策最重要的往往是极端事件等特定结果。因此需要一种能将评估与校准限制在用户关注的结果区域的方法。

Method: 提出结果条件重校准：先对预测的条件分布应用 Kuleshov 等（2018）的分位数重校准，再将条件分布重新缩放，使预测事件概率与经验发生频率一致，从而在任意结果空间区域内生成有效且连续的校准预测分布。方法简单易实现，适用于任意预测分布。

Result: 在多个回归基准上，现有重校准方案在关注特定结果时并不必然给出校准预测；本文方法在结果条件校准上优于现有条件与无条件重校准方法，同时整体校准保持竞争力。在日前电价预测应用中，显著改善了对负电价的校准，且对预测精度的损失可忽略。

Conclusion: 结果条件重校准为针对特定结果区域的概率预测校准提供了通用、易实施的事后方案，在极端事件与负电价等关键场景中提升了条件校准质量，同时不牺牲整体校准与预测精度。

Abstract: Calibration is an essential requirement for probabilistic predictions to be useful for decision making. While state-of-the-art prediction methods often yield miscalibrated predictive distributions, several post-hoc recalibration schemes have been proposed to generate calibrated predictions. However, popular recalibration schemes can conceal miscalibration in specific regions of the outcome space. Since particular outcomes, such as extreme events, often matter most for decision making, probabilistic predictions should be calibrated when evaluation is restricted to these outcomes. Hence, in this paper, we introduce outcome-conditional recalibration, a post-hoc method to recalibrate probabilistic predictions on user-defined regions of the outcome space. The method is simple, easy to implement, and can be applied to arbitrary predictive distributions. It works by applying the quantile recalibration approach of Kuleshov et al. (2018) to forecast conditional distributions, before rescaling these conditional distributions so that forecast event probabilities match empirical occurrence frequencies. This produces valid and continuous predictive distributions that are calibrated within each region of interest. Across regression benchmarks, we demonstrate that existing recalibration schemes do not necessarily yield calibrated predictions when interest is on particular outcomes, and that our approach improves outcome-conditional calibration relative to existing conditional and unconditional recalibration methods, while retaining competitive calibration overall. In an application to day-ahead electricity price forecasting, the approach substantially improves calibration when predicting negative prices, at negligible cost to forecast accuracy.

</details>


### [548] [Conformal Prediction for Spatially Dependent Data via Sequential Whitening](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10168)
*Ayush Baran Sen,Arkajyoti Saha*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种在空间依赖下改进分裂共形预测的方法：通过在序列上额外条件化校准残差，实现任意空间设计下的精确有限样本覆盖，并提升区间效率与稳定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准分裂共形预测依赖校准误差与目标误差可交换性，在空间依赖和非随机采样几何下会失效。现有空间方法用拟合残差去除可预测的空间变异，但仅校准残差能预测的那部分空间变异仍残留在目标误差与校准误差中，导致区间效率与稳定性下降。

Method: 在去除可预测空间变异的基础上，进一步对校准残差进行序列条件化，并通过最近邻近似扩展到大规模网络；理论分析建立在正确的工作协方差与椭圆残差分布假设下。

Result: 在正确工作协方差和椭圆残差律下，所得区间在任意空间设计下具有精确有限样本覆盖，并在进一步条件下渐近达到oracle效率；同时给出协方差误设下的覆盖损失上界，并开发可识别低覆盖风险区域的诊断方法。模拟中区间比全局和局部最先进替代方法更窄、更稳定；全国PM2.5应用中，在网内产生更窄区间并识别覆盖失败风险区域。

Conclusion: 通过对校准残差序列条件化并结合最近邻近似，该方法在空间依赖下兼顾有限样本覆盖、渐近效率与大规模可扩展性，并提供误设诊断，优于现有空间共形预测方法。

Abstract: Split conformal prediction uses prediction errors on held-out (calibration) data to determine how wide the prediction intervals should be. It guarantees distribution-free finite-sample coverage when these errors and the error at the target site are exchangeable. This assumption may fail under spatial dependence and nonrandom sampling geometry. Existing spatial methods use fitting residuals to remove the predictable part of spatial variation from calibration and target errors. However, the spatial variation that only the calibration residuals can predict remains in both the target and calibration errors, reducing the efficiency and stability of the interval. We address this by additionally conditioning on the calibration residuals sequentially, which scales to large networks through nearest-neighbour approximations. Under a correct working covariance and an elliptical residual law, the resulting interval has exact finite-sample coverage under any spatial design, and under further conditions it is asymptotically oracle efficient. We also bound coverage loss under covariance misspecification and develop a diagnostic that identifies regions at risk of undercoverage. In simulated data, our method produces narrower and more stable intervals than global and localized state-of-the-art alternatives. In a national PM2.5 application, it produces narrower intervals within the network and identifies regions at risk of coverage failure.

</details>


### [549] [Kinetic Langevin Meets Split Gibbs: Accelerated Posterior Sampling for Imaging Inverse Problems with Diffusion Priors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10187)
*Dai Hai Nguyen,Duc Dung Nguyen*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 提出RED-KLwSGS：在Split Gibbs Sampling中用单次去噪分数驱动的欠阻尼Langevin扩散更新辅助变量，保持与Langevin-within-SGS相同的单次迭代成本，并在强对数凹先验下证明非渐近Wasserstein-2收敛，实验上收敛更快、重建质量高。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 贝叶斯成像逆问题中的后验采样常用SGS框架，它将高斯数据保真项与复杂先验解耦。现有采样器对先验侧条件分布的处理存在两难：Plug-and-play SGS每步需运行多步扩散去噪器，计算昂贵且缺乏非渐近保证；Langevin-within-SGS虽每步便宜但需大量迭代。因此需要一种兼顾低单步成本与快速收敛、且有理论保证的方法。

Method: 保持数据变量的精确高斯更新，辅助变量改用欠阻尼（动能）Langevin扩散，并由一次性的去噪分数（one-shot denoising score）驱动，单次迭代成本与Langevin-within-SGS相当。进一步提出Joint-RED-KLwSGS，对两个变量均采用动能Langevin扩散。理论方面，针对强对数凹先验，在连续与离散时间下证明非渐近Wasserstein-2收敛。

Result: 在FFHQ与ImageNet数据集上，以去噪扩散概率模型（DDPM）作为扩散先验的实验表明，所提方法收敛更快，并获得高质量图像重建。

Conclusion: RED-KLwSGS通过欠阻尼Langevin扩散与单次去噪分数，在保持低单步成本的同时提升了SGS后验采样的收敛速度，并具备非渐近收敛理论支撑；联合版本进一步扩展至双变量更新，在图像逆问题中表现优于现有方案。

Abstract: Split Gibbs sampling (SGS) is a popular framework for posterior sampling in Bayesian imaging inverse problems. It decouples a Gaussian data-fidelity term from a complex prior through an auxiliary variable, so the data variable is updated exactly and only the prior-side conditional is hard to sample. Existing samplers treat this conditional in one of two ways. Plug-and-play SGS runs a multi-step diffusion denoiser at every iteration, which is expensive and lacks non-asymptotic guarantees. Langevin-within-SGS takes cheap overdamped Langevin steps but needs many iterations. We propose RED-KLwSGS, which keeps the exact Gaussian update for the data variable and updates the auxiliary variable with underdamped (kinetic) Langevin diffusions driven by a one-shot denoising score, at the same per-iteration cost as Langevin-within-SGS. We prove non-asymptotic Wasserstein-2 convergence in continuous and discrete time for strongly log-concave priors. We also introduce Joint-RED-KLwSGS, which applies kinetic Langevin diffusions to both variables. Experiments with Denoising diffusion probabilistic models as diffusion priors on FFHQ and ImageNet datasets show faster convergence and high-quality image reconstruction.

</details>


### [550] [Universal Local Error and Realized Amplification for the First-Order EDM Predictor](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10190)
*Nicolas Brosse,Arnak S. Dalalyan*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文在2-Wasserstein距离下分析EDM确定性扩散采样器的一阶离散化误差，将其分解为局部离散化误差与经学习步骤的误差放大，证明局部误差具有与数据分布无关的二次界，并给出低噪声放大的全局误差界O(e^{Λ_K}/K)。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型采样通常需要大量步骤，其离散化误差来源与传播机理尚不清晰；已有分析往往难以区分局部离散误差与网络导致的误差放大，且放大估计多依赖最坏情况Lipschitz常数，可能过于保守。作者希望为EDM这类一阶确定性采样器提供更精细、可解释的误差理论。

Method: 将总误差拆为局部离散化误差与后续学习步骤的放大两部分。证明局部单步误差对任意有限二阶矩分布均为步长二次且常数与分布无关。高噪声下利用EDM的网络参数化推导显式收缩准则；低噪声下用采样器所输送分布上实现的放大（realized amplification）刻画传播，而非最坏情况Lipschitz常数。在1维高斯混合和预训练CIFAR-10模型上做诊断实验。

Result: 局部误差具有普适二次界，常数不依赖数据分布；高噪声可由EDM参数化得到显式收缩条件；低噪声放大由分布上的实现放大衡量，可远小于最坏情况Lipschitz常数。由此得到K步采样的全局离散化误差上界O(e^{Λ_K}/K)，Λ_K为低噪声对数放大。1维高斯混合实验显示实测放大解释了有限网格上误差衰减变慢的现象；CIFAR-10诊断展示相关稳定性机制，但不构成对全局假设的证明。

Conclusion: 该工作将EDM采样误差清晰分解为可普适界定的局部项与依赖学习网络的传播项，提出比最坏情况Lipschitz更紧的"实现放大"视角，并给出O(e^{Λ_K}/K)的全局误差刻划。实验验证了放大对误差衰减的解释力，同时指出高维预训练模型上的结论仍属诊断性质而非严格认证。

Abstract: We analyze the first-order deterministic diffusion sampler of Karras et al. (2022), termed EDM, in 2-Wasserstein distance by separating two sources of error: local discretization error and its amplification by subsequent learned steps. We prove that local error admits a universal bound: for any data distribution with finite second moment, the one-step discretization error is quadratic in the step size, with an explicit constant that does not depend on the data distribution. Error propagation, in contrast, depends on the learned network. At high noise levels, we exploit the network parametrization of EDM to derive an explicit contraction criterion. At low noise levels, we measure propagation through the amplification realized on the distributions transported by the sampler; this realized amplification can be arbitrarily smaller than the worst-case Lipschitz constant. This analysis yields an $O(e^{Λ_K}/K)$ global discretization error for $K$ sampling steps, where $Λ_K$ is the low-noise log-amplification. Experiments on a one-dimensional Gaussian mixture show how measured amplification accounts for slower error decay on finite sampling grids. Diagnostics on a pretrained CIFAR-10 model illustrate related stability mechanisms without certifying the global assumptions.

</details>


### [551] [Broadly Applicable Approximate MCMC for Switching Stochastic Differential Equations Using Uniformization and Time-Conditioned Factorized Neural Likelihood Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10194)
*Shion Hosoda,Michiaki Hamada*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 提出一种基于均匀化与因子化神经似然估计（FNLE）的近似MCMC采样器，实现无需解析转移密度的切换随机微分方程贝叶斯推断。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 切换随机微分方程（SSDE）可刻画参数随隐状态连续时间马尔可夫链（CTMC）切换的连续时间动力学，广泛用于异质系统建模。但其贝叶斯推断困难，现有方法适用性受限，存在无噪声观测、单变量状态、线性漂移、状态无关扩散等限制。

Method: 利用均匀化（uniformization）给出CTMC的精确表示，但需任意时间间隔上的SDE转移密度；为此训练一个时间条件化的因子化神经似然估计（FNLE，属于基于模拟的推断）模型来近似这些转移密度，并将其嵌入近似MCMC采样器中，从而无需解析可解的转移密度。

Result: 在合成数据实验中，对三个以往方法适用性受限的SSDE模型成功恢复了状态路径与参数；并在真实数据集上检测到一个状态转移。

Conclusion: 所提采样器对SSDE具有广泛适用性，不依赖解析转移密度，为一般切换扩散过程的贝叶斯推断提供了可行且有效的途径。

Abstract: Switching stochastic differential equations (SSDEs) describe continuous-time dynamics whose parameters switch according to a latent regime process that follows a continuous-time Markov chain (CTMC). By allowing dynamics to change between regimes, SSDEs represent heterogeneous system behavior and have been applied across diverse fields. However, Bayesian inference for SSDEs remains difficult, and existing SSDE inference methods have limited applicability, with restrictions such as noise-free observations, univariate states, linear drift, or state-independent diffusion. In this study, we propose an approximate Markov chain Monte Carlo sampler for SSDEs using uniformization and factorized neural likelihood estimation (FNLE), a simulation-based inference method. Uniformization provides an exact representation of the CTMC but requires SDE transition densities over arbitrary time intervals. We approximate these densities by training a time-conditioned FNLE model. The resulting sampler is broadly applicable to SSDEs without requiring analytically tractable transition densities. In synthetic-data experiments, our method recovered regime paths and parameters for three SSDE models for which previous methods have limited applicability. We also applied our method to a real dataset and detected a regime transition.

</details>


### [552] [RoBART: Bayesian Additive Regression Trees with Tree-Specific Rotations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10214)
*Jeongung Heo,Seonghyun Jeong*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: RoBART为每棵树引入共享的Givens旋转，在旋转坐标系下保留轴对齐分裂，并通过Metropolis-Hastings联合采样旋转序列与切点，证明了后验收缩率与下界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准BART依赖轴对齐分裂，逼近与预测轴不平行的边界时需大量分裂，效率低。作者希望通过旋转坐标解决该问题，并从理论上刻画其自适应性。

Method: 为每棵树分配一个由所有内部节点共享的Givens旋转序列，在旋转坐标中保持轴对齐分裂与常数叶；用Metropolis-Hastings在旋转序列与切点网格上联合采样，并在叶均值积分掉后证明条件后验的可逆性。

Result: 对分量各有旋转且具有各向异性Hölder光滑性的可加函数，证明经验L2距离与噪声标准差的收缩率，其速率由各分量的光滑性与所用旋转坐标数决定；并给出后验收缩下界，显示存在某些函数RoBART能适应内在维度而轴对齐BART不能。

Conclusion: RoBART在保持BART简单结构的同时增强了处理非轴对齐结构的能力，理论上具备对内在维度的自适应优势。

Abstract: Bayesian additive regression trees (BART) can require many splits to approximate boundaries misaligned with the predictor axes. RoBART assigns each tree a rotation shared by all internal nodes, retaining axis-aligned splits in rotated coordinates and constant leaves. We jointly propose a Givens rotation sequence and cutpoints on the resulting grid by Metropolis-Hastings and establish reversibility with respect to the conditional posterior with leaf means integrated out. For additive functions with component-specific rotations and anisotropic Hölder smoothness, we prove posterior contraction in empirical $L_2$ distance and for the noise standard deviation. Under the stated prior, design, and grid conditions, with fixed numbers of predictors, trees, and components and no more components than trees, the rate is a sum of componentwise rates determined by smoothness and the number of rotated coordinates used. We also establish a posterior contraction lower bound showing that there exist functions for which RoBART adapts to the intrinsic dimension but axis-aligned BART does not.

</details>


### [553] [Data Reuse in Non-Stationary Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10340)
*Tomer Gafni,Garud Iyengar,Assaf Zeevi*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文研究非平稳环境中的在线学习，目标跟踪在有限循环取值间突变切换的未知参数。作者提出 Exposure-Capped Reuse（ECR）算法类，结合在线变化检测、兼容性测试与"污染"控制，在特定机制下使遗憾界随不同取值数量而非变化次数增长，并给出信息论下界证明其近极小极大最优性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 非平稳环境中参数会在有限个循环出现的取值间突变，这种循环性为复用历史观测提供了可能，可提升算法性能。但底层信号的动态变化以及对这些动态缺乏先验信息，使得"安全"复用数据面临风险。论文旨在量化该问题中的基本权衡，揭示其与经典偏差-方差困境的相似性。

Method: 提出一类随时（anytime）算法，称为 Exposure-Capped Reuse（ECR），其融合三个组件：在线变化检测（online change detection）、兼容性测试（compatibility testing）以及"污染"控制（contamination control）。该框架通过限制数据"暴露"程度来控制复用风险。

Result: 刻画了 ECR 遗憾界随不同取值数量（而非变化次数）增长的机制区间，并推导出一个新的信息论下界，证明 ECR 具有近极小极大最优性（near-minimax optimality）。

Conclusion: 论文对数据复用的统计"价值"给出了严格的量化，表明在循环非平稳环境中，恰当设计的复用机制能够将性能代价从变化次数降低到不同取值数量层面，接近最优。

Abstract: We consider online learning in non-stationary environments, where the goal is to track an unknown parameter that switches abruptly between a finite set of recurring values. Recurrence opens the possibility of judiciously reusing past observations to improve algorithm performance. However, the changing nature of the underlying signal and lack of information on these dynamics may limit the ability to "safely" reuse data. In this paper we quantify some of the fundamental tradeoffs in this class of problems, and show that they bear a certain resemblance to the classical bias-variance dilemma. Specifically, we propose a class of anytime algorithms, dubbed Exposure-Capped Reuse (ECR), that combine online change detection, compatibility testing, and "contamination" control. We characterize the regime in which ECR's regret scales with the number of distinct values rather than the number of changes, and derive a novel information-theoretic lower bound that establishes the near-minimax optimality of ECR. This provides rigorous quantification of the statistical "value" of data reuse.

</details>


### [554] [Dataset Pruning from First Principles: A Label-Free Linear Programming Approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10347)
*Rodrigo Schuller,Francisco Ganacim*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 该论文从无偏子集选择的方差最小化视角出发，重新推导几何选择准则，在高维多胞体上构造高效顶点行走算法，实现无需标签与模型训练的数据集剪枝，并在多基准上匹配或超越均匀采样与对比几何方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于几何的数据集剪枝方法通常假设嵌入空间中邻近点具有相似性质，这一假设缺乏理论依据且可能不成立。作者希望不依赖该假设，通过将无偏子集选择重构为方差最小化问题，从理论上导出几何选择准则。

Method: 将无偏子集选择算法刻画为高维多胞体；在此框架下，最小化期望采样方差是一个线性目标。作者推导出在刚体运动平均下采样方差差的闭式成对表达式。由于多胞体维度高，直接线性规划不实用，因此利用这些表达式构造高效的顶点行走，优化方差目标的近似值，同时保持无偏性。整个选择过程无需标签和模型训练。

Result: 在 CIFAR-10、MNIST 和 CelebA 基准上，该方法在每个评估预算下的平均测试精度均匹配或超过均匀采样，并在若干设置（尤其是小选择预算）下优于竞争性几何方法。此外，同一框架可在保持批大小不变的情况下，通过增加小批量内的多样性来降低随机梯度方差。

Conclusion: 该工作将无偏子集选择统一为方差最小化问题，提供了无需标签和训练的高效几何剪枝方法，并推广至降低随机梯度方差，验证了无偏性约束下几何准则的理论价值与实用效果。

Abstract: Dataset pruning reduces a large training set to a representative subset while preserving model performance. Existing geometry-based methods typically assume that nearby points in embedding space share similar properties. Rather than imposing this assumption, we derive geometric selection criteria by reformulating unbiased subset selection as a variance minimization problem. Unbiasedness ensures that unweighted subset averages recover full-dataset averages in expectation, including losses and gradients at fixed model parameters. Specifically, we characterize a family of unbiased subset selection algorithms as a high-dimensional polytope. In this context, minimizing the expected sampling variance is a linear objective. Differences in sampling variance, averaged over rigid motions, admit closed-form pairwise expressions. Because the polytope has high dimension, directly applying standard linear programming is impractical. We instead use these expressions to construct an efficient vertex walk that optimizes an approximation of the variance objective while preserving unbiasedness, yielding a method that requires neither labels nor model training during selection. Across CIFAR-10, MNIST, and CelebA benchmarks, our method matches or exceeds uniform sampling in mean test accuracy at every evaluated budget and outperforms competing geometric methods in several settings, particularly at small selection budgets. Beyond dataset pruning, the same framework reduces stochastic-gradient variance by increasing diversity within mini-batches while keeping the batch size unchanged.

</details>


### [555] [Safe Meta-Policy Design with Risk Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10393)
*Wenbin Zhou,Michael Lingzhi Li,Shixiang Zhu*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文研究在候选模型训练前如何规划策略更新（元策略），在改进收益与性能回退风险之间权衡。将更新计划建模为DAG路径，用动态规划选择方案，并给出信噪比驱动更新频率的渐近分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模型可随新数据重训练，但每次部署新版本都有用较差策略替换较好策略的风险。需要提前规划更新时机，在有限的风险预算下最大化长期收益。

Method: 将策略更新计划形式化为离线元策略问题：最大化期望累积价值，约束为期望劣于被替换策略的更新次数。利用历史学习轨迹估计切换的价值与风险，把更新日程表示为有向无环图中的路径，并用动态规划求解。

Result: 一阶渐近分析表明策略改进的信噪比是决定更新频率、等待时间和风险分配的关键因素：改进越清晰，更新越早越频繁；改进越嘈杂，需要更长等待或更多风险支出。渐近速率还揭示随时间的推移，获得更高安全性所需的边际成本递减。合成数据与临床试验数据的实验展示了性能—风险权衡，并与多种基线方法进行了比较。

Conclusion: 提前规划策略更新可在改进收益与回退风险之间取得可控平衡，信噪比提供了指导更新频率与安全投入的核心准则，且提高安全性的边际成本随时间递减。

Abstract: Models can be retrained as new data arrive, but deploying every new version risks replacing a good policy with a worse one. We study how to plan policy updates (i.e., meta-policy) before future candidates are trained, balancing the benefits of improvement against the risk of performance regression. Our offline meta-policy maximizes expected cumulative value subject to a budget on the expected number of updates that perform worse than the policies they replace. We estimate the value and risk of possible switches from historical learning trajectories, represent an update schedule as a path in a directed acyclic graph, and select a schedule using dynamic programming. A leading-order analysis identifies the signal-to-noise ratio of policy improvement as a key driver of update frequency, waiting times, and risk allocation: clearer improvements support earlier, more frequent updates, while noisier improvements call for longer waits or greater risk expenditure. Their asymptotic rates also reveal a diminishing marginal cost of achieving greater safety over time. Experiments on synthetic and clinical trial data illustrate the performance--risk tradeoff and compare our method with alternative baselines.

</details>


### [556] [Derivative Gaussian Processes on a Two-Direction Budget](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10428)
*Hyunseok Seung,Matthias Katzfuss*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 提出一种仅用两个方向表示梯度的导数高斯过程方法，显著降低梯度信息引入成本，在精度与效率上均优于精确梯度约简方法和仅函数GP基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 梯度观测虽能提升高斯过程代理模型精度，但将其纳入模型的成本长期很高，难以实际应用。论文旨在以极低预算利用梯度信息。

Method: 提出每观测梯度仅用两个方向的导数高斯过程：一个方向捕获该梯度对目标预测的直接贡献，另一个通过与被条件化函数值的相关性聚合间接贡献；在Vecchia近似下，每次预测条件于d维中m个近邻输入，用至多2m个方向导数表示md个梯度坐标，每次预测目标的稠密分解代价为O(m^3)。对一般条件集，给出相对使用完整梯度的后验近似误差界，并刻画误差小或近似精确的条件。

Result: 仿真中，在相同条件集大小下，本方法精度与领先的精确梯度约简方法相当；由于成本随条件集大小增长更慢，可使用远超精确方法内存限制的条件集，以更少时间和内存达到更低预测误差；甚至比仅函数GP基线更省计算时间或内存。

Conclusion: 该两方向梯度表示使GP能高效利用梯度观测，在保持精度的同时大幅降低时间与内存开销，突破了精确梯度方法的规模限制。

Abstract: Gradient observations promise more accurate Gaussian process (GP) surrogates, but the cost of incorporating them has long stood in the way of realizing that promise. We propose a derivative GP with a budget of just two directions per observed gradient. One direction focuses on each gradient's direct contribution to target prediction, while the other aggregates its indirect contributions through correlations with the conditioning function values. Within a Vecchia approximation, where each prediction conditions on $m$ nearby inputs in $d$ dimensions, this construction represents their $md$ gradient coordinates using at most $2m$ directional derivatives, giving $\mathcal{O}(m^3)$ dense factorization cost per prediction target. For general conditioning sets, we bound the posterior approximation error relative to using full gradients and characterize when the error is small or the approximation is exact. In simulations, our method matches the accuracy of a leading exact gradient-reduction method at equal conditioning set size. Because its cost grows much more slowly with that size, it can use conditioning sets well beyond the memory limit of the exact method, reaching lower prediction error with a small fraction of the time and memory. Notably, our method can exploit gradient observations while requiring less computation time or memory than function-only GP baselines.

</details>


### [557] [Best Arm Identification for Bandits with Shifting Means](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10488)
*Lukas Zierahn,Wouter M. Koolen,Shubhada Agrawal,Christina Katsimerou,Dirk van der Hoeven*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出并研究"Shifting Means"（均值漂移）随机环境下的最佳臂识别问题：仅有臂间均值差稳定，公共漂移可由对手逐轮决定；证明基于GLRT的停止规则（含Track-and-Stop）失效，并提出ISM算法达到δ-正确及最优样本复杂度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典随机最佳臂识别假设各臂均值奖励随时间稳定，而现实中可能出现均值共同漂移、仅臂间差距保持稳定的情形。本文引入Shifting Means这一新型对抗扰动模型，弥补传统模型无法刻画此类时变环境的不足，并在固定置信度设定下研究其样本复杂度。

Method: 提出Shifting Means模型：$K$个臂的均值差$\boldsymbol\Delta$稳定，而公共漂移每轮可由对手任意选择。分析表明，采用广义似然比检验（GLRT）停止规则的算法（包括流行的Track-and-Stop）在时变漂移下失效。为此提出ISM（Importance Weights for Shifting Means）算法。在均值有界$U$、奖励$\sigma^2$-次高斯假设下，证明其$\delta$-正确性。

Result: ISM的样本复杂度为$K(\sigma^2+U^2)\Delta_{\min}^{-2}\ln\frac{1}{\delta}$量级；同时给出匹配（至常数因子）的最坏情况下界，并通过实验验证理论结果。

Conclusion: 在Shifting Means模型下，传统GLRT类方法不再适用，而ISM能够以近最优样本复杂度实现高概率最佳臂识别，为时变对抗环境下的最佳臂识别提供了理论保证与实证支持。

Abstract: We study the best arm identification problem in a stochastic environment with a novel form of adversarial perturbations, which we coin Shifting Means. While classically the mean rewards of the $K$ arms are stable in time, in Shifting Means only the gaps $\boldsymbolΔ$ between mean rewards are stable, while their common shift may be determined adversarially in each round. The objective of the learner is to identify the best arm with high probability while minimizing sample complexity (the fixed confidence setting). Handling shifts requires new tools: we show that algorithms employing a Generalized Likelihood Ratio Test (GLRT) stopping rule, including the popular Track-and-Stop, fail under time-varying shifts. Instead, we propose Importance Weights for Shifting Means ($\mathsf{ISM}$). Assuming means bounded by $U$ and $σ^2$-sub-Gaussian rewards, we show $\mathsf{ISM}$ to be $δ$-correct and to enjoy a sample complexity bound of order $K (σ^2 + U^2) Δ_{\min}^{-2} \ln \frac{1}δ$. We also present a matching (up to constant factors) worst-case lower bound and evaluate our results empirically.

</details>


<div id='cs.AI'></div>

# cs.AI [[Back]](#toc)

### [558] [BEACON-SP: Ontology-Grounded GraphRAG Framework for Clinical Suicide Risk Assessment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09026)
*Kemal Davaslioglu,Nathan Conger,Sastry Kompella,Yalin E. Sagduyu,Nathaniel D. Bastian*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出BEACON-SP：一种本体驱动的GraphRAG框架，用于行为健康（如自杀预防）临床决策支持，通过融合三步理论、IMV模型与SSDoH本体的自杀预防本体，构建患者知识图谱并引导多跳检索，在1500条查询基准上优于向量RAG基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 行为健康（如自杀预防）的有效评估需要整合异质的临床、行为、社会与时间证据，而传统向量检索RAG难以支撑跨诊断、用药、风险与保护因素、生活事件及时间关系的多跳推理，缺乏结构化的临床语境与证据溯源。

Method: 构建统一的自杀预防本体，整合三步理论（Three-Step Theory）、整合动机-意志模型（IMV）与自杀健康社会决定因素本体（SSDoH）；基于该本体构建患者知识图谱，并采用本体引导的检索实现多跳推理；在面向临床医生的问答任务上，与向量RAG基线对比，使用1500条查询、覆盖15个临床类别与100名患者的基准，并采用校正后的比较评估协议。

Result: 在完整性、临床相关性与证据依据方面均优于向量RAG基线，事实准确性有小幅提升；在成对的标准级比较中，GraphRAG在76.4%的案例中更受偏好。

Conclusion: 本体驱动的GraphRAG能够为临床决策支持提供结构化、语境化的患者证据，在行为健康决策支持场景中具有应用潜力。

Abstract: We present BEACON-SP, an ontology-grounded Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation (GraphRAG) framework for clinician-facing decision support in behavioral health settings such as suicide prevention, where effective assessment requires integrating heterogeneous clinical, behavioral, social, and temporal evidence. BEACON-SP combines patient knowledge graphs with ontology-guided retrieval to support multi-hop reasoning across diagnoses, medications, risk and protective factors, life events, and temporal relationships. The framework is enabled by a comprehensive suicide prevention ontology that integrates the Three-Step Theory, the Integrated Motivational-Volitional Model, and the Suicide Social Determinants of Health Ontology into a unified representation of patient risk factors. We construct ontology-grounded patient knowledge graphs and evaluate BEACON-SP for clinician-facing question answering. Compared with a vector-based retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) baseline on a 1,500-query benchmark spanning 15 clinical categories and 100 patients, BEACON-SP improves completeness, clinical relevance, and evidence grounding under a corrected comparative evaluation protocol, with a small gain on factual accuracy. In paired criterion-level comparisons, GraphRAG is preferred in 76.4% of cases. These results demonstrate the potential of ontology-guided GraphRAG to provide structured, contextualized patient evidence for clinical decision support.

</details>


### [559] [From High Recall to High Utility: Dataset-Adaptive Post-Processing of LLM-Generated Customer Intents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09039)
*Mahesh Viswanathan,Joan Rossello,Leticia Fernandes,Paul Mutawe*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出面向客户意图抽取（CIE）的数据集自适应后处理架构，将高召回LLM抽取输出转化为稳定、可追溯的意图单元，并给出两类下游应用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM可从异构企业数据中提取有用信号，但高召回抽取易产生重复、粒度不均、语义重叠或数量过大的输出，难以被下游系统与人工审阅有效使用。

Method: 将召回导向的抽取与效用导向的归约分离：先做来源特定预处理，从多模态方案、稀疏运营记录和结构化商机数据中隔离证据；再对候选意图标准化与去重，可选补充元数据以计算嵌入，映射到共享语义向量空间，并按候选集特征选择聚类策略；以簇级关键词提供可解释层，单例重分配需嵌入与关键词相似度一致；最后用受约束的LLM聚合，每簇生成一条简洁意图且不引入无依据概念，并保留来源、聚类、嵌入与生成元数据。

Result: 产出稳定、可追溯的意图单元，保留来源、聚类、嵌入与生成元数据；该后处理被视为语义归约层而非表面清理，可将高召回LLM输出转化为可复用企业智能；并展示两类下游应用：机器生成意图（借助相似画像的同侪客户为缺乏直接证据的客户推断可能目标）与意图引导的语义检索与映射（以稳定意图为查询对接下游决策空间，如将客户意图映射到业务结果）。

Conclusion: 后处理应被定位为语义归约层，将高召回LLM输出转化为可复用的企业智能；该方法支撑机器生成意图与意图引导语义检索等下游应用。

Abstract: Large language models can extract useful signals from heterogeneous enterprise data, but high-recall extraction often produces outputs that are duplicated, uneven in granularity, semantically overlapping, or too numerous for downstream systems and human reviewers to use effectively. We present a dataset-adaptive post-processing architecture developed for Customer Intent Extraction (CIE), where unstructured customer language is transformed into stable, traceable intent units. The approach separates recall-oriented extraction from utility-oriented reduction. Source-specific preprocessing first isolates evidence from multimodal plans, sparse operational records, and structured opportunity data. Candidate intents are then standardized and deduplicated, optionally enriched with metadata for embedding computation, represented in a shared semantic vector space, and grouped using a clustering strategy selected according to the candidate set's characteristics. Cluster-level keywords provide an explainability layer, while singleton reassignment requires agreement between embedding and keyword similarity. Finally, constrained language-model aggregation produces one concise intent per cluster without introducing unsupported concepts, and the resulting unit retains provenance, clustering, embedding, and generation metadata. This treats post-processing not as cosmetic cleanup, but as a semantic reduction layer converting high-recall LLM outputs into reusable enterprise intelligence. We also describe two downstream applications: Machine-Generated Intents, which infer likely objectives for customers lacking direct evidence from peer customers with similar profiles, and intent-guided semantic retrieval and mapping, which uses the stable intent as a query against a downstream decision space, illustrated here by mapping customer intents to business outcomes.

</details>


### [560] [Efficient Dense Crowd Trajectory Prediction Via Dynamic Clustering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.18166)
*Antonius Bima Murti Wijaya,Paul Henderson,Marwa Mahmoud*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种基于聚类的群体轨迹预测方法，将相似属性个体随时间分组并给出质心代替行人输入，作为即插即用模块可与现有预测器结合，在保持精度的同时提升速度并降低内存占用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人群轨迹预测对公共安全和管理（如预防踩踏等灾害）具有重要意义。现有工作依赖人工标注数据预测个体轨迹并考虑周围目标，但往往忽视密集人群场景；在该场景下，跟踪输出具有大规模、噪声大、不准确等问题，导致自动化挑战加剧且计算成本高昂。

Method: 提出并系统评估一种新的基于聚类的方法：将具有相似属性的个体随时间进行分组，通过准确的群体汇总（group summarisation）实现更快的执行。该方法为即插即用（plug-and-play）设计，可用所输出的群体质心（centroid）替代原有行人输入，从而与现有轨迹预测器结合。

Result: 在多个具有挑战性的密集人群场景上进行了评估，结果表明：与当前最先进方法相比，该方法处理速度更快、内存占用更低，同时保持预测精度。

Conclusion: 基于聚类与群体汇总的思路能有效缓解密集人群场景中跟踪输出的噪声、规模与不准确问题，在不牺牲精度的前提下提升效率，且因即插即用特性具备良好的通用性与扩展性。

Abstract: Crowd trajectory prediction plays a crucial role in public safety and management, where it can help prevent disasters such as stampedes. Recent works address the problem by predicting individual trajectories and considering surrounding objects based on manually annotated data. However, these approaches tend to overlook dense crowd scenarios, where the challenges of automation become more pronounced due to the massiveness, noisiness, and inaccuracy of the tracking outputs, resulting in high computational costs. To address these challenges, we propose and extensively evaluate a novel cluster-based approach that groups individuals based on similar attributes over time, enabling faster execution through accurate group summarisation. Our plug-and-play method can be combined with existing trajectory predictors by using our output centroid in place of their pedestrian input. We evaluate our proposed method on several challenging dense crowd scenes. We demonstrated that our approach leads to faster processing and lower memory usage when compared with state-of-the-art methods, while maintaining the accuracy

</details>


### [561] [GAGR-Lab: Evaluating Joint Spatial-Geometric and Analytic Function Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10201)
*Jingyao Zhang,Yun Li,Lu Han*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出 GAGR-Lab 框架，用于评估模型将空间配置转化为符号函数并满足几何约束的能力，但仅完成小规模试点，未发现目标命中。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联合空间几何与解析函数推理需要把感知到的空间配置转化为符号函数，并使其执行轨迹满足几何约束。现有研究缺乏对"符号合规性"与"几何成功"分离测量的操作化框架。

Method: 通过笛卡尔游戏场景、显式函数语义和权威 Rust 轨迹执行构建 GAGR-Lab；区分空间感知、度量接地、几何关系、函数解释、函数构造、约束合成六类能力；设计四个可配置场景难度预设与前瞻性 24 单元诊断方案。对 Llama 3.2 11B Vision Instruct 进行有界试点（两个 API 凭据作执行副本），并设置特权解析搜索作为上界对照。

Result: 试点得到 72 个平衡游戏、432 次尝试、429 个有效响应，无目标命中；普通函数提示变体同样失败，结构化定位接口无可评分输出。特权解析搜索在 300 个生成场景的 600 个方向性案例上独立成功，具有精确可重复性，并通过 1,200 次垂直反射/平移检查。

Conclusion: 该工作贡献是一个带已执行试点的操作性研究框架与明确的前瞻性研究计划；框架分离了服务可靠性、符号合规性与几何成功，并保留精确的模型可见输入与实现路径，但完整难度矩阵与多模型对比结果仍待验证。

Abstract: Joint spatial-geometric and analytic function reasoning requires translating a perceived spatial configuration into a symbolic function whose executed curve satisfies geometric constraints. We present GAGR-Lab, a framework for measuring this capability through Cartesian game scenes, explicit function semantics, and authoritative Rust trajectory execution. It distinguishes spatial perception, metric grounding, geometric relations, function interpretation, function construction, and constrained synthesis. We specify four configurable scene-difficulty presets and a prospective 24-cell diagnostic design, while reporting only the subset actually evaluated. A bounded pilot of one hosted model (Llama 3.2 11B Vision Instruct) using two API credentials as execution replicas yields 72 balanced games with 432 attempts, 429 valid provider responses, and no target hits; exploratory ordinary-function prompt variants also fail to hit, while the structured localization interface yields no scoreable outputs. A privileged analytic search control independently succeeds on 600 directional cases from 300 generated scenes, with exact repeatability and 1,200 successful vertical-reflection or translation checks. The framework separates serving reliability, symbolic compliance, and geometric success, and preserves exact model-visible inputs and realized paths. A staged protocol outlines diagnostic calibration, held-out replication, multi-model comparison, and paired robustness tests. The contribution is an operational research framework with an executed pilot and a clearly identified prospective study plan; the full difficulty matrix and comparative model results remain untested.

</details>


### [562] [Humanity's Sixth Sense: Benchmarking Intuitive Visual Reasoning in Multimodal Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08966)
*Xingang Guo,Jing Gu,Brian Jang,Renxiong Wang,Utkarsh Tyagi,Daniel Quigley,Steven Li,David Yan,Daniel Yue Zhang,Darvin Yi,Forrest Huang,HiJae Kim,Tianyi Zhang,Jared Lichtarge,Jihua Huang,Le Xue,Manan Tomar,Qiuyi Richard Zhang,Ruofei Yu,Seth Neel,Yaning Hu,Marcella Valentine,Xinzhe Jiang,Daniel Evans,Chenguang Wang,Dustin Tran,Tong Zhao,Yinfei Yang,Yunzhong He*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出 Humanity's Sixth Sense (HSS) 基准，用于评测多模态大模型在"直觉性视觉推理"（即从图像/视频中快速、零样本恢复隐含的时序、空间、社会与抽象信息）上的能力。结果显示人类准确率 93.1%，最强模型 GPT-6-astra 仅 53.6%，即便引入动态视觉操作的智能体框架也只能缩小而非消除差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类能在一瞥之间推断场景中的隐含信息（如过去成因、未来轨迹、社会权威关系、抽象隐性规则），这种"第六感"式直觉推理是日常导航与社会交互的基础，也是与人类共处的多模态大模型所需的关键能力。然而现有视觉基准要么聚焦学术/数学领域的专家级深度分析，要么停留在低层感知，几乎未评测人类的直觉性推理，形成评测空白。

Method: 构建 HSS 基准：涵盖多样化图像与视频输入，按结构化分类体系组织条目，并为每条配以人工撰写的提示词，探测人类一瞥即可推断的隐含时序、空间、社会和抽象结构；同时探索应用动态视觉操作的智能体（agentic）设定。

Result: 人类参与者准确率达 93.1%，而最强前沿模型 GPT-6-astra 在最大推理努力下仅 53.6%；当前模型虽在需要高级感知与知识的复杂任务上表现出色，但在这类对人类而言直观的视觉任务上仍显著落后。智能体化设置可缩小但无法弥合该差距。

Conclusion: HSS 将直觉性视觉推理确立为可测量的评测维度，指出该能力是当前基准上的规模化扩展尚未触及的方向，呼吁研究关注这一对人类至关重要的能力短板。

Abstract: Humans perceive far more in a scene than what is explicitly depicted: a single glance captures past causes and future trajectories; a quick peek determines if a vehicle can fit between two parked cars; a few seconds of video reveals who holds authority in a room; and a fleeting clip highlights subtle abstract patterns like unwritten rules or hidden labels. This capacity reflects a form of humanity's sixth sense: an intuitive reasoning mechanism that recovers implicit information beyond raw sensory perception. Crucially, this rapid, zero-shot visual intuition underpins everyday navigation and social interaction, making it a vital capability for Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) deployed alongside people. Existing visual benchmarks, however, target either deliberate expert-level analysis in academic and mathematical domains or low-level perception, leaving the intuitive reasoning that people perform largely untested. To bridge this gap, we introduce Humanity's Sixth Sense (HSS), a benchmark for intuitive visual reasoning. HSS spans diverse image and video inputs, organizes items under a structured taxonomy, and pairs each with human-written prompts probing the implicit temporal, spatial, social, and abstract structure that people infer at a glance. Frontier MLLMs fall short of human performance: participants reach 93.1% accuracy, while the strongest model, GPT-6-astra, reaches only 53.6% even at maximum reasoning effort. Despite excelling in many complex tasks that require advanced perception and knowledge, current models still struggle significantly on these visual tasks that are intuitive for humans. We further explore agentic setup that apply dynamic visual manipulation to HSS, which narrows but does not close the gap. HSS establishes intuitive visual reasoning as a measurable axis and directs attention to a capability that scaling on current benchmarks has so far left behind.

</details>


### [563] [Shared-Roadmap Generation and Evaluator for Multi-Agent Path Planning Using Heterogeneous Graph Neural Network](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09034)
*Brandon Ho,Nikola Rogers,Seung-Kyum Choi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种可扩展的异构图神经网络（GNN）框架，用于自动生成与评估共享多智能体路网图，通过将路标点、智能体位置与任务位置建模为异构节点，学习裁剪冗余节点与边，从而在连续环境中降低规划开销并提升解质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 连续环境下的多智能体路径规划（MAPP）通常依赖路网图（roadmap）来兼顾安全性与搜索效率，但传统路网图生成方法（如栅格规划或标准采样方法）在图的密度与找到可行、高质量解的可能性之间存在权衡：图过密则搜索开销大，图过稀则可能丢失优质解。因此需要一个能自动生成紧凑且协调感知路网图的框架。

Method: 提出可扩展的异构GNN框架。将三类实体——路标点（waypoints）、智能体位置（agent locations）与任务位置（task locations）——表示为异构图中的不同节点类型，使模型能够对全局连通性与智能体间交互进行推理。利用由专家求解器轨迹聚合采集的占用密度图（occupation density maps）进行训练，使GNN学会识别关键兴趣点，并裁剪冗余的节点与边。最终生成的路网图对任务排列具有不变性，且可在多智能体取送（pick and delivery）任务中复用。

Result: 实验结果表明，该框架能够减少规划开销，并有可能找到更优解；在稠密路网图上，运行时间与图规模均至少降低40%。

Conclusion: 该工作表明，基于异构GNN的自动路网图生成与评估能够在保证解质量的前提下显著压缩图规模并提升规划效率，为连续环境中的多智能体路径规划提供了一种可扩展、任务可复用的路网图构建范式。

Abstract: Multi-agent path planning (MAPP) in continuous environments often relies on roadmaps to balance safety and search efficiency. However, traditional roadmap generation methods, such as lattice grids or standard sampling-based approaches, frequently face a trade-off between graph density and the likelihood of finding feasible, high-quality solutions. In this paper, we propose a scalable heterogeneous Graph Neural Network (GNN) framework for the automated generation and evaluation of shared multi-agent roadmaps. Our model covers the representation of waypoints, agent locations, and task locations as distinct nodes in a heterogeneous graph, allowing it to reason over global connectivity and inter-agent interactions. By training on occupation density maps aggregated and collected from expert solver trajectories, the GNN learns to identify critical points of interest and prune redundant nodes and edges. This process produces a compact, coordination-aware roadmap that is invariant to task permutations and is reusable for multi-agent pick and delivery tasks. Experimental results demonstrate that our framework can reduce planning effort and can potentially find better solutions, reaching at least 40% reduction in runtime and in graph size for dense roadmaps.

</details>


### [564] [Learning Situation-Conditioned Thinking Policies for Long-Term LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09590)
*Hong Su*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"情境条件化思维记忆"框架，将历史推理经验转化为轻量策略，用于预测当前情境下"该思考什么"，而把具体推理交给大语言模型；并通过跨片段周期分析发现长程规律，固化为新思维知识并被策略内化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长期运行的自主智能体必须复用累积的推理经验，但又不能让显式历史记忆和LLM上下文无限增长。现有记忆机制主要做检索、摘要或压缩，不能直接学习"何时应激活何种思考"，也无法从时间上分散的经验中发现新的思维知识。

Method: 提出情境条件化思维记忆框架：将历史推理经验转化为一个轻量策略，用于预测当前情境下应思考的内容，具体推理仍由LLM完成；情境可表示时间或时空演化，而非仅当前状态；对临时经验按多个独立片段周期性分析，识别重复出现的长程规律，固化为新思维知识，并由轻量策略进一步内化。

Result: 在时序规则泛化上取得1.000 F1；将DeepSeek推理F1从0.789提升至0.868；在30,000条历史情境下，在线处理时间从0.3636 ms/查询降至0.0382 ms/查询；在积累足够跨经验重复证据后，关系发现F1与未来思维准确率均达1.000。

Conclusion: 结果表明，该框架能在不无限扩张记忆与上下文的前提下，有效复用、巩固并内化历史推理经验，兼顾推理性能提升与在线效率，并支持长程规律与关系发现。

Abstract: Long-running autonomous agents must reuse accumulated reasoning experience without allowing explicit historical memory and LLM context to grow indefinitely. However, existing memory mechanisms mainly retrieve, summarize, or compress past content and do not directly learn when particular kinds of thinking should be activated or discover new thinking knowledge from temporally dispersed experiences. This paper proposes a situation-conditioned thinking memory framework that transforms historical reasoning experience into a lightweight policy for predicting what should be thought about in the current situation, while leaving detailed reasoning to a large language model. Situations may represent temporal or spatiotemporal evolution rather than only current states. Temporary experiences are also periodically analyzed across multiple independent episodes to identify repeated long-range regularities, which are consolidated into new thinking knowledge and further internalized by the lightweight policy. Experiments show that the learned policy achieves 1.000 F1 on temporal-rule generalization, improves DeepSeek reasoning F1 from 0.789 to 0.868, reduces online processing time from 0.3636 ms to 0.0382 ms per query at 30,000 historical situations, and reaches 1.000 relation-discovery F1 and future-thinking accuracy after sufficient repeated cross-experience evidence.

</details>


### [565] [MeshSIPP: Efficient Lattice Planning in Dynamic Environment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09652)
*Marat Agranovskiy,Konstantin Yakovlev*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出MeshSIPP规划器，通过将运动基元作为空间束（spatial bundle）批量传播与验证，消除状态格栅+Safe Interval Path Planning中因丰富基元集导致的高分支因子瓶颈，实现动态环境下满足非完整约束的时空轨迹规划。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动态环境中自主导航需满足非完整运动约束的时空轨迹。基于预计算可行运动基元构建的状态格栅配合SIPP（Safe Interval Path Planning）是具备理论保证的搜索方案，但为平滑导航所需的丰富基元集导致分支因子过大，与时间依赖的障碍区间结合后计算代价高昂。

Method: MeshSIPP利用许多基元扫掠相同区域这一特性，将其作为空间束（spatial bundle）一并传播与验证；采用轻量级包围区间（bounding-interval）检查进行快速筛选，把昂贵的精确出发时间搜索延迟到基元到达终止状态时执行；并引入时间感知剪枝规则，在搜索早期丢弃冗余的时空分支。

Result: 在6,000多个基准实例及ROS 2实时仿真上的大量实验表明，MeshSIPP相比当前最先进的时空规划器最高可获得约3倍加速，且理论上被证明搜索是完备且最优的。

Conclusion: MeshSIPP通过空间束批量传播、包围区间筛选与延迟精确出发时间搜索，有效缓解了状态格栅+SIPP的时空搜索瓶颈，在保持完备性与最优性的同时显著提升规划效率。

Abstract: Autonomous navigation in dynamic environments requires computing spatiotemporal trajectories that satisfy non-holonomic motion constraints. When the trajectories of the moving obstacles are predictable or known, a promising approach is to rely on the combination of state lattices constructed from precomputed feasible motion primitives and Safe Interval Path Planning -- a search-based algorithm with strong theoretical guarantees. While this approach yields feasible paths, the rich primitive sets needed for smooth navigation induce a large branching factor, which becomes costly when coupled with time-dependent obstacle intervals. To this end, we present MeshSIPP, an efficient planner that removes the computational bottleneck by exploiting the fact that many primitives sweep the same regions and can therefore be validated together. MeshSIPP propagates primitives as spatial bundles, screens them with lightweight bounding-interval checks, and defers the expensive exact departure-time search until a primitive reaches its terminal state. A time-aware pruning rule additionally discards redundant space-time branches early in the search. We prove that the resulting search is complete and optimal. Extensive experiments over more than 6,000 benchmark instances and real-time ROS~2 simulations show that MeshSIPP achieves up to a 3$\times$ speedup over state-of-the-art spatiotemporal planners.

</details>


### [566] [RoboJEPA: Scaling Robotic Latent World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10515)
*Artem Zholus,Nicolas Beltran-Velez,Jianhao Yuan,Sarath Chandar,Tushar Nagarajan,Daniel Severo,Koustuv Sinha,Michal Drozdzal,Adriana Romero Soriano,Jeannette Bohg,Nicolas Ballas,Mahmoud Assran*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出RoboJEPA——基于JEPA架构、在12种机器人本体数据上训练的世界模型，首次为真实机器人多本体世界模型建立缩放定律：想象误差随计算量呈二阶幂律，可外推预测模型质量；下游规划性能随计算量可预测提升并与想象误差强相关；模型可零样本部署为机器人智能体完成长时程规划；8B参数为迄今最大JEPA预测器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 潜在世界模型在状态预测与真实世界规划方面表现优异，但学界缺乏一种原则性方法来估计其能力如何随模型规模、数据量和计算量缩放，这一开放问题制约了领域进展。此外，真实机器人评估成本高，亟需可靠的代理指标。

Method: 构建RoboJEPA，一种基于联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）的潜在世界模型，在覆盖12种机器人本体的大规模数据集上训练。通过分析想象误差（潜在推演的误差）与计算量的关系拟合缩放定律，并考察其与下游规划性能的相关性；进一步将模型零样本部署到真实硬件，以单张目标图像为规划目标执行长时程任务。

Result: RoboJEPA的想象误差随计算量遵循二阶幂律，可外推预测远超拟合尺度之外的模型质量；下游机器人规划性能随计算量可预测地提升，且想象误差与其强相关，可作为真实机器人评估的可靠代理指标；潜在世界模型能零样本部署为机器人智能体，在真实硬件上完成需要长时程规划的任务（仅需单张目标图像）。

Conclusion: 据作者所知，这是首个为基于真实机器人数据训练的多本体世界模型建立缩放定律的工作；RoboJEPA以8B参数成为迄今训练的最大JEPA预测器模型。所有模型检查点、训练与机器人部署代码均已开源。

Abstract: Latent world models have shown a remarkable ability to predict future states and to plan in the real world. In practice, however, we lack a principled way to estimate how their capabilities scale with model size, data, and compute, an open problem that slows progress in the field. In this work we present RoboJEPA, a world model based on the Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) and trained on a large-scale dataset spanning 12 robotic embodiments. We show that RoboJEPA's imagination error, the error of its latent rollouts, follows a second-order power law in compute, allowing us to predict model quality well beyond the scale at which the law is fit. We further show that downstream robotic planning performance improves predictably with compute, and that imagination error is strongly correlated with it, making it a reliable proxy for real-robot evaluation. Finally, we demonstrate that latent world models can be deployed zero-shot as robotic agents, planning toward a single goal image to solve tasks requiring long-horizon planning on real hardware. We release all model checkpoints together with our training and robot deployment code. To our knowledge, this is the first work to establish scaling laws for multi-embodiment robotic world models trained on real robot data, and RoboJEPA, at 8B parameters, is the largest JEPA predictor model trained to date.

</details>


### [567] [Outperformance Inverse Optimization: Learning Objective Functions that Outperform Agent Decisions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09890)
*Akira Kitaoka*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"优超逆优化"（outperformance inverse optimization），寻找在每个状态下能产生在各分量上均优于观测动作的最优解的权重，并给出可用前向问题预言机评估的损失函数及梯度与DC优化算法，理论上证明了泛化误差界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有逆优化方法针对混合整数线性规划（MILP）时，目标是复现观测为最优解，因此当观测为次优解时只能学到妥协权重，无法刻画"更优"的决策意图。作者希望转向学习能产生超越观测动作的权重。

Method: 提出outperformance inverse optimization框架，寻求在每个状态使最优解在所有分量上优超（outperform）观测动作的权重；构造仅依赖前向问题预言机即可评估的损失函数，因此适用于MILP；采用基于梯度的算法与DC（difference of convex）优化算法最小化该损失。

Result: 理论方面：对能在所有观测上诱导唯一优超最优解的权重，证明在新状态上无法诱导此类解的泛化误差概率被一个与观测数成反比的量所界定，且该界在观测数上至多相差对数因子是紧的。实验方面：在合成与真实数据上，所提方法在预测优超动作的解方面优于现有方法。

Conclusion: 通过从"复现观测"转向"优超观测"，该方法为MILP逆优化提供了可计算的损失与优化算法，并给出了具有紧性的泛化保证，实验中提升了优超解的预测性能。

Abstract: Inverse optimization estimates the weights of an objective function that explain observed decisions as optimal solutions, and is used in a variety of fields. For mixed-integer linear programs (MILPs), existing methods aim to reproduce the observations as optimal solutions, and thus learn compromise weights when the observations are suboptimal.
